examples.mandarin_sentence: 我深感抱歉，未能按时完成工作。
examples.english_sentence: I deeply apologize for being unable to finish the work on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我深感榮幸能夠參與今次項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sam1 gam2 wing4 hang6 nang4 gau3 caam1 jyu5 gam1 ci3 hong6 muk6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我深感荣幸能够参与此次项目。
examples.english_sentence: I feel deeply honored to be able to participate in this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到你成功，我深感欣慰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 nei5 sing4 gung1, ngo5 sam1 gam2 jan1 wai6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到你成功，我深感欣慰。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing about your success, I feel deeply gratified.

mandarin_meaning: 深水埗（香港九龍的一個地區）
english_meaning: Sham Shui Po (a district in Kowloon, Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 深水埗是香港九龍的一個舊式社區，歷史悠久，以電子零件、布料市場、小食與平價商店聞名，人口多為工薪階層及地區居民。
explanation_english: Sham Shui Po is an older district in Kowloon, Hong Kong, known for its history, electronics and fabric markets, affordable eateries and shops, and a predominantly working‑class local population.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去深水埗買手機零件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 sam1 seoi2 bou2 maai5 sau2 gei1 ling4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去深水埗买手机零件。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Sham Shui Po tomorrow to buy phone parts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 深水埗有好多平價電子用品同布料市場，行街好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 seoi2 bou2 jau5 hou2 do1 ping4 gaa3 din6 zi2 jung6 ban2 tung4 bou3 liu6 si5 coeng4, haang4 gaai1 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 深水埗有很多平价电子用品和布料市场，逛街很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Sham Shui Po has many affordable electronics shops and fabric markets; it's very convenient for shopping.

mandarin_meaning: 深沉（沉靜、內斂、聲音低沉）
english_meaning: deep; reserved; solemn; having a deep or heavy tone (voice/personality)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人性格沉靜、內斂或聲音低沉、沉穩，有時帶有莊重或難以看透的感覺。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is quiet, reserved, or profound; can refer to a deep or heavy voice, a solemn mood, or an inward, hard-to-read personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好深沉，唔會隨便表露感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 sam1 cam4, m4 wui5 ceoi4 bin6 biu2 lou6 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她這個人很深沉，不會隨便表露感情。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very reserved and doesn't show emotions easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅聲線好深沉，好有磁性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 seng1 sin3 hou2 sam1 cam4, hou2 jau5 ci4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她說話的聲音很深沉，很有磁性。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her voice is deep and resonant, very magnetic.

mandarin_meaning: 深海（海洋中水深的海域）
english_meaning: deep sea; deep ocean
explanation_mandarin: 指海洋中水深的海域，通常位於遠離岸邊或接近海溝的地方。也可泛指難以接觸或探索的深處。
explanation_english: Refers to parts of the ocean with great depth, typically far from shore or near ocean trenches. Can also figuratively mean a deep, hard-to-reach or explore area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定做潛水員，去深海研究海洋生物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 zou6 cim4 seoi2 jyun4, heoi3 sam1 hoi2 jin4 gau3 hoi2 joeng4 saang1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他決定當潛水員，去深海研究海洋生物。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to become a diver and go to the deep sea to study marine life.

mandarin_meaning: 深海石斑（深海石斑魚）
english_meaning: deep-sea grouper (a type of grouper fish found in deep waters)
explanation_mandarin: 指生活在深海的石斑魚，常見於海鮮市場或高檔餐廳，肉質鮮嫩、價格較高。
explanation_english: Refers to groupers that inhabit deep-sea environments. Commonly found in seafood markets and high-end restaurants; the flesh is tender and often commands a higher price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條深海石斑好新鮮，可以蒸或者煎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sam1 hoi2 sek6 baan1 hou2 san1 sin1, ho2 ji5 zing1 waak6 ze2 zin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條深海石斑很新鮮，可以蒸或煎。
examples.english_sentence: This deep-sea grouper is very fresh and can be steamed or pan-fried.

mandarin_meaning: 深深（shēnshēn）
english_meaning: deeply; profoundly
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深或感情強烈，通常作副词使用，用來修飾感情、印象、記憶等，例如「深深感激」、「深深記得」。
explanation_english: Indicates a great depth or intensity; commonly used as an adverb to modify emotions, impressions, memories, etc. e.g., "deeply grateful", "deeply remember".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對你深深感激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 nei5 sam1 sam1 gam2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對你深深感激。
examples.english_sentence: I am deeply grateful to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我深深記住呢句說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sam1 sam1 gei3 zyu6 ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我深深記住這句話。
examples.english_sentence: I remember this sentence deeply.

mandarin_meaning: 深渊
english_meaning: abyss; chasm; profound gulf (literal or metaphorical)
explanation_mandarin: 指非常深的洞穴或谷底，亦常用作比喻表示極大的危險、困境或絕望。
explanation_english: Refers to a very deep chasm or pit; often used metaphorically to describe a profound danger, dire predicament, or despair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條裂縫下面係一個深淵，唔好企太近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 lit6 fung3 haa6 min6 hai6 jat1 go3 sam1 jyun4, m4 hou2 kei5 taai3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那道裂缝下面有一个深渊，别站太近。
examples.english_sentence: There is an abyss beneath that crack; don't stand too close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由希望跌入深淵，令人感到絕望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 hei1 mong6 dit3 jap6 sam1 jyun4, ling6 jan4 gam2 dou3 zyut6 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从希望跌入深渊，让人感到绝望。
examples.english_sentence: He fell from hope into an abyss, leaving people feeling utterly hopeless.

mandarin_meaning: 深浅；深度或程度（包括顏色的深淺、事物的深淺）
english_meaning: depth; degree; shade (how deep or shallow something is, including color shade or extent)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物的深或淺，可以指水、洞、顏色的深淺，或比喻指事情、問題、程度的深度。通常作名詞使用。
explanation_english: Refers to how deep or shallow something is. It can describe literal depth (e.g., water), color shade, or metaphorically the degree/seriousness of an issue. Used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條河嘅深淺好唔穩定，落雨之後更加危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 ho4 ge3 sam1 cin2 hou2 m4 wan6 ding6, lok6 jyu5 zi1 hau6 gaang1 gaa1 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條河的深淺很不穩定，雨後更加危險。
examples.english_sentence: The depth of this river is unstable; it's more dangerous after rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅顏色深淺有分別，深色睇落會顯瘦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 sam1 cin2 jau5 fan1 bit6, sam1 sik1 tai2 lok6 wui5 hin2 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服的顏色深淺有分別，深色看起來更顯瘦。
examples.english_sentence: The shade of this garment varies; darker colors make you look slimmer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要評論一件事嘅深淺，唔可以淨係靠表面資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 ping4 leon6 jat1 gin6 si6 ge3 sam1 cin2, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 kaau3 biu2 min6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要評論一件事的深淺，不能只靠表面資料。
examples.english_sentence: To judge how deep/serious a matter is, you can't rely only on surface information.

mandarin_meaning: 深溝高壘（原指防禦工事，借指防守嚴密、堅固）
english_meaning: Deep trenches and high ramparts — originally military defenses; figuratively, extremely well-defended or impregnable
explanation_mandarin: 原指軍事上的深溝與高壘等防禦工事，後用作比喻表示戒備嚴密、守衛堅固，不易被攻破或滲透。
explanation_english: Literally refers to military defenses of deep ditches and high ramparts. Figuratively used to describe something very well-protected or fortified, difficult to breach or penetrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢層保安做得好，深溝高壘，外人好難入內。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cang4 bou2 on1 zou6 dak1 hou2, sam1 gau1 gou1 leoi5, ngoi6 jan4 hou2 naan4 jap6 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這層保安做得很嚴密，深溝高壘，外人很難進入。
examples.english_sentence: The security on this level is tight — deep trenches and high ramparts; outsiders can hardly get in.

mandarin_meaning: 深潜
english_meaning: deep dive; scuba diving; to delve deeply
explanation_mandarin: 指在水下進行潛水，尤其是深入水下或進行水肺潛水；也可比喻深入探討某個議題或問題。
explanation_english: Refers to diving underwater, especially deep diving or scuba diving; can also be used figuratively to mean delving deeply into a topic or issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個星期去深潛，順便睇下珊瑚礁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 heoi3 sam1 cim4, seon6 bin6 tai2 haa5 saan1 wu4 ziu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下個星期去深潛，順便看看珊瑚礁。
examples.english_sentence: We're going deep-diving next week and will check out the coral reefs.

mandarin_meaning: 深痛惡絕（對某人或某事極端憎惡、痛恨）
english_meaning: to detest utterly; to hate intensely and feel absolute loathing
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事懷有極深的憎恨和厭惡，恨到極點，毫無寬恕或容忍之意。
explanation_english: Expresses extreme hatred and loathing toward someone or something, to the point of complete rejection with no tolerance or forgiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗啲好可怕嘅事，大家對佢深痛惡絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 di1 hou2 ho2 paa3 ge3 si6, daai6 gaa1 deoi3 keoi5 sam1 tung3 ok3 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了很可怕的事，大家對他深痛惡絕。
examples.english_sentence: He did something terrible; everyone detests him utterly.

mandarin_meaning: 深切地知道；非常了解
english_meaning: to know deeply; to be well aware of
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事或某種情況有深刻的了解或認識，強調程度深。
explanation_english: Indicates having a deep or thorough understanding or awareness of something; emphasizes the depth of knowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我深知你嘅困難，但係我會聽你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sam1 zi1 nei5 ge3 gwan3 naan4 , daan6 hai6 ngo5 wui5 teng1 nei5 gong2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我深知你的困难，但我会倾听你。
examples.english_sentence: I am well aware of your difficulties, but I will listen to you.

mandarin_meaning: 深秋（秋季後期）
english_meaning: late autumn; deep autumn
explanation_mandarin: 指秋季的後期，天氣漸冷，樹葉大量凋落，常用來描述秋天接近尾聲的時期。
explanation_english: Refers to the later part of autumn when temperatures drop and leaves fall; used to describe the period near the end of the autumn season.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 深秋嘅早晨已經有啲凍，記得著多件外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 cau1 ge3 zou2 san4 ji5 ging1 jau5 di1 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 深秋的早晨已經有點冷，記得多穿一件外套。
examples.english_sentence: The mornings in late autumn are already a bit cold; remember to wear an extra jacket.

mandarin_meaning: 深究；深入探究、追究（某事的原因、細節或責任）
english_meaning: to investigate thoroughly; to probe into; to delve into
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事進行深入追問或探討，通常指探查原因、細節或責任。
explanation_english: Indicates investigating something thoroughly, probing into causes, details, or responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想深究佢嘅過去，想向前看。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sam1 gau3 keoi5 ge3 gwo3 heoi3, soeng2 hoeng3 cin4 hon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想深究他的過去，想向前看。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to probe into his past; I want to look forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官唔會深究呢啲細節，除非有證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gwan1 m4 wui5 sam1 gau3 ni1 di1 sai3 zit3, ceoi4 fei1 jau5 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官不會深究這些細節，除非有證據。
examples.english_sentence: The judge won't delve into those details unless there's evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好再深究佢，彼此都需要休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zoi3 sam1 gau3 keoi5, bei2 ci2 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們不要再深究他了，彼此都需要休息。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not dig into him anymore; we both need a break.

mandarin_meaning: 笔迹重（笔画浓、墨迹深）的字
english_meaning: characters/handwriting written with heavy/dark strokes; heavy-inked handwriting
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容字迹笔画较深、笔压或墨迹较重的写法，常指书写显得用力或墨迹浓重，影响清晰度或美观。
explanation_english: Describes handwriting or characters written with heavy, dark strokes—either due to strong pen pressure or heavy ink. It often implies the writing looks forceful or overly dark, which can affect legibility or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢封信入面啲深筆字好難睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fung1 seon3 jap6 min6 di1 saam1 bat1 zi6 hou2 naan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这封信里面的笔迹太重，很难看清。
examples.english_sentence: The handwriting in this letter is very dark; it's hard to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫字成日都有啲深筆字，感覺好用力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zi6 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 di1 saam1 bat1 zi6, gam2 gok3 hou2 jung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写字经常有些笔画很重，感觉用力很猛。
examples.english_sentence: He often writes with heavy strokes; it looks forceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畫漫畫要控制筆觸，唔好成日畫到深筆字，會影響層次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 maan6 waa6 jiu3 hung3 zi3 bat1 cuk1, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 waa6 dou3 saam1 bat1 zi6, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 cang4 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 画漫画要控制笔触，不要总是画得笔迹太重，会影响层次感。
examples.english_sentence: When drawing comics you should control your strokes; don't always make them too heavy, it will affect the sense of depth.

mandarin_meaning: 深入耕耘、细致打磨或精耕细作（比喻在某一领域做深入、细致的工作）
english_meaning: To cultivate thoroughly and work meticulously; to do in-depth, careful work (often used metaphorically)
explanation_mandarin: 原指农事中仔细耕作，现常比喻在某一领域做深入、细致的工作或经营，强调精细与持续投入。
explanation_english: Originally referred to careful agricultural tilling; now used metaphorically to mean doing thorough, meticulous work or cultivation in a field, emphasizing careful, sustained effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今次要喺本地市場深耕細作，慢慢建立品牌認知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 gam1ci3 jiu3 hai2 bun2dei6 si5coeng4 sam1 gang1 sai3 zok3, maan6maan6 gin3laap6 ban1paai4 jing6zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司这次要在本地市场深耕细作，慢慢建立品牌认知。
examples.english_sentence: This time the company will do in-depth, meticulous work in the local market to gradually build brand awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農夫春天要深耕細作，先至有好收成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4fu1 ceon1tin1 jiu3 sam1 gang1 sai3 zok3, sin1zi3 jau5 hou2 sau1sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农夫春天要深耕细作，才会有好收成。
examples.english_sentence: Farmers need to till and work carefully in spring to get a good harvest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做內容要深耕細作，唔好只浮於表面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 noi6jung4 jiu3 sam1 gang1 sai3 zok3, m4 hou2 zi2 fau4 jyu1 biu2min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做内容要深耕细作，不能只停留在表面。
examples.english_sentence: When producing content, you should work in-depth and carefully, not just stay on the surface.

mandarin_meaning: 深色（shēn sè）
english_meaning: dark color; dark-colored
explanation_mandarin: 表示顏色偏深、較暗的顏色，例如深藍、深綠等。可用來形容衣物、油漆、畫作等色調。
explanation_english: Refers to colors that are deep or dark (e.g., dark blue, dark green). Used to describe the color tone of clothing, paint, paintings, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意著深色衫，睇落精神啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 sam1 sik1 saam1, tai2 lok6 zing1 san4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡穿深色的衣服，看起來精神一點。
examples.english_sentence: I like wearing dark-colored clothes; they make me look more energetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫用咗深色，層次感好強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 jung6 zo2 sam1 sik1, cang4 ci3 gam2 hou2 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫用了深色，層次感很強。
examples.english_sentence: This painting uses dark colors and has a strong sense of depth.

mandarin_meaning: 深藏不露（形容隱藏才能、不輕易顯露）
english_meaning: to conceal one's abilities; to keep a low profile despite having talents or strengths
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人有深厚的才能或實力，但不輕易表現或炫耀，給人低調隱忍的印象。
explanation_english: Describes someone who hides their true abilities or strengths and does not show them off, appearing low-key while actually very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時好低調，原來係深藏不露，做事能力好強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 hou2 dai1 diu6, jyun4 loi4 hai6 sam1 cong4 bat1 lou6, zou6 si6 nang4 lik6 hou2 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平時很低調，原來是深藏不露，做事能力很強。
examples.english_sentence: He is usually very low-key, but it turns out he's hiding his talents and is very capable at work.

mandarin_meaning: 深表（深切地表示）
english_meaning: to express deeply; to convey (feelings) profoundly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（及物，書面／正式用語）
explanation_mandarin: 「深表」常用於書面或正式語境，後接情感名詞（如遺憾、感謝、慰問、關切等），表示深切地表達某種情感或態度。
explanation_english: A formal phrase used to indicate that one expresses a feeling or attitude deeply. It is typically followed by nouns like 'regret', 'thanks', 'condolences', or 'concern'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於今次意外，我深表遺憾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 gam1 ci3 ji3 ngoi6, ngo5 sam1 biu2 wai4 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 對於這次意外，我深表遺憾。
examples.english_sentence: I deeply express my regret about this accident.

mandarin_meaning: 谋划周详，考虑长远。
english_meaning: Plan carefully and consider long-term consequences; be strategic and farsighted.
explanation_mandarin: 形容謀劃周密、考慮長遠、做事有遠見和策略。
explanation_english: Describes someone who plans thoroughly and takes long-term consequences into account; displaying foresight and strategic thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市長做事深謀遠慮，先後推出多項長遠政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zoeng2 zou6 si6 sam1 mau4 jyun5 leoi6, sin1 hau6 teoi1 ceot1 do1 hong6 coeng4 jyun5 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市长做事深谋远虑，先后推出多项长远政策。
examples.english_sentence: The mayor acts with careful long-term planning, successively introducing a number of long-term policies.

mandarin_meaning: 深蹲（锻炼下肢的一种动作）
english_meaning: squat (exercise); deep squat
explanation_mandarin: 一種鍛鍊下半身（如大腿、臀部）肌肉的運動，動作是屈膝下蹲再站起。
explanation_english: An exercise for the lower body (thighs, glutes) in which you bend the knees into a squat and then stand back up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日喺健身房做咗一百個深蹲，腿好酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hai2 gin6 san1 fong4 zou6 zo2 jat1 baak3 go3 sam1 deon1, teoi2 hou2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天在健身房做了100个深蹲，腿很酸。
examples.english_sentence: I did 100 squats at the gym today; my legs are very sore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練示範咗深蹲嘅正確姿勢，大家跟住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 si6 faan6 zo2 sam1 deon1 ge3 zing3 kok3 zi1 sai3, daai6 gaa1 gan1 zyu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练示范了深蹲的正确姿势，大家跟着做。
examples.english_sentence: The coach demonstrated the correct squat form; everyone followed along.

mandarin_meaning: 進修、攻讀更高學位（如碩士、博士），或到海外留學以增進學識與專業技能
english_meaning: to pursue advanced studies or further education (e.g., studying for a master's/PhD or studying abroad to deepen knowledge or professional skills)
explanation_mandarin: 指為了增進學術或專業能力而到更高層次的學校或進行更深入的學習，常用於描述考取碩士、博士或到海外留學。
explanation_english: Refers to undertaking more advanced or in-depth study to improve academic or professional abilities; commonly used for pursuing graduate degrees or studying abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打算畢業之後去英國深造。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 syun3 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 heoi3 jing1 gwok3 sam1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打算畢業之後去英國深造。
examples.english_sentence: He plans to go to the UK for further studies after graduation.

mandarin_meaning: 深远（形容影响、意义等深刻且广泛持久）
english_meaning: profound; far-reaching; deep and long-lasting
explanation_mandarin: 指影响、意义或想法等既深刻又影响广泛、持久。
explanation_english: Describes something that is deep in meaning or significance and has wide-ranging, long-lasting effects or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅研究對社會有深遠嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin4 gau3 deoi3 se5 wui6 jau5 sam1 jyun5 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的研究對社會有深遠的影響。
examples.english_sentence: His research has deep and far-reaching effects on society.

mandarin_meaning: 深閨（shēn guī）：指婦女居住的內室或闺房；比喻女子閉門不出、與世隔絕的生活或處境。
english_meaning: deep boudoir / inner chamber; figuratively, a woman's secluded life or seclusion from the outside world
explanation_mandarin: 「深閨」原指女子居住的內室、闺房，常用於書面或古典語境；引申為女子閉門不出或與外界隔絕的處境與生活狀態。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a woman's inner chamber or boudoir (literary use); figuratively it denotes a woman living in seclusion or being cut off from the outside world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺深閨長大，好少出街，對外面嘅事唔太了解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sam1 gwai1 coeng4 daai6, hou2 siu2 ceot1 gaai1, deoi3 ngoi6 min6 ge3 si6 m4 taai3 liu5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在深閨長大，很少出門，對外界的事不太了解。
examples.english_sentence: She grew up secluded in the inner chambers and rarely went out, so she didn't know much about the outside world.

mandarin_meaning: 淳；纯朴、诚挚、淳厚（常见于“淳厚”“淳朴”等）
english_meaning: pure; honest; sincere; simple and unsophisticated (often in compounds like "淳厚" or "淳朴")
explanation_mandarin: 表示性情纯朴、诚挚或淳厚的品质，常用于构成词语如“淳厚”“淳朴”，也可作人名用字。
explanation_english: Denotes a quality of purity, honesty, sincerity, or kindly simplicity. Commonly appears in compounds such as "淳厚" or "淳朴" and is occasionally used in personal names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個心地淳厚嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 sam1 dei6 seon4 hau6 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个心地淳厚的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a kind-hearted and sincere person.

mandarin_meaning: （水）深淵；深潭；比喻深處或根源（如「淵源」）
english_meaning: deep pool; abyss; a profound depth or source (as in 'origin')
explanation_mandarin: 「淵」原指深水處、深潭，也常用作比喻，表示難以接近或理解的深處；常見於合成詞如「深淵」「淵源」。
explanation_english: Originally denotes a deep body of water or abyss. It is also used metaphorically for a profound or inscrutable depth; appears in compounds such as 'abyss' (深淵) and 'source/origin' (淵源).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個湖有個好深嘅淵，唔好游近去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wu4 jau5 go3 hou2 sam1 ge3 jyun1, m4 hou2 jau4 gan6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个湖有个很深的渊，不要游近去。
examples.english_sentence: This lake has a very deep abyss; don't swim near it.

mandarin_meaning: 博学、渊博
english_meaning: erudite; possessing deep and extensive knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人學識深厚且廣博，知識豐富。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has deep and wide-ranging knowledge; learned or erudite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學問淵博，經常提出好有深度嘅見解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 man6 jyun1 bok3, ging1 soeng4 tai4 ceot1 hou2 jau5 sam1 dou6 ge3 gin3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他學問淵博，經常提出很有深度的見解。
examples.english_sentence: He is erudite and often offers very insightful observations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位教授淵博，學生都好尊敬佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 gaau1 sau6 jyun1 bok3, hok6 saang1 dou1 hou2 zyun1 ging3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位教授學識淵博，學生們都很尊敬他。
examples.english_sentence: This professor is learned; the students respect him greatly.

mandarin_meaning: 淵源（起源、來歷；彼此之間的歷史關係）
english_meaning: origin, source; historical or deep connection/relationship
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物的起源或來龍去脈，也可用來比喻人或事物之間的歷史淵源或關係。
explanation_english: Refers to the origin or source of something; can also describe historical ties or deep connections between people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間有好深嘅淵源，係好耐以前就開始合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 hou2 sam1 ge3 jyun1 jyun4, hai6 hou2 noi6 ji5 cin4 zau6 hoi1 ci2 hop6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們之間有很深的淵源，很久以前就開始合作。
examples.english_sentence: They have deep ties; they started cooperating long ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 研究呢件事嘅淵源，可以幫我哋了解背後嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin4 gau3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 jyun1 jyun4, ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 liu5 gaai2 bui3 hau6 ge3 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 研究這件事的淵源，可以幫我們了解背後的原因。
examples.english_sentence: Tracing the origins of this matter can help us understand the reasons behind it.

mandarin_meaning: 深切的痛苦；深沉的悲痛
english_meaning: profound pain; deep sorrow
explanation_mandarin: 「淵痛」用以形容內心深處的痛苦或悲傷，語氣較為文言或書面，表示傷痛深重且難以排解。
explanation_english: Used to describe pain or sorrow that is deep-seated and profound. It is relatively literary or formal, indicating intense inner anguish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起嗰件事，仍然覺得淵痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 go2 gin6 si6, jing4 jin4 gok3 dak1 jyun1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一提起那件事，仍然覺得深切的痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: When he brings up that matter, he still feels profound pain.

mandarin_meaning: 混（hùn）
english_meaning: to mix; to muddle along/loaf; to get by without much effort
explanation_mandarin: “混”在粤语中有多重含义：1) 表示混合（把不同的東西拌在一起）；2) 表示混日子、摸魚、混跡於某處（游手好閒或勉強過日子）；3) 表示混迹、混入（在一個圈子或地方待着）。語氣可口語化或帶貶義。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, “混” has several senses: 1) to mix (combine different things); 2) to muddle along or loaf (to pass time without doing much); 3) to hang about or blend into a group/place. Usage is colloquial and can be mildly pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁多年都係混日子，冇進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 do1 nin4 dou1 hai6 wan6 jat6 zi2, mou5 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这些年都在混日子，没有进步。
examples.english_sentence: He has been loafing for years and hasn't improved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲材料要混埋先至可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 coi4 liu2 jiu3 wan6 maai4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些材料要混合起来才能使用。
examples.english_sentence: These materials need to be mixed together before use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司打混，做唔到乜嘢正經嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 daa2 wan6, zou6 m4 dou3 mat1 je5 zing3 ging1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司偷懒，做不到什么正经事。
examples.english_sentence: He's loafing at the company and can't get any proper work done.

mandarin_meaning: 混乱 (hùnluàn)
english_meaning: chaos; disorder; confusion; messy
explanation_mandarin: 表示秩序或狀態混亂、不整齊或無條理，可作形容詞也可作名詞。
explanation_english: Describes a state of disorder or lack of organization; can function as an adjective or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個屋企好混亂，成日搵唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 uk1 kei2 hou2 wan6 lyun6, sing4 jat6 wan2 m4 dou3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個家很混亂，總是找不到東西。
examples.english_sentence: This house is very messy/chaotic; I can never find anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議一開始就好混亂，大家都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 zau6 hou2 wan6 lyun6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議一開始就很混亂，大家都不知道怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting was chaotic from the start; nobody knew what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 洪水導致交通混亂，唔少路段要封路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 seoi2 dou6 zi3 gaau1 tung1 wan6 lyun6, m4 siu2 lou6 dyun6 jiu3 fung1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洪水導致交通混亂，不少路段要封閉。
examples.english_sentence: Flooding caused traffic chaos; many road sections had to be closed.

mandarin_meaning: 混入 (hùn rù)：偷偷或悄悄地加入、滲入某個群體或混合到某物中，常帶有滲透或偽裝的意味。
english_meaning: to infiltrate; to mix into; to sneak into or blend into a group or substance, often implying stealth or deception.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物悄悄進入或加入到一個群體、場所或混合物中，可能是為了滲透、偽裝或混合。
explanation_english: Indicates someone or something secretly entering or joining a group, place, or mixture, often for infiltration, disguise, or blending purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢混入咗我哋個群組，成日發廣告訊息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan6 jap6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 go3 kwan4 zou2, sing4 jat6 faat3 gwong2 gou3 seon3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他混入了我们的群组，经常发广告信息。
examples.english_sentence: He infiltrated our group and keeps posting advertisement messages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有間諜混入咗軍隊，收集情報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 gaan1 dip6 wan6 jap6 zo2 gwan1 deoi2, sau1 zaap6 zing3 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有间谍混入了军队，收集情报。
examples.english_sentence: A spy infiltrated the army to gather intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批次料被混入到正貨裡，影響咗整批產品嘅質量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pat1 ci3 liu6 bei6 wan6 jap6 dou3 zing3 fo3 leoi5, jing2 hoeng2 zo2 zing2 pat1 caan2 ban2 ge3 zat1 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这批次材料被混入到正货里，影响了整批产品的质量。
examples.english_sentence: This batch of materials was mixed into the genuine goods, affecting the quality of the entire batch of products.

mandarin_meaning: 混凝土
english_meaning: concrete (construction material)
explanation_mandarin: 一種建築材料，由水泥、骨料（如砂、石子）和水混合，經過凝結和硬化後形成堅硬的物質，常用於地基、梁、柱、地面等結構。
explanation_english: A construction material made by mixing cement, aggregates (such as sand and gravel) and water; it hardens after curing to form a strong solid used for foundations, beams, columns, floors, and other structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座橋係用混凝土建造嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 kiu4 hai6 jung6 wan6 jing4 tou2 gin3 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座橋是用混凝土建造的。
examples.english_sentence: That bridge was built with concrete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 混凝土要等足夠嘅時間先至可以完全硬化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 jing4 tou2 jiu3 dang2 zuk1 gau3 ge3 si4 gaan3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 ngaang6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 混凝土需要等待足夠的時間才能完全硬化。
examples.english_sentence: Concrete needs enough time to fully cure.

mandarin_meaning: 混凝土车（用于运输和搅拌混凝土的车辆）
english_meaning: concrete mixer truck (vehicle used to transport and mix concrete)
explanation_mandarin: 指用于运输和搅拌混凝土的專用车辆，车后通常有旋转的滚筒以保持混凝土在运输过程中不凝固并保持均匀。
explanation_english: A vehicle used to transport and mix concrete. It typically has a rotating drum on the back that keeps the concrete agitated so it doesn't set during transport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工地外面停咗幾架混凝土車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 dei6 ngoi6 min6 ting4 zo2 gei2 gaa3 wan6 ning4 tou2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地外面停了好幾輛混凝土車。
examples.english_sentence: Several concrete mixer trucks are parked outside the construction site.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 混凝土車進咗工地，開始倒料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 ning4 tou2 ce1 zeon3 zo2 gung1 dei6, hoi1 ci2 dou3 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 混凝土车进了工地，开始倒料。
examples.english_sentence: The concrete mixer truck has entered the site and started pouring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 道路濕滑，駕駛混凝土車要特別小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou6 lou6 sap1 waat6, gaa3 sai2 wan6 ning4 tou2 ce1 jiu3 dak6 bit6 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 道路濕滑，駕駛混凝土車要特別小心。
examples.english_sentence: The road is slippery; drivers of concrete mixer trucks need to be especially careful.

mandarin_meaning: 混合；把兩種或多種事物合在一起；由多種成分組成的混合物
english_meaning: to mix; to blend; a mixture
explanation_mandarin: 表示把兩種或多種物質、特徵等合在一起，或指由多種成分組成的混合物。
explanation_english: Means to combine two or more substances, features, etc., or refers to something made up of multiple components blended together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將兩種顏色混合，先要揀定比例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 loeng5 zung2 ngaan4 sik1 wan6 hap6, sin1 jiu3 gaan2 ding6 bei2 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要把兩種顏色混合，先要確定比例。
examples.english_sentence: We need to mix the two colors; first decide the ratio.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款藥水係由多種化學物質混合而成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 kwan2 joek6 seoi2 hai6 jau4 do1 zung2 faa3 hok6 mat6 zat1 wan6 hap6 ji4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款藥水是由多種化學物質混合而成。
examples.english_sentence: This solution is made by mixing various chemical substances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅個性係由好幾種特質混合而成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go3 sing3 hai6 jau4 hou2 gei2 zung2 dak6 zat1 wan6 hap6 ji4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的個性是由好幾種特質混合而成。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is a mix of several traits.

mandarin_meaning: 混合物（由兩種或以上物質混合而成的物體或物質）
english_meaning: mixture (a substance or material made by combining two or more different substances)
explanation_mandarin: 指由兩種或以上不同成分混合而成的物質，也可泛指由多種成分混合在一起的東西。
explanation_english: Refers to a substance or material formed by combining two or more different components; can also broadly denote anything composed of mixed parts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個混合物入面包含咗水同油，唔容易分開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wan6 hap6 mat6 jap6 min6 baau1 ham4 zo2 seoi2 tung4 jau4, m4 jung4 ji6 fan1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個混合物裡包含了水和油，不容易分開。
examples.english_sentence: This mixture contains water and oil and is not easy to separate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化學課上我哋將幾種化學劑混合，最後得到咗一種新嘅混合物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa3 hok6 fo3 seong6 ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 gei2 zung2 faa3 hok6 zai1 wan6 hap6, zeoi3 hau6 dak1 dou3 zo2 jat1 zung2 san1 ge3 wan6 hap6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在化學課上我們把幾種化學試劑混合，最後得到了一種新的混合物。
examples.english_sentence: In chemistry class we mixed several reagents and ended up with a new mixture.

mandarin_meaning: 走運；湊巧；好運
english_meaning: to be lucky; a lucky break; fortunate
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 非正式口語 — 形容詞/動詞（表示走運）
explanation_mandarin: 「混吉」是香港粵語口語用詞，用來表示碰巧走運或湊巧逃過不利情況，常作感嘆或描述幸運的情況，屬非正式用法。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term meaning to be lucky or to get a lucky break. Used informally as an exclamation or to describe a fortunate situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝遲到，但老細唔記得咗我，真係混吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 ci4 dou3, daan6 lou5 sai3 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 wan6 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天迟到，但老板忘了我，真是走運。
examples.english_sentence: I was late this morning, but my boss forgot about me — really lucky.

mandarin_meaning: 混合；摻雜；不純
english_meaning: to mix; mixed; blended; adulterated
explanation_mandarin: 表示把兩種或多種物質、成分或顏色混在一起，或指摻雜、不純的狀態。用法接近“混合”。
explanation_english: Indicates combining two or more substances, elements, or colors together, or refers to a mixed/adulterated state. Usage is similar to 'mix' or 'blend'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲顏料係混和咗幾種顏色整出嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ngaan4 liu6 hai6 wan6 wo4 zo2 gei2 zung2 ngaan4 sik1 zing2 ceot1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些颜料是混合几种颜色调出来的。
examples.english_sentence: These pigments were mixed from several colors.

mandarin_meaning: 混沌、糊塗、精神恍惚；也可指愚昧或無知
english_meaning: muddled; confused; in a daze; mentally foggy; sometimes implies ignorance or dull-wittedness
explanation_mandarin: 「混噩」用來形容人的頭腦或精神狀態混亂、模糊、不清醒，有時也用來形容愚昧或昏庸的狀態。詞語帶有書面或文言色彩。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person's mental state as muddled, confused, or dazed; it can also denote ignorance or dull-wittedness. The term has a somewhat literary or classical tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日好混噩，記憶力差，做嘢冇條理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 hou2 wan6 ngok6, gei3 jik1 lik6 caa1, zou6 je5 mou5 tiu4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近总是很混噩，记忆力差，做事没有条理。
examples.english_sentence: He has been very muddled lately, with poor memory and no sense of order in his work.

mandarin_meaning: 混蛋／混账（骂人的用语，指讨厌或可恶的人）
english_meaning: bastard; scoundrel; damn (vulgar insult used to call someone despicable)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗俗的罵人用語，用來指責或侮辱某人，等同於普通話的「混蛋/混账」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar insult used to denounce or insult someone, equivalent to Mandarin '混蛋' (bastard).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個混帳，成日遲到令大家等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 wan6 zoeng3, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 ling6 daai6 gaa1 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个混账，老是迟到让大家等。
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, you're always late and keep everyone waiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷咗我啲嘢，真係混帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 zo2 ngo5 di1 je5, zan1 hai6 wan6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷了我的东西，真是个混账。
examples.english_sentence: He stole my stuff — what a bastard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 混帳！你唔好再講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 zoeng3! nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 混账！你别再说了。
examples.english_sentence: Bastard! Stop talking.

mandarin_meaning: 混战（hùnzhàn）：混乱的战斗或争斗，指多方或多人之间无序的打斗或冲突。
english_meaning: Melee; a chaotic fight or free-for-all involving multiple parties; a confused or disorderly clash.
partOfSpeech_english: noun (melee); can be used as verb phrase
explanation_mandarin: 用于形容多方或多人之间发生的混乱无序的争斗、打斗或冲突，常指群体性冲突或群殴。
explanation_english: Used to describe a disorderly fight or clash involving several parties or many people; often refers to group scuffles, brawls, or chaotic conflicts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚酒吧入面突然爆發混戰，警方要出動增援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zau2 baa1 jap6 min6 daan6 syun4 baau3 faat3 wan6 zin3, ging2 fong1 jiu3 ceot1 dung6 zang1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚酒吧里面突然爆发混战，警方要出动增援。
examples.english_sentence: A melee broke out inside the bar tonight; the police had to call for backup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩隊球迷喺場外爆發混戰，差人即刻介入制止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 deoi6 kau4 mai4 hai2 coeng4 ngoi6 baau3 faat3 wan6 zin3, caa1 jan4 zik1 hak1 gaai3 jap6 zai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两队球迷在场外爆发混战，警察立即介入制止。
examples.english_sentence: Fans from both teams got into a brawl outside the stadium; the police intervened immediately to stop it.

mandarin_meaning: 混水摸魚（趁混亂或他人不注意時謀取私利）
english_meaning: to fish in troubled waters; to take advantage of chaos or confusion to gain benefit
explanation_mandarin: 比喻趁混亂、紛爭或他人不注意時，趁機謀取私利或做不正當的事。
explanation_english: A metaphor for taking advantage of a chaotic situation or others' inattention to seek personal gain or do something improper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出事，佢就趁機混水摸魚，偷走啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, keoi5 zau6 can3 gei1 wan6 seoi2 mo1 jyu4, tau1 zau2 di1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出事，他就趁機混水摸魚，偷走一些文件。
examples.english_sentence: When the company ran into trouble, he took advantage of the situation to fish in troubled waters and stole some documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議會亂成一鍋粥，啲官員就想趁機混水摸魚，爭取利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 wui2 lyun6 sing4 jat1 wo1 zuk1, di1 gung1 jyun4 zau6 soeng2 can3 gei1 wan6 seoi2 mo1 jyu4, zaang1 ceoi2 lei6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 議會亂成一鍋粥，有些官員想趁機混水摸魚，爭取利益。
examples.english_sentence: The council was in chaos, and some officials tried to take advantage of it to gain benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺大家爭論嘅時候混水摸魚，誠實啲處理問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 daai6 gaa1 zang1 leon6 ge3 si4 hau6 wan6 seoi2 mo1 jyu4, sing4 sat6 di1 cyu2 lei5 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在大家爭論的時候混水摸魚，要誠實地處理問題。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take advantage of everyone arguing to fish in troubled waters; handle the problem honestly.

mandarin_meaning: 混沌 (hùndùn)，指沒有秩序或原始未分化的狀態
english_meaning: chaos; a state of disorder or primordial undifferentiated state
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有秩序、雜亂或原始未分化的狀態，可用來形容混亂的情況或宇宙初成時的狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to a lack of order or a state of confusion, or the primordial undifferentiated condition; can describe chaotic situations or the universe before differentiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面一片混沌，大家都唔知道應該點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jap6min6 jat1pin3 wan6deon6, daai6gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1dou6 jing1goi1 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裡一片混沌，大家都不知道應該怎麼做。
examples.english_sentence: The company is in chaos; nobody knows what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據說宇宙初成係一個混沌未分嘅狀態。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3syut3 jyu5zau6 co1sing4 hai6 jat1go3 wan6deon6 mei6fan1 ge3 zong6taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 據說宇宙初成時是一個混沌未分的狀態。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that when the universe first formed, it was in a state of undifferentiated chaos.

mandarin_meaning: 把兩個或多個事物、概念或資訊混在一起，難以分辨或造成誤解（hùnxiáo）
english_meaning: to confuse or mix up; to blur the distinction between things
explanation_mandarin: 指將兩個或多個事物、概念或資訊混為一談，導致難以區分或引起誤會。
explanation_english: To mix two or more things, concepts, or pieces of information so they become hard to distinguish, often causing misunderstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將兩樣嘢混淆喇，佢哋係唔同嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 loeng5 joeng6 je5 wan6 haau4 laa3, keoi5 dei6 hai6 m4 tung4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把兩樣東西混淆，它們是不一樣的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't confuse the two things; they are different.

mandarin_meaning: 混淆视听（用假象或歪曲事实来误导公众判断）
english_meaning: to confuse or mislead the public; to create confusion to deceive listeners/viewers
explanation_mandarin: 通过歪曲事实、散布假信息或模糊真相，令公眾产生错误判断或被误导。
explanation_english: Deliberately creating confusion or distorting facts to mislead people's perception or opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說法係想混淆視聽，令大家誤解事實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3 faat3 hai6 soeng2 wan6 haau4 si6 ting1, ling6 daai6 gaa1 ng6 gaai2 si6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那些說法是想混淆視聽，讓大家誤解事實。
examples.english_sentence: Those claims are intended to confuse the public and make people misunderstand the facts.

mandarin_meaning: 形容生活或精神狀態混亂、無目標、茫然度日（拼音：hùn hùn è è）
english_meaning: muddled, aimless, living in a daze; drifting through life without purpose
explanation_mandarin: 表示精神狀態或生活狀況混沌、沒方向、沒有積極作為，常用來形容人整日渾渾噩噩、碌碌無為。
explanation_english: Describes a muddled, dazed, or aimless state of mind or way of living — lacking direction or purpose and drifting through life without much initiative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日混混噩噩，唔想做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 wan6 wan6 ngok6 ngok6, m4 soeng2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近整天混混噩噩，不想做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been muddled and aimless lately, not wanting to do any work.

mandarin_meaning: 混浊 (hùn zhuó) — 指水、空气等含有杂质或不清澈，也可形容思想、言语不清晰或混乱。
english_meaning: turbid; muddy; impure; figuratively, unclear or muddled (in thought or expression).
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容液體或空氣含有雜質，不清澈；也可比喻思路、語言等不清楚或混亂。
explanation_english: Describes liquids or air that contain impurities and are not clear; can also be used metaphorically for thoughts or language that are unclear or muddled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為污水排放，條河變得混濁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 wu1 seoi2 paai4 fong3, tiu4 ho4 bin3 dak1 wan6 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为污水排放，河水变得混浊。
examples.english_sentence: The river has become turbid due to sewage discharge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近瞓唔好，腦袋覺得有啲混濁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 fan3 m4 hou2, nou5 doi6 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 wan6 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近睡得不好，脑子觉得有点混浊。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't been sleeping well lately; my mind feels a bit muddled.

mandarin_meaning: 把不同的事物或情況混為一談（hùn wéi yī tán）：把不同的事物說成一樣、沒有區別。
english_meaning: To lump together different things or situations as if they were the same; to confuse distinct matters without distinguishing between them.
explanation_mandarin: 用來批評把本質或情況不同的事物一概而論、沒有分別或分析。
explanation_english: Used to criticize treating things with different natures or circumstances as identical — failing to distinguish or analyze differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將所有學生嘅表現混為一談，佢哋嘅背景同資源都唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 hok6 saang1 ge3 biu2 jin6 wan6 wai4 jat1 taam4, keoi5 dei6 ge3 bui3 ging2 tung4 zi1 jyun4 dou1 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把所有學生的表現混為一談，他們的背景和資源都不一樣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lump all students' performances together; their backgrounds and resources are different.

mandarin_meaning: 混为一谈
english_meaning: to lump together; to treat distinct things as the same
explanation_mandarin: 把不同的事物或概念错误地当成一样，混为一谈常用于指责将两者混淆或一概而论。
explanation_english: To treat distinct matters or concepts as if they were the same; to conflate different things, often used to criticize unjustified generalization or confusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將兩樣唔同嘅問題混為一談。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 loeng5 joeng6 m4 tung4 ge3 man6 tai4 wan6 wai4 jat1 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把两件不同的事物混为一谈。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lump two different things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺報告入面將民生問題同政治問題混為一談，實在唔合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 zoeng1 man4 sang1 man6 tai4 tung4 zing3 zi6 man6 tai4 wan6 wai4 jat1 taam4, sat6 zoi6 m4 ho2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在报告中把民生问题和政治问题混为一谈，实在不合理。
examples.english_sentence: In the report they lumped livelihood issues together with political issues; that's unreasonable.

mandarin_meaning: 混种 (hùnzhǒng)：指雜交種、混血；口語亦可作罵人的貶義用語
english_meaning: mixed breed; mongrel; (slang, derogatory) bastard / scoundrel
explanation_mandarin: 可用於生物學語境表示雜交或混血的個體；在口語或罵人時作貶義，指人卑劣或令人不齒。
explanation_english: Can refer to a biological hybrid or mixed-breed animal/person. In colloquial usage it is often a derogatory insult aimed at a person (similar to 'bastard' or 'scoundrel').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻狗係混種，唔係純種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gau2 hai6 wan6 zung2, m4 hai6 seon4 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這隻狗是混種，不是純種。
examples.english_sentence: This dog is a mixed-breed, not a purebred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個混種，唔好再騷擾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 wan6 zung2, m4 hou2 zoi3 sou1 jiu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個混種，不要再騷擾我。
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, don't bother me again.

mandarin_meaning: 混紡（hùn fǎng）：指將兩種或以上不同的纖維混合後紡製成布料或紗線
english_meaning: blended (textile); mixed-spun — referring to fibers or fabrics made from a mixture of two or more types of fibers (e.g., cotton-polyester blend)
explanation_mandarin: 紡織領域的術語，表示把不同種類的纖維（如棉、聚酯、羊毛等）混合後紡織，得到兼具多種纖維特性的布料或紗線。也可作為動詞，表示進行混合紡製。
explanation_english: A textile term meaning the blending of two or more types of fibers (e.g., cotton and polyester) to produce yarns or fabrics that combine properties of each fiber. It can be used as a noun (a blended fabric) or a verb (to blend-spun fibers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係混紡布，好耐用又容易打理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 wan6 bong2 bou3, hou2 noi6 jung6 jau6 jung4 ji6 daa2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服是混紡布料，很耐用而且容易打理。
examples.english_sentence: This garment is made of blended fabric; it's durable and easy to care for.

mandarin_meaning: 能勉强应付；能混日子
english_meaning: able to get by; passable; can muddle through
explanation_mandarin: 俗語/俚語，用來形容某人或某事能力不強，但能勉強應付、混日子，帶有將就或不夠稱職的含義。
explanation_english: Colloquial/slang term describing someone or something that isn't very capable but can just get by or muddle through; implies passable or merely adequate performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係好叻，但係都可以混能過日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 lek1, daan6 hai6 dou1 ho2 ji5 wan6 nang4 gwo3 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不太厲害，但也能勉強混日子。
examples.english_sentence: He's not very skilled, but he can get by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司請嗰啲只係混能嘅員工，表現普通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceng2 go2 di1 zi2 hai6 wan6 nang4 ge3 jyun4 gung1, biu2 jin2 pou2 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司僱用了那些只是能混日子的員工，表現一般。
examples.english_sentence: The company hired employees who just get by; their performance is average.

mandarin_meaning: 混蛋 (骂人的话，表示极度鄙视或愤怒，意为“混球/混账/混蛋/混蛋的人”)
english_meaning: bastard; jerk; scoundrel (vulgar insult expressing strong contempt or anger)
explanation_mandarin: “混蛋”是粗俗的骂人用语，用来形容品行恶劣或令人极为反感的人，可用于愤怒的指责，有时朋友间也会半开玩笑地使用，但总体带有强烈侮辱意味。
explanation_english: “混蛋” is a vulgar insult used to describe someone as a bastard/jerk/scoundrel. It expresses strong contempt or anger. It can sometimes appear jokingly among close friends, but it is generally offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個混蛋，點解要出賣我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 wan6 daan2, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 ceot1 maai6 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个混蛋，为什么要出卖我？
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, why did you betray me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出賣我朋友，佢係個混蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 maai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5, keoi5 hai6 go3 wan6 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出卖了我朋友，他是个混蛋。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed my friend; he's a bastard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開玩笑啫，我唔係混蛋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 waan2 siu3 ze1, ngo5 m4 hai6 wan6 daan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只是开玩笑，我不是混蛋啦。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just joking — I'm not a bastard.

mandarin_meaning: 混血 (hùn xuè)：具有不同民族或種族血統的人（混血兒）
english_meaning: mixed-race; of mixed ancestry (person of mixed ethnic/racial parentage)
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used attributively as adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 指父母來自不同民族或種族，子女具有混合血統的人。也常以「混血兒」稱呼，並可用作描述外貌或背景。
explanation_english: Refers to a person whose parents come from different ethnic or racial backgrounds, resulting in mixed ancestry. Often called a 'mixed-race person' and can describe appearance or background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係混血，老竇係法國人，老母係香港人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wan6 hyut3, lou5 dau6 hai6 faat3 gwok3 jan4, lou5 mou5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是混血兒，爸爸是法國人，媽媽是香港人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is mixed-race; the father is French and the mother is from Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 混血儿；具有不同种族或民族血统的人
english_meaning: mixed-race person; someone of mixed heritage
explanation_mandarin: 指父母來自不同種族或民族，子女具有混合血統的人。語氣通常中性，用於描述血統或外貌背景。
explanation_english: Refers to a person whose parents come from different races or ethnicities, resulting in mixed ancestry. The term is typically neutral and used to describe heritage or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係混血兒，爸爸係英國人，媽媽係香港人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wan6 hyut3 ji4, baa4 baa1 hai6 jing1 gwok3 jan4, maa4 maa1 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是混血儿，爸爸是英國人，媽媽是香港人。
examples.english_sentence: He is mixed-race: his father is British and his mother is from Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 混进（潜入、混入某个场合或人群）
english_meaning: to sneak into; to infiltrate; to blend into a group or place
explanation_mandarin: 表示不被發覺地進入某個場所或混入某個群體，常含有偷偷或偽裝的意思。
explanation_english: To enter a place or mix into a group without being noticed; often implies sneaking in or infiltrating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢混進咗人群，冇人發覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan6 zeon3 zo2 jan4 kwan4, mou5 jan4 faat3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他混进了人群，没有人发觉。
examples.english_sentence: He slipped into the crowd and no one noticed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有小偷混進會場偷嘢，保安要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 siu2 tau1 wan6 zeon3 wui6 coeng4 tau1 je5, bou2 on1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有小偷混进会场偷东西，保安要小心些。
examples.english_sentence: A thief sneaked into the venue to steal things; the security needs to be more vigilant.

mandarin_meaning: 混双 / 混合双打
english_meaning: mixed doubles (a doubles match with one male and one female per team)
explanation_mandarin: 指羽毛球、網球、乒乓球等運動中由一男一女組成一隊的雙打比賽，為“混合雙打”的簡稱。
explanation_english: Refers to a doubles event in sports (e.g., badminton, tennis, table tennis) where each team consists of one male and one female player; abbreviation of 'mixed doubles'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下星期比賽有混雙項目，我哋要報名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 sing1 kei4 bei2 coi3 jau5 wan6 soeng1 hoeng6 muk6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下星期比赛有混双项目，我们要报名。
examples.english_sentence: There's a mixed doubles event at next week's competition; we need to sign up.

mandarin_meaning: 混杂 (húnzá)：多种不同成分或因素混在一起，常含杂乱或不纯的意思。
english_meaning: mixed; mingled; heterogeneous; a mixture of different elements, often implying disorder or lack of purity.
explanation_mandarin: 表示两种或多种不同的事物、成分或因素混在一起，通常带有杂乱、不纯或难以区分的含义。
explanation_english: Describes two or more different things or elements mixed together, often carrying a sense of disorder, impurity, or indistinctness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲資料好混雜，分唔清邊個係可信嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zi1liu2 hou2 wan6 zaap6, fan1 m4 cing1 bin1 go3 hai6 ho2 seon3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的资料很混杂，分不清谁是可信的。
examples.english_sentence: Their information is very mixed; it's hard to tell which parts are trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市入面嘅人好混雜，有本地人亦有外地遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 jap6 min6 ge3 jan4 hou2 wan6 zaap6, jau5 bun2 dei6 jan4 jik6 jau5 ngoi6 dei6 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市裡面的人很混杂，有本地人也有外地游客。
examples.english_sentence: The people in the city are very mixed — there are locals as well as visitors.

mandarin_meaning: 混音（指在音樂或聲音製作中對多軌錄音進行混合處理）
english_meaning: mixing (the process of combining and processing multiple audio tracks into a final stereo/mono/master)
explanation_mandarin: 指在錄音或音樂製作過程中，調整各聲部的音量、頻率、立體聲位置、效果（如混響、延遲）等，使整體聲音均衡且具表現力；也可指混音後的成品。
explanation_english: Refers to the process in recording or music production of adjusting levels, EQ, panning, and effects (e.g., reverb, delay) of multiple tracks to create a balanced and cohesive final mix; can also refer to the resulting mixed audio.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅專輯交畀佢做混音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 zyun1 zap6 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6 wan6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次的專輯交給他做混音。
examples.english_sentence: This album was handed to him to do the mixing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 混音要注意平衡各個聲部，並加入適量嘅混響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 jam1 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 ping4 hang4 gok3 go3 sing1 bou6 bing6 gaa1 jap6 sik1 loeng6 ge3 wan6 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 混音時要注意平衡各個聲部，並加入適量的混響。
examples.english_sentence: When mixing, pay attention to balancing the different parts and adding an appropriate amount of reverb.

mandarin_meaning: 淹（yān）：淹没、淹没于水中；浸泡；（使）溺死
english_meaning: to submerge; to flood; to drown; to soak
explanation_mandarin: 表示被水覆盖或吞没（如淹没、淹死），也可指浸泡或使浸湿。
explanation_english: Indicates being covered or inundated by water (e.g., to flood or drown); can also mean to soak or immerse in liquid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雨，條街淹咗水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 jyu5, tiu4 gaai1 jim1 zo2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雨，街道被淹了。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily and the street was flooded.

mandarin_meaning: 用尖銳/細碎的聲音抱怨或發牢騷，表現悶悶不樂或不滿
english_meaning: to whine or complain in a high-pitched/thin voice, expressing boredom or irritation
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語或口語用法，形容某人以尖細或刺耳的聲音不停抱怨、發牢騷或表現悶悶不樂，通常帶有令人厭煩的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression describing someone who constantly whines or complains in a high-pitched, thin voice—showing boredom or dissatisfaction and often coming across as annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日淹尖聲悶，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jim1 zim1 sing1 mun6, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是用尖聲抱怨，真的很煩人。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is always whining in a high-pitched voice; it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 淹没 (yān mò)
english_meaning: to submerge; to flood; to inundate; to overwhelm/engulf
explanation_mandarin: 表示被水或其他事物覆蓋、淹沒或吞沒，也可比喻被大量事物壓倒或淹沒。
explanation_english: To be covered or submerged by water or something else; can also be used figuratively to mean overwhelmed or engulfed by something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴雨淹沒咗成條街，啲車都浸咗水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 jyu5 jim1 mut6 zo2 sing4 tiu4 gaai1, di1 ce1 dou1 zam3 zo2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴雨淹没了整条街，车都浸在水里。
examples.english_sentence: The heavy rain flooded the entire street, and the cars were soaked in water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我被工作淹沒，冇時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei6 gung1 zok3 jim1 mut6, mou5 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被工作淹没，沒有时间休息。
examples.english_sentence: I'm overwhelmed by work and have no time to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 被水淹没；吞没、覆盖；比喻被大量事物压倒或掩盖
english_meaning: to flood, to submerge; to inundate or overwhelm (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示被水或其他事物覆盖、浸没或比喻被大量事物压倒、掩盖。
explanation_english: To be submerged or covered by water or other things; figuratively, to be overwhelmed or drowned out by a large amount of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街因為落大雨而淹没咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 jan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 ji4 jim1 mut6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街因为下大雨而淹没了。
examples.english_sentence: This street was flooded because of the heavy rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家畀工作淹没，冇時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 bei2 gung1 zok3 jim1 mut6, mou5 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在被工作淹没，没时间休息。
examples.english_sentence: I'm swamped by work right now and have no time to rest.

mandarin_meaning: 淹没 (yān mò)：被水覆盖、掩没；比喻被压倒或覆盖
english_meaning: to submerge; to inundate; to flood; to overwhelm; to drown out
explanation_mandarin: 指被水淹没、覆盖或比喻性地被大量事物、信息等压倒、掩盖。
explanation_english: Means to be submerged or covered by water, or metaphorically to be overwhelmed or drowned out by a large amount of something (e.g., information, noise).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成條街都畀洪水淹沒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 bei2 hung4 seoi2 jim1 mut6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整条街都被洪水淹没了。
examples.english_sentence: The whole street was submerged by the flood.

mandarin_meaning: 浅（qiǎn）：浅、颜色浅、程度或理解不深
english_meaning: shallow; light (in color); superficial; not deep
explanation_mandarin: 「淺」可表示水或物體深度小（不深）、顏色偏淡、程度或理解不深、膚淺等。
explanation_english: “淺” can mean shallow (low depth), light in color, slight/superficial in degree, or lacking depth of understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個泳池水好淺，小朋友可以喺度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wing6 ci4 seoi2 hou2 cin2, siu2 pang4 jau5 ho2 ji5 hai2 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游泳池水很浅，孩子可以在这里玩。
examples.english_sentence: The pool water is shallow; children can play here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫嘅顏色好淺，啲污漬好易見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 cin2, di1 wu1 zik1 hou2 ji6 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她那件衣服颜色很浅，污渍很容易看见。
examples.english_sentence: The color of their shirt is very light; stains are easy to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個科目嘅了解好淺，未做足功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 fo1 muk6 ge3 liu5 gaai2 hou2 cin2, mei6 zou6 zuk1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對這個科目的了解很淺，還沒做好準備/功課。
examples.english_sentence: His understanding of this subject is shallow; he hasn't done enough homework.

mandarin_meaning: 膚淺、淺薄（口語）
english_meaning: superficial; shallow (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「淺兜兜」為廣東話口語用詞，形容人或言談內容很膚淺、停留在表面，沒有深度。常用於批評某人的見解或討論太淺。帶有輕微貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing something or someone as shallow or superficial. It criticizes remarks, opinions, or discussions that lack depth. It is informal and slightly derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁淺兜兜，我聽唔落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 cin2 dau1 dau1, ngo5 teng1 m4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說話這麼膚淺，我聽不下去。
examples.english_sentence: Your talk is so shallow, I can't listen.

mandarin_meaning: 浅析 / 对……进行简要分析
english_meaning: to give a brief analysis; brief analysis
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（常用作動詞）
partOfSpeech_english: verb / noun (commonly used as a verb)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個問題或現象進行簡短、概括性的分析，通常不深入或詳盡。
explanation_english: Indicates giving a short, concise analysis of an issue or phenomenon, usually not in-depth or exhaustive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺報告入面淺析咗呢個問題嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 cin2 sik1 zo2 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在报告中对这个问题的原因做了浅析。
examples.english_sentence: We briefly analyzed the causes of this problem in the report.

mandarin_meaning: 浅水湾 (香港一處海灣及海灘)
english_meaning: Repulse Bay (a bay and popular beach on southern Hong Kong Island)
explanation_mandarin: 淺水灣位於香港島南區，是著名的海灘與海灣，也是高檔住宅區和旅遊熱點，以沙灘、日落及海濱景致聞名。
explanation_english: A bay and popular beach on southern Hong Kong Island (commonly known as Repulse Bay). It is a well-known tourist spot and upscale residential area, famous for its sandy beach, sunsets, and seaside scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去淺水灣游水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 cin2 seoi2 waan1 jau4 seoi2 laa1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期天去浅水湾游泳吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go swim at Repulse Bay on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淺水灣附近有好多高級住宅同酒店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin2 seoi2 waan1 fu6 gan6 jau5 hou2 do1 gou1 kap1 zyu6 zaak6 tung4 zau2 dim3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 浅水湾附近有很多高级住宅和酒店。
examples.english_sentence: There are many high-end residences and hotels near Repulse Bay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淺水灣啲日落好靚，黃昏時好多人嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin2 seoi2 waan1 di1 jat6 lok6 hou2 leng3, wong4 fan1 si4 hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 jing2 soeng2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 浅水湾的日落很美，黄昏时有很多人来拍照。
examples.english_sentence: The sunset at Repulse Bay is beautiful; many people come to take photos at dusk.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻只做小本經營或安於現狀、不敢冒險追求更大成就
english_meaning: A Cantonese idiom meaning to stick to small-scale, low-risk activities; to be content with small gains and avoid taking risks
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容做事小打小鬧、安於現狀、不願冒險或進取。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression describing someone who plays it safe, operates on a small scale, or avoids taking risks to pursue greater achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司淺水養田螺，唔想爭取升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 cin2 seoi2 joeng5 tin4 lo4, m4 soeng2 zang1 ceoi2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司淺水養田螺，不想爭取升職。
examples.english_sentence: He is coasting at the company and doesn't want to pursue a promotion.

mandarin_meaning: 浅滩（沙洲），水位较浅的地方，常会妨碍航行或在退潮时露出
english_meaning: shoal; sandbank — a shallow area of water (sand or rock) that can obstruct navigation or be exposed at low tide
explanation_mandarin: 指河流、海岸或水域中水较浅、靠近或露出水面的沙地或岩石区，常影响船隻通行或在退潮時顯現。
explanation_english: Refers to a shallow area in a river, coastal, or marine environment—sandbar or shoal—where water is shallow and sand/rocks may be exposed, often affecting navigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條航道前面有個淺灘，啲船要小心避開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 hong4 dou6 cin4 min6 jau5 go3 cin2 taan1, di1 syun4 jiu3 siu2 sam1 bei6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條航道前面有一個淺灘，船隻要小心避開。
examples.english_sentence: There's a shoal ahead in this channel; the boats need to steer clear carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退潮嗰陣，淺灘會露出嚟，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3 ciu4 go2 zan6, cin2 taan1 wui5 lou6 ceot1 lai4, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退潮時淺灘會露出來，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: At low tide the shoal emerges, so be careful when walking.

mandarin_meaning: 浅白；简明易懂，言語或表達方式不複雜
english_meaning: plain; simple and easy to understand
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容說話或文字表達得簡單明瞭、容易理解。在某些語境下也可指淺顯或略顯膚淺。
explanation_english: Describes speech or writing that is simple, clear, and easy to understand. In some contexts it can also imply being superficial or not deep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以講得淺白啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 dak1 cin2 baak6 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以讲得浅白一点吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you explain it more simply?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用淺白嘅語言講解咗個概念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 cin2 baak6 ge3 jyu5 jin4 gong2 gaai2 zo2 go3 goi3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用浅白的语言讲解了这个概念。
examples.english_sentence: He explained the concept in plain language.

mandarin_meaning: 心胸狹窄；小氣、目光短淺
english_meaning: narrow-minded; petty; small‑minded
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，形容人思想、胸襟或眼光狹窄，常為小事斤斤計較或不包容他人。
explanation_english: A colloquial term describing someone who is narrow‑minded or petty — inclined to fuss over small matters and not tolerant of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個性好淺窄，成日計較啲小事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sing3 hou2 cin2 zaak3, sing4 jat6 gai3 gaau3 di1 siu2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她很小氣，總是為小事斤斤計較。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very petty — always nitpicking over small things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔好咁淺窄，大家有分歧就傾下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 hou2 gam2 cin2 zaak3, daai6 gaa1 jau5 fan1 kei4 zau6 king1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不要那麼狹隘，有分歧就多溝通。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so narrow‑minded; if there are disagreements, talk them through.

mandarin_meaning: 浅笑；淡淡地笑
english_meaning: a faint smile; to smile faintly
explanation_mandarin: 指輕微、淡淡地微笑，多用來形容不張揚或含蓄的笑容，可作動詞或名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to a slight or faint smile, describing a subtle or restrained expression; can be used as a verb ('to smile faintly') or a noun ('a faint smile').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淺笑咗一下，令到氣氛舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cin2 siu3 zo2 jat1 haa6, ling6 dou3 hei3 fan1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他淺笑了一下，讓氣氛舒服一些。
examples.english_sentence: He smiled faintly, making the atmosphere a bit more pleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到舊相，我忍唔住淺笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 gau6 soeng2, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 cin2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到舊相，我忍不住淺笑。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the old photos, I couldn't help smiling faintly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只是淺笑，並無多講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 si6 cin2 siu3, bing6 mou5 do1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是淺笑，並沒有多說什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He merely gave a faint smile and didn't say much.

mandarin_meaning: 浅色
english_meaning: light-colored; pale (color)
explanation_mandarin: 表示顏色較淺、明度較高的顏色，與深色相對，常用於描述衣物、牆面或配色風格。
explanation_english: Refers to colors that are pale or light in shade (higher brightness), opposite of dark colors; commonly used to describe clothing, walls, or color palettes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係淺色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 cin2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是浅色的。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is light-colored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將房間漆成淺色，似米白色咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 fong4 gaan1 cat1 seng4 cin2 sik1, ci5 mai5 baak6 sik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把房间漆成浅色，比如米白色。
examples.english_sentence: I want to paint the room a light color, like off-white.

mandarin_meaning: 浅薄 (qiǎnbó)
english_meaning: superficial; shallow; lacking depth
explanation_mandarin: 表示思想、知識或論述不深入、膚淺，缺乏深度或深刻性。
explanation_english: Describes ideas, knowledge, or arguments that are superficial or shallow and lack depth or insight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對問題嘅理解好淺薄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 man6 tai4 ge3 lei5 gaai2 hou2 cin2 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對問題的理解很淺薄。
examples.english_sentence: His understanding of the problem is very superficial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰篇評論太淺薄，冇深入分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 pin1 ping4 leon6 taai3 cin2 bok3, mou5 sam1 jap6 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那篇評論太淺薄，沒有深入分析。
examples.english_sentence: That review is too shallow; it lacks in-depth analysis.

mandarin_meaning: 淺陋（浅陋）：淺薄、粗陋，缺乏深度或教養
english_meaning: shallow; crude; lacking in depth, refinement, or culture
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容思想、言語、作品或見解淺薄、粗陋、沒有深度或文化修養。
explanation_english: Used to describe ideas, speech, works, or views that are superficial, crude, and lacking in depth or refinement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅論文好淺陋，冇乜理據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 leon6 man4 hou2 cin2 lau6, mou5 mat1 lei5 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的論文很淺陋，沒有什麼理據。
examples.english_sentence: His paper is very shallow and lacks solid evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 添（tiān）：增加、再、還；在粵語中也可作句尾語氣詞，表示更甚或附加
english_meaning: tim (to add; additionally; even more) — in Cantonese also a sentence-final particle indicating an added state or intensification
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞；（粵語用法）句尾語氣助詞（口語）
explanation_mandarin: 「添」在粵語可作動詞，表示「添上、增加、加多」，例如「添杯水」。作句尾語氣詞時，用來表示附加情況或程度加深，相當於「更、還」或「甚至更...」，例如「煩人添」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 「添」 (tim1) can be a verb meaning to add or refill (e.g., "添杯水" = refill a glass). As a sentence-final particle it conveys addition or increased degree — similar to "even more" or "on top of that."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貴添！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwai3 tim1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 更貴了！
examples.english_sentence: Even more expensive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到，又唔打電話，真係煩人添。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3, jau6 m4 daa2 din6 waa2, zan1 hai6 faan4 jan4 tim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他遲到又不打電話，真是很讓人煩惱。
examples.english_sentence: He was late and didn't call — it's really annoying on top of that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以幫我添杯水嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 tim1 bui1 seoi2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以幫我再添一杯水嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Could you refill my glass of water?

mandarin_meaning: 添丁（指家庭增加子嗣，通常指有新生兒）
english_meaning: to add a child to the family; to welcome a new baby
explanation_mandarin: 表示家庭增添人口，通常用來指有了新生兒，有時特指添男丁（傳統上重視男丁）。
explanation_english: Refers to adding a family member, typically the birth of a new baby. Often used to announce or celebrate having a child (traditionally a son).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企終於添丁喇，依家屋企更加熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 zung1 jyu1 tim1 ding1 laa3, ji1 gaa1 uk1 kei2 gang1 gaa1 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家終於添丁了，現在家裡更熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: Our family finally welcomed a new baby; the house is livelier now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜晒，你哋添丁啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 saai3, nei5 dei6 tim1 ding1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜，你們添丁了！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations, you've had a baby!

mandarin_meaning: 添加 (增加、加入)
english_meaning: to add; to add on; to append; to increase
explanation_mandarin: 表示增加或加入某物、內容或數量，常用於文件、系統、食物等情況。
explanation_english: To increase or include something additional — to add or append items, content, users, ingredients, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺系統入面添加一個新用戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 hai6 tung2 jap6 min6 tim1 gaa1 jat1 go3 san1 jung6 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要在系統裡面添加一個新用戶。
examples.english_sentence: We need to add a new user in the system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咖啡太苦，你可唔可以添加啲糖呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fe1 taai3 fu2, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tim1 gaa1 di1 tong4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 咖啡太苦，你可以添加一些糖嗎？
examples.english_sentence: The coffee is too bitter; can you add some sugar?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請喺報告入面添加多啲資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 tim1 gaa1 do1 di1 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請在報告裡添加更多資料。
examples.english_sentence: Please add more information to the report.

mandarin_meaning: 添加剂
english_meaning: additive
explanation_mandarin: 指在食品、化工或其他產品中加入以改變性質、改善口感、延長保質期或賦予特定功能的物質。
explanation_english: A substance added to food, chemical products, or other items to change properties, improve taste or appearance, extend shelf life, or provide a specific function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好食咁多包裝食品，入面有好多添加劑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sik6 gam2 do1 baau1 zong1 sik6 ban2, jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 tim1 gaa1 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要吃太多包裝食品，裡面有很多添加劑。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat too many packaged foods; they contain a lot of additives.

mandarin_meaning: 添置 (tiānzhì)：增添、购买或置办物品
english_meaning: to add/acquire by purchasing additional items; to buy or procure (usually household or office items)
explanation_mandarin: 指为补充或更新而购买或置办物品，常用于家庭、公司等场合添购家具、设备或日用品。
explanation_english: To purchase or procure additional items to supplement or update existing belongings; commonly used for buying furniture, equipment, or household supplies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算喺新屋入面添置啲傢俬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 hai2 san1 uk1 jap6 min6 tim1 zi6 di1 gaa1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算在新房里添置一些家具。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to purchase some furniture for the new home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每年都會添置少少新衣服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 tim1 zi6 siu2 siu2 san1 ji1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每年都会添置一些新衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He buys a few new clothes every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗改善工作環境，添置咗新嘅電腦同打印機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 goi2 sin6 gung1 zok3 waan4 ging2, tim1 zi6 zo2 san1 ge3 din6 nou5 tung4 daa2 jan3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司为了改善工作环境，添置了新的电脑和打印机。
examples.english_sentence: The company bought new computers and printers to improve the work environment.

mandarin_meaning: 添补 (tiānbǔ) — 补充、填补缺口或弥补不足
english_meaning: to supplement; to fill up; to make up for a deficiency; to fill a vacancy
explanation_mandarin: 表示对不足之处进行补充或填补，例如补上缺口、补足差额或填补职位空缺。
explanation_english: Indicates adding or supplementing something to cover a shortfall, fill a gap, or replace/fill a vacancy (e.g., replenishing stock, covering a deficit, filling a job opening).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要添補個空缺，打算請新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 tim1 bou2 go3 hung1 kyut3, daa2 syun3 ceng2 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要填补这个空缺，打算请新人。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to fill this vacancy and plans to hire a new person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要添補存貨，因為快賣晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tim1 bou2 cyun4 fo3, jan1 wai6 faai3 maai6 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要添补存货，因为快卖完了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to replenish the stock because it's almost sold out.

mandarin_meaning: 赚钱、补贴家用、增加收入
english_meaning: to earn extra money; to supplement one's income; to make a living
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面是「增加食物」，引申為透過工作或兼職賺取金錢以補貼家用或增加收入。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally meaning "add food," used figuratively to mean earning money (often extra income or to help support the family).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份兼職可以俾我添食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gim1 zik1 ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 tim1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份兼职可以让我赚点外快/补贴家用。
examples.english_sentence: This part-time job can help me earn some extra money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開咗間網店，淨係為咗添食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 mong5 dim3, zing6 hai6 wai6 zo2 tim1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开了网店，只是为了赚点钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: He opened an online shop just to make a bit of extra money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工唔係理想，但足夠我同屋企人添食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 m4 hai6 lei5 soeng2, daan6 zuk1 gau3 ngo5 tung4 uk1 kei5 jan4 tim1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作不是理想，但足够让我和家里人维持生计。
examples.english_sentence: This job isn't ideal, but it's enough for me and my family to get by.

mandarin_meaning: 添饭 / 加饭（再加一碗饭；也可引申为来吃白食、蹭饭）
english_meaning: to add rice (ask for seconds); (colloquially) to come eat without contributing / freeload
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把饭再添一些、再盛一碗；口语上也可用来形容只来吃饭、不帮忙或蹭饭的行为。
explanation_english: Literally 'to add rice' — to put another serving of rice. Colloquially it can mean coming to eat (often implying freeloading or not contributing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以再添飯嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 zoi3 tim1 faan6 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以再添饭吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I have another helping of rice?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我添咗飯，咁我就唔使出去整飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 tim1 zo2 faan6, gam2 ngo5 zau6 m4 sai2 ceot1 heoi3 zing2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我添了饭，这样我就不用出去做饭了。
examples.english_sentence: He served me extra rice, so I don't have to go out and cook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日嚟我屋企食，淨係識嚟添飯唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6, zing6 hai6 sik1 lai4 tim1 faan6 m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常来我家吃饭，只知道来蹭饭不干活。
examples.english_sentence: He often comes to my place to eat and only freeloads without helping.

mandarin_meaning: 再喝一輪／續杯、為他人加飲料
english_meaning: to buy another round of drinks / to refill someone's drink
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，常用於聚會或飲宴，指再為自己或他人加飲料、續杯或請一輪飲品。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb used at gatherings to indicate getting another round of drinks, topping up a drink, or offering to buy more drinks for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我請大家添飲，今日升職要慶祝！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 ceng2 daai6 gaa1 tim1 jam2, gam1 jat6 sing1 zik1 jiu3 hing3 zuk1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我請大家再喝一輪，今天升職要慶祝！
examples.english_sentence: I'll buy everyone another round tonight — celebrating a promotion!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 杯酒飲完未？要唔要我幫你添飲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bui1 zau2 jam2 jyun4 mei6? jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 tim1 jam2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 杯酒喝完了嗎？要不要我幫你續杯？
examples.english_sentence: Finished your drink? Want me to top up your glass?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔識飲酒，但朋友成日叫佢添飲，佢有啲唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sik1 jam2 zau2, daan6 pang4 jau5 sing4 jat6 giu3 keoi5 tim1 jam2, keoi5 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不太會喝酒，但朋友經常要他再喝，讓他有點不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He isn't good at drinking, but his friends often urge him to drink more, which makes him feel uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 廣闊的水域；水勢遼闊（文言用字）
english_meaning: a vast expanse of water; vast/immense (literary)
explanation_mandarin: 「淼」原指水勢廣闊、浩渺，常見於書面或人名中，表達水面寬廣或遼闊的意象。
explanation_english: Originally refers to an expansive body of water or great watery vastness. Used mainly in literary contexts or as a character in names to evoke the image of wide, boundless water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅中文名有個字係「淼」，代表廣闊嘅水域。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zung1 man4 ming4 jau5 go3 zi6 hai6 "miu5", doi6 biu2 gwong2 fut3 ge3 seoi2 wik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的中文名里有一个字是“淼”，代表广阔的水域。
examples.english_sentence: His Chinese name contains the character "淼", which represents a vast expanse of water.

mandarin_meaning: 清（qīng）：清澈、乾淨、清晰；也可作動詞表示打掃、清理或結清（帳目）。
english_meaning: clear; clean; pure; to clear or settle (accounts); distinct
explanation_mandarin: 「清」可表示狀態（如清澈、清晰、乾淨），也可作動詞表示清理、清除或結清（如結算帳目）。常見於合成詞（清楚、清潔、清理）及口語用法（清枱、清晒）。
explanation_english: The character "清" can describe a state (clear, clean, distinct) or function as a verb meaning to clear, clean, or settle (e.g. accounts). It appears in compounds (清楚, 清潔, 清理) and in colloquial usages (e.g. 清枱, 清晒).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我清枱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 cing1 toi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫我清理桌子。
examples.english_sentence: Help me clear the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅聲音好清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 seng1 jam1 hou2 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的聲音很清晰。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is very clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月賬目已經清晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 zoeng3 muk6 ji5 ging1 cing1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個月的帳目已經結清了。
examples.english_sentence: This month's accounts have been settled.

mandarin_meaning: 清一色 / 纯一色（全部由同一花色/同一类型组成）
english_meaning: qingyise (mahjong): a hand made entirely of one suit; by extension, all of the same kind / uniform
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語；可作名詞或形容詞
explanation_mandarin: 原指麻將裡由同一花色的牌組成的一種牌型（清一色/純一色），引申為全部相同、單一類型或全部屬於同一陣營。
explanation_english: Originally a mahjong term for a winning hand composed entirely of tiles from one suit (qingyise). Extended meaning: all the same, of a single type, or all belonging to the same group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺麻雀攞咗清一色，贏咗好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 maa4zoek3 lo2 zo2 cing1 jat1 sik1, jing4 zo2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在打麻将时胡了清一色，赢了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He won with a qīngyīsè in mahjong and won big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議會入面清一色都係同一個黨，冇反對聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 wui2 jap6 min6 cing1 jat1 sik1 dou1 hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 dong2, mou5 faan2 deoi3 sing1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 议会里全都是同一个党，没有反对的声音。
examples.english_sentence: The council is entirely from the same party, with no opposing voices.

mandarin_meaning: 清仓（清理库存；以降价或促销方式出售存货）
english_meaning: to clear out inventory; clearance (sale); to sell off remaining stock
explanation_mandarin: 指商家为了清空仓库或减少存货而大量出售商品，通常会以降价、打折或促销方式进行；也可引申为把某处的物品全部清走。
explanation_english: Refers to a business selling off stock to empty the warehouse or reduce inventory, typically by discounting or promotions; can also mean clearing out items from a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭今個星期做緊清倉大減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 zou6 gan2 cing1 cong1 daai6 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店这星期正在清仓大减价。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is having a clearance sale this week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司轉型，打算清倉賣晒舊貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zyun2 jing4, daa2 syun3 cing1 cong1 maai6 saai3 gau6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司转型，打算清仓卖掉旧货。
examples.english_sentence: The company is restructuring and plans to clear out and sell the old stock.

mandarin_meaning: 把（年假等）休完；把剩餘的假期用完
english_meaning: to use up/finish one's (remaining) leave (e.g., annual leave); to take leave to clear remaining vacation days
explanation_mandarin: 常用於職場語境，指將剩餘的假期休掉或在指定期間把年假等用完。
explanation_english: Commonly used in workplace contexts to mean taking/using up remaining leave (e.g., annual leave), often before a deadline or specified period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲有三日年假未用，要趁住年底前清假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jau5 saam1 jat6 nin4 gaa3 mei6 jung6, jiu3 can3 zyu6 nin4 dai2 cin4 cing1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 還有三天年假沒用，要趁年底前把假休完。
