explanation_english: Describes extremely heavy rain, like a downpour or torrential rain; often seen in phrases like "滂沱大雨".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝落滂沱大雨，成個街都積水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 lok6 pong4 to4 daai6 jyu5, sing4 go3 gaai1 dou1 zik1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下着滂沱大雨，整個街道都積水。
examples.english_sentence: It was pouring this morning; the whole street was flooded.

mandarin_meaning: 滂沱大雨 / 傾盆大雨
english_meaning: torrential downpour; heavy rain
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容雨下得非常大、持續且猛烈的短語或成語，相當於「傾盆大雨」。
explanation_english: A phrase describing extremely heavy, continuous, and intense rainfall — equivalent to a torrential downpour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落滂沱大雨，成條街都積水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 pong1 to4 daai6 jyu5, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 zik1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下着滂沱大雨，整條街都積水了。
examples.english_sentence: It poured heavily today; the whole street is flooded.

mandarin_meaning: 苍、深蓝、广阔（常见于合成词如“滄海”“滄桑”）
english_meaning: deep blue/azure; vast (especially of the sea); used in compounds to convey vastness or vicissitudes
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（多用于合成词）
explanation_mandarin: “滄”本义与水色、深广有关，用于构词如“滄海”“滄桑”，可指苍茫、广大或岁月变迁的沧桑感。
explanation_english: Literary character relating to deep blue or vast waters. Commonly appears in compounds (e.g. 滄海, 滄桑) to evoke vastness or the sense of vicissitudes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺滄海一粟嘅世界入面，呢件事好渺小。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 cong1 hoi2 jat1 suk1 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jap6 min6, ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 miu4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在滄海一粟的世界裡，這件事微不足道。
examples.english_sentence: In the grand scheme of things (a drop in the ocean), this matter is insignificant.

mandarin_meaning: 沧桑 (形容经历巨大变化或岁月留下的痕迹)
english_meaning: time-worn; marked by vicissitudes; showing the effects of many changes or hardships
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容經歷了長時間和許多變遷後所呈現的滄桑感或巨大變化，常用於描述人、容貌或事物因歲月和經歷而顯得滄老、變化很大。
explanation_english: Describes the sense of being worn or altered by time and many changes; often used for people, appearances, or things that show signs of long experience, hardship, or great transformation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷咗咁多事，佢個面容顯得滄桑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 zo2 gam2 do1 si6, keoi5 go3 min6 jung4 hin2 dak1 cong1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历了这么多事情，他的面容显得沧桑。
examples.english_sentence: After going through so much, his face looked weathered by the vicissitudes of life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊村落經過時代變遷，變得滿目滄桑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 cyun1 lok6 ging1 gwo3 si4 doi6 bin3 cin1, bin3 dak1 maan5 muk6 cong1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧村落经过时代变迁，变得满目沧桑。
examples.english_sentence: The old village, after the changes of the times, became full of signs of vicissitude.

mandarin_meaning: 沧海桑田：比喻世事、環境或人生經歷發生巨大的變化
english_meaning: An idiom describing great changes over time; the vicissitudes of life (literally: the blue sea turned into mulberry fields)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容經過長時間後，世事或環境發生極大變化，常帶有感慨之意。
explanation_english: Used to describe dramatic changes in the world, environment, or people's lives over long periods of time; often conveys a sense of nostalgia or wonder at change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋返鄉探親，一睇到舊屋變成商場，忍唔住感慨滄海桑田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 faan1 hoeng1 taam3 can1, jat1 tai2 dou3 gau6 nguk1 bin3 sing4 soeng1 coeng4, jan2 m4 zyu6 gam2 koi3 cong1 hoi2 soeng1 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們返鄉探親，一看到舊屋變成商場，忍不住感慨沧海桑田。
examples.english_sentence: When we returned to our hometown to visit relatives, seeing the old houses turned into shopping malls, we couldn't help but sigh at how much things have changed.

mandarin_meaning: 意指在眾多事物中被忽視或遺漏的優秀人物或事物；可與「遺珠之憾」相近
english_meaning: A gem lost in the vast sea — a talented person or excellent thing that is overlooked or omitted; a regrettable omission
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在激烈競爭或大量事物之中未被發掘或被忽略的優秀人才或事物，帶有惋惜意味。
explanation_english: Used metaphorically for a capable person or outstanding thing that is overlooked or left out amid many others; carries a sense of regret about the oversight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選拔賽入圍名單太短，結果有幾位有實力嘅選手變咗滄海遺珠，好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 baat3 coi3 jap6 wai4 ming4 daan1 taai3 dyun2, git3 gwo2 jau5 gei2 wai2 jau5 sat6 lik6 ge3 syun2 sau2 bin3 zo2 cong1 hoi2 wai4 zyu1, hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次選拔賽入圍名單太短，結果有幾位有實力的選手成了滄海遺珠，真可惜。
examples.english_sentence: The shortlist for this selection was too short; as a result, several capable contestants were overlooked — a real pity.

mandarin_meaning: 灭（扑灭、消灭、消失）
english_meaning: to extinguish; to put out; to eliminate; to die out
explanation_mandarin: 表示使火、光、聲等停止或使某事物消失、滅絕，也可引申為消除、根除。
explanation_english: Means to put out or extinguish (fire, light, etc.), to eliminate or cause something to cease, or to become extinct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員成功滅咗火，無人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 sing4 gung1 mit6 zo2 fo2, mou5 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员成功扑灭了火，没有人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters successfully put out the fire; no one was injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲滅支煙啦，屋企唔可以喺室內抽煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 mit6 zi1 jin1 laa1, uk1 kei2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 sat1 noi6 cau1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把煙快點掐滅，家裡不能在室內抽煙。
examples.english_sentence: Put out your cigarette quickly; you can't smoke indoors at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種動物已經滅絕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 dung6 mat6 ji5 ging1 mit6 gyut3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種動物已經滅絕了。
examples.english_sentence: This species of animal has already become extinct.

mandarin_meaning: 灭亡（mièwáng）
english_meaning: to perish; to be destroyed; extinction; annihilation
explanation_mandarin: 指國家、民族、物種或事物完全喪失生存或存在的狀態，即被消滅或滅絕。
explanation_english: Refers to the complete loss of existence or survival of a country, people, species, or thing — being destroyed or driven to extinction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔改變方法，呢種文化有機會滅亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 goi2 bin3 fong1 faat3, ni1 zung2 man4 faa3 jau5 gei1 wui6 mit6 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不改变方法，这种文化有可能灭亡。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't change our methods, this culture may perish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司如果繼續蝕下去，好快就會滅亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jyu4 gwo2 gai3 zuk6 sik6 haa6 heoi3, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 mit6 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司如果继续亏损，很快就会灭亡。
examples.english_sentence: If this company keeps losing money, it will soon go out of business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為人類破壞自然環境，唔少物種已經滅亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jan4 leoi5 po3 waai6 zi6 jin4 waan4 ging2, m4 siu2 mat6 zung2 ji5 ging1 mit6 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为人类破坏自然环境，不少物种已经灭亡。
examples.english_sentence: Because humans damage the natural environment, many species have already become extinct.

mandarin_meaning: （通常指）通过杀害或压制等手段使知情者不再说出真相；封口
english_meaning: to silence someone (often by killing or otherwise preventing them from revealing information); to cover up by silencing a witness
explanation_mandarin: “滅口”一般指为防止泄密或掩盖罪行而对知情者采取极端手段使其不能再说话，既可指实际的杀害，也可泛指用金钱、威胁等手段封口。
explanation_english: “滅口” means to silence someone to prevent them from speaking out or revealing information. It often implies extreme measures (including killing) but can also refer to bribery, threats, or other ways of suppressing speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋驚有人會洩密，竟然想滅口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 geng1 jau5 jan4 wui5 sit3 mat6, ging2 jin4 soeng2 mit6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们担心有人会泄密，竟然想灭口。
examples.english_sentence: They were worried someone would leak the information and actually considered silencing (even killing) them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆用錢滅口，叫員工唔好講公司內情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jung6 cin2 mit6 hau2, giu3 jyun4 gung1 m4 hou2 gong2 gung1 si1 noi6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板用钱收买人封口，叫员工不要讲公司的内情。
examples.english_sentence: The boss tried to buy people's silence with money, telling employees not to talk about the company's inner affairs.

mandarin_meaning: 灭团（miè tuán）：（游戏）整个队伍被消灭；（引申）使团队、项目或活动失败或解散
english_meaning: to wipe out the team/party (in gaming); figuratively, to cause a group/project/event to collapse or disband
explanation_mandarin: “灭团”常用于网络游戏，指整队被敌人消灭（全队被打挂、失败）。引申用法可指使某个团队、项目或活动受到重创而失败或解散。
explanation_english: Commonly used in online gaming to mean the entire party was wiped out. By extension, it can be used slangily to mean causing a team, project, or event to be ruined, collapse, or disband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場副本好難，頭先我哋全隊畀怪物打到滅團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 fu6 bun2 hou2 naan4, tau4 sin1 ngo5 dei6 cyun4 deoi2 bei2 gwaai3 mat6 daa2 dou3 mit6 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场副本很困难，刚才我们全队被怪物打得灭团了。
examples.english_sentence: This dungeon was tough — our whole party just got wiped out by the monsters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，成個project差啲就滅團，幸好有人幫手救返番。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, seng4 go3 project caa1 di1 zau6 mit6 tyun4, hang6 hou2 jau5 jan4 bong1 sau2 gau3 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事，整个项目差点就垮了，幸好有人帮忙挽救回来。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up and the whole project almost collapsed — luckily someone stepped in to save it.

mandarin_meaning: 灭火（字面：熄灭火焰；引申：平息、消减热度或冲动）
english_meaning: to extinguish a fire; figuratively, to put out enthusiasm/arousal or to defuse/Calm down a situation
explanation_mandarin: 滅火原指把火熄灭。引申用法包括：1）使某人的热情或兴奋冷却（如“澆冷水”）；2）平息冲突或化解紧张局面。
explanation_english: Literally means to put out a fire. Figuratively it is used to describe putting out someone's enthusiasm or arousal, or to defuse/take the heat out of a tense situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員趕到現場滅火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 gon2 dou3 jin6 coeng4 mit6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员赶到现场灭火。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters arrived at the scene to put out the fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講會滅我火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gong2 wui5 mit6 ngo5 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說會讓我掃興。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that will kill my enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去同佢傾下，幫手滅火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 tung4 keoi5 king1 haa5, bong1 sau2 mit6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去跟他談談，幫忙把事情平息下來。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go talk to him to help calm things down.

mandarin_meaning: 消防水带 / 灭火水喉
english_meaning: fire hose
explanation_mandarin: 指用來輸送水以撲滅火災的軟管或管道，常見於消防裝備中。
explanation_english: A hose used to deliver water for extinguishing fires; commonly part of firefighting equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火警嗰陣，消防員好快拉出滅火喉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 ging2 go2 zan6, siu1 fong4 jyun4 hou2 faai3 laai1 ceot1 mit6 fo2 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起火時，消防員很快拉出滅火喉。
examples.english_sentence: When the fire broke out, the firefighters quickly pulled out the fire hose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要定期檢查滅火喉有冇破損或滲漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ding6 kei4 gim2 caa4 mit6 fo2 hau4 jau5 mou5 po3 syun2 waak6 sam3 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要定期檢查滅火喉有沒有破損或滲漏。
examples.english_sentence: We need to inspect the fire hoses regularly for damage or leaks.

mandarin_meaning: 灭火器；（口语）比喻扫兴的人或能平息事态/争端的事物
english_meaning: fire extinguisher; (colloquially) a mood-killer or something/someone that puts out a heated situation
explanation_mandarin: 原指用于扑灭火灾的器具。口语中也可用来比喻使气氛冷却、扫兴的人或物，或指用来平息纷争、“灭火”的手段。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a device used to extinguish fires. Colloquially it can mean a person or thing that kills the mood or calms/defuses a heated situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司樓梯間放咗個滅火筒，萬一起火可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 lau4tai1 gaan1 fong3 zo2 go3 mit6 fo2 tung4, maan6 jat1 hei2 fo2 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司楼梯间放了一个灭火器，以防万一起火可以使用。
examples.english_sentence: They placed a fire extinguisher in the company's stairwell in case of fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺派對不停講安全嘢，真係個滅火筒，搞到大家冇晒氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 paai3 deoi3 bat1 ting4 gong2 on1cyun4 je5, zan1 hai6 go3 mit6 fo2 tung4, gaau2 dou3 daai6gaa1 mou5 saai3 hei3fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在派对不停讲安全的事，真是个扫兴的人，搞得大家没了气氛。
examples.english_sentence: He kept talking about safety at the party — a real mood-killer; he ruined the atmosphere.

mandarin_meaning: 灭绝 (mièjué)，彻底消失或根除
english_meaning: to become extinct; to annihilate; extinction
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as noun: extinction)
explanation_mandarin: 指物種、現象或事物徹底消失、不再存在；也可指完全消滅或根除某事物。
explanation_english: Refers to a species, phenomenon, or thing being completely wiped out and ceasing to exist; can also mean to eradicate or annihilate something entirely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔保護佢哋，呢啲動物好快就會滅絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 bou2 wu6 keoi5 dei6, ni1 di1 dung6 mat6 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 mit6 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不保护它们，这些动物很快就会灭绝。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't protect them, these animals will become extinct soon.

mandarin_meaning: 消除/赦免罪责；（宗教或比喻）赎罪
english_meaning: to remove/absolve guilt or criminal liability; to atone for sins
explanation_mandarin: 「滅罪」可指從法律或道德層面消除或赦免罪責；在宗教語境常指赎罪或得赦免。口語中亦可比喻用某種行為試圖抹去羞愧或責任。
explanation_english: “滅罪” means to eliminate or absolve guilt or criminal responsibility. In religious contexts it refers to atonement or forgiveness of sins; colloquially it can mean attempting to erase blame by some action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想用捐錢滅罪，但其實唔係咁簡單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jung6 gyun1 cin2 mit6 zeoi6, daan6 kei4 sat6 m4 hai6 gam2 gaan2 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想用捐钱来消除罪责，但其实不是那么简单。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to donate money to clear his guilt, but it's not that simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牧師話只有信神先可以滅罪，呢樣係教會嘅教導。
examples.jyutping_sentence: muk6 si1 waa6 zi2 jau5 seon3 san4 sin1 ho2 ji5 mit6 zeoi6, ni1 joeng6 hai6 gaau3 wui2 ge3 gaau3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牧师说只有相信上帝才能赦免罪过，这是教会的教导。
examples.english_sentence: The pastor said only by believing in God can sins be forgiven; this is the church's teaching.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）使某人噤聲或停止發言；使聲音消失或被壓制
english_meaning: to silence (someone); to make someone stop speaking; to quiet or suppress sound
explanation_mandarin: 滅聲為廣東話口語用法，通常指令某人停止說話或被迫不再發言，也可指讓聲音消失或被壓制。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term meaning to silence someone or to stop making a sound; often used to say someone was made quiet or dared not speak again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上畀老細滅聲，之後冇再發言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 bei2 lou5 sai3 mit6 seng1, zi1 hau6 mou5 zoi3 faat3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在會議上被老闆噤聲，之後沒有再發言。
examples.english_sentence: He was silenced by the boss in the meeting and didn't speak again afterwards.

mandarin_meaning: 灭门 (灭绝一家或一个家族；亦指灭门案件)
english_meaning: to wipe out a household/family; familicide; mass killing of a family
explanation_mandarin: 指将一个家庭或家族全部杀害或灭绝，常用于法律或新闻语境（如“灭门案”）。
explanation_english: Refers to killing off an entire household or clan (extermination of a family). Often used in legal or news contexts (e.g., “a familicide” or “a wipe-out of a household”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞話有一宗滅門案，成個屋企都冇人倖存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 waa6 jau5 jat1 zung1 mit6 mun4 on3, sing4 go3 uk1 kei2 dou1 mou5 jan4 hang6 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新闻报道称发生了一起灭门案件，整个家庭都没有幸存者。
examples.english_sentence: The news reported a familicide — the entire household had no survivors.

mandarin_meaning: 灭顶之灾（遭遇毁灭性的大灾难或灾祸）
english_meaning: a catastrophic disaster; utter calamity (literally 'a disaster of being submerged/drowned')
explanation_mandarin: 原指被水淹没而遭受灭顶的灾祸，现多用于比喻遭受极为严重或毁灭性的灾难或祸患。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the calamity of being submerged (drowned). Now used figuratively to describe a severe or devastating catastrophe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔及早檢討，可能會引致公司滅頂之災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 kap6 zou2 gim2 tou2, ho2 nang4 wui5 jan5 zi3 gung1 si1 mit6 ding2 zi1 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不及早檢討，公司可能會面臨滅頂之災。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't review this promptly, the company could face utter disaster.

mandarin_meaning: 滇（古称），指云南，常作地名简称（如滇池、滇西）
english_meaning: Dian (old name for Yunnan); used as an abbreviation for Yunnan in place names
explanation_mandarin: 「滇」原為古地名，指今中國雲南一帶，現多用作地名簡稱或作為地區前綴，如滇池、滇西、滇南等。
explanation_english: "滇" is an historical place name referring to the Yunnan region in China. It is commonly used as an abbreviation or prefix in place names (e.g., Dianchi, western Yunnan).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滇池喺雲南昆明附近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din1 ci4 hai2 wan4 naam4 kwan1 ming4 fu6 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 滇池在云南昆明附近。
examples.english_sentence: Dianchi is near Kunming, Yunnan.

mandarin_meaning: 滋：滋生、滋长；滋味、味道
english_meaning: to grow; to cause/to give rise to; taste/flavor
explanation_mandarin: “滋”常作动词，表示产生、滋生、滋长等，也可作为名词构成表示味道的词（如“滋味”）。在合成词中用于表示事物的生长或产生，如“滋生”“滋长”“滋润”。
explanation_english: “滋” is often used as a verb meaning to produce, give rise to, or grow; it also appears as a root forming nouns referring to taste or flavor (e.g. “滋味”). In compounds it commonly indicates growth or generation (e.g. '滋生', '滋长', '滋润').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯好滋味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 hou2 zi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗汤很有滋味。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup is very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲細問題會滋生大麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sai3 man6 tai4 wui5 zi1 saang1 daai6 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些小问题会滋生大麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: These small problems can give rise to big troubles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 潮濕環境會滋長細菌，記得保持清潔乾燥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu4 sap1 waan4 ging2 wui5 zi1 zoeng2 sai3 kwan4, gei3 dak1 bou2 ci4 cing1 git3 gon1 ziu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 潮湿环境会滋长细菌，记得保持清洁干燥。
examples.english_sentence: A damp environment fosters bacterial growth; remember to keep things clean and dry.

mandarin_meaning: 滋事（挑起事端、擾亂秩序）
english_meaning: to cause trouble; to make a disturbance; to provoke disorder
explanation_mandarin: 表示挑起或製造事端、擾亂公共秩序，常用於描述鬧事或滋擾治安的行為。
explanation_english: To provoke or create disturbances that disrupt public order; commonly used to describe troublemaking or disorderly conduct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人喺街度滋事，搞到交通塞晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zi1 si6, gaau2 dou3 gaau1 tung1 sak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在街上滋事，搞得交通完全塞住了。
examples.english_sentence: Some people are causing trouble on the street, making traffic completely jammed.

mandarin_meaning: 味道；（口語）感覺、滋味、好處或不舒服的感受
english_meaning: taste; flavor; (colloquial) a feeling or experience — pleasant or unpleasant
explanation_mandarin: 「滋味」原指食物的味道、風味；在廣東話口語中也常用來形容某種感覺或經歷，例如「好滋味」表示好吃、舒服或愉快，「唔滋味」表示不舒服或不開心。
explanation_english: Originally denotes the taste or flavor of food. In Cantonese colloquial use it also describes how something feels or the quality of an experience — e.g. "hou2 zi1 mei6" (好滋味) = tasty/pleasant/satisfying, while "m4 zi1 mei6" (唔滋味) = unpleasant/not feeling well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲湯好滋味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 tong1 hou2 zi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗湯很有滋味。
examples.english_sentence: This soup is very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同朋友傾偈嗰陣，真係好滋味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 pang4 jau5 king1 gai2 go2 zan6, zan1 hai6 hou2 zi1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 和朋友聊天的時候，真的很愉快。
examples.english_sentence: Chatting with my friends then was really enjoyable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我有啲唔滋味，心情唔太好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 jau5 di1 m4 zi1 mei6, sam1 cing4 m4 taai3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我有點不太舒服，心情不好。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've been feeling a bit off; my mood isn't great.

mandarin_meaning: 閒逛、悠閒、瞎混（俚語）
english_meaning: to loaf around, hang out idly; to take it easy (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「滋悠」是香港粵語的俚語，用來形容無所事事、閒逛或悠閒地混日子，有時帶有懶散或打發時間的意思。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang verb meaning to loaf around, hang out idly or take it easy — often implying idleness or killing time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日冇嘢做，不如去街度滋悠吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 mou5 je5 zou6, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 gaai1 dou6 zi1 jau4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天沒事做，不如去街上閒逛一下。
examples.english_sentence: There's nothing to do today — let's go hang out on the street for a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企滋悠，唔肯搵工，屋企人好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 zi1 jau4, m4 hang2 wan2 gung1, uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在家裡閒混，不肯找工作，家裡人很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: He loafs around at home all day and won't look for a job — his family is worried.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語口語）悠然淡定、從容不迫、泰然自若
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for being calm, composed, unbothered, and relaxed
explanation_mandarin: 「滋悠淡定」是粵語口語/俚語，用來形容一個人態度從容、不慌張、非常淡定，帶有輕鬆、不被外界干擾的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression describing someone who is composed, unflustered, and relaxed — coolly unfazed by situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對困難嘅時候佢好滋悠淡定，唔會亂嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6 keoi5 hou2 zi1 jau4 daam6 ding6, m4 wui5 lyun6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對困難的時候，他很淡定，不會慌張。
examples.english_sentence: When facing difficulties, he stays calm and unbothered; he doesn't panic.

mandarin_meaning: 滋擾 (zī rǎo)：打擾、騷擾，擾亂他人安寧
english_meaning: to disturb; to harass; to cause annoyance or disruption to others
explanation_mandarin: 表示造成騷擾或打擾，使他人感到不安或無法安寧。可用於日常生活情境或法律、投訴的語境中。
explanation_english: Indicates causing disturbance or harassment, making others feel uneasy or preventing them from having peace. Used in everyday contexts as well as legal/complaint contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企搞到好嘈，滋擾咗隔離嘅鄰居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 gaau2 dou3 hou2 cou4, zi1 jiu6 zo2 gaak3 lei4 ge3 leon4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在家裡製造很吵的噪音，擾亂了隔壁的鄰居。
examples.english_sentence: He often makes a lot of noise at home, disturbing the neighbors.

mandarin_meaning: 加油（用于鼓励、打气）
english_meaning: cheer on; encourage; keep it up
explanation_mandarin: 「滋油」是香港粵語網絡與口語中的俗用詞，常作「加油」的諧音或變體，用來鼓勵別人或為團隊打氣，語氣較輕鬆、非正式。
explanation_english: “滋油” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used online and in speech as a variant or homophone of “加油” (gaa1 jau4). It’s used to cheer someone on or offer encouragement; informal and colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，滋油啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, zi1 jau4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，加油！
examples.english_sentence: Good luck on the exam tomorrow — go for it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日比賽要贏，大家滋油！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 bei2 coi3 jiu3 jing4, daai6 gaa1 zi1 jau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天比赛要赢，大家加油！
examples.english_sentence: We need to win today's match — everyone, let's go!

mandarin_meaning: 保持冷靜、淡定（口語／俚語）
english_meaning: stay calm and collected; remain composed (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「滋油淡定」為香港粵語網絡/口語用語，意思是勸人或描述某人保持冷靜、不慌張、心態從容。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase used to tell or describe someone to stay calm and composed — to not panic and keep a relaxed attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發生咁多事，你都要滋油淡定呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 saang1 gam2 do1 si6, nei5 dou1 jiu3 zi1 jau4 daam6 ding6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 發生這麼多事，你也要保持冷靜啊。
examples.english_sentence: So much is happening — you should stay calm and collected.

mandarin_meaning: 滋滋悠悠（擬聲詞）形容聲音細小、連綿且悠長，如油鍋或電流持續發出的聲音
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic expression describing a faint, continuous, long-drawn sound (e.g. sizzling or crackling that lingers)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 拟声词 / 可作状词或形容词
explanation_mandarin: “滋滋”常用來模仿油鍋、電流等發出的嘶嘶聲，“悠悠”表示聲音延綿、悠長。合起來用於形容那種持續、微弱且帶拖長感的聲響。
explanation_english: “Zi-zi yau-yau” combines a sizzling sound with a sense of length/lingering. It describes a sustained, faint, drawn-out noise (for example, oil frying, electric crackle), and is used as an onomatopoeic descriptive phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鑊入面啲油滋滋悠悠咁響，唔好離開廚房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wok6 jap6 min6 di1 jau4 zi1 zi1 jau4 jau4 gam2 hoeng2, m4 hou2 lei4 hoi1 cyu4 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鍋裡的油滋滋悠悠地響著，別離開廚房。
examples.english_sentence: The oil in the wok is sizzling continuously; don't leave the kitchen.

mandarin_meaning: 滋润 (zī rùn) — 使湿润、滋养；形容湿润或富有营养，也可指使生活、心灵等得到充实、受益。
english_meaning: to moisten / moisturizing / nourishing — to make moist or nourish; describes something that is moist or well-nourished; can be used figuratively to mean enriching or nourishing (e.g., the soul, life).
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某物變得濕潤或有營養，常用於皮膚、土壤等，亦可引申為滋養心靈或生活。
explanation_english: Indicates making something moist or nourishing; commonly used for skin, soil, etc., and figuratively for nourishing the mind or enriching life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支面霜好滋潤，冬天用啱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 min6 soeng1 hou2 zi1 jeon6, dung1 tin1 jung6 aam3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支面霜很滋润，冬天用正合适。
examples.english_sentence: This face cream is very moisturizing; perfect for winter use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多啲閱讀可以滋潤心靈，令人感覺充實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 di1 jyut6 duk6 ho2 ji5 zi1 jeon6 sam1 ling4, ling6 jan4 gam2 gok3 cung1 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多阅读可以滋润心灵，让人感觉充实。
examples.english_sentence: Reading more can nourish the soul and make one feel fulfilled.

mandarin_meaning: 滋生（产生、繁殖、引起，常指不良事物如虫害、腐败、问题等的产生）
english_meaning: to give rise to; to breed; to generate or cause to proliferate (often used for undesirable things like pests, corruption, problems)
explanation_mandarin: 表示产生或增长，常用于不好的事物或情况，如滋生蚊蟲、滋生腐敗、滋生問題等。
explanation_english: Indicates something comes into being or increases, frequently used for undesirable phenomena (e.g., to breed pests, foster corruption, cause problems).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企唔清潔會滋生霉菌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nguk1 kei2 m4 cing1 git3 wui5 zi1 saang1 mui4 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡不清潔會滋生霉菌。
examples.english_sentence: A dirty home will breed mold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 垃圾堆放不當會滋生蚊蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laap6 saap3 deoi1 fong3 bat1 dong6 wui5 zi1 saang1 man1 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 垃圾堆放不當會滋生蚊蟲。
examples.english_sentence: Improperly disposed garbage can breed mosquitoes and other pests.

mandarin_meaning: 滋补 (zībǔ)
english_meaning: to nourish; nourishing; tonic; restorative
explanation_mandarin: 指補益身體、增強體力或恢復元氣，常用於食品或藥材（如補湯、補藥）表示有滋養、養生作用。
explanation_english: Refers to nourishing or tonifying the body to strengthen health, restore vitality, or recover strength. Commonly used for foods or medicinal preparations (e.g., tonic soups or remedies).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚飲碗雞湯，幾滋補㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jam2 wun2 gai1 tong1, gei2 zi1 bou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚喝碗雞湯，很滋補啊。
examples.english_sentence: Have a bowl of chicken soup tonight — it's quite nourishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病好咗之後都要滋補一下，補返體力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 hou2 zo2 zi1 hau6 dou1 jiu3 zi1 bou2 jat1 haa5, bou2 faan1 tai2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病好了之後也要滋補一下，恢復體力。
examples.english_sentence: After recovering from illness it's good to take nourishing food to restore strength.

mandarin_meaning: 使增長；滋生、繁殖；（常用於不良事物的擴散或增多）
english_meaning: to promote growth; to cause to increase or proliferate (often used for undesirable things)
explanation_mandarin: 表示使某種事物生長或增多，常用來形容不良現象或有害事物的擴張與繁衍。
explanation_english: Indicates causing something to grow or increase; frequently used to describe the spread or proliferation of undesirable phenomena or harmful things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污滋長係因為監管唔夠嚴格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 zi1 zoeng2 hai6 jan1 wai6 gaam1 gun2 m4 gau3 jim4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 貪污滋長是因為監管不夠嚴格。
examples.english_sentence: Corruption has proliferated because oversight is not strict enough.

mandarin_meaning: 滋陰（zī yīn），中醫術語，補養陰液、潤燥以治陰虛。
english_meaning: to nourish (tonify) the yin; replenish the body's yin (in Traditional Chinese Medicine).
explanation_mandarin: 滋陰是中醫術語，指滋養人體的陰液（陰津、陰血等），用以緩解陰虛、乾燥等症狀，常通過中藥或飲食調理達成。
explanation_english: A Traditional Chinese Medicine term meaning to nourish the body's yin (the cooling, moistening aspect). It refers to replenishing yin fluids to relieve yin deficiency and dryness, commonly treated with herbs or dietary therapy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話我肺陰虛，要食啲滋陰嘅藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 ngo5 fai3 jam1 heoi1, jiu3 sik6 di1 zi1 jam1 ge3 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医说我肺阴虚，要吃些滋阴的药。
examples.english_sentence: The TCM doctor said I have lung-yin deficiency and I need to take some yin-nourishing medicine.

mandarin_meaning: 滋养（zī yǎng）— 供给营养，使身体、皮肤或生长发育得到保养和促进。
english_meaning: to nourish; nourishing — to provide nutrients or support growth, health, or maintenance (e.g., of the body or skin).
explanation_mandarin: 表示提供營養或有助於保養、生長與恢復，如滋養身體、滋養皮膚。
explanation_english: Refers to supplying nourishment or helping with maintenance, growth, or recovery — e.g., nourishing the body or skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯好滋養，對身體幫助好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 hou2 zi1 joeng5, deoi3 san1 tai2 bong1 zo6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗湯很滋養，對身體幫助很大。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup is very nourishing and is great for the body.

mandarin_meaning: 洗滌 (xǐdí)：清洗、淨化
english_meaning: to wash; to cleanse; to purify (literally washing or figuratively purifying)
explanation_mandarin: 表示清洗、洗滌、洗刷的動作，既可指物理上的清潔，也可用來比喻精神或思想上的淨化，常見於詞語如「洗滌」。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of washing or cleansing. Can refer to physical washing (e.g., clothes) or be used metaphorically for purification of mind or ideas. Commonly appears in compounds like "洗滌".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要將啲衫洗滌乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 saam1 sai2 dik6 gon1 zeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要把衣服洗滌乾淨。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wash the clothes clean tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段經歷幫我洗滌咗內心嘅雜念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 ging1 lik6 bong1 ngo5 sai2 dik6 zo2 noi6 sam1 ge3 zaap6 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段經歷幫助我洗滌了內心的雜念。
examples.english_sentence: This experience helped cleanse the distracting thoughts in my heart.

mandarin_meaning: 滑 (huá)：光滑、滑溜；也可指人油滑、狡猾
english_meaning: slippery; smooth; slick; (of a person) slippery/sly
explanation_mandarin: 「滑」常用來表示表面光滑或質地順滑（例如食物口感），也可用來形容人言行油滑、狡猾或事物易滑動。
explanation_english: "滑" is used to describe a smooth or slippery surface or texture (e.g., food mouthfeel). It can also describe a person as slick/oily or something that easily slips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地面好滑，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 min6 hou2 waat6, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地面很滑，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The floor is very slippery — be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好滑，唔好信晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 waat6, m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很油滑，不要全信他。
examples.english_sentence: He talks in a slick way; don't trust him completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊豆腐食落好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 dau6 fu6 sik6 lok6 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块豆腐吃起来很滑。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of tofu is very smooth (in texture).

mandarin_meaning: 圓滑、狡猾；愛推卸或迴避責任（口語/網絡用語）
english_meaning: slick/sly; someone who is evasive, crafty, or 'slippery' — often dodges responsibility (colloquial Hong Kong slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「滑lulu」是香港口語/網絡俚語，用來形容一個人圓滑、狡猾或愛推託、迴避責任。語感比正式的「圓滑」或「狡猾」更輕鬆、帶口語色彩。
explanation_english: “滑lulu” is Hong Kong colloquial/slang used to describe someone who is slick, sly, or evasive — prone to making excuses or dodging responsibility. It carries a casual, informal tone compared with standard words like “sly” or “crafty.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好滑lulu，成日搵藉口唔承認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 waat6 lu1lu1, seng4 jat6 wan2 zek3 hau2 m4 sing4 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很滑lulu，總是找藉口不承認錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He's really slick/sly at work — always making excuses and won't admit mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: （形容聲音）沙啞且帶滑順感，常指嗓音既有磁性或性感的特質
english_meaning: Describes a voice that is smooth/velvety yet husky or raspy — often implying a seductive or magnetic quality
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語形容詞，通常用來描述人的聲音既有沙啞（啞嗓、粗糙）又帶滑順或圓潤的特色，常用於稱讚嗓音有魅力或性感。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adjective used to describe a voice that is simultaneously husky/raspy and smooth/velvety. Often used to compliment a voice as attractive, magnetic, or seductive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好滑啞，聽落好有魅力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 waat6 aa3, teng1 lok6 hou2 jau5 mei6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話聲音很滑啞，聽起來很有魅力。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks with a smooth, husky voice — it sounds very attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱歌嗰陣佢啲聲有啲滑啞，反而更有味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 go1 go2 zan6 keoi5 di1 seng1 jau5 di1 waat6 aa3, faan2 ji4 gang3 jau5 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱歌時他的聲音有點滑啞，反而更有韻味。
examples.english_sentence: When singing his voice is a bit husky and smooth, which actually adds more character.

mandarin_meaning: 滑溜溜、很光滑/滑嫩（口語）
english_meaning: very smooth or slippery; silky (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，常用來形容表面非常光滑或滑溜，既可指皮膚、食物的滑嫩質感，也可指地面或物件的滑溜易滑。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adjective used to describe something that is very smooth or slippery — can refer to skin, the silky texture of food, or a slick surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB嘅皮膚滑嘟嘟，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 BB ge3 pei4 fu1 waat6 du1 du1, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个宝宝的皮肤滑嘟嘟，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: The baby's skin is smooth and adorable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊豆腐滑嘟嘟，入口即化，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 dau6 fu6 waat6 du1 du1, jap6 hau2 zik1 faa3, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块豆腐滑嘟嘟，入口即化，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of tofu is silky and melts in the mouth — very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地面濕咗，行落去好滑嘟嘟，小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 min6 sap1 zo2, haang4 lok6 heoi3 hou2 waat6 du1 du1, siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地面湿了，走下去很滑嘟嘟，小心点。
examples.english_sentence: The floor is wet and very slippery — be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 滑坡（可指地質上的山體或土石崩塌，即山崩、塌方；也可引申為事物、能力或情況逐漸下滑或衰退）
english_meaning: landslide; slump; decline (literally a landslide or collapse of a slope; metaphorically a gradual deterioration or downward trend)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞／動詞（可作名詞或動詞）
partOfSpeech_english: noun / verb (can be used as noun or verb)
explanation_mandarin: 指山體或斜坡上的土石沿坡面向下移動造成的坍塌（地質意義）；引申為某種情況、能力或表現逐漸下滑或衰退。
explanation_english: Refers to the collapse or downward movement of soil/rock on a slope (a landslide); figuratively used for a gradual deterioration or decline in condition, performance, or standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上連日大雨，發生咗嚴重嘅滑坡，條路畀掩埋咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng6 lin4 jat6 daai6 jyu5, faat3 saang1 zo2 jim4 zung6 ge3 waat6 po1, tiu4 lou6 bei2 jim2 maai4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上連日大雨，發生了嚴重的滑坡，道路被掩埋了。
examples.english_sentence: After continuous heavy rain on the mountain, a severe landslide occurred and the road was buried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔改善經濟政策，企業嘅競爭力會逐步滑坡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 goi2 sin6 ging1 zai3 zing3 caak3, kei5 jip6 ge3 ging6 zang1 lik6 wui5 zuk6 bou6 waat6 po1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不改善經濟政策，企業的競爭力會逐步下滑。
examples.english_sentence: If economic policies aren't improved, companies' competitiveness will gradually decline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學業成績開始滑坡，我哋要幫佢補習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 jip6 sing4 zik1 hoi1 ci2 waat6 po1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 bou2 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的學業成績開始下滑，我們要幫他補習。
examples.english_sentence: His academic performance began to decline; we need to help him with tutoring.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）滑溜溜；表面光滑，或比喻人圓滑、狡猾
english_meaning: Colloquial Cantonese for 'very slippery' or 'smooth'; can also figuratively mean 'slick' or 'evasive' (of a person).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，通常用來形容物件表面很滑或手感光滑；引申可形容人處事圓滑、難以捉摸。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression typically describing something very slippery or smooth to the touch; by extension it can describe a person who is slick or hard to pin down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地面好濕，行路要小心，會好滑捋捋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 min6 hou2 sap1, hang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, wui5 hou2 waat6 leot6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地面很湿，走路要小心，会很滑溜溜。
examples.english_sentence: The floor is very wet; be careful when walking, it's going to be very slippery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好滑捋捋，唔易捉到佢把柄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 waat6 leot6 leot6, m4 ji5 zuk1 dou3 keoi5 baa2 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很圆滑，不容易抓到他的把柄。
examples.english_sentence: He handles things very slickly; it's hard to catch him out.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）滑頭、狡猾、不可靠
english_meaning: colloquial adjective meaning sly/slippery; crafty or untrustworthy
explanation_mandarin: 「滑揗揗」屬於粵語口語用法，常用來形容人處事圓滑、狡猾或不太可靠。語氣帶有輕微貶義或調侃意味，使用上多見於香港粵語口語中。此詞帶有擬聲／疊字的口語特色，書面上較少見。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to describe someone who is sly, slippery, or crafty — someone who cannot be fully trusted. It has a slightly derogatory or teasing tone and is mainly used in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese. The term is reduplicative/onomatopoeic in style and is uncommon in formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人成日滑揗揗，唔好太相信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 sing4 jat6 waat6 syun2 syun2, m4 hou2 taai3 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事總是很滑頭，不要太相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being slippery/sly — don't trust him too much.

mandarin_meaning: 滑板 (huábǎn)
english_meaning: skateboard
explanation_mandarin: 一種有四個輪子的板子，人可以站在上面滑行並做出各種花式動作；同時指以此進行的運動（滑板運動）。
explanation_english: A board with wheels used for riding and performing tricks; also refers to the sport of skateboarding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗一塊滑板，想去公園試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 jat1 faai3 waat6 baan2, soeng2 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛買了一塊滑板，想去公園試一下。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a skateboard and want to go to the park to try it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滑板係一種受年青人歡迎嘅街頭運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waat6 baan2 hai6 jat1 zung2 sau6 nin4 cing1 jan4 fun1 jing4 ge3 gaai1 tau4 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 滑板是一種受年輕人歡迎的街頭運動。
examples.english_sentence: Skateboarding is a popular street sport among young people.

mandarin_meaning: 滑梯 / 溜滑梯
english_meaning: slide (playground slide)
explanation_mandarin: 指遊樂場或公園裡供小孩從上方滑到下方的傾斜遊樂設施。
explanation_english: A playground apparatus with an inclined surface that children slide down for play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喺遊樂場玩滑梯，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 jau4 lok6 coeng4 waan2 waat6 tai1, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子們在游樂場玩滑梯，很開心。
examples.english_sentence: The children are playing on the slide at the playground and are very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 偷懶；敷衍；偷工減料，逃避責任
english_meaning: to slack off; to shirk responsibilities; to do a half-hearted job
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指在工作、上課或其他應該認真做的事情上偷懶、敷衍了事或逃避責任。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese slang meaning to slack off, do the bare minimum, or avoid responsibilities in work, class, or other duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺公司滑水啦，今日有大project要交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 gung1si1 waat6 seoi2 laa1, gam1jat6 jau5 daai6 project jiu3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在公司偷懒了，今天有重要的项目要交。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off at the office — there's a big project due today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你成日滑水，老細會唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 sing4 jat6 waat6 seoi2, lou5 sai3 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你总是偷懒，老板会不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep slacking off, the boss won't be happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次唔好再滑水，做完先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi6 waat6 seoi2, zou6 jyun4 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次别再偷懒了，做完再走。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off this time — finish the work before you leave.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俚語）偷懶、敷衍、逃避責任或翹課
english_meaning: Cantonese slang for slacking off, shirking duties, loafing around, or cutting class
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，通常用來形容在工作或上學時偷懶、不認真做事或逃避責任；有時也用來指翹課。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb used to describe slacking off at work or school, shirking responsibilities, or loafing around; it can also mean cutting class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日滑浪，乜嘢都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4jat6 waat6 long6, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她總是偷懶，什麼事都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He/She always slacks off and doesn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生如果經常滑浪，成績會跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6saang1 jyu4gwo2 ging1soeng4 waat6 long6, sing4zik1 wui5 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果學生經常滑浪，成績會下滑。
examples.english_sentence: If students often slack off, their grades will decline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺返工嘅時間滑浪，專心返工先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 faan1 gung1 ge3 si4gaan3 waat6 long6, zyun1sam1 faan1 gung1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在上班時間滑浪，先專心工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off during work hours; focus on your job first.

mandarin_meaning: 帆板運動（風帆衝浪）
english_meaning: windsurfing (sailboarding)
explanation_mandarin: 指在海面或湖面上，運動者站在一塊有帆的衝浪板上，利用風力操控帆來滑行和轉向的水上運動。
explanation_english: A water sport where a person stands on a sailboard and uses a sail to catch the wind to glide and steer across the water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暑假我想學滑浪風帆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 gaa3 ngo5 soeng2 hok6 waat6 long6 fung1 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暑假我想學帆板運動（滑浪風帆）。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn windsurfing during the summer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺西貢好鍾意滑浪風帆，成日出海練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sai1 gung3 hou2 zung1 ji3 waat6 long6 fung1 faan4, sing4 jat6 ceot1 hoi2 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在西貢很喜歡滑浪風帆，經常出海練習。
examples.english_sentence: He loves windsurfing in Sai Kung and often goes out to sea to practice.

mandarin_meaning: 滑溜；光滑、容易滑動
english_meaning: slippery; smooth; sleek
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容物體表面光滑或很容易滑動，也可口語地形容某些人或事物圓滑、靈巧或不易抓穩。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is smooth or easy to slip on. Colloquially can describe something or someone as slick or hard to hold/catch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地板好滑溜，小心啲，唔好跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 baan2 hou2 waat6 lau1, siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地板很滑，小心別跌倒。
examples.english_sentence: The floor is very slippery, be careful not to fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條魚好滑溜，好難拎得穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 hou2 waat6 lau1, hou2 naan4 ling1 dak1 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條魚很滑，很難拿穩。
examples.english_sentence: This fish is very slippery and hard to hold steady.

mandarin_meaning: 光滑而潺潺流动的样子（拟声/形容），形容液体或表面流动时发出连绵声音或流动平滑的状态
english_meaning: smoothly flowing; gliding with a murmuring flow (onomatopoeic), describing liquids or surfaces that move with a continuous, smooth sound
explanation_mandarin: “滑潺潺”带有拟声和形容性质，常用來描写溪水、液體或光滑表面流動時的聲響與平滑感，既可用于书面描写，也可口語化使用。
explanation_english: “滑潺潺” is an onomatopoeic descriptive phrase used to evoke the continuous, smooth murmuring of flowing water or the gliding of a smooth surface. It appears in both literary descriptions and colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條魚滑潺潺咁喺水入面游來游去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jyu4 waat6 caan4 caan4 gam2 hai2 seoi2 jap6 min6 jau4 loi4 jau4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條魚在水裡滑潺潺地游來游去。
examples.english_sentence: The fish glided smoothly, swimming back and forth in the water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條小溪啲水滑潺潺咁流過山谷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 siu2 kai1 di1 seoi2 waat6 caan4 caan4 gam2 lau4 gwo3 saan1 guk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小溪的水滑潺潺地流過山谷。
examples.english_sentence: The creek's water flowed smoothly and murmuring through the valley.

mandarin_meaning: 油腔滑舌/諂媚（口語俚語）
english_meaning: glib; slick-talking; flattering (insincere)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，用來形容一個人說話很油滑、會奉承或用甜言蜜語討好別人，帶有不太誠懇或狡猾的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang adjective describing someone who talks in a slick, flattering, or insincere way—glib or smooth-talking, often to gain advantage or favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對老闆滑牙，想攞升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 lou5 baan2 waat6 ngaa4, soeng2 lo2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是對老闆油嘴滑舌，想獲得升職。
examples.english_sentence: He is always flattering the boss, trying to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心佢，佢好滑牙，唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 waat6 ngaa4, m4 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心他，他很油腔滑調，不值得信任。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful with him; he's very glib and not trustworthy.

mandarin_meaning: 偷懶、逃避工作或責任（粵語口語）
english_meaning: to slack off; to shirk responsibilities; to loaf on the job (Cantonese colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「滑牛」是粵語口語，常用來形容在工作或學習上偷懶、敷衍、逃避做事或推卸責任。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to describe slacking off, shirking duties, loafing at work or avoiding responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司滑牛，淨係玩手機唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 waat6 ngau4, zing6 hai6 waan2 sau2 gei1 m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在公司偷懶，只玩手機不工作。
examples.english_sentence: He often slacks off at the company, only plays with his phone and doesn't work.

mandarin_meaning: 滑石（huáshí）——一種軟質礦物，主要成分為含水鎂矽酸鹽，常用於製作滑石粉、化妝品及工業填料。
english_meaning: talc — a soft mineral (hydrated magnesium silicate) commonly used to make talcum powder, in cosmetics, and as an industrial filler.
explanation_mandarin: 滑石是一種矽酸鹽類的軟礦物，手感光滑，常被研磨成滑石粉用於嬰兒爽身粉、化妝品以及工業用途，但部分產品可能受石棉污染需注意檢測。
explanation_english: Talc is a soft silicate mineral with a smooth feel. It is often ground into talcum powder for baby and cosmetic uses and used as an industrial filler. Some products may be contaminated with asbestos, so testing and certification are important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊石頭係滑石，摸落去好滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 sek6 tau4 hai6 waat6 sek6, mo2 lok6 heoi3 hou2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块石头是滑石，摸起来很光滑。
examples.english_sentence: This rock is talc; it feels very smooth to the touch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 化妝品成份表寫有滑石，我唔知會唔會對皮膚敏感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fa3 zong1 ban2 sing4 bun2 biu2 se2 jau5 waat6 sek6, ngo5 m4 zi1 wui5 m4 wui5 deoi3 pei4 fu1 man5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 化妆品成分表写有滑石，我不知道会不会对皮肤过敏。
examples.english_sentence: The ingredient list of the cosmetic includes talc; I'm not sure if it will cause skin allergies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有報導指出部分滑石粉可能含石棉，選購時要揀有第三方檢測證明嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 bou3 dou6 zi2 syut3 bou6 fan6 waat6 sek6 fan2 ho2 nang4 ham4 sek6 min4, syun2 gau3 si4 jiu3 gaan2 jau5 dai6 saam1 fong1 gim2 cak1 zing3 ming4 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有报道指出部分滑石粉可能含有石棉，选购时要选择有第三方检测证明的产品。
examples.english_sentence: Reports indicate some talcum powders may contain asbestos; choose products with third‑party testing certification.

mandarin_meaning: 滑石粉（由滑石磨成的細粉，常用作爽身粉或吸濕劑）
english_meaning: talcum powder (talc) — a fine powder made from the mineral talc, used as baby/talcum powder or moisture absorber
explanation_mandarin: 由礦物滑石研磨而成的細粉，質地細滑，常用作爽身粉、嬰兒粉或吸濕劑，但有關長期吸入或某些用途的安全性曾有爭議。
explanation_english: A fine, smooth powder made from the mineral talc. Commonly used as talcum/baby powder or a moisture absorber. There have been safety concerns about prolonged inhalation or certain uses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天出汗，我會喺腋下搽滑石粉，覺得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ceot1 hon4, ngo5 wui5 hai2 jik6 haa6 caat3 waat6 sek6 fan2, gok3 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天出汗时，我会在腋下擦滑石粉，觉得比较舒服。
examples.english_sentence: In summer when I sweat, I apply talcum powder under my arms; it feels more comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 滑稽（有趣、可笑、荒诞）
english_meaning: comical; funny; amusing; absurd
explanation_mandarin: 指令人发笑或显得荒诞、可笑，常用來形容言行或表演誇張、滑稽可笑，有時也帶有嘲諷意味。
explanation_english: Describes something amusing, comical, or absurd. Often used for exaggerated behavior, speech, or performances that provoke laughter; can sometimes carry a tone of ridicule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲表演好滑稽，成場觀眾笑到唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 biu2 jin2 hou2 waat6 gai1, seng4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演很滑稽，全场观众笑个不停。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was very funny; the whole audience couldn't stop laughing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁滑稽，大家都唔知係唔係認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 waat6 gai1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 hai6 m4 hai6 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话这么滑稽，大家都不知道是不是认真的。
examples.english_sentence: You're speaking so comically that no one knows whether you're being serious.

mandarin_meaning: 滑翔（在空中無動力或少量動力地滑行、飛行）
english_meaning: glide; to glide through the air (flight without or with minimal propulsion)
explanation_mandarin: 指在空中以滑行方式飛行，通常不依靠引擎推力，或只靠很少的動力或空氣動力維持高度與方向（如滑翔傘、滑翔翼等）。
explanation_english: To move smoothly through the air without engine power or with minimal propulsion; used for activities like gliding, paragliding, or hang-gliding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我上個暑假試過玩滑翔傘，喺空中滑翔嘅感覺好自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng6 go3 syu3 gaa3 si3 gwo3 waan2 waat6-coeng4-saan3, hai2 hung1 zung1 waat6-coeng4 ge3 gam2 gok3 hou2 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上个暑假试过玩滑翔伞，在空中滑翔的感觉很自由。
examples.english_sentence: Last summer I tried paragliding; the feeling of gliding through the air was very freeing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滑翔翼需要良好嘅風向先可以安全飛行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waat6-coeng4-jik6 seoi1 jiu3 loeng4 hou2 ge3 fung1 hoeng3 sin1 ho2 ji5 on1 cyun4 fei1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 滑翔翼需要良好的风向才能安全飞行。
examples.english_sentence: A hang-glider needs good wind conditions to glide safely.

mandarin_meaning: 滑溜溜；狡猾、圓滑或難以捉摸
english_meaning: slick; slippery; sly; evasive — hard to pin down or untrustworthy
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人處事圓滑、狡猾或者行為難以捉摸，可能推卸責任或不可靠。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slick, evasive, or sly — behaviour that is hard to pin down and may avoid responsibility; implies untrustworthiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢滑脫脫，成日唔肯負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 waat6 tyut3 tyut3, sing4 jat6 m4 hang2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事滑溜溜，經常不肯負責。
examples.english_sentence: He is slippery in how he does things and often refuses to take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 狡猾、滑溜（說話/行事圓滑、愛迴避）
english_meaning: slick/sly; slippery; evasive (talking or acting in a smooth, evasive way)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容人說話或做事很圓滑、機靈或有點狡猾，常用來表示迴避或不直接回答問題。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adjective describing someone who is smooth, slick, or sly in speech or behavior—often evasive or dodging direct answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好滑脱脱，成日拐彎抹角，答唔到直接問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 waat6 tyut3 tyut3, sing4 jat6 gwaai2 waan1 mut6 gok3, daap3 m4 dou2 zik6 zip3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很滑溜，常常拐彎抹角，回答不了直接的問題。
examples.english_sentence: He talks very slickly, always beating around the bush and unable to answer direct questions.

mandarin_meaning: 滑落；下滑、掉落（huálù/xiàhuá）
english_meaning: to slip/slide down; to fall; to decline
explanation_mandarin: 表示從高處或表面上滑下、掉落，亦可比喻情況或數值的下跌或下降。
explanation_english: Indicates sliding down from a higher place or surface, falling, or metaphorically a decrease/decline in condition or numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個杯喺桌邊度唔穩，滑落地下碎咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bui1 hai2 zoek3 bin1 dou6 m4 wan2, waat6 lok6 dei6 haa6 seoi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 杯子放在桌边不稳，滑落到地上碎了。
examples.english_sentence: The cup at the edge of the table was unstable, slipped to the floor and broke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅業績因市場波動，滑落咗好幾個百分點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 zik1 jan1 si5 coeng4 bo1 dung6, waat6 lok6 zo2 hou2 gei2 go3 baak3 fan6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的业绩因市场波动，下降了好几个百分点。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance fell by several percentage points due to market fluctuations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山邊啲泥石鬆，落咗雨之後好容易滑落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 bin1 di1 nai4 sek6 sung1, lok6 zo2 jyu5 zi1 hau6 hou2 jung6 ji6 waat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山边的泥石松动，雨后很容易滑落。
examples.english_sentence: The soil and rocks on the hillside are loose and can easily slide down after rain.

mandarin_meaning: 滑蕨 (huá jué) — 一種蕨類植物，通常指葉面較光滑的蕨類
english_meaning: A type of fern (literally "slippery fern"); refers to ferns with relatively smooth leaves
explanation_mandarin: 用來指稱一類蕨類植物，常見於潮濕或陰涼的環境，葉面較光滑或呈特定形態，屬植物學或自然環境詞彙。
explanation_english: Refers to a category of fern plants, often found in moist or shaded environments; characterized by relatively smooth leaves or particular leaf shapes. A botanical / nature term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山邊成片都有滑蕨，行路要小心唔好踩爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 bin1 sing4 pin3 dou1 jau5 waat6 kyut3, haang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 caai2 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山坡上到處都有滑蕨，走路要小心不要踩壞它們。
examples.english_sentence: The hillside is covered with ferns; be careful not to step on them.

mandarin_meaning: 滑行（huáxíng）：在表面上平滑地滑動或滑翔；也指飛機在跑道上的地面滑行（taxi）。
english_meaning: to glide; to slide; (of an aircraft) to taxi on the runway.
explanation_mandarin: 指物體在較光滑的表面上以摩擦較小的方式移動（滑動、滑翔）；在航空術語中可指飛機在地面沿跑道移動（滑行/taxi）。
explanation_english: To move smoothly over a surface with little friction (to slide or glide). In aviation, it also refers to an aircraft moving along the runway on the ground (taxiing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飛機喺跑道上滑行準備起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fei1 gei1 hai2 paau2 dou6 soeng6 waat6 haang4 zeon2 bei6 hei2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机在跑道上滑行准备起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane is taxiing on the runway preparing for takeoff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喺雪地上滑行，好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 syut3 dei6 soeng6 waat6 haang4, hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在雪地上滑行，很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The children are sliding on the snow and having a great time.

mandarin_meaning: 滑轮 (huálún) — 指能滑动或转动的轮子，常用于滑轮装置或旱冰/滑轮鞋等
english_meaning: roller; pulley — a wheel that rolls or is used in pulley systems (e.g., a pulley wheel or a roller skate wheel)
explanation_mandarin: 「滑輪」指可以滑動或轉動的輪子。既可指機械上用來改變方向或傳遞力的滑輪（pulley），也可指如滑輪鞋上用的輪子（roller）。
explanation_english: “滑輪” denotes a wheel that rolls or rotates. It can refer to a pulley used in machinery to change direction or transmit force, or to the wheels on roller skates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個滑輪係用嚟改變繩嘅方向。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 waat6 leon4 hai6 jung6 lai4 goi2 bin3 sing4 ge3 fong1 hoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个滑轮是用来改变绳子的方向。
examples.english_sentence: That pulley is used to change the direction of the rope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅滑輪鞋其中一個輪壞咗，要換新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 waat6 leon4 haai4 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 leon4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的滑轮鞋其中一个轮坏了，要换新的。
examples.english_sentence: One of the wheels on my roller skates is broken and needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 滑铁卢（指滑鐵盧戰役；比喻遭受決定性慘敗或致命挫折）
english_meaning: Waterloo (the Battle of Waterloo); used figuratively for a decisive crushing defeat or one's undoing
explanation_mandarin: 原指1815年滑鐵盧戰役（拿破崙的決定性失敗）；在粵語中常用作比喻，指某人或某事遭遇重大且致命的失敗或挫敗，成為敗亡或事業終結的關鍵一役。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the 1815 Battle of Waterloo (Napoleon's decisive defeat). In Cantonese it is commonly used figuratively to mean a decisive, crushing defeat or an event that becomes someone's downfall or undoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉真係成為咗佢嘅滑鐵廬，從此再冇返上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 zan1 hai6 sing4 wai4 zo2 keoi5 ge3 waat6 tit3 lou4, cung4 ci2 zoi3 mou5 faan1 soeng5 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次选举真成了他的滑铁卢，从此再也没能重返权力中心。
examples.english_sentence: This election really became his Waterloo; he never returned to power afterward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰場比賽對佢嚟講係個滑鐵廬，從此佢再唔敢參加國際賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 coeng4 bei2 coi3 deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2 hai6 go3 waat6 tit3 lou4, cung4 ci2 keoi5 zoi3 m4 gam2 caam1 gaa1 gwok3 zai3 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那场比赛对他来说就是滑铁卢，从此他再也不敢参加国际赛。
examples.english_sentence: That match was his Waterloo; after that he no longer dared to compete in international tournaments.

mandarin_meaning: 滑铁卢（指決定性的慘敗或終結性的失敗）
english_meaning: Waterloo — a decisive or crushing defeat; a person's ultimate downfall
explanation_mandarin: 原指比利時地名滑鐵盧，拿破崙在此戰敗。現多用作比喻遭遇決定性、慘重的失敗或終極挫敗。
explanation_english: Originally the Belgian battlefield where Napoleon was defeated; now used figuratively to refer to a decisive, crushing defeat or someone's downfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢考得好差，真係遇到滑鐵盧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 haau2 dak1 hou2 caa1, zan1 hai6 jyu6 dou3 waat6 tit3 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試他考得很差，真是遇到滑鐵盧。
examples.english_sentence: He did very poorly on this exam — he really met his Waterloo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 該公司新產品上市後失敗，成為管理層的滑鐵盧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: goi1 gung1 si1 san1 caan2 ban2 soeng5 si5 hau6 sat1 baai6, sing4 wai4 gun2 lei5 cang4 dik1 waat6 tit3 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 該公司新產品上市後失敗，成為管理層的滑鐵盧。
examples.english_sentence: The company's new product flopped after launch and became management's Waterloo.

mandarin_meaning: 滑雪 (huáxuě)
english_meaning: ski; skiing
explanation_mandarin: 指在雪地上以滑雪板或其他裝備移動的一種冬季運動或娛樂活動。
explanation_english: Refers to the winter sport or recreational activity of moving over snow using skis or other skiing equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年冬天我想去滑雪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 dung1 tin1 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 waat6 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年冬天我想去滑雪。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go skiing this winter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次去滑雪就跌親，幸好冇大礙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 waat6 syut3 zau6 dit3 can1, hang6 hou2 mou5 daai6 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次去滑雪就摔倒了，幸好沒有大礙。
examples.english_sentence: He fell the first time he went skiing, but luckily wasn't seriously hurt.

mandarin_meaning: 滑雪用的板子（可指單板或雙板）
english_meaning: a board used for skiing/snowboarding (can refer to a snowboard or a pair of skis depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 指在雪地上滑行時使用的板子，根據語境可指單板（snowboard）或雙板（skis）。
explanation_english: A board used to glide on snow; depending on context it may mean a snowboard (single board) or skis (pair of boards).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一塊滑雪板，準備下個月去滑雪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 faai3 waat6 syut3 baan2, zeon2 bei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 waat6 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一块滑雪板，准备下个月去滑雪。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a snowboard/skis and I'm preparing to go skiing next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雪場有單板同雙板租借，你要揀邊種？
examples.jyutping_sentence: syut3 coeng4 jau5 daan1 baan2 tung4 soeng1 baan2 zou1 zoek3, nei5 jiu3 gaan2 bin1 zung2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雪场有单板和双板租借，你要选哪一种？
examples.english_sentence: The resort rents snowboards and skis — which one do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌咗，滑雪板斷咗一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 zo2, waat6 syut3 baan2 dyun6 zo2 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔了，滑雪板断了一边。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and one side of his ski/snowboard broke.

mandarin_meaning: 滑音（可指音樂上的滑音、連音或語音學上的滑音/半元音）
english_meaning: Slide/portamento in music; glide or semivowel in phonetics
explanation_mandarin: 在音樂裡指從一個音平滑地滑到另一個音（portamento 或 slide）；在語音學裡可指半元音或發音上的滑動過程（如 /j/, /w/ 類似的滑音）。
explanation_english: In music, a smooth slide (portamento) from one pitch to another. In phonetics, a glide or semivowel — a transitional sound like /j/ or /w/.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌用咗好多滑音，聽落好有感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 waat6 jam1, teng1 lok6 hou2 jau5 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌用了很多滑音，聽起來很有感情。
examples.english_sentence: He used a lot of slides in his singing; it sounded very emotional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語音分析入面，/w/ 同 /j/ 類似滑音，係元音同輔音之間的過渡音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jam1 fan1 sik1 jap6 min6, /w/ tung4 /j/ noi6 ci5 waat6 jam1, hai6 jyun4 jam1 tung4 fu6 jam1 zi1 gaan1 dik1 gwo3 dou6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在語音分析中，/w/ 和 /j/ 類似滑音，是元音與輔音之間的過渡音。
examples.english_sentence: In phonetic analysis, /w/ and /j/ act like glides — transitional sounds between vowels and consonants.

mandarin_meaning: 滑頭（滑头）
english_meaning: sly; slippery; crafty person
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人圓滑、狡猾，善於鑽營或迴避責任，常帶負面含義。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is slick or sly—good at maneuvering, dodging responsibility, or manipulating situations; often a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，佢好滑頭，唔好咁容易信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, keoi5 hou2 waat6 tau4, m4 hou2 gam2 jung4 ji6 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心點，他很滑頭，不要那麼容易相信他。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, he's very sly—don't trust him so easily.

mandarin_meaning: 狡猾、圓滑、愛耍手段的人（俚語，帶貶義）
english_meaning: a sly, slippery person; someone crafty or evasive (slang, pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容一個人狡猾、圓滑、愛耍手段或推卸責任，通常帶有貶義，用於批評或警惕別人不要被對方騙過。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who is sly, crafty, or slippery — a person who dodges responsibility, deceives others, or uses cunning tactics. Usually used pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次出事都推晒俾人，真係個滑頭蛇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 ceot1 si6 dou1 teoi1 saai3 bei2 jan4, zan1 hai6 go3 waat6 tau4 se4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次出事都把責任推給別人，真是個滑頭蛇。
examples.english_sentence: Every time something goes wrong he shifts the blame onto others — he's such a slippery/conniving person.

mandarin_meaning: 滑鼠（huáshǔ）／鼠标（shǔbiāo），主要指電腦的輸入裝置；亦可指鼠類（較少用）
english_meaning: computer mouse (input device); (less commonly) a mouse (rodent)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港和台灣習慣上，『滑鼠』常用來指電腦的鼠標（用於控制游標的輸入設備）。在一般語境下也可指動物「老鼠」，但這種用法較少見。
explanation_english: Commonly used in Cantonese to mean a computer mouse (the input device used to control the cursor). It can also refer to the animal mouse, though that sense is less common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦嘅滑鼠壞咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 waat6 syu2 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的電腦的滑鼠壞了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: My computer mouse is broken; I need to replace it.

mandarin_meaning: 渣滓、沉渣、糟粕（废弃的残渣或污物）
english_meaning: dregs; sediment; residue; waste; scum
explanation_mandarin: 指液体或固体中留下的残渣或杂质（如酒渣、泥沙等），也可比喻为糟粕或无用、低劣的东西。
explanation_english: Refers to residue or sediment left in liquids or solids (e.g., lees in wine, silt), and can be used metaphorically for worthless or inferior material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢罐酒有滓，唔好飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gun3 zau2 jau5 zai2, m4 hou2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这罐酒有沉渣，别喝。
examples.english_sentence: This jar of wine has sediment; don't drink it.

mandarin_meaning: （指水勢）汹涌、泛濫；比喻說話連綿不絕或程度極大。常見於「滔滔不絕」「滔天」等詞語。
english_meaning: Surging, overflowing (of water); a torrent. Figuratively: unceasing flow (of speech) or extreme/huge extent (as in 'tremendous').
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞／動詞（多用作合成詞的詞根）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / verb (bound morpheme used in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示水勢浩大或奔涌，也可比喻說話連綿不絕或事情程度極大。多出現在合成詞或成語中，如「滔滔不絕」「滔天」。
explanation_english: Denotes a powerful surging or overflowing flow (usually of water); figuratively used for continuous speech or an extreme degree. Commonly appears in compounds and idioms like '滔滔不绝' and '滔天'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢滔滔不絕，根本停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 tou4 tou4 bat1 zyut6, gan1 bun2 ting4 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他講話滔滔不絕，根本停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks incessantly; he can't stop talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係滔天大罪，無得寬恕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 tou4 tin1 daai6 zeoi6, mou5 dak1 fun1 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事是滔天大罪，無法寬恕。
examples.english_sentence: This is a heinous罪 of tremendous scale; it cannot be forgiven.

mandarin_meaning: 滔天大罪（指極其嚴重、無法饒恕的罪行）
english_meaning: An extremely serious or heinous crime; an unforgivable offense.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容極其嚴重、惡劣且難以寬恕的罪行或過錯，常帶有強烈的譴責意味。
explanation_english: An idiomatic expression used to describe an extremely grave, evil, and unforgivable crime or wrongdoing; often used with strong condemnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗滔天大罪，冇得赦免。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 tou4 tin1 daai6 zeoi6, mou5 dak1 se3 min5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯下了滔天大罪，沒有赦免的可能。
examples.english_sentence: He has committed an atrocious crime and cannot be pardoned.

mandarin_meaning: 滔滔不绝 (tāotāo bù jué) — 形容说话连续不断、滔滔不止
english_meaning: talking incessantly; speaking at great length without stopping
explanation_mandarin: 形容說話連續不斷，如水勢奔流般滔滔不止。常用來形容某人談話很多、不中斷。
explanation_english: Describes speaking continuously and incessantly, like a rushing stream. Often used to say someone talks at great length without pausing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺晚飯嘅時候滔滔不絕噉講佢啲旅行經歷，大家都聽得入神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 maan5faan6 ge3 si4hau6 tou4 tou4 bat1 zyut6 gam2 gong2 keoi5 di1 leoi5hang4 ging1lik6, daai6gaa1 dou1 teng1 dak1 jap6 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在吃晚飯的時候滔滔不絕地講述他的旅行經歷，大家都聽得入神。
examples.english_sentence: He talked about his travel experiences incessantly during dinner; everyone listened intently.

mandarin_meaning: 滕（姓氏）；古代諸侯國名；用於地名或文學典故（如滕王閣）
english_meaning: Teng (a Chinese surname); the ancient State of Teng; appears in place names and literary references (e.g. Tengwang Pavilion)
explanation_mandarin: 滕通常作為姓氏使用，也可指古代的滕國或與該姓相關的地名與典故。在粵語語境中，這個字主要見於人名或地名，不常單獨作為一般動詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: The character 滕 is primarily used as a surname and can refer to the ancient State of Teng or related place names and literary allusions. In Cantonese it is mainly encountered in personal or place names rather than as a common lexical word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺姓滕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3je4 sing3 tang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷姓滕。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather's surname is Teng.

mandarin_meaning: 小河口、溪口或港灣（小水道）
english_meaning: inlet; creek; small estuary; water channel
explanation_mandarin: 「滘」多指小的河口、溪口或水道，常見於地名或舊時對小港灣、小水道的稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to a small water channel, estuary, creek, or inlet. Often found in place names or used historically to denote a minor harbour or watercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條滘好淺，唔好落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaau3 hou2 cin2, m4 hou2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條滘很淺，別下去。
examples.english_sentence: This inlet is shallow — don't go in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滘口附近有個小村落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 hau2 fu6 gan6 jau5 go3 siu2 cyun1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 滘口附近有個小村落。
examples.english_sentence: There is a small village near the estuary.

mandarin_meaning: 汇 (huì)：聚集、汇兑、汇款；常用于“汇率”“汇款”“汇集”等词
english_meaning: to gather; to remit/transfer money; exchange (as in exchange rate)
explanation_mandarin: “滙”是“匯”的異體字，香港書寫與某些專有名詞中常見（如滙豐）。意思包括聚集、匯款或貨幣匯兌等。
explanation_english: “滙” is a variant form of the character 匯 (huì). In Cantonese/Hong Kong usage it appears in book names and bank names and means to gather, to remit money, or to exchange (as in exchange rate).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想由香港滙錢去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jau4 hoeng1 gong2 wui6 cin2 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想從香港匯錢到美國。
examples.english_sentence: I want to remit money from Hong Kong to the United States.

mandarin_meaning: 汇（汇集、汇款、汇率）
english_meaning: to gather; to remit/transfer money; exchange (rate)
explanation_mandarin: 「滙」為「汇」的異體字，常用於表示匯集、匯款或匯率等金融或匯兌相關意思。在香港書寫或名稱中也常見此字變體。
explanation_english: “滙” is a variant form of the character 匯 (huì). It is used to mean to gather, to remit/transfer money, or exchange (as in exchange rate). The variant appears in some Hong Kong usages and names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要去銀行滙款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 wui6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要去银行汇款。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the bank to transfer money tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家滙率跌咗，換錢要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 wui6 leot6 dit3 zo2, wun6 cin2 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在汇率跌了，换钱要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The exchange rate has fallen now; be careful when exchanging money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我滙咗一筆錢返香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 wui6 zo2 jat1 bat1 cin2 faan1 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我汇了一笔钱回香港。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me transfer a sum of money back to Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 匯價 / 匯率
english_meaning: exchange rate (the price of one currency in terms of another)
explanation_mandarin: 指不同貨幣之間兌換的價格或比率，例如港幣對美元的兌換價。通常用於銀行、外匯交易或旅遊換錢時。
explanation_english: Refers to the price or rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another, e.g., the Hong Kong dollar to US dollar rate. Commonly used in banking, forex trading, and when exchanging money for travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家港幣對美元嘅滙價係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gong2 bai6 deoi3 mei5 jyun4 ge3 wui6 gaa3 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在港幣對美元的匯價是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What's the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar to the US dollar right now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出國前最好比較唔同銀行嘅滙價同手續費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gwok3 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 bei2 gaau3 m4 tung4 ngan4 hong4 ge3 wui6 gaa3 tung4 sau2 zuk6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出國前最好比較不同銀行的匯價和手續費。
examples.english_sentence: Before traveling abroad it's best to compare the exchange rates and fees at different banks.

mandarin_meaning: 匯合／會合（聚集、合併、會面）
english_meaning: to converge; to join; to merge; to meet up
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩股或多股事物會聚在一起、合併或相遇，常用於河流匯流或人員、隊伍會合等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates two or more streams/parts coming together, merging, or meeting; commonly used for rivers converging or groups/teams meeting up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩條支流喺河口滙合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 tiu4 zi1 lau4 hai2 ho4 hau2 wui6 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩條支流在河口匯合。
examples.english_sentence: The two tributaries converge at the river mouth.

mandarin_meaning: 匯報／報告
english_meaning: to report; to give a report
explanation_mandarin: 指向上級或在正式場合報告工作、情況或進度，較正式用語。常見於會議或公文中。
explanation_english: To report information, progress, or status to supervisors or in a formal setting; a more formal term often used in meetings or official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以喺會議上滙報一下項目嘅進度？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 wai6 bou3 jat1 haa5 hong6 muk6 ge3 zeon3 dou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以在會議上匯報一下項目的進度？
examples.english_sentence: Can you report the project's progress at the meeting?

mandarin_meaning: 外匯市場／外滙市場
english_meaning: foreign exchange market (forex)
explanation_mandarin: 滙市（即外滙／外匯市場）是進行不同貨幣買賣的市場，決定匯率並影響國際資本流動與進出口收支。
explanation_english: The foreign exchange market where currencies are traded; it determines exchange rates and influences international capital flows and trade balances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滙市今日波動好大，港幣升咗幾個百分點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 si5 gam1 jat6 bo1 dung6 hou2 daai6, gong2 bai6 sing1 zo2 gei2 go3 baak3 fan6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外匯市場今天波動很大，港幣升了幾個百分點。
examples.english_sentence: The forex market was very volatile today; the Hong Kong dollar rose by a few percentage points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滙市對企業出口收入有直接影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 si5 deoi3 kei4 jip6 ceot1 hau2 sau1 jap6 jau5 zik6 zip3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外匯市場對企業出口收入有直接影響。
examples.english_sentence: The foreign exchange market directly affects companies' export revenue.

mandarin_meaning: 匯款 (huìkuǎn)：將款項通過銀行或其他渠道轉給別人／轉帳
english_meaning: remit money; remittance; money transfer
explanation_mandarin: 指通過銀行、電匯或網上渠道把錢轉給別人。可用作動詞（去匯款）或名詞（一次匯款、一筆匯款）。
explanation_english: The act of sending money to someone via bank, telegraphic transfer, or online channels. Can be used as a verb (to remit) or as a noun (a remittance/transfer).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝已經滙款畀你喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 ji5 ging1 wui6 fun2 bei2 nei5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天已經匯款給你了。
examples.english_sentence: I already remitted the money to you this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用網上銀行滙款，幾方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 mong5 soeng6 ngan4 hong4 wui6 fun2, gei2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用網上銀行匯款，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: You can use online banking to transfer money; it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滙款通常要收手續費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 fun2 tung1 soeng4 jiu3 sau2 zuk6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 匯款通常要收手續費。
examples.english_sentence: Remittances usually incur handling fees.

mandarin_meaning: 汇演；演出、表演活动
english_meaning: a performance or show (often a concert, variety show, or joint performance)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個或多個節目組成的表演活動，常用於學校、電視或公開演出場合。
explanation_english: Refers to a performance event composed of one or multiple acts; commonly used for school shows, TV programmes, or public performances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下個禮拜有滙演，你要參加嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 wui6 jin2, nei5 jiu3 caam1 gaa1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校下个礼拜有汇演，你要参加吗？
examples.english_sentence: The school has a show next week — do you want to take part?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台今晚會播出大型滙演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 gam1 maan5 wui5 bo3 ceot1 daai6 jing4 wui6 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视台今晚会播出大型汇演。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station will broadcast a large-scale show tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 匯率 / 两种货币之间的兑换比例
english_meaning: exchange rate (the rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another)
explanation_mandarin: 指兩種貨幣之間交換的比例，表示一單位某種貨幣可以兌換多少另一種貨幣，常用於外匯交易與旅遊換匯。
explanation_english: The rate that indicates how much of one currency can be exchanged for a unit of another currency; used in foreign exchange, banking, and travel money conversions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家美元兌港幣嘅滙率係點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mei5 jyun4 deoi3 gong2 bai6 ge3 wui6 leot6 hai6 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在美元兌換港幣的匯率是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What's the USD to HKD exchange rate right now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換錢之前要問清楚銀行嘅手續費，因為手續費會影響實際滙率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 cin2 zi1 cin4 jiu3 man6 cing1 co2 ngan4 hong4 ge3 sau2 zuk6 fai3, jan1 wai6 sau2 zuk6 fai3 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 sat6 zai3 wui6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 換錢之前要問清楚銀行的手續費，因為手續費會影響實際匯率。
examples.english_sentence: Before exchanging money, ask about the bank's fees, because fees affect the effective exchange rate.

mandarin_meaning: 匯率操縱國（被指透過干預外匯市場操控匯率以獲取貿易或經濟利益的國家）
english_meaning: currency‑manipulating country (a country accused of intervening in foreign exchange markets to manipulate its exchange rate for trade or economic advantage)
explanation_mandarin: 指被其他國家或國際機構指控，透過外匯市場干預、資本管制或其他手段使本國貨幣升貶以取得貿易或經濟利益的國家。
explanation_english: Refers to a country accused by others or international bodies of intervening in foreign exchange markets, using capital controls or other means to alter its currency value to gain trade or economic advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國話佢哋係滙率操縱國，可能會對佢哋加徵關稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 waa6 keoi5 dei6 hai6 wui6 leot6 cou1 zung6 gwok3, ho2 nang4 wui5 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zing1 gwaan1 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美國說他們是匯率操縱國，可能會對他們加徵關稅。
examples.english_sentence: The US says they are a currency‑manipulating country and may impose tariffs on them.

mandarin_meaning: 匯票（汇票）
english_meaning: bill of exchange; bank draft; money order
explanation_mandarin: 匯票是一種書面票據和支付工具，通常由出票人指示銀行或承兌人向收款人支付一定金額。可用於匯款、支付貨款，並可背書轉讓或由銀行承兌。
explanation_english: A bill of exchange or bank draft — a written negotiable instrument directing a bank or drawee to pay a specified amount to a payee. Used for remittances or payments, it can be endorsed/ transferred or accepted by a bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我畀咗佢一張滙票，等佢去銀行兌現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 zo2 keoi5 jat1 zoeng1 wui6 piu3, dang2 keoi5 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 deoi3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我给了他一张汇票，让他去银行兑现。
examples.english_sentence: I gave him a bank draft so he can cash it at the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司用滙票付款俾供應商，唔係即時現金支付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jung6 wui6 piu3 fuk6 fun2 bei2 gung1 jing3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司用汇票支付给供应商，不是即时现金支付。
examples.english_sentence: The company paid the supplier with a bill of exchange rather than with immediate cash.

mandarin_meaning: 汇聚
english_meaning: to gather; to converge; to pool (resources/people)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把不同的人、資源或資訊集合到一起，集中處理或利用。
explanation_english: To bring together different people, resources, or information into one place; to converge or pool resources for coordinated use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司希望將資源滙聚，集中力量去開發新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hei1 mong6 zoeng1 zi1 jyun4 wai6 zeoi6, zaap6 zung1 lik6 loeng6 heoi3 hoi1 faat3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司希望将资源汇聚，集中力量去开发新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company hopes to pool resources and concentrate efforts to develop new products.

mandarin_meaning: 匯款；把錢從一個帳戶轉到另一個帳戶或匯往國外
english_meaning: to remit money; to transfer/send money to another account or abroad
explanation_mandarin: 「滙錢」是廣東話常用動詞，指透過銀行、匯款公司、電子支付或網上轉帳，將錢從一個帳戶轉移到另一個帳戶，或匯出到其他地方（例如國外）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '滙錢' is a verb meaning to remit or transfer money via banks, remittance services, or online transfers — sending funds from one account to another or abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要用網上銀行滙錢畀屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 jung6 mong5 seong6 ngan4 hong4 wui6 cin2 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要用網上銀行把錢匯給家人。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to use online banking tonight to transfer money to my family.

mandarin_meaning: 匯集
english_meaning: to gather; to assemble; to collect; to aggregate
explanation_mandarin: 指把來自不同來源的資料、資源或人員集中、收集或集合起來，形成一個整體。
explanation_english: To bring together items, data, resources, or people from different sources into one collection or assembly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個報告滙集咗唔同部門嘅數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou3 gou3 wui6 zaap6 zo2 m4 tung4 bou6 mun4 ge3 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告匯集了不同部門的數據。
examples.english_sentence: This report has gathered data from different departments.

mandarin_meaning: （上海的別稱或簡稱）滬；指上海
english_meaning: Shanghainese name/abbreviation for Shanghai
explanation_mandarin: 「滬」原指長江口附近的一種漁汛或護魚用的柵欄，後來成為上海的古稱和簡稱，用於書面或地名中。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a fishing weir near the Yangtze estuary; later became an ancient name and common abbreviation for the city of Shanghai, used in written contexts and place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去滬出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 wu6 ceot1 caai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去沪出差。
