examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 mou5 fan3 hou2, tau4 nou5 maan5 wu4, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上沒睡好，頭腦很糊塗，做什麼都不行。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't sleep well this morning; my head is all muddled and I can't do anything right.

mandarin_meaning: 肚子裡藏有很多秘密或心事（滿腹心事）
english_meaning: to be full of secrets or private worries; to keep many thoughts to oneself; inwardly preoccupied
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語/俚語，形容一個人心裡藏有許多秘密或心事，不願說出來，表現得沉默或心事重重。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression describing someone who is full of secrets or private worries and keeps them to themselves — appearing quiet or inwardly preoccupied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日好沉默，滿肚密圈，唔知係咪遇到咩煩心事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 hou2 cam4 mak6, mun5 tou5 mat6 hyun1, m4 zi1 hai6 mai6 jyu6 dou3 me1 faan4 sam1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近一直很沉默，滿肚秘密，不知道是不是遇到什麼煩心事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been very quiet lately, full of secrets; I don't know if he's facing some troubles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺度問佢，佢滿肚密圈，佢唔想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 man6 keoi5, keoi5 mun5 tou5 mat6 hyun1, keoi5 m4 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別總是在那裡問他，他滿肚秘密，不想說。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep asking him; he's full of secrets and doesn't want to talk.

mandarin_meaning: 充满（某种情感）
english_meaning: filled with (a strong emotion); brimming with
explanation_mandarin: 表示胸中充滿某種強烈的情感，如熱情、怒火、悲傷等，常用作修飾語與名詞連用（如「滿腔熱情」）。
explanation_english: Indicates being filled with a strong emotion (e.g., enthusiasm, anger, sorrow). Commonly used as a modifier before a noun (e.g., "filled with enthusiasm").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢滿腔熱情投入工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mun5 hong1 jit6 cing4 tau4 jap6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他滿腔熱情地投入工作。
examples.english_sentence: He threw himself into his work with great enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢滿腔怒火，無得抑制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mun5 hong1 nou6 fo2, mou4 dak1 jik1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他滿腔怒火，無法抑制。
examples.english_sentence: He was filled with anger that couldn't be contained.

mandarin_meaning: 满脑子：脑子里全是某个想法或事物，表示被某事物占据注意力或执着（口语）
english_meaning: literally "full head" — someone's mind is full of something; to be preoccupied with or obsessed by something
explanation_mandarin: 表示脑海中充满某种想法、念头或事物，常用于口语，形容某人被某事物占据注意力或执著於某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person's mind is filled with a particular thought, idea, or concern. Commonly used colloquially to describe being preoccupied or fixated on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢滿腦子都係手機遊戲，做唔到正經嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan5 nou5 zi2 dou1 hai6 sau2 gei1 jau4 hei3, zou6 m4 dou3 zing3 ging1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他满脑子都是手机游戏，做不了正经事。
examples.english_sentence: His head is full of mobile games; he can't focus on proper work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日滿腦子諗住報復，對你冇好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 maan5 nou5 zi2 lam2 zyu6 bou3 fuk6, deoi3 nei5 mou5 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是满脑子想着报复，对你没有好处。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep your head filled with thoughts of revenge; it's no good for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家滿腦子諗緊點樣搵錢交租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 maan5 nou5 zi2 lam2 gan2 dim2 joeng6 wan2 cin2 gaau1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在满脑子在想怎样赚钱交房租。
examples.english_sentence: Right now his head is full of thoughts about how to make money to pay the rent.

mandarin_meaning: 滿腹經綸（形容人學識淵博、善於籌劃和治理事務）
english_meaning: Full of knowledge and strategic ability; learned, resourceful, and skilled in planning or administration.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人學問豐富、胸有成策，擅長安排、管理或處理複雜事務。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is well-read and knowledgeable, with the ability to devise plans and manage complex affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢滿腹經綸，絕對有能力處理呢單大案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mun5 fuk1 ging1 leon4, zyut6 deoi3 jau5 nang4 lik6 cyu2 lei5 ni1 daan1 daai6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他滿腹經綸，絕對有能力處理這起重大案件。
examples.english_sentence: He is full of knowledge and strategies; he definitely has the ability to handle this major case.

mandarin_meaning: 满足 (mǎnzú)
english_meaning: to be satisfied; to be content; satisfaction
explanation_mandarin: 表示心裡感到滿意、充足；作動詞時可表示使某人或某事達到滿意的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates a feeling of satisfaction or contentment; as a verb it can mean to satisfy or fulfill someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做完功課，覺得好滿足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3, gok3 dak1 hou2 mun5 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做完功课，觉得很满足。
examples.english_sentence: I feel very satisfied after finishing my homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對而家嘅生活感到十分滿足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ji4 gaa1 ge3 sang1 wut6 gam2 dou3 sap6 fan1 mun5 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對現在的生活感到十分滿足。
examples.english_sentence: He/She feels very content with his/her current life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗屋之後，成日話自己好滿足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 uk1 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 mun5 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了房子之後，常常說自己很滿足。
examples.english_sentence: After he bought the house, he often says he's very satisfied.

mandarin_meaning: 满足感 (对某事或状态感到满足的感觉)
english_meaning: a sense of satisfaction; feeling of contentment
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某件事、需要或期待得到满足后内心产生的满意与充实的感觉。
explanation_english: The feeling of being satisfied or content when needs, desires, or expectations are met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 完成咗個項目之後，我有好大嘅滿足感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan4 sing4 zo2 go3 hong6 muk6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 mun5 zuk1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 完成那个项目之后，我有很大的满足感。
examples.english_sentence: After completing the project, I felt a great sense of satisfaction.

mandarin_meaning: 满载；装满、装载；也可比喻收获丰厚或充满
english_meaning: fully loaded; loaded to capacity; figuratively, returning with abundant gains or being filled with something (e.g., memories, achievements)
explanation_mandarin: 表示装满或装载到最大容量，也常用于比喻，表示收获丰富或充满某种东西（如回忆、成果）。常见搭配有「滿載而歸」。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is loaded to capacity; used literally (e.g., a vehicle full of goods) or figuratively to mean returning with plentiful gains or being filled with something (memories, achievements). Common collocation: '滿載而歸'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架貨車滿載家具，準備開去運送。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fo3 ce1 mun5 zoi3 gaa1 geoi6, zeon2 bei6 hoi1 heoi3 wan6 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货车装满了家具，准备开去运送。
examples.english_sentence: The truck is fully loaded with furniture and is ready to drive off for delivery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次旅行我滿載而歸，帶咗好多回憶同手信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 mun5 zoi3 ji4 gwai1, daai3 zo2 hou2 do1 wui4 jik1 tung4 sau2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次旅行我满载而归，带了很多回忆和手信（纪念品）。
examples.english_sentence: I came back from this trip with plenty of memories and souvenirs.

mandarin_meaning: 满载而归
english_meaning: to return with a full load; to come back with abundant gains or harvest
explanation_mandarin: 指帶著豐富的收穫或成果回來，常用來形容獲益良多或成果豐盛的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to returning with abundant harvest or results; commonly used to describe coming back having gained a lot or achieved plentiful results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次旅行我哋滿載而歸，帶咗好多手信返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ngo5 dei6 mun5 zoi3 ji4 gwai1, daai3 zo2 hou2 do1 sau2 seon3 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次旅行我们满载而归，带了很多礼物回来。
examples.english_sentence: We came back from this trip fully loaded, bringing back lots of souvenirs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 漁民今次出海滿載而歸，捕咗好多魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 man4 gam1 ci3 ceot1 hoi2 mun5 zoi3 ji4 gwai1, bou6 zo2 hou2 do1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 渔民这次出海满载而归，捕了很多鱼。
examples.english_sentence: The fishermen returned from the sea fully loaded, having caught many fish.

mandarin_meaning: 滿門抄斬（指株連全家、滅門或把整個家族處死）
english_meaning: the whole family punished/executed (collective extermination or execution of an entire family)
explanation_mandarin: 原指古代因重大罪行而連累整個家族被處決或滅門，現多用來形容株連九族或全家遭到嚴重懲罰。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the punishment in which an entire family was executed for a grave crime; nowadays used to describe the extermination or severe punishment of a whole family or kin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代如果犯叛國，差唔多會被滿門抄斬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jyu4 gwo2 faan6 bun6 gwok3, caa1 m4 do1 wui5 bei6 mun5 mun4 caau1 zaam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代如果犯叛國，差不多會被滿門抄斬。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, if someone committed treason, the whole family would almost certainly be executed.

mandarin_meaning: 滿臉；臉上充滿（表情、顏色或物質）
english_meaning: face full of; with one's face covered in (an expression, color, or substance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示臉上充滿某種表情、顏色或東西，常見用法如「滿面笑容」「滿面通紅」，可與名詞構成短語。
explanation_english: Indicates that the face is full of something (an expression, color, or substance). Commonly used in phrases like '滿面笑容' (beaming smile) or '滿面通紅' (face flushed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢滿面笑容咁出嚟迎接我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan5 min6 siu3 jung4 gam2 ceot1 lai4 jing4 zip3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他滿臉笑容地出來迎接我。
examples.english_sentence: He came out to greet me with a beaming smile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步佢滿面通紅，好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6 keoi5 maan5 min6 tung1 hung4, hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完步他滿臉通紅，很累。
examples.english_sentence: After running, his face was flushed and he was very tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路食蛋糕食到滿面都係忌廉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou5 sik6 daan6 gou1 sik6 dou3 maan5 min6 dou1 hai6 gei3 lim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩把蛋糕吃得到滿臉都是奶油。
examples.english_sentence: The child ate the cake until his face was covered in cream.

mandarin_meaning: 满面春风（mǎn miàn chūn fēng）：形容脸上满是愉快或得意的神情
english_meaning: to be all smiles; to have a beaming, pleased expression
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人臉上充滿喜悅、得意或滿足的表情，常表示高興或自得。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose face is full of happiness, pride, or satisfaction — literally 'a face full of spring breeze', meaning beaming or all smiles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥考到好成績，阿媽滿面春風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1, aa3 maa1 mun5 min6 ceon1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥考到好成绩，妈妈满面春风。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother got good grades, and Mom was all smiles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職之後成日滿面春風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 zi1 hau6 sing4 jat6 mun5 min6 ceon1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后经常满面春风。
examples.english_sentence: After he was promoted, he was constantly beaming.

mandarin_meaning: 滿頭大汗（滿頭都是汗），形容大量出汗，也可比喻非常緊張或焦慮
english_meaning: covered in sweat; drenched in sweat; sweating profusely (can be literal or figurative for extreme nervousness)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容頭部或全身大量出汗，常用於運動後或因緊張、害怕、辛勞而出汗的情況，也可做比喻用，表示非常緊張或慌亂。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose head (or whole body) is covered in sweat — used literally for heavy sweating (e.g., after exercise) and figuratively for extreme nervousness or anxiety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做完跑步，滿頭大汗，要即刻沖涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 paau2 bou6, maan5 tau4 daai6 hon4, jiu3 zik1 haak1 cung1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跑步後滿頭大汗，得趕快洗個澡。
examples.english_sentence: I was drenched in sweat after running and need to take a shower right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前佢緊張到滿頭大汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 keoi5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 maan5 tau4 daai6 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前他緊張得滿頭大汗。
examples.english_sentence: He was so nervous before the exam that he was sweating profusely.

mandarin_meaning: （名額）已滿；額度已達
english_meaning: full quota; capacity reached (no more spots available)
explanation_mandarin: 表示名額或配額已被佔滿，不能再接受更多報名、預訂或申請。
explanation_english: Indicates that a quota or allotment is full and no further registrations, orders, or applications can be accepted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次優惠限前一百名，已經滿額，唔可以再報名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jau1 wai6 haan6 cin4 jat1 baak3 ming4, ji5 ging1 mun5 ngok6, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 bou3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次優惠限前一百名，已經額滿，不能再報名。
examples.english_sentence: This promotion was limited to the first 100 people and is already full; you can't sign up anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲贈品數量有限，部分型號已經滿額，只剩其他顏色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zang3 ban2 sou3 loeng6 jau5 haan6, bou6 fan6 jing4 hou6 ji5 ging1 mun5 ngok6, zi2 sing4 kei4 taa1 ngaan4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贈品數量有限，部分型號已經滿額，只剩其他顏色。
examples.english_sentence: The free gifts are limited in quantity; some models are already fully subscribed and only other colors remain.

mandarin_meaning: 捕鱼；捕捞鱼类（渔）
english_meaning: to fish; to catch fish; fishing
explanation_mandarin: 表示捕捞水中魚類的動作或與漁業相關的概念，常見於合成詞如「打漁」「漁民」「漁獲」。在書面語或合成詞中使用較多。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of catching fish or concepts related to the fishing industry. Commonly appears in compounds such as '打漁' (to go fishing), '漁民' (fisherfolk), or '漁獲' (catch). More often used in written/formal contexts or within compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日出海打漁，今朝返嚟滿載而歸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 ceot1 hoi2 daa2 jyu4, gam1 ziu1 faan1 lai4 mun5 zoi3 ji4 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們經常出海打魚，今天早上回來滿載而歸。
examples.english_sentence: They often go out to sea to fish; this morning they returned with a full catch.

mandarin_meaning: 渔人（指以捕鱼为职业或活动的人）
english_meaning: fisherman; a person who fishes as an occupation or activity
explanation_mandarin: 指以捕魚為職業或休閒活動的人，常出海或在河、湖、海邊作業。
explanation_english: A person who catches fish as a job or pastime, typically working at sea, or by rivers, lakes, or the shore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位漁人每日都喺海邊撒網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 jyu4 jan4 mui5 jat6 dou1 hai2 hoi2 bin1 saat3 mong5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位渔人每天都在海边撒网。
examples.english_sentence: That fisherman casts his nets on the seaside every day.

mandarin_meaning: 渔人码头（指漁船停靠的碼頭；亦常作為沿海或河畔的觀光、餐飲與休閒區名稱）
english_meaning: Fisherman's wharf / fishing pier (a pier where fishermen dock; also used as a name for waterfront tourist, dining and leisure areas)
explanation_mandarin: 漁人碼頭通常指漁船停靠、卸貨或修理的碼頭；在旅遊或商業語境下，也常作為沿海或河畔餐飲、購物和觀光區的專有名稱（例如某些城市的「漁人碼頭」景點）。
explanation_english: Refers to a pier or wharf where fishing boats dock, unload, or are serviced. In tourism and commercial contexts it is often used as a proper name for waterfront areas featuring dining, shopping and attractions (e.g., a city's 'Fisherman's Wharf').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 週末我哋去漁人碼頭散步，順便食海鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 mut6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jyu4 jan4 maa5 tau4 saan3 bou6, seon6 bin6 sik6 hoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 周末我們去渔人码头散步，顺便吃海鲜。
examples.english_sentence: We went to the Fisherman's Wharf over the weekend to take a walk and eat seafood.

mandarin_meaning: 渔夫 (從事捕魚的人)
english_meaning: fisherman
explanation_mandarin: 指以捕魚為業或經常出海捕魚的人。
explanation_english: A person who fishes for a living or regularly goes out to sea to catch fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位漁夫今日朝早出海，帶返好多魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 jyu4 fu1 gam1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 ceot1 hoi2, daai3 faan1 hou2 do1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位漁夫今天一早出海，帶回了很多魚。
examples.english_sentence: That fisherman went out to sea early this morning and brought back a lot of fish.

mandarin_meaning: 渔夫帽
english_meaning: bucket hat; fisherman's hat
explanation_mandarin: 一種帽子，通常由柔軟的布料或帆布製成，帽沿向下，外形像漁夫常戴的帽子，也稱為桶帽。
explanation_english: A soft hat, typically made of cloth or canvas, with a downward-sloping brim; also called a bucket hat or fisherman's hat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一頂漁夫帽，夏天戴好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 ding2 jyu4 fu1 mou6, haa6 tin1 daai3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一顶渔夫帽，夏天戴着很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bucket hat; it's very comfortable to wear in summer.

mandarin_meaning: 漁夫外套 / 漁夫夾克（防水外套）
english_meaning: fisherman's jacket — a waterproof/windproof jacket or anorak
explanation_mandarin: 粵語詞，原指漁民穿的防水外套，現指有帽或有防風防水功能的短款外套或雨衣，常見於香港日常用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term originally for fishermen's waterproof outerwear; now refers generally to a hooded, waterproof/windproof short jacket or raincoat (anorak) commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨記得著件漁夫褸，夠防水又暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 zoek3 gin6 jyu4 fu1 lau4, gau3 fong4 seoi2 jau6 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨要記得穿漁夫外套，又防水又保暖。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wear a fisherman's jacket when it rains; it's waterproof and keeps you warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件漁夫褸好實用，行山或者出海都適合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 jyu4 fu1 lau4 hou2 sat6 jung6, hang4 saan1 waak6 ze2 ceot1 hoi2 dou1 sik1 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件漁夫外套很實用，爬山或出海都適合。
examples.english_sentence: This fisherman's jacket is very practical — suitable for hiking or going out to sea.

mandarin_meaning: 渔村
english_meaning: fishing village
explanation_mandarin: 以捕魚或海洋資源為主要生計的小村莊，通常位於海岸、河口或島嶼附近，具有當地漁業文化特色。
explanation_english: A small village whose primary livelihood is fishing or other marine resources, typically located on a coast, estuary, or island, often featuring local fishing-related culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋周末去漁村度假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zau1 mut6 heoi3 jyu4 cyun1 dou6 gaa3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们周末去渔村度假。
examples.english_sentence: We went to a fishing village for a weekend holiday.

mandarin_meaning: 渔业（捕捞、养殖和相关加工业）
english_meaning: fisheries; the fishing industry (catching, aquaculture and related processing)
explanation_mandarin: 指以捕魚、養殖魚類及海產品加工為主的行業，包含捕撈、養殖、運輸與銷售等環節。
explanation_english: The industry concerned with catching, farming, and processing fish and other aquatic products, including harvesting, aquaculture, transport and marketing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅漁業近年受到污染同過度捕撈嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jyu4 jip6 gan6 nin4 sau6 dou3 wu1 jim5 tung4 gwo3 dou6 bou6 laau4 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的渔业近年来受到污染和过度捕捞的影响。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's fisheries have been affected in recent years by pollution and overfishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出咗一啲規管措施，鼓勵可持續嘅漁業發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 di1 kwai1 gun2 cou3 sik1, gu2 lai6 ho2 ci4 zuk6 ge3 jyu4 jip6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出了一些规管措施，鼓励可持续的渔业发展。
examples.english_sentence: The government has introduced regulations to encourage sustainable development of the fishing industry.

mandarin_meaning: 渔民
english_meaning: fisherman; fishermen; fishing people
explanation_mandarin: 以捕魚為生的人，通常在海邊或淡水水域從事捕撈作業，包含個體漁夫或以漁業為生的社群。
explanation_english: People who make a living by fishing; those who work catching fish in the sea or freshwater, including individual fishermen and fishing communities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 漁民喺海邊工作好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 man4 hai2 hoi2 bin1 gung1 zok3 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 渔民在海边工作很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Fishermen working by the sea have a very hard life.

mandarin_meaning: 渔港
english_meaning: fishing port; fishery harbour
explanation_mandarin: 指供漁船停泊、裝卸漁貨及相關作業的港口或碼頭，通常附近有捕魚、加工和買賣海產的設施。
explanation_english: A harbour or port where fishing boats berth, unload their catch, and carry out related activities; often includes facilities for fishing, processing, and selling seafood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去嗰個漁港食海鮮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 go2 go3 jyu4 gong2 sik6 hoi2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去那个渔港吃海鲜吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to that fishing port to eat seafood tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 渔火（海上或湖面上漁船為捕魚點亮的燈火）
english_meaning: fishing lights; the lights of fishing boats seen on the water
explanation_mandarin: 指漁船在夜間為了誘捕或作業而點亮的燈火，也常用作比喻，描寫夜色中閃爍的光點或喚起思鄉、孤寂等意象。
explanation_english: Refers to lights lit on fishing boats at night for fishing or work; often used metaphorically to describe twinkling lights at night or to evoke feelings of nostalgia or solitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚海面上閃爍嘅漁火好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hoi2 min6 soeng6 sim2 coek3 ge3 jyu4 fo2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜晚海面上閃爍的漁火很美。
examples.english_sentence: The fishing lights twinkling on the sea at night are beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 漁獲（指漁民捕撈到的魚、貝類等海產或捕撈量）
english_meaning: catch (fish); the fish and other marine products caught, or the amount of such catch
explanation_mandarin: 指漁民出海或捕撈時所獲得的魚、貝類等海產，或泛指捕撈的數量。
explanation_english: Refers to the fish and other marine products obtained by fishing, or generally the quantity caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝出海，漁獲好豐富，捕咗好多魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ceot1 hoi2, jyu4 wok6 hou2 fung1 fu3, bou6 zo2 hou2 do1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天出海，漁獲很豐富，捕了很多魚。
examples.english_sentence: We went out to sea this morning; the catch was abundant — we caught a lot of fish.

mandarin_meaning: 渔产；渔业产品；海产品
english_meaning: fishery products; marine/fish products
explanation_mandarin: 指由海洋、河川或其他水域所提供的魚、貝、蝦等水產資源或其加工產品，常用於漁業、食品和貿易領域。
explanation_english: Refers to products obtained from fishing or aquaculture—such as fish, shellfish, shrimp, and other marine or freshwater products—used in fisheries, food, and trade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅漁產有魚、蝦同貝類。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jyu4 caan2 jau5 jyu4, haa1 tung4 bui3 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的渔产有鱼、虾和贝类。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's fishery products include fish, shrimp, and shellfish.

mandarin_meaning: 渔获（指捕捞到的鱼类或其他海产）
english_meaning: fish catch; the haul/yield of fish or other seafood from fishing
explanation_mandarin: 指從捕魚或捕撈活動中所得的魚類或其他海產品，亦可指漁獲量或漁獲物。
explanation_english: Refers to fish or other marine products obtained through fishing — the catch or yield (the amount or items caught).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝船返嚟，漁穫好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 syun4 faan1 lai4, jyu4 wok6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上漁船回來，漁獲非常豐富。
examples.english_sentence: The fishing boat came back this morning with a very abundant catch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 港口的漁穫要分送去市集同餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 hau2 dik1 jyu4 wok6 jiu3 fan1 sung3 heoi3 si5 zaap6 tung4 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 港口的漁獲要分送到市場和餐廳。
examples.english_sentence: The port's catch will be distributed to markets and restaurants.

mandarin_meaning: 鱼网装（鱼网衣、网状服装）
english_meaning: fishnet outfit / mesh clothing (e.g., fishnet top, stockings)
explanation_mandarin: 指以网状材料制成的服装，通常呈半透明或透视效果，常用于上衣、连身衣或丝袜等，带有性感或前卫的时尚风格，也可作为层次穿搭的一部分。
explanation_english: Clothing made from mesh or fishnet material, often semi-transparent; used for tops, bodysuits, stockings, etc. It conveys a sexy or edgy fashion look and is also used for layered styling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚著咗件漁網裝去酒吧，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 jyu4 mong5 zong1 heoi3 zau2 baa1, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今晚穿了一件鱼网装去酒吧，很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a fishnet outfit to the bar tonight; it was eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天配漁網裝可以襯到好有型，但唔係所有場合都啱著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 pui3 jyu4 mong5 zong1 ho2 ji5 can3 dou3 hou2 jau5 jing4, daan6 m4 hai6 so2 jau5 hoi6 hap6 dou1 aam1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天搭配鱼网装可以显得很有型，但不是所有场合都适合穿。
examples.english_sentence: Pairing fishnet pieces in summer can look stylish, but they're not appropriate for every occasion.

mandarin_meaning: 趁他人相爭或形勢混亂時從中取利（類似「趁火打劫／漁翁得利」）
english_meaning: To take advantage of others' conflict or disorder to profit; 'to fish in troubled waters.'
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在兩方或多方爭鬥、矛盾或混亂時，第三方乘機從中獲利或佔便宜。
explanation_english: An idiom describing a third party seizing the opportunity to benefit while others are fighting or when there is disorder—similar to 'fish in troubled waters.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩邊為咗利益鬥得好激，最後畀第三者漁翁撒網，賺走最多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 bin1 wai6 zo2 lei6 jik6 dau3 dak1 hou2 gik1, zeoi3 hau6 bei2 dai6 saam1 ze2 jyu4 jung1 saat3 mong5, zaan6 zau2 zeoi3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雙方為了利益爭得很激烈，最後讓第三者趁機漁翁撒網，賺走最多。
examples.english_sentence: The two sides fought fiercely over profits, and in the end a third party took advantage and reaped most of the gains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢場收購戰入面，B公司冇出手就漁翁撒網，攞走原本屬於A公司嘅資產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 coeng4 sau1gou3 zin3 jap6 min6, B gung1si1 mou5 ceot1 sau2 zau6 jyu4 jung1 saat3 mong5, lo2 zau2 jyun4 bun2 suk6 jyu1 A gung1si1 ge3 zi1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在這場收購戰中，B公司不用出手就趁機漁翁撒網，取得了原本屬於A公司的資產。
examples.english_sentence: In this takeover battle, Company B didn't even have to act; it took advantage and captured assets that originally belonged to Company A.

mandarin_meaning: 渔船 (用于捕魚的船隻)
english_meaning: fishing boat; fishing vessel
explanation_mandarin: 指用於捕魚作業的船隻，通常配備漁網、魚艙和相關漁具與設備。
explanation_english: A boat or vessel used for fishing, typically equipped with nets, fish holds, and other fishing gear and equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢艘漁船今日朝早出海，帶返好多魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sou1 jyu4 syun4 gam1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 ceot1 hoi2, daai3 faan1 hou2 do1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這艘漁船今天一早出海，帶回了很多魚。
examples.english_sentence: This fishing boat went out to sea early this morning and brought back a lot of fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風嚟緊，漁民將漁船拖返上岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 lai4 gan2, jyu4 man4 zoeng1 jyu4 syun4 to1 faan1 soeng5 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風要來了，漁民把漁船拖上岸。
examples.english_sentence: A typhoon is coming; the fishermen hauled their fishing boats ashore.

mandarin_meaning: 漂：有“漂浮、漂白、漂亮（用在合成詞）”等含義
english_meaning: 漂: to float; to bleach; (in compounds) pretty/beautiful
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞（在合成詞中）
explanation_mandarin: “漂”可作動詞，表示在水面等處漂浮（常讀作piu1）；也可表示用化學方法使物品變白（漂白，讀作piu3）；在合成詞如“漂亮”中表示美麗（讀作piu3）。
explanation_english: “漂” has several senses: to float (often pronounced piu1), to bleach (漂白, pronounced piu3), and as part of compounds like '漂亮' meaning pretty/beautiful (piu3).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊木頭喺水面上漂住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 muk6 tau4 hai2 seoi2 min6 soeng6 piu1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊木頭在水面上漂著。
examples.english_sentence: The piece of wood is floating on the surface of the water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好漂亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 piu3 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真的很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She is really pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件白衫要漂白先會乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 baak6 saam1 jiu3 piu3 baak6 sin1 wui5 gon1 zeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件白襯衫要漂白才能乾淨。
examples.english_sentence: This white shirt needs to be bleached to get clean.

mandarin_meaning: 漂亮 (piào liang)，美麗、好看
english_meaning: pretty; beautiful; attractive; neat
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外表或事物的美觀、好看，也可表示整潔、乾淨。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as attractive, pretty, or visually pleasing; can also mean neat or well-arranged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日睇落好漂亮呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 tai2 lok6 hou2 piu3 loeng6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天看起來很漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: You look very pretty today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好漂亮，喺邊度買㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 piu3 loeng6, hai2 bin1 dou6 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很漂亮，是在哪裡買的？
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very pretty — where did you buy it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個房間整理得好漂亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 fong4 gaan1 zing2 lei5 dak1 hou2 piu3 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房間整理得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: His room is arranged very nicely.

mandarin_meaning: 把稿件（例如小說、劇本、手稿）投遞或寄給多間出版社或製作單位，即四處投稿、投書
english_meaning: to circulate or send a manuscript/script to multiple publishers or production companies; to shop around a manuscript
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語用法，通常指把自己的稿件、小說、劇本等向多間出版社或製作公司投遞，希望有人接受或出版。帶有四處投遞、將作品“漂”出去的意思，多用於創作人尋求發表或出路的情況。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial term meaning to send or circulate one's manuscript, novel, or script to several publishers or production companies—i.e., to shop the work around in hopes of acceptance. Implies sending the work out broadly to find a taker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱漂咗本稿俾幾間出版社，依家等緊佢哋嘅回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 piu1 zo2 bun2 gou2 bei2 gei2 gaan1 ceot1 baan2 se5, ji1 gaa1 dang2 gan2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛把稿子投給了幾家出版社，現在在等他們的回覆。
examples.english_sentence: I just sent my manuscript to several publishers and am now waiting for their replies.

mandarin_meaning: 漂白与染色（通常指对头发或织物先漂白再染色）
english_meaning: bleaching and dyeing; to bleach and then dye (hair or fabric)
explanation_mandarin: 指对头发、布料等先用漂白剂或其他方法去色，再进行染色的处理方法。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of bleaching and then dyeing — often applied to hair or fabrics to remove color first and then apply a new dye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將頭髮漂染成金色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 tau4faat3 piu3 jim5 sing4 gam1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把头发漂染成金色。
examples.english_sentence: I want to bleach and dye my hair blonde.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊布要先漂染，先至可以染到均勻嘅顏色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 bou3 jiu3 sin1 piu3 jim5, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jim5 dou3 gwan1 wan4 ge3 ngaan4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块布要先漂染，才能染出均匀的颜色。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of fabric needs to be bleached first so it can be dyed evenly.

mandarin_meaning: 漂泊（漂泊、流浪、無固定居所）
english_meaning: to drift about; to live a wandering or itinerant life; to be homeless or unsettled
explanation_mandarin: 表示到處漂泊、沒有固定居所或長期四處流浪，也可引申為生活不穩定、飄零不定。
explanation_english: Refers to drifting or wandering without a fixed home; can also imply an unstable, unsettled life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢漂泊咗好耐，都未搵到穩定嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 piu1 bok3 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 mei6 wan2 dou2 wan2 ding6 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他漂泊了很久，還沒找到穩定的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He has drifted for a long time and still hasn't found stable employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲年輕人漂泊喺外地打工，唔想返鄉下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 piu1 bok3 hai2 ngoi6 dei6 daa2 gung1, m4 soeng2 faan1 hoeng1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年輕人在外地漂泊打工，不想回鄉下。
examples.english_sentence: Young people drift and work away from home and don't want to return to their hometowns.

mandarin_meaning: 漂流 (piāoliú) — 在水上随波漂动；也可比喻漂泊、无定所
english_meaning: to drift; to float (on water); figuratively, to wander or be without a fixed home/direction
explanation_mandarin: 指物體在水面上隨波漂動（如漂流木、漂流瓶），也常用作比喻，表示人或事物沒有固定居所或方向、飄泊不定。
explanation_english: Refers to something floating or being carried by currents on water (e.g., driftwood, message in a bottle). Also used figuratively to describe people or things without a fixed home or direction, i.e., wandering or drifting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個周末去漂流，應該會好刺激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 heoi3 piu3 lau4, jing1 goi1 wui5 hou2 cik1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这个周末去漂流，应该会很刺激。
examples.english_sentence: We're going river rafting this weekend; it should be very exciting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人生漂流咗幾年，依家終於穩定落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 sang1 piu3 lau4 zo2 gei2 nin4, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 wan2 ding6 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生漂流了几年，现在终于稳定下来了。
examples.english_sentence: He drifted through life for several years and has finally settled down now.

mandarin_meaning: 飄浮
english_meaning: to float; to drift; to be buoyant
explanation_mandarin: 表示在水面或空中漂流、不固定地停留或移動，也可引申為狀態不穩定或飄忽不定。
explanation_english: Indicates floating or drifting on water or in the air; not fixed in position. Can also be used metaphorically for an unstable or unsettled state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲枯葉漂浮喺河面上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fu1 jip6 piu1 fau4 hai2 ho4 min6 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些枯叶漂浮在河面上。
examples.english_sentence: The dead leaves are floating on the surface of the river.

mandarin_meaning: 飄渺；渺茫、朦朧
english_meaning: ethereal; vague; indistinct; remote
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物或景象模糊、飄忽、虛幻不真切，常用於描寫氛圍或視覺印象。
explanation_english: Describes something that is vague, ethereal, indistinct, or remote—often used for scenery, atmosphere, or impressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清晨嘅山谷籠罩喺薄霧入面，景致顯得漂渺，好似一幅畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 san4 ge3 saan1 guk1 lung4 ziu6 hai2 bok6 mou6 jap6 min6, ging2 zi3 hin2 dak1 piu1 miu5, hou2 ci5 jat1 fuk1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清晨的山谷籠罩在薄霧中，景致顯得飄渺，像一幅畫。
examples.english_sentence: The valley at dawn was shrouded in a thin mist, and the scenery appeared ethereal, like a painting.

mandarin_meaning: 漂白；（口語/隱喻）洗錢或洗白、粉飾醜聞
english_meaning: to bleach; (slang/metaphorical) to launder money or to whitewash/cover up wrongdoing
explanation_mandarin: 原意是用漂白劑使物品變白；在口語或新聞語境中常引申為洗錢（把非法資金變得表面合法）或粉飾、掩蓋不當行為，使其看似無問題。
explanation_english: Literally 'to bleach' (using bleach to whiten). Colloquially it is used metaphorically to mean laundering money or whitewashing/covering up scandals or wrongdoing to make them appear clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用漂白水將件恤衫漂白咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 piu3 baak6 seoi2 zoeng1 gin6 seot1 saam1 piu3 baak6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用漂白水把T恤漂白了。
examples.english_sentence: I used bleach to whiten the T‑shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司用公關手法想將醜聞漂白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jung6 gung1 gwaan1 sau2 faat3 soeng2 zoeng1 cau2 man4 piu3 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司想用公關手法把醜聞漂白。
examples.english_sentence: The company tried to whitewash the scandal with PR tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被指控用複雜交易去漂白贓款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 zi2 hung3 jung6 fuk1 zaap6 gaau1 jik6 heoi3 piu3 baak6 zong1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被控利用複雜交易來洗錢、漂白贓款。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of using complex transactions to launder the stolen money.

mandarin_meaning: 漂白剂（常指次氯酸钠溶液，用作漂白或消毒）
english_meaning: Bleach (a disinfecting/whitening solution, usually sodium hypochlorite)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於去污、漂白或消毒的化學溶液，日常語境多指含次氯酸鈉的漂白劑。使用時需注意稀釋與安全，避免與其他清潔劑混合產生有毒氣體。
explanation_english: Refers to a chemical solution used for whitening, stain removal, or disinfection; commonly refers to sodium hypochlorite bleach. It must be used with care (dilution and safety) and not mixed with other cleaners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房啲地要用漂白水抹一抹，先乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 di1 dei6 jiu3 jung6 piu1 baak6 seoi2 mut3 jat1 mut3, sin1 gon1 zeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房的地要用漂白水抹一抹，才會乾淨。
examples.english_sentence: Wipe the kitchen floor with bleach so it will be clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將漂白水同其他清潔劑混合，會有危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 piu1 baak6 seoi2 tung4 kei4 taa1 cing1 git3 zai1 wan6 hap6, wui5 jau5 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把漂白水和其他清潔劑混合，會有危險。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mix bleach with other cleaning agents — it's dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 漆（qī）：漆、油漆；給物體表面塗上漆
english_meaning: lacquer; varnish; paint (to coat with lacquer or paint)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來保護或裝飾物件表面的塗料（如油漆）；作動詞時表示在物體表面塗漆或上漆。
explanation_english: Refers to lacquer/varnish or paint used to protect or decorate surfaces; as a verb it means to apply paint or varnish to a surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張枱要漆一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 jiu3 cat1 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子需要漆一次。
examples.english_sentence: This table needs to be painted/varnished once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部舊車嘅漆剝晒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gau6 ce1 ge3 cat1 bok3 saai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那辆旧车的漆都剥落了。
examples.english_sentence: The paint on that old car has all peeled off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係做油漆嘅工人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zou6 jau4 cat1 ge3 gung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是做油漆的工人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a painter/varnisher by trade.

mandarin_meaning: 漆器（塗有漆並經加工製成的器物，如漆木器、漆盤等）
english_meaning: lacquerware (objects coated with lacquer and crafted into household or decorative items)
explanation_mandarin: 用漆塗覆並經過加工製成的器物，常見於傳統工藝品與家居裝飾，具有防潮、防腐與美觀的功能。
explanation_english: Objects coated with lacquer and crafted into functional or decorative pieces; traditional craft items often used for household ware and decoration, offering protection and aesthetic finish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企收藏咗好多古董漆器，啲花紋好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 sau1 cong4 zo2 hou2 do1 gu2 dung2 cat1 hei3, di1 faa1 man4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家裡收藏了很多古董漆器，花紋很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He has collected many antique lacquerware pieces, and the patterns are beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件漆器剝咗漆，要唔要送去修復？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 cat1 hei3 bok3 zo2 cat1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 sung3 heoi3 sau1 fuk6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件漆器的漆剝落了，要不要送去修復？
examples.english_sentence: This lacquerware has flaked; should we send it for restoration?

mandarin_meaning: 油漆（塗在物件表面的漆料）
english_meaning: varnish; oil paint; lacquer (paint applied to surfaces)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來塗在木材、金屬等表面以保護或裝飾的漆料，俗稱油漆或漆面。
explanation_english: Refers to paint or varnish applied to surfaces (wood, metal, etc.) for protection or decoration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張枱面嘅漆油剝咗，要搵人補返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 min6 ge3 cat1 jau4 baau6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 bou2 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張桌面的油漆剝落了，要找人補漆才行。
examples.english_sentence: The tabletop's varnish has peeled off; we need to get someone to revarnish it.

mandarin_meaning: 漆皮；經過漆或光亮塗層處理的皮革（鏡面皮、漆面皮）
english_meaning: patent leather; leather with a glossy lacquered coating
explanation_mandarin: 指經過漆塗或塗膜處理而表面光亮、有反光效果的皮革，常見於漆皮鞋、漆皮包等物品。
explanation_english: Refers to leather that has been lacquered or coated to produce a shiny, reflective surface (patent leather). Commonly used for shoes, bags, and accessories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢新買嗰對漆皮鞋，閃到好顯眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 maai5 go2 deoi3 cat1 pei4 haai4, sim2 dou3 hou2 hin2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他新買的那雙漆皮鞋，非常亮眼。
examples.english_sentence: The patent-leather shoes he just bought are really shiny and eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 漆包线（外面包有绝缘漆的导线，常指漆包铜线／磁线）
english_meaning: enameled (magnet) wire — metal (usually copper) wire coated with insulating enamel/varnish, used for winding coils, motors, transformers
explanation_mandarin: 指外層被漆或絕緣漆包覆的導線（多為銅線），常用於繞製電機、變壓器、電磁線圈等。粵語口語中有時將「漆包線」稱為「漆皮線」。
explanation_english: Refers to wire (typically copper) whose surface is coated with an insulating enamel or varnish. Commonly used as magnet wire for winding motors, transformers, and coils. In colloquial Cantonese it is sometimes used interchangeably with '漆包線'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅話要換呢卷漆皮線先得，部風扇先至可以郁返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 waa6 jiu3 wun6 ni1 gyun2 cat1 pei4 sin3 sin1 dak1, bou6 fung1 sin3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 juk6 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 師傅說要換這捲漆包線才能修好，那台風扇才能轉動。
examples.english_sentence: The technician said we need to replace this reel of enameled wire first; then the fan can start working again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲漆皮線表面有層漆，要先刮走先可以焊接。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cat1 pei4 sin3 biu2 min6 jau5 cang4 cat1, jiu3 sin1 gwaat3 zau2 sin1 ho2 ji5 hon3 zip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些漆包線表面有一層漆，要先刮掉才能焊接。
examples.english_sentence: These enameled wires have a coating of enamel on the surface; you have to scrape it off before you can solder them.

mandarin_meaning: 漆皮鞋（亮面皮鞋，鏡面皮鞋）
english_meaning: patent leather shoes (shiny dress shoes)
explanation_mandarin: 指表面有漆光或亮面處理的皮鞋，通常用作正式或禮服場合的鞋款，表面光亮但較易刮花。
explanation_english: Shoes made of patent (glossy) leather or leather treated to be shiny. Commonly worn as dress/formal shoes; the surface is glossy but can scar or scratch easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對漆皮鞋好鍾意，成日著去出席活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 cat1 pei4 haai4 hou2 zung1 ji3, sing4 jat6 zoek3 heoi3 ceot1 zik1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢漆皮鞋，常常穿去参加活动。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes patent leather shoes and often wears them to events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意著漆皮鞋，因為好易整花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 zoek3 cat1 pei4 haai4, jan1 wai6 hou2 ji6 zing2 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢穿漆皮鞋，因為很容易刮花。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like wearing patent leather shoes because they scratch easily.

mandarin_meaning: 漆黑（非常黑暗）
english_meaning: pitch-black; very dark
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容非常黑暗，像塗上漆一般的黑。常用於描寫夜色或無光的環境。
explanation_english: Describes an extremely dark state, as if coated in lacquer. Commonly used to describe night scenes or places without light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚路上漆黑一片，我差啲撞到隻狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lou6 soeng6 cat1 hak1 jat1 pin3, ngo5 caa1 di1 zong6 dou3 zek3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚路上漆黑一片，我差點撞到一隻狗。
examples.english_sentence: The road was pitch-black tonight; I almost ran into a dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無手電筒，入咗山洞裏面漆黑，咩都睇唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 sau2 din6 tung4, jap6 zo2 saan1 dung6 leoi5 min6 cat1 hak1, me1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沒有手電筒，進到山洞裏面漆黑，什麼都看不到。
examples.english_sentence: Without a flashlight, the inside of the cave was pitch-black and nothing could be seen.

mandarin_meaning: 濾、過濾（把液體中的渣滓去掉）
english_meaning: to strain; to filter (to remove solids or impurities from a liquid)
explanation_mandarin: 指用濾器、紗布、濾網等將液體中的渣滓或浮油過濾、濾除，使液體變清。
explanation_english: To use a sieve, cloth, or filter to remove solids, residue, or floating oil from a liquid so that it becomes clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我將啲湯漉一漉，等啲渣走？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 di1 tong1 luk6 jat1 luk6, dang2 di1 zaa1 zau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以幫我把湯濾一濾，讓渣滓去掉？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me strain the soup to get rid of the residue?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲湯之後要用濾網將浮油漉走，咁啲湯先清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 tong1 zi1 hau6 jiu3 jung6 leoi6 mong5 zoeng1 fau4 jau4 luk6 zau2, gam2 di1 tong1 sin1 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煲湯之後要用濾網把浮油濾走，這樣湯才會清澈。
examples.english_sentence: After making soup you should use a sieve to strain off the floating oil so the soup is clear.

mandarin_meaning: 漏；漏出、漏掉（液體滲出或信息洩露，也可指遺漏、漏看）
english_meaning: to leak, to seep; to omit or miss (something); an information leak
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词（在某些语境中也可作名词）
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: ‘漏’常用來表示液體從容器、管道等處滲出或流出，也可用於信息洩露或指遺漏（沒注意到或忘記做某事）。
explanation_english: ‘漏’ commonly denotes liquid leaking or seeping from containers or pipes; it can also mean information being leaked or something being omitted/missed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廁所個喉漏水，要快啲修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 go3 hau4 lau6 seoi2, jiu3 faai3 di1 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廁所的水管在漏水，要快點修理。
examples.english_sentence: The bathroom pipe is leaking; it needs to be repaired quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我漏咗睇個電郵，所以冇回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lau6 zo2 tai2 go3 din6 jau4, so2 ji5 mou5 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我漏看了那封電子郵件，所以沒有回覆。
examples.english_sentence: I missed that email, so I didn't reply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住唔好走漏風聲，等到驚喜嗰刻先講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 m4 hou2 zau2 lau6 fung1 seng1, dang2 dou3 ging1 hei2 go2 hak1 sin1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記住不要洩露風聲，等到驚喜那一刻再說。
examples.english_sentence: Remember not to let the secret leak; wait until the surprise moment to tell them.

mandarin_meaning: 經血外漏；月經滲出（口語）
english_meaning: menstrual leakage; to have menstrual blood leak through clothing or menstrual products (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 指在月經期間經血滲出內褲或衣物的情況，為廣東話口語用法，常用於女性之間描述經期走樣或護理用品保護不足的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to menstrual blood leaking through underwear or clothing during a period. It is a Cantonese colloquial term commonly used among women to describe when menstrual protection is insufficient or a leak occurs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝做運動嘅時候唔小心漏M，褲底都污糟晒，好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 zou6 wan6 dung6 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 siu2 sam1 lau6 M, fu3 dai2 dou1 wu1 zou1 saai3, hou2 gon1 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天運動時不小心經血外漏，褲子都弄髒了，真尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: This morning while exercising I accidentally had a menstrual leak; my underwear got stained — so embarrassing.

mandarin_meaning: 漏报 (lòubào)：未把應該報告或申報的事項如實告知或記載
english_meaning: to omit to report; to underreport or fail to declare something
explanation_mandarin: 「漏報」指在申報、報告或填表時遺漏、少報或未如實申報應有的資訊，常用於稅務、報表或官方文件的情況。
explanation_english: "漏報" means failing to report or declaring less than the truth in contexts such as taxes, financial statements, or official reports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢漏報咗入息，被稅局罰錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lau6 bou3 zo2 jap6 sik1 , bei6 seoi3 guk6 fat6 cin2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他漏报了收入，被税务局罚款。
examples.english_sentence: He underreported his income and was fined by the tax office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺報表入面漏報咗一筆開支，依家要補回數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hai2 bou3 biu2 jap6 min6 lau6 bou3 zo2 jat1 bat1 hoi1 zi1 , ji4 gaa1 jiu3 bou2 wui4 sou3 geoi3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在报表里面漏报了一笔开支，現在要補回數據。
examples.english_sentence: The company omitted an expense in the financial statement and now has to correct the figures.

mandarin_meaning: 遺漏；漏掉（未包含或忘記）
english_meaning: to omit; to leave out; to miss (something); to forget to include
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示把某樣東西、資訊或項目遺漏了，沒有包含或忘記提及。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to omit or leave something out — to miss or forget to include an item or piece of information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我漏低咗啲資料，等我補番俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 lou6 dai1 zo2 di1 zi1 liu6, dang2 ngo5 bou2 faan1 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我遺漏了一些資料，等我補給你。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I missed some information — let me give it to you.

mandarin_meaning: 说漏嘴/泄露消息
english_meaning: to let slip; to blurt out (accidentally reveal information)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指不小心把秘密或消息說出來，相當於普通話的「說漏嘴」「走漏風聲」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to accidentally reveal a secret or information — equivalent to Mandarin '说漏嘴' or English 'let slip'/'blurt out'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心就漏口講咗我哋嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 zau6 lau6 hau2 gong2 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心就说漏了我们的计划。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally let slip our plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記住唔好漏口，等老闆收到正式通知先講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 zyu6 m4 hou2 lau6 hau2, dang2 lou5 baan2 sau1 dou3 zing3 sik1 tung1 zi1 sin1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记住别说漏嘴，等老板收到正式通知再说。
examples.english_sentence: Remember not to let it slip; wait until the boss gets the official notice before mentioning it.

mandarin_meaning: 泄露风声；说漏嘴
english_meaning: to let slip information; to unintentionally reveal a secret
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指不小心把秘密或消息透露出去，说走漏风声。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning to accidentally reveal information or let a secret slip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你千祈唔好漏口風，呢件事只可以喺我哋之間講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 lau6 hau2 fung1, ni1 gin6 si6 zi2 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你千万不要泄露风声，这件事只能在我们之间说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let anything slip; this matter can only be discussed between us.

mandarin_meaning: 漏单（lòudān）：未把顧客的訂單記錄、傳達或處理，導致該訂單被遺漏。
english_meaning: missed order — failure to record, transmit, or process a customer's order, causing it to be omitted.
explanation_mandarin: 在餐飲、零售或網店等行業中常用，指訂單未被記錄、傳達到廚房/倉庫或未發貨，結果被遺漏。也可指帳單未開或未計算到。
explanation_english: Common in food service, retail, and e-commerce. Refers to an order that wasn't recorded, transmitted to kitchen/warehouse, or processed/shipped and thus was omitted. Can also mean a bill/invoice that was not entered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲廚房職員唔小心漏單，客人等咗成半個鐘都未有食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cyu4 fong4 zik1 jyun4 m4 siu2 sam1 lou6 daan1, haak3 jan4 dang2 zo2 sing4 bun3 go3 zung1 dou1 mei6 jau5 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房的員工不小心漏掉了訂單，客人等了半個小時都還沒吃到東西。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen staff accidentally missed an order; the customer waited half an hour and still hadn't received the food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網店出貨時有兩張單漏咗，要即刻補發俾客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 dim3 ceot1 fo3 si4 jau5 loeng5 zoeng1 daan1 lou6 zo2, jiu3 zik1 hak1 bou2 faat3 bei2 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 網店發貨時有兩張訂單被漏掉了，需要立刻補發給客人。
examples.english_sentence: When shipping from the online shop, two orders were missed and need to be resent to the customers immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 說漏嘴、無意中透露（消息）
english_meaning: to let something slip; to inadvertently reveal information
explanation_mandarin: 「漏埗」為廣東話口語，用來形容無意中說出不該說的事或洩露消息，相當於「說漏嘴／洩漏」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to unintentionally reveal something or let information slip (equivalent to 'let something slip' or 'blurt out').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好漏埗呀，嗰件事仲未同人講過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lau6 bou6 aa3, go2 gin6 si6 zung6 mei6 tung4 jan4 gong2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要說漏嘴，這件事還沒跟別人說過。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let it slip — that hasn't been told to others yet.

mandarin_meaning: 墨水渗漏或印刷时局部缺墨/走墨；也可引申为不小心泄露信息（口语中较少见）
english_meaning: Ink leakage/ink bleed or areas with missing ink in printing; can be used figuratively to mean accidentally revealing information.
explanation_mandarin: 用于描述墨水从笔或印刷设备渗出、印刷品上出现缺墨或走墨的情况；在口语中有时借指不小心把事情或消息透露出去。
explanation_english: Used to describe ink leaking from a pen or printing equipment, or parts of a printed piece that have missing or bleeding ink; sometimes used colloquially to refer to unintentionally revealing information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份宣傳單印得唔好，有啲位漏墨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 syun1 cyun4 daan1 jan3 dak1 m4 hou2, jau5 di1 wai6 lau6 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份宣传单印得不好，有些位置漏墨。
examples.english_sentence: This leaflet was printed poorly; some areas are missing ink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將呢啲嘢漏墨畀人知，等我哋先處理好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 ni1 di1 je5 lau6 mak6 bei2 jan4 zi1, dang2 ngo5 dei6 sin1 cyu2 lei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把这些事泄露给别人，让我们先处理好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leak this to others; let us handle it first.

mandarin_meaning: 漏夜 / 通宵、整夜（副詞）
english_meaning: throughout the night; overnight; all night
explanation_mandarin: 表示在深夜或整晚持續進行某事，常用於「漏夜趕工」、「漏夜值守」等情況，意同「通宵」、「整夜」。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something late into the night or throughout the night (overnight). Commonly used in contexts like working overnight or staying on duty; similar to "through the night" or "overnight."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗緊急項目，大家漏夜加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 gan2 gap1 hong6 muk6, daai6 gaa1 lou6 je6 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司為了緊急項目，大家通宵加班。
examples.english_sentence: Because of an urgent project, the company had everyone working overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護人員漏夜照顧病人，直至情況穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 lou6 je6 ziu3 gu3 beng6 jan4, zik6 zi3 cing4 fong3 wan5 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫護人員通宵照顧病人，直到情況穩定。
examples.english_sentence: Medical staff cared for patients through the night until the situation stabilized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我昨晚漏夜寫報告，今日仲未交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zok3 maan5 lou6 je6 se2 bou3 gou3, gam1 jat6 zung6 mei6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚通宵寫報告，今天還沒交。
examples.english_sentence: I worked through the night writing the report and still haven't submitted it today.

mandarin_meaning: 露底
english_meaning: to be exposed; to let a secret slip; (literally) to leak at the bottom
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指把隱藏的事情、弱點或身分不小心洩露出來；也有字面意思，指容器底部漏水或滲漏。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese meaning 'to have a secret or weakness exposed' or 'to let information slip'. Can also be literal: the bottom of something is leaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一講就漏底，原來佢唔係新手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gong2 zau6 lou6 dai2, jyun4 loi4 keoi5 m4 hai6 san1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一說話就露底，原來他不是新手。
examples.english_sentence: He let his cover slip as soon as he spoke — it turned out he's not a novice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好漏底，呢啲嘢唔好講出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lou6 dai2, ni1 di1 je5 m4 hou2 gong2 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要露底，這些事情不要說出去。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let anything slip; don't talk about this outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個水桶漏底咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 seoi2 tung2 lou6 dai2 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水桶底漏了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: The bucket's bottom is leaking; we need to replace it.

mandarin_meaning: 漏斗 (lòudǒu)，用來將液體或散狀物導入窄口容器的器具；也可比喻為篩選或集中過程
english_meaning: funnel — a tool used to channel liquid or granular materials into a container with a small opening; also used metaphorically for a process that filters or concentrates
explanation_mandarin: 指一種錐形或喇叭形的器具，可把液體或粉狀物從大口導入細口容器；在比喻用法上，常形容把大量輸入逐步篩選或集中至少數輸出。
explanation_english: A cone- or horn-shaped tool used to channel liquids or powders from a wide opening into a narrow one; metaphorically, it describes a process that narrows down or filters many inputs into few outputs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用漏斗倒油入細口樽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 lau6 dau2 dou3 jau4 jap6 sai3 hau2 zeon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用漏斗把油倒入细口瓶。
examples.english_sentence: I used a funnel to pour the oil into a narrow-necked bottle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試流程好似個漏斗，最後得返好少人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 lau4 cing4 hou2 ci5 go3 lau6 dau2, zeoi3 hau6 dak1 faan1 hou2 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试流程像个漏斗，最后只剩下很少的人。
examples.english_sentence: The interview process is like a funnel; only a few people make it to the end.

mandarin_meaning: 漏气：字面意思是漏出空气或气体；引申为洩气、气馁、士气低落等口语用法。
english_meaning: To leak air (literally); figuratively, to be deflated, discouraged, or to lose morale.
explanation_mandarin: 「漏氣」可指物件（例如輪胎、氣球）漏出空氣，也常用作口語，表示人因挫折或打擊而感到洩氣、失去鬥志。
explanation_english: Literally means air or gas escaping (e.g., a tire). Colloquially it describes someone becoming discouraged, deflated, or losing motivation after a setback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個輪胎漏氣喇，我哋要換條新胎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 leon4 toi1 lau6 hei3 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wun6 tiu4 san1 toi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 輪胎漏氣了，我們要換一個新胎。
examples.english_sentence: The tire is leaking air; we need to put on a new tire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽落後兩球之後，隊員都漏氣晒，已經唔再有鬥志。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 lok6 hau6 loeng5 kau4 zi1 hau6, deoi6 jyun4 dou1 lau6 hei3 saai3, ji5 ging1 m4 zoi3 jau5 dau3 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽落後兩球之後，隊員們都洩了氣，已經不再有鬥志。
examples.english_sentence: After falling two goals behind, the players were completely deflated and no longer had the fighting spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆當眾批評佢之後，佢即刻漏氣，唔敢再舉手發言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 dong3 zung3 pai1 ping4 keoi5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zik1 hak1 lau6 hei3, m4 gam2 zoi3 geoi2 sau2 faat3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆當眾批評他之後，他立刻洩氣，不敢再舉手發言。
examples.english_sentence: After being publicly criticized by the boss, he immediately got discouraged and didn't dare raise his hand to speak again.

cantonese: 漏氣橡皮波 - 吹唔脹掹唔長
jyutping: lau6 hei3 zoeng6 pei4 bo1 — ceoi1 m4 zong3 maang1 m4 coeng4
mandarin_meaning: 漏氣的橡皮球——吹不鼓、拉不長；比喻無用、沒出息、無法靠努力改變或改善的東西或人。
english_meaning: A leaking rubber ball — can't be blown up, can't be stretched; metaphor for something or someone useless, unproductive, or incapable of improvement despite effort.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語/俚語（形容詞性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 用「漏氣的橡皮球」作比喻，說明某人或某物無用、沒效果或沒有進步空間，無論怎麼做都改變不了情況，帶有貶義和口語色彩。
explanation_english: Uses the image of a leaking rubber ball to describe a person or thing that is useless, ineffective, or shows no improvement — efforts to fix or improve it are futile. Informal and pejorative slang used in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣教佢都冇用，佢係漏氣橡皮波——吹唔脹掹唔長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gaau3 keoi5 dou1 mou5 jung6, keoi5 hai6 lau6 hei3 zoeng6 pei4 bo1 — ceoi1 m4 zong3 maang1 m4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣教他也沒用，他是個漏氣橡皮球——吹不漲、拉不長。
examples.english_sentence: Teaching him like this is useless; he's a leaking rubber ball — can't be inflated, can't be stretched.

mandarin_meaning: 漏洞（漏洞、缺陷、破绽）
english_meaning: loophole; flaw; gap; security hole
explanation_mandarin: 指系統、制度、計劃或事物中的缺陷或破綻，可能被利用或導致資訊洩露、失誤或問題發生。
explanation_english: Refers to a defect or gap in a system, policy, plan, or object that can be exploited or lead to data leaks, errors, or problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個系統有漏洞，唔快啲整好會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hai6 tung2 jau5 lau6 dung6, m4 faai3 di1 zing2 hou2 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个系统有漏洞，不快点修好会出事。
examples.english_sentence: That system has a loophole; if it's not fixed quickly, something bad will happen.

mandarin_meaning: 漏税 / 逃稅（少報或隱瞞應繳稅款）
english_meaning: tax evasion; underreporting or concealing taxes owed
explanation_mandarin: 指少報、隱瞞或未繳應付的稅款，屬違法行為，通常會被處罰或追繳。
explanation_english: Refers to underreporting, concealing, or failing to pay owed taxes. It's an illegal act and may result in fines, back taxes, or criminal charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府查到間公司漏稅，結果要罰好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 caa4 dou3 gaan1 gung1 si1 lau6 seoi3, git3 gwo2 jiu3 fat6 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府查出那間公司漏稅，結果要罰很多錢。
examples.english_sentence: The government found that the company evaded taxes and ended up having to pay a large fine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲商人會故意少申報收入，等於係漏稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 soeng1 jan4 wui5 gu3 ji3 siu2 san1 bou3 sau1 jap6, dang2 jyu1 hai6 lau6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些商人會故意少申報收入，等於是漏稅。
examples.english_sentence: Some merchants deliberately underreport income, which amounts to tax evasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為少少漏稅唔會被發現，輕則補稅，重則要受刑責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai6 siu2 siu2 lau6 seoi3 m4 wui5 bei6 faat3 jin4, hing1 zak1 bou2 seoi3, zung6 zak1 jiu3 sau6 jing4 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以為一點漏稅不會被發現，輕則補稅，重則要負刑責。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume small tax evasions won't be discovered; lightly you'll just have to pay back taxes, severely you could face criminal charges.

mandarin_meaning: 漏稅 / 逃稅（未如實申報或未繳足稅款）
english_meaning: tax evasion; omission to report or pay due taxes
explanation_mandarin: 指未如實申報收入或故意少報、隱瞞以致未繳足應繳稅款的行為，屬違法行為。
explanation_english: Refers to failing to report income or intentionally underreporting/omitting to pay the required taxes; an illegal act of evading tax obligations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司被揭發有漏稅，罰款好重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 bei6 gik1 faat3 jau5 lau6 seoi3, fat6 fun2 hou2 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司被揭發有漏稅，罰款很重。
examples.english_sentence: That company was exposed for tax evasion and was heavily fined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲自僱人士會隱瞞收入去漏稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 zi6 gu3 jan4 si6 wui5 jan2 maan4 sau1 jap6 heoi3 lau6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些自雇人士會隱瞞收入來漏稅。
examples.english_sentence: Some self-employed people hide income to evade taxes.

mandarin_meaning: 漏税（指未按规定申报或缴纳应缴税款，等同于逃税/少报税款）
english_meaning: Tax evasion / omission to report or pay required taxes
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词（也可作名词，视语境而定）
partOfSpeech_english: Verb (can also be a noun phrase: 'tax evasion')
explanation_mandarin: 指纳税人未按税法规定如实申报或缴纳税款的行为，包括少报、漏报或隐瞒收入等。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of failing to report or pay required taxes, including underreporting, omitting taxable income, or otherwise concealing taxable activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司少報收入，等於漏稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 siu2 bou3 sau1 jap6, dang2 jyu1 lou6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司少报收入，等于漏税。
examples.english_sentence: The company underreported income, which amounts to tax evasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果個人漏稅，稅務署會罰佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 go3 jan4 lou6 seoi3, seoi3 mou6 cyu5 wui5 faat3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果个人漏税，税务署会罚他。
examples.english_sentence: If an individual evades taxes, the tax authority will fine them.

mandarin_meaning: 漏洞；破绽；也可指窗户漏水（字面意思）
english_meaning: a loophole or vulnerability; (literal) a leaking window
explanation_mandarin: 「漏窗」可用作比喻，指事務或系統中的漏洞、破綻或疏漏，可能被別人利用或導致資訊外洩；在字面上也可指窗戶漏水或窗有縫隙造成滲漏。
explanation_english: Figuratively, "漏窗" refers to a loophole, flaw, or oversight in a plan/system that can be exploited or lead to information leaking; literally it can mean a window that leaks (e.g., lets water or air in).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有好多漏窗，可能會俾人利用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 hou2 do1 lau6 coeng1, ho2 nang4 wui5 bei2 jan4 lei6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划有很多漏洞，可能会被人利用。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has many loopholes and could be exploited by others.

mandarin_meaning: 指在追捕、檢查或清查中未被抓到或遺漏的人或事物（比喻漏掉的人或東西）。
english_meaning: A person or thing that slipped through the net; someone or something that evaded capture or escaped detection.
explanation_mandarin: 用來比喻在打擊、搜查或檢查中沒有被捕獲或漏掉的對象，強調從整體中被遺漏或逃脫的人或事。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone or something that was missed during a sweep, search, or crackdown — literally 'a fish that escaped the net.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然警方捉咗好多賊，但仍有幾個漏網之魚仲未捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ging2 fong1 zuk1 zo2 hou2 do1 caak3, daan6 jing4 jau5 gei2 go3 lau6 mong5 zi1 jyu4 zung6 mei6 zuk1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然警方抓了很多賊，但仍有幾個漏網之魚還沒被抓到。
examples.english_sentence: Although the police caught many thieves, there are still a few that slipped through the net and haven't been caught.

mandarin_meaning: 漏洞 / 縫隙
english_meaning: a gap, crack, or loophole; an omission or oversight
explanation_mandarin: 「漏罅」是粵語口語，指實際上的縫隙、裂縫或比喻上的漏洞、疏漏，常用來形容計劃、文件或物件有缺陷或可被利用的空隙。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to a physical gap/crack or, figuratively, a loophole or oversight—used to describe defects or exploitable gaps in plans, documents, or objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有啲漏罅，老細話要我哋再檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 di1 lau6 hat3, lou5 sai3 waa6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告有些漏洞，老闆說要我們再檢查。
examples.english_sentence: This report has some loopholes; the boss said we need to check it again.

mandarin_meaning: 出錯、疏漏、忘記（粵語口語）
english_meaning: to slip up; to make a blunder; to omit or forget something (Cantonese colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「漏雞」是粵語俚語，常用於口語，表示在做事或講話時出現疏漏、忘記或犯錯的情況。
explanation_english: “漏雞” is Cantonese slang used colloquially to indicate making a slip-up, forgetting something, or leaving something out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考試嘅時候漏雞咗幾條題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2 si3 ge3 si4 hau6 lou6 gai1 zo2 gei2 tiu4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試時我漏掉了幾道題目。
examples.english_sentence: I missed a few questions during the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好漏雞，記得按時交報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lou6 gai1, gei3 dak1 on3 si4 gaau1 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別犯錯，記得按時交報告。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slip up; remember to submit the report on time.

mandarin_meaning: 漏电（字面：电流泄漏）；（俚语）对异性产生强烈的生理或情感反应、变得兴奋或失控
english_meaning: leakage of electricity (literal); (slang) to become aroused/turned on or act crazily/losing control (figurative)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 可以指电器发生电流泄漏的现象（技术用语），也可作俚语，形容看到异性或某事物后产生性冲动或表现出失控、奇怪的行为。
explanation_english: Can mean electrical leakage (technical term) or, as slang, describe someone becoming sexually aroused, overly excited, or acting erratically when provoked by someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部洗衣機有漏電，唔好再插電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 jau5 lau6 din6, m4 hou2 zoi3 caap3 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台洗衣机有漏电，别再插电了。
examples.english_sentence: This washing machine has an electrical leak; don't plug it in again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到啲靚女就會漏電，好難控制自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 di1 leng3 neoi5 zau6 wui5 lau6 din6, hou2 naan4 hung3 zai3 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到漂亮的女生就会“漏电”，很难控制自己。
examples.english_sentence: He gets 'leaky electricity' when he sees pretty girls — i.e., he becomes aroused and can't control himself.

mandarin_meaning: 漏風 / 洩漏（資訊）；（建築）漏風、有縫隙讓風進來
english_meaning: to leak (information); to let wind in / to have a draft
explanation_mandarin: 「漏風」可用於字面意思，指房屋或物件有縫隙導致風進入；亦常用作比喻，表示洩漏消息或機密，讓他人知道不該公開的資訊。
explanation_english: “漏風” can be literal, meaning a place has gaps causing drafts, or figurative, meaning to leak information or reveal secrets that should be kept private.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅計劃好秘密，唔可以漏風俾人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gai3 waak6 hou2 bei3 mat6, m4 ho2 ji5 lau6 fung1 bei2 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次的計劃很祕密，不能洩漏給外人知道。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very secret; it must not be leaked to outsiders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋好舊，冬天成日會漏風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hou2 gau6, dung1 tin1 sing4 jat6 wui5 lau6 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間房子很舊，冬天常會漏風。
examples.english_sentence: This house is very old; in winter it often has drafts.

mandarin_meaning: （可能為粵語粗俗俚語，含義不明或地區性用法；可能指露出下體或作爲侮辱用語）
english_meaning: Vulgar Cantonese slang — likely means 'to expose one's genitals' or used as a derogatory insult; regional/uncertain usage.
explanation_mandarin: 此詞為粵語口語中的粗俗說法（原字寫作「漏鷄」並常見被打碼為「漏鷄*」）。字面上「漏」有露出、漏出的意思；「鷄」在俗語中可指男性生殖器或代指妓女等；因此可能用來指露出下體或作爲辱罵他人的粗口。此詞使用帶有冒犯性，並非標準詞彙，地域性和語境差異大，亦可能是拼寫或打碼變體。
explanation_english: This is a vulgar Cantonese slang term (often censored as "漏鷄*"). Literally, "漏" means to leak/expose and "鷄" is slang that can refer to male genitals or a prostitute; thus the term likely refers to exposing one’s genitals or is used as a crude insult. It is offensive, non-standard, regionally variable, and may appear as a censored/altered form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你唔好亂嚟，唔好漏鷄！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 lai4, m4 hou2 lau6 gai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你別亂來，別露下體！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't act like that — don't flash (your genitals)!

mandarin_meaning: （罕見）古漢語字，通用含義推測與水有關，可能指潭、深水或水灣等（現代用法罕見）
english_meaning: rare/archaic character likely related to water — possibly a pool, deep water, or small bay; very uncommon in modern usage
explanation_mandarin: 「漒」為較罕見的漢字，帶水字旁，古籍或方誌中偶見。現代粵語中極少使用，字義多數資料不足，推測與水體（如潭、池或小灣）有關，讀音常按右方構件推測為「qiáo」（粵語近似【kiu4】）。
explanation_english: 漒 is a very rare/archaic Chinese character with the water radical. It appears infrequently in classical texts or local gazetteers. Modern Cantonese usage is exceptionally rare. Scholarly references are limited, but the meaning is generally inferred to be water-related (e.g., a pool, pond, or small bay). Pronunciation is usually reconstructed from the phonetic component as Mandarin qiao and Cantonese approximated as kiu4.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個古字「漒」好少人識，喺現代粵語入面幾乎唔用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu2 zi6 "kiu4" hou2 siu2 jan4 sik1, hai2 jin6 doi6 jyut6 jyu5 jap6 min6 gei2 fu1 m4 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個古字「漒」很少人認識，在現代粵語中幾乎不用。
examples.english_sentence: The archaic character "漒" is seldom recognized; it is almost never used in modern Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: （古义）滴、清澈；现代多见于专名（如“漓江”）或复合词中（如“淋漓”，表示“尽致、酣畅”）
english_meaning: (classical) to drip; clear. In modern usage mainly appears in proper names (e.g. the Li River) or in compounds such as '淋漓' meaning 'thorough, vivid'.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词/动词/形容词（主要作为词素或专名出现）
partOfSpeech_english: noun/verb/adjective (mainly as a morpheme or proper noun)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字“漓”原有流滴、清澈的意思，現代漢語中多作地名（如漓江）或出現在詞語“淋漓”（淋漓盡致）中，用以表達充分、徹底或生動的含義。
explanation_english: The character '漓' originally referred to dripping or clarity. In contemporary usage it mainly appears in place names (e.g. the Li River) or in compounds like '淋漓' (as in '淋漓尽致'), conveying thoroughness or vividness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜會去桂林同漓江旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 wui5 heoi3 gwai3 lam4 tung4 lei4 gong1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个星期会去桂林和漓江旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Guilin and the Li River next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個演出表現得淋漓盡致，觀眾都好投入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jin2 ceot1 biu2 jin2 dak1 lam4 lei4 zeon6 zi3, gun1 zung3 dou1 hou2 tau4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演出表现得淋漓尽致，观众都很投入。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was vivid and thorough; the audience was very engaged.

mandarin_meaning: 演（表演、扮演、演出；（事物）演变、发展）
english_meaning: to perform; to act; to play (a role); to stage; to develop/evolve
explanation_mandarin: 表示表演、扮演或演出，也可用于描述事物的发展、演变。在口語中也可指「裝腔作勢、演戲」。
explanation_english: Indicates performing, acting, or staging a show; can also describe the development or evolution of something. In colloquial use it can mean to pretend or put on an act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戲院演主角，好出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hei3 jyun6 jin2 zyu2 gok3, hou2 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在影院饰演主角，很出色。
examples.english_sentence: He plays the lead role in the theater; very outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好演，做返你自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jin2, zou6 faan1 nei5 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别演，做回你自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act/pretend, be yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情況可能會演變，要觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 fong3 ho2 nang4 wui5 jin2 bin3, jiu3 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情况可能会演变，需要观察。
examples.english_sentence: The situation may evolve; it needs to be monitored.

mandarin_meaning: 演出（yǎnchū）：表演；演出的節目或活動
english_meaning: performance; to perform
explanation_mandarin: 指在舞台、電視或其他場所進行表演的行為，也可指具體的表演節目或活動。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of performing on stage, TV, or other venues; can also denote the performance/show itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有一個音樂會，我哋去睇演出啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 jat1 go3 jam1 ngok6 wui2, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 jin2 ceot1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有一個音樂會，我們去看演出吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's a concert tonight; let's go watch the performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上嘅演出好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 ge3 jin2 ceot1 hou2 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上的演出很精彩。
examples.english_sentence: His performance on stage was brilliant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 劇團下個月會喺藝術館演出一齣新戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kek6 tyun4 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 hai2 ngai6 seot6 gun2 jin2 ceot1 jat1 ceot1 san1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 劇團下個月會在藝術館演出一齣新戲。
examples.english_sentence: The troupe will perform a new play at the art center next month.

mandarin_meaning: 演化（yǎnhuà）：演變、進化或發展的過程
english_meaning: evolution; to evolve; the process of change or development over time
explanation_mandarin: 指事物隨時間或環境逐步改變、演變或進展的過程，可用於生物、語言、技術、文化等領域。
explanation_english: Refers to the process by which something changes, develops, or transforms over time or in response to the environment; used for biological, linguistic, technological, cultural, and other kinds of change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生命係經過長時間嘅演化先至可以適應環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sang1 ming6 hai6 ging1 gwo3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 ge3 jin2 faa3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sik1 jing3 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生命是經過長時間的演化才能適應環境。
examples.english_sentence: Life evolves over long periods to adapt to the environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 語言會隨住時代演化，出現新詞同變化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 jin4 wui5 ceoi4 zyu6 si4 doi6 jin2 faa3, ceot1 jin2 san1 ci4 tung4 bin3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 語言會隨著時代演化，出現新詞和變化。
examples.english_sentence: Languages evolve with the times, producing new words and changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔改進技術，產品可能無辦法跟市場演化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 goi2 zeon3 gei6 seot6, caan2 ban2 ho2 nang4 mou4 baan6 faat3 gan1 si5 coeng4 jin2 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不改進技術，產品可能無法跟上市場的演化。
examples.english_sentence: If technology isn't improved, products may not be able to evolve with the market.

mandarin_meaning: 演員 (yǎnyuán)
english_meaning: actor; actress; performer
explanation_mandarin: 指在電影、電視、舞台等媒介中扮演角色並進行表演的人。
explanation_english: A person who performs roles in films, television, theatre, or other media — an actor/actress/performer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好有經驗嘅演員，演過好多電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 jin2 jyun4, jin2 gwo3 hou2 do1 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有經驗的演員，演過很多電影。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very experienced actor; he has acted in many films.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位演員今次嘅演出好成功，觀眾反應熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 jin2 jyun4 gam1 ci3 ge3 jin2 ceot1 hou2 sing4 gung1, gun1 zung3 faan2 jing3 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位演員這次的演出很成功，觀眾反應熱烈。
examples.english_sentence: This actor's performance this time was very successful; the audience reacted enthusiastically.

mandarin_meaning: 演唱 (yǎnchàng)：演唱歌曲，作為表演的一部分
english_meaning: to sing (as a performance); to perform a song
explanation_mandarin: 指在舞台、活動或節目中演唱歌曲，強調表演性和公開演出。
explanation_english: To sing songs as part of a public performance (on stage or at an event), emphasizing the act of performing vocally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚喺體育館演唱咗佢嘅新歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 hai2 tai2 juk6 gun2 jin2 coeng3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 san1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚在体育馆演唱了他的新歌。
examples.english_sentence: He performed his new song tonight at the stadium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歌手喺台上演唱，台下掌聲雷動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go1 sau2 hai2 toi4 soeng5 jin2 coeng3, toi4 haa6 zoeng2 sing1 leoi4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歌手在台上演唱，台下掌声雷动。
examples.english_sentence: The singer sang on stage, and thunderous applause came from the audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔鍾意喺公眾面前演唱，會好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 hai2 gung1 zung3 min6 cin4 jin2 coeng3, wui5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不喜欢在公众面前演唱，会很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't like singing in front of the public; he gets very nervous.

mandarin_meaning: 演唱会
english_meaning: concert (singing performance)
explanation_mandarin: 指歌手或乐队以歌唱为主的现场表演活动，通常在场馆举行，观众购票入场。
explanation_english: A live performance event focused on singing by one or more artists or bands; typically held in a venue with ticketed audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚會去睇演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 heoi3 tai2 jin2 coeng3 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚會去看演唱會。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to watch a concert tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 演戏；装腔作势、装模作样（口语）
english_meaning: to act/put on an act; to pretend or show off (Colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「演嘢」是廣東話口語，通常指裝腔作勢、故意表現或作態以吸引別人注意或欺騙別人。有時亦可中性地指在舞台或電影中演戲。常用作動詞，語氣偏口語或粗俗。
explanation_english: In Cantonese colloquial speech, "演嘢" typically means to put on an act, pretend, or show off to attract attention or deceive others. It can also neutrally mean to perform/act in a play or film. It is used as a verb and is informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我面前演嘢，想攞人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai6 ngo5 min6 cin4 jin2 je5, soeng2 lok6 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在我面前装腔作势，想吸引别人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on an act in front of me to get people's attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度演嘢，快啲講真話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 jin2 je5, faai3 di1 gong2 zan1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里演戏了，快点说实话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act here — just tell the truth quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺派對度一路笑一路演嘢，好多人都覺得討厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 paai3 deoi6 dou6 jat1 lou6 siu3 jat1 lou6 jin2 je5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 tou2 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在派对上又笑又演戏，很多人觉得很讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: At the party he kept smiling and putting on an act; many people found it annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 用乐器演奏（演出乐曲）
english_meaning: to perform music on an instrument; to play a musical piece
explanation_mandarin: 表示用乐器演奏音乐，指在音乐会、演出或练习中演奏乐曲。
explanation_english: To play or perform music using an instrument; often refers to performing a musical piece in a concert, recital, or practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺音樂會上演奏咗一首鋼琴曲，得到好評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam1 ngok6 wui6 seong6 jin2 zau3 zo2 jat1 sau2 gong3 kam4 kuk1, dak1 dou3 hou2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首钢琴曲，获得好评。
examples.english_sentence: He performed a piano piece at the concert and received praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小提琴嘅演奏技巧需要長期練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 tai4 kam4 ge3 jin2 zau3 gei6 haau6 seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 kei4 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小提琴的演奏技巧需要长期练习。
examples.english_sentence: Violin technique requires long-term practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫學生上台演奏一段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 hok6 saang1 soeng5 toi4 jin2 zau3 jat1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師請學生上台演奏一段。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked the student to perform a piece on stage.

mandarin_meaning: 演奏级（演奏級）／演出等級，達到可公開演奏的水準
english_meaning: performance-grade; concert-level; suitable for public performance (usually of musical instruments or players)
explanation_mandarin: 表示樂器或演奏者的水準足以用於公開演出，常用來形容樂器品質或技術等級，也可口語化指高水準或專業等級。
explanation_english: Indicates that an instrument or a player's skill is at a level suitable for public performance. Commonly used to describe instrument quality or performer proficiency; can be used colloquially to mean high/professional level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把小提琴係演奏級，唔係練習用嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 siu2 tai4 kam4 hai6 jin2 zau3 kap1, m4 hai6 lin6 zaap6 jung6 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這把小提琴是演奏級，不是練習用的那種。
examples.english_sentence: This violin is performance-grade, not the practice kind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鋼琴嘅水平已經達到演奏級，可以上台表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong3 kam4 ge3 seoi2 ping4 ji5 ging1 daat6 dou3 jin2 zau3 kap1, ho2 ji5 soeng5 toi4 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的鋼琴水平已經達到演奏級，可以上台表演。
examples.english_sentence: His piano level has reached performance-grade; he can perform on stage.

mandarin_meaning: 演戏 (yǎnxì)：表演、演出；（口語）裝模作樣、假裝
english_meaning: to act; to perform (in a play or film); (colloquial) to put on an act, to pretend
explanation_mandarin: 指在舞台、電影或電視上表演角色；在口語中也可用來表示假裝、裝腔作勢。
explanation_english: Refers to performing a role on stage, film, or television. Colloquially it can also mean pretending or putting on an act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚佢喺劇場演戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 keoi5 hai2 kek6 coeng4 jin2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚他/她在劇場演戲。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight he/she is acting in the theatre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺我面前演戲，我已經知道你唔真心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 jin2 hei3, ngo5 ji5 ging1 zi1 dou3 nei5 m4 zan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在我面前演戲，我已經知道你不真心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on an act in front of me — I already know you're not sincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個已經開始演戲，依家係專業演員。
