explanation_english: Originally refers to a qilin (a mythical creature) with fire attributes or a fiery appearance. In modern usage it appears in games, fantasy literature, comics, or art, and can also be used as a nickname or metaphor for something or someone powerful, spectacular, or fire-element themed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻火麒麟喺遊戲入面係五星寵物，好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 fo2 kei4 leon4 hai6 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 ge3 ng5 sing1 cung2 mat6, hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻火麒麟在遊戲裡是五星寵物，很強。
examples.english_sentence: That fire qilin is a five-star pet in the game; it's very powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 藝術家畫咗幅火麒麟，畫風好震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngai6 seot6 gaa1 waa6 zo2 fuk1 fo2 kei4 leon4, waa6 fung1 hou2 zan3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 藝術家畫了一幅火麒麟，畫風很震撼。
examples.english_sentence: The artist painted a fire qilin; the style is very striking.

jyutping: fo2 kei4 leon4 zau1 san1 jan5
mandarin_meaning: （粵語俚語）形容一個人外表非常吸引、火辣迷人，從頭到腳都令人注目。
english_meaning: (Cantonese slang) describes someone who is extremely attractive and eye-catching from head to toe.
explanation_mandarin: 「火麒麟——周身引」是香港粵語的口語說法，用來誇張地稱讚某人全身都很吸引、氣質或打扮非常出眾，常帶有讚賞或驚嘆意味。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase used to praise someone as being strikingly attractive all over; typically an exaggerated compliment implying they draw attention wherever they go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下佢，真係火麒麟——周身引，成條街都望住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 keoi5, zan1 hai6 fo2 kei4 leon4 zau1 san1 jan5, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看他，真的是火麒麟——全身都很吸引，整條街的人都在看著他。
examples.english_sentence: Look at him — he's a 'fire qilin' — attractive from head to toe; the whole street is staring at him.

mandarin_meaning: 火麻仁（大麻籽），中药名，指大麻的种子，可入药或作食用
english_meaning: hemp seed (seeds of Cannabis sativa); used as a traditional Chinese medicinal herb and as an edible seed
explanation_mandarin: 火麻仁是大麻植物的種子，傳統中醫常用作潤腸通便、潤膚的藥材；亦可作為食品加入麥片、沙拉等。
explanation_english: Hemp seed refers to the seeds of the Cannabis plant. In traditional Chinese medicine it is commonly used to moisten the intestines and relieve constipation; it is also used as an edible seed added to cereals, salads, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話火麻仁可以潤腸通便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 fo2 maa4 jan4 ho2 ji5 jeon6 coeng4 tung1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医说火麻仁可以润肠通便。
examples.english_sentence: Traditional Chinese medicine says hemp seed can moisten the intestines and relieve constipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有賣火麻仁，啲籽可以拌落沙律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 maai6 fo2 maa4 jan4, di1 zi2 ho2 ji5 bun3 lok6 saa1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有卖火麻仁，籽可以拌入沙拉。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells hemp seeds; the seeds can be mixed into salads.

mandarin_meaning: 火龙果（亦称红龙果、龙果）
english_meaning: dragon fruit (pitaya/pitahaya)
explanation_mandarin: 一种热带/亚热带水果，外皮鲜艳多为红色或黄色，果肉可为白色或红色，含许多小黑籽，味道清甜。
explanation_english: A tropical/subtropical fruit with bright skin (red or yellow) and white or red flesh dotted with many small black seeds; mildly sweet in taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食火龍果，佢好甜又有好多籽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 fo2 lung4 gwo2, keoi5 hou2 tim4 jau5 hou2 do1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃火龙果，它很甜而且有很多籽。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating dragon fruit; it's very sweet and has lots of seeds.

jyutping: fo2 lam4 (讀音記錄稀少，標示為近似讀音)
mandarin_meaning: （罕見俗語）非常生氣／怒不可遏（推測）
english_meaning: a rare Cantonese slang expression (likely) meaning extremely angry or furious
explanation_mandarin: 「火𤓓」並非現代標準詞典常見詞條，為廣東話口語或網絡俗語形式。字形中「火」明示與「生氣／火氣」相關，整體語義可理解為「非常生氣、火大」。由於第二字（𤓓）極為罕見，讀音與用法存在不確定性，以上為基於語感與構詞推測的說明，使用時應注意語境並謹慎採用。
explanation_english: “火𤓓” is not a standard dictionary entry and appears as a rare Cantonese colloquial or online slang form. The character "火" indicates association with anger; overall it is likely used to mean “very angry” or “furious.” The second character (𤓓) is extremely uncommon, so pronunciation and exact usage are uncertain — the entry gives a plausible interpretation but use with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再鬧我，我已經火𤓓晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 nau6 ngo5, ngo5 ji5 ging1 fo2 lam4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再骂我，我已经火𤓓了（表達：我很生氣）。
examples.english_sentence: Stop scolding me — I'm already 火𤓓 (i.e. I'm really angry).

mandarin_meaning: 灭 / 熄灭 / 消灭（使火、光等消失；消除、毁灭）
english_meaning: to extinguish; to put out (a fire/light); to eliminate or destroy; to die out
explanation_mandarin: 表示使火、光等终止或消失，也可用于比喻义，表示消除、毁灭或使某事物灭绝。
explanation_english: Used to indicate putting out a fire or light, or more generally to eliminate, destroy, or cause something to cease to exist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲灭火啦，唔好等成間屋着晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 mit6 fo2 laa1, m4 hou2 dang2 sing4 gaan1 uk1 zoek3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点灭火，别等整间房子都着起来。
examples.english_sentence: Put out the fire quickly; don't wait until the whole house catches fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完煙記得灭支煙，唔好亂拋喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 jin1 gei3 dak1 mit6 zi1 jin1, m4 hou2 lyun6 paau1 hai2 dei6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抽完烟记得把烟熄灭，不要乱扔在地上。
examples.english_sentence: After smoking, remember to extinguish the cigarette; don't throw it on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃可以滅晒佢哋嘅競爭對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ho2 ji5 mit6 saai3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划可以把他们的竞争对手全部消灭。
examples.english_sentence: This plan can eliminate all of their competitors.

mandarin_meaning: 灯（燈）：发光的器具或光线
english_meaning: lamp; light; lantern; light bulb
explanation_mandarin: 指用于照明的器具或其发出的光，可指燈具、燈泡、路燈等。
explanation_english: Refers to a device that produces light or the light it emits; can mean a lamp, light bulb, streetlight, or lantern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開燈啦，我睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 dang1 laa1, ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开灯吧，我看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Turn on the light, I can't see clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街燈壞咗，夜晚行路好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 dang1 waai6 zo2, je6 maan5 haang4 lou6 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街灯坏了，晚上走路很危险。
examples.english_sentence: The streetlight is broken; it's dangerous to walk at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個燈泡燒咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dang1 paau4 siu1 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个灯泡烧坏了，要换一个。
examples.english_sentence: This light bulb burned out; it needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 灰（huī）：① 灰烬、灰尘；② 灰色（颜色）
english_meaning: ash; ash(s) or dust; gray (the color)
explanation_mandarin: “灰”常用作名词表示烧剩的灰烬或尘土，也可用作表示颜色（灰色）。在口语中也常见于复合词，如“灰心”（灰心丧气）。
explanation_english: “灰” is commonly a noun meaning ash or dust, and can describe the color gray. It also appears in compounds (e.g., '灰心' meaning discouraged).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火爐燒完之後，地下滿佈灰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 lou4 siu1 jyun4 zi1 hau6, dei6 haa6 mun5 bou3 fui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炉子烧完之后，地上满是灰。
examples.english_sentence: After the stove burned out, the floor was covered in ash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗件灰色嘅外套，好襯我條褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 fui1 sik1 ge3 ngoi6 tou3, hou2 can3 ngo5 tiu4 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一件灰色的外套，很配我的裤子。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a gray coat; it matches my pants well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔及格令佢好灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 m4 kap6 gaak3 ling6 keoi5 hou2 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格让他很灰心。
examples.english_sentence: Failing the exam made him very discouraged.

mandarin_meaning: 鏟爐灰的勺子；泛指用來鏟灰的小器具
english_meaning: an ash spoon (a small scoop/spoon used to remove ash); can refer generally to a small scoop for ash
explanation_mandarin: 指用來鏟取爐灰或燒炭灰的勺狀或鏟狀小器具。在日常用語中通常為字面意思，也可泛指小型鏟灰工具。
explanation_english: Refers to a spoon- or scoop-shaped small tool used to remove ash from stoves or braziers. Usually used in the literal sense; can also broadly denote a small ash-scooping utensil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有把灰匙，專門用嚟鏟爐灰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 baa2 fui1 si4, zyun1 mun4 jung6 lai4 caam2 lou4 fui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房裡有一把灰匙，專門用來鏟爐灰。
examples.english_sentence: There is an ash spoon in the kitchen, used specifically to scoop ash from the stove.

mandarin_meaning: 灰尘 (细小的尘土颗粒)
english_meaning: dust; fine particles of dirt or soil
explanation_mandarin: 指漂浮或附着在物体表面、空气中的细小固体颗粒，常见于室内外，可能导致过敏或呼吸道不适。
explanation_english: Refers to tiny solid particles that float in the air or settle on surfaces; commonly found indoors and outdoors and can cause allergies or respiratory irritation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企太多灰塵會令人打噴嚏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 taai3 do1 fui1 can4 wui5 ling6 jan4 daa2 pan3 tai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡灰塵太多會讓人打噴嚏。
examples.english_sentence: Too much dust at home can make people sneeze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨之後，窗台上有好多灰塵同泥沙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, coeng1 toi4 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 fui1 can4 tung4 nei4 saa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨後，窗台上有很多灰塵和泥沙。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, there is a lot of dust and silt on the windowsill.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見俚語）形容消沉、灰心或情緒低落的人
english_meaning: a downbeat or gloomy person; someone who is feeling dispirited (slang, rare)
explanation_mandarin: 「灰士」屬於廣東話的非正式用語或俚語，用來戲稱或描述一個人情緒低落、消極或整日無精打采。此詞較少見，可能帶有輕微貶義或玩笑性質。
explanation_english: A rare Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who is gloomy, apathetic, or perpetually down. It is informal and can carry a mildly derogatory or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁灰士，乜都提不起勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gam2 fui1 si6, mat1 dou1 tai4 bat1 hei2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是這麼消沉，什麼都提不起勁。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so downbeat; he can't get motivated for anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做灰士，出嚟行下透透氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 fui1 si6, ceot1 lai4 haang4 haa5 tau3 tou3 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當消沉的人，出來走走透透氣吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a downer — come out for a walk and get some fresh air.

mandarin_meaning: 灰姑娘（童話人物）；比喻平凡或被忽視的女孩經歷改變後獲得重視或成功
english_meaning: Cinderella (the fairy-tale character); metaphor for an overlooked or humble girl who becomes noticed or successful after a transformation
explanation_mandarin: 原指格林童話中的女主角灰姑娘，後來常用來比喻從平凡、被忽略的地位突然變得受重視或成功的人或經歷。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the heroine Cinderella from the fairy tale. It is also used figuratively to describe someone—often a girl—who rises from obscurity or neglect to prominence or success after a transformation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日扮灰姑娘，等王子嚟救佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 baan6 fui1 gu1 noeng4, dang2 wong4 zi2 lei4 gau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小時候常常扮演灰姑娘，等待王子來救她。
examples.english_sentence: She used to play Cinderella when she was a child, waiting for a prince to rescue her.

mandarin_meaning: 灰心（huī xīn）——感到氣餒、失去信心
english_meaning: discouraged; disheartened; to lose heart
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為遇到挫折或失敗而感到氣餒、喪失信心，常用來描述情緒狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling discouraged or losing confidence after setbacks or failures; commonly used to describe an emotional state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好灰心，呢次唔順利，下次再試啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, ni1 ci3 m4 seon6 lei6, haa6 ci3 zoi3 si3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別灰心，這次不順利，下次再試吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be discouraged; this time didn't go well, try again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到結果之後都好灰心，唔想再做落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 git3 gwo2 zi1 hau6 dou1 hou2 fui1 sam1, m4 soeng2 zoi3 zou6 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到結果後很灰心，不想再做下去。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very discouraged after hearing the result and didn't want to continue.

mandarin_meaning: 尴尬 / 丢脸
english_meaning: embarrassed; ashamed; feeling humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 表示感到尴尬、丢脸或难为情，常用来形容因为出丑、失態或被人取笑而觉得窘迫。
explanation_english: Expresses feeling embarrassed, ashamed, or humiliated; commonly used when someone has made a mistake, lost face, or is being laughed at.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先喺台上跌親，真係好灰掃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 hai2 toi4 soeng5 dit3 can1, zan1 hai6 hou2 fui1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在台上摔倒了，真是很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: I just fell on stage — I was really embarrassed.

mandarin_meaning: 盛放灰燼的容器；煙灰缸或灰盤
english_meaning: a container for ash (an ashpan/ashtray)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放燃燒後灰燼的容器，常用於盛煙灰或爐灰，在口語中可指小型的灰盤或灰斗。
explanation_english: Refers to a container used to hold ash from burning (for example cigarette ash or stove ash). In colloquial Cantonese it can mean a small ashpan or ashtray.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企個灰斗已經滿咗，要倒咗先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 go3 fui1 dau2 ji5 ging1 mun5 zo2, jiu3 dou2 zo2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的灰斗已經滿了，要先倒掉。
examples.english_sentence: The ashpan at home is already full; you need to empty it first.

mandarin_meaning: 灰暗，昏暗；阴沉、情绪低落的感觉
english_meaning: gloomy; dim; bleak; dull
explanation_mandarin: 表示光线不足或颜色暗淡，也可形容氛围或心情沉重、阴郁。
explanation_english: Describes dim or dull lighting/colour, or metaphorically a gloomy, bleak atmosphere or mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天色變得灰暗，可能快要落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 sik1 bin3 dak1 fui1 am3, ho2 nang4 faai3 jiu3 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天色变得灰暗，可能快要下雨。
examples.english_sentence: The sky turned gloomy; it might rain soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近心情好灰暗，唔想同人傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sam1 cing4 hou2 fui1 am3, m4 soeng2 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近心情很灰暗，不想和人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He's been feeling very gloomy lately and doesn't want to talk to anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 房間入面燈光好弱，顏色睇落灰暗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 gaan1 jap6 min6 dang1 gwong1 hou2 joek6, ngaan4 sik1 tai2 lok6 fui1 am3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里面灯光很弱，颜色看起来灰暗。
examples.english_sentence: The room's lighting is weak and the colours look dull.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語，少見）形容人情緒低落、沮喪或灰心，字面為「灰色的柿子」。
english_meaning: (colloquial, rare) describes someone who is downcast, dejected, or disheartened; literally "grey persimmon".
explanation_mandarin: 「灰柿」為廣東話口語中較少見的俚語，用來形容一個人情緒低落、無精打采或灰心喪志。字面上是「灰色的柿子」，帶有比喻意味，強調情緒沉鬱或失望。
explanation_english: "灰柿" is a less common Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone who is gloomy, downcast, or demoralized. Literally "grey persimmon," the phrase is metaphorical and conveys a sense of dullness or disheartenment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁灰柿，失敗一次唔代表全部都完咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 fui1 si6, sat1 baai6 jat1 ci3 m4 doi6 biu2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 jyun4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么灰柿，失败一次不代表全部都完了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so downcast — one failure doesn't mean everything is over.

mandarin_meaning: 灰桶；用來放煙灰、煙頭或爐灰的容器
english_meaning: ash bucket; a receptacle for cigarette ashes/butts or stove/altar ashes
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛放煙灰、煙頭或爐灰的桶狀容器，在公共場所或寺廟常見；與「煙灰缸」相近，但通常體積較大或為專門的容器。
explanation_english: Refers to a bucket-like container used to hold cigarette ash/butts or stove/altar ashes. Common in public places or temples; similar to an ashtray but often larger or purpose-built.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 門口擺住個灰桶，俾人擲煙頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mun4 hau2 baai2 zyu6 go3 fui1 tung4, bei2 jan4 zaak6 jin1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 门口放着一个灰桶，供人扔烟头。
examples.english_sentence: There's an ash bucket at the entrance for people to throw cigarette butts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟裏有幾個灰桶用嚟放爐灰同香灰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 leoi5 jau5 gei2 go3 fui1 tung4 jung6 lai4 fong3 lou4 fui1 tung4 hoeng1 fui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 庙里有几个灰桶，用来放炉灰和香灰。
examples.english_sentence: There are several ash buckets in the temple used for stove ashes and incense ash.

mandarin_meaning: 打飛機（俚語，指男性自慰）
english_meaning: to masturbate (male); jerk off (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「灰機」是廣東話俚語，常用作「打飛機」的替代寫法或簡稱，指男性自慰。屬於粗俗用語，網路上有時用來避開審查或以較隱晦的方式表達。
explanation_english: “灰機” (fui1 gei1) is Cantonese slang used as an alternative spelling or shorthand for “打飛機” (to masturbate/jerk off). It refers specifically to male masturbation and is vulgar/slang; sometimes written this way online to avoid censorship or be euphemistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房度打灰機，唔想俾人知道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 dou6 daa2 fui1 gei1, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房間打飛機，不想讓人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He was masturbating in his room and didn't want people to know.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）沮喪、失落、灰心
english_meaning: A slang term meaning dejected, disappointed, or let down
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，用來形容因失望、被冷落或未達期望而感到情緒低落、沮喪或灰心。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression used to describe feeling dejected, disappointed, or down — typically caused by unmet expectations or social rejection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢唔嚟派對，我真係好灰水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 m4 lai4 paai3 deoi6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 fui1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽說他不來派對，我真的很灰心／很失落。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard he wouldn't come to the party, I felt really disappointed.

mandarin_meaning: 滿地灰塵或沙土的地方；形容非常灰塵多、髒亂的地面
english_meaning: a place covered with dust and sand; a dusty, sandy, or filthy ground
explanation_mandarin: 「灰沙地」字面指地面佈滿灰塵和沙土，口語中可用來形容某處非常灰塵多或凌亂髒亂的情況。
explanation_english: Literally refers to ground covered in dust and sand. Colloquially used to describe a place that is very dusty, sandy, or generally messy and dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工地搞到成條街都係灰沙地，行路要戴口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 dei6 gaau2 dou3 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hai6 fui1 saa1 dei6, haang4 lou6 jiu3 daai3 hau2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工地把整條街都弄得滿是灰沙，走路要戴口罩。
examples.english_sentence: The construction site has left the whole street covered in dust and sand; you need to wear a mask when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋好耐冇掃，成個客廳變咗灰沙地，差唔多坐唔低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hou2 noi6 mou5 sou3, seng4 go3 haak3 teng1 bin3 zo2 fui1 saa1 dei6, caa1 m4 do1 co5 m4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間屋很久沒打掃，整個客廳變成灰沙地，幾乎坐不下。
examples.english_sentence: They haven't cleaned the house for a long time; the whole living room has become dusty and sandy, almost unusable.

mandarin_meaning: 灰沙磚（建築用的灰色砂質磚塊，常見於香港舊式建築）
english_meaning: grey sand brick; a type of building brick with a sandy texture commonly seen in older Hong Kong buildings
explanation_mandarin: 指一種表面呈灰色、帶砂質感的磚塊，常用於牆身或外牆裝飾，尤其在香港的舊樓或傳統建築中常見。
explanation_english: Refers to a brick that has a grey, sandy texture, used for walls or exterior decoration; often seen in older or traditional buildings in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幢舊樓啲牆係用灰沙磚砌成，睇落幾有年代感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zong6 gau6 lau4 di1 coeng4 hai6 jung6 fui1 saa1 zyun1 cai3 seng4, tai2 lok6 gei2 jau5 nin4 doi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幢舊樓的牆是用灰沙磚砌成的，看起來很有年代感。
examples.english_sentence: The walls of this old building are built with grey sand bricks; they look quite vintage.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）非常、很；（字面）灰熊、棕熊（動物）
english_meaning: (slang) very; extremely (intensifier); (literal) grizzly bear
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词（俚语：程度副词）；名词（字面：動物）
explanation_mandarin: 「灰熊」是廣東話口語用法，作為程度副詞使用，用來強調程度很高，例如「灰熊熱」「灰熊肚餓」。字面上亦可指棕熊/灰熊，但在香港日常對話中常見為俚語用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "灰熊" is a colloquial intensifier meaning very/extremely (e.g., 灰熊熱 = extremely hot). Literally it can mean a grizzly bear, but in Hong Kong usage it is commonly used as slang to indicate high degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日灰熊熱，唔想出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 fui1 hung4 jit6, m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天非常热，不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: It's extremely hot today; I don't want to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家灰熊肚餓，食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 fui1 hung4 tou5 ngo6, sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在非常饿，吃东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really hungry now — let's eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢部電影灰熊唔鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 fui1 hung4 m4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她对这部电影非常不喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He/She really doesn't like this movie.

mandarin_meaning: 灰烬 (huījìn)
english_meaning: ashes; the remnants left after something has burned
explanation_mandarin: 指火焚烧后留下的灰和未完全燃尽的残余，也可比喻事物的彻底毁灭或消失。
explanation_english: Refers to the ashes and remnants left after something has been burned; can also be used metaphorically to indicate complete destruction or disappearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大火過後，屋企只剩下一堆灰燼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 fo2 gwo3 hau6, uk1 kei5 zi2 sing4 haa6 jat1 deoi1 fui1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大火过后，房子只剩下一堆灰烬。
examples.english_sentence: After the big fire, the house was reduced to a pile of ashes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅希望化為灰燼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hei1 mong6 faa3 wai4 fui1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的希望化为灰烬。
examples.english_sentence: His hopes turned to ashes.

mandarin_meaning: 灰指甲（指甲真菌感染）
english_meaning: onychomycosis; fungal nail infection (colloquially 'gray nail')
explanation_mandarin: 對指甲或趾甲的真菌感染，導致指甲變灰、變厚或易碎。"灰甲"是口語簡稱，通常指灰指甲（灰指甲／甲癬）。
explanation_english: A fungal infection of the fingernails or toenails (onychomycosis) that causes nails to become discolored (often gray), thickened, and brittle. "灰甲" is a colloquial short form for gray/fungal nails.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手指有灰甲，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2 jau5 fui1 gaap3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我手指有灰指甲，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I have a fungal nail on my finger; I need to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 灰白（灰白色），泛指介於灰和白之間的顏色；也常用來形容頭髮變白或面色蒼白。
english_meaning: gray-white; ashy white — describes a color between gray and white; can also describe hair turning white or a pale, ashy complexion.
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述顏色偏灰而帶白，或形容年老頭髮變白、臉色蒼白等狀態。
explanation_english: Used to describe a grayish-white color, or metaphorically to describe hair going white or a pale/ashen appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲頭髮開始變灰白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 tau4 faat3 hoi1 ci2 bin3 fui1 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的头发开始变灰白。
examples.english_sentence: His hair has started to turn gray-white.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天色灰白，冇乜陽光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 sik1 fui1 baak6, mou5 mat1 joeng4 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的天色灰白，没什么阳光。
examples.english_sentence: Today's sky is grayish-white with little sunlight.

mandarin_meaning: 灰色 (huīsè)
english_meaning: gray; grey
explanation_mandarin: 表示顏色為灰色；在引申用法中可指模糊、不明確的狀態（如「灰色地帶」）。
explanation_english: Denotes the color gray; figuratively it can refer to ambiguity or a 'grey area' (e.g. 'grey area').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係灰色，好襯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 fui1 sik1, hou2 can3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是灰色，很适合你。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is gray; it suits you well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題有啲處於灰色地帶，唔容易判斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jau5 di1 cyu3 jyu1 fui1 sik1 dei6 daai6, m4 jung4 ji6 pun3 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题有点处于灰色地带，不容易判断。
examples.english_sentence: This issue falls into a gray area and isn't easy to judge.

mandarin_meaning: 灰色地带（huīsè dìdài），指界限不清、介於兩者之間的模糊區域或情況。
english_meaning: gray area — an ambiguous area or situation where boundaries are unclear
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容在法律、道德、政策或判斷上既非黑白分明，又不容易界定的模糊範圍或情況。
explanation_english: Used to describe situations or areas (legal, moral, policy, etc.) that are not clearly defined as right or wrong and are difficult to categorize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題唔係非黑即白，係一個灰色地帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 m4 hai6 fei1 hak1 zik6 baak6, hai6 jat1 go3 fui1 sik1 dei6 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题不是非黑即白，是一个灰色地带。
examples.english_sentence: This issue isn't black and white; it's a gray area.

mandarin_meaning: 二氧化錳（可能是二氧化锰的非正式寫法或誤寫）
english_meaning: manganese dioxide (likely an informal or mistaken writing referring to MnO2)
explanation_mandarin: 「灰錳氧」並非標準中文化學名，字面為「灰、錳、氧」。在化學語境下，多數情況下應指化合物二氧化錳（MnO2），常用於乾電池、催化劑和顏料等。也有可能是網絡上的非正式用法或錯寫。
explanation_english: “灰錳氧” is not a standard chemical name; literally it reads “ash / gray, manganese, oxygen.” In chemical contexts it most likely refers to manganese dioxide (MnO2), a compound commonly used in batteries, catalysts, and pigments. It may also appear as an informal or mistaken internet usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種粉末好似灰錳氧，實驗室要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 fan2 mut6 hou2 ci5 fui1 maang5 joeng6, sat6 jim6 sat1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种粉末看起来像二氧化锰，实验室要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: This powder looks like manganese dioxide; the lab should handle it with care.

mandarin_meaning: 灰飞烟灭 (huī fēi yān miè)：彻底消失或毁灭，化为乌有。
english_meaning: to be reduced to ashes; to vanish completely; to be wiped out without a trace.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物完全被毀滅或徹底消失，常用來形容計劃、希望或物體被徹底摧毀。
explanation_english: Describes something being completely destroyed or disappearing without a trace; often used for plans, hopes, or things that are utterly wiped out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋畀大火燒咗，差唔多灰飛煙滅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 bei2 daai6 fo2 siu1 zo2, caa1 m4 do1 fui1 fei1 jin1 mit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間房子被大火燒了，差不多灰飛煙滅。
examples.english_sentence: The house was burned by a big fire and was almost reduced to ashes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲計劃一夜之間全部灰飛煙滅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 gai3 waak6 jat1 je6 zi1 gaan1 cyun4 bou6 fui1 fei1 jin1 mit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的計劃一夜之間全部灰飛煙滅。
examples.english_sentence: Their plans vanished overnight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個消息，我原本嘅希望即刻灰飛煙滅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 jyun4 bun2 ge3 hei1 mong6 zik1 hak1 fui1 fei1 jin1 mit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到這個消息，我原本的希望立刻灰飛煙滅。
examples.english_sentence: Upon hearing the news, my original hopes immediately vanished.

mandarin_meaning: 灰黑（huīhēi）；偏暗的灰色或灰中带黑
english_meaning: gray-black; dark gray or ashy black
explanation_mandarin: 表示介于灰色与黑色之间的颜色，偏暗的灰色；也可用来形容物品顏色暗沉或略带污跡。
explanation_english: Describes a color between gray and black — a dark gray or ashy black; can also describe something looking dull or slightly soiled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住一件灰黑色嘅外套，好襯佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 jat1 gin6 fui1 hak1 sik1 ge3 ngoi6 tou3, hou2 can3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着一件灰黑色的外套，很適合他。
examples.english_sentence: He is wearing a gray-black coat; it suits him well.

mandarin_meaning: 灶（灶台、爐灶）
english_meaning: stove; hearth; kitchen stove
explanation_mandarin: 指用來做飯、煮食的爐具或灶台，傳統上也指家中用火烹飪的場所。
explanation_english: Refers to the stove or hearth used for cooking; traditionally denotes the place in a household where food is cooked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺灶頭度煮緊餸，屋企好快有得食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 zou6 tau4 dou6 zyu2 gan2 sung3, uk1 kei5 hou2 faai3 jau5 dak1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽在灶台上煮菜，家裡很快就可以吃了。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is cooking at the stove; the family will be eating soon.

mandarin_meaning: 灶君／灶王（民間信仰中掌管灶火及家宅、於農曆新年前上天稟報人間善惡的灶神）
english_meaning: Kitchen God; Stove God — a household deity who watches over the stove/household and traditionally reports the family's deeds to the heavens, worshiped especially before Lunar New Year
explanation_mandarin: 灶君是華人民間信仰中的灶神，負責守護家宅與灶火。傳統習俗在農曆新年前祭灶，盼灶君上天稟報時能保佑家人平安或多做美言。
explanation_english: The Kitchen God (Stove God) is a deity in Chinese folk religion who looks after the household and hearth. Traditionally families offer worship before Lunar New Year so the Kitchen God will report their good deeds to the Jade Emperor and bring protection or blessings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年嘅時候，屋企會拜灶君，祈求來年屋企平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, uk1 kei2 wui5 baai3 zou6 gwan1, kei4 kau4 loi4 nin4 uk1 kei2 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農曆新年的時候，家裡會祭拜灶君，祈求來年家人平安。
examples.english_sentence: During Lunar New Year, the family worships the Kitchen God, praying for the household's safety in the coming year.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：灶君掉进锅里；引申：倒霉、惹上大麻烦、完蛋了
english_meaning: Literally 'the kitchen god fell into the wok' — figuratively, to be in big trouble; to be doomed or screwed
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語俚語 / 動詞片語（或感嘆語）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (colloquial slang) / verb phrase or exclamation
explanation_mandarin: 此為廣東話俗語，字面描述灶君（家中灶神）掉進鑊裡。常用來比喻某人遇上大麻煩、倒霉或完蛋了，語氣可帶驚訝或同情。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally describing the kitchen god falling into the wok. It is used figuratively to say someone is in deep trouble, doomed, or extremely unlucky; tone can be surprised, sympathetic, or exasperated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷嘢俾人捉到，宜家真係灶君跌落鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 je5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 zou6 gwan1 dit3 lok6 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷东西被人抓到，現在真是倒霉透顶／完蛋了。
examples.english_sentence: He got caught stealing; now he's really in deep trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 灶台的底座；炉灶的基座或基礎
english_meaning: the base or foundation of a stove/kitchen hearth
explanation_mandarin: 指廚房或爐灶下方的結構性基座或基礎，用於支撐灶台或爐具，有時也指傳統灶爐所在的地基位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the structural base or foundation beneath a stove or hearth in the kitchen, used to support the stove or cooking apparatus; can also mean the ground/foundation where a traditional stove sits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房嘅灶基裂開，師傅話要整返個新的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 ge3 zou6 gei1 lit6 hoi1, si1 fu1 waa6 jiu3 zing2 faan1 go3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房的灶基裂开了，师傅说要修一个新的。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen's stove base cracked; the technician said it needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 厨房 (chúfáng)
english_meaning: kitchen; hearth; the place for cooking
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指做飯、煮食的地方，即廚房或灶間，帶有生活化、俗稱的語感。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for the kitchen or hearth—the place where cooking is done; informal and commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我喺灶窟煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 hai2 zou6 kut3 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我在厨房煮饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'll cook in the kitchen tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日喺灶窟度整嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 hai2 zou6 kut3 dou6 zing2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常在厨房里做东西吃。
examples.english_sentence: Mom often makes food in the kitchen.

mandarin_meaning: 家庭中负责做饭的人（口语），相当于闽南语的“灶脚”，多指主妇或在家煮饭的人。
english_meaning: The person who cooks for the household (colloquial); akin to 'home cook' or 'housewife'.
explanation_mandarin: 「灶蝦」為粵語口語詞，受閩南語「灶腳」影響，用來指在家裡負責煮食的人，通常帶有親暱或俗稱色彩，為地區性用語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term (influenced by Hokkien '灶腳') referring to the household member who cooks—commonly the housewife or home cook. Informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽一直係屋企嘅灶蝦，午飯晚飯都係佢整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 jat1 zik6 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 zou6haa1, ng5faan6 maan5faan6 dou1 hai6 keoi5 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我媽媽一直是家裡負責做飯的人，午飯和晚飯都是她做。
examples.english_sentence: My mother has always been the household cook; she makes lunch and dinner.

mandarin_meaning: 灶台；炉灶；厨房用来做饭的地方
english_meaning: stove; kitchen stove; cooking hearth
explanation_mandarin: 指用于烹饪的炉灶或灶台，泛指厨房里做饭的地方或火口。
explanation_english: Refers to the stove or hearth used for cooking—the stove top or cooking area in a kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企個灶頭壞咗，要換新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 go3 zou6 tau4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家的灶台坏了，要换新的。
examples.english_sentence: The stove in our home is broken and needs to be replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺灶頭度整飯，香味出晒嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 zou6 tau4 dou6 zing2 faan6, hoeng1 mei6 ceot1 saai3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈在灶台做饭，香味都飘出来了。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is cooking at the stove; the aroma is wafting out.

mandarin_meaning: 灸（jiǔ）——中醫的灸療方法；用艾草等熏燒或加熱穴位、患處以治療
english_meaning: Moxibustion; to apply heat/cauterization (by burning moxa) to acupoints or affected areas for therapeutic purposes
explanation_mandarin: 灸是傳統中醫療法，通常用燃燒的艾草（或其他藥物）在穴位或病灶處熏烤、灼熱以達到祛寒、通經或止痛等療效。可作名詞（艾灸）或動詞（灸穴）。
explanation_english: Moxibustion is a traditional Chinese medicine therapy that uses burning moxa (mugwort) or other materials to apply heat to acupoints or affected areas, aiming to dispel cold, promote circulation, or relieve pain. It functions as both a noun (moxibustion) and a verb (to moxa).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日去做艾灸，話對腰骨好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 heoi3 zou6 ngoi6 gau3, waa6 deoi3 jiu1 gwat1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常去做艾灸，说对腰骨好。
examples.english_sentence: My mom often gets moxibustion; she says it's good for her lower back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生用艾灸幫我治背痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jung6 ngoi6 gau3 bong1 ngo5 zi6 bui3 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生用艾灸帮我治背痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor used moxibustion to help treat my back pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 艾灸有啲熱，同埋有股艾草味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngoi6 gau3 jau5 di1 jit6, tung4 maai4 jau5 gu2 ngoi6 cou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 艾灸有点热，而且有艾草味。
examples.english_sentence: Moxibustion is a bit hot and has the smell of mugwort.

mandarin_meaning: （动）灼、烫、烧；（形）灼热；（书面）见解深刻（如“灼见”）
english_meaning: to burn/scorch/scald; (adj.) scorching, burning hot; (literary) clear/insightful (as in '灼見')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞（書面亦可作名詞性用法如“灼見”）
explanation_mandarin: 表示用火或熱使物體受灼、燒或燙傷，也可形容非常熱（灼熱）；在書面語中可用於表示見解明確、深刻（如“灼見”）。
explanation_english: Denotes burning, scorching, or scalding by heat; can describe intense heat (scorching). In literary usage it can refer to clear or incisive insight (e.g. '灼見').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心畀熱水灼親隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 bei2 jit6 seoi2 zoek3 can1 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心被热水烫伤了手。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally scalded my hand with hot water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天個天氣好灼熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 go3 tin1 hei3 hou2 zoek3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天的天气非常灼热。
examples.english_sentence: The summer weather is very scorching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提出咗啲好有灼見嘅意見，幫咗我好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 di1 hou2 jau5 zoek3 gin3 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出了一些很有见解的意见，帮了我很多。
examples.english_sentence: He offered some very insightful opinions that helped me a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 贬低；羞辱（口語）
english_meaning: to put someone down; to belittle or humiliate (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示當眾或以言語貶低、挖苦或羞辱他人，使對方難堪。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to belittle, mock, or humiliate someone (often publicly), putting them down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人面前灼低人，難怪冇乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 min6 cin2 zoek3 dai1 jan4, naan4 gwaai3 mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在别人面前贬低人，难怪没什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts others down in front of people; no wonder he has few friends.

mandarin_meaning: 灼伤；烫伤、烧伤
english_meaning: to burn; burn injury; to scald
explanation_mandarin: 指皮肤或组织因高温、化学物质、电流或辐射等原因受损，出现红肿、水疱或坏死，也可指造成这种伤害的行为。
explanation_english: An injury to the skin or tissue caused by heat, chemicals, electricity, or radiation; to burn or scald, or the act of causing such an injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心，熱水會灼傷你嘅皮膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1, jit6 seoi2 wui5 zoek3 soeng1 nei5 ge3 pei4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心，热水会灼伤你的皮肤。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, hot water can burn your skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為炒菜時不小心被熱油灼傷咗隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 caau2 coi3 si4 bat1 siu2 sam1 bei6 jit6 jau4 zoek3 soeng1 zo2 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为炒菜时不小心被热油灼伤了手。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally burned his hand with hot oil while cooking.

mandarin_meaning: 灼热（形容非常热或有灼痛感）
english_meaning: scorching; burning hot; burning sensation
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述極度的熱或像被燒灼般的灼痛感，可用於天氣、物體溫度或身體部位的感覺。
explanation_english: Describes extreme heat or a burning sensation, like being scalded; can refer to weather, the temperature of an object, or a burning feeling in the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天嘅太陽好灼熱，出街要戴帽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 ge3 taai3 joeng4 hou2 zoek3jit6, ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 daai3 mou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天的太阳很灼热，出门要戴帽子。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is scorching in summer; wear a hat when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗啲辣湯，口腔覺得灼熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 zo2 di1 laat6 tong1, hau2 hong1 gok3dak1 zoek3jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了些辣汤，口腔觉得灼热。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking the spicy soup, my mouth feels burning hot.

mandarin_meaning: 灼烧 (zhuóshāo)：烧灼、灼热或烫伤，也可指产生强烈的灼热感或用以电灼、烧灼等医疗处理。
english_meaning: to burn; to scorch; to cauterize; a burning/scorching sensation
explanation_mandarin: 指用火、熱、化學或電等使組織受燒灼、產生灼痛感，或指感覺到類似燒灼的強烈熱感。醫學上亦指用燒灼法處理病變組織（如電灼）。
explanation_english: Refers to causing tissue to be burned or scorched by fire, heat, chemicals, or electricity, or to experiencing a strong burning sensation. In medical contexts, it can mean cauterizing tissue (e.g., electrocautery).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我手背被熱水灼燒咗，好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau2 bui3 bei6 jit6 seoi2 zoek3 siu1 zo2, hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我手背被热水灼烧了，很痛。
examples.english_sentence: My hand was scalded by hot water; it hurts a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽曬到我，皮膚有灼燒感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 saai3 dou3 ngo5, pei4 fu1 jau5 zoek3 siu1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳晒到我，皮肤有灼烧感。
examples.english_sentence: The sun hit me and my skin feels a burning sensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生用電灼燒去除疣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jung6 din6 zoek3 siu1 heoi3 ceoi4 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生用电灼烧去除疣。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor used electrocautery to remove the wart.

mandarin_meaning: 灼痛（灼熱、刺痛的感覺）
english_meaning: burning pain; stinging/burning sensation
explanation_mandarin: 指像被燙傷或接觸刺激性物質時，產生的灼熱、刺痛的感覺或疼痛。
explanation_english: Refers to a burning or stinging sensation or pain, such as from scalding or contact with an irritant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畀熱水潑到，隻手好灼痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 jit6 seoi2 put3 dou3, zek3 sau2 hou2 zoek3 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被熱水潑到，手很灼痛。
examples.english_sentence: I got splashed with hot water; my hand is burning/stinging a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 灾；灾害；灾难
english_meaning: disaster; calamity; misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 指造成破壞或損失的不幸事件或狀況，常見於複合詞如「天災」「水災」「災難」。
explanation_english: Refers to an event or situation causing destruction, loss, or misfortune; commonly appears in compounds such as 'natural disaster' (天災) or 'flood' (水災).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 水災嚟咗，成條街都淹咗水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi2 zoi1 lai4 zo2, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 jim1 zo2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水灾来了，整條街都淹水了。
examples.english_sentence: A flood has come; the whole street is flooded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近真係麻煩，遇到好多災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4, jyu6 dou3 hou2 do1 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近真的很倒霉，遇到很多灾难。
examples.english_sentence: He's been having a lot of misfortune lately, encountering many disasters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果發生天災，政府會派救援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 faat3 sang1 tin1 zoi1, zing3 fu2 wui5 paai3 gau3 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果发生天灾，政府会派救援。
examples.english_sentence: If a natural disaster occurs, the government will send rescue teams.

mandarin_meaning: 灾劫（大災難、劫難）
english_meaning: calamity; disaster; catastrophe
explanation_mandarin: 指大規模或嚴重的災難、劫難，常用來形容造成重大損失或苦難的事件。
explanation_english: Refers to a large-scale or severe disaster or calamity, often used to describe events that cause great loss or suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰場風災真係一場大災劫，屋企同農作物都遭殃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 coeng4 fung1 zoi1 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 daai6 zoi1 gip3, uk1 kei5 tung4 nung4 zok3 mat6 dou1 zou1 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那場風災真是一場大災難，房屋和農作物都遭殃。
examples.english_sentence: That storm was truly a major disaster; houses and crops were all damaged.

mandarin_meaning: 灾区
english_meaning: disaster area; disaster zone
explanation_mandarin: 指因天災、人禍或其他事故而受到嚴重破壞、需要救援與重建的地區。
explanation_english: An area that has been severely damaged by natural disasters, accidents, or other incidents and requires relief and reconstruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風過後，成個地區變成災區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 gwo3 hau6, seng4 go3 dei6 keoi1 bin3 sing4 zoi1 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风过后，整个地区变成灾区。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, the whole area became a disaster area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 災區最需要糧食同清水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoi1 keoi1 zeoi3 seoi1 jiu3 loeng4 sik6 tung4 cing1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灾区最需要粮食和清水。
examples.english_sentence: Disaster areas need food and clean water most.

mandarin_meaning: 災難；禍害
english_meaning: disaster; calamity; misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 指由天災或人禍造成的重大災害或不幸，語氣較正式或書面。
explanation_english: Refers to major disasters or misfortunes caused by natural or human factors; often used in formal or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場風暴帶嚟好大嘅災厄，成個村莊都受唔少損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 fung1 bou6 daai3 lai4 hou2 daai6 ge3 zoi1 ngok6, sing4 go3 cyun1 zong1 dou1 sau6 m4 siu2 syun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場風暴帶來了重大的災厄，整個村莊都遭受不少損失。
examples.english_sentence: This storm brought great calamity; the whole village suffered considerable damage.

mandarin_meaning: 灾害
english_meaning: disaster; calamity; catastrophe
explanation_mandarin: 指由自然或人為因素引起，對人員、財產或環境造成破壞或損失的重大事件，例如地震、洪水或工業事故等。
explanation_english: Refers to a serious event caused by natural or human factors that brings damage or loss to people, property, or the environment (e.g., earthquakes, floods, industrial accidents).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次颱風引致咗嚴重嘅災害，全條街都畀洪水淹沒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 toi4 fung1 jan5 zi3 zo2 jim4 zung6 ge3 zoi1 hoi6, cyun4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 bei2 hung4 seoi2 jim1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次台风引致了严重的灾害，整条街都被洪水淹没。
examples.english_sentence: This typhoon caused severe disaster; the whole street was flooded.

mandarin_meaning: 災害的情況或損失（如災區的受災狀況）
english_meaning: the situation or extent of damage caused by a disaster; disaster situation
explanation_mandarin: 指自然災害或意外事故發生後的情況與損失程度，包括人員傷亡、財產損失與基礎設施破壞等。
explanation_english: Refers to the condition and extent of damage after a disaster or accident, including casualties, property loss, and damage to infrastructure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要盡快評估災情，安排救援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 ping4 gu1 zoi1 cing4, on1 paai4 gau3 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要盡快評估災情，安排救援。
examples.english_sentence: The government must quickly assess the disaster situation and arrange rescue efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風之後，山區有嚴重嘅災情，好多房屋都塌咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 zi1 hau6, saan1 keoi1 jau5 jim4 zung6 ge3 zoi1 cing4, hou2 do1 fong4 uk1 dou1 taap3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風之後，山區有嚴重的災情，很多房屋都倒塌了。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, there was severe disaster damage in the mountain areas; many houses collapsed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民如發現災情請致電熱線報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 jyu4 faat3 jin6 zoi1 cing4 ceng2 zi3 din6 jit6 sin3 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民如發現災情請致電熱線報告。
examples.english_sentence: If citizens discover any disaster damage, please call the hotline to report it.

mandarin_meaning: 祸星降世；带来灾祸的人或不祥的预兆
english_meaning: a bringer of disaster; a jinx or person/thing that seems to cause misfortune wherever it goes
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容會帶來災禍或不幸的人或事物，帶有誇張和貶義，常用於口語或文學性描述。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that brings misfortune or bad luck; a figurative, often derogatory idiom implying someone is a walking disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日行到邊都出事，簡直係災星托世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haang4 dou3 bin1 dou1 ceot1 si6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 zoi1 sing1 tok3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到哪兒都出事，簡直就是祸星托世。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to cause misfortune wherever he goes — he's practically a walking disaster.

mandarin_meaning: 災民 / 受災者
english_meaning: disaster victim(s); people affected by a disaster
explanation_mandarin: 在自然災害或意外事故中遭受損失或受影響，需要救助、安置或援助的民眾。
explanation_english: People who have suffered loss or been affected by a disaster (natural or man-made) and often require relief, shelter, or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風之後，政府設立臨時收容中心，幫助無家可歸嘅災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 zi1 hau6, zing3 fu2 cit3 lap6 lam4 si4 sau1 jung4 zung1 sam1, bong1 zo6 mou4 gaa1 ho2 gwai1 ge3 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風過後，政府設立臨時收容中心，幫助無家可歸的災民。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, the government set up temporary shelters to help disaster victims who had lost their homes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救援隊為災民分發糧食同乾淨飲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 wun6 tyun4 deoi2 wai6 zoi1 man4 fan1 faat3 loeng4 sik6 tung4 gon1 zeng6 jam2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救援隊為災民分發糧食和乾淨飲用水。
examples.english_sentence: Relief teams distributed food and clean drinking water to the disaster victims.

mandarin_meaning: 災難與瘟疫；（粵語俚語）用作罵人或形容某人或某事可惡、倒霉或討厭
english_meaning: Disaster and plague; in Cantonese slang, an insulting term used to call someone or something cursed, unlucky, or detestable
explanation_mandarin: 原指天災或瘟疫。粵語口語中常作粗口或詛咒用，既可指災難，也可用來辱罵某人，表示對其極度厭惡或認為其帶來不幸。
explanation_english: Originally refers to disasters and epidemics. In Cantonese colloquial speech it is often used as a coarse curse or insult; it can denote catastrophe or be used to denounce a person as detestable, unlucky, or bringing misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條災瘟，成日都唔守時！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 zoi1 wan1, sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 sau2 si4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这灾瘟，老是都不守时！
examples.english_sentence: You damn (lit. 'disaster-plague'), you're always late!

mandarin_meaning: 災禍（zāihuò）：指災難、災害或不幸的事件
english_meaning: calamity; disaster; misfortune
explanation_mandarin: 指由自然或人為原因造成的重大災害或不幸，帶來損失和苦難，例如颱風、地震、戰亂等造成的後果。
explanation_english: Refers to a major disaster or misfortune caused by natural or human factors, bringing loss and suffering—for example, effects caused by typhoons, earthquakes, or wars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場颱風帶嚟好大嘅災禍，成個社區都受咗嚴重嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 toi4fung1 daai3 lai4 hou2 daai6 ge3 zoi1 wo6, sing4 go3 se5 keoi1 dou1 sau6 zo2 jim4 zung6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場颱風帶來了巨大的災禍，整個社區都受到了嚴重的影響。
examples.english_sentence: This typhoon brought great calamity; the whole community was severely affected.

mandarin_meaning: 災荒（指導致糧食減產或斷供的災害或饑荒）
english_meaning: famine; disaster-caused crop failure leading to widespread food shortage
explanation_mandarin: 指由天災、蟲害、戰亂等原因造成農作物歉收或糧食短缺的災難，即饑荒、糧荒。
explanation_english: Refers to a calamity (often drought, flood, pests, or war) that destroys crops and causes widespread food shortages — essentially a famine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次大旱造成咗嚴重嘅災荒，好多村民冇得食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 daai6 hon3 zou6 sing4 zo2 jim4 zung6 ge3 zoi1 fong1, hou2 do1 cyun1 man4 mou5 dak1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次大旱造成了嚴重的災荒，很多村民沒有東西吃。
examples.english_sentence: That severe drought caused a serious famine; many villagers had nothing to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要實施緊急救濟，避免災荒擴大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 sat6 si1 gan2 gap1 gau3 zai3, bei6 min5 zoi1 fong1 kwaa3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要實施緊急救濟，避免災荒擴大。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to carry out emergency relief to prevent the famine from spreading.

mandarin_meaning: 災難（zāinàn）
english_meaning: disaster; calamity; catastrophe
explanation_mandarin: 指由自然或人為原因造成的嚴重損害或不幸事件，例如地震、風暴或重大事故等。
explanation_english: Refers to a severe harmful or unfortunate event caused by natural or human factors, such as earthquakes, storms, or major accidents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場地震造成好大災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 dei6 zan3 zou6 sing4 hou2 daai6 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場地震造成了很大的災難。
examples.english_sentence: This earthquake caused a great disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要幫助災難中嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 zo6 zoi1 naan6 zung1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們要幫助災難中的人。
examples.english_sentence: They need to help people affected by the disaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次風暴真係變成一場災難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 fung1 bou6 zan1 hai6 bin3 sing4 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次風暴真的是一場災難。
examples.english_sentence: This storm really became a disaster.

mandarin_meaning: 灾难级（达到灾难般的程度）
english_meaning: disaster-level; catastrophic (used colloquially to indicate something extremely bad)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示某事物或情況糟糕、嚴重到像災難一樣的程度，常作誇張性的描述。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression meaning something is so bad or severe it is like a disaster; often used hyperbolically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次颱風嘅破壞力真係災難級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 toi4 fung1 ge3 po3 waai6 lik6 zan1 hai6 zoi1 naan4 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次台风的破坏力真是灾难级别。
examples.english_sentence: The destructive power of this typhoon is truly disaster-level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個廚藝災難級，唔好畀佢整飯俾你食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ceoi4 ngai6 zoi1 naan4 kap1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 zing2 faan6 bei2 nei5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的厨艺是灾难级，别让他做饭给你吃。
examples.english_sentence: His cooking is disaster-level; don't let him cook for you.

mandarin_meaning: 气（炁）：呼吸、空气、生命能量，在道家和中医中指“气”
english_meaning: Qi (vital energy, breath, air) — the life force or vital energy in Daoist and traditional Chinese medicine contexts
explanation_mandarin: 「炁」為「氣」的古字或異體字，常見於道家、內丹與中醫文獻，指生命的能量、呼吸或氣場。現代書寫多用「氣」。
explanation_english: The character 炁 is an archaic/variant form of 氣 (qi). It appears in Daoist, alchemical, and traditional Chinese medicine texts to denote breath, air, or vital energy. In modern usage the standard form 氣/气 is more common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師父教我點樣調理身體嘅炁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 tiu4 lei5 san1 tai2 ge3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师父教我怎样调理身体的炁。
examples.english_sentence: The master taught me how to regulate the body's qi.

mandarin_meaning: 焖 / 燜（mèn）——用小火慢煮、炖使入味、变软
english_meaning: to simmer; to braise; to stew slowly until tender and flavorful
explanation_mandarin: 「炆」是粤语常用的烹饪用字，指用文火慢煮或炖，使食物入味且变软，与普通话的“焖/燜”意义相同。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 炆 refers to cooking food slowly over low heat (simmering/braising) so it becomes tender and absorbs flavors. Equivalent to Mandarin 焖.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我炆咗個牛腩，要唔要嚟試下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 man4 zo2 go3 ngau4 naam5, jiu3 m4 jiu3 lai4 si3 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我焖了牛腩，要不要来尝一尝？
examples.english_sentence: I braised beef brisket tonight — do you want to try some?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲雞要炆耐啲先會入味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gai1 jiu3 man4 noi6 di1 sin1 wui5 jap6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些鸡要焖久一点才会入味。
examples.english_sentence: These chickens need to be simmered longer to absorb the flavor.

mandarin_meaning: 用火煮食、做饭（chuī）
english_meaning: to cook (food) by fire; especially to cook rice
explanation_mandarin: 表示用火烹煮食物，尤指煮飯。古漢語中亦有吹的含義，但現代常用作“煮飯、做飯”。
explanation_english: Means to cook food using fire, especially to cook rice. In classical usage it could also mean to blow, but modern usage is primarily 'to cook'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺廚房炊緊飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 cyu4 fong4 ceoi1 gan2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈在厨房做饭。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

mandarin_meaning: 炊具／厨具（用於烹飪、煮食的器具）
english_meaning: cooking utensils; cookware (pots, pans, and other kitchen implements used for cooking)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於烹飪或煮食的各種器具，例如鍋、鑊、蒸鍋、平底鍋等，屬於廚房用具範疇。
explanation_english: Refers to tools and implements used for cooking, such as pots, woks, steamers, and frying pans; a category of kitchenware.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗啲炊具，平底鑊同蒸鍋都唔見咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 di1 ceoi1 geoi6, ping4 dai2 wok6 tung4 zing1 wo1 dou1 m4 gin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我丟失了一些炊具，平底鍋和蒸鍋都不見了。
examples.english_sentence: I lost some cooking utensils; the frying pan and the steamer are missing.

mandarin_meaning: 炎（yán）：炎熱、灼熱；醫學上指炎症、發炎
english_meaning: flame; heat; inflammation (medical)
explanation_mandarin: 表示熱、炙熱的狀態；在醫學語境中指炎症或發炎。常見於複合詞如「發炎」「炎熱」「炎症」。
explanation_english: Denotes heat or burning; medically refers to inflammation. Commonly appears in compounds such as '發炎' (inflammation), '炎熱' (hot), and '炎症' (inflammatory condition).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個傷口發炎咗，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 soeng1 hau2 faat3 jim4 zo2, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伤口发炎了，要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: The wound is inflamed; you need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好炎熱，唔想出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 jim4 jit6, m4 soeng2 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很炎热，不想出门。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot today; I don't want to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話係炎症，要食消炎藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 hai6 jim4 zing3, jiu3 sik6 siu1 jim4 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说是炎症，要吃消炎药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said it's an inflammatory condition and prescribed anti-inflammatory medicine.

mandarin_meaning: （網路用語）在網路上引發大量批評或圍攻，掀起網路風波
english_meaning: to trigger or be the target of an online backlash; to be 'flamed' or become the focus of an online controversy
explanation_mandarin: 源自日語，指在社交媒體或網路平台上因言行或事件而被大量批評、攻擊或引發輿論風波。
explanation_english: A loanword from Japanese used in online contexts to describe when someone or something provokes mass criticism or is attacked on social media, causing an online uproar or flame war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位藝人因為啲唔小心嘅言論喺社交媒體度炎上，宜家要公開道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 ngai6 jan4 jan1 wai6 di1 m4 siu2 sam1 ge3 jin4 leon6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 dou6 jim4 soeng5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gung1 hoi1 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位藝人因為不慎的言論在社交媒體上引發網路公憤，現在要公開道歉。
examples.english_sentence: That celebrity triggered an online backlash on social media because of careless remarks and now has to apologize publicly.

mandarin_meaning: 炎热的夏季；酷热的夏天
english_meaning: scorching summer; extremely hot summer
explanation_mandarin: 指非常炎热的夏季，常用来形容高温、闷热的天气状况。
explanation_english: Refers to an extremely hot summer, emphasizing high temperatures and sultry weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 炎夏要多飲水，小心中暑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jim4 haa6 jiu3 do1 jam2 seoi2, siu2 sam1 zung1 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炎热的夏天要多喝水，小心中暑。
examples.english_sentence: During the scorching summer, drink more water and beware of heatstroke.

mandarin_meaning: 炎热（yánrè）
english_meaning: scorching; very hot; sweltering
explanation_mandarin: 形容天氣或環境非常熱、燥熱，常用來描述炎夏或酷熱的日子。
explanation_english: Describes weather or conditions that are very hot and scorching, often used for hot summer days or sweltering heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好炎熱，出街記得補充水分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 jim4 jit6, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 bou2 cung1 seoi2 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很炎热，出门记得补充水分。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot today; remember to drink enough water when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 炎症（yánzhèng）：組織對感染、刺激或損傷產生的發炎反應
english_meaning: inflammation: the body's localized response to infection, injury, or irritation, typically causing redness, swelling, heat and pain
explanation_mandarin: 炎症是指身體組織因感染、外傷或其他刺激而產生的一種防禦性反應，常表現為紅、腫、熱、痛，有時伴有功能障礙。
explanation_english: Inflammation is a protective response by the body's tissues to infection, injury, or irritation, typically characterized by redness, swelling, heat, pain, and sometimes loss of function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙齦有炎症，要睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ngai6 jau5 jim4 zing3, jiu3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙龈有炎症，要看牙医。
examples.english_sentence: My gums are inflamed; I need to see a dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅喉嚨有炎症，聲音沙啞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hau4 lung4 jau5 jim4 zing3, seng1 jam1 saa1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的喉咙有炎症，声音沙哑。
examples.english_sentence: He has inflammation in his throat and his voice is hoarse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果傷口紅腫同埋痛，可能係炎症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 soeng1 hau2 hung4 zung2 tung4 maai4 tung3, ho2 nang4 hai6 jim4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果伤口红肿并且疼，可能是炎症。
examples.english_sentence: If a wound is red, swollen and painful, it may be inflammation.

mandarin_meaning: 炎黄子孙：指炎帝与黄帝的后代，泛指中华民族的后裔或中国人。
english_meaning: Descendants of Yan and Huang; metaphorically, the Chinese people or those of Chinese descent.
explanation_mandarin: “炎黃子孫”源自傳說中的炎帝與黃帝，常用來指稱中華民族的後代或泛指中國人，帶有民族身份與文化傳承的含義。
explanation_english: The phrase refers to the legendary descendants of the Yan and Yellow Emperors; it is commonly used to denote the Chinese people and carries connotations of ethnic identity and cultural heritage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自豪咁講自己係炎黃子孫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 hou4 gam2 gong2 zi6 gei2 hai6 jim4 wong4 zi2 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自豪地说自己是炎黄子孙。
examples.english_sentence: He proudly said that he is a descendant of Yan and Huang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為炎黃子孫，我哋要保存同傳承中華文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai6 jim4 wong4 zi2 syun1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bou2 cyun4 tung4 cyun4 sing4 zung1 waa4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为炎黄子孙，我们要保存并传承中华文化。
examples.english_sentence: As descendants of Yan and Huang, we should preserve and pass on Chinese culture.

mandarin_meaning: 炒 (chǎo) — 用油煎、炒食物；引申為解僱、投機炒作等
english_meaning: to stir-fry (food); extended meanings: to fire/dismiss, to speculate/hype (e.g., stocks or property)
explanation_mandarin: 「炒」本義指用鍋和油快速烹調食物；在口語中亦可引申為「炒魷魚」（被解僱）或「炒股／炒樓」（投機買賣、炒作）。
explanation_english: Originally means to stir-fry food in oil. Colloquially it can also mean to be fired ('炒魷魚') or to speculate/hype (e.g., '炒股' for stock speculation, '炒樓' for property speculation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我整炒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zing2 caau2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我做炒饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'll make fried rice tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲到畀老闆炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ci4 dou3 bei2 lou5 baan2 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為迟到被老板炒了。
examples.english_sentence: He was fired by his boss for being late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家樓市咁熱，大家都喺度炒樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lau4 si5 gam2 jit6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai2 dou6 caau2 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在楼市这么热，大家都在炒楼。
examples.english_sentence: The property market is so hot now, everyone is speculating on properties.

mandarin_meaning: 炒方便麵（尤指「一丁」牌的即食麵）
english_meaning: to stir-fry instant noodles (especially the 'Yat Ding' brand); to cook instant noodles by stir-frying
explanation_mandarin: 「炒一丁」原指把即食麵（常指『一丁』牌）用鍋炒，加入蛋、蔬菜或調味料等。此詞在香港日常用語中常用來表示用方便麵快速解決一餐。
explanation_english: Literally 'stir-fry (Yat Ding)', referring to frying instant noodles (often the 'Yat Ding' brand) with ingredients like egg, vegetables, or seasonings. In Hong Kong Cantonese it commonly means to quickly make a meal using instant noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇餸，就炒一丁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 sung3, zau6 caau2 jat1 ding1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚沒菜，就炒一包方便麵吧。
examples.english_sentence: No dishes tonight, let's stir-fry a packet of instant noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜深返到屋企，冇心機整嘢，就隨手炒一丁食住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 sam1 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5, mou5 sam1 gei1 zing2 je5, zau6 ceoi4 sau2 caau2 jat1 ding1 sik6 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 深夜回到家沒心情做菜，就順手炒一包方便麵先充飢。
examples.english_sentence: Arriving home late and not in the mood to cook, I quickly stir-fried a packet of instant noodles to tide me over.

mandarin_meaning: 一次性把所有人或事情全部處理/解決（類似「一鍋端」）
english_meaning: to deal with everything/all people in one go; to settle everything at once
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面是「把東西在一鑊裡炒熟」，引申為一次過把多件事或所有人/問題全部處理、收拾或罰清。通常用於把事情一口氣解決或一次掃蕩完畢的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "to fry everything in one pan." Figuratively it means to handle or settle all matters or people in one go — to wrap everything up at once or sweep everything away in a single action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢唔好分開處理，不如一次過炒一鑊熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 m4 hou2 fan1 hoi1 cyu2 lei5, bat1 jyu4 jat1 ci3 gwo3 caau2 jat1 wok6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些事不要分開處理，不如一次性全部解決。
examples.english_sentence: Don't handle these matters separately; better to settle them all at once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府今次一次過清理晒啲非法建築，真係炒一鑊熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gam1 ci3 jat1 ci3 gwo3 cing1 lei5 saai3 di1 fei1 faat3 gin3 zuk1, zan1 hai6 caau2 jat1 wok6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府這次一次性清理了所有非法建築，真是一鍋端（一次把所有問題處理掉）。
examples.english_sentence: The government cleared all illegal structures in one go — it really was a one-shot clean-up.

mandarin_meaning: 炒作
english_meaning: to hype; to sensationalize; to manipulate (e.g. market or publicity)
explanation_mandarin: 指媒體或個別人士透過誇大、渲染或集中報道某事，以引起公眾注意、製造話題或牟利；在經濟/股市語境下，也可指刻意推高價格或人氣以獲利。
explanation_english: To deliberately hype or sensationalize something—often by media or individuals—by exaggerating or overemphasizing it to attract public attention, create buzz, or profit; in economic/market contexts, it can mean artificially inflating prices or popularity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳媒成日炒作佢啲緋聞，令佢好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4mui4 sing4jat6 caau2zok3 keoi5 di1 fei1man4, ling6 keoi5 hou2 san1fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒體經常炒作他的緋聞，讓他很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: The media keeps hyping his gossip, which makes things hard for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲人喺市場上炒作股票，最後散戶蝕大錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jan4 hai6 si5coeng4 soeng5 caau2zok3 gu2piu3, zeoi3hau6 saan3wu6 sik1 daai6cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人在市場上炒作股票，最後散戶虧了大錢。
examples.english_sentence: Those people were pumping the stocks in the market; retail investors ended up losing a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 哄抬價格；抬高價格（常指人为炒作推高股票、樓市或商品價格）
english_meaning: to drive up or speculate on prices; to artificially raise prices (often by speculation or manipulation, e.g., in stocks, property, or goods)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示通過炒作或操控使價格上漲，常用於股票、樓市、商品等情況，也可指哄抬物價的行為。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term meaning to push prices up through speculation or manipulation. Commonly used for stocks, the property market, or goods; can imply price gouging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲地產商成日炒價，樓市愈嚟愈貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dei6 caan2 soeng1 sing4 jat6 caau2 gaa3, lau4 si5 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房地產商經常哄抬房價，樓市越來越貴。
examples.english_sentence: Developers often drive up property prices; the housing market is getting more and more expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋炒價買股票，想賺快錢，結果蝕大本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 caau2 gaa3 maai5 gu2 piu3, soeng2 zaan6 faai3 cin2, git3 gwo2 sik1 daai6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們炒高股價買股票，想賺快錢，結果賠了大本。
examples.english_sentence: They drove up stock prices to buy shares hoping to make quick money, but ended up losing most of their capital.

mandarin_meaning: 炒冷饭（比喻重复旧闻、旧事或把旧内容重新拿出来谈，缺乏新意）
english_meaning: to rehash; to recycle old material or ideas; to repeat something without originality
explanation_mandarin: 原指把冷饭拿去炒，现比喻把旧事、旧内容重新翻出来谈论或重复使用，通常含贬义，表示没有新意或创新。
explanation_english: Literally 'frying cold rice'; figuratively to rehash or recycle old topics, stories, or material. Usually pejorative—implies lack of originality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部劇成日都係炒冷飯，冇新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 kek6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 caau2 laang5 faan6, mou5 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧老是炒冷饭，没有新意。
examples.english_sentence: This show keeps rehashing old plots; there's nothing new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家出新碟，其實係炒冷飯，全都係舊歌重錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ceot1 san1 dip6, kei4 sat6 hai6 caau2 laang5 faan6, cyun4 dou1 hai6 gau6 go1 cung4 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在出新专辑，实际上是在炒冷饭，全都是旧歌重录。
examples.english_sentence: He's releasing a new album, but it's just rehashing old songs—it's all re-recorded old tracks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再炒冷飯啦，我想聽新意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 caau2 laang5 faan6 laa1, ngo5 soeng2 teng1 san1 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再炒冷饭了，我想听新的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rehash old ideas anymore; I want to hear new suggestions.

mandarin_meaning: （香港粵語俚語）曾經是朋友但後來不再來往或關係破裂的朋友（類似「前朋友」）
english_meaning: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term for someone who used to be a friend but is no longer on friendly terms or in contact — essentially an "ex-friend."
explanation_mandarin: 「炒友」為香港粵語俚語，用來形容曾經和自己關係密切但因故疏遠、鬧翻或不再往來的人。語感偏口語，常帶有關係結束的含義。
explanation_english: "炒友" is Hong Kong Cantonese slang referring to someone who was once a friend but, due to a falling-out or other reasons, no longer keeps in touch or maintains a friendly relationship. It is informal and implies the relationship has ended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以前好夾，但嗰次生意失敗之後，佢就變咗我嘅炒友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 hou2 gaap3, daan6 go2 ci3 saang1 ji3 sat1 baai6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 bin3 zo2 ngo5 ge3 caau2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以前很合得来，但那次生意失败之后，他就变成了我的「炒友」（不再来往的朋友）。
examples.english_sentence: We used to get along, but after that business failure he became my 'chàoyǒu' — a friend I no longer keep in touch with.

mandarin_meaning: 炒作；製造話題或挑起事端
english_meaning: to hype up; to sensationalize; to stir up trouble or create a buzz
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指透過言論或行為誇大、製造話題或挑起爭端以吸引注意或達到某種目的。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to create hype, sensationalize, or stir up controversy/trouble—often to attract attention or provoke a reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺媒體度炒嘢，成日想上頭條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mui4tai2 dou6 caau2 je5, sing4 jat6 soeng5 tau4 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在媒體上炒作，總是想上頭條。
examples.english_sentence: He is hyping things up in the media, always trying to make the headlines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂炒嘢，搞到大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 caau2 je5, gaau2 dou3 daai6gaa1 m4 hoi1sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要亂炒事情，弄得大家不開心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stir up trouble; you'll make everyone unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話冇嘢，但其實係炒嘢，想吸引人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 mou5 je5, daan6 kei4sat6 hai6 caau2 je5, soeng2 kap1jan5 jan4 zyu3ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說沒事，但其實是在炒作，想吸引人注意。
examples.english_sentence: He says it's nothing, but actually he's hyping things up to attract attention.

mandarin_meaning: 把各種東西/關係混在一起，弄得一團糟或模糊不清
english_meaning: to mix everything together (often causing a mess); to lump things together or tangle matters so distinctions are lost
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，字面是「炒到埋一碟」，比喻把不同的人、事或問題混在一起，造成混亂或難以分清楚。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally 'stir-fry into one plate'. Figuratively it means to mix or lump different people/things/issues together, resulting in confusion or a mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好將私事同工作炒埋一碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoeng1 si1 si6 tung4 gung1 zok3 caau2 maai4 jat1 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要把私事和工作混在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mix your personal matters with your work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成件事被佢哋炒埋一碟，乜都講唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 gin6 si6 bei6 keoi5 dei6 caau2 maai4 jat1 dip6, mat1 dou1 gong2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整件事情被他們弄得一團糟，什麼都說不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The whole matter was muddled together by them, and nothing can be clearly explained.

mandarin_meaning: 惹上大麻煩 / 闖大禍
english_meaning: to get into big trouble; to cause a big mess/problem
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，字面為「炒大鑊」（炒大鍋），表示做錯事或處理不當，導致出現很大的問題或麻煩。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning "to fry a big wok." It means to make a big mistake or mess and end up in serious trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再亂講，會炒大鑊㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 lyun6 gong2, wui5 caau2 daai6 wok6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再亂說，會惹上大麻煩！
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense anymore—you'll get into big trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，結果炒大鑊，公司要賠錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, git3 gwo2 caau2 daai6 wok6, gung1si1 jiu3 pui4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事，結果惹上大麻煩，公司要賠錢。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up and ended up in big trouble; the company had to pay compensation.

mandarin_meaning: 连做两班 / 连班（连续上两个班次）
english_meaning: work a double shift; do two consecutive shifts
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语俚语，指连续上两个班次（连做两班），通常表示工作时间较长且很累。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term meaning to work two shifts back-to-back (do consecutive shifts). It usually implies long, tiring work hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚佢叫我炒孖更，結果我做足十二個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 keoi5 giu3 ngo5 caau2 maa1 geng1, git3 gwo2 ngo5 zou6 zuk1 sap6 ji6 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚他叫我连做两班，结果我做足十二个小时。
examples.english_sentence: He asked me to work a double shift tonight; as a result I worked a full twelve hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再炒孖更，落班都攰到行唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 caau2 maa1 geng1, lok6 baan1 dou1 gui6 dou3 haang4 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再连做两班，下班后累得走不动路。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to work double shifts anymore; I'm so exhausted after work I can barely walk.

mandarin_meaning: 投機客；炒家（短線投資、炒賣以謀取利潤的人）
english_meaning: speculator; flipper — someone who engages in short-term trading or reselling (e.g., property, stocks, tickets) to make quick profits
explanation_mandarin: 指以短期買賣、炒賣為目的的投機者，常見於樓市、股市或黃牛炒票等情況，帶有負面或中性偏負面的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who speculates by buying and selling for short-term profit; commonly used for people flipping properties, trading stocks rapidly, or reselling tickets. Often carries a negative or critical connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲炒客成日喺樓市入面炒賣，搞到樓價愈升愈高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 caau2 haak3 sing4 jat6 hai2 lau4 si5 jap6 min6 caau2 maai6, gaau2 dou3 lau4 gaa3 jyu6 sing1 jyu6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些炒客經常在樓市裡炒賣，導致房價越來越高。
examples.english_sentence: Those speculators frequently flip properties in the housing market, causing prices to keep rising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係長線投資者，係一個炒客，見升就沽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 coeng4 sin3 tau4 zi1 ze2, hai6 jat1 go3 caau2 haak3, gin3 sing1 zau6 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是長期投資者，是個投機客，看到上漲就賣出。
examples.english_sentence: He's not a long-term investor; he's a speculator who sells as soon as prices rise.

mandarin_meaning: 炒家（投機者、投機客）
english_meaning: speculator (someone who trades assets like property or stocks to make quick profits)
explanation_mandarin: 指從事短線買賣或炒作股票、樓宇或其他資產，以謀取短期利潤的人，常帶貶義，在香港語境中常用來描述投機者或抬價者。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who engages in short-term trading or speculation in stocks, property, or other assets to seek quick profits. Often used pejoratively; commonly used in the Hong Kong context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家樓市咁熱，成日都有炒家入市抬價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 lau4 si5 gam2 jit6, sing4 jat6 dou1 jau5 caau2 gaa1 jap6 si5 taai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在樓市這麼火，經常有炒家入市抬高價格。
examples.english_sentence: The property market is so hot now; speculators often enter the market to push prices up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被人話係股市嘅炒家，專門短線炒賣賺快錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jan4 waa6 hai6 gu2 si5 ge3 caau2 gaa1, zyun1 mun4 dyun2 sin3 caau2 maai6 zaan6 faai3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人說是股市的炒家，專門短線買賣賺快錢。
examples.english_sentence: He is called a market speculator who specializes in short-term trades to make quick money.

mandarin_meaning: 抄底（在价格下跌时买入以等待回升）
english_meaning: to buy the dip; to try to buy at the market bottom in hopes of profiting from a rebound
explanation_mandarin: 在股票、加密貨幣或其他投資市場中，指趁價格下跌時買入，期望在價格回升時獲利。含有投機或試圖『抓底』的意味，有風險。
explanation_english: In stock, crypto, or other investment contexts, it means buying when prices have fallen, hoping to profit from a rebound. It implies speculating on the bottom and carries risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排股市咁差，你唔好咁心急去炒底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gu2 si5 gam2 caa1, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 sam1 gap1 heoi3 caau2 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近股市這麼差，不要急着去抄底。
examples.english_sentence: The market's been so bad lately — don't rush to try to buy the dip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人鍾意喺跌勢時炒底，希望等到反彈賺一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zung1 ji3 hai2 dit3 sai3 si4 caau2 dai2, hei1 mong6 dang2 dou3 faan2 daan6 zaan6 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人喜欢在下跌时抄底，希望等到反弹赚一笔。
examples.english_sentence: Some people like to buy the dip during a downtrend, hoping to make a profit when it rebounds.

mandarin_meaning: 被解雇；炒鱿鱼（俗语）
english_meaning: to be fired; to sack; (colloquially) to do temporary/casual work
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俗语，主要用来表示被公司或单位解雇（被炒散/被炒魷魚）。也可用作主动用法表示解雇别人；在口语中有时也指做临时或零散的工作。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term primarily meaning to be fired or laid off by an employer. It can be used actively (to sack someone) or passively (to be sacked). In casual speech it may also refer to doing temporary/casual work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上個月畀公司炒散咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 bei2 gung1 si1 caau2 saan3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上个月被公司炒散了。
examples.english_sentence: He was fired by the company last month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司話如果表現再差就會炒散你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 biu2 jin6 zoi3 caa1 zau6 wui5 caau2 saan3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司说如果表现再差就会把你炒鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: The company said they'd sack you if your performance doesn't improve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家冇穩定嘅全職，佢靠炒散維生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mou5 wan2 ding6 ge3 cyun4 zik1, keoi5 kaau3 caau2 saan3 wai4 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在没有稳定的全职工作，他靠做临时工作维持生计。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have a steady full-time job right now; he survives by doing temporary gigs.

mandarin_meaning: 頂班／頂更（臨時替人上班或加班以賺取額外工資）
english_meaning: to pick up an extra work shift; to cover someone else's shift (slang, HK)
explanation_mandarin: （香港口語／俚語）指臨時頂替他人的班次或自行額外上班以賺取額外工資，或換班頂替他人。
explanation_english: Hong Kong slang meaning to take an extra shift or cover someone else's shift, usually to earn extra pay or as a temporary replacement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今個禮拜日日炒更，攞多啲錢應付屋租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ngo5 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 jat6 jat6 caau2 gang1, lo2 do1 di1 cin2 jing3 fu6 nguk1 zo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我這個星期天天頂班，拿更多錢來付房租。
examples.english_sentence: I'm picking up extra shifts every day this week to earn more money for the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好每次都叫我炒更，我都忙唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: M4 hou2 mui5 ci3 dou1 giu3 ngo5 caau2 gang1, ngo5 dou1 mong4 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要每次都叫我頂班，我也忙不過來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always ask me to cover shifts — I'm already overwhelmed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司冇加班費，你炒更都係蝕底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Gung1 si1 mou5 gaa1 baan1 fai3, nei5 caau2 gang1 dou1 hai6 sik1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司沒有加班費，你頂班其實是吃虧的。
examples.english_sentence: The company doesn't pay overtime; picking up extra shifts is actually a loss for you.

mandarin_meaning: 炒房；在房地產市場上進行短期買賣以牟利
english_meaning: property speculation; buying and selling real estate (flats/houses) to make short-term profit
explanation_mandarin: 指投資者在房地產市場上短期買入再賣出樓房以獲取利潤，帶有投機性質，常用於香港語境。
explanation_english: Refers to speculating in the real-estate market by buying and quickly reselling flats/houses to earn profit. It is often used in Hong Kong contexts and carries a speculative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人靠炒樓追短線收益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 kaau3 caau2-lau4 zeoi1 dyun2 sin3 sau1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多人靠炒房追求短期收益。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many people speculate in property to chase short-term gains.

mandarin_meaning: 炒热；造势、炒作（使某事受关注或气氛热闹）；（也可指把食物加热）
english_meaning: to hype up; to stir up excitement or publicity; (also) to reheat food / make something hot
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语里，“炒熱”可指通过宣传或制造话题使某事变得热闹或受关注（相当于“炒作”“带热”），也可指把食物加热或重新加热。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '炒熱' can mean to hype something up or stir up excitement/publicity (similar to 'to stir up' or 'to hype'), and it can also be used literally to mean reheating or making food hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺社交媒體上炒熱呢個話題，大家都開始討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6 caau2 jit6 ni1 go3 waa6 tai4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hoi1 ci2 tou2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在社交媒体上把这个话题炒热，大家都开始讨论。
examples.english_sentence: They hyped up this topic on social media; everyone started discussing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟菜唔夠熱，我幫你炒熱先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 coi3 m4 gau3 jit6, ngo5 bong1 nei5 caau2 jit6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜不够热，我帮你把它炒热一下。
examples.english_sentence: This dish isn't hot enough; I'll reheat it for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅演唱會炒熱咗全場氣氛，成個場都好high。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 caau2 jit6 zo2 cyun4 coeng4 hei3 fan1, sing4 go3 coeng4 dou1 hou2 high.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演唱会炒热了全场气氛，整个场子都很HIGH。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's concert fired up the whole crowd; the whole place was really hyped.

mandarin_meaning: （把食物）炒焦、煮糊（也可引申為弄砸、失敗）
english_meaning: to burn (food) while frying or cooking; to scorch or overcook; figuratively, to mess up or fail
explanation_mandarin: 指在煮、炒、煎等烹調過程中把食物燒焦或煮糊，造成顏色變黑、產生燒焦味；口語中也可用來比喻把事情弄砸或失敗。
explanation_english: Refers to burning or scorching food during cooking (e.g., frying or pan-searing), resulting in charring, darkening, or a burnt taste; in colloquial use it can also figuratively mean to botch something or cause a failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心將雞蛋炒燶咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 gai1 daan2 caau2 nung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把雞蛋炒焦了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally burned the eggs while frying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣煎，會整到炒燶㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 zin1, wui5 zing2 dou3 caau2 nung4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要這樣煎，會把東西煎糊的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fry it like that, you'll burn it.

mandarin_meaning: 揭發或挖出某人的黑歷史／過去不光彩的事，讓對方難堪或被抹黑
english_meaning: to dig up and publicize someone's embarrassing or damaging past (expose someone's skeletons in the closet)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，多用於社交媒體或人際衝突中，指把某人的舊事、醜聞或不光彩紀錄公開，令對方蒙羞或受罰。
