examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲片喺社交網短時間內炸版，成千上萬人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 pin3 hai2 se5 gaau1 mong5 dyun2 si4 gaan1 noi6 zaa3 baan2, seng4 cin1 soeng5 maan6 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的影片在社交網短時間內炸版，成千上萬人觀看。
examples.english_sentence: His/her videos went viral on social media in a short time, attracting thousands upon thousands of views.

mandarin_meaning: 气炸、大发脾气
english_meaning: to blow one's top; to be furious; to lose one's temper (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俚語，字面為「炸牛屎」，用來形容某人非常生气、大发雷霆或爆粗骂人。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Cantonese slang literally 'deep-fry cow dung'; used to describe someone becoming extremely angry, blowing their top, or losing their temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日報告做得咁差，老闆見到即刻炸牛屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 gam2 caa1, lou5 baan2 gin3 dou3 zik1 hak1 zaa3 ngau4 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天報告做得這麼差，老闆一看就氣炸了。
examples.english_sentence: The report was so poor today that when the boss saw it he blew his top.

mandarin_meaning: 炸物（指油炸食品）
english_meaning: deep-fried foods / fried snacks
explanation_mandarin: 指各種經過油炸的食物，通常指小吃或點心，例如炸雞、炸魚、炸薯條等。也可用於菜單上指一類油炸拼盤或小吃。
explanation_english: Refers to various foods that have been deep-fried, typically snacks or side dishes such as fried chicken, fried fish, French fries, etc. Often used on menus to denote a category of fried items or a fried platter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜市有好多好食嘅炸物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 sik6 ge3 zaa3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜市有很多好吃的炸物。
examples.english_sentence: The night market has lots of tasty fried foods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想叫一份炸物拼盤，一齊食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 giu3 jat1 fan6 zaa3 mat6 ping1 pun4, jat1 cai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想点一份炸物拼盘，一起吃。
examples.english_sentence: I want to order a fried food platter to share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 炸物食多咗對身體唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa3 mat6 sik6 do1 zo2 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃太多炸物對身體不太好。
examples.english_sentence: Eating too much fried food isn't very good for your health.

mandarin_meaning: 用于油炸的粉或炸浆（裹粉、面糊等）
english_meaning: batter or coating flour used for deep-frying; breading/coating
explanation_mandarin: 指用來裹在食材表面再下油炸的粉類或調好的炸漿，通常由麵粉、生粉或其他澱粉混合調味而成，用以增加口感與香脆度。
explanation_english: Refers to the flour or batter used to coat food before deep-frying. Typically made from wheat flour, cornstarch or other starches mixed with seasonings to create a crispy texture and flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲雞翼要落多啲炸粉先炸得香脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gai1 jik6 jiu3 lok6 do1 di1 zaa3 fan2 sin1 zaa3 dak1 hoeng1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些鸡翅要加多一些炸粉才会炸得香脆。
examples.english_sentence: These chicken wings need more batter/coating to fry up crispy.

mandarin_meaning: 刺耳的噪音；聲音非常響或讓人不舒服（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: ear‑splitting / piercing noise; very loud or harsh sound (colloquial/slang)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（口語／俚語）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容聲音非常刺耳、響亮或難以忍受，有時亦可引申形容人說話尖銳、難聽或令人反感。
explanation_english: Used to describe sounds that are extremely harsh, loud, or unbearable to the ear. By extension it can describe someone's sharp or unpleasant way of speaking (colloquial/slang).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌真係炸耳仔，音量一大就聽唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ni1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 zaa3 ji5 zai2, jam1 loeng6 jat1 daai6 zau6 teng1 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌真的很刺耳，声音一大就听不下去。
examples.english_sentence: This song is really ear‑splitting; I can't listen to it when the volume gets high.

mandarin_meaning: 氣炸了；非常生氣（俗語/口語，罕見）
english_meaning: to be extremely angry; to blow one's top (slang, colloquial, rare)
explanation_mandarin: 「炸肶」為香港口語或俚語，常用以形容一個人怒氣爆發或非常生氣。此詞較為罕見或地域性強，書面語中不常見。
explanation_english: “炸肶” is a Hong Kong colloquial/slang expression used to describe someone becoming extremely angry or exploding with rage. It is relatively rare and regionally used; not common in formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰件事即刻炸肶，喊咗一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 gin6 si6 zik1 haak1 zaa3 but6, naam4 zo2 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那件事立刻氣炸了，哭了一會兒。
examples.english_sentence: He heard about that and immediately blew his top, crying for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搞佢啦，唔然佢會炸肶㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 keoi5 laa3, m4 jin4 keoi5 wui5 zaa3 but6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹他了，否則他會氣炸的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, or he'll blow his top!

mandarin_meaning: 炸藥；爆炸性物質；（引申）具有強烈衝擊力或能引發劇烈反應的事物
english_meaning: explosive (material); explosive/volatile thing; (figurative) something that causes a powerful or violent reaction
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used figuratively, adjectival in informal use)
explanation_mandarin: 「炸葯/炸藥」原指可燃爆炸的化學物質。口語中也常用作比喻，形容某事物或言論具有強烈、迅速產生重大反應或破壞力。
explanation_english: Literally an explosive substance. In colloquial use it can be metaphorical, describing something (an event, remark, etc.) that provokes a strong, sudden reaction or has destructive/impactful power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包係真炸藥，唔好亂郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 hai6 zan1 zaa3 joek6, m4 hou2 lyun6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包是真正的炸藥，別亂動。
examples.english_sentence: This package is real explosive material; don't touch it.

mandarin_meaning: 炸药 (zhàyào)
english_meaning: explosive; dynamite; explosive material
explanation_mandarin: 用于爆破或引起爆炸的化学物质或装置，用于采矿、拆除或军事用途等。
explanation_english: A chemical substance or device that detonates or explodes, used for blasting, demolition, mining, or military purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺工地搵到好多炸藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 gung1 dei6 wan2 dou3 hou2 do1 zaa3 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在工地发现了很多炸药。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a large amount of explosives at the construction site.

mandarin_meaning: 炸酱面 (zhájiàngmiàn)
english_meaning: zhajiang noodles; Chinese noodles served with a savory fried soybean/meat sauce
explanation_mandarin: 一种中式面食，通常以面条配上以黄豆酱或甜面酱及肉末炒制的酱料，起源于华北地区，但在华人社会广泛流行。
explanation_english: A Chinese noodle dish typically served with a savory sauce made from fermented soybean paste (or sweet bean sauce) and often minced meat; originates from northern China and is popular across Chinese communities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食炸醬麪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 zaa3 zoeng3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃炸酱面。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat zhajiang noodles tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間麵館嘅炸醬麪好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 min6 gun2 ge3 zaa3 zoeng3 min6 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家面馆的炸酱面很有名。
examples.english_sentence: This noodle shop's zhajiang noodles are very famous.

mandarin_meaning: 炸酱面，一種以炸醬（通常用黃豆醬或豆瓣醬炒製肉末）拌面的北方麵食
english_meaning: Zhajiang noodles — wheat noodles topped or mixed with a savory soybean/fermented bean paste and minced meat sauce
explanation_mandarin: 炸醬麵是中國北方常見的麵食，麵條通常與用醬料和肉末炒成的炸醬拌在一起食用，口味偏鹹香濃郁。
explanation_english: A Northern Chinese noodle dish consisting of wheat noodles mixed with a fried sauce (usually fermented soybean paste and minced meat). It is savory and richly flavored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食唔食炸醬麵呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 m4 sik6 zaa3 zoeng3 min6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃不吃炸酱面？
examples.english_sentence: Are you eating zhajiang noodles tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖嘅炸醬麵好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 zaa3 zoeng3 min6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的炸酱面很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The zhajiang noodles at this shop are very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 炸开 / 爆裂；（口語）爆紅、突然大量湧現或笑得很厲害
english_meaning: to burst open / to explode; (colloquial) to blow up (go viral), to burst into laughter
explanation_mandarin: 「炸開」可以指物體因受力或爆裂而裂開、破裂（如瓶子炸開）；口語上也常用來形容某事迅速走紅、熱鬧起來或笑得很厲害（如貼文炸開、笑到炸開）。
explanation_english: Literally 'to explode/burst open' (an object breaking apart). Colloquially used to mean something 'blew up' (went viral) or as an emphatic phrase for extreme reactions (e.g., 'bursting into laughter').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個汽水樽跌落地，炸開咗，汁水飛得到處都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 hei3 seoi2 zyun1 dit3 lok6 dei6, zaa3 hoi1 zo2, zap1 seoi2 fei1 dou3 cyu3 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汽水瓶掉到地上，炸开了，饮料溅得到处都是。
examples.english_sentence: The soda bottle fell on the ground and burst open; the drink splashed everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個帖一出就炸開，留言同讚好多到爆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 tip3 jat1 ceot1 zau6 zaa3 hoi1, lau4 jim4 tung4 zaan3 hou2 do1 dou3 baau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那篇帖一发出就炸开了，留言和赞好多到爆。
examples.english_sentence: His post blew up as soon as it was posted — comments and likes were ridiculously many.

mandarin_meaning: 炸鸡 (zhájī)
english_meaning: fried chicken
explanation_mandarin: 炸雞指以油炸方式烹調的雞肉製品，常見於速食、小吃或宵夜，口感多為外脆內嫩。
explanation_english: Fried chicken — chicken prepared by deep-frying, commonly served as fast food or a snack; typically crispy on the outside and tender inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋買咗啲炸雞做宵夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 di1 zaa3 gai1 zou6 siu1 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们买了些炸鸡当宵夜。
examples.english_sentence: We bought some fried chicken for a late-night snack tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間舖嘅炸雞好香又脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 pou3 ge3 zaa3 gai1 hou2 hoeng1 jau6 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家铺子的炸鸡又香又脆。
examples.english_sentence: The fried chicken at that shop is fragrant and crispy.

mandarin_meaning: 闲着/无所事事（粤语俚语）
english_meaning: to laze about; to be idle/loaf around (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「炸髀」是香港廣東話的俚語，字面為「炸大腿」，實際用法指閒著不做事、無所事事或偷懶。有時亦用來形容失業或暫時沒找工作的狀態。
explanation_english: "炸髀" is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang literally meaning "to fry the thigh," used figuratively to mean idling, lazing about, or doing nothing. It can also describe being unemployed or not looking for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假唔好成日喺屋企炸髀，多啲出去行下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei5 zaa3 bei2, do1 di1 ceot1 heoi3 haang4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假别整天在家里闲着，多出去走走。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spend the whole holiday lazing around at home; go out and take a walk more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業後一直炸髀，冇搵新工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 hau6 jat1 zik6 zaa3 bei2, mou5 wan2 san1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业后一直闲着，没有找新工作。
examples.english_sentence: After he lost his job, he just loafed around and didn't look for a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度炸髀，幫手做啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zaa3 bei2, bong1 sau2 zou6 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里闲着，帮忙做点事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just sit here doing nothing; help out with something.

mandarin_meaning: 炸鱼皮
english_meaning: deep-fried fish skin; crispy fried fish skin (a snack)
explanation_mandarin: 指將魚皮放入油中炸至酥脆的食品，常見於香港與華南地區作為小吃或零食。有時口語中亦簡稱為「魚皮」。
explanation_english: Refers to fish skin that has been deep-fried until crispy, a common snack or small dish in Hong Kong and parts of southern China. Sometimes colloquially shortened to "fish skin."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜市有間檔口賣炸魚皮，好香，我哋買啲試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 si5 jau5 gaan1 dong3 hau2 maai6 zaa3 jyu4 pei4, hou2 hoeng1, ngo5 dei6 maai5 di1 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜市有一家攤位賣炸魚皮，很香，我們買點來試試。
examples.english_sentence: There was a stall selling deep-fried fish skin at the night market — it smelled great. Let's buy some to try.

mandarin_meaning: 炸鱼薯条
english_meaning: fish and chips (deep-fried battered fish with fried potato chips)
explanation_mandarin: 指將魚裹上麵糊或麵包屑後油炸，配以炸薯條的英式料理。香港常見於西式餐廳或外賣店。
explanation_english: A classic British dish of battered and deep-fried fish served with fried potato chips (fries). Common in the UK and at Western-style eateries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去食炸魚薯條啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 zaa3 jyu4 syu4 tiu4 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去吃炸鱼薯条吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go have fish and chips tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 炸鸡 (zhá jī) — 指以油炸方式烹调的鸡肉，常指炸鸡块、炸鸡腿等
english_meaning: fried chicken — chicken cooked by deep-frying (pieces, drumsticks, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指把鸡肉放入油中炸制而成的食品。在香港常見的快餐或小吃，既可指整隻炸雞，也可指炸雞塊、炸雞髀等。字形中「鷄」是「雞」的異體字，輸入時有時見到變體或帶星號標記。
explanation_english: Refers to chicken prepared by deep-frying. In Hong Kong it is a common fast-food or snack and can denote whole fried chicken or pieces such as drumsticks and nuggets. The character 鷄 is a variant of 雞; the asterisk likely marks a variant or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去嗰間食店食炸鷄啦，佢哋啲炸鷄好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 go2 gaan1 sik6 dim3 sik6 zaa3 gai1 laa1, keoi5 dei6 di1 zaa3 gai1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去那家店吃炸鸡吧，他们的炸鸡很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to that shop for fried chicken tonight — their fried chicken is really tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 点 (diǎn)：表示点菜、点火、表示时间（点钟）、一点、如何/怎么
english_meaning: to order (food), to light/ignite, o'clock (time), a little, how/what
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词 / 副词
explanation_mandarin: “点”在粤语中用途广泛：可以表示点菜（例：點嘢）、点火或点烟（例：點支煙），也用于表示时间的“点钟”（例：幾點），以及作为询问方式的词（如點解/點樣，表示“为什么/怎样”）。此外在口语中可表示少量或一点。
explanation_english: “Dim” (点) in Cantonese has many uses: to order (food), to light (a fire or cigarette), to mark the hour (o'clock), and as interrogative forms (e.g. dim2 gaai2 'why', dim2 joeng6 'how'). It can also indicate a small amount in some contexts. It functions as a verb, noun or adverb depending on usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去茶餐廳點嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 caa4 caan1 teng1 dim2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去茶餐厅点东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's order something at the cha chaan teng (HK-style café).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家幾點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 gei2 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在几点？
examples.english_sentence: What time is it now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點解遲到？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 gaai2 ci4 dou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么迟到？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you late?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我點支煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 dim2 zi1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我点支烟。
examples.english_sentence: Light a cigarette for me.

mandarin_meaning: 为 (wèi / wéi) — 表示「为了、因为、成为/视为」等
english_meaning: for; because of; to be/regard as; (used to indicate purpose, cause, or role)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词 / 连词 / 动词
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「為」在廣東話有兩個常見讀音（wai4、wai6），用法多樣，可表示目的（為了）、原因（因為）、或作為判定/視為（成為、當作）等，既出現在書面語也見於口語合成詞如「為咗」「視為」。
explanation_english: The character '為' has multiple Cantonese pronunciations (wai4, wai6) and uses: indicating purpose ('for'), cause ('because of'), or role/consideration ('to be/regard as'). It functions as a preposition, conjunction, or verb and appears in both formal and colloquial compounds like '為咗' and '視為'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咗你，可以等多陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 zo2 nei5, ho2 ji5 dang2 do1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我为了你，可以等一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait a while for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都視佢為老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 si6 keoi5 wai4 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都视他为老师。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone regards him as a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為難自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai4 naan6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要为难自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make things difficult for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 以……為主（wéi zhǔ）：以某事物或某方面為主要、為最重要
english_meaning: to take as the main focus; to prioritize; mainly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語 / 介詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某一方面當作主要考量或主要方向，常用於「以…為主」的結構，說明重點或主導元素。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is regarded as the primary focus or main basis. Commonly used in the structure "以...為主" to state the main emphasis or dominant element.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次以安全為主，唔好冒險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 ji5 on1 cyun4 wai4 zyu2, m4 hou2 mou6 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們這次以安全為主，不要冒險。
examples.english_sentence: This time we'll prioritize safety; don't take risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考慮到成本，公司會以節約成本為主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 leoi6 dou3 sing4 bun2, gung1 si1 wui5 ji5 zit3 joek6 sing4 bun2 wai4 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考慮到成本，公司會以節約成本為主。
examples.english_sentence: Considering the costs, the company will focus on saving costs.

mandarin_meaning: 為此 / 對此 / 因此（書面語）
english_meaning: for it; because of it; thereby (literary)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 書面語連詞 / 介詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 「為之」多見於書面語或文言，常用來表示「因此、為此」或引出對某事的反應、結果；也可表示所作動作的對象。
explanation_english: A literary phrase used to indicate 'because of it' or 'for it', often introducing a result or reaction to something; can also mark the object/target of an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事令人為之驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ling6 jan4 wai6 zi1 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事讓人因此感到驚訝。
examples.english_sentence: This matter makes people feel surprised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成功來之不易，大家為之付出很多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 gung1 loi4 zi1 bat1 ji6, daai6 gaa1 wai6 zi1 fu6 ceot1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 成功來之不易，大家為此付出了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Success doesn't come easily; everyone has put a lot in for it.

mandarin_meaning: 為什麼
english_meaning: why; for what reason
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，相當於「為乜嘢/點解/為什麼」，用來詢問原因，語氣隨意、口語化。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning "why" (equivalent to 點解/為乜嘢). Used to ask for a reason; informal and conversational.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你為乜唔嚟㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai6 mat1 m4 lei4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為什麼沒來？
examples.english_sentence: Why didn't you come?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為乜咁嬲㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 mat1 gam2 nau4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她為什麼這麼生氣？
examples.english_sentence: Why is he/she so angry?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為乜要咁做㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 mat1 jiu3 gam2 zou6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為什麼要這樣做？
examples.english_sentence: Why do you have to do that?

mandarin_meaning: 为了 (wèile)
english_meaning: in order to; for the sake of; for the purpose of
explanation_mandarin: 表示目的或動機，說明為了達到某個目標而採取的行動。
explanation_english: Used to indicate purpose or motive; introduces the reason or goal for which an action is taken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為了考試，日日溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 liu5 haau2si3, jat6 jat6 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我为了考试，每天复习。
examples.english_sentence: I study every day for the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為了家庭，犧牲咗好多時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 liu5 gaa1ting4 hei1sang1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了家庭，牺牲了很多时间。
examples.english_sentence: He sacrificed a lot of time for his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為了安全起見，你最好買多一份保險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 liu5 ngon1cyun4 hei2 gin3, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 maai5 do1 jat1 fan6 bou2 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了安全起见，你最好多买一份保险。
examples.english_sentence: For safety's sake, you'd better buy an extra insurance policy.

jyutping: wai6 ng5 dau2 mai5 zit3 jiu1
mandarin_meaning: 為了五斗米折腰（為了一點微薄的報酬而屈尊、放棄原則）
english_meaning: To stoop or humiliate oneself for a small material gain; to sacrifice one's principles or dignity for a pittance.
explanation_mandarin: 出自古代典故，字面意思是為了五斗米而折腰。比喻為了一點微薄的報酬或眼前利益而放棄志節、屈尊就職或做不願做的事情。
explanation_english: Originally from a classical story; literally 'to bend one's waist for five pecks of rice.' It figuratively means compromising one's principles or dignity for a small, material reward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為五斗米折腰，乜都肯做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 ng5 dau2 mai5 zit3 jiu1, mat1 dou1 hang2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了五斗米折腰，什麼都願意做。
examples.english_sentence: He stoops for five pecks of rice; he'll do anything for a small sum of money.

jyutping: wai6 ng5 dau2 mai5 ji4 zit3 jiu1
mandarin_meaning: 為了五斗米而折腰 (wèi wǔ dǒu mǐ ér zhé yāo)：為了微薄的利益或生計而屈就、出賣原則
english_meaning: To stoop or abase oneself for a meagre material gain; to sacrifice one's principles for a small reward
explanation_mandarin: 原指為了五斗米（一點微薄的糧食）而屈身乞憐，現用來形容為了微小的利益或生計而放棄原則或尊嚴。
explanation_english: Originally meaning to bend one's waist for five pecks of rice (a small amount of food), it now describes compromising one's principles or dignity for trivial material gain or livelihood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為五斗米而折腰，為咗幾個錢就肯出賣原則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 ng5 dau2 mai5 ji4 zit3 jiu1, wai6 zo2 gei2 go3 cin2 zau6 hang2 ceot1 maai6 jyun4 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為五斗米而折腰，為了幾塊錢就願意出賣原則。
examples.english_sentence: He stoops for a meagre wage; he's willing to sell his principles for a little money.

mandarin_meaning: 為人 / 为人（性格、品德；待人处事的方式）
english_meaning: one's character, moral conduct, or the way one behaves toward others; to behave
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can also be used as a verb)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的性格、品德或待人處事的方式，也可用來表示『為人某種方式／表現』。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's character, moral qualities, or manner of dealing with others; can also indicate behaving in a certain way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為人好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 jan4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很有禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: He is very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意最緊要為人誠實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 wai4 jan4 sing4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意最重要的是為人誠實。
examples.english_sentence: In business, the most important thing is to be honest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為人好慳，唔太肯花錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 jan4 hou2 haan1, m4 taai3 hang2 faa1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人很節省，不太願意花錢。
examples.english_sentence: He is frugal and not very willing to spend money.

mandarin_meaning: 做人的榜樣，作為老師或表率
english_meaning: to be a model/example for others (especially as a teacher); to set a good example
explanation_mandarin: 「為人師表」為成語，用來形容應當以自己言行作為他人的榜樣，尤指老師應當以身作則，起表率作用。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to act as an exemplar for others — especially used for teachers who should lead by example and serve as a moral/modeling standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師應該為人師表，言行一致，做學生嘅榜樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jing1 goi1 wai4 jan4 si1 biu2, jin4 hang4 jat1 zi3, zou6 hok6 saang1 ge3 bong2 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師應該為人師表，言行一致，做學生的榜樣。
examples.english_sentence: Teachers should be models for others, act consistently, and be examples for their students.

cantonese: 為人為到底，送佛送到西
jyutping: wai4 jan4 wai4 dou3 dai2, sung3 fat6 sung3 dou3 sai1
mandarin_meaning: 既然要做，就做到最後；既然幫忙，就幫到底。
english_meaning: If you're going to do something, do it thoroughly; if you help someone, help them all the way.
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俗語用來勸誡或形容一個人做事徹底、不半途而廢，或幫人幫到底，不留尾巴。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb advising that one should see things through and not do things half-heartedly; if you help, help completely and follow through to the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然答應人，你就要做到，為人為到底，送佛送到西。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 daap3 jing3 jan4, nei5 zau6 jiu3 zou6 dou3, wai4 jan4 wai4 dou3 dai2, sung3 fat6 sung3 dou3 sai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然答應別人，就要做到，做事要徹底、幫人要幫到底。
examples.english_sentence: If you've promised someone, you should follow through — do things thoroughly and help others all the way.

mandarin_meaning: 为什么 (wèishéme)
english_meaning: why; for what reason
explanation_mandarin: 用來詢問原因或理由的疑問詞，常用於句首或句中引出原因相關的問句。
explanation_english: A question word used to ask about the reason or cause of something; commonly appears at the start or within questions asking for explanations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你為什麼唔嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai6 sam1 mo1 m4 lei4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為什麼不來？
examples.english_sentence: Why didn't you come?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為什麼要轉工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 sam1 mo1 jiu3 zyun2 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為什麼要換工作？
examples.english_sentence: Why does he want to change jobs?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為什麼我成日都咁衰？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 sam1 mo1 ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 seoi1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為什麼我總是這麼倒霉？
examples.english_sentence: Why am I always so unlucky?

jyutping: wai6 taa1 jan4 zok3 gaa3 ji1 soeng1
mandarin_meaning: 为他人做嫁衣裳
english_meaning: Literally 'to make a wedding dress for someone else'; idiom meaning to do work or make sacrifices that end up benefiting someone else (often implying being exploited or losing out).
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是为别人做嫁衣裳，比喻自己辛苦付出或努力，最终让别人享受成果或得到利益，常含被利用或吃亏的意味。
explanation_english: The literal image is making a wedding dress for someone else. Figuratively, it describes working hard or sacrificing for someone so that another person reaps the benefits—often implying exploitation or coming up short.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫公司做咁多方案，最後畀人攞去用，真係為他人作嫁衣裳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 gung1 si1 zou6 gam3 do1 fong3 on3, zeoi3 hau6 bei2 jan4 lo2 heoi3 jung6, zan1 hai6 wai6 taa1 jan4 zok3 gaa3 ji1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是為公司做很多方案，最後被別人拿去用了，真是為他人作嫁衣裳。
examples.english_sentence: He always does a lot of work for the company only to have others take it and use it — it's really like making a wedding dress for someone else.

mandarin_meaning: 与……为伍；与不良分子结党、结伙（常含贬义）
english_meaning: to associate with; to join or band together with (often negative connotation of associating with bad elements)
explanation_mandarin: 表示与某些人结伴、结党或交往，通常含有与不良分子或有害人群同流合污的负面意味。
explanation_english: Indicates associating or banding together with certain people; often carries a negative connotation of allying with undesirable or harmful elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想同嗰班壞朋友為伍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 tung4 go2 baan1 waai6 pang4 jau5 wai4 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想和那群坏朋友为伍。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to associate with that group of bad friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然同黑社會為伍，令人好驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 tung4 hak1 se5 wui6 wai4 ng5, ling6 jan4 hou2 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然和黑社会为伍，令人很惊讶。
examples.english_sentence: He actually associated with the triads, which surprised people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要小心啲，唔好同啲亂搞嘢嘅人為伍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 tung4 di1 lyun6 gaau2 je5 ge3 jan4 wai4 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要小心点，不要和那些惹是生非的人为伍。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful; don't associate with people who cause trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 為甚麼 / 為何 (詢問原因)
english_meaning: why; for what reason
explanation_mandarin: 表示詢問原因的書面或正式用語，相當於「為甚麼／為什麼」。
explanation_english: A formal/written interrogative adverb used to ask for a reason; equivalent to "why".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你為何唔嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai6 ho4 m4 lei4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為何不來？
examples.english_sentence: Why didn't you come?

mandarin_meaning: 作为例子；例如（常用于「以...为例」）
english_meaning: for example; as an example (often used in the structure '以...為例')
explanation_mandarin: 通常用於「以...為例」，表示把某事物拿來當作例子來說明或比較。
explanation_english: Usually used in the structure '以...為例' to indicate taking something as an example for illustration or comparison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以香港為例，居住密度相當高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 hoeng1 gong2 wai4 lai6, geoi1 zyu6 mat6 dou6 soeng1 dong1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以香港为例，居住密度相当高。
examples.english_sentence: Take Hong Kong as an example; the residential density is quite high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以小班教學為例，老師可以更細心照顧學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 siu2 baan1 gaau3 hok6 wai4 lai6, lou5 si1 ho2 ji5 gang3 sai3 sam1 ziu3 gu3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以小班教学为例，老师可以更细心照顾学生。
examples.english_sentence: For example, with small-class teaching, teachers can take better care of students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以我自己為例，我覺得學廣東話需要時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 ngo5 zi6 gei2 wai4 lai6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以我自己为例，我觉得学粤语需要时间。
examples.english_sentence: For example, speaking for myself, I think learning Cantonese takes time.

mandarin_meaning: 為了兩頓飯；為了糊口、維持生計
english_meaning: Literally 'for two meals' — doing something just to earn a living or to get by; doing something for subsistence
explanation_mandarin: 表示為了糊口或維持生活而做某事，常帶有無奈或輕視的語氣，指為了短期生計而從事某些工作或行為。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something merely to earn a living or to get by, often with a tone of resignation or slight disdain; refers to working or acting for short-term subsistence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰份兼職冇前途，但係佢話只係為兩餐飯，暫時頂住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 fan6 gim1 zik1 mou5 cin4 tou4, daan6 hai6 keoi5 waa6 zi2 hai6 wai6 loeng5 caan1 faan6, zaam6 si4 ding2 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那份兼職沒有前途，但他說只是為了兩頓飯，暫時撐一下。
examples.english_sentence: His part-time job has no future, but he says he's only doing it to get by for now.

mandarin_meaning: 被形勢所逼；迫於情勢而被迫做某事
english_meaning: forced by circumstances; compelled by pressure
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞性短語（成語／慣用語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為外在形勢或壓力而被迫做某事，常含無奈或被迫的意思，適用於較正式或書面語境。
explanation_english: Indicates being compelled to do something by external circumstances or pressure; conveys a sense of reluctance or being forced. Common in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係為勢所逼先答應幫手，心裏其實唔情願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wai4 sai3 so2 bik1 sin1 daap3 jing3 bong1 sau2, sam1 leoi5 kei4 sat6 m4 cing4 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是被形勢所逼才答應幫忙，心裏其實不情願。
examples.english_sentence: He only agreed to help because he was forced by the situation; he was actually unwilling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為勢所逼，最後裁員咗十個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai4 sai3 so2 bik1, zeoi6 hau6 coi4 jyun4 zo2 sap6 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司迫於形勢，最後裁員了十個人。
examples.english_sentence: The company, compelled by circumstances, ended up laying off ten people.

mandarin_meaning: 為了生計奔波；為了謀生而四處奔走
english_meaning: to hustle or run around to make a living; to work hard to support oneself or one's family
explanation_mandarin: 表示為了維持生計或餬口而辛勞奔波、到處奔走工作或尋找機會。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom meaning to busy oneself or hustle to earn a living — to toil, run around, or work hard so as to support oneself or one’s family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家為口奔馳，要做兩份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 wai6 hau2 ban1 ci4, jiu3 zou6 loeng5 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在為了生計奔波，要做兩份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently hustling to make a living; he has to work two jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬為口奔馳，唔想拖累屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 wai6 hau2 ban1 ci4, m4 soeng2 to1 leoi6 uk1 kei5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟為了生計奔波，不想拖累家人。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother is scrambling to make a living and doesn't want to burden the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗學出嚟做嘢，純粹係為口奔馳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 hok6 ceot1 lai4 zou6 je5, seon4 ceoi3 hai6 wai6 hau2 ban1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他輟學出來工作，純粹是為了生計奔波。
examples.english_sentence: He dropped out to work; purely, he's hustling to make ends meet.

mandarin_meaning: 为了
english_meaning: for the sake of; in order to; because of
explanation_mandarin: 「為咗」是粵語口語用法，相當於普通話的「为了」，用來表示目的或為了某事而採取行動，或表示因為某個原因。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression equivalent to Mandarin '为了' (wèile). It marks purpose or reason—doing something for the sake of or because of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咗通過考試，成日溫書到夜晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai4 zo2 tung1 gwo3 haau2 si3, seng4 jat6 wan1 syu1 dou3 je6 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我为了通过考试，经常温习到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: I study late every night to pass the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗啲錢，去咗好遠嘅地方做工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 di1 cin2, heoi3 zo2 hou2 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1 zou6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了钱，去了很远的地方工作。
examples.english_sentence: He went to a far place to work for the sake of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗你嘅安全，我鎖咗門先離開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 nei5 ge3 on1 cyun4, ngo5 so2 zo2 mun4 sin1 lei4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了你的安全，我把门锁上才离开。
examples.english_sentence: For your safety, I locked the door before leaving.

mandarin_meaning: 做不到／應付不來／無法承受（口語）
english_meaning: can't do it / can't cope / can't handle (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「為唔過」是廣東話口語用法，用來表示無法做到、應付不了或承受不來某事，常帶有放棄或無奈的語氣。屬非正式語境下的說法。
explanation_english: “為唔過” is a colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate inability to do something, inability to cope, or being unable to endure/handle a situation. It often conveys a sense of resignation or that it's not worth trying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅工作太多，我真係為唔過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gung1 zok3 taai3 do1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 wai6 m4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次的工作太多，我真的應付不來。
examples.english_sentence: There's too much work this time; I really can't cope.

mandarin_meaning: 為了逞一口氣或出氣；為了顯擺、報復或洩憤而做某事
english_meaning: to do something out of spite or to vent; to act just to prove a point, show off, or get back at someone
explanation_mandarin: 「為啖氣」常用於粵語，指為了逞一口氣、洩憤或顯擺而去做某件事，通常暗含不必要或衝動的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to do something out of spite, to vent, or to prove a point — often implying the action is unnecessary or done on impulse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好為啖氣買啲你唔需要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wai6 daam2 hei3 maai5 di1 nei5 m4 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要為了逞一口氣買些不需要的東西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy things you don't need just to prove a point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為啖氣辭咗份工，依家後悔緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 daam2 hei3 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, ji1 gaa1 hau6 fui3 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了一時逞氣辭了工作，現在正在後悔。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job out of spite and is now regretting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想為啖氣回覆佢，免得火上加油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 wai6 daam2 hei3 wui4 fuk1 keoi5, min5 dak1 fo2 soeng5 gaa1 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想為了一口氣回覆他，免得火上加油。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to reply to him out of spite and add fuel to the fire.

mandarin_meaning: 為國捐軀（为国捐躯）
english_meaning: to sacrifice one's life for the country
explanation_mandarin: 指為了國家而捐出生命，多用來稱頌在戰爭或重大事件中為國犧牲的人。
explanation_english: Refers to giving one's life for the country; often used to honor those who died serving the nation in war or other major events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺戰場上為國捐軀，成為後人敬重嘅英雄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zin3 coeng4 soeng6 wai4 gwok3 gyun1 keoi1, sing4 wai4 hau6 jan4 ging3 zung6 ge3 jing1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在戰場上為國捐軀，成為後人敬重的英雄。
examples.english_sentence: He sacrificed his life for his country on the battlefield, becoming a hero revered by later generations.

mandarin_meaning: 为国争光（为国家争取荣誉、光荣）
english_meaning: to bring honor/glory to one's country; to win glory for the nation
explanation_mandarin: 表示為國家爭取榮譽或光榮，常用來表揚個人或團隊以優異表現使國家感到光榮。
explanation_english: Expresses winning honor or glory for one's country; often used to praise individuals or teams whose outstanding achievements bring national pride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺今次比賽奪冠，真係為國爭光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1-ci3 bei2-coi3 dyut6-gun3, zan1-hai6 wai4 gwok3 zang1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这次比赛夺冠，真是为国争光。
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship in this competition and truly brought honor to the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲運動員努力訓練，希望可以為國爭光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wan6-dung6-jyun4 nou5-lik6 fan3-lin6, hei1-mong6 ho2-ji5 wai4 gwok3 zang1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些运动员努力训练，希望可以为国争光。
examples.english_sentence: The athletes train hard in hopes of bringing honor to the country.

mandarin_meaning: 危害；造成損害
english_meaning: to harm; to cause damage; to be detrimental
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人、事物或環境造成傷害或損害，常用於書面或較正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates causing harm or damage to people, things, or the environment; commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲化學廢物可能會為害環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faa3 hok6 fai3 mat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 wai6 hoi6 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些化學廢物可能會危害環境。
examples.english_sentence: These chemical wastes may harm the environment.

mandarin_meaning: 為富不仁（wéi fù bù rén）：有錢卻沒有仁德，對他人冷酷、自私。
english_meaning: To be rich but lacking in compassion; wealthy yet cruel or unkind.
explanation_mandarin: 表示雖然財富豐厚，但缺乏仁德或同情，常用以批評有錢人不顧他人利益、冷酷自私。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is wealthy but lacks benevolence or compassion. Commonly used to criticize people who, despite their riches, act selfishly or cruelly toward others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賺咗好多錢，但為富不仁，完全唔理員工嘅待遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, daan6 wai4 fu3 bat1 jan4, jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 jyun4 gung1 ge3 doi6 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他賺了很多錢，但為富不仁，完全不管員工的待遇。
examples.english_sentence: He earned a lot of money, but being rich and unkind, he completely ignores his employees' treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會上有啲為富不仁嘅人，只顧自己利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 soeng5 jau5 di1 wai4 fu3 bat1 jan4 ge3 jan4, zi2 gu3 zi6 gei2 lei6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會上有些為富不仁的人，只顧自己的利益。
examples.english_sentence: There are some people in society who, though wealthy, lack compassion and only look after their own interests.

mandarin_meaning: 像個體面的人；體面、像樣
english_meaning: to be decent/respectable; to be presentable or acceptable as a person
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，表示行為或外表達到體面、像樣、令人能接受的程度。常用於否定句表示不體面、丟人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be decent, respectable, or presentable. Often used in negative sentences to say something is not proper or is embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣講人，唔為得人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 gong2 jan4, m4 wai6 dak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那樣說人，這樣不體面。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about people like that; it's not decent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街見人要整潔啲，先至為得人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gin3 jan4 jiu3 zing2 git3 di1, sin1 zi3 wai6 dak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外出見人要整潔一點，才算體面。
examples.english_sentence: When going out to meet people you should be a bit tidier; then you'll be presentable.

mandarin_meaning: 還過得去；勉強可以
english_meaning: passable; tolerable; just acceptable
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示某事或某物雖然不是很好，但還算可以、過得去。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning that something is not great but is acceptable or tolerable — just passable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物唔係最好，但都為得過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 m4 hai6 zeoi3 hou2, daan6 dou1 wai4 dak1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的食物不是最好，但還過得去。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant isn't the best, but it's passable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試成績唔差，為得過可以過關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 m4 caa1, wai4 dak1 gwo3 ho2 ji5 gwo3 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試成績不差，還過得去，可以過關。
examples.english_sentence: The exam result isn't bad; it's passable and can pass the course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢做事唔夠快，但做得細心，結果都為得過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 zou6 si6 m4 gau3 faai3, daan6 zou6 dak1 sai3 sam1, git3 gwo2 dou1 wai4 dak1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他做事不夠快，但做得細心，結果還是過得去。
examples.english_sentence: Although he isn't fast at his work, he is careful, so the results are still passable.

mandarin_meaning: 为所欲为
english_meaning: to do whatever one wants; to act as one pleases (often with a negative sense of recklessness or lack of restraint)
explanation_mandarin: 形容任凭自己的意愿去做任何事，常含有肆意、放纵或无法无天的贬义。
explanation_english: Describes acting entirely according to one's own wishes without restraint; often carries a negative connotation of being reckless, unrestrained, or unscrupulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都為所欲為，唔顧其他人嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 wai6 so2 juk6 wai4, m4 gu3 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天为所欲为，不顾别人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He does whatever he wants all the time, not caring about others' feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家長唔好任由細路為所欲為，要設界線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 zoeng2 m4 hou2 jam6 jau4 sai3 lou6 wai6 so2 juk6 wai4, jiu3 cit3 gaai3 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家长不要放任孩子为所欲为，要设立界限。
examples.english_sentence: Parents shouldn't let children do whatever they please; they need to set boundaries.

mandarin_meaning: 算是；具有一定數量
english_meaning: to amount to; to count as; (a) number/amount
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（表示數量/是否可算）
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某事物在數量或程度上可被視為、算作或達到一定數目，常見於「為數不少」「為數不多」等搭配。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something amounts to or can be considered as a certain number/amount. Commonly appears in phrases like '為數不少' (quite a few) or '為數不多' (not many).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班為數唔多，但都好用功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 wai4 sou3 m4 do1, daan6 dou1 hou2 jung6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们班人数不多，但都很用功。
examples.english_sentence: There aren't many of us in the class, but we're all hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊人為數唔少，大約有三十個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi6 jan4 wai4 sou3 m4 siu2, daai6 joek3 jau5 saam1 sap6 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这队人不少，大约有三十个人。
examples.english_sentence: There are quite a few people on this team, about thirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個領域入面，佢係為數不多嘅專家之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 ling5 wik6 jap6 min6, keoi5 hai6 wai4 sou3 bat1 do1 ge3 zyun1 gaa1 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个领域里，他是为数不多的专家之一。
examples.english_sentence: In this field, he is one of the few experts.

mandarin_meaning: 为时已晚（已经太迟，来不及）
english_meaning: Too late; it is already too late to change or salvage the situation.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情已經太遲，無法挽回或來得及改變。
explanation_english: Indicates that it is already too late to reverse or correct a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家先開始做功課，為時已晚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 sin1 hoi1 ci2 zou6 gung1 fo3, wai4 si4 ji5 maan5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在才开始做功课，已经为时已晚了。
examples.english_sentence: It's already too late to start the homework now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔快啲行，就真係為時已晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 faai3 di1 haang4, zau6 zan1 hai6 wai4 si4 ji5 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不快点走，就真的为时已晚。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't leave quickly, it'll really be too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋錯過咗最後申請日期，為時已晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co3 gwo3 zo2 zeoi3 hau6 san1 cing2 jat6 kei4, wai4 si4 ji5 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们错过了最后的申请日期，已经为时已晚。
examples.english_sentence: We missed the final application date; it's too late now.

mandarin_meaning: 为期
english_meaning: to be scheduled for; to last for (a specified period)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事約定或安排在一段特定的期限內完成或持續（例如「為期三年」表示持續三年）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is scheduled to last for or be set within a specified period (e.g. "for three years").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃為期三年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wai4 kei4 saam1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划为期三年。
examples.english_sentence: This project is scheduled for three years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 合約為期一年，之後可以續約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6 joek3 wai4 kei4 jat1 nin4, zi1 hau6 ho2 ji5 zuk6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合同为期一年，之后可以续约。
examples.english_sentence: The contract is for one year, and can be renewed afterward.

mandarin_meaning: 以……为本；以……为基础/根本
english_meaning: to take (something) as the basis; be based on; regard as fundamental
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某事物作為根本或基礎，常見於「以……為本」的用法，例如「以人為本」表示以人為中心或最重要。
explanation_english: Indicates taking something as the foundation or basis. Commonly appears in constructions like "以...為本" (e.g., "以人為本" = people-oriented).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司以顧客為本，所有決策都會考慮客人需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 gu3 haak3 wai4 bun2, so2 jau5 kyut3 caak3 dou1 wui5 haau2 leoi6 haak3 jan4 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司以顾客为本，所有决策都会考虑顾客的需要。
examples.english_sentence: The company takes customers as its core; all decisions will take customers' needs into account.

mandarin_meaning: （表示截止、到某個時間或範圍）為止
english_meaning: up to; until; as far as (indicating a cutoff point or limit)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞短語（表示截止或範圍）
explanation_mandarin: 「為止」用於表示某個動作、狀態或情況的截止點或範圍，常與時間或數量連用，如「截至今日為止」。
explanation_english: “為止” indicates a cutoff point or limit for an action, state, or condition; it is commonly used with time or quantity expressions (e.g. “up to today”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 截至今日為止，我已經等咗三個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit3 zi3 gam1 jat6 wai4 zi2, ngo5 ji5 ging1 dang2 zo2 saam1 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 截至今日為止，我已經等了三個小時。
examples.english_sentence: As of today, I have already been waiting for three hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話只係試做，到月底為止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi2 hai6 si3 zou6, dou3 jyut6 dai2 wai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说只是试做，到月底为止。
examples.english_sentence: He said it's only a trial, lasting until the end of the month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到此為止，你唔好再講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 ci2 wai4 zi2, nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到此为止，你不要再说了。
examples.english_sentence: That's it; don't say any more.

mandarin_meaning: 为民请命：为人民争取权益或福利，替民众向当权者请愿或呼吁。
english_meaning: To plead on behalf of the people; to petition or appeal to authorities for the people's rights or welfare; to speak up for the populace.
explanation_mandarin: 「為民請命」為書面或口語成語，指代表民眾向掌權者請求、陳情或為民眾爭取權益與福利。
explanation_english: An idiomatic expression meaning to represent or plead for the people — to petition authorities, appeal for relief, or advocate for the rights and welfare of the populace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 議員上星期為民請命，向政府爭取加強基層醫療服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 jyun4 soeng6 sing1 kei4 wai4 man4 cing2 ming6, hoeng3 zing3 fu2 zeng1 ceoi2 gaa1 koeng4 gei1 cang4 ji1 liu4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 议员上星期为民请命，向政府争取加强基层医疗服务。
examples.english_sentence: Last week the councillor petitioned on behalf of the people, asking the government to strengthen grassroots medical services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為記者，佢經常為民請命，報道基層的聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai6 gei3 ze2, keoi5 ging1 soeng4 wai4 man4 cing2 ming6, bou3 dou6 gei1 cang4 dik1 sing1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为记者，他经常为民请命，报道基层的声音。
examples.english_sentence: As a reporter, he often speaks up for the people and reports the voices of the grassroots.

mandarin_meaning: 为民除害（wèi mín chú hài）：为百姓消除祸害、铲除危害社会的人或事
english_meaning: To rid the people of harm; to eliminate threats or evils that harm the populace (often used of officials or authorities taking action against criminals or dangers)
explanation_mandarin: 成語，表示為了保護民眾而消除禍害或懲治禍害之人，多用於描述政府或執法機構打擊犯罪、維護社會秩序的行為。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to eliminate harms or threats for the people. It describes actions (often by government or law enforcement) to suppress criminals or remove dangers to protect public welfare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一上任就承諾要為民除害，嚴打黑社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 soeng5 jam6 zau6 sing4 nok6 jiu3 wai4 man4 ceoi4 hoi6, jim4 daa2 hak1 se5 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一上任就承诺要为民除害，严打黑社会。
examples.english_sentence: He vowed upon taking office to rid the people of harm and crack down on the triads.

mandarin_meaning: 以...为准
english_meaning: to be taken as the standard; to serve as the final criterion
explanation_mandarin: 表示以某事物作为标准或最终依据。
explanation_english: Indicates taking something as the standard or final authority; used to state that something should be used as the reference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以公司嘅最新通知為準，聽日嘅會議時間可能會改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 gung1si1 ge3 zeoi3 san1 tung1zi1 wai4 zeon2, ting1 jat6 ge3 wui6ji5 si4gaan3 ho2nang4 wui5 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以公司的最新通知为准，明天的会议时间可能会改。
examples.english_sentence: Take the company's latest notice as the standard; tomorrow's meeting time may be changed.

mandarin_meaning: 为什么 (wèishénme)
english_meaning: why
explanation_mandarin: 用于询问原因或理由的疑问词，相当于普通话的“为什么”。在粤语口语中也常用“為乜嘢”或“點解”。
explanation_english: A question word used to ask for reasons or causes; equivalent to Mandarin '为什么' and English 'why'. In colloquial Cantonese, forms like '為乜嘢' or '點解' are also common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你為甚麼唔嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai6 sam6 mo1 m4 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么不来？
examples.english_sentence: Why didn't you come?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為甚麼咁嬲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 sam6 mo1 gam2 nau1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为什么这么生气？
examples.english_sentence: Why is he so angry?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔明白你為甚麼要咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ming4 baak6 nei5 wai6 sam6 mo1 jiu3 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不明白你为什么要这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I don't understand why you want to do this.

mandarin_meaning: 調皮、搗蛋、耍性子（口語俚語）
english_meaning: to be cheeky or mischievous; to mess around for fun (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，指故意調皮、搗蛋或耍弄、耍性子，通常帶有玩笑或不太嚴重的惡作劇意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to act mischievously or cheekily — to mess around or play pranks, usually in a lighthearted way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好為皮，成日諗啲古怪主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 wai4 pei4, sing4 jat6 nam2 di1 gu2 gwaai3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很愛搗蛋，整天想一些古怪的主意。
examples.english_sentence: He's very mischievous; he keeps coming up with weird ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好為皮，依家有工作要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai4 pei4, ji1 gaa1 jau5 gung1 zok3 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別調皮了，現在有工作要做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be cheeky; we have work to do now.

mandarin_meaning: 為了
english_meaning: for; in order to; for the sake of
explanation_mandarin: 表示目的或原因，相當於「為了」，常用於書面或較正式的語境。
explanation_english: Indicates purpose or reason; equivalent to "for" or "in order to". Often used in written or more formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為着家庭努力工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zoek3 gaa1 ting4 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了家庭努力工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works hard for his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為着通過考試，每日都溫習到好夜先瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 zoek3 tung1 gwo3 haau2 si3, mui5 jat6 dou1 wan1 zaap6 dou3 hou2 je6 sin1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我為了通過考試，每天都溫習到很晚才睡。
examples.english_sentence: I study late every day to pass the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為着安全，請記住帶備身份證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zoek3 on1 cyun4, ceng2 gei3 zyu6 daai3 bei6 san1 fan6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了安全，請記得帶上身份證。
examples.english_sentence: For safety, please remember to bring your ID.

jyutping: wai4 lou5 bat1 zyun1, gaau3 waai6 zi2 syun1
mandarin_meaning: 身為長者卻行為不端、不值得尊敬，給子孫樹立了壞榜樣
english_meaning: An elder who does not behave with dignity or respect, thereby setting a bad example for their descendants
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容年紀較大的人不守長輩應有的風範或不自重，反而給下一代帶來不良影響或樹立壞榜樣。
explanation_english: Used to describe an older person who fails to behave with the dignity expected of an elder, thereby negatively influencing or setting a bad example for younger generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺為老不尊，教壞子孫，成日喺街度飲酒鬧人，啲細路都學佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 wai4 lou5 bat1 zyun1, gaau3 waai6 zi2 syun1, sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 jam2 zau2 nau6 jan4, di1 sai3 lou6 dou1 hok6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他祖父為老不尊，教壞子孫，整天在街上喝酒罵人，孩子們都學他。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather behaves like an undignified elder and sets a bad example for the children — he's always drinking and shouting at people in the street, and the kids copy him.

mandarin_meaning: 为恶势力或坏人当帮凶、充当帮手（为虎作伥）
english_meaning: to act as an accomplice to evil; to help wrongdoers carry out or cover up their crimes
explanation_mandarin: 指为坏人或恶势力当帮凶，替他们掩饰或协助作恶。
explanation_english: Refers to serving as an accomplice to villains, helping them commit or conceal wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好為虎作倀，幫住佢哋做啲犯法嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wai4 fu2 zok3 coeng1, bong1 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 zou6 di1 faat3 faan6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要为虎作伥，帮着他们做些违法的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act as an accomplice for them and help carry out illegal activities.

mandarin_meaning: （可能为误写）「圍起來」：围拢、围聚在一起、围住
english_meaning: Likely a misspelling of '圍起嚟' — to gather around; to encircle; to surround
explanation_mandarin: 此詞寫作「為起嚟」時非標準寫法，口語中常用的是「圍起嚟」（wai4 hei2 lai4），表示多人或物聚集成一圈、圍住某人或某物，屬口語用法。
explanation_english: The written form '為起嚟' is likely a non-standard/misspelling. The common colloquial form is '圍起嚟' (wai4 hei2 lai4), meaning to gather round, encircle or surround someone/something. It is a spoken Cantonese verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人為起嚟睇表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 wai4 hei2 lai4 tai2 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人們圍著看表演。
examples.english_sentence: People gathered around to watch the performance.

mandarin_meaning: 以……為重；把……看作重要
english_meaning: to consider something important; to give priority to
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某事或某物視為重要，強調優先考慮或重視。
explanation_english: Indicates regarding something as important, emphasizing giving it priority or holding it in high regard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出行以安全為重，唔好心急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 hang4 ji5 ngon1 cyun4 wai4 zung6, m4 hou2 sam1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出行以安全為重，不要心急。
examples.english_sentence: When traveling, prioritize safety; don't be impatient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司以顧客利益為重，唔會犧牲服務質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 gu3 haak3 lei6 jik6 wai4 zung6, m4 wui5 hei1 sang1 fuk6 mou6 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司以顧客利益為重，不會犧牲服務質量。
examples.english_sentence: The company places customers' interests first and won't sacrifice service quality.

mandarin_meaning: 以...为限；限定为...
english_meaning: to be limited to; limited to; only up to
explanation_mandarin: 「為限」常與「以」連用（以...為限），表示把範圍、條件或數量限定在某個範圍或上限內。
explanation_english: Often used with '以' (以...為限), meaning to restrict or limit the scope, conditions, or quantity to a specified range or maximum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次優惠以會員為限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jau1 wai6 ji5 wui6 jyun4 wai4 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本次优惠以会员为限。
examples.english_sentence: This offer is limited to members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 參賽人數以二百人為限，額滿即止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam1 coi3 jan4 sou3 ji5 ji6 baak3 jan4 wai4 haan6, ngaak6 mun5 zik1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 参赛人数以200人为限，额满即止。
examples.english_sentence: The number of participants is limited to 200 people; registration closes when full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學位只以本地學生為限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 wai6 zi2 ji5 bun2 dei6 hok6 saang1 wai4 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学位只限本地学生。
examples.english_sentence: Places are reserved for local students only.

mandarin_meaning: 为难 (使别人处于尴尬或难堪；感到为难、难以应付)
english_meaning: to put (someone) in an awkward or difficult position; to feel awkward or unable to comply
explanation_mandarin: 表示使他人处于尴尬或难堪的处境，也可用来表示自己感到难以应付或不便答应某事。
explanation_english: Used to indicate causing someone to be embarrassed or put in a difficult position; can also describe one's own feeling of awkwardness or inability to comply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想為難你，你自己決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 wai6 naan4 nei5, nei5 zi6 gei2 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想为难你，你自己决定吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to put you in an awkward position; you decide yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試官唔好為難候選人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 gun1 m4 hou2 wai6 naan4 hau6 syun2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试官不要为难候选人。
examples.english_sentence: Interviewers shouldn't make things difficult for candidates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係為難，就講清楚原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 wai6 naan4, zau6 gong2 cing1 co2 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的为难，就把原因说清楚。
examples.english_sentence: If it's really awkward/difficult, explain the reasons clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 为非作恶；做坏事、干坏事
english_meaning: to do evil deeds; to commit wrongdoing; to behave lawlessly
explanation_mandarin: 成語，指做壞事、幹壞事或作惡，帶有貶義，形容人作惡多端或為非作惡。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to commit evil or wrongful acts. It is derogatory and describes someone engaging in malicious or lawless behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲流氓成日喺街度為非作歹，搞到居民好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lau4 mang4 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 wai4 fei1 zok3 daai2, gaau2 dou3 geoi1 man4 hou2 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些流氓经常作恶，搞得居民很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: Those hooligans often commit crimes, making the residents very afraid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有人為非作歹，總有一日會畀法律制裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 wai4 fei1 zok3 daai2, zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 bei2 faat3 leot6 zai3 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有人为非作恶，总有一天会被法律制裁。
examples.english_sentence: If someone commits evil deeds, one day they will be punished by the law.

mandarin_meaning: 愛吃；貪吃
english_meaning: fond of eating; greedy for food; foodie (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容喜歡吃、貪吃或對食物特別有興趣的人，有時帶輕微貶義，也可中性或帶幽默意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who loves to eat or is greedy for food. It can be mildly pejorative, neutral, or joking depending on context; sometimes used like 'foodie'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好為食，成日去搵嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 wai6 sik6, sing4 jat6 heoi3 wan2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很愛吃，經常去找東西吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's very fond of eating; he often goes looking for something to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁為食，小心會發胖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 wai6 sik6, siu2 sam1 wui5 faat3 pong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼愛吃，小心會發胖。
examples.english_sentence: If you eat like that, be careful you'll gain weight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個為食鬼，成日介紹新餐廳俾我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 wai6 sik6 gwai2, sing4 jat6 gaai3 siu6 san1 caan1 teng1 bei2 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個愛吃鬼，經常向我們介紹新餐廳。
examples.english_sentence: He's a foodie who often recommends new restaurants to us.

mandarin_meaning: 吃貨；愛吃的人
english_meaning: foodie; someone who loves to eat (often teasingly)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指喜歡吃、貪吃或對食物特別有興趣的人，語氣可親切或帶戲謔。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a person who loves eating or is greedy for food; often used affectionately or teasingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個為食貓，成日搵新嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 wai6 sik6 maau1, seng4 jat6 wan2 san1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個吃貨，總是找新東西吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's a foodie; always looking for new things to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 愛吃鬼；吃貨；貪吃的人
english_meaning: a foodie; someone who loves to eat; a glutton (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指非常愛吃或容易被食物吸引的人。可用作戲稱或輕微貶義，視語境而定。相當於普通話的「吃貨」或「愛吃鬼」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who loves to eat or is easily tempted by food. It can be used affectionately or mildly pejoratively depending on context; roughly equivalent to 'foodie' or 'glutton'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個為食鬼，成日食到半夜都唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 wai4 sik6 gwai2, sing4 jat6 sik6 dou3 bun3 je6 dou1 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個愛吃鬼，經常吃到半夜都不停。
examples.english_sentence: He's a foodie who often eats until midnight without stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好比個為食鬼搶晒啲餸啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bei2 go3 wai4 sik6 gwai2 coeng2 saai3 di1 sung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別讓那個愛吃鬼把菜都搶光了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't let that foodie grab all the dishes!

mandarin_meaning: 以……為首；領導、帶頭
english_meaning: to lead; to head (a group or action); to be at the forefront
explanation_mandarin: 表示在一群人或一個行動中處於領導或帶頭的位置，常用於「以⋯⋯為首」的結構，說明由某人或某方領導或帶頭。
explanation_english: Indicates being the leader or taking the lead in a group or action. Often used in the structure 'headed by …' or 'led by …' to show who is leading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次小組以阿明為首，完成咗任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 siu2 zou2 ji5 aa3 ming4 wai4 sau2, jyun4 sing4 zo2 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次小組以阿明為首，完成了任務。
examples.english_sentence: This time the small team, headed by Ah Ming, completed the task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遊行由學生為首，吸引咗大量市民參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 hang4 jau4 hok6 sang1 wai4 sau2, kap1 jan5 zo2 daai6 loeng6 si5 man4 caam1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遊行由學生為首，吸引了大量市民參與。
examples.english_sentence: The march was led by students, attracting a large number of citizens to participate.

mandarin_meaning: 猛烈、強烈、激烈
english_meaning: fierce; intense; violent; strong
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度強、猛烈或激烈，可用於描述天氣（如烈日）、情感或競爭等情況，也常用於構成合成詞如「激烈」「強烈」。
explanation_english: Indicates great intensity or fierceness. Used to describe strong heat (e.g.,烈日), intense emotions, or fierce competition. Often appears in compounds such as 激烈 or 強烈.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日烈日當空，出街要帶遮陽傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lit6 jat6 dong1 hung1, ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 daai3 ze1 joeng4 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天烈日當空，出門要帶遮陽傘。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is blazing today; bring a sun umbrella when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場比賽好激烈，雙方都拼得好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 hou2 gik1 lit6, soeng1 fong1 dou1 ping3 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛很激烈，双方都拼得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This match is very intense; both sides are fighting hard.

mandarin_meaning: 烈士（lièshì）：为国家、民族或正义事业而牺牲的人。
english_meaning: martyr; a person who dies for a country, cause, or principle.
explanation_mandarin: “烈士”指为国家、民族、民主、信仰或其他重大正義事业牺牲性命的人，通常帶有尊敬和纪念的意味。
explanation_english: “烈士” refers to a person who sacrificed their life for their country, nation, faith, or a significant just cause; the term is respectful and often used in memorial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲烈士為國捐軀，應該被後人銘記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lit6 si6 wai4 gwok3 gyun1 keoi1, jing1 goi1 bei6 hau6 jan4 ming4 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些烈士为国捐躯，应该被后人铭记。
examples.english_sentence: These martyrs gave their lives for the country and should be remembered by future generations.

mandarin_meaning: 烈日当空 / 骄阳似火
english_meaning: The scorching sun high in the sky; extremely hot (idiom describing blazing midday sun)
explanation_mandarin: 形容太陽高掛，陽光強烈，天氣非常炎熱，常用來描述酷熱的日子。
explanation_english: Describes the sun being high and fierce in the sky; used to indicate very hot, scorching weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日烈日當空，出街記得帶遮同搽防曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lit6 jat6 dong1 hung1, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 tung4 caat3 fong4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天烈日当空，出门记得带伞并涂防晒霜。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is blazing today; remember to take an umbrella and put on sunscreen when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 烈火（liè huǒ），猛烈的火焰；也可比喻激烈的力量或情感。
english_meaning: raging fire; blazing flame; inferno; can be used metaphorically for intense force or passion.
explanation_mandarin: 指猛烈且旺盛的火焰，常用來形容大火或比喻強烈、激烈的情況或情感。
explanation_english: Refers to intense, fierce flames; often describes a large blaze or is used metaphorically for strong, intense situations or emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座大廈起咗烈火，消防員即刻趕嚟救人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 daai6 haa6 hei2 zo2 lit6 fo2, siu1 fong4 jyun4 zik1 hak1 gon2 lai4 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座大厦起了烈火，消防员立刻赶来救人。
examples.english_sentence: A raging fire broke out in that building; firefighters rushed over to rescue people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上表演好似烈火咁熱情，感染晒全場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 biu2 jin2 hou2 ci5 lit6 fo2 gam2 jit6 cing4, gam2 jin5 saai3 cyun4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上的表演像烈火一样热情，感染了全场。
examples.english_sentence: His performance on stage was as passionate as a blazing fire, moving the entire audience.

mandarin_meaning: 烈焰（lièyàn）：猛烈、炽热的火焰；也可作比喻，形容强烈的情感或气势。
english_meaning: blazing flame; fierce or intense fire; also used metaphorically for intense passion or force
explanation_mandarin: “烈焰”指猛烈、炽热且范围或温度都很高的火焰。常用于描述大火、焚烧的情景，也常在比喻意义上用来形容激情、愤怒或气势等强烈状态。
explanation_english: “烈焰” denotes powerful, intensely hot flames. It is used to describe large or fierce fires and is also frequently used metaphorically to depict intense emotions (such as passion or rage) or powerful momentum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大廈失火，烈焰吞噬整層樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 haa6 sat1 fo2, lit6 jim6 tan1 zap6 zing2 cang4 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大厦失火，烈焰吞噬整层楼。
examples.english_sentence: The building caught fire; blazing flames engulfed the entire floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅激情似烈焰咁熾熱，令人難以忘懷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gik1 cing4 ci5 lit6 jim6 gam2 ci3 jit6, ling6 jan4 naan4 ji5 mong4 waai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的激情如烈焰般炽热，让人难以忘怀。
examples.english_sentence: His passion was like blazing flames, making it unforgettable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員冒住烈焰搶救被困嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 mou6 zyu6 lit6 jim6 coeng2 gau3 bei6 kwan3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员冒着烈焰抢救被困的人。
examples.english_sentence: Firefighters braved the blazing flames to rescue those who were trapped.

mandarin_meaning: 烈酒（烈性酒）
english_meaning: spirits; strong liquor (high-alcohol alcoholic beverages)
explanation_mandarin: 烈酒指酒精含量較高的酒類，例如威士忌、伏特加、朗姆酒等，通常作為蒸餾酒或烈性酒。
explanation_english: Spirits or strong alcoholic beverages with relatively high alcohol content, typically distilled liquors such as whiskey, vodka, or rum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲烈酒嘅酒精度好高，要小心飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 lit6 zau2 ge3 zau2 zing1 dou6 hou2 gou1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些烈酒的酒精度很高，要小心飲用。
examples.english_sentence: These spirits have a high alcohol content; drink with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意飲烈酒，尤其係威士忌同朗姆酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 jam2 lit6 zau2, jau1 kei4 hai6 wai1 si6 gei3 tung4 long5 mou5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡喝烈酒，尤其是威士忌和朗姆酒。
examples.english_sentence: He likes drinking spirits, especially whiskey and rum.

mandarin_meaning: 烈风（强烈的风）
english_meaning: gale; violent/strong wind
explanation_mandarin: 指猛烈、有力的風，常用於書面語或氣象報告來描述強風天氣。
explanation_english: Refers to a violent or very strong wind (gale). Often used in written language or weather reports to describe gale-force conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝有烈風，我哋去唔到海邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 jau5 lit6 fung1, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 m4 dou2 hoi2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有烈风，我们去不了海边。
examples.english_sentence: There was a strong gale this morning; we couldn't go to the seafront.

mandarin_meaning: 融化；溶解（拼音：yáng）
english_meaning: to melt; to liquefy; to dissolve
explanation_mandarin: 指固體因受熱或其他原因變為液體，或物質溶解的過程。常用於描述冰、蠟等的熔化。
explanation_english: Refers to a solid becoming liquid due to heat or other causes, or the process of dissolving. Often used to describe melting of ice, wax, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雪糕喺咁熱會烊晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syut3 gou1 hai6 gam2 jit6 wui5 joeng4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冰淇淋在這麼熱會融化。
examples.english_sentence: The ice cream will melt in such heat.

mandarin_meaning: （乌）黑、暗；烏鴉（鳥名）
english_meaning: black/dark; (a) crow
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「烏」（簡體作「乌」）在粵語讀作 wu1，常用來表示顏色的黑或暗，也出現在表示烏鴉等詞彙中。可作形容詞（如「烏黑」）或名詞（如「烏鴉」）。
explanation_english: The character 烏 (simplified 乌) is pronounced wu1 in Cantonese. It commonly denotes black/dark or appears in words for crow. It can function as an adjective (e.g., "烏黑") or a noun (e.g., "烏鴉").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天色烏黑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 sik1 wu1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天色乌黑。
examples.english_sentence: The sky is pitch black.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住件烏色衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 wu1 sik1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她穿著一件黑色的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is wearing a black shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樹上有隻烏鴉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu6 soeng5 jau5 zek3 wu1 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 樹上有一隻烏鴉。
examples.english_sentence: There's a crow on the tree.

mandarin_meaning: 以「烏」為開頭但第二個字未知或被隱去的表記（□ 表示省略或被遮蔽的字）
english_meaning: A notation using '烏' plus a blank square to indicate that the second character (after '烏') is unknown, omitted, or censored
explanation_mandarin: 「烏□」並不是一個獨立的詞語，而是一種書寫表記，常用於報章、文本或口語書寫中，用 □ 來代表被省略、未知或被遮蔽的字，例如欲隱去或不便直接寫出的第二個字。
explanation_english: ‘烏□’ is not an independent lexical item but a written notation: the square (□) stands for a missing, omitted, or censored character following 烏. It is used when the writer/speaker wants to indicate a word starting with 烏 but leaves the second character unknown or intentionally hidden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲報紙寫住「烏□」，好似係要隱去嗰個字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bou3 zi2 se2 zyu6 "wu1 □", hou2 ci5 hai6 jiu3 jan2 heoi3 go2 go3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报纸上写着「烏□」，好像是要隐去那个字。
examples.english_sentence: The newspaper wrote '烏□', it seems they wanted to hide that character.

mandarin_meaning: 烏龍（wūlóng）：口語中指大錯誤、失誤或烏龍事件；另指烏龍茶。
english_meaning: A blunder or mishap (slang); also refers to oolong tea.
explanation_mandarin: 「烏龍」在口語中常用來形容因疏忽或差錯而造成的事件或失誤（如「發生烏龍」）；此外為茶類名稱「烏龍茶」。
explanation_english: In colloquial use, "烏龍" describes a blunder, mishap, or an embarrassing mistake (e.g., "an oops/mess-up"). It also denotes the tea type oolong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今朝出咗個大烏龍，報告入面啲數字全部錯咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 gam1ziu1 ceot1 zo2 go3 daai6 wu1 lung4, bou3gou3 jap6min6 di1 sou3 zi6 cyun4bou6 co3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今天出了個大烏龍，報告裡面的數字全部錯了。
examples.english_sentence: The company made a big blunder this morning; all the figures in the report were wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 笨蛋；傻瓜
english_meaning: fool; idiot
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，用來形容某人愚蠢或做事笨拙，帶有輕微或中度的貶義。常見於香港的日常對話中，屬於非正式用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to call someone foolish or clumsy. It carries a mild to moderate derogatory tone and is commonly used informally in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做真係烏㰖喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zan1 hai6 wu1 zaap6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做真是笨蛋啊。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that is really foolish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢，佢只係個烏㰖罷了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 zi2 hai6 go3 wu1 zaap6 baa6 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理他，他只是個笨蛋而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mind him; he's just an idiot.

mandarin_meaning: 笨、傻、愚蠢（廣東話俚語）
english_meaning: stupid; foolish; clumsy (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「烏低」是廣東話口語/俚語，用來形容人笨拙、做事愚蠢或反應慢。帶有一定貶義，主要在香港粵語口語中使用。
explanation_english: “烏低” is Cantonese colloquial/slang used to describe someone who is dull, foolish, clumsy, or slow to react. It carries a mildly derogatory tone and is primarily used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁烏低做咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 wu1 dai1 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼笨做什麼？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so stupid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢真係好烏低，成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 wu1 dai1, seng4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事真的很笨，老是出錯。
examples.english_sentence: He works so carelessly/stupidly and keeps making mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 低頭、彎腰；比喻卑躬屈膝或為了某利益而示弱
english_meaning: to duck/stoop down; figuratively to abase oneself or act submissively (e.g., to kowtow for benefits)
explanation_mandarin: 「烏低身」在廣東話可指身體實際彎腰躲避，也常用作俗語，形容人為了利益或避免衝突而刻意卑躬屈膝、示弱。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "烏低身" can mean physically to bend down or duck; colloquially it often means to abase oneself or act submissively—doing so to gain favor or avoid trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗升職，成日喺老細面前烏低身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 sing1 zik1, seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 wu1 dai1 san1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了升職，經常在老闆面前卑躬屈膝。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly humbles himself in front of the boss to get promoted.

mandarin_meaning: 乌克兰（乌克兰国），位于欧洲东部的国家
english_meaning: Ukraine (the country in Eastern Europe)
explanation_mandarin: 指位于欧洲东部的主权国家乌克兰，中文的国名翻译。
explanation_english: The Chinese name for the country of Ukraine, located in Eastern Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去烏克蘭旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 wu1 hak1 laan4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去乌克兰旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel to Ukraine next month.

mandarin_meaning: 烏冬（日本粗麵條，日語：うどん）
english_meaning: Udon (Japanese thick wheat noodles)
explanation_mandarin: 借自日語「うどん」，指日本的一種粗小麥麵條，可熱食或冷食，常以湯或醬汁配食。香港粵語通常直接稱為「烏冬」或「烏冬麵」。
explanation_english: Borrowed from Japanese 'udon' (うどん). Refers to thick wheat noodles commonly served hot in broth or chilled with dipping sauce. In Cantonese, it is usually called '烏冬' or '烏冬麵'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食烏冬，唔想食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 wu1 dung1, m4 soeng2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃烏冬，不想吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat udon tonight, not rice.

mandarin_meaning: 乌冬面（烏冬麪）：日本式的粗麵條，以小麦粉製作，可熱食或冷食，常見於各種湯底或沾麵。
english_meaning: Udon noodles: thick Japanese wheat noodles, chewy in texture, served in hot broths or chilled with dipping sauce.
explanation_mandarin: 烏冬麪是源自日本的麵食，麵條較粗，口感彈牙。常見吃法有熱湯烏冬（如釜揚烏冬、醬油湯底）或冷食配沾醬，配料可有天婦羅、蔥花、蒲燒等。
explanation_english: Udon is a type of thick Japanese noodle made from wheat flour, known for its chewy texture. Common preparations include hot soups or chilled with dipping sauce; toppings often include tempura, scallions, or broiled items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想食烏冬麪，去邊間好呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 wu1 dung1 min6, heoi3 bin1 gaan1 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚想吃乌冬面，去哪一家比較好？
examples.english_sentence: I feel like having udon tonight — which place is good?

mandarin_meaning: 烏冬麵（日本的烏冬，粗小麥麵條）
english_meaning: udon noodles (Japanese thick wheat noodles)
explanation_mandarin: 指日本料理中的烏冬麵，為較粗的麵條，常以熱湯或冷食方式搭配各種配料和湯底。在香港的粵語日常用語中亦常以「烏冬麵」或簡稱「烏冬」指這類麵食。
explanation_english: Refers to Japanese udon noodles, a type of thick wheat noodle often served hot in broth or chilled with dipping sauce and various toppings. In Hong Kong Cantonese it is commonly called "烏冬麵" or simply "烏冬."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去食烏冬麵啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 sik6 wu1 dung1 min6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去吃烏冬面吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat udon tonight!

mandarin_meaning: （口語）形容人或事物卑劣、惡劣、令人討厭或骯髒
english_meaning: colloquial Cantonese adjective meaning despicable, nasty, filthy or disgusting
explanation_mandarin: 烏劣劣為廣東話口語或俚語，用來形容人或事情很卑劣、可惡、令人反感，或形容物件骯髒、糟糕。語氣偏負面且非正式。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang adjective used to describe a person or thing as despicable, nasty, disgusting, or filthy. It carries a strong negative, informal tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人好烏劣劣，唔想同佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 wu1 lit6 lit6, m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個人很卑劣，我不想跟他做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: This person is really despicable; I don't want to be friends with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫又污糟又有味，真係烏劣劣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau6 wu1 zong1 jau6 jau5 mei6, zan1 hai6 wu1 lit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服又髒又有味，真是很噁心/糟糕。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is dirty and smelly — really gross.

mandarin_meaning: 漆黑、陰暗或黑壓壓的樣子
english_meaning: dark, gloomy, densely black (appearance); a gloomy or oppressive look
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容天色、環境或一大片景象顯得很黑、陰沉或密集成一片黑色，帶有沉悶或壓迫感。有時也用來形容人群或物件密集而望落去一片黑。
explanation_english: Describes a scene that looks very dark, gloomy, or densely black (e.g., the sky, an area, or a crowd). Conveys a sense of dimness, oppressiveness, or a compact dark mass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天色開始變得烏卒卒，可能快要落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 sik1 hoi1 ci2 bin3 dak1 wu1 zuk1 zuk1, ho2 nang4 faai3 jiu3 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天色開始變得昏暗，可能快要下雨。
examples.english_sentence: The sky started to turn dark and gloomy; it might rain soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威嗰日，街上企咗好多黑衫人，望落去成條街烏卒卒，好震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 go2 jat6, gaai1 soeng6 kei5 zo2 hou2 do1 hak1 saam1 jan4, mong6 lok6 heoi3 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 wu1 zuk1 zuk1, hou2 zan3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威那天，街上站了很多穿黑衣的人，望去整條街黑壓壓的，很震撼。
examples.english_sentence: On the day of the protest, many people in black stood on the street; the whole street looked densely black—very striking.

mandarin_meaning: 愁眉苦臉、沉默不語或不悅的樣子
english_meaning: sullen; sulky; having a dark, displeased expression and being taciturn
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人面色陰沉、不高興或沉默不語，表現出悶悶不樂或生氣的樣子。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who looks sullen or displeased and is taciturn—shows a moody, sulky, or morose expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日成日烏口烏面，連答問題都唔想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 wu1 hau2 wu1 min6, lin4 daap3 man6 tai4 dou1 m4 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天整天愁眉苦臉，連回答問題都不想說。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sulking all day today; he doesn't even want to answer questions.

mandarin_meaning: 乌合之众（wū hé zhī zhòng）：指没有组织、纪律和领导的一群人，常含贬义，形容杂乱无章、缺乏凝聚力或战斗力的群体。
english_meaning: A rabble; a disorderly crowd or mob; figuratively, an unorganized, ineffective group lacking cohesion or leadership.
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容一群没有组织、缺乏纪律或领导的人，通常带有贬义，强调杂乱无序或无战斗力。
explanation_english: Used to describe a group of people without organization, discipline, or leadership; usually derogatory, emphasizing disorder or ineffectiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班人根本冇計劃，淨係一班烏合之眾，做唔成乜嘢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 jan4 gan1 bun2 mou5 gai3 waak6, zing6 hai6 jat1 baan1 wu1 hap6 zi1 zung3, zou6 m4 seng4 mat1 je5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些人根本没有计划，只是一群乌合之众，做不成什么事情。
examples.english_sentence: These people have no plan; they're just a rabble and can't get anything done.

mandarin_meaning: 烏合之眾（形容一群沒有組織、紀律或凝聚力的人）
english_meaning: a disorderly crowd; a ragtag or motley group lacking organization or discipline
explanation_mandarin: 指一群雜亂無章、缺乏組織和紀律的人，行動散漫、難以達成目標，常帶貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to a crowd or group that is disorganized, undisciplined, and lacking cohesion; often used pejoratively to describe people who cannot act effectively together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲人只係一班烏合之衆，做乜嘢都冇章法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 jan4 zi2 hai6 jat1 baan1 wu1 hap6 zi1 zung3, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 mou5 zoeng1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人只是一群烏合之眾，做什麼都沒有章法。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are just a ragtag crowd; they do everything without any order.

mandarin_meaning: 害羞、怯場或畏縮不前
english_meaning: to act shy/hesitant; to sulk or hang back timidly
explanation_mandarin: 口語擬聲詞，形容人因害羞、怯場或不願意而顯得畏縮、吞吞吐吐、做事拖泥帶水或小小地耍脾氣。
