examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話上個禮拜畀差人叫去焗茶，問咗成晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 bei2 caa1 jan4 giu3 heoi3 guk6 caa4, man6 zo2 seng4 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说上个礼拜被警察叫去问话，被问了一整晚。
examples.english_sentence: He said last week the cops called him in for questioning and grilled him all night.

mandarin_meaning: 焗烤螃蟹；焗蟹（菜名）
english_meaning: baked/gratinated crab (a dish)
explanation_mandarin: 「焗蟹」指將螃蟹加上材料（如芝士、蒜蓉、牛油等）放入焗爐焗烤而成的菜式，常見於粵菜酒樓或海鮮餐廳。也可用來指一份這樣的菜。
explanation_english: “焗蟹” is a dish of crab baked or gratinated (often with ingredients like cheese, garlic butter, or breadcrumbs). It is commonly served at Cantonese restaurants and seafood eateries and refers to the prepared dish or a serving of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去酒樓食焗蟹啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 zau2 lau4 sik6 guk6 haai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去酒楼吃焗蟹吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the restaurant to eat baked crab tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個焗蟹好香，有芝士同蒜蓉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 guk6 haai5 hou2 hoeng1, jau5 zi1 si6 tung4 syun3 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个焗蟹很香，有芝士和蒜蓉。
examples.english_sentence: This baked crab smells great; it has cheese and garlic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋叫一份焗蟹同一碗白飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 giu3 jat1 fan6 guk6 haai5 tung4 jat1 wun2 baak6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们点了一份焗蟹和一碗白饭。
examples.english_sentence: We ordered a serving of baked crab and a bowl of plain rice.

mandarin_meaning: 被逼、被迫；被困住
english_meaning: to be forced/pressured into something; to be stuck/trapped (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「焗親」是廣東話口語，字面上「焗」有逼迫、悶熱之意，加上結果補語「親」，表示某人被逼到、被迫做某事或被困在某個情況中。常用於描述受壓力或被困住的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression. Literally combining 焗 (guk6, to force/to steam) with the resultative 親 (can1), it means to be forced or pressured into something, or to be stuck/trapped in a situation. Used informally to describe being pressured or confined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日加班，經常焗親啲員工做多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 sing4 jat6 gaa1 baan1, ging1 soeng4 guk6 can1 di1 jyun4 gung1 zou6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板经常逼員工加班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss often pressures the staff to work overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵出事，成班人焗親喺月台度好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 ceot1 si6, seng4 baan1 jan4 guk6 can1 hai2 jyut6 toi4 dou6 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁出事，很多人被困在月台上很久。
examples.english_sentence: There was an incident on the subway, and many people were stuck on the platform for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 悶雨（悶熱潮濕的下雨天）
english_meaning: muggy rain; an oppressive, humid rainy condition
explanation_mandarin: 「焗雨」為廣東話俗語，指在悶熱、潮濕的天氣中伴隨的降雨，讓人感到悶促、不舒服，常用於描述香港一帶的天氣狀況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing rainy weather that is muggy and oppressive — humid rain that makes the atmosphere feel stuffy and uncomfortable, often used to describe Hong Kong–style weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日成日都係焗雨，出街感覺好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 guk6 jyu5, ceot1 gaai1 gam2 gok3 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天整天都是焗雨，出門感覺很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: It's been muggy rainy all day — it feels uncomfortable to go outside.

mandarin_meaning: 焗饭 / 焗烤饭（焗烤米饭）
english_meaning: baked rice; gratin-style rice (rice baked with sauce, toppings and often cheese)
explanation_mandarin: 指把米饭与配料（如肉类、蔬菜及调味料）拌好后放入烤箱或焗炉加热，通常表面有芝士或酱汁并烤至金黄的一类菜肴。香港粤语常用于餐厅菜单或日常用语。
explanation_english: Refers to a dish where rice is mixed with ingredients (meat, vegetables, sauce) and baked in an oven, often topped with cheese or sauce and browned on top. Common on Hong Kong menus and in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食焗飯，去嗰間餐廳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 guk6 faan6, heoi3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃焗饭，我们去那家餐厅吧。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat baked rice tonight — let's go to that restaurant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個雞肉焗飯好好味，芝士都焗到金黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai1 juk6 guk6 faan6 hou2 hou2 mei6, zi1 si6 dou1 guk6 dou3 gam1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个鸡肉焗饭很好吃，芝士都烤得金黄。
examples.english_sentence: This chicken baked rice is delicious; the cheese is nicely golden.

mandarin_meaning: 烘烤、焙烤（如烘焙食物、茶葉、咖啡豆等）
english_meaning: to bake; to roast; to parch; to dry by heat (used for food, tea leaves, coffee beans, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用熱力對食物、茶葉或咖啡豆等進行烘烤或焙乾，使其熟、增香或去濕。
explanation_english: Denotes applying heat to bake or roast items such as food, tea leaves, or coffee beans to cook, enhance aroma, or dry them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學緊烘焙，想做麵包師傅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 gan2 hung1 bui3, soeng2 zou6 min6 baau1 si1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在學烘焙，想當麵包師傅。
examples.english_sentence: He's learning baking; he wants to become a baker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅會把茶葉焙一焙，令佢更加香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu1 wui5 baa2 caa4 jip6 bui3 jat1 bui3, ling6 keoi5 gang3 gaa1 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 師傅會把茶葉焙一下，使它更香。
examples.english_sentence: The master will roast the tea leaves a bit to make them more fragrant.

mandarin_meaning: 烘焙炉（用于烘烤或焙烧物料的炉子，例如咖啡豆、茶叶或中草药）
english_meaning: roasting oven / roaster (a stove or furnace used for roasting or baking materials such as coffee beans, tea leaves, or herbs)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來焙烤或烘焙物料的爐子或設備，常見於咖啡烘焙、茶葉處理或中藥材焙乾等工序。
explanation_english: A device or furnace used for roasting or baking materials. Commonly used in coffee roasting, tea processing, or for drying herbs and other ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部焙火爐啱啱買返嚟，係用嚟焙烤咖啡豆同茶葉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 bui6 fo2 lou4 aam1 aam1 maai5 faan1 lei4, hai6 jung6 lai4 bui6 haau1 gaa3 fe1 dau2 tung4 caa4 jip6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台焙火炉刚买回来，用来焙烤咖啡豆和茶叶的。
examples.english_sentence: We just bought this roaster; it's used for roasting coffee beans and tea leaves.

mandarin_meaning: 焚（fén）：焚烧、焚毁；烧掉（多用于书面或文言）
english_meaning: to burn; to set on fire; to incinerate (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: “焚”是一个书面或文言色彩较强的动词，表示用火烧毁、焚烧，常见于“焚烧”、“焚香”、“焚书”等词语中。
explanation_english: “焚” is a literary/formal verb meaning to burn or set on fire. It appears in compounds such as 焚燒 (to burn/incinerate), 焚香 (to burn incense), 焚書 (to burn books).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 二戰嗰陣，好多古書俾人焚燒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji6 zin3 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 gu2 syu1 bei2 jan4 fan4 siu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 二战那时，许多古书被焚烧了。
examples.english_sentence: During World War II, many ancient books were burned.

mandarin_meaning: 焚烧；火化（将物品或遗体用火烧成灰）
english_meaning: to incinerate; to cremate (to burn into ashes)
explanation_mandarin: 指用火焚烧使之化为灰烬，既可用于处理垃圾，也可指对遗体进行火化。
explanation_english: Refers to burning something to ashes by fire; can mean incinerating waste or cremating a body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定將部分垃圾送去焚化爐焚化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 bou6 fan6 laap6 saap3 song3 heoi3 fan4 faa3 lou4 fan4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定将部分垃圾送去焚化炉焚化。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to send some of the garbage to the incinerator for incineration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家人最後決定把遺體焚化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 jan4 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 baa2 wai4 tai2 fan4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家人最后决定把遗体焚化。
examples.english_sentence: The family finally decided to cremate the remains.

mandarin_meaning: 焚化炉（用于焚烧垃圾或遗体的设备）
english_meaning: incinerator; a furnace used to burn waste or corpses
explanation_mandarin: 焚化爐是用來焚燒垃圾或遺體的設備，常見於垃圾處理廠或殯葬設施，用以減少廢棄物體積或處理遺體。
explanation_english: An incinerator — a furnace used to burn waste or human remains. Commonly found at waste-treatment facilities or funeral/cremation sites to reduce refuse volume or cremate bodies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市政府計劃興建一座焚化爐，用來處理城市垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 hing1 gin3 jat1 zo6 fan4 faa3 lou4 jung6 loi4 cyu3 lei5 dou1 si6 laap6 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市政府计划兴建一座焚化炉，用来处理城市垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: The city government plans to build an incinerator to handle urban garbage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定喺殯儀館旁邊加建一座焚化爐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 hai2 ban3 ji4 gun2 pong4 bin1 gaa1 gin3 jat1 zo6 fan4 faa3 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定在殡仪馆旁边加建一座焚化炉。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to add an incinerator/crematorium beside the funeral home.

mandarin_meaning: 焚书坑儒
english_meaning: Book-burning and burying of (Confucian) scholars; suppression of intellectual dissent
explanation_mandarin: 源自秦朝焚書坑儒的歷史事件，指焚毀書籍、處罰或殺害學者，後用以比喻政治上壓制思想、迫害學者或鎮壓異見。
explanation_english: Refers to the historical event under the Qin dynasty of burning books and burying Confucian scholars; now used to describe the suppression of intellectual freedom, persecution of scholars, or harsh repression of dissenting ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府焚書坑儒咁嘅做法，係對學術自由嘅嚴重打擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 fan4 syu1 haang1 jyu4 gam2 ge3 zou6 faat3, hai6 deoi3 hok6 seot6 zi6 jau4 ge3 jim4 zung6 daa2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府像焚书坑儒那样的做法，是对学术自由的严重打击。
examples.english_sentence: The government's book-burning-and-burying-scholars approach is a severe blow to academic freedom.

mandarin_meaning: 焚毁（fén huǐ）：用火焚燒並摧毀
english_meaning: to burn down; to destroy by fire; to incinerate
explanation_mandarin: 指用火焚燒並摧毀建築物或物品，常見於書面或新聞報導中。
explanation_english: To destroy something by setting it on fire; to burn down buildings or objects. Often used in formal or news contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人故意焚毀倉庫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 gu3 ji3 fan4 wai2 cong1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方懷疑有人故意焚毀倉庫。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone deliberately burned down the warehouse.

mandarin_meaning: 焚烧（用火烧掉、焚化）
english_meaning: to burn; to incinerate; to set on fire
explanation_mandarin: 指用火焚燒或燒掉物品，常用於焚燒垃圾、焚化工業廢料或焚燒遺體等處理方式，具有環境與安全影響。
explanation_english: Refers to burning or setting something on fire; commonly used for burning rubbish, incinerating industrial waste, or cremation. It often has environmental and safety implications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人喺郊外焚燒垃圾，啲濃煙好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 hai2 gaau1 ngoi6 fan4 siu1 laap6 saap3, di1 nung4 jin1 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在郊外焚烧垃圾，那些浓烟很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Someone is burning trash in the countryside; the thick smoke is very dangerous.

mandarin_meaning: 焚毁；用火烧掉，毁灭
english_meaning: to burn up; to destroy by fire
explanation_mandarin: 指用火焚燒、摧毀事物，常用於法庭語境或新聞報導，表示藉火將證據、建築等毀滅。
explanation_english: To destroy something by setting it on fire; often used in legal or news contexts to describe burning documents, buildings, or evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗掩蓋證據，竟然焚燬咗啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 jim2 goi3 zing3 geoi3, ging2 jin4 fan4 wai2 zo2 di1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們為了掩蓋證據，竟然焚毀了那些文件。
examples.english_sentence: They actually burned those documents to conceal the evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 焚琴煮鹤（毁掉美好、高雅或珍贵的事物）
english_meaning: To burn the zither and boil the crane — to senselessly destroy or ruin something refined, valuable, or culturally important
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（比喻性短語，可作謂語或定語）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (figurative expression, used attributively or predicatively)
explanation_mandarin: 出自典故，用焚燒琴、烹煮仙鶴這類高雅之物來比喻糟蹋、破壞珍貴或高雅的事物，或以短視、蠻橫的方式毀掉有價值之物。
explanation_english: An allusive idiom that likens burning a fine zither and cooking a crane to wantonly ruining elegant, valuable, or culturally important things — often implying wastefulness, short-sightedness, or contempt for refinement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府為咗發展，拆咗舊街坊嘅文化地標，真係焚琴煮鶴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wai6 zo2 faat3 zin2, caak3 zo2 gau6 gaai1 fong1 ge3 man4 faa3 dei6 biu1, zan1 hai6 fan4 kam4 zyu2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府為了發展，拆掉了舊街區的文化地標，真是焚琴煮鶴。
examples.english_sentence: The government tore down the old neighborhood's cultural landmark for development — it's truly burning the zither and boiling the crane.

mandarin_meaning: 焚风；干热的风
english_meaning: a hot, dry wind (like a föhn); burning wind that raises temperatures and dries vegetation
explanation_mandarin: 指一种干燥、炙热的风，类似暖下沉气流或焚烧般的热风，会使气温升高并增加火险。
explanation_english: Refers to a hot, dry wind — a burning wind similar to a föhn or katabatic warm wind; it raises temperatures and dries out vegetation, increasing wildfire risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有焚風，天氣又乾又熱，容易起火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi6 gan6 jau5 fan4 fung1, tin1 hei3 jau6 gon1 jau6 jit6, jung4 ji6 hei2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近刮着焚风，天气又干又热，容易引发火灾。
examples.english_sentence: There's been a hot, dry wind recently; the weather is dry and hot and it's easy for fires to start.

mandarin_meaning: 没有 / 无
english_meaning: not have; there is no; without
explanation_mandarin: 「無」在廣東話中表示否定或缺乏，等同普通話的「沒有」或書面語的「無」。口語通常寫作「冇」，可用來表示「沒有、無法、沒發生」等含義。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "無" expresses negation or absence, equivalent to Mandarin "沒有" or literary "無". In colloquial writing it's often written as "冇". It is used to mean "not have", "there is no", or "not (do)".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我無錢買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou4 cin2 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒有錢買東西。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have money to buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她沒有來。
examples.english_sentence: He/She didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次無得贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 mou4 dak1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次沒得贏。
examples.english_sentence: There's no way to win this time.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有⋯就不高興/不滿足；非⋯不可
english_meaning: not happy unless ...; won't be satisfied without ...; must have ... to be pleased
explanation_mandarin: 「無⋯不歡」是一種結構性慣用語，表示某人如果沒有某種事物或條件就不會感到滿意或高興。常見用法如「無辣不歡」、「無肉不歡」。
explanation_english: "無⋯不歡" is a fixed expression pattern meaning someone won't be satisfied or happy unless a certain thing/condition is present. Common usages include "無辣不歡" (must have spice) and "無肉不歡" (must have meat).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個食家，無辣不歡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 sik6 gaa1, mou4 laat6 bat1 fun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個吃貨，沒有辣的就不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He's a foodie; he won't be happy unless the food is spicy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我無肉不歡，餐餐都要有肉先至開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou4 juk6 bat1 fun1, caan1 caan1 dou1 jiu3 jau5 juk6 sin1 zi3 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒有肉就不滿足，每餐都要有肉才開心。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not satisfied without meat; I need meat in every meal to be happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買嘢嗰陣，佢無折扣不歡，見到平嘢就會買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 je5 go2 zan6, keoi5 mou4 zit3 kau3 bat1 fun1, gin3 dou3 peng4 je5 zau6 wui5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 逛街的時候，他沒有折扣就不滿足，看到便宜的東西就會買。
examples.english_sentence: When shopping, he won't be satisfied unless there's a discount; he buys things when they're cheap.

mandarin_meaning: 无一幸免（没有一个能够幸免于难）
english_meaning: not a single one is spared; none escape unscathed
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有一個人或事物能夠倖免於災禍或不利情況，全部都受到影響或牽連。
explanation_english: Indicates that not a single person or thing is spared from misfortune or adverse effects; all are affected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次地震，村入面嘅屋無一倖免，全部都受損。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 dei6 zan3, cyun1 jap6 min6 ge3 uk1 mou4 jat1 hang6 min5, cyun4 bou6 dou1 sau6 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次地震，村里的房屋无一幸免，全部都受损。
examples.english_sentence: In this earthquake, none of the village houses were spared; they were all damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺疫情期間，細鋪無一倖免，有啲要結業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jik6 cing4 kei4 gaan1, sai3 pou3 mou4 jat1 hang6 min5, jau5 di1 jiu3 git3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在疫情期间，小店无一幸免，有的要结业。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, small shops were not spared; some had to close.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有一個倖免 / 無一倖免（都沒能倖免）
english_meaning: not a single one is spared; none escape; without exception
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有一個人或事物能倖免，全部受到相同的影響或遭遇，常用來形容災禍、流行病或普遍損失。
explanation_english: Indicates that not a single person or thing escapes; all are affected or suffer the same fate. Commonly used to describe disasters, epidemics, or widespread losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲電腦都中咗病毒，無一幸免。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 din6 nou5 dou1 zung6 zo2 beng6 duk6, mou4 jat1 hang6 min5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些電腦都感染了病毒，無一倖免。
examples.english_sentence: None of the computers escaped the virus; all were infected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風吹襲，成個村都無一幸免，損失好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 ceoi1 zaap6, sing4 go3 cyun1 dou1 mou4 jat1 hang6 min5, syun2 sat1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風襲來，整個村莊無一倖免，損失很大。
examples.english_sentence: The typhoon hit and the entire village was not spared; the losses were severe.

mandarin_meaning: 事出三次就成定例 / 三番兩次就會成為習慣
english_meaning: It takes three occurrences for something to become a pattern; after happening three times it becomes customary or a habit.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某種行為或情況出現到第三次時，就會被其他人視為常態或成為規矩、習慣。
explanation_english: Used to say that when a behavior or situation occurs three times, people start treating it as a pattern, custom, or habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲小錯誤唔係一次兩次，無三不成幾，遲早會變成習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 siu2 co3 ng6 m4 hai6 jat1 ci3 loeng5 ci3, mou4 saam1 bat1 sing4 gei2, ci4 zou2 wui5 bin3 sing4 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些小错误不是一次两次，事出三次就会变成习惯。
examples.english_sentence: These little mistakes aren't just once or twice; if they happen three times they'll become a habit.

mandarin_meaning: 无上（至高、無可超越）
english_meaning: supreme; unsurpassed; paramount
explanation_mandarin: 表示至高、無可超越或最高無比的地位或程度，常用於表達崇高的榮譽或地位。
explanation_english: Indicates the highest, unsurpassable, or supreme status/degree; often used to express exalted honor or status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對我嚟講，媽媽嘅愛係無上嘅幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2, maa4 maa1 ge3 oi3 hai6 mou4 soeng6 ge3 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 對我來說，媽媽的愛是無上的幸福。
examples.english_sentence: To me, a mother's love is the supreme happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 能夠獲得國家嘅表彰係一種無上嘅榮耀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nang4 gau3 wok6 dak1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 biu2 zoeng1 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou4 soeng6 ge3 wing4 jiu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能夠獲得國家的表彰是一種無上的榮耀。
examples.english_sentence: Receiving recognition from the state is a supreme honor.

mandarin_meaning: 沒穿上衣；上半身赤裸
english_meaning: not wearing a top; shirtless; bare-chested
explanation_mandarin: 「無上裝」是粵語口語，用來形容上半身沒有穿上衣或上裝，常用於描述赤膊或沒穿襯衫、T恤等的情況，語氣可中性或口語化。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "無上裝" literally means "no top" and is used colloquially to describe someone not wearing an upper garment (shirtless/bare-chested). It’s typically used literally and can be neutral or casual in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺沙灘無上裝，喺度晒太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 saa1 taan1 mou4 soeng6 zong1, hai2 dou6 saai3 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在沙灘沒穿上衣，在那裡曬太陽。
examples.english_sentence: He's on the beach without a top, sunbathing there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔可以喺屋企無上裝跑來跑去，會著涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 uk1 kei2 mou4 soeng6 zong1 paau2 loi4 paau2 heoi3, wui5 zoek3 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩不能在家沒穿上衣到處跑，會著涼。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't run around the house without a top on; they'll catch a cold.

mandarin_meaning: 无中生有（凭空捏造，捏造不存在的事情）
english_meaning: to fabricate something out of nothing; to make up facts without basis
explanation_mandarin: 指没有根据地捏造事实或从无到有地虚构某事。常用来批评造谣、捏造或凭空编造的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to inventing facts without any basis or creating something out of nothing. Commonly used to criticize fabrication, rumor-mongering, or baseless accusations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好無中生有，件事根本唔係咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 mou4 zung1 saang1 jau5, gin6 si6 gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 gam2 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要无中生有，事情根本不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fabricate things out of nothing; the matter isn't like that at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲記者成日無中生有，結果害到人好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 gei3 ze2 seng4 jat6 mou4 zung1 saang1 jau5, git3 gwo2 hoi6 dou3 jan4 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有的记者经常无中生有，结果害得别人很惨。
examples.english_sentence: Some reporters often make things up, and as a result they cause people to suffer.

mandarin_meaning: 无主的孤魂；指无依无靠、无人祭奠或被遗弃的灵魂，亦可比喻孤苦无助的人
english_meaning: an ownerless/abandoned lonely soul; a wandering spirit without a guardian — figuratively, an abandoned or helpless person
explanation_mandarin: 「無主孤魂」原指沒有主人的孤魂野鬼，常用於描述無人供奉或被遺棄的靈魂；引申為形容孤苦無靠、被遺棄的人或處境。
explanation_english: Literally 'ownerless lonely soul' — originally refers to wandering spirits without a protector or offerings. Figuratively used to describe someone who is abandoned, helpless, or without support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚個公園入面，好多人話見到無主孤魂徘徊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 go3 gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6, hou2 do1 jan4 waa6 gin3 dou2 mou4 zyu2 gu1 wan4 pui4 waai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上公园里很多人说看到无主孤魂徘徊。
examples.english_sentence: At night in the park, many people say they saw ownerless lonely spirits wandering about.

mandarin_meaning: 无限期；没有规定的期限
english_meaning: indefinitely; for an indefinite period; no fixed deadline
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有結束時間或期限，常用來形容某事被延遲、擱置或停滯而沒有明確的完成時間。
explanation_english: Indicates there is no set end date or deadline. Often used to describe something postponed, suspended, or stalled with no fixed time for resolution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司講好嘅升職計劃因為經濟問題拖咗無了期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 gong2 hou2 ge3 sing1 zik1 gai3 waak6 jan1wai6 ging1zai3 man6tai4 to1 zo2 mou4 liu5 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司說好的晉升計劃因為經濟問題被拖延到無限期。
examples.english_sentence: The company's promised promotion plan has been postponed indefinitely because of economic problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰單官司拖咗幾年，仲拖到無了期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 daan1 gun1si1 to1 zo2 gei2 nin4, zung6 to1 dou3 mou4 liu5 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那樁官司拖了好幾年，還拖到無限期。
examples.english_sentence: That lawsuit has been dragged on for years and is still stalled indefinitely.

jyutping: mou4 si6 bat1 dang1 saam1 bou2 din6
mandarin_meaning: 沒有事情不會去找高位者或重要地方，只有有事才會前往；用來形容只在有目的或需要時才出現的人。
english_meaning: Literally 'one wouldn't go up to the Three Treasures Hall without a reason' — people don't visit an important person/place without a purpose. Used to describe someone who only shows up when they want something or when there's a reason.
explanation_mandarin: 此成語用來形容平時不會特意拜訪或打擾重要人物或場所，只有在有需求或目的時才會前來，暗含對來者動機可疑或功利的評價。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the idea that people normally don't approach important people or places without a reason; it implies someone only appears when they want something, often suggesting opportunistic or self-interested motives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時唔會嚟搵我，無事不登三寶殿，今次嚟一定係有事要我幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 m4 wui5 lei4 wan2 ngo5, mou4 si6 bat1 dang1 saam1 bou2 din6, gam1 ci3 lei4 jat1 ding6 hai6 jau5 si6 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平時不會來找我，無事不登三寶殿，這次來一定是有事要我幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He usually wouldn't come to see me; people don't visit the important hall without a reason — if he's here this time, he must need my help.

jyutping: mou4 si6 hin3 jan1 kan4, fei1 gaan1 zik1 dou6
mandarin_meaning: 對沒有理由的殷勤應懷疑對方有企圖，可能是奸詐或圖財物
english_meaning: If someone shows unnecessary or unwarranted eagerness/kindness, suspect ulterior motives — either deceitful or a thief.
explanation_mandarin: 用來提醒或警告，對方無緣無故表現得很殷勤時，應該小心其可能有不良動機、奸詐或圖謀不軌。
explanation_english: A proverb used to warn that when someone displays excessive kindness for no apparent reason, you should be wary of their motives — they are likely up to something dishonest or trying to take advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日無事獻殷勤，非奸即盜，唔好咁容易信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 mou4 si6 hin3 jan1 kan4, fei1 gaan1 zik1 dou6, m4 hou2 gam2 jung6 ji6 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是無事獻殷勤，很可疑，非奸即盜，別那麼容易相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being overly nice for no reason; it's suspicious — if not deceitful, then a thief. Don't trust him so easily.

mandarin_meaning: 無事生非（指無故挑起事端或製造麻煩）
english_meaning: to make trouble out of nothing; to stir up trouble or make a fuss without cause
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有理由地挑起事端或製造麻煩，故意找碴或擾亂秩序。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to create trouble or make a fuss over nothing; to pick quarrels or stir up problems without cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日無事生非，搞到屋企好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 mou4 si6 saang1 fei1, gaau2 dou3 uk1 kei5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是無事生非，搞得家裡很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes trouble for no reason, causing unhappiness at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢講呢啲事，佢會無事生非，越講越激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 ni1 di1 si6, keoi5 wui5 mou4 si6 saang1 fei1, jyut6 gong2 jyut6 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別跟他談這些事，他會無事生非，越說越激動。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk to him about these things; he'll make trouble out of nothing and get more agitated.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有人；無人（表示沒有人或無人看守）
english_meaning: nobody; no one; unmanned (no person present or no one in charge)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 代詞（有時可作形容詞，表示「無人看管/無人使用」）
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中「無人」用來表示「沒有任何人」，可用於描述某處沒有人或某物無人看管或無人使用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "無人" means "no one" or "nobody." It can describe a place with no people or indicate something is unattended or unmanned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度無人，你可以入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 mou4 jan4, nei5 ho2 ji5 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡沒有人，你可以進去。
examples.english_sentence: There is nobody here, you can go in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車係無人駕駛嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 hai6 mou4 jan4 gaa3 si2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這輛車是無人駕駛的。
examples.english_sentence: This car is unmanned/self-driving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日成日都無人搵我，我覺得有啲孤單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou4 jan4 wan2 ngo5, ngo5 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 gu1 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天整天都沒有人找我，我覺得有點孤單。
examples.english_sentence: Nobody contacted me all day; I feel a bit lonely.

mandarin_meaning: 无人之境；荒无人烟的地方；人迹罕至的境地
english_meaning: a deserted place; an uninhabited or desolate area; a place where no one is present
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有人居住或經過、非常荒涼或冷清的地方。也可作比喻，用來形容某地或情況空無一人、缺乏人煙或活動。
explanation_english: Refers to a place without people — deserted, uninhabited, or desolate. Can be used literally for empty locations or metaphorically to describe a lack of people or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度係無人之境，夜晚去好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 hai6 mou4 jan4 zi1 ging2, je6 maan5 heoi3 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那裡是无人之境，晚上去很危险。
examples.english_sentence: That's a deserted place; it's dangerous to go there at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，商場一度變成無人之境，街上好少人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 kei4 gaan1, soeng1 coeng4 jat1 dou6 bin3 sing4 mou4 jan4 zi1 ging2, gaai1 soeng6 hou2 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，商场一度变成无人之境，街上很少人。
examples.english_sentence: During the outbreak, the mall at one time became like a deserted place; there were very few people on the streets.

mandarin_meaning: 无人问津
english_meaning: to be neglected; to attract no attention or interest
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有人过问、关注或光顾，常用来形容商品、作品、店铺或事情冷落、无人理睬。
explanation_english: Indicates that something receives no attention, interest, or patronage; often used to describe goods, works, shops, or matters that are neglected or ignored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本小說出咗街幾個月，但仲係無人問津。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 siu2 syut3 ceot1 zo2 gaai1 gei2 go3 jyut6, daan6 zung6 hai6 mou4 jan4 man6 zeon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本小說已經上市幾個月，但仍然沒有人問津。
examples.english_sentence: This novel has been on the market for several months, but it still hasn't attracted any interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新開嗰間舖開咗一個月，依家仲係無人問津。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 hoi1 go2 gaan1 pou3 hoi1 zo2 jat1 go3 jyut6, ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 mou4 jan4 man6 zeon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新開的那間店開了一個月，現在仍沒有人問津。
examples.english_sentence: The newly opened shop has been open for a month, and still no one shows interest.

mandarin_meaning: 无人机
english_meaning: drone; unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)
explanation_mandarin: 由遙控或自動駕駛的飛行器，常用於航拍、測量、巡檢、運輸或娛樂等用途。
explanation_english: An aircraft operated remotely or autonomously without an onboard pilot, commonly used for aerial photography, surveying, inspection, transport, or recreational purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部無人機嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 mou4 jan4 gei1 lai4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一架无人机来拍照。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a drone to take photos.

mandarin_meaning: 无人知晓
english_meaning: nobody knows; unknown to anyone
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有任何人知道某件事或某個情況，常用於描述事情的未知狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that no one knows about a certain matter or situation; commonly used to describe that something is unknown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事而家仲無人知曉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji4 gaa1 zung6 mou4 jan4 zi1 hiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事现在还没人知道。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is still unknown to anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅真相至今無人知曉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zan1 soeng1 zi3 gam1 mou4 jan4 zi1 hiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的真相至今无人知晓。
examples.english_sentence: His true situation remains unknown to this day.

mandarin_meaning: 没有仇恨、没有怨恨；彼此没有恩怨
english_meaning: no hatred or resentment; no grudges between parties
explanation_mandarin: 表示彼此之間沒有仇恨或怨恨，關係和睦或已經了結恩怨。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is no hatred or resentment between people — relations are amicable or any grievances have been resolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以前有啲誤會，但而家已經無仇無怨，大家和平相處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 jau5 di1 ng6 wui6, daan6 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 mou4 cau4 mou4 jyun6, daai6 gaa1 wo4 ping4 soeng1 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以前有些误会，但现在已经无仇无怨，大家和平相处。
examples.english_sentence: We had some misunderstandings before, but now there's no hatred or resentment; everyone gets along peacefully.

mandarin_meaning: 沒別的 / 只是、僅僅
english_meaning: nothing else; merely; no other reason
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有其他原因或目的，相當於「只是」、「僅僅」。
explanation_english: Indicates there is no other reason or motive — equivalent to "merely" or "nothing else."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得好誠懇，無他，就係想幫手啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 hou2 sing4 han2, mou4 taa1, zau6 hai6 soeng2 bong1 sau2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說得很誠懇，沒別的，就是想幫忙而已。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke sincerely; there was no other reason — he just wanted to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無他，可能只係天氣唔好，影響咗心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 taa1, ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, jing2 hoeng2 zo2 sam1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沒別的，可能只是天氣不好，影響了心情。
examples.english_sentence: Nothing else — maybe it's just the bad weather affecting the mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我無他意思，淨係講事實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou4 taa1 ji3 si1, zing6 hai6 gong2 si6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒別的意思，只是在說事實。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mean anything else; I'm just stating the facts.

mandarin_meaning: 无以复加（无法再增加；程度极高）
english_meaning: extremely; to an utmost degree; nothing can be added
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度非常高，已达到了极点，无法再加。常用来形容情形或程度极端。
explanation_english: Indicates an extreme degree that cannot be increased any further; used to describe something as utmost or exceedingly so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題嚴重得無以復加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jim4 zung6 dak1 mou4 ji5 fuk1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题严重得无以复加。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is extremely serious.

mandarin_meaning: 無法報答（對別人的恩情或幫助無法回報）
english_meaning: unable to repay (someone's kindness); no way to repay
explanation_mandarin: 表示對別人的恩情、幫助或關照感激，但覺得自己沒有辦法用任何方式來回報。
explanation_english: Used to express gratitude and the feeling that one cannot adequately repay someone's kindness, help, or care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫咗我咁多，我真係無以為報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam2 do1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou4 ji5 wai4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫了我這麼多，我真是無以為報。
examples.english_sentence: You've done so much for me; I really have no way to repay you.

mandarin_meaning: 无以为继（无法继续下去、没有可以维持或延续的办法）
english_meaning: Unable to continue; no means to carry on or sustain; cannot be prolonged
explanation_mandarin: 表達事物因缺乏資源或條件而無法繼續、不能延續下去的情況。
explanation_english: Expresses that something cannot continue or be sustained due to lack of resources or conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司生意差到無以為繼，老闆要收縮營運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 saang1ji3 caa1 dou3 mou4 ji5 wai4 gai3, lou5baan2 jiu3 sau1suk1 jing4wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司生意差到无法为继，老板要收缩营运。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business is so bad it can't be sustained; the boss has to scale back operations.

mandarin_meaning: 無法回報（別人的恩情或幫助）
english_meaning: cannot repay (someone's kindness); unable to adequately repay or express gratitude
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示對別人的恩惠、幫助或救命之恩無法回報或難以報答，語氣較書面或正式。
explanation_english: A formal idiom used to express that one cannot repay someone's kindness, help, or life-saving favor; often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫咗我咁多，我真係無以爲報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam2 do1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou4 ji5 wai4 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他幫了我這麼多，我真是無法回報。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me so much; I really have no way to repay him.

mandarin_meaning: 無以為繼（wú yǐ wéi jì）：無法繼續下去，無力再維持
english_meaning: unable to continue; impossible to sustain; no means to carry on
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情、經濟或處境已經到了無法繼續維持的地步，常用於形容無法支撐下去的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates a situation, operation, or condition that cannot be sustained or continued; often used to describe finances, organizations, or affairs that have no means to go on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司連年虧損，已經無以爲繼，最後要宣佈裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lin4 nin4 kwai1 syun2, ji5 ging1 mou4 ji5 wai4 gai3, zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 syun1 bou3 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司連年虧損，已經無以為繼，最後要宣布裁員。
examples.english_sentence: The company has been losing money for years and can no longer continue; it finally had to announce layoffs.

mandarin_meaning: （疑似錯別字）應為「無人歡迎」，意思是沒有人歡迎；不受歡迎
english_meaning: Likely a misspelling of '無人歡迎' — 'unwelcome; nobody welcomes (someone); not popular'
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞/短語（表示不受歡迎）
explanation_mandarin: 「無任歡迎」並非常見正字用法，通常是打字或書寫錯誤，應為「無人歡迎」，用來形容沒有人歡迎或不受歡迎的情況。
explanation_english: “無任歡迎” is not a standard written form and is likely a typo for “無人歡迎”. It describes a situation where nobody welcomes someone — i.e., being unwelcome or unpopular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上有人寫「無任歡迎」，其實係打錯，正確應該係「無人歡迎」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng6 jau5 jan4 se2 「mou4 jam6 fun1 jing4」，kei4 sat6 hai6 daa2 co3，zing3 kok3 jing1 goi1 hai6 「mou4 jan4 fun1 jing4」。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 網上有人寫「無任歡迎」，其實是打錯字，正確應該是「無人歡迎」。
examples.english_sentence: Somebody wrote '無任歡迎' online — it's actually a typo; the correct phrase should be '無人歡迎'.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有依靠；孤立無援
english_meaning: having no one to rely on; without support, isolated and helpless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人沒有可以依靠的人或資源，處於孤立無助的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks people or resources to rely on, being isolated and without support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢家境困難，成日覺得無依無靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa1 ging2 kwan3 naan4, sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 mou4 ji1 mou4 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家境困難，常常覺得沒有依靠。
examples.english_sentence: His family is poor; he often feels like he has no one to rely on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人院裏有啲孤寡長者無依無靠，需要社工探訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 jyun2 leoi5 jau5 di1 gu1 gwaa3 zoeng2 ze2 mou4 ji1 mou4 kaau3, seoi1 jiu3 se5 gung1 taam3 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人院裡有些孤寡老人沒有依靠，需要社工探訪。
examples.english_sentence: There are some isolated elderly in the care home with no one to rely on; they need social workers to visit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失業後佢感到無依無靠，好擔心未來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 jip6 hau6 keoi5 gam2 dou6 mou4 ji1 mou4 kaau3, hou2 daam1 sam1 mei6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失業後他感到沒有依靠，對未來很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job he feels like he has no support and is worried about the future.

mandarin_meaning: （多為錯寫）無論；不管／有時作為「無倫理」的簡寫或古語用法
english_meaning: (commonly a misspelling) '無論' (regardless/no matter); occasionally seen as a variant in names or archaic/literary uses
explanation_mandarin: 「無倫」在現代廣東話和書寫中多數被視為「無論」的錯寫或變體，意思為「不管、不論」。在少數情況下可見於名字、古文或特殊用法，但標準寫法為「無論」。
explanation_english: In modern Cantonese usage, "無倫" is most often a misspelling or variant of "無論" (meaning "regardless"/"no matter"). It can occasionally appear in names or archaic/literary contexts, but the standard form is "無論".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人會寫「無倫」，但正確係「無論」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 se2 "mou4 leon4", daan6 zing3 kok3 hai6 "mou4 leon6".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人會寫「無倫」，但正確是「無論」。
examples.english_sentence: Some people write "無倫", but the correct form is "無論".

mandarin_meaning: 无伤大雅 / 无关紧要
english_meaning: no great harm; nothing to worry about; not a big deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事雖有缺失或小錯，但不會造成重大影響或破壞整體格局，無需過分在意。
explanation_english: Indicates that a fault or mistake is minor and does not cause serious harm or affect the overall outcome; not worth worrying about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小錯誤無傷大雅，唔使太自責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 co3 ng6 mou4 soeng1 daai6 ngaa5, m4 sai2 taai3 zi6 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小错误无伤大雅，不必太自责。
examples.english_sentence: This minor mistake is no big deal; you don't need to blame yourself too much.

mandarin_meaning: 无价（非常珍贵、无法用金钱衡量）
english_meaning: priceless; invaluable
explanation_mandarin: 表示极其珍贵或无法用价格衡量的价值，常用来形容感情、回忆或稀有物品等。
explanation_english: Indicates something extremely valuable or beyond monetary valuation; used for feelings, memories, heirlooms, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件祖傳的手錶對我嚟講係無價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 zou2 cyun4 dik1 sau2 biu1 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 mou4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只祖传的手表对我来说是无价的。
examples.english_sentence: This ancestral watch is priceless to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次旅行嘅回憶真係無價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 wui4 jik1 zan1 hai6 mou4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次旅行的回忆真是无价。
examples.english_sentence: The memories from that trip are truly priceless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母嘅教導係無價嘅資產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 ge3 gaau3 dou6 hai6 mou4 gaa3 ge3 zi1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母的教导是无价的财富。
examples.english_sentence: Parental guidance is a priceless asset.

mandarin_meaning: 無價寶（wújiàbǎo）
english_meaning: priceless treasure; invaluable (person or thing)
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常珍貴、無法用金錢衡量的人或物。可用於真實描述（如珍貴文物）或比喻、誇張地形容某人或某物的珍貴性。
explanation_english: Indicates something or someone extremely precious and beyond monetary value. Can be used literally for priceless objects or figuratively/hyperbolically to describe someone/something invaluable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個細路對我嚟講係無價寶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sai3lou6 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 mou4 gaa3 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的孩子對我來說是無價寶。
examples.english_sentence: His child is a priceless treasure to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本古書係無價寶，唔可以賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 gu2 syu1 hai6 mou4 gaa3 bou2, m4 ho2 ji5 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本古書是無價寶，不能賣。
examples.english_sentence: This ancient book is a priceless treasure; it can't be sold.

mandarin_meaning: 无偿（wúcháng）：不付报酬、免费的
english_meaning: without compensation; free of charge; gratis
explanation_mandarin: 表示不索取報酬或不付代價，例如「無償提供」「無償幫助」。常用於描述免費提供的服務或幫助。
explanation_english: Indicates something done without payment or compensation — free of charge. Commonly used to describe services or help provided gratis (e.g., "provided without payment").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲服務係無償嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fuk6 mou6 hai6 mou4 soeng4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些服务是无偿的。
examples.english_sentence: These services are free of charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢願意無償幫手教我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyun6 ji3 mou4 soeng4 bong1 sau2 gaau3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他愿意无偿帮忙教我。
examples.english_sentence: He is willing to help teach me for free.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有兒女
english_meaning: childless; having no sons or daughters
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有兒女（沒有子女），用來描述個人或夫妻未有子女的狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to having no children (no sons or daughters); used to describe an individual or couple who do not have children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚咗十年，依家仍然係無兒無女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zo2 sap6 nin4, ji1 gaa1 jing4 jin4 hai6 mou4 ji4 mou4 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚十年了，现在仍然没有儿女。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for ten years and still have no children.

mandarin_meaning: 无出其右（无人能及；无可比拟）
english_meaning: second to none; unrivalled; nothing surpasses it
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语 / 形容词性短语
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有什么能够超过或比得上它，强调独一无二或最佳的地位。
explanation_english: Indicates that nothing can surpass or compare to it; emphasizes being unmatched or the very best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅燒鵝一流，真係無出其右。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 siu1 ngo4 jat1 lau4, zan1 hai6 mou4 ceot1 kei4 jau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的烧鹅一流，真是无出其右。
examples.english_sentence: The roast goose at this restaurant is first-rate — truly second to none.

mandarin_meaning: 无力 (wúlì)
english_meaning: lacking strength; weak; powerless; exhausted
explanation_mandarin: 「無力」表示缺乏體力或感到無能為力，可以描述身體上的虛弱，也可以描述面對事情時的無助或無辦法的感覺。
explanation_english: '無力' (mou4 lik6) indicates a lack of strength or feeling powerless. It can refer to physical weakness or to an emotional/situational sense of helplessness or inability to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日覺得好無力，連樓梯都上唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gok3 dak1 hou2 mou4 lik6, lin4 lau4 tai1 dou1 soeng5 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天覺得很無力，連樓梯都上不去。
examples.english_sentence: I feel very weak today; I can't even climb the stairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢件事好無力，不知道點處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 mou4 lik6, bat1 zi1 dou3 dim2 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對這件事很無力，不知道怎麼處理。
examples.english_sentence: He feels powerless about this matter and doesn't know how to handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到噩耗之後我心都無力晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 ngok3 hou3 zi1 hau6 ngo5 sam1 dou1 mou4 lik6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到噩耗之後我心裡覺得很無力。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the bad news, I felt emotionally drained and powerless.

mandarin_meaning: 无力感
english_meaning: a feeling of powerlessness or lack of strength; helplessness; fatigue
explanation_mandarin: 指感到沒有力量或無法改變現狀，既可指身體上的乏力，也可指心理上的無助、沮喪或無望感。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling a lack of strength or ability to change circumstances; can describe physical weakness or psychological feelings of helplessness, demotivation, or despair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近成日有無力感，乜都提不起勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 jau5 mou4 lik6 gam2, mat1 dou1 tai4 bat1 hei2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近总是有无力感，什么都提不起劲。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I often feel a lack of energy and can't get motivated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對公司嘅改革，我有一種無力感，覺得改變好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 goi2 gaak3, ngo5 jau5 jat1 zung2 mou4 lik6 gam2, gok3 dak1 goi2 bin3 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对公司的改革，我有一种无力感，觉得改变很难。
examples.english_sentence: Facing the company's restructuring, I feel a sense of powerlessness and that change is difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完一場激烈嘅運動後，我有啲無力感，要休息一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 jat1 coeng4 gik1 lit6 ge3 wan6 dung6 hau6, ngo5 jau5 di1 mou4 lik6 gam2, jiu3 jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完一场激烈的运动后，我有点无力感，需要休息一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: After an intense workout I feel a bit weak and need to rest for a while.

jyutping: mou4 gung1 ze2 faan6 sung3 bat1 lau4
mandarin_meaning: 沒有貢獻的人得不到飯菜或好處（用以形容無功者不得利）
english_meaning: Those who contribute nothing do not get a share (of the food/benefits); no reward for the non-contributing.
explanation_mandarin: 一句俗語，意思是沒有付出或沒有功勞的人不會被分配到食物或好處，常用來說明有功者有賞、無功者無份。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning people who make no contribution will not receive a share of food or benefits; used to express that rewards go to those who earn them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果淨係坐喺度唔幫手，無功者飯餸不留。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing6 hai6 co5 hai2 dou6 m4 bong1 sau2, mou4 gung1 ze2 faan6 sung3 bat1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果只是坐着不幫忙，沒有貢獻的人不會得到飯菜。
examples.english_sentence: If you just sit there and don't help, those who contribute nothing won't get a share.

synonyms: 有功者有賞，無功者無份

mandarin_meaning: 無助 / 无助 (wúzhù)
english_meaning: helpless; powerless; lacking help or means to cope
explanation_mandarin: 表示缺乏外界或自身能力來應付某種情況，感到無助、無能為力。
explanation_english: Indicates lacking help or the ability to handle a situation; feeling helpless or powerless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗，我覺得好無助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2, ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 mou4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了，我覺得很無助。
examples.english_sentence: He left; I feel very helpless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對重重困難，我哋有時會覺得無助，但唔可以放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 cung4 cung4 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 jau5 si4 wui5 gok3 dak1 mou4 zo6, daan6 m4 ho2 ji5 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對重重困難，我們有時會覺得無助，但不能放棄。
examples.english_sentence: Facing many difficulties, we sometimes feel helpless, but we mustn't give up.

mandarin_meaning: 無助感
english_meaning: a sense of helplessness; feeling powerless
explanation_mandarin: 指感覺自己無法控制情況或無法得到幫助，覺得無能為力的一種情緒狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to the emotional state of feeling unable to control a situation or obtain help — a feeling of powerlessness or helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近壓力好大，我經常有一種無助感，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngaat3 lik6 hou2 daai6, ngo5 ging1 soeng4 jau5 jat1 zung2 mou4-zo6-gam2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近壓力很大，我經常有一種無助感，不知道該怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the pressure has been huge; I often feel a sense of helplessness and don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: （常寫作「無動於衷」）對某事不為所動、沒有感情波動或漠不關心
english_meaning: unmoved; indifferent; apathetic (often written as "無動於衷")
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某件事沒有情感上的波動或關切，保持冷漠或不為所動。常見的正確或更常用寫法為「無動於衷」，「無動於中」有時被視為誤寫或變體。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of emotional response or concern about something — remaining calm, indifferent, or apathetic. The more common/standard form is "無動於衷"; "無動於中" is often a variant or mistaken writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對嗰件事真係無動於中，連一句安慰都唔講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 go2 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 mou4 dung6 jyu1 zung1, lin4 jat1 ge3 on1 wai6 dou1 m4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對那件事真是無動於衷，連一句安慰都不說。
examples.english_sentence: He was truly unmoved by that matter; he didn't even offer a word of comfort.

mandarin_meaning: 无动于衷 (對事情或情感毫無反應、不關心、漠然不動)
english_meaning: to be unmoved or indifferent; apathetic; showing no concern or emotional response
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某件事或別人的情感沒有任何反應或感情，不為所動。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of emotional response or concern toward something; not affected or moved by events or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 即使大家都好難過，佢仍然無動於衷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 si2 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 naan4 gwo3, keoi5 jing4 jin4 mou4 dung6 jyu1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使大家都很難過，他仍然無動於衷。
examples.english_sentence: Even though everyone was very upset, he remained unmoved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者問佢對事件有咩感覺，佢無動於衷，冇表示。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 man6 keoi5 deoi3 si6 gin2 jau5 me1 gam2 gok3, keoi5 mou4 dung6 jyu1 zung1, mou5 biu2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記者問他對事件有什麼感覺，他無動於衷，沒有表示。
examples.english_sentence: When reporters asked him how he felt about the incident, he showed no reaction and remained unmoved.

mandarin_meaning: 无数 / 数不清
english_meaning: countless; innumerable; very many
explanation_mandarin: 口語表達，表示數量極多、數不清，常用作形容詞或程度強調語，類似「無數」或「成千上萬」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning an extremely large or innumerable quantity; used as an adjective or intensifier, similar to "countless" or "thousands upon thousands."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅問題無千無萬，真係搞到我頭都大晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 man6 tai4 mou4 cin1 mou4 maan6, zan1 hai6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 daai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的问题无数，真把我弄得头大。
examples.english_sentence: The problems here are countless; it's really giving me a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上有無千無萬嘅資料，搵到你頭昏眼花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng6 jau5 mou4 cin1 mou4 maan6 ge3 zi1 liu2, wan2 dou3 nei5 tau4 fan1 ngaan5 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上有无数的资料，找得你头昏眼花。
examples.english_sentence: There are countless resources online; you'll get overwhelmed looking for them.

mandarin_meaning: 无印良品（日本品牌，意為「無品牌良品」）
english_meaning: Muji (Japanese retail brand; literally 'no-brand quality goods')
explanation_mandarin: 日本生活用品品牌，創立於1980年代，以簡約、無標誌（無印）設計以及實用、質素穩定的日用品、家居產品著稱。
explanation_english: A Japanese retail brand (Muji) founded in the 1980s, known for minimalist, no-logo design and practical, well-made household and consumer goods. The name literally means 'no-brand quality goods.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日去咗無印良品買啲收納盒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 mou4 jan3 loeng4 ban2 maai5 di1 sau1 naap6 hap6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天去了无印良品买了一些收纳盒。
examples.english_sentence: I went to Muji today to buy some storage boxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意無印良品嗰種簡約風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 mou4 jan3 loeng4 ban2 go2 zung2 gaan2 joek3 fung1 gaak3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她喜欢无印良品那种简约风格。
examples.english_sentence: They like Muji's minimalist style.

mandarin_meaning: 突然且荒唐、莫名其妙的一瞬間
english_meaning: an abrupt, nonsensical moment; something absurd that happens all of a sudden
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語用語，結合「無厘頭」和「剎那」，用來形容某件事在瞬間發生，且帶有荒唐、莫名其妙或不合邏輯的特質，常用於描述突如其來、出乎意料的情況。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial phrase combining the ideas of 'nonsense' and 'an instant'. It describes something that happens suddenly and is absurd or inexplicable. Used to characterize abrupt, out-of-the-blue, nonsensical occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日無厘剎那笑咗出嚟，大家都唔知點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou4 lei4 saat3 naa6 siu3 zo2 ceot1 lai4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天突然莫名其妙地笑了起來，大家都不知道為什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly started laughing for no reason today; nobody knew why.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嗰段情節無厘剎那突變，觀眾都唔知點反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 go2 dyun6 cing4 zit3 mou4 lei4 saat3 naa6 dat6 bin3, gun1 zung3 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影裡面那段情節突然莫名其妙地變化，觀眾都不知道如何反應。
examples.english_sentence: That scene in the movie suddenly and nonsensically changed; the audience didn't know how to react.

mandarin_meaning: 荒謬、無厘頭、莫名其妙（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: absurd; nonsensical; totally random (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容某人或某事荒唐、沒有道理或莫名其妙，語氣可帶戲謔或貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe something or someone as absurd, nonsensical, or bizarre — often used jokingly or disparagingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲無厘啦更嘢，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 mou4 lei4 laa1 gang1 je5, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天說些莫名其妙的話，別理他。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying nonsensical stuff; ignore him.

mandarin_meaning: 無厘頭（表示荒謬、沒有道理或出人意表）
english_meaning: absurd; nonsensical; random; without rhyme or reason
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容言行、情節或幽默風格荒謬、毫無道理或出人意表，常帶滑稽或離奇的意味，源自粵語口語，亦用於描述無厘頭喜劇風格。
explanation_english: Used to describe speech, actions, plots, or a comedic style that is absurd, illogical, or unexpectedly random. Often carries a tone of zany or nonsensical humor; originated in Cantonese colloquial usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅笑話好無厘頭，大家都笑唔出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 siu3 waa6 hou2 mou4 lei4 tau4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 siu3 m4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他講的笑話很無厘頭，大家都笑不出來。
examples.english_sentence: His joke was so nonsensical that nobody could laugh.

mandarin_meaning: 非常無厘頭、荒唐或莫名其妙（口語俚語，帶強調或貶義）
english_meaning: completely nonsensical, absurd, or random (colloquial/slang; often emphatic or derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 由「無厘頭」與俗語「尻」組成的強調用法，用來形容事情或言行特別荒唐、莫名其妙或毫無邏輯，帶有口語和貶義色彩，常在香港粵語口語中出現。
explanation_english: An emphatic colloquial expression combining '無厘頭' (nonsensical) with a slang particle '尻', used to describe actions, remarks, or situations that are absurd, random, or make no sense. It is informal, slangy, and often carries a critical or mocking tone in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日突然講啲無厘頭尻嘢，令到大家好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dat6 jin4 gong2 di1 mou4 lei4 tau4 haau1 je5, ling6 dou3 daai6 gaa1 hou2 gaam1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是突然說些莫名其妙（非常無厘頭）的話，讓大家很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps suddenly saying random, nonsensical stuff, which makes everyone feel awkward.

mandarin_meaning: 胡鬧、無厘頭地亂搞
english_meaning: to act absurdly or nonsensically; to mess around without reason
explanation_mandarin: 口語化的廣東話俗語，表示沒有道理或邏輯地胡鬧、亂搞或耍無賴，語氣常帶輕佻或戲謔。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase meaning to behave nonsensically or mess around without reason. It often implies playful, absurd, or illogical actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日無厘𠸎耕，做嘢好無章法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 mou4 lei4 tau4 gang1, zou6 je5 hou2 mou4 zoeng1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是無厘頭亂搞，做事很沒章法。
examples.english_sentence: He always messes around absurdly and does things without any method.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有反應/沒回應
english_meaning: no reaction; no response; unresponsive
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示對某事物或訊息沒有反應或沒有回應，常用於描述人或群體未作出反應。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning 'to have no reaction' or 'to not respond'. Used to describe a person or group who doesn't react or reply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我send咗短訊畀佢，但佢無反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 send3 zo2 dyun2 seon3 bei2 keoi5, daan6 keoi5 mou4 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我發了簡訊給他，但他沒有回應。
examples.english_sentence: I sent him a message, but he didn't respond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講完個笑話，大家都無反，冇人笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 go3 siu3 waa6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 mou4 faan2, mou5 jan4 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說完那個笑話，大家都沒反應，沒有人笑。
examples.english_sentence: He finished the joke, but nobody reacted; no one laughed.

mandarin_meaning: 无可厚非（表示雖有缺點或錯誤，但情有可原，不應嚴厲指責）
english_meaning: Not to be blamed too severely; understandable; excusable
explanation_mandarin: 表示雖然有錯誤或不足，但情況可以理解，不值得過分責備。
explanation_english: Indicates that although there are faults or mistakes, the circumstances make them understandable and not worthy of harsh criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯咗嘢固然唔啱，但考慮到佢經驗唔多，無可厚非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 zo2 je5 gu3 jin4 m4 aap3, daan6 haau2 leoi6 dou3 keoi5 ging1 jim6 m4 do1, mou4 ho2 hau5 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了錯固然不對，但考慮到他經驗不足，無可厚非。
examples.english_sentence: His mistake is certainly wrong, but considering his lack of experience, it's understandable.

mandarin_meaning: 无可否认
english_meaning: undeniable; there is no denying
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事无法被否认，用来强调一个客观事实或普遍认同的观点。
explanation_english: Indicates that something cannot be denied; used to emphasize an objective fact or widely accepted viewpoint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影無可否認係一部經典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 mou4 ho2 fau2 jing6 hai6 jat1 bou6 ging1 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影无可否认是一部经典。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is undeniably a classic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無可否認，佢做嘢好有才能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 ho2 fau2 jing6, keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 coi4 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无可否认，他工作很有才能。
examples.english_sentence: Undeniably, he is very talented at his work.

mandarin_meaning: 无法可奈何；没有办法；无可奈何
english_meaning: have no choice; be helpless; there's nothing one can do
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某種情況沒有辦法、無能為力或感到無奈，只能接受現狀。
explanation_english: Indicates a situation where one has no solution or is powerless; expresses helplessness or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要裁員，我哋都無可奈何。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 coi4 jyun4, ngo5 dei6 dou1 mou4 ho2 noi6 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要裁员，我们也无可奈何。
examples.english_sentence: The company is laying people off; we have no choice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病得咁嚴重，醫生都無可奈何。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 dak1 gam3 jim4 zung6, ji1 sang1 dou1 mou4 ho2 noi6 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病得这么严重，医生也无可奈何。
examples.english_sentence: His illness is so severe that even the doctors are helpless.

mandarin_meaning: 无可奉告（不愿或不能透露、不予置评）
english_meaning: No comment; unable or unwilling to disclose information
explanation_mandarin: 表示不願意或不能透露某些信息，常用於拒絕記者提問或避免發表評論的正式說法。有時可見漢字變體如「吿」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate unwillingness or inability to disclose information; commonly used to refuse reporters' questions or avoid commenting. A formal set phrase; the last character may appear in variant forms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者問佢關於醜聞嘅細節，佢只答：「無可奉告。」
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 man6 keoi5 gwaan1 jyu1 cau2 man4 ge3 sai3 zit3, keoi5 zi2 daap3: "mou4 ho2 fung3 gou3."
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者问他关于丑闻的细节，他只回答：“无可奉告。”
examples.english_sentence: When reporters asked him about the scandal's details, he only replied: 'No comment.'

mandarin_meaning: 無可奉告（表示不回答或不透露資訊）
english_meaning: No comment; unwilling or unable to disclose information
explanation_mandarin: 用於拒絕回答問題或不願透露資訊，相當於「不予置評」或「沒什麼可告知的」。常在記者會、訪問或敏感話題時使用。
explanation_english: Used to refuse to answer a question or to decline to disclose information; equivalent to 'no comment' or 'nothing to report'. Commonly used in press interviews or on sensitive topics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者問佢啲財務問題，佢就話：「無可奉告」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 man6 keoi5 di1 coi4 mou6 man6 tai4, keoi5 zau6 waa6: "mou4 ho2 fung6 gou3".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記者問他有關財務的問題，他回答說：「無可奉告」。
examples.english_sentence: When reporters asked him about the finances, he replied, "No comment."

mandarin_meaning: 无可救药（无法挽救、不可救药）
english_meaning: hopeless; beyond cure; incurable; beyond help
explanation_mandarin: 表示無法挽救或治療，形容情況或人的毛病、習慣等已經到了無法改變的地步。
explanation_english: Indicates that something cannot be remedied or cured; used to describe situations, faults, or habits that are beyond help or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲壞習慣真係無可救葯，改唔到㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3 zan1 hai6 mou4 ho2 gau3 joek6, goi2 m4 dou3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的壞習慣真是無可救藥，改不了了。
examples.english_sentence: His bad habits are truly hopeless; they can't be changed.

mandarin_meaning: 無可救藥
english_meaning: hopeless; beyond cure; irredeemable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或事已經到了無法挽救、無法治療或無法改正的程度。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone or something that is beyond remedy or salvation — cannot be cured, fixed, or changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人嘅壞習慣已經無可救藥，改唔到喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 ge3 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3 ji5 ging1 mou4 ho2 gau3 joek6, goi2 m4 dou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的壞習慣已經無可救藥，改不了了。
examples.english_sentence: His bad habits are hopeless — he can't change.

mandarin_meaning: 无所谓／既不特别好也不坏，态度中性或敷衍
english_meaning: so-so; neither good nor bad; indifferent; neutral/okay either way
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物或表現既不讚賞也不否定，態度中性或不置可否，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Indicates a neutral, noncommittal attitude toward something — neither particularly good nor bad; used colloquially to mean 'so-so' or 'either way is fine.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式無可無不可，冇乜特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 mou4 ho2 mou4 bat1 ho2, mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜式无可无不可，没有什么特别。
examples.english_sentence: The dishes at this restaurant are so-so; nothing special.

mandarin_meaning: 无可置疑 / 毋庸置疑
english_meaning: undeniable; beyond doubt; indisputable
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事非常确定，不容怀疑或反驳。常用于正式或书面语，用來強調事情的確定性或證據的充足性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is certain and cannot be doubted or disputed. Commonly used in formal or written contexts to emphasize certainty or sufficiency of evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提供嘅證據充分，無可置疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 gung1 ge3 zing3 geoi3 cung1 fu3, mou4 ho2 zi3 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提供的证据充分，无可置疑。
examples.english_sentence: The evidence he provided is sufficient and indisputable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅結論係無可置疑嘅事實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 git3 leon6 hai6 mou4 ho2 zi3 ji4 ge3 si6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的结论是无可置疑的事实。
examples.english_sentence: The conclusion of this report is an indisputable fact.

mandarin_meaning: 不可避免；无法避免
english_meaning: inevitable; unavoidable
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事無法避免或必然會發生，強調無可阻止或迴避的可能性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something cannot be avoided or is bound to happen; emphasizes the impossibility of preventing or escaping it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁差，活動延期係無可避免嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 caa1, wut6 dung6 jin4 kei4 hai6 mou4 ho2 bei6 min5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么差，活动延期是不可避免的。
examples.english_sentence: With such bad weather, postponing the event is unavoidable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟衰退令失業率上升係無可避免。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3 ling6 sat1 jip6 leot6 soeng5 sing1 hai6 mou4 ho2 bei6 min5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济衰退导致失业率上升是不可避免的。
examples.english_sentence: An economic downturn causing unemployment to rise is inevitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試期間壓力無可避免，但要學識調節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 kei4 gaan1 aat3 lik6 mou4 ho2 bei6 min5, daan6 jiu3 hok6 sik1 tiu4 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试期间压力无法避免，但要学会调节。
examples.english_sentence: Pressure during exams is unavoidable, but you need to learn to manage it.

mandarin_meaning: 無可限量 / 不可限量（无法估量、前景或潜力非常大）
english_meaning: limitless; boundless; immeasurable; of unlimited potential
explanation_mandarin: 表示無法估量或沒有界限，常用來形容前途、潛力或發展前景非常好、不可限量。
explanation_english: Indicates that something cannot be measured or limited. Commonly used to describe boundless prospects, potential, or development that is very promising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅前途無可限量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 cin4 tou4 mou4 ho2 haan6 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的前途無可限量。
examples.english_sentence: His future is boundless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新技術嘅應用前景無可限量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 gei6 seot6 ge3 jing3 jung6 cin4 ging2 mou4 ho2 haan6 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這項新技術的應用前景無可限量。
examples.english_sentence: The application prospects of this new technology are limitless.

mandarin_meaning: 無名指 (wúmíngzhǐ)
english_meaning: ring finger; the fourth finger (between the middle finger and the little finger)
explanation_mandarin: 手的一根指頭，位於中指與小指之間，常用來戴結婚戒指或裝飾戒指。
explanation_english: A finger of the hand located between the middle and little fingers (the fourth finger); commonly used to wear wedding or decorative rings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無名指戴住隻鑽石戒指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou4 ming4 zi2 daai3 zyu6 zek3 zyun3 sek6 gaai3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她無名指戴著一枚鑽石戒指。
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing a diamond ring on her ring finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚戒指通常戴喺無名指上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 gaai3 zi2 tung1 soeng4 daai3 hai2 mou4 ming4 zi2 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 結婚戒指通常戴在無名指上。
examples.english_sentence: Wedding rings are usually worn on the ring finger.

mandarin_meaning: 无名氏（指署名不详或没有名声的人；匿名者/不知名者）
english_meaning: an anonymous person; someone of no known name or reputation; unknown author
explanation_mandarin: “無名氏”常用來指署名不詳或不願透露姓名的人，也可用來形容沒有名氣或不出名的人，在書面或口語中都可見到。
explanation_english: “無名氏” refers to an anonymous person or an unknown author; it can also describe someone without a reputation. Used in both written and spoken contexts to indicate no name or unknown identity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章係由一位無名氏寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 hai6 jau4 jat1 wai6 mou4 ming4 si6 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章是由一位无名氏写的。
examples.english_sentence: This article was written by an anonymous person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方表示嫌疑人係一個無名氏，暫時未能確定身份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 biu2 si6 jim4 ji4 jan4 hai6 jat1 go3 mou4 ming4 si6, zaam6 si4 mei6 nang4 kok3 ding6 san1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方表示嫌疑人是一名无名氏，暂时无法确定身份。
examples.english_sentence: The police said the suspect is an anonymous person; their identity cannot be confirmed for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺論壇上以無名氏留言，大家都唔知係邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 leon4 taan4 soeng6 ji5 mou4 ming4 si6 lau4 jin4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 hai6 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在论坛上以无名氏留言，大家都不知道是谁。
examples.english_sentence: He left a comment on the forum as 'Anonymous'; nobody knows who he is.

mandarin_meaning: 怒火中燒；突然生氣（無緣無故發怒）
english_meaning: to flare up in sudden anger; to get angrily worked up for no obvious reason
explanation_mandarin: 粵語慣用語，字面為「沒有名號的火起」，用來形容情緒突然爆發、因小事或莫名其妙地大發脾氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom meaning a sudden outbreak of anger — getting unexpectedly enraged or snapping over something trivial or without clear reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日為小事無名火起，搞到屋企好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 wai6 siu2 si6 mou4 ming4 fo2 hei2, gaau2 dou3 uk1 kei5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常為小事突然生氣，弄得家裡很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: He often flies into a rage over minor things, making the household tense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好無名火起，講嘢禮貌啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 mou4 ming4 fo2 hei2, gong2 je5 lai5 maau6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要無緣無故生氣，說話要有禮貌一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get angry for no reason; be more polite when you speak.

mandarin_meaning: 无名无姓；没有姓名或没有名气，身份不显赫或不为人知
english_meaning: Having no name or surname; anonymous, obscure, unremarkable; someone or something with no reputation or social standing
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容沒有名氣或沒有人認識的人或事物，也可指身份不明、沒有顯赫背景。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or thing that is unnamed, anonymous, or lacks reputation; can also imply obscure social status or unknown identity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個無名無姓嘅記者，冇乜人識佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 mou4 ming4 mou4 sing3 ge3 gei3 ze2, mou5 mat1 jan4 sik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一個無名無姓的記者，沒什麼人認識他。
examples.english_sentence: He is an anonymous/unremarkable reporter; not many people know him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間店係無名無姓，但手工好，客都排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dim3 hai6 mou4 ming4 mou4 sing3, daan6 sau2 gung1 hou2, haak3 dou1 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店沒什麼名氣，但手藝好，客人都排隊。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has no reputation, but the craftsmanship is good and customers still queue up.

mandarin_meaning: 突然；莫名其妙地；無緣無故
english_meaning: suddenly; out of the blue; for no apparent reason
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，表示事情無預警或無明顯原因地發生，常用於日常對話中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adverb used to indicate that something happens suddenly or for no obvious reason; common in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你無啦啦咁嬲乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou4 laa1 laa1 gam2 nou5 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你突然為什麼生氣？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you suddenly angry?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無啦啦唔嚟返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 m4 lei4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然沒來上班。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly didn't come to work.

jyutping: mou4 laa1 laa1 do1 daap6 gaap3
mandarin_meaning: 莫名其妙地變得很尷尬／做出怪異行為
english_meaning: suddenly (for no reason) become awkward/act oddly; out of the blue get embarrassed or behave weirdly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語短語／俚語（副詞性／形容詞性用法）
explanation_mandarin: 「無啦啦多笪𤶸」是香港粵語口語俚語，用來形容某人在沒有明顯原因下突然變得笨拙、尷尬或做出奇怪的舉動。常見於非正式對話。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang phrase used to describe someone who, for no apparent reason, suddenly becomes awkward, embarrassed, or starts acting strangely. Commonly used in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無啦啦多笪𤶸，突然講咗啲好奇怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 do1 daap6 gaap3, dat6 jin4 gong2 zo2 di1 hou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他莫名其妙地變得很尷尬，突然說了一些很奇怪的話。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly got all awkward for no reason and started saying some really weird things.

jyutping: mou4 laa1 laa1 zing2 daap6 baan1
mandarin_meaning: 無緣無故惹事/突然製造麻煩或起衝突
english_meaning: to cause trouble or make a fuss out of the blue; to pick a fight or act up suddenly for no clear reason
explanation_mandarin: 口語俗語，表示某人莫名其妙地突然挑起事端、發脾氣或製造麻煩，通常帶有不合情理或無預警的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase meaning someone suddenly causes trouble, creates a fuss, or gets angry for no apparent reason. It implies an unexpected or unreasonable action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日無啦啦整笪𤶸，成日發脾氣，搞到大家好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou4 laa1 laa1 zing2 daap6 baan1, sing4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 hou2 gaan1 ngaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天莫名其妙地挑事，整天發脾氣，搞得大家很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: He started making trouble out of the blue today, snapping all the time and making everyone feel awkward.

jyutping: mou4 laa1 laa1 saang1 daap6 lei4
mandarin_meaning: 莫名其妙地生氣／發脾氣
english_meaning: to get angry or sulk out of the blue; to be upset for no apparent reason
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，表示一個人沒有明顯原因或理由突然發脾氣、情緒化或耍性子。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning someone suddenly gets angry or sulks for no obvious reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢無啦啦生笪𤶸，搞到大家都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 saang1 daap6 lei4, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他莫名其妙地發脾氣，弄得大家都不知道怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly got upset for no reason, leaving everyone not knowing what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 沒有來由／無端／莫名其妙
english_meaning: for no reason; without cause; out of the blue
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，表示某事或某人的行為沒有明顯原因或來由，常用來形容無端發生的事情或無緣無故的情緒反應。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang Cantonese phrase meaning that something happens without an apparent reason or cause. Used to describe unprovoked actions or sudden, inexplicable reactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日無嚟頭尻咁鬧我，我都唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou4 lai4 tau4 haau1 gam2 naau6 ngo5, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天莫名其妙地罵我，我也不知道發生了什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: He scolded me today for no reason; I don't know what happened.

mandarin_meaning: 无地自容 (wú dì zì róng)：形容感到非常羞愧，难以见人。
english_meaning: To be utterly ashamed or mortified; unable to show one's face.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因為羞愧或尷尬而無法見人，像找不到可以藏身的地方。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone who feels so ashamed or embarrassed that they cannot bear to face others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被揭發偷嘢，當場無地自容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 git3faat3 tau1 je5, dong1 coeng4 mou4 dei6 zi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被揭发偷东西，当场无地自容。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for stealing and was utterly ashamed on the spot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試作弊畀人捉到，返到屋企都無地自容，唔敢見家人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 zou6 bei6 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 dou1 mou4 dei6 zi6 jung4, m4 gam2 gin3 gaa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊被人抓到，回到家里都无地自容，不敢见家人。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught cheating on the exam; when he got home he was too ashamed to face his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司出錯，老闆當眾批評，職員無地自容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ceot1 co3, lou5 baan2 dong1 zung3 pai1 ping4, zik1 jyun4 mou4 dei6 zi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司出错，老板当众批评，职员无地自容。
examples.english_sentence: After the company's mistake was publicly criticized by the boss, the employee felt too ashamed to show his face.

mandarin_meaning: 无垠（无限、广阔）
english_meaning: boundless; limitless; vast
explanation_mandarin: 表示范围极广、没有边际或限度，常用于描写广阔的空间或抽象的无限。
explanation_english: Describes something extremely vast or without boundaries; often used for expansive physical spaces or abstract notions of limitlessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 望住無垠嘅海洋，我感到渺小。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong6 zyu6 mou4 jan4 ge3 hoi2 joeng4, ngo5 gam2 dou3 miu5 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 望着无垠的海洋，我感到渺小。
examples.english_sentence: Gazing at the boundless ocean, I felt small.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜空無垠，星星閃爍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 hung1 mou4 jan4, sing1 sing1 sim2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜空无垠，星星闪烁。
examples.english_sentence: The night sky is boundless, and the stars twinkle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對未來嘅想像係無垠嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 mei6 loi4 ge3 soeng2 zoeng6 hai6 mou4 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对未来的想象是无垠的。
examples.english_sentence: His imagination about the future is limitless.

mandarin_meaning: 所向披靡 / 所向無敵（無物可阻、勢不可擋）
english_meaning: Invincible; unstoppable; nothing can withstand it
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 「無堅不摧」為成語，字面意為沒有堅固的東西能被摧毀，用來形容勢力強大、無可抵擋或所向無敵。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that nothing firm can resist or be destroyed by it; used to describe something overwhelmingly powerful or unstoppable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺球場上嘅表現真係無堅不摧，對手根本招架唔住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 ge3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 mou4 gin1 bat1 ceoi1, deoi3 sau2 gan1 bun2 ziu1 gaak3 m4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在球场上的表现真是无坚不摧，对手根本招架不住。
examples.english_sentence: His performance on the field was truly unstoppable; the opponents couldn't cope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隊新創公司嘅研發團隊實力雄厚，產品質量嚴謹，喺市場上幾乎無堅不摧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi2 san1 cong3 gung1 si1 ge3 jin4 faat3 tyun4 deoi2 sat6 lik6 hung4 hau5, caan2 ban2 zat1 loeng6 jim4 gan2, hai2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 gei2 fu1 mou4 gin1 bat1 ceoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家新创公司的研发团队实力雄厚，产品质量严谨，在市场上几乎所向披靡。
examples.english_sentence: The R&D team of this startup is powerful and the product quality is rigorous; in the market they are almost unbeatable.

mandarin_meaning: 世上無奇不有（什麼稀奇古怪的事都有）
english_meaning: There is nothing strange in the world; anything can happen; all sorts of strange/unexpected things exist
explanation_mandarin: 表示世上各種奇怪或異常的事情都有，常用來感嘆或評論見到的奇事。
explanation_english: Expresses that all kinds of strange or unexpected things exist in the world; used to remark with surprise or resignation when encountering odd occurrences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，呢啲怪事真係無奇不有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, ni1 di1 gwaai3 si6 zan1 hai6 mou4 kei4 bat1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，這些怪事真是無奇不有。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, you really see all kinds of strange things.

mandarin_meaning: 无奈；无可奈何
english_meaning: helpless; resigned; having no choice
explanation_mandarin: 表示對於某種情況感到無辦法、無能為力或無可奈何，常用來表達無法改變現狀的無助或無可奈何的情緒。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of having no choice or being powerless; used to convey resignation or helplessness in the face of an unchangeable situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係無奈，佢唔肯聽我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou4 noi6, keoi5 m4 hang2 teng1 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真是无奈，他不肯听我说。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really helpless; he refuses to listen to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對呢個情況，我感到無奈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 ni1 go3 cing4 fong3, ngo5 gam2 dou3 mou4 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这个情况，我感到无奈。
examples.english_sentence: Facing this situation, I feel helpless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我無奈之下，只好答應咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou4 noi6 zi1 haa6, zi2 hou2 daap3 jing3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我无奈之下，只好答应了。
examples.english_sentence: Out of helplessness, I had no choice but to agree.

mandarin_meaning: 無奸不商
english_meaning: There is no business without trickery; merchants are often crafty/unscrupulous
explanation_mandarin: 形容做生意的人往往奸詐，暗示為了利益可能會使用不誠實或不道德的手段。
explanation_english: Describes the idea that businesspeople are often crafty or unscrupulous; implies that people may use dishonest or unethical methods to make deals or profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意嗰啲人好多時候都無奸不商，為咗錢乜都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 go2 di1 jan4 hou2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 mou4 gaan1 bat1 soeng1, wai4 zo2 cin2 mat1 dou1 zou6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意的人很多時候都無奸不商，為了錢什麼都做得出。
examples.english_sentence: Many people in business are crafty; they'll do anything for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗰間公司被揭發無奸不商，成日欺騙客戶簽不公平合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 bei6 gip3 faat3 mou4 gaan1 bat1 soeng1, sing4 jat6 hei1 pin3 haak3 wu6 cim1 bat1 gung1 ping4 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們那家公司被揭發無奸不商，經常欺騙客戶簽不公平合約。
examples.english_sentence: Their company was exposed as unscrupulous; they often trick customers into signing unfair contracts.

mandarin_meaning: 無緣無故遭受的災禍；不應得的禍害或損失
english_meaning: an undeserved or unforeseen calamity; a disaster that befalls someone without fault or cause
explanation_mandarin: 無妄之災指無緣無故遭受的災禍或責難，強調受害者並無過失或牽連。常用於書面語或正式語境，表示意外且不應有的損害。
explanation_english: An idiom describing an unexpected or undeserved misfortune — emphasizing that the victim bears no fault or responsibility. Commonly used in formal or written contexts to denote an inadvertent calamity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次真係遇到無妄之災，俾人冤枉，結果失咗工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jyu6 dou3 mou4 mong6 zi1 zoi1, bei2 jan4 jyun1 wong5, git3 gwo2 sat1 zo2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次真的是遭遇了無妄之災，被人冤枉，結果失去了工作。
examples.english_sentence: He really suffered an undeserved misfortune this time — he was wrongly accused and ended up losing his job.

mandarin_meaning: 不妨（表示允許或沒關係）
english_meaning: it's okay; no harm; no problem; might as well
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某事沒關係或可以接受，常用於允許、建議或安慰語境中。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something is acceptable or harmless; commonly used to give permission, make a suggestion, or reassure someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你遲到少少無妨，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ci4 dou3 siu2 siu2 mou4 fong4, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你迟到一会儿也无妨，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: It's no problem if you're a little late, don't worry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想試吓都無妨，反正冇咩損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 si3 haa5 dou1 mou4 fong4, faan2 zin3 mou5 me1 syun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想试试也无妨，反正没有什么损失。
