examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 suk6 sing3 zau6 m4 haak3 hei3, sing4 jat6 lyun6 hoi1 jan4 waan2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一旦熟絡起來就不拘禮貌，常常亂開別人的玩笑。
examples.english_sentence: Once he gets comfortable, he stops being polite and often makes jokes at other people's expense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢未熟性，唔敢咁隨便同佢傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 mei6 suk6 sing3, m4 gam2 ceoi4 bin6 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他還未熟，不敢那麼隨便和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not familiar with him yet, so I don't dare to chat with him so casually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 時間耐咗，佢一熟性就放得開，會亂講笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si4 gaan1 noi6 zo2, keoi5 jat1 suk6 sing3 zau6 fong3 dak1 hoi1, wui5 lyun6 gong2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 時間久了，他一熟絡就變得放得開，會亂講笑話。
examples.english_sentence: After some time, once he becomes familiar, he loosens up and cracks silly jokes.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉
english_meaning: to be familiar with; familiar
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人、某地或某事有較深入或常接觸，因而認識得很清楚。
explanation_english: Indicates having a thorough or well-acquainted knowledge of a person, place, or thing due to frequent contact or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢度好熟悉，細個成日嚟玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 dou6 hou2 suk6 sik1, sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 lai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對這裡很熟悉，小的時候常來玩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very familiar with this place; I used to come here a lot when I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好熟悉公司嘅流程，可以教你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 suk6 sik1 gung1 si1 ge3 lau4 cing4, ho2 ji5 gaau3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很熟悉公司的流程，可以教你。
examples.english_sentence: He is very familiar with the company's procedures and can teach you.

mandarin_meaning: 内行；熟练的人
english_meaning: an experienced person; a skilled hand; someone proficient at a task
explanation_mandarin: 指在某方面有豐富經驗或技術熟練的人；也可作形容詞表示某人或某事很熟練。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is experienced or highly skilled in a particular area; can also be used adjectivally to describe someone or something as skilled or proficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係熟手，我哋交畀你做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 zuk6 sau2, ngo5 dei6 gaau1 bei2 nei5 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是內行，我們把這件事交給你做吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're experienced — we'll leave this to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅廚房有幾個熟手，出菜好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 cyu4 fong2 jau5 gei2 go3 zuk6 sau2, ceot1 coi3 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餐廳的廚房有幾個內行，上菜很快。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's kitchen has several experienced cooks — the dishes come out quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係電腦維修嘅熟手，幫我搞掂咗部機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 din6 nou5 wai4 sau1 ge3 zuk6 sau2, bong1 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 zo2 bou6 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是電腦維修的內行，幫我修好了這台機器。
examples.english_sentence: He's an experienced computer repairer — he fixed my machine.

mandarin_meaning: 熟練的技工／技術人員
english_meaning: an experienced/skilled technician or tradesperson
explanation_mandarin: 指經驗豐富、技術熟練的技工或技術人員，通常用來形容能快速且有效完成維修或保養工作的專業人員。
explanation_english: Refers to a technician or tradesperson who is experienced and skilled—someone able to carry out repairs, maintenance, or technical work quickly and effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司入面嘅熟手技工，乜嘢機器都整得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1si1 jap6min6 ge3 suk6 sau2 gei6 gung1, mat1je5 gei1hei3 dou1 zing2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司裡最好的熟練技工，什麼機器都修得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He is the company's best experienced technician; he can fix any machine very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵熟手技工修水喉，快又好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 suk6 sau2 gei6 gung1 sau1 seoi2 hau4, faai3 jau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找熟練的技工修水管，又快又好。
examples.english_sentence: Hire an experienced technician to fix the plumbing—fast and well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間車行專門請熟手技工保養車輛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ce1 hong4 zyun1mun4 ceng2 suk6 sau2 gei6 gung1 bou2 joeng5 ce1 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間車行專門聘請熟練技工保養車輛。
examples.english_sentence: This auto shop specifically hires experienced technicians to service vehicles.

mandarin_meaning: 熟普洱（經過渥堆發酵處理的普洱茶）
english_meaning: ripe (shou) Pu-erh tea — Pu-erh tea that has been pile-fermented
explanation_mandarin: 「熟普」是對「熟普洱」的口語簡稱，指經過渥堆發酵處理、茶性醇厚、口感順滑的普洱茶類型。
explanation_english: An informal abbreviation for 'shou Pu-erh' (ripe Pu-erh tea). Refers to Pu-erh that has undergone pile fermentation, producing a mellow, earthy, smooth tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意飲熟普多過生普。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 suk6 pou2 do1 gwo3 saang1 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡喝熟普洱勝過生普洱。
examples.english_sentence: I prefer drinking ripe Pu-erh to raw Pu-erh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款熟普香氣濃郁，飲落好順口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 suk6 pou2 hoeng1 hei3 nung4 juk6, jam2 lok6 hou2 seon6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款熟普香氣濃郁，喝起來很順口。
examples.english_sentence: This ripe Pu-erh has a strong aroma and is very smooth to drink.

mandarin_meaning: 裝熟／擺架子（故作老練、自以為懂）
english_meaning: to act like an old hand / to act smug or pretentious; to show off one’s supposed experience
explanation_mandarin: 「熟架步」是廣東話俚語，用來形容某人故作老練或裝熟、擺架子，給人自以為很懂或很在行的感覺，通常帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression describing someone who pretends to be experienced or acts smugly/confidently—putting on airs or showing off. It is usually derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家成日熟架步，好似乜都識晒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 seng4 jat6 suk6 gaa3 bou6, hou2 ci5 mat1 dou1 sik1 saai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在經常愛裝熟，好像什麼都懂一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting like an expert now, as if he knows everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢噉講，我真係唔鍾意佢熟架步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 suk6 gaa3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他那樣說，我真的不喜歡他裝熟。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that, I really don't like him acting all know-it-all.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉的攤檔／熟識的店家（常去的攤位或熟絡的販售者）
english_meaning: a regular stall/vendor or a familiar seller; a stall you often buy from (a known contact at a market/shop)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，常用於香港，指在街市或市集中與買賣關係熟絡的攤檔或賣家，通常會因為熟絡而有優惠或方便。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term (commonly used in Hong Kong) referring to a market stall or vendor you are familiar with — someone you deal with regularly. Because of the relationship, you may get favors or discounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間街市嘅魚檔係我嘅熟檔，買多啲會俾我平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gaai1 si5 ge3 jyu4 dong2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 suk6 dong2, maai5 do1 di1 wui5 bei2 ngo5 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個街市的魚檔是我熟悉的攤檔，買多一點會便宜一些。
examples.english_sentence: The fish stall in this market is my regular stall; if I buy more they'll give me a discount.

mandarin_meaning: 熟練；熟悉；有經驗
english_meaning: experienced; skilled; familiar with something
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示對某項工作或事情很熟練、有經驗、不需多指導。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term meaning very familiar or skilled at something, usually through experience; doesn't need much guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺餐廳做咗十幾年，做嘢好熟水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 caan1 teng1 zou6 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4, zou6 je5 hou2 suk6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在餐廳做了十幾年，做事很熟練。
examples.english_sentence: He's worked in the restaurant for over ten years; he's very skilled at the job.

mandarin_meaning: 老練、圓滑（有時帶狡詐或油滑的意味）
english_meaning: seasoned/slick (often implying slyness or craftiness); experienced
explanation_mandarin: 在香港廣東話的俚語用法中，“熟油”用來形容一個人很有經驗、很老練或圓滑；有時帶有負面含義，指人油滑、狡詐或不太可靠。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, "熟油" describes someone who is very experienced and slick—smooth and practiced. It can carry a negative nuance implying the person is sly, crafty, or untrustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做呢行做咗十幾年，幾熟油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 ni1 hong4 zou6 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4, gei2 suk6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這行做了十幾年，很老練（很有經驗）。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in this line of work for over ten years; he's pretty seasoned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，佢好熟油，成日呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, keoi5 hou2 suk6 jau4, sing4 jat6 ngaak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心點，他很油，很會騙人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful — he's very slick and often tricks people.

mandarin_meaning: （俗語）指已點燃或已吸過的香煙及其味道，有時泛指二手煙／煙味
english_meaning: (sl̶a̶n̶g) smoke from a lit or previously smoked cigarette or its smell; sometimes used to refer to secondhand smoke / cigarette smell
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語口語中，“熟煙”常用來指已點燃或已被吸過的香煙所產生的煙及其味道；根據語境也可泛指殘留的煙味或二手煙。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial speech, "熟煙" commonly refers to smoke from a lit or previously smoked cigarette and its smell. Depending on context, it can also be used more generally for lingering smoke smell or secondhand smoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企抽煙，啲熟煙好難散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei5 dou6 cau1 jin1, di1 suk6 jin1 hou2 naan4 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在家裡抽煙，煙味很難散。
examples.english_sentence: He always smokes at home; the smell of smoke is hard to get rid of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意聞到熟煙味，覺得好難受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 man4 dou3 suk6 jin1 mei6, gok3 dak1 hou2 naan4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜歡聞到煙味，覺得很難受。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like smelling cigarette smoke; it makes me feel uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 熟切片（已煮熟並切成片的食材）
english_meaning: cooked slices; slices of food that have been cooked
explanation_mandarin: 指已經煮熟並切成片的食材或食品，常用於即食產品或烹調時作為配料。此詞多為字面用法，並非常見慣用語或俚語。
explanation_english: Refers to ingredients or food items that have been cooked and sliced. Commonly used for ready-to-eat products or as ingredients in cooking. This is primarily a literal term rather than an idiom or slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲熟片可以直接食，放喺飯度都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 suk6 pin3 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 sik6, fong3 hai2 faan6 dou6 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些熟片可以直接吃，放在饭里也可以。
examples.english_sentence: These cooked slices can be eaten directly; they also work mixed into rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超級市場有賣即食熟片，好方便做三文治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 jau5 maai6 zik1 sik6 suk6 pin3, hou2 fong1 bin6 zou6 saam1 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有卖即食的熟片，很方便做三明治。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells ready-to-eat cooked slices; they're convenient for making sandwiches.

mandarin_meaning: 熟睡 (shúshuì)，睡得很沉
english_meaning: to be sound asleep; to sleep deeply
explanation_mandarin: 表示睡得很沉、睡得很熟，不易被吵醒。
explanation_english: Indicates sleeping very deeply or soundly, not easily awakened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家熟睡緊，唔好吵佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 suk6 seoi6 gan2, m4 hou2 caau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在熟睡中，別吵他。
examples.english_sentence: He's sound asleep right now; don't disturb him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嬰兒熟睡咗之後，父母終於可以休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 ji4 suk6 seoi6 zo2 zi1 hau6, fu6 mou5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嬰兒熟睡之後，父母終於可以休息。
examples.english_sentence: After the baby fell into a deep sleep, the parents could finally rest.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉；了解得很清楚
english_meaning: to be well acquainted with; to know thoroughly
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物或情況非常熟悉、了解得很清楚。語氣偏正式，常用於書面或較正式的語境中。
explanation_english: Indicates being very familiar with or having a thorough knowledge of something. The term is relatively formal and often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對香港嘅歷史非常熟知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lik6 si2 fei1 soeng4 suk6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對香港的歷史非常熟知。
examples.english_sentence: He is very familiar with Hong Kong's history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你熟知程式碼嘅結構，修改就容易啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 suk6 zi1 cing4 sik1 maa5 ge3 git3 gau3, sau1 goi2 zau6 jung4 ji6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你熟知程式碼的結構，修改就容易些。
examples.english_sentence: If you are familiar with the code's structure, making changes will be easier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為導師，你要熟知考試規則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai6 dou6 si1, nei5 jiu3 suk6 zi1 haau2 si3 kwai1 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為導師，你要熟知考試規則。
examples.english_sentence: As an instructor, you should be well acquainted with the exam rules.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉；关系亲近
english_meaning: to be familiar with; to be on close terms (with someone)
explanation_mandarin: 表示和某人关系熟悉或亲近，或经常来往而变得熟识。可作动词或形容词使用，属粤语口语表达。
explanation_english: Indicates being familiar or close with someone, often through frequent contact. Used as a verb or adjective in Cantonese colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢唔係好熟絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 suk6 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他不太熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very close with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做同事做咗幾年，好熟絡晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 tung4 si6 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4, hou2 suk6 lok3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们做同事做了好几年，很熟络/很熟悉了。
examples.english_sentence: We've been colleagues for years and are very close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好容易同人熟絡，識咗好多朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jung4 ji6 tung4 jan4 suk6 lok3, sik1 zo2 hou2 do1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很容易和别人熟络，认识了很多朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He easily becomes friendly with people and has made many friends.

mandarin_meaning: 熟练 (shúliàn)
english_meaning: skilled; proficient; practiced
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某種技能或工作非常熟悉且具備豐富經驗與高超技術。
explanation_english: Indicates being very familiar and experienced with a skill or task, possessing a high level of ability and technique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位師傅好熟練，手勢好穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai6 si1 fu1 hou2 suk6 lin6, sau2 si6 hou2 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位師傅很熟練，手法很穩。
examples.english_sentence: This craftsman is very skilled; his technique is steady.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我練咗幾年結他，依家彈得好熟練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lin6 zo2 gei2 nin4 git6 taa1, ji4 gaa1 taan4 dak1 hou2 suk6 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我練了幾年吉他，現在彈得很熟練。
examples.english_sentence: I've practiced guitar for several years and now I play very proficiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做會計工作已經好熟練，唔使人教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 wui6 gai3 gung1 zok3 ji5 ging1 hou2 suk6 lin6, m4 sai2 jan4 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做會計工作已經很熟練，不需要別人教。
examples.english_sentence: He's very experienced in accounting and doesn't need others to teach him.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉；熟练
english_meaning: to be familiar with; to be well-acquainted; to be practiced
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物、技能或環境非常熟悉、有經驗或已經練習得很好。
explanation_english: Indicates being very familiar with something, experienced in a skill, or well practised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個程式好熟習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 hou2 suk6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對這個程式很熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very familiar with this program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要熟習呢啲步驟，先可以獨立做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 suk6 zaap6 ni1 di1 bou6 zau6, sin1 ho2 ji5 duk6 lap6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要熟悉這些步驟，才能獨立做。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be familiar with these steps before you can do it independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經好熟習呢份工作，唔需要太多人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 hou2 suk6 zaap6 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3, m4 seoi1 jiu3 taai3 do1 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經對這份工作很熟悉，不需要太多人幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He is already very familiar with this job and doesn't need much help.

mandarin_meaning: 熟的肉；（網絡用語）已加中文字幕或已處理好的視頻/影音資源
english_meaning: cooked meat; (internet slang) a video/media file that has been processed and usually has Chinese subtitles
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指已經煮熟的肉。2) 網絡用語，與「生肉」相對，指已經加上中文字幕或經過處理，方便直接觀看的視頻或影音檔案。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to meat that has been cooked. 2) Internet slang (opposite of "raw"/"生肉"): a media file (often anime/foreign video) that has been processed and typically includes Chinese subtitles, ready to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟熟肉好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 suk6 juk6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤熟肉很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of cooked meat is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部日本動畫有熟肉未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 jat6 bun2 dung6 waa6 jau5 suk6 juk6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部日本動畫有中文字幕版了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Is there a Chinese-subtitled version of this Japanese anime yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵到熟肉喇，快啲睇啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 dou3 suk6 juk6 laa3, faai3 di1 tai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找到熟肉了，快點看吧。
examples.english_sentence: I found the subtitled version; hurry up and watch.

mandarin_meaning: 多练习可以掌握技巧
english_meaning: Practice makes perfect; skill comes from repeated practice
explanation_mandarin: 表示通过反复练习可以掌握技巧，技能会逐渐熟练并变得灵巧。
explanation_english: A proverb meaning repeated practice leads to skill — with enough practice, one becomes proficient and adept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要多練習，熟能生巧，唔好灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 do1 lin6 zaap6, suk6 nang4 saang1 haau2, m4 hou2 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要多练习，熟能生巧，不要灰心。
examples.english_sentence: As long as you practice more, practice makes perfect — don't lose heart.

mandarin_meaning: 变得熟悉、亲近；习惯
english_meaning: to become familiar or comfortable (with someone or something); to warm up or get used to
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示與人相處或對某事物逐漸熟悉、親近或習慣起來。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to become familiar or get comfortable with someone/something; to warm up or get used to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋傾咗幾次，依家已經熟落咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 zo2 gei2 ci3, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 suk6 lok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们聊了几次，现在已经熟悉了。
examples.english_sentence: They've talked a few times and are already getting familiar with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一開始同老細唔熟，但做咗幾個月而家熟落咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 hoi1 ci2 tung4 lou5 sai3 m4 suk6, daan6 zou6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 ji4 gaa1 suk6 lok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一开始跟老板不熟，但做了几个月现在熟悉了。
examples.english_sentence: At first we weren't familiar with the boss, but after a few months we're now comfortable (with him).

mandarin_meaning: 熟蛋 / 煮熟的蛋（如水煮蛋、茶叶蛋）
english_meaning: cooked/boiled egg
explanation_mandarin: 指已經煮熟的蛋，常見形式有水煮蛋、茶葉蛋等。日常用語中主要為實物名詞。
explanation_english: Refers to an egg that has been cooked (e.g., boiled egg, tea egg). Primarily a concrete noun in everyday use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗幾隻熟蛋，一齊食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 gei2 zek3 suk6 daan2, jat1 cai4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們買了好幾顆熟蛋，一起吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: We bought several boiled eggs — let's eat together.

mandarin_meaning: 熟練；在某一行很有經驗（熟悉行當）
english_meaning: experienced; well-versed in a trade or line of work; knows the ropes
explanation_mandarin: 「熟行」是廣東話口語，表示在某個行業或某種事務上很有經驗、很熟悉，能夠應付各種情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone is experienced or skilled in a particular field or line of work and knows how to handle various situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行做咗十幾年，好熟行，乜都識處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hong4 zou6 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4, hou2 suk6 hong4, mat1 dou1 sik1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在這行做了十幾年，很熟練，什麼都會處理。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked in this field for over ten years; he's very experienced and can handle anything.

mandarin_meaning: 熟视无睹（对常见或已知的事物视而不见、置若罔闻）
english_meaning: To regard something with familiar indifference; to turn a blind eye; to ignore something one sees frequently
explanation_mandarin: 形容對已經見慣或熟悉的情況不再注意，對問題或不良現象置之不理、視而不見。
explanation_english: Describes becoming so familiar with something that one no longer notices it; used to indicate deliberate indifference or ignoring a problem or undesirable situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經多次收到投訴，管理層卻熟視無睹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 do1 ci3 sau1 dou3 tau4 sou3, gun2 lei5 cang4 koek3 suk6 si6 mou4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經多次收到投訴，管理層卻熟视无睹。
examples.english_sentence: The company has received multiple complaints, but the management turns a blind eye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上啲垃圾大家見慣咗，對佢哋熟視無睹，冇人肯清理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 di1 laap6 saap3 daai6 gaa1 gin3 gun3 zo2, deoi3 keoi5 dei6 suk6 si6 mou4 dou2, mou5 jan4 hang2 cing1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上的垃圾大家看習慣了，對它們熟视无睹，沒人願意清理。
examples.english_sentence: People are used to the trash on the street and ignore it; no one is willing to clean it up.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉；了解
english_meaning: to be familiar with; to know well
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事很了解、熟悉，可作動詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates being well-acquainted or familiar with someone or something. Can function as a verb or an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好熟識，已經識咗十幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 suk6 sik1, ji5 ging1 sik1 zo2 sap6 gei1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很熟悉，已经认识十几年了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very familiar with him; I've known him for over ten years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對呢個城市熟識唔熟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ni1 go3 sing4 si5 suk6 sik1 m4 suk6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对这个城市熟悉吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you familiar with this city?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面好熟識工作流程，負責培訓新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hou2 suk6 sik1 gung1 zok3 lau4 cing4, fu6 zaak3 pui4 fan3 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对公司内部的工作流程很熟悉，负责培训新人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very familiar with the company's internal workflows and is responsible for training new staff.

mandarin_meaning: 熟讀（shú dú）：反覆閱讀直到熟悉或能背誦
english_meaning: to read/study thoroughly; to be very familiar with or memorize by repeated reading
explanation_mandarin: 指把課文或資料反覆閱讀、研讀，直到非常熟悉、掌握內容或能背誦。
explanation_english: To read or study a text or material repeatedly until it is thoroughly known, well understood, or memorized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要熟讀課文，先至可以答到老師嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 suk6 duk6 fo3 man4, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 daap3 dou3 lou5 si1 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要熟讀課文，才能回答老師的問題。
examples.english_sentence: You should study the text thoroughly before you can answer the teacher's questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經熟讀咗成本小說，連細節都記得好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 suk6 duk6 zo2 seng4 bun2 siu2 syut3, lin4 sai3 zit3 dou1 gei3 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經熟讀整本小說，連細節都記得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He has read the entire novel thoroughly and remembers the details clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 熟悉的路；比喻對某事很有經驗或很拿手
english_meaning: a familiar route; (figuratively) experienced or well-practiced at something
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞；（口語）形容詞/比喻用法
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，字面上指熟悉的一條路；引申指對某件事或某個流程很熟練、有經驗或知道常用的辦法/路數。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning a familiar road. Figuratively it describes being familiar with or experienced in something, knowing the usual way of doing things or tricks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，我好熟路，帶你去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, ngo5 hou2 suk6 lou6, daai3 nei5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用擔心，我很熟悉那條路，帶你去。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry — I'm very familiar with that route; I'll take you.

mandarin_meaning: 熟铁（可锻铁、锻铁、软铁）
english_meaning: wrought iron / refined (malleable) iron
explanation_mandarin: 在冶金和材料中指经过锻鍊或加工、碳含量較低、可鍛性的鐵，一般用於欄杆、器具或裝飾品等。與生鐵相比韌性較高，較易加工。
explanation_english: In metallurgy, refers to iron that has been worked or refined (low carbon, malleable iron), often used for railings, tools or decorative items. It is more ductile and easier to work than pig iron.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條欄杆係用熟鐵做嘅，幾穩陣又耐用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 laan4 gon1 hai6 jung6 suk6 tit3 zou6 ge3, gei2 wan2 zan3 jau6 noi6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栏杆是用熟铁做的，挺结实又耐用。
examples.english_sentence: This railing is made of wrought iron; it's quite sturdy and durable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熟鐵比生鐵韌性高，較易加工同鍛造。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 tit3 bei2 saang1 tit3 jan6 sing3 gou1, gaau3 ji6 gaa1 gung1 tung4 dyun3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 熟铁比生铁韧性高，较易加工和锻造。
examples.english_sentence: Wrought iron is more ductile than pig iron and is easier to work and forge.

mandarin_meaning: 熟人 / 熟面孔
english_meaning: a familiar face; an acquaintance
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指看過很多次、彼此熟悉的人或面孔。常與「熟面孔」或「熟人」互換使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for someone you see often or already know — a familiar face or acquaintance. Often used interchangeably with '熟面孔' or '熟人'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅熟面口，成日喺呢間茶餐廳見到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 suk6 min6 hau2, sing4 jat6 hai2 ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 gin3 dou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的熟面孔，經常在這家茶餐廳看到他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a familiar face of mine; I often see him at this cafe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個係我熟面口，唔使特登介紹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 hai6 ngo5 suk6 min6 hau2, m4 sai2 dak6 daan1 gaai3 siu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個是我的熟人，不用特意介紹。
examples.english_sentence: That's someone I know; no need for a formal introduction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆對啲熟面口都好客氣，成日有講有笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 deoi3 di1 suk6 min6 hau2 dou1 hou2 haak3 hei3, sing4 jat6 jau5 gong2 jau5 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆對那些熟客都很客氣，經常有說有笑。
examples.english_sentence: The owner is very friendly with the regulars — often chatting and joking with them.

mandarin_meaning: 熟食（已經煮熟或預先烹調、可直接食用的食品）
english_meaning: cooked food; ready-to-eat food; prepared food
explanation_mandarin: 指已經煮熟或預先烹調、可即食的食品，常見於熟食中心、熟食檔或超市熟食櫃位，用於外賣或即時食用。
explanation_english: Refers to foods that have been cooked or pre-prepared and are ready to eat. Commonly found at cooked-food centres, deli counters, or takeaway stalls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去熟食中心買啲熟食返屋企食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 suk6 sik6 zung1 sam1 maai5 di1 suk6 sik6 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去熟食中心買些熟食回家吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the cooked-food centre tonight to buy some prepared food to take home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有賣各種熟食，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 maai6 gok3 zung2 suk6 sik6, hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有賣各種熟食，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells various ready-to-eat foods; it's very convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 熟食中心 / 熟食广场（提供多档熟食摊位的用餐场所）
english_meaning: cooked food centre; food court / hawker-style food centre with multiple stalls
explanation_mandarin: 在香港等地常見的公共用餐場所，內有多個熟食檔口或小吃攤，顧客可以在不同檔位選擇各類即食食品並在共用座位區用餐。
explanation_english: A common dining venue in Hong Kong and similar places featuring multiple cooked-food stalls or hawker-style vendors. Customers choose food from different stalls and eat in a shared seating area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去熟食中心食嘢，嗰度有好多檔口揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 suk6 sik6 zung1 sam1 sik6 je5, go2 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 dong3 hau2 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去熟食中心吃东西，那里有很多档口可以选择。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the cooked food centre tonight to eat; there are lots of stalls to choose from.

mandarin_meaning: 熟食市场（售卖熟食、即食小吃和热食的市场或摊档区）
english_meaning: cooked-food market / cooked-food centre — a market area with stalls selling ready-to-eat or cooked food
explanation_mandarin: 指通常位于街市或商场内，专门售卖熟食、热食和即食小吃的摊位聚集区，常见于香港的街市或熟食中心。
explanation_english: Refers to an area (often within a wet market or market complex) where stalls sell prepared/cooked foods and ready-to-eat dishes; common in Hong Kong and other Cantonese-speaking places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚喺熟食市場買咗啲燒味返屋企食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 suk6 sik6 si5 coeng4 maai5 zo2 di1 siu1 mei6 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚在熟食市场买了些烧味回家吃。
examples.english_sentence: We bought some roasted meats at the cooked-food market tonight to eat at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熟食市場通常喺街市入面，好方便買即食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 sik6 si5 coeng4 tung1 soeng4 hai2 gaai1 si5 jap6 min6, hou2 fong1 bin6 maai5 zik1 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 熟食市场通常在街市里面，很方便买到即食食品。
examples.english_sentence: Cooked-food markets are usually inside wet markets; it's convenient to buy ready-to-eat food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃翻新幾個熟食市場，改善衛生同環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 faan1 san1 gei2 go3 suk6 sik6 si5 coeng4, goi2 sin6 wai6 sang1 tung4 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划翻新几个熟食市场，改善卫生和环境。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to renovate several cooked-food markets to improve hygiene and the surroundings.

mandarin_meaning: 熟食档（在街市或熟食中心販售即食熟食的小攤或檔位）
english_meaning: cooked-food stall; ready-to-eat food stall (a market or food-centre stall selling prepared hot dishes)
explanation_mandarin: 指在街市、熟食中心或街邊販售已煮熟、可直接食用的菜餚或飯麵的小攤位，常見的有燒味、滷味、湯麵、飯類等，是香港常見的用語。
explanation_english: Refers to a stall or counter in markets or cooked-food centres that sells prepared, ready-to-eat hot dishes (e.g., roast meats, braised items, soups, rice/noodle dishes). Common in Hong Kong and other Cantonese-speaking areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去街市嗰邊嘅熟食檔買雞飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gaai1 si5 go2 bin1 ge3 suk6 sik6 dong3 maai5 gai1 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們去街市那邊的熟食檔買雞飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the cooked-food stall at the market tonight to buy chicken rice.

mandarin_meaning: 熟盐（字面意思為經過處理或烘焙的鹽；在粵語中也可指調味用的『調味鹽』；此詞較罕見或地區性用語）
english_meaning: literally 'cooked/treated salt' — a processed or seasoned salt used for cooking; a regional/rare term for seasoned salt
explanation_mandarin: 「熟鹽」直譯為已處理或烘焙過的鹽，用於烹調或調味。此詞在粵語中相對罕見，常可用來指代市面上的調味鹽或經過加工的食用鹽，亦可能為地區或口語習慣用法。
explanation_english: “熟鹽” literally means salt that has been cooked or processed. It refers to a type of processed or seasoned salt used in cooking. The term is relatively uncommon and may be regional; it is often used to mean seasoned salt or processed edible salt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜要落熟鹽先夠味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 jiu3 lok6 suk6 jim4 sin1 gau3 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜要放熟盐才够味。
examples.english_sentence: This dish needs some seasoned salt to be flavorful.

mandarin_meaning: 光明、閃耀；光彩照人
english_meaning: bright; shining; glittering; radiant
explanation_mandarin: 表示光彩耀眼或明亮，常用於書面語或成語，如「熠熠生輝」。
explanation_english: Indicates shining brightly or radiantly; commonly used in literary contexts and idioms such as "熠熠生輝".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上熠熠生輝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mou5 toi4 seong6 jik6 jik6 saang1 fai1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上熠熠生輝。
examples.english_sentence: He shone brilliantly on the stage.

mandarin_meaning: 闪闪发光；（光芒或眼神）一闪一闪、闪烁不定
english_meaning: to sparkle/twinkle; to glimmer repeatedly (often used as an onomatopoeic expression)
explanation_mandarin: 口语或方言中用于拟声，形容光亮、眼神或闪烁的状态，常以重复形式出现，语气轻快，多用于描写夜空、眼睛或物体的闪烁。
explanation_english: A colloquial/onomatopoeic expression describing something that sparkles or twinkles repeatedly (e.g., stars, eyes, or shiny objects). Commonly used in casual speech to evoke a bright, flickering appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚啲星星熠下熠下，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 di1 sing1 sing1 jik6 haa6 jik6 haa6, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜晚的星星闪闪发光，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The stars at night were twinkling; they looked beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路見到禮物，眼睛都熠下熠下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 gin3 dou3 lai5 mat6, ngaan5 zing1 dou1 jik6 haa6 jik6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩看到礼物，眼睛都闪闪发光。
examples.english_sentence: The child saw the present and their eyes were sparkling.

mandarin_meaning: 裝作很熟/裝作有經驗（帶諷刺）
english_meaning: to pretend to be experienced or overly familiar (sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 「熠熟狗頭」為香港口語／網絡俚語，用於諷刺某人故作老練或裝熟，實際上並無相應的能力或經驗。語氣通常帶嘲諷或不屑。
explanation_english: “熠熟狗頭” is Hong Kong colloquial/internet slang used to mock someone who pretends to be seasoned or overly familiar but actually lacks the ability or real experience. The tone is usually sarcastic or contemptuous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日熠熟狗頭，講到好懂，其實連最基本嘅都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jik6 suk6 gau2 tau4, gong2 dou3 hou2 dung2, kei4 sat6 lin4 zeoi3 gei1 bun2 ge3 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是熠熟狗頭，說得很懂，實際上連最基本的都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps acting like an expert (熠熟狗頭), talks as if he knows everything, but in reality he doesn't even know the basics.

mandarin_meaning: 熨（yùn）：用熨斗或加熱壓平衣物、布料等；也可指壓平、燙平。
english_meaning: to iron (clothes); to press or flatten with heat/pressure
explanation_mandarin: 指用熨斗或熱力把衣物、布料等燙平，使皺摺消失；在口語中也可指用力壓平某物。
explanation_english: Refers to using an iron or heat to smooth out clothes or fabric, removing creases; colloquially can also mean pressing something flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我熨件衫啦，嗰摺未平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 wan3 gin6 saam1 laa1, go2 zip3 mei6 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你幫我熨衣服吧，那個摺痕還沒弄平。
examples.english_sentence: Please help iron my shirt; that crease hasn't been flattened yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識唔識用熨斗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 m4 sik1 jung6 wan3 dau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他會不會用熨斗？
examples.english_sentence: Does he know how to use an iron?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心，熨斗好燙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1, wan3 dau2 hou2 tong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心，熨斗很燙。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, the iron is very hot.

mandarin_meaning: 熨斗（熨衣服用的器具）
english_meaning: clothes iron (tool used to press garments)
explanation_mandarin: 熨斗是用來燙平或去除衣物皺褶的器具，現代多為電熱式。
explanation_english: An iron used to press clothes and remove wrinkles; modern versions are typically electric.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識用熨斗，會燒壞件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 jung6 wan3 dau2, wui5 siu1 waai6 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会用熨斗，会把衣服烫坏。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to use the iron; I'll burn the shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熨斗壞咗，要買部新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan3 dau2 waai6 zo2, jiu3 maai5 bou6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 熨斗坏了，要买一部新的。
examples.english_sentence: The iron broke; I need to buy a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心，熨斗好熱，唔好摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1, wan3 dau2 hou2 jit6, m4 hou2 mo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心，熨斗很热，不要摸。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, the iron is very hot; don't touch it.

mandarin_meaning: 妥貼；貼服；合身；處理得恰當
english_meaning: well-fitted; neat; appropriate; handled properly
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容衣物合身或事情/說法處理得妥當、恰當、不突兀。
explanation_english: Describes something that fits well (e.g. clothing) or an action/remark that is appropriate, neat, or properly handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好熨貼，著落身好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 wan3 tip3, zoek3 lok6 san1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很合身，穿起來很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt fits well and is very comfortable to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講得熨貼啲，佢會比較容易接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 dak1 wan3 tip3 di1, keoi5 wui5 bei2 gaau3 jung6 ji6 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說得更得體一些，他會比較容易接受。
examples.english_sentence: If you say it more appropriately, he'll be more likely to accept it.

mandarin_meaning: 熬（áo）：用小火長時間加熱；忍受、度過（困苦）；熬夜（通宵不睡）
english_meaning: to simmer/slow-cook for a long time; to endure/suffer through; to stay up late (to pull an all-nighter)
explanation_mandarin: 「熬」可以指用文火長時間加熱（如熬湯、熬藥），也可指忍受困苦或勉強支撐，還可表示通宵不睡（熬夜）。
explanation_english: “熬” can mean to simmer or slow-cook over low heat (e.g., simmer soup or decoct medicine), to endure or suffer through hardships, and to stay up late (to pull an all-nighter).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺爐頭熬中藥，熬咗成個鐘先夠味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 lou4 tau4 ngou4 zung1 joek6, ngou4 zo2 sing4 go3 zung1 sin1 gau3 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽在爐上熬中藥，熬了一個小時才夠味。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is simmering the herbal medicine on the stove; she simmered it for an hour to bring out the flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗照顧家庭，熬咗好多年先穩定落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 ziu3 gu3 gaa1 ting4, ngou4 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 sin1 wan2 ding6 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了照顧家庭，熬了很多年才穩定下來。
examples.english_sentence: He endured many years taking care of the family before things finally settled down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我昨晚熬夜做功課，依家頭好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zok6 maan5 ngou4 je6 zou6 gung1 fo3, ji4 gaa1 tau4 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚熬夜做功課，現在頭很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I pulled an all-nighter doing homework last night; my head really hurts now.

mandarin_meaning: 熬出头 / 熬出头来（经过辛苦或长期坚持后终于成功或翻身）
english_meaning: to endure hardship and finally come out on top; to succeed after a period of struggle
explanation_mandarin: 表示經過長時間的忍耐或艱苦努力，最終取得成功或改善處境，常用於形容從低處經過努力升到較好地位。
explanation_english: A colloquial phrase meaning to persevere through difficult times and eventually achieve success or improve one’s situation; often used to describe rising from a low position after hard work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年基層，終於熬出頭，依家做主管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 gei1 cang4, zung1 jyu1 ngou4 ceot1 tau4, ji4 gaa1 zou6 zyu2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了幾年基層，終於熬出頭，現在做主管。
examples.english_sentence: He worked several years at the grassroots level and finally made it; now he's a manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放棄，只要努力總有一日會熬出頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 hei3, zi2 jiu3 nou5 lik6 zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 ngou4 ceot1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要放棄，只要努力總有一天會熬出頭。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up — if you keep working hard you'll eventually get ahead.

mandarin_meaning: 熬夜
english_meaning: to stay up late; to stay up all night
explanation_mandarin: 指在深夜仍然不睡覺，熬到很晚或通宵，通常因工作、學習或娛樂而延遲睡眠，可能對健康有害。
explanation_english: To stay awake late into the night or all night, often due to work, study, or leisure; can have negative effects on health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有個報告要交，我成日熬夜做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 go3 bou3 gou3 jiu3 gaau1, ngo5 sing4 jat6 ngo4 je6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有个报告要交，我经常熬夜做。
examples.english_sentence: I have a report due recently; I've been staying up late to work on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日熬夜，對身體唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 ngo4 je6, deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要经常熬夜，对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stay up late all the time; it's bad for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋通宵打機，今晚應該會熬夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung1 siu1 daa2 gei1, gam1 maan5 jing1 goi1 wui5 ngo4 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们通宵打游戏，今晚应该会熬夜。
examples.english_sentence: We're gaming all night; we'll probably stay up late tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 到老都沒有伴，孤獨終老（粵語俚語）
english_meaning: to end up single in old age; to grow old without a partner (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來形容一個人到老仍然沒有伴侶、單身到老，語氣常帶有擔心或自嘲。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang describing someone who will grow old without a partner — to end up single in old age; often used with a tone of worry or self-mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日唔出去識人，驚遲啲會熬老襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jat6 m4 ceot1 heoi3 sik1 jan4, geng1 ci4 di1 wui5 ngou4 lou5 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總是不出去認識人，擔心將來會孤老無伴。
examples.english_sentence: They never go out to meet people and worry they'll end up alone when they're older.

mandarin_meaning: （罕用）缓慢燃烧、发热发光；闷烧、炭火微红发亮
english_meaning: (rare/archaic) to smolder; to glow or burn slowly (as embers); a smoldering ember
explanation_mandarin: “熰”为较少使用的汉字，常用来形容炭、火等在无明火下缓慢闷烧、发热发光的状态。现代汉语中多见于文献或方言用法。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character used to describe slow burning or smoldering (e.g., embers glowing without open flame). Mostly appears in literary or dialectal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 炭頭仲喺熰，唔好摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taan3 tau4 zung6 hai6 jung2, m4 hou2 mo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炭火还在闷烧，别摸。
examples.english_sentence: The charcoal is still smoldering; don't touch it.

mandarin_meaning: 热（rè）
english_meaning: hot; warm; feverish; (can indicate popularity in some contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 表示溫度高（如天氣或物體）；也可指身體發燒或口語中表示受歡迎、熱門的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates a high temperature (for weather or objects); can describe being feverish; colloquially may imply being popular or 'hot'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好熱，要開冷氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6, jiu3 hoi1 laang5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很热，要开空调。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot today; we need to turn on the air conditioner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗湯好熱，小心燙親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 tong1 hou2 jit6, siu2 sam1 tong3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這碗湯很燙，小心燙到。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of soup is very hot; be careful not to burn yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發緊燒，覺得好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 gan2 siu1, gok3 dak1 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在发烧，觉得很热。
examples.english_sentence: He's having a fever and feels very hot.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見用語，通常被視為錯寫或非標準用法；有時可能是將「熱狗」(熱狗，指 hot dog)誤寫成「熱九」。字面上為「熱（熱的）+ 九（數字九）」，但並無常見的固有含義。
english_meaning: Rare/obscure term; generally regarded as a misspelling or nonstandard usage. It is sometimes a typo of 熱狗 (hot dog). Literally 'hot + nine', but it has no established meaning in standard Cantonese.
explanation_mandarin: 「熱九」並非香港廣泛使用的詞彙或成語。發音與「熱狗」相同（jit6 gau2），因此在書寫或輸入時有人會把「狗」錯寫為「九」。除被視為錯字外，沒有固定的語義或慣用搭配。
explanation_english: “熱九” is not a commonly used Cantonese word or idiom. It shares pronunciation with 熱狗 (jit6 gau2), so it often appears as a typographic or input error where 狗 ('dog') is written as 九 ('nine'). Apart from being considered a misspelling, it has no established meaning or common collocations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺群組入面打錯字，將「熱狗」寫成「熱九」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kwan4 zou2 jap6 min6 daa2 co3 zi6, zoeng1 "jit6 gau2" se2 sing4 "jit6 gau2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在群組裡打錯字，把「熱狗」寫成「熱九」。
examples.english_sentence: They made a typo in the group chat, writing '熱九' instead of '熱狗' (hot dog).

mandarin_meaning: 热兵器；指利用火药或爆炸力发射弹丸或弹头的武器，如枪械、火炮等。
english_meaning: Firearms / gunpowder weapons — weapons that use explosive propellants to launch projectiles (e.g., guns, artillery).
explanation_mandarin: 用于与冷兵器相对，通常指依靠火药或爆炸能量发射弹丸的武器体系，包括手枪、步枪、机枪、火炮等；在广义上可指以火力为主的现代武器装备。
explanation_english: Contrasted with 'cold weapons', it refers to weapons that rely on gunpowder or explosive force to project bullets or shells, such as pistols, rifles, machine guns, and artillery. Broadly, it can denote the firepower component of modern weaponry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺現代戰爭，熱兵器好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jin6 doi6 zin3 zang1, jit6 bing1 hei3 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在现代战争中，热兵器非常重要。
examples.english_sentence: In modern warfare, firearms are very important.

mandarin_meaning: 熱切（表示急切、渴望或熱切期待）
english_meaning: eager; keen; ardent; enthusiastic
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事物或某行動抱有強烈的期待或關注，帶有積極或迫切的意味。
explanation_english: Indicates having a strong expectation or keen interest in something or an action, often implying eagerness or urgency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個計劃好熱切，希望可以盡快開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hou2 jit6 cit3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zeon6 faai3 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對這個計劃很熱切，希望可以盡快開始。
examples.english_sentence: He is very eager about this project and hopes it can start soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請人對呢份工表現出熱切嘅興趣，面試官印象良好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 jan4 deoi3 ni1 fan6 gung1 biu2 jin6 ceot1 jit6 cit3 ge3 hing3 ceoi3, min6 si3 gun1 jan3 soeng2 loeng4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申請人對這份工作表現出熱切的興趣，面試官印象良好。
examples.english_sentence: The applicant showed keen interest in this job, leaving a good impression on the interviewer.

mandarin_meaning: 热得要命 / 热得不得了（非常热）
english_meaning: extremely hot; scorching; very intense (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「熱到飛起」是粵語口語說法，用來形容天氣、場所或情況非常炎熱或熱得誇張，也可用作強調程度。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning extremely hot or overwhelmingly warm. It describes weather, places, or situations that are intensely hot and is used to emphasize degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日熱到飛起，出街記得帶遮同抹汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jit6 dou3 fei1 hei2, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze3 tung4 mut6 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天热得要命，出门记得带伞并擦汗。
examples.english_sentence: It's scorching hot today — remember to take an umbrella and wipe your sweat when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會場熱到飛起，大家坐低都出晒汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 coeng4 jit6 dou3 fei1 hei2, daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 dou1 ceot1 saai3 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会场热得不得了，大家坐着都满身大汗。
examples.english_sentence: The venue was unbelievably hot — everyone was sitting there sweating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌而家熱到飛起，成日都喺榜上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ji4 gaa1 jit6 dou3 fei1 hei2, sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 bong2 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌现在红得不得了，常常在排行榜上。
examples.english_sentence: This song is crazy popular right now — it's always on the charts.

mandarin_meaning: 热力（rèlì）；比喻气氛热烈、活力或劲头
english_meaning: heat; energy; enthusiasm; momentum (colloquially: lively energy or momentum)
explanation_mandarin: 原指热量或热能，在粤语口语中常用来形容气氛热烈、充满活力或有冲劲。
explanation_english: Originally refers to thermal energy/heat. In Cantonese colloquial usage it commonly describes a lively atmosphere, strong energy, or momentum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌好有熱力，令全場都跳起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hou2 jau5 jit6 lik6, ling6 cyun4 coeng4 dou1 tiu3 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很有热力，让全场都跳起来。
examples.english_sentence: This song has a lot of energy and made the whole audience start dancing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好有熱力，做嘢好有衝勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 jau5 jit6 lik6, zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 cung1 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很有热力，做事很有冲劲。
examples.english_sentence: He's been full of energy lately and very driven at work.

mandarin_meaning: 熱的啤酒；變溫、不再冰涼的啤酒（通常口感較差）
english_meaning: warm beer; beer that has lost its chill (usually undesirable)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指啤酒因放置或環境溫度升高而變暖，影響口感。可作日常描述，不是正式術語。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to beer that has warmed up (lost its cold temperature), affecting its taste. Common informal usage rather than a technical term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好飲熱啤啦，放去雪櫃攞返凍啲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jam2 jit6 be1 laa1, fong3 heoi3 syut3 gwai6 lo2 faan1 dung3 di1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要喝熱啤，把它放進冰箱先讓它冷一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink warm beer; put it in the fridge to cool it down first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢罐放咗成日，依家淨係係熱啤，味道唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gun3 fong3 zo2 seng4 jat6, ji1 gaa1 zing6 hai6 jit6 be1, mei6 dou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這罐放了一整天，現在只是熱啤，味道不好。
examples.english_sentence: This can has been sitting all day; it's just warm beer now and doesn't taste good.

mandarin_meaning: 热天
english_meaning: hot day; hot weather
explanation_mandarin: 指天氣很熱的日子，常用來描述高溫、悶熱的天氣狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to a day with hot weather; used to describe high temperatures and stuffy, warm conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係熱天，出街記得飲多啲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 jit6 tin1, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是热天，出门记得多喝点水。
examples.english_sentence: It's a hot day today; remember to drink more water when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排熱天，街上人人都著短衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 jit6 tin1, gaai1 soeng6 jan4 jan4 dou1 zoek3 dyun2 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近是热天，街上人们都穿短袖。
examples.english_sentence: It's been hot recently; people on the street are wearing short sleeves.

mandarin_meaning: 热带
english_meaning: the tropics; tropical zone
explanation_mandarin: 指位於赤道附近、氣候炎熱且雨量充沛的地區，常見熱帶雨林或季風氣候。
explanation_english: Refers to the region near the equator characterized by hot temperatures and abundant rainfall; often associated with tropical rainforests or monsoon climates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱帶雨林嘅生物好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 daai3 jyu5 lam4 ge3 saang1 mat6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 热带雨林的生物非常丰富。
examples.english_sentence: The biodiversity of tropical rainforests is very rich.

mandarin_meaning: 热带气旋 (rèdài qìxuán)
english_meaning: tropical cyclone (including tropical storms, typhoons, or hurricanes depending on intensity and region)
explanation_mandarin: 熱帶氣旋是形成於熱帶或副熱帶海洋上的低氣壓系統，通常伴隨強風和暴雨。根據強度和所在海域，強烈的熱帶氣旋可稱為颱風、颶風或熱帶風暴。
explanation_english: A tropical cyclone is a low-pressure system that forms over tropical or subtropical oceans, typically bringing strong winds and heavy rain. Depending on intensity and region, strong tropical cyclones are called typhoons, hurricanes, or tropical storms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台話會有熱帶氣旋靠近香港，大家要準備好抗風措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 wui5 jau5 jit6 daai3 hei3 syun4 kaau3 gan6 hoeng1 gong2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2 kong3 fung1 cou3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台說有熱帶氣旋靠近香港，大家要準備好防風措施。
examples.english_sentence: The Observatory says a tropical cyclone is approaching Hong Kong; everyone should prepare for strong winds and take safety precautions.

mandarin_meaning: 脾氣急躁；上火
english_meaning: hot-tempered; irritable (also: having internal 'heat' in TCM, i.e. 'shang huo')
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，常用來形容一個人容易生氣、脾氣急躁；亦可指中醫所說的“上火”導致口瘡、喉痛等症狀。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term used to describe someone who is easily angered or short-tempered. It can also refer to the TCM notion of 'internal heat' (shang huo) that causes mouth ulcers, sore throat, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都熱底，好容易就發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jit6 dai2, hou2 ji6 jung4 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她很容易生氣，脾氣很急躁。
examples.english_sentence: He/she gets hot-tempered easily; quick to lose their temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我好熱底，口瘡連連，可能要食清熱的藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 hou2 jit6 dai2, hau2 cong1 lin4 lin4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 sik6 cing1 jit6 dik1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我上火，口腔潰瘍不斷，可能要吃清熱的藥。
examples.english_sentence: I've been 'hot' lately and keep getting mouth ulcers; I might need medicine to clear the heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪熱底呀？點解今日咁易嬲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai6 jit6 dai2 aa3? dim2 gaai2 gam2 ji6 nau5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是脾氣不好/上火了？為什麼今天這麼容易生氣？
examples.english_sentence: Are you hot-tempered? Why are you so easily annoyed today?

mandarin_meaning: 热厨房（指餐厅或宴会中负责烹饪热菜的厨房区域）
english_meaning: hot kitchen (the area in a restaurant or catering operation where hot dishes are prepared)
explanation_mandarin: 在餐飲業中，「熱廚房」指負責烹調熱食、熱菜的廚房區，通常與處理冷菜或沙律的「冷廚房」相對。也可作字面上的「溫度較高的廚房」。
explanation_english: In the food service industry, 'hot kitchen' refers to the kitchen area responsible for cooking hot dishes, as opposed to the 'cold kitchen' that handles salads and cold preparations. It can also be used literally for a physically hot kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅熱廚房好亂，廚師要快手啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 jit6 cyu4 fong4 hou2 lyun6, cyu4 si1 jiu3 faai3 sau2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的熱廚房很混亂，廚師要快一點。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant's hot kitchen is chaotic; the cooks need to be quicker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺大型宴會，熱廚房通常同冷廚房分開安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daai6 jing4 jin3 wui2, jit6 cyu4 fong4 tung1 soeng4 tung4 laang5 cyu4 fong4 fan1 hoi1 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在大型宴會中，熱廚房通常與冷廚房分開安排。
examples.english_sentence: At large banquets, the hot kitchen is usually arranged separately from the cold kitchen.

mandarin_meaning: 热心 (rèxīn)：热情、乐于助人、积极投入
english_meaning: warm-hearted; enthusiastic; eager to help; zealous
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人有熱情、樂於幫助別人或對某事物積極投入、關心。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is warm-hearted, enthusiastic, and willing to help others or actively engaged with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好熱心，成日幫人解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jit6 sam1, sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很热心，经常帮助别人解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: He's very warm-hearted and often helps others solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁熱心幫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam2 jit6 sam1 bong1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你这么热心帮我。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for being so helpful.

mandarin_meaning: 热忱（rèchén）：热情、真诚的态度或感情
english_meaning: warm enthusiasm; sincere ardor; fervent zeal
explanation_mandarin: 表示对人或事物充满真诚和热情的态度或感情，常用来形容工作、事业、服务等方面的积极投入。
explanation_english: Refers to a sincere, warm enthusiasm or ardent attitude toward someone or something; commonly describes committed, wholehearted engagement in work, service, or causes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對教學充滿熱忱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gaau3 hok6 cung1 mun5 jit6zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對教學充滿熱忱。
examples.english_sentence: He is full of enthusiasm for teaching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用滿腔嘅熱忱去幫助新同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 mun5 kong1 ge3 jit6zam1 heoi3 bong1 zo6 san1 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以滿腔的熱忱幫助新同事。
examples.english_sentence: He helps new colleagues with wholehearted enthusiasm.

mandarin_meaning: 热情（对人或事物充满热忱、热心）
english_meaning: enthusiasm; warmth; passionate; cordiality
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人或事充滿熱忱、積極關心或熱烈的態度。可用作形容詞或名詞，描述人的態度或氣氛。
explanation_english: Indicates warm enthusiasm or a passionate, cordial attitude toward people or things. Can be used as an adjective or a noun to describe a person's attitude or the atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對工作好有熱情，日日都好投入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 zok3 hou2 jau5 jit6 cing4, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 tau4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對工作很有熱情，每天都很投入。
examples.english_sentence: He is very enthusiastic about his work and is very engaged every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 店員招呼客人態度好熱情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim3 jyun4 ziu1 fu1 haak3 jan4 taai3 dou6 hou2 jit6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店員招待客人的態度很熱情。
examples.english_sentence: The shop assistant greeted customers very warmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對新同事非常熱情，幫手介紹公司制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 san1 tung4 si6 fei1 soeng4 jit6 cing4, bong1 sau2 gaai3 siu6 gung1 si1 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對新同事非常熱情，幫忙介紹公司制度。
examples.english_sentence: He is very warm toward new colleagues and helps introduce the company rules.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语俚语）热情、外向的人；字面也可指百香果（passion fruit）
english_meaning: a very enthusiastic, outgoing person (slang); literally, passion fruit
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中常用作俚语，形容性格热情、外向、喜欢主动与人交往的人；在字面上也可指一种水果（即百香果/ pasión fruit）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, it describes someone who is very enthusiastic and outgoing — a social, proactive person. Literally it can also mean the fruit 'passion fruit'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明係個十足嘅熱情果，成日主動同人傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai6 go3 sap6 zuk1 ge3 jit6 cing4 gwo2, sing4 jat6 zyu2 dung6 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是个十足的热情果，总是主动和别人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: A-Ming is a real social butterfly; he's always starting conversations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食熱情果雪糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 jit6 cing4 gwo2 syut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃百香果冰淇淋。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating passion fruit ice cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做咁嘅熱情果，太熱情有時會令人覺得唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 gam2 ge3 jit6 cing4 gwo2, taai3 jit6 cing4 jau5 si4 wui5 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别做那么热情的人，太热情有时会让人觉得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such an overly enthusiastic person; being too enthusiastic can sometimes make others uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 热爱 (rè'ài)
english_meaning: to love passionately; to be ardently fond of
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某事怀有强烈的喜爱或热情，通常用于正式或书面语。
explanation_english: Indicates having a strong love or passion for someone or something; often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對音樂非常熱愛，經常練習同創作新歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 jam1 ngok6 fei1 soeng4 jit6 oi3, ging1 soeng4 lin6 zaap6 tung4 cong3 zok3 san1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她非常热爱音乐，经常练习并创作新歌。
examples.english_sentence: He/She loves music passionately and often practices and composes new songs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多學生都熱愛科學，希望將來可以從事科研工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hok6 saang1 dou1 jit6 oi3 fo1 hok6, hei1 mong6 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 cung4 si6 fo1 jin4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多学生都热爱科学，希望将来可以从事科研工作。
examples.english_sentence: Many students are passionate about science and hope to work in research in the future.

mandarin_meaning: 熱感（指感到身體或局部溫熱的感覺，常與發燒或炎症有關）
english_meaning: sensation of heat; feeling of warmth (often associated with fever or localized inflammation)
explanation_mandarin: 指感覺到身體整體或局部溫熱的症狀，常見於發燒、炎症或局部血流增加，也可用於描述皮膚或內臟的熱覺。
explanation_english: Refers to the experience of overall or localized warmth in the body; commonly occurs with fever, inflammation, or increased local blood flow. Can describe skin or internal heat sensations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有啲熱感，可能發燒喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 di1 jit6 gam2, ho2 nang4 fat3 siu1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有點熱感，可能發燒了。
examples.english_sentence: I have a sensation of heat; I might have a fever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病人話皮膚有局部熱感同紅腫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 jan4 waa6 pei4 fu1 jau5 guk6 bou6 jit6 gam2 tung4 hung4 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 患者報稱皮膚有局部熱感和紅腫。
examples.english_sentence: The patient reported localized heat sensation of the skin along with redness and swelling.

mandarin_meaning: 热敏纸
english_meaning: thermal paper (heat-sensitive paper used for receipts, tickets, labels)
explanation_mandarin: 指表面塗有感熱塗層、受熱會變色的紙張，常用於收據、發票、標籤和傳真紙等印刷方式，長時間會褪色。
explanation_english: Paper coated with a heat-sensitive layer that darkens when heated; commonly used for receipts, tickets, labels and fax paper. Prints can fade over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲收據係熱感紙印嘅，時間耐咗會褪色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sau1 geoi3 hai6 jit6 gam2 zi2 jan3 ge3, si4 gaan3 noi6 zo2 wui5 teoi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些收据是用热敏纸打印的，放久会褪色。
examples.english_sentence: These receipts were printed on thermal paper; they fade over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這張小票係用熱感紙印出嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 zoeng1 siu2 piu3 hai6 jung6 jit6 gam2 zi2 jan3 ceot1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张小票是用热敏纸印出来的。
examples.english_sentence: This receipt was printed on thermal paper.

mandarin_meaning: 热恋（深切而热烈的恋爱）
english_meaning: to be passionately in love; a passionate romance
explanation_mandarin: 表示兩人處於熱烈、甜蜜的戀愛階段，可以作動詞（正熱戀）或作名詞（熱戀期）。
explanation_english: Indicates that two people are in a passionate, affectionate stage of a relationship. Can be used as a verb (to be in passionate love) or as a noun (a period of passionate love).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋而家正熱戀，成日黐埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zing3 jit6 lyun2, seng4 jat6 ci1 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们现在正热恋，经常黏在一起。
examples.english_sentence: They're currently passionately in love and are always together.

mandarin_meaning: 热播（节目/剧集被大量播放或非常受欢迎）
english_meaning: widely broadcast; a program or show that is being heavily aired or is very popular
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容電視劇、節目等目前被大量播放或非常受歡迎，常見搭配如「熱播劇」。
explanation_english: Used to describe TV shows or programs that are currently being heavily aired or are very popular. Often appears in collocations like "a hotly-broadcast drama."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套新劇而家好熱播，收視成日都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 san1 kek6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 jit6 bo3, sau1 si6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部新剧现在很热播，收视率一直很高。
examples.english_sentence: That new drama is currently being widely broadcast and has consistently high ratings.

mandarin_meaning: 热敏纸
english_meaning: thermal paper (coated paper that changes color when heated, used for receipts, fax paper, labels)
explanation_mandarin: 一种表面涂有热敏显色层的纸张，遇热会发生颜色变化，常用于收据、传真纸和票据等。
explanation_english: Paper coated with a heat-sensitive layer that changes color when exposed to heat; commonly used for receipts, fax paper, and labels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收銀機印出嚟嘅單係用熱敏紙印嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 ngan4 gei1 jan3 ceot1 lai4 ge3 daan1 hai6 jung6 jit6 man5 zi2 jan3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收银机印出来的单子是用热敏纸打印的。
examples.english_sentence: The receipt printed by the cash register is on thermal paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱敏紙遇熱會變色，所以保存時要避免陽光直射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 man5 zi2 jyu6 jit6 wui5 bin3 sik1, so2 ji5 bou2 cyun4 si4 jiu3 bei6 min5 joeng4 gwong1 zik6 se6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 热敏纸遇热会变色，所以保存时要避免阳光直射。
examples.english_sentence: Thermal paper discolors when exposed to heat, so avoid direct sunlight when storing it.

mandarin_meaning: 上火 / 內熱
english_meaning: heatiness (internal heat in TCM); getting 'hot' or causing symptoms like mouth ulcers
explanation_mandarin: 中醫概念，指人體內的過度熱量或陰陽失衡引起的燥熱症狀（如口腔潰瘍、喉嚨痛、便秘、長痘等）。在廣東話中也常用來形容某食物或行為容易令人生病或不舒服（“上火”）。
explanation_english: A Traditional Chinese Medicine concept meaning internal heat or 'heatiness' caused by diet, environment, or imbalance, producing symptoms such as mouth ulcers, sore throat, constipation, or acne. Colloquially used to say something or someone causes heatiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咁多煎炸嘢會熱氣㗎，飲啲菊花茶好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 gam2 do1 zin1 zaa3 je5 wui5 jit6 hei3 gaa3, jam2 di1 guk1 faa1 caa4 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃这么多油炸的东西会上火，喝点菊花茶好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Eating so much fried food will make you heaty; drink some chrysanthemum tea to feel better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近成日口腔生瘡，可能係有啲熱氣，要少吃辛辣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 hau2 hong1 saang1 cong1, ho2 nang4 hai6 jau5 di1 jit6 hei3, jiu3 siu2 hek3 san1 laat6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近总是口腔长溃疡，可能是有点上火，要少吃辛辣的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I've been getting mouth ulcers lately—maybe I'm a bit heaty; I should eat less spicy food.

mandarin_meaning: 热气球 (rèqìqiú)
english_meaning: hot air balloon
explanation_mandarin: 一種靠加熱氣體使大氣球產生浮力從而升空的飛行器或娛樂用氣球。
explanation_english: A large balloon that rises and flies by heating the air inside it; used for flight and recreational rides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋星期日去坐熱氣球，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 co5 jit6 hei3 kau4, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们星期天去坐热气球，好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go for a hot air balloon ride on Sunday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 熱氣球慢慢升上藍天，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jit6 hei3 kau4 maan6 maan6 sing1 soeng5 laam4 tin1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 热气球慢慢升上蓝天，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The hot air balloon slowly rose into the blue sky; it's beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 會令人上火的飯或食物
english_meaning: heat-inducing meal/food (food that causes 'internal heat' symptoms)
explanation_mandarin: 「熱氣飯」是廣東話口語，指容易引起「上火」症狀（如口瘡、喉嚨痛、長痘等）的飯或菜肴，通常指油膩、辛熱或燒烤類食物。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for meals or foods that tend to cause 'internal heat' (symptoms like mouth ulcers, sore throat, acne). Typically refers to oily, spicy, or roasted foods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日唔好食太多熱氣飯，會上火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 m4 hou2 sik6 taai3 do1 jit6 hei3 faan6, wui5 soeng5 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天別吃太多會上火的食物，會上火的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat too much heat-inducing food today; it'll make you 'hot' (cause symptoms).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲燒味配白飯好熱氣，最好飲杯涼茶中和一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 siu1 mei6 pui3 baak6 faan6 hou2 jit6 hei3, zeoi3 hou2 jam2 bui1 loeng4 caa4 zung1 wo4 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些燒臘配白飯很容易上火，最好喝杯涼茶中和一下。
examples.english_sentence: These roasted meats with plain rice are likely to cause 'heatiness'; it's best to drink some cooling herbal tea to balance it.

mandarin_meaning: 热水壶
english_meaning: kettle; hot-water kettle
explanation_mandarin: 指用來燒、盛裝或保溫熱水的容器，常見類型有電水壺、燒水壺或保溫壺（但保溫壺有時稱為保溫瓶）。
explanation_english: A container used to boil, hold, or keep water hot. Common types include electric kettles and stovetop kettles (note: thermal flasks are sometimes called vacuum flasks).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房裡個熱水壺壞咗，要唔要我買個新嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 leoi5 go3 jit6 seoi2 wu4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 maai5 go3 san1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里的热水壶坏了，要不要我买一个新的？
examples.english_sentence: The kettle in the kitchen is broken. Do you want me to buy a new one?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放低個熱水壺，小心燙親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 dai1 go3 jit6 seoi2 wu4, siu2 sam1 tong3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把热水壶放下，小心烫到。
examples.english_sentence: Put the kettle down, be careful not to get burned.

mandarin_meaning: 热水器; 热水炉 (用于加热和储存热水的家用设备)
english_meaning: water heater; hot water boiler; geyser
explanation_mandarin: 指用于加热并提供热水的家用设备，常安装在浴室或厨房附近，用于淋浴或洗涤。
explanation_english: A household appliance that heats and stores hot water, commonly installed near bathrooms or kitchens for showers and washing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部熱水爐壞咗，要搵人修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 re6 seoi2 lou4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的热水器坏了，要找人修理。
examples.english_sentence: My water heater is broken; I need to get someone to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啱啱換咗個新嘅熱水爐，而家沖涼有熱水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaam1 ngaam1 wun6 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 re6 seoi2 lou4, ji4 gaa1 cung1 loeng4 jau5 re6 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚换了一个新的热水器，现在洗澡有热水了。
examples.english_sentence: We just replaced the water heater, so now there's hot water for showers.

mandarin_meaning: 热浪（rèlàng），指一段持续且异常的高温天气，通常称为“热浪”或“热浪来袭”
english_meaning: heatwave; a prolonged period of excessively hot weather
explanation_mandarin: 指一段時間內持續且異常的高溫天氣，常伴隨高濕度和對健康、用電需求等造成影響，可能增加中暑和相關健康風險。
explanation_english: Refers to a prolonged period of unusually high temperatures, often accompanied by high humidity and impacts on health, electricity demand, and increased risk of heat-related illnesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近的熱浪好厲害，大家出街記得搽防曬同飲多啲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 dik1 jit6 long6 hou2 lai6 haai6, daai6 gaa1 ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 caat3 fong4 saai3 tung4 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的热浪很厉害，大家出门记得擦防晒并多喝水。
examples.english_sentence: The recent heatwave is severe; everyone going out remember to apply sunscreen and drink more water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院提醒長者避開熱浪嘅高峰時段，盡量留在冷氣場所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 tai4 jing6 coeng4 ze2 bei6 hoi1 jit6 long6 ge3 gou1 fung1 si4 dyun6, zeon6 loeng6 lau4 zoi6 laang5 hei3 coeng4 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院提醒长者避开热浪的高峰时段，尽量待在有空调的场所。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital reminded elderly people to avoid peak times of the heatwave and stay in air-conditioned places when possible.

mandarin_meaning: 热泪（因情绪激动流出的眼泪）
english_meaning: hot tears; tears shed from strong emotion
explanation_mandarin: 指因感动、悲伤或激动等情绪而流出的眼泪，常用於“熱淚盈眶”等表述。
explanation_english: Refers to tears produced by strong emotions such as being moved or saddened; often used in expressions like 'hot tears filling the eyes.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講到激動，忍唔住流出熱淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 gik1 dung6, jan2 m4 zyu6 lau4 ceot1 jit6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲到激动，忍不住流出热泪。
examples.english_sentence: He became so moved while speaking that he couldn't help shedding tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到家人健康，好多回憶湧返上心頭，我都掉下幾滴熱淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 gaa1 jan4 gin6 hong1, hou2 do1 wui4 jik1 jung5 faan1 soeng5 sam1 tau4, ngo5 dou1 diu6 haa6 gei2 dik1 jit6 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到家人健康，很多回忆涌上心头，我也流下几滴热泪。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing my family healthy brought back so many memories that I shed a few hot tears.

mandarin_meaning: 热泪盈眶（眼中充满泪水，通常表示非常感动或悲伤）
english_meaning: eyes brimming with tears; moved to tears; almost crying from strong emotion
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语 / 形容词性短语
explanation_mandarin: 形容眼睛里充满热泪，表示受到强烈的感动、悲伤或激动，快要哭出来。
explanation_english: Describes eyes filled with tears, indicating strong emotion such as deep feeling, sadness, or being moved to the point of crying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起嗰段經歷，令我熱淚盈眶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 go2 dyun6 ging1lik6, ling6 ngo5 jit6 leoi6 jing4 kwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲起那段经历，使我热泪盈眶。
examples.english_sentence: When he talked about that experience, it moved me to tears.

mandarin_meaning: 熱滯（中醫/俗稱上火或熱氣滯留）
english_meaning: heat stagnation; feeling heaty/blocked (TCM term and colloquial for feeling hot, bloated or unwell after eating spicy/oily food)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語及中醫語境中，「熱滯」指體內熱邪或熱氣滯留，可能引起口乾、口瘡、喉嚨痛、便秘或胃脹等不適。口語上也常用來形容吃太多辛辣或油膩食物後的燥熱、不舒服感。
explanation_english: In Cantonese and TCM contexts, '熱滯' (heat stagnation) refers to heat being retained or stagnant in the body, causing symptoms like dry mouth, mouth ulcers, sore throat, constipation, or bloating. Colloquially it describes feeling heaty, bloated, or generally unwell after eating too much spicy or greasy food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食咗好多辣嘢，依家覺得熱滯，喉嚨又痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 laat6 je5, ji4 gaa1 gok3 dak1 jit6 zai3, hau4 lung4 jau6 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃了很多辣的東西，現在覺得熱滯，喉嚨也痛。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a lot of spicy food; now I feel heat-stagnated (heaty) and my throat hurts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣熱，加上熬夜，我成日覺得熱滯，唔想食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 jit6, gaa1 soeng6 ngou4 je6, ngo5 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 jit6 zai3, m4 soeng2 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天氣炎熱，加上熬夜，我經常感到熱滯，不想吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the weather's hot and I've been staying up late; I often feel heaty/stagnated and don't want to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 热潮（rècháo）
english_meaning: wave; craze; boom
explanation_mandarin: 指在某段時間內廣泛流行或引起高度關注的現象，一股熱烈的潮流或風氣。
explanation_english: A phenomenon that becomes widely popular or attracts intense attention for a period of time; a wave or craze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近人工智能好熱門，掀起咗一股學習人工智能嘅熱潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jan4 gung1 zi6 nang4 hou2 jit6 mun5, hin1 hei2 zo2 jat1 gu2 hok6 zaap6 jan4 gung1 zi6 nang4 ge3 jit6 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近人工智能很熱門，引起了一股學習人工智能的熱潮。
examples.english_sentence: Recently AI has become very popular, sparking a wave of people learning AI.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新出嘅韓劇一播出就掀起咗一陣追捧嘅熱潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ceot1 ge3 hon4 kek6 jat1 bo3 ceot1 zau6 hin1 hei2 zo2 jat1 zan6 zeoi1 pung2 ge3 jit6 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新出的韓劇一播出就掀起了一陣追捧的熱潮。
examples.english_sentence: The new Korean drama sparked a wave of adoration as soon as it aired.

mandarin_meaning: 热烈
english_meaning: enthusiastic; ardent; fervent; warm
explanation_mandarin: 表示情感、氣氛或反應非常強烈且熱情，常用來形容歡迎、掌聲、反應等，是一個形容詞。
explanation_english: Indicates a strong, enthusiastic, or fervent feeling or atmosphere; often used to describe receptions, applause, reactions, etc. It is an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 觀眾對歌手嘅表現反應熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 zung3 deoi3 go1 sau2 ge3 biu2 jin2 faan2 jing3 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 观众对歌手的表现反应热烈。
examples.english_sentence: The audience reacted enthusiastically to the singer's performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋以熱烈嘅掌聲歡迎新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 jit6 lit6 ge3 zoeng2 sing1 fun1 jing4 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们以热烈的掌声欢迎新人。
examples.english_sentence: They welcomed the newcomer with enthusiastic applause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社區對新設施嘅反應十分熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 keoi1 deoi3 san1 cit3 si1 ge3 faan2 jing3 sap6 fan1 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社区对新设施的反应十分热烈。
examples.english_sentence: The community's response to the new facility was very enthusiastic.

jyutping: jit6 lit6 dik1 daan6 kam4 jit6 lit6 dik1 coeng3
mandarin_meaning: 熱情地彈琴、熱情地唱（以激昂或投入的方式演奏和歌唱）
english_meaning: To play an instrument passionately and sing passionately; to perform with enthusiasm and intensity.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞短語（副詞 + 動詞）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容以熱情、激昂或非常投入的方式彈奏樂器並高歌，通常用於描述現場表演的氣氛和表演者的投入程度。
explanation_english: Describes playing an instrument and singing with passion and intensity. Often used to characterize a lively, wholehearted performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺演唱會上熱烈地彈琴熱烈地唱，觀眾都拍手叫好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jin2 coeng3 wui6 soeng5 jit6 lit6 dik1 daan6 kam4 jit6 lit6 dik1 coeng3, gwaan1 zung3 dou1 paak3 sau2 giu3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在演唱会上热情地弹琴、热情地唱，观众都鼓掌叫好。
examples.english_sentence: He played the instrument and sang passionately at the concert; the audience applauded.

mandarin_meaning: 热狗 (règǒu)
english_meaning: hot dog (sausage in a bun)
explanation_mandarin: 指把香腸夾在長形麵包裡食用的小吃，常見於街頭攤位或快餐店。有時也稱為熱狗包或香腸包。
explanation_english: A food item consisting of a sausage placed in a split bun, commonly sold by street vendors or fast-food outlets. Also called a hot dog bun or sausage roll in some contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街市買咗一個熱狗，幾好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 jit6 gau2, gei2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街市买了一个热狗，挺好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a hot dog at the market; it's quite tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔好鍾意食抹咗番茄醬嘅熱狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 mut3 zo2 faan1 ke2 zoeng3 ge3 jit6 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子很喜欢吃抹了番茄酱的热狗。
examples.english_sentence: Kids really like hot dogs with ketchup.

mandarin_meaning: 痱子（熱痱、熱疹）
english_meaning: heat rash; prickly heat
explanation_mandarin: 指因天氣炎熱或出汗過多，皮膚出現的小紅疹或刺癢感，常見於嬰兒和潮濕環境下的人。
explanation_english: Refers to small red bumps or itchiness on the skin caused by hot weather or excessive sweating; commonly seen in babies and in humid conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬成日起熱疿，可能係因為出咗好多汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 sing4 jat6 hei2 jit6 fai3, ho2 nang4 hai6 jan1 wai6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟經常起熱痱，可能是因為流了很多汗。
examples.english_sentence: My little brother often gets heat rash; it might be because he sweats a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 痱子（因悶熱、出汗導致的皮膚小疹）
english_meaning: heat rash (prickly heat; small itchy red bumps caused by heat and sweat)
explanation_mandarin: 熱痱是指在高溫或悶熱環境下，汗液阻塞汗腺，引起皮膚出現小紅疹、癢或刺痛的現象，嬰兒和天氣炎熱時較常見。
explanation_english: Heat rash is a skin condition where sweat ducts become blocked in hot or humid conditions, causing small red bumps, itching, or prickling. It commonly occurs in babies and during hot weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排天氣咁熱，細路仔成日出熱痱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 tin1 hei3 gam2 jit6, sai3 lou6 zai2 sing4 jat6 ceot1 jit6 fai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天氣這麼熱，小孩子很容易長痱子。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been so hot lately, kids easily get heat rash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽喺個BB頸後面搽爽身粉，避免出熱痱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hai2 go3 bi1 bi1 geng2 hau6 min6 caat3 song2 san1 fan2, bei6 min6 ceot1 jit6 fai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽在寶寶脖子後面擦爽身粉，避免長痱子。
examples.english_sentence: Mom applies talcum powder behind the baby's neck to prevent heat rash.

mandarin_meaning: 性急、易怒、暴躁
english_meaning: hot-tempered; short-tempered; easily irritated
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容人性格急躁、容易生氣或發脾氣，常用於香港口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing someone who is quick-tempered or easily irritated; commonly used in Hong Kong colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都咁熱癪，好容易就發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam2 jit6 zik1, hou2 jung4 ji6 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常這樣，很容易就發脾氣。
examples.english_sentence: He is always like this and gets angry easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好惹佢，佢今日好熱癪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 je5 keoi5, keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別惹他，他今天很暴躁。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him; he's very short-tempered today.

mandarin_meaning: （中醫）積熱 / 熱積，即體內熱邪聚積
english_meaning: Accumulation of internal heat (TCM concept); 'heatiness' — a condition causing symptoms like mouth ulcers, pimples, constipation
explanation_mandarin: 中醫術語，指體內熱邪聚積引起的一類症狀（例如口瘡、便秘、尿黃、痘痘等）。在日常廣東話中也用來形容因飲食或作息不當導致的『上火、熱氣』狀態。
explanation_english: A Traditional Chinese Medicine term meaning accumulation of internal heat. It describes symptoms such as mouth ulcers, constipation, dark urine, or acne. Colloquially in Cantonese it refers to being 'heatier' from diet, lack of sleep, or other causes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食太多辣嘢會熱積，會生口瘡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 taai3 do1 laat6 je5 wui5 jit6 zik1, wui5 saang1 hau2 cong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃太多辣的東西會積熱，會長口瘡。
examples.english_sentence: Eating too much spicy food can cause heat accumulation and lead to mouth ulcers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞓覺唔夠又成日熬夜，好容易熱積，第二日會生暗瘡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan3 gaau3 m4 gau3 jau6 sing4 jat6 ngou4 je6, hou2 ji6 ji6 jit6 zik1, dai6 ji6 jat6 wui5 saang1 am3 cong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡眠不足又經常熬夜，很容易積熱，第二天會長痘痘。
examples.english_sentence: Lack of sleep combined with frequent late nights easily causes heat accumulation; you may get pimples the next day.

mandarin_meaning: 热线
english_meaning: hotline
explanation_mandarin: 指為諮詢、求助或處理緊急情況而設的專用電話線路，如醫療熱線、客服熱線或求助熱線。
explanation_english: A dedicated telephone line for inquiries, assistance, or emergencies, such as medical hotlines, customer service hotlines, or help lines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你遇到緊急情況，可以打熱線求助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jyu6 dou3 gan2 gap1 cing4 fong3, ho2 ji5 daa2 jit6 sin3 kau4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你遇到紧急情况，可以打热线求助。
examples.english_sentence: If you encounter an emergency, you can call the hotline for help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府開咗一條醫療熱線，幫市民解答問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hoi1 zo2 jat1 tiu4 ji1 liu4 jit6 sin3, bong1 si5 man4 gaai2 daap3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府开了一条医疗热线，帮助市民解答问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government has launched a medical hotline to help citizens with questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果熱線好忙，有時要等好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jit6 sin3 hou2 mong4, jau5 si4 jiu3 dang2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果热线很忙，有时要等很久。
examples.english_sentence: If the hotline is busy, sometimes you have to wait a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 热线电话
english_meaning: hotline; dedicated telephone line for immediate assistance or inquiries
explanation_mandarin: 指用于提供咨询、求助或报告紧急情况的专用电话号码或服务，通常由政府或机构运营，提供即时支援或资讯。
explanation_english: A telephone line designated for immediate assistance, inquiries, or reporting emergencies; usually operated by a government agency or organization to provide prompt support or information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你遇到緊急情況，可以打呢條熱線電話求助。
