examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jyu6 dou3 gan2 gap1 cing4 fong3, ho2 ji5 daa2 ni1 tiu4 jit6 sin3 din6 waa2 kau4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你遇到紧急情况，可以拨打这条热线电话寻求帮助。
examples.english_sentence: If you encounter an emergency, you can call this hotline to seek help.

mandarin_meaning: 熱能 (rènéng)
english_meaning: thermal energy; heat energy
explanation_mandarin: 指以熱的形式存在或可被轉換和傳遞的能量，常用於物理學、工程學和能源領域，描述物體的內部熱能或熱量的性質。
explanation_english: Refers to energy in the form of heat or energy that can be transferred as heat; commonly used in physics, engineering, and energy contexts to describe the internal thermal energy or heat content of a system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽提供咗大量嘅熱能，令地球有溫暖嘅環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 tai4 gung1 zo2 daai6 loeng6 ge3 jit6 nang4, ling6 dei6 kau4 jau5 wan1 nyun5 ge3 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太陽提供了大量的熱能，使地球有溫暖的環境。
examples.english_sentence: The sun provides a large amount of thermal energy, giving the Earth a warm environment.

mandarin_meaning: 热胀冷缩（指物体随温度变化而膨胀或收缩）
english_meaning: Thermal expansion and contraction (objects expand when heated and contract when cooled)
explanation_mandarin: 指物體因溫度變化而在體積或尺寸上發生膨脹或收縮的物理現象，常用於描述金屬、建築材料等受熱或受冷時的反應。
explanation_english: Refers to the physical phenomenon where materials change in volume or size with temperature changes; commonly used to describe how metals, construction materials, etc., expand when heated and contract when cooled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲金屬件會因為熱脹冷縮而變形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gam1 seot6 gin6 wui5 jan1 wai6 jit6 zoeng3 laang5 suk1 ji4 bin3 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些金属件会因为热胀冷缩而变形。
examples.english_sentence: These metal parts deform because of thermal expansion and contraction.

mandarin_meaning: 熱門且帶血腥、耸人听闻的（話題或報導）
english_meaning: Hot/trending and gory; sensational because of bloody or lurid content
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語俚語，用來形容某些新聞、話題或影片以血腥或耸人听聞的內容吸引大量關注和討論，意指「既熱又腥」。多用於評論媒體或網絡上的耸人內容。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term used to describe news, topics, or videos that draw attention because of gory or lurid content — literally 'hot and bloody/fishy'. It implies something both trending and sensational/graphic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲新聞好熱腥，成日播啲血腥畫面，唔適合細路睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san1 man4 hou2 jit6 seng1, sing4 jat6 bo3 di1 hyut3 seng1 waa6 min6, m4 sik1 hap6 sai3 lou6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些新聞很熱腥，經常播放血腥畫面，不適合小孩子觀看。
examples.english_sentence: That news is very 'hot and gory' — they often show bloody scenes; not suitable for children to watch.

mandarin_meaning: 热舞 (rèwǔ)，指热烈、有力或节奏感强的舞蹈表演或跳舞
english_meaning: hot dance; an energetic, high-energy dance or dance performance
explanation_mandarin: 「熱舞」可指一段節奏強烈、充滿能量或吸引觀眾的舞蹈表演；也可作動詞，表示熱情、有力地跳舞。
explanation_english: “熱舞” refers to an energetic, high-energy dance or dance performance. It can be used as a noun for the performance or as a verb meaning to dance energetically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去夜店睇人跳熱舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 je6 dim3 tai2 jan4 tiu3 jit6 mou5
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去夜店看人跳热舞。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the club tonight to watch people dance energetically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋表演嗰段熱舞好震撼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 biu2 jin2 go2 dyun6 jit6 mou5 hou2 zan3 ham6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们表演的那段热舞很震撼。
examples.english_sentence: Their hot dance performance was very impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上熱舞，吸引咗好多觀眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 jit6 mou5, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 gwan1 zung3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上热舞，吸引了很多观众。
examples.english_sentence: He danced energetically on stage, attracting many spectators.

mandarin_meaning: 热葷（字面：热的葷菜）；口语/俚语：带有下流、淫秽或黄色意味的言谈
english_meaning: Literal: hot meat/non-vegetarian dish; Colloquial/slang: lewd/dirty (sexual) content or remarks
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词/形容词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: “熱葷”字面上指熱的葷菜（有肉、非素食的菜式）。在口語或俚語中，有時用來形容帶有下流、黃色或性暗示的言語或笑話。
explanation_english: Literally, "熱葷" refers to hot non-vegetarian dishes (meat dishes). Colloquially, it can be used as slang to describe risqué, dirty, or sexually suggestive remarks or jokes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有熱葷，你想食咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 jit6 fan1 nei5 soeng2 sik6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有热的葷菜，你想吃什麼？
examples.english_sentence: There are hot meat dishes tonight — what do you want to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好講熱葷啦，阿媽喺度聽住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gong2 jit6 fan1 laa1, aa3 maa1 hai2 dou6 teng1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別講那些下流的話，媽媽在場聽着。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make those dirty jokes — mom is here listening.

mandarin_meaning: 热血 (rèxuè)，形容充滿熱情、衝勁或激昂的情緒；也可指血液本身。
english_meaning: hot-blooded; passionate; fervent (literally 'hot blood'); can mean enthusiastic, spirited, or impulsive.
explanation_mandarin: 熱血原指血液溫熱，常用作比喻形容人充滿熱情、衝勁或為理想激昂而行動。有時帶正面（熱情、有幹勁）或負面（衝動、欠考慮）含義。
explanation_english: Originally referring to warm blood, used figuratively to describe someone full of passion, zeal, or impulsiveness. It can be positive (enthusiastic, spirited) or negative (hot-headed, reckless).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日好熱血，見到唔公道嘅事就會出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hou2 jit6 hyut3, gin3 dou3 m4 gung1 dou6 ge3 si6 zau6 wui5 ceot1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平常很熱血，看到不公道的事就會出聲。
examples.english_sentence: He's always very hot-blooded; he speaks up when he sees something unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係靠熱血，做嘢都要有計劃同耐性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 kaau3 jit6 hyut3, zou6 je5 dou1 jiu3 jau5 gai3 waak6 tung4 noi6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是靠熱血，做事也要有計劃和耐心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rely only on hot-bloodedness; you need plans and patience to get things done.

mandarin_meaning: 热血沸腾 (rè xuè fèi téng)：形容情緒高漲、激動或熱情澎湃
english_meaning: To be fired up; to feel intensely excited or passionately stirred (literally 'hot blood boiling')
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對某事物感到非常興奮、激動或充滿熱情，常用於描述群眾或個人在激情時刻的情緒狀態。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone feeling extremely excited, passionate, or emotionally stirred—often applied to crowds or individuals at a moment of high enthusiasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到香港隊贏波，我成個人都熱血沸騰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 hoeng1 gong2 deoi6 jing4 bo1, ngo5 sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 jit6 hyut3 fai3 tang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到香港隊贏球，我整個人都熱血沸騰。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the Hong Kong team win, I was totally fired up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上演講嗰陣，令全場觀眾熱血沸騰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 jin2 gong2 go2 zan6, ling6 cyun4 coeng4 gwan1 zung3 jit6 hyut3 fai3 tang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上演講的時候，讓全場觀眾熱血沸騰。
examples.english_sentence: When he gave the speech on stage, he made the whole audience feel fired up.

mandarin_meaning: 热衰竭（因高温、脱水或体温调节失衡引起的一种中暑/热相关疾病）
english_meaning: Heat exhaustion (a heat-related medical condition caused by prolonged exposure to high temperature and dehydration)
explanation_mandarin: 一種因長時間暴露於高溫或潮濕環境、體內水分與電解質失衡導致的疾病，常見症狀包括大量出汗、虛弱、頭暈、噁心、肌肉痙攣；若未及時處理，可能惡化為熱射病（熱中風）。
explanation_english: A medical condition resulting from prolonged exposure to high temperatures and dehydration, characterized by heavy sweating, weakness, dizziness, nausea, and muscle cramps. If untreated, it can progress to heat stroke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺烈日下行咁耐，結果熱衰竭要送院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lit6 jat6 haa6 haang4 gam2 noi6, git3 gwo2 jit6 seoi1 git3 jiu3 sung3 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在烈日下走了很久，結果熱衰竭被送往醫院。
examples.english_sentence: He walked under the blazing sun for a long time and ended up with heat exhaustion and had to be taken to the hospital.

mandarin_meaning: 對某事物非常熱衷、熱愛或投入
english_meaning: to be very enthusiastic about; to be keen on; to be devoted to
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某個活動、事物或話題抱有強烈興趣並願意投入時間或精力。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong interest or enthusiasm for an activity, thing, or topic, often involving willingness to spend time or energy on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對攝影好熱衷，成日帶部相機去周圍影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 sip3 jing2 hou2 jit6 zung1, sing4 jat6 daai3 bou6 soeng2 gei1 heoi3 zau1 wai4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對攝影很熱衷，經常帶著相機到處拍照。
examples.english_sentence: He is very keen on photography; he always takes his camera everywhere to take photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近都鼓勵員工熱衷創新，但都要顧及風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 dou1 gu2 lai6 jyun4 gung1 jit6 zung1 cong3 san1, daan6 dou1 jiu3 gu3 kap6 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近都鼓勵員工熱衷創新，但也要顧及風險。
examples.english_sentence: The company has recently encouraged employees to be enthusiastic about innovation, but they should also consider the risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好熱衷政治呢啲話題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 jit6 zung1 zing3 zi6 ni1 di1 waa6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太熱衷於政治這些話題。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very keen on political topics.

mandarin_meaning: 热裤 (rè kù)
english_meaning: hot pants; very short shorts
explanation_mandarin: 指长度很短、露出大腿的短裤，来源于英语 hot pants，常用于夏天或休闲场合。
explanation_english: Refers to very short shorts (hot pants) that expose much of the thighs; commonly worn in summer or casual settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著熱褲去海邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 jit6 fu3 heoi3 hoi2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她经常穿热裤去海边。
examples.english_sentence: She often wears hot pants to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天著熱褲好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 zoek3 jit6 fu3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天穿热裤很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing hot pants in summer is very comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 热门话题；被热议的话题
english_meaning: hot topic; trending topic; popular subject (often gossip or widely discussed matter)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指當下廣泛被討論或關注的話題，語氣可中性或帶八卦意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to a topic that is widely discussed or attracting a lot of attention; can be neutral or imply gossip/tabloid interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事而家係個熱話，成日喺社交媒體出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji4 gaa1 hai6 go3 jit6 waa6, sing4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 ceot1 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事现在是个热门话题，经常在社交媒体上出现。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is a hot topic now and often appears on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋講緊嘅都係啲熱話，主要係八卦同花邊新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gong2 gan2 ge3 dou1 hai6 di1 jit6 waa6, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 baat3 gwaa3 tung4 faa1 bin1 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在讨论的都是一些热门话题，主要是八卦和小报新闻。
examples.english_sentence: They're talking about hot topics, mainly gossip and tabloid news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 節目中討論嘅熱話令觀眾反應熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit3 muk6 zung1 tou2 leon6 ge3 jit6 waa6 ling6 gun1 zung3 faan2 jing3 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 节目中讨论的热门话题引起观众强烈反应。
examples.english_sentence: The hot topics discussed on the show provoked a strong reaction from the audience.

mandarin_meaning: 热忱；对人或事物充满热情与真诚的态度
english_meaning: warm sincerity; enthusiastic and wholehearted commitment
explanation_mandarin: 表示對人或事物懷有熱情和真誠，常用來形容對工作、服務或待人處事的積極誠懇態度。
explanation_english: Expresses a warm, sincere enthusiasm; often used to describe a positive, earnest attitude toward work, service, or interpersonal dealings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對工作好有熱誠，老闆好欣賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 zok3 hou2 jau5 jit6 sing4, lou5 baan2 hou2 jan1 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對工作很有熱忱，老板很欣賞他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very enthusiastic about his work; the boss appreciates him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你用熱誠去服務，客人會感受到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jung6 jit6 sing4 heoi3 fuk6 mou6, haak3 jan4 wui5 gam2 sau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你用热忱去服务，客人会感受到。
examples.english_sentence: If you serve with genuine enthusiasm, customers will notice.

mandarin_meaning: 热卖（畅销、销售火爆）
english_meaning: hot-selling; selling very well; best-selling
explanation_mandarin: 表示某商品或產品銷售情況很好、很受歡迎，常用於描述暢銷品或熱賣活動。
explanation_english: Indicates that an item or product is selling very well and is popular; used to describe fast-selling or best-selling items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款手袋好熱賣，成日俾人買晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 sau2 doi2 hou2 jit6 maai6, sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 maai5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款手袋很热卖，经常被人买光。
examples.english_sentence: This handbag is selling very well; it's often sold out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新產品喺網上熱賣，庫存好快就賣晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 caan2 ban2 hai2 mong5 soeng6 jit6 maai6, fu3 cyun4 hou2 faai3 zau6 maai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新产品在网上热卖，库存很快就卖光了。
examples.english_sentence: The new product is selling well online and the stock sold out quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 热身
english_meaning: warm up; to do warm-up exercises; to prepare/loosen up (physically or mentally)
explanation_mandarin: 指在运动前进行的热身活动以预防受伤；也可引申为做准备或进行铺垫性的活动（例如热身游戏或试演）。
explanation_english: Refers to exercises or activities done before physical exercise to prepare the body and reduce injury risk; can also mean preliminary activities to prepare people or 'warm up' an audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做運動之前先熱身，咁樣可以減低受傷風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wan6 dung6 zi1 cin4 sin1 jit6 san1, gam2 joeng6 ho2 ji5 gaam2 dai1 sau6 soeng1 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动前要热身，这样可以降低受伤风险。
examples.english_sentence: Warm up before exercising; this can reduce the risk of injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先做個熱身遊戲，等大家熟悉下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 zou6 go3 jit6 san1 jau4 hei3, dang2 daai6 gaa1 suk6 sik1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们先做个热身游戏，让大家熟悉一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let's do a warm-up game first to help everyone get comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新員工仲需要一陣時間熱身先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jyun4 gung1 zung6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 zan6 si4 gaan1 jit6 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新员工还需要一段时间来热身。
examples.english_sentence: New employees still need some time to warm up.

mandarin_meaning: 热身赛 (rèshēn sài)
english_meaning: warm-up match; preparatory game
explanation_mandarin: 用來讓運動員或隊伍在正式比賽前熱身、調整狀態的非正式比賽或練習性比賽。
explanation_english: A non-official or practice match held to let athletes or teams warm up and adjust their form before an official competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有一場熱身賽，隊員都要提早到練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 jat1 coeng4 jit6 san1 coi3, deoi6 jyun4 dou1 jiu3 tai4 zou2 dou3 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有一场热身赛，队员都要提前到练习。
examples.english_sentence: There's a warm-up match tonight; the players need to arrive early for practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這場熱身賽主要係為下星期嘅正式比賽做準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 coeng4 jit6 san1 coi3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 wai6 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 zing3 sik1 bei2 coi3 zou6 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场热身赛主要是为下星期的正式比赛做准备。
examples.english_sentence: This warm-up match is mainly to prepare for next week's official competition.

mandarin_meaning: 熱輻射（物體因溫度以電磁波形式放射能量）
english_meaning: thermal radiation (emission of energy from an object as electromagnetic waves due to its temperature)
explanation_mandarin: 指物體因為溫度而以電磁波（主要是紅外線）向外放射能量的現象或過程，屬於熱傳遞的一種方式。
explanation_english: The phenomenon or process by which an object emits energy as electromagnetic waves (mainly infrared) because of its temperature; a mode of heat transfer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽會發出大量嘅熱輻射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 wui5 faat3 ceot1 daai6 loeng6 ge3 jit6 fuk1 se6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太陽會發出大量的熱輻射。
examples.english_sentence: The sun emits a large amount of thermal radiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企裝咗隔熱層，可以減少熱輻射嘅傳入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 zong1 zo2 gaak3 jit6 cang4, ho2 ji5 gam2 siu2 jit6 fuk1 se6 ge3 cyun4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們家裝了隔熱層，可以減少熱輻射的傳入。
examples.english_sentence: We installed insulation in our house to reduce the ingress of thermal radiation.

mandarin_meaning: （非常）熱、燙；也可比喻很熱門或最新的事物
english_meaning: very hot; scorching; piping hot (can also mean 'hot' as in fresh or popular)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示溫度很高或燙，常用於形容天氣、食物或物件；在口語中亦可比喻消息或事物很新、很熱門。
explanation_english: An emphatic colloquial expression meaning very hot or scalding, used for weather, food, or objects. It can also be used figuratively to describe something fresh or 'hot' (popular, newsworthy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 碗湯熱辣辣，小心會燙親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun2 tong1 jit6 laat6 laat6, siu2 sam1 wui5 tong3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 碗湯很燙，小心會燙到。
examples.english_sentence: The bowl of soup is piping hot — be careful not to burn yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣熱辣辣，記得多飲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 jit6 laat6 laat6, gei3 dak1 do1 jam2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天氣很熱，記得多喝水。
examples.english_sentence: It's scorching today — remember to drink more water.

mandarin_meaning: 热量（指食物或物體所含的能量，常以卡路里表示）
english_meaning: calories; the amount of energy contained in food or released by a substance
explanation_mandarin: 指食物或飲品所含的能量，常用來表示攝入或消耗的能量，單位常用卡路里（kcal）。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount of energy contained in food or beverages; commonly used to indicate energy intake or expenditure, often measured in calories (kcal).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食嗰件蛋糕熱量好高，要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 go2 gin6 daan6 gou1 jit6 loeng6 hou2 gou1, jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃那塊蛋糕的熱量很高，要小心。
examples.english_sentence: That slice of cake has a lot of calories; be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都會計算飲食嘅熱量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 gai3 syun3 jam2 sik6 ge3 jit6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都會計算飲食的熱量。
examples.english_sentence: I calculate the calories in my meals every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 低熱量嘅食物適合減肥期間食用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai1 jit6 loeng6 ge3 sik6 mat6 sik1 hap6 gaam2 fei4 kei4 gaan1 sik6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 低熱量的食物適合在減肥期間食用。
examples.english_sentence: Low-calorie foods are suitable to eat during a diet.

mandarin_meaning: 热钱（短期投机性资本）
english_meaning: hot money (short-term speculative capital)
explanation_mandarin: 指為追求短期利潤而快速跨境流動的短期投機性資金，常會引起資產價格波動或形成資產泡沫。
explanation_english: Refers to short-term, speculative capital that moves quickly across borders seeking quick returns; often causes asset price volatility or bubbles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有好多熱錢流入香港樓市，令樓價進一步上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 hou2 do1 jit6 cin2 lau4 jap6 hoeng1 gong2 lau4 si5, ling6 lau4 gaa3 zeon3 jat1 bou6 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有很多热钱流入香港楼市，导致房价进一步上升。
examples.english_sentence: Recently a lot of hot money has flowed into Hong Kong's property market, causing prices to rise further.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府擔心大量熱錢湧入會增加金融體系嘅風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 daam1 sam1 daai6 loeng6 jit6 cin2 jung2 jap6 wui5 zeng1 gaa1 gam1 jung4 tai2 hai6 ge3 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府担心大量热钱涌入会增加金融体系的风险。
examples.english_sentence: The government is worried that a large inflow of hot money will increase risks in the financial system.

mandarin_meaning: 热锅上的蚂蚁；比喻非常焦急、坐立不安的人或情形
english_meaning: Like ants on a hot pan; describes someone who is extremely anxious, restless, or agitated
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 形容因焦急、擔心或受壓力而坐立不安、手忙腳亂的人或情況，就像熱鍋上的螞蟻不停亂竄。
explanation_english: Describes a person or situation that is extremely anxious, restless, or panicked — moving or acting frantically like ants on a hot pan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試結果仲未公布，佢而家就好似熱鍋上的螞蟻，一直等唔到消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 git3 gwo2 zung6 mei6 gung1 bou3, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zau6 hou2 ci5 jit6_wo1_soeng5_dik1_maa5_ngai5, jat1 zik6 dang2 m4 dou3 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試結果還沒公布，他現在像熱鍋上的螞蟻，一直等不到消息。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results haven't been released yet; he's like an ant on a hot pan, anxiously waiting and not hearing anything.

mandarin_meaning: 热门
english_meaning: popular; hot (topic); in demand; trendy
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物受欢迎、关注度高或流行，常用于描述话题、商品、场所等。
explanation_english: Indicates something that is popular, widely discussed, in demand, or trendy; often used for topics, products, places, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌而家好熱門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ji4 gaa1 hou2 jit6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌现在很热门。
examples.english_sentence: This song is very popular right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳而家好熱門，要預約先有位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ji4 gaa1 hou2 jit6 mun4, jiu3 jyu6 joek3 sin1 jau5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅现在很热门，要预约才能有位置。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very popular now; you need to make a reservation to get a table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事成咗社交媒體嘅熱門話題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 sing4 zo2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 ge3 jit6 mun4 waa6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事成了社交媒体的热门话题。
examples.english_sentence: This has become a hot topic on social media.

mandarin_meaning: 容易衝動／急躁，對某事很有幹勁或熱情（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: hot-headed; impulsive; eager/keen (colloquial slang) — getting easily fired up or enthusiastic, sometimes acting without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人容易衝動、容易被激起興致或熱情，常帶有一時衝動或不夠冷靜的含義；有時亦可表示對某事很有幹勁或熱心。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who gets easily excited or impulsive — quick to act or show enthusiasm (often without much deliberation). It can also sometimes mean being keen or having drive for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好熱頭，見到新項目就想即刻開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jit6 tau4, gin3 dou3 san1 hong6 muk6 zau6 soeng2 zik1 hak1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很衝動，看到新項目就想立刻開始。
examples.english_sentence: He's very hot-headed — when he sees a new project he wants to start right away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁熱頭，諗清楚先再決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 jit6 tau4, lam2 cing1 co2 sin1 zoi3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這麼衝動，先想清楚再決定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so hot-headed; think it through before deciding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對工作好有熱頭，經常主動承擔新任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 gung1 zok3 hou2 jau5 jit6 tau4, ging1 soeng4 zyu2 dung6 sing4 daam1 san1 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對工作很有幹勁，經常主動承擔新任務。
examples.english_sentence: He's really keen on his work — he often volunteers for new tasks.

mandarin_meaning: 热饮 (rè yǐn) — 热的饮品
english_meaning: hot drink; a beverage served hot (e.g., tea, coffee, hot chocolate)
explanation_mandarin: 指加热或温热的饮料，如热茶、咖啡或热巧克力，常在寒冷时或想暖身时饮用，也可泛指商店或茶餐厅提供的热饮品。
explanation_english: Refers to beverages served hot or warm, such as hot tea, coffee, or hot chocolate. Commonly consumed to warm up in cold weather; can also refer generally to hot beverages offered by cafés or vendors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁凍，我想飲杯熱飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 dung3, ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 jit6 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么冷，我想喝杯热饮。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold; I want a hot drink.

mandarin_meaning: 馬屁精；拍馬屁的人
english_meaning: brown‑noser; suck‑up; someone who flatters to gain favor
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，指為了討好或謀取利益而對有權勢的人諂媚、拍馬屁的人，通常帶有貶義。
explanation_english: A slang term for a person who flatters or sucks up to someone in power to gain favor or benefits; usually derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺上司面前拍馬屁，大家都話佢係個熱香餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 soeng6 si1 min6 cin4 paak3 maa5 pei3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 go3 jit6 hoeng1 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在上司面前拍馬屁，大家都說他是個馬屁精。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly sucks up to his boss; everyone says he's a brown‑noser.

mandarin_meaning: 热闹
english_meaning: lively; bustling; noisy; festive
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can also be used as a verb: 'to liven up')
explanation_mandarin: 形容場所或氛圍有很多人、聲音熱鬧、氣氛活躍；也可作動詞，表示使某處變得熱鬧。
explanation_english: Describes a place or event that is lively, bustling, and noisy with a festive atmosphere; can also be used as a verb meaning to make something more lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個市集好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 si5 zaap6 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的市集很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The night market is very lively tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企過年嗰時好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 gwo3 nin4 go2 si4 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家过年的时候很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: Their home is very lively during Chinese New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋整多啲節目，令晚會熱鬧啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zing2 do1 di1 zit3 muk6, ling6 maan5 wui6 jit6 naau6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们多准备些节目，让晚会热闹一些。
examples.english_sentence: Let's prepare more performances to make the party livelier.

mandarin_meaning: 热点
english_meaning: hotspot; hot topic
explanation_mandarin: 指受到高度关注或活动集中的地点或话题；也可指无线网络的热点（Wi‑Fi）。
explanation_english: Refers to a place or topic that attracts a lot of attention or activity; can also mean a wireless network hotspot (Wi‑Fi).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個話題而家係一個熱點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 waa6 tai4 ji4 gaa1 hai6 jat1 go3 jit6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个话题现在是一个热点。
examples.english_sentence: This topic is currently a hot topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間咖啡店有免費熱點可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 kaa1 fe1 dim3 jau5 min5 fai3 jit6 dim2 ho2 ji5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间咖啡店有免费的热点（Wi‑Fi）可以使用。
examples.english_sentence: This café has a free hotspot (Wi‑Fi) you can use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尖沙咀係好出名嘅旅遊熱點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zim1 saa1 zeoi2 hai6 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 leoi5 jau4 jit6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 尖沙咀是著名的旅游热点。
examples.english_sentence: Tsim Sha Tsui is a famous tourist hotspot.

mandarin_meaning: 熵（熱力學或資訊論中的熵，表示系統的無序或不確定性）
english_meaning: entropy (in thermodynamics or information theory; a measure of disorder or uncertainty)
explanation_mandarin: 熵是物理學和資訊論中的概念，在熱力學中用來描述系統的無序程度，在資訊論中表示不確定性或信息量的平均度量。
explanation_english: Entropy is a concept in physics and information theory. In thermodynamics it measures a system's degree of disorder; in information theory it quantifies uncertainty or average information content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺熱力學入面，熵用嚟度量一個系統嘅無序程度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 jit6 lik6 hok6 jap6 min6, soeng1 jung6 lai4 dou6 loeng4 jat1 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 mou4 seoi6 cing4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在熱力學中，熵用來衡量一個系統的無序程度。
examples.english_sentence: In thermodynamics, entropy is used to measure the degree of disorder of a system.

mandarin_meaning: （光）微明、光輝；常用於書面或人名（同“曦”“熙”）
english_meaning: bright; radiant; dawn's faint light; often literary or used in names
explanation_mandarin: 「熹」字表示光亮、光輝或晨曦的微明，常見於書面語或用作人名。與「曦」「熙」等字義相近，常出現在詞語如「熹微」中，指清晨微弱的光線。
explanation_english: The character indicates brightness or radiance, especially the faint light of dawn. It is often literary or used in personal names. It is similar in meaning to 曦 and 熙 and appears in expressions like 熹微, meaning dim morning light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝晨光熹微，我就起身做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 san4 gwong1 hei1 mei4, ngo5 zau6 hei2 san1 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天清晨天色微明，我就起來運動。
examples.english_sentence: This morning at dawn's faint light, I got up to exercise.

mandarin_meaning: 炽（炽热、热烈、旺盛）
english_meaning: blazing; fervent; intense; ardent
explanation_mandarin: 表示強烈的熱、光或情感，常見於書面或文言用法，如「熾熱」「熾盛」。
explanation_english: Indicates intense heat, brightness, or fervent feeling; often used in literary or formal contexts (e.g., '熾熱' meaning blazing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火勢好熾，快啲走！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 sai3 hou2 ci3, faai3 di1 zau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火势很猛，快走！
examples.english_sentence: The fire is fierce; get out quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天個太陽好熾，出街要戴遮陽帽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 go3 taai3 joeng4 hou2 ci3, ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 daai3 ze1 joeng4 mou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天太阳很炽热，出门要戴遮阳帽。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is scorching in summer; wear a sun hat when going out.

mandarin_meaning: 炽热；炎热或热烈，既可形容温度极高，也可形容感情强烈。
english_meaning: Scorching; blazing; ardent — describes extremely high temperature or very intense/fervent feelings.
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常强烈的热或感情。可用于描述天气、物体的高温（如“熾熱的陽光”），也可用来形容强烈的情感或热情（如“熾熱的熱情”）。
explanation_english: Indicates very intense heat or passionate feeling. Can describe extremely hot temperatures (e.g., "scorching sun") or fervent emotions/passion (e.g., "ardent enthusiasm").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日室外嘅天氣好熾熱，大家記得飲多啲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sat1 ngoi6 ge3 tin1 hei3 hou2 ci3 jit6, daai6 gaa1 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天室外的天气非常炎热，大家記得多喝水。
examples.english_sentence: The weather outside is extremely hot today; everyone remember to drink more water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對音樂有熾熱嘅熱情，日日都練琴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 jam1 ngok6 jau5 ci3 jit6 ge3 jit6 cing4, jat6 jat6 dou1 lin6 kam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對音樂抱有炽热的热情，每天都練琴。
examples.english_sentence: He has a burning passion for music and practices the piano every day.

mandarin_meaning: 用火燎、烧；用热水烫（禽畜）去毛
english_meaning: to singe; to burn off hair or feathers using fire or hot water
explanation_mandarin: 指用火燎烧物体表面（如去毛、烤焦表皮），或用热水烫禽畜使其脱毛。此字较古雅，日常口语中常用“熝”、“燒”或“用火燎”代替。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of singeing or burning the surface of something (e.g., to remove hair or feathers) or scalding poultry/livestock with hot water for defeathering. This character is somewhat classical; in daily speech, words like '熝 (luk6)', '燒 (siu1)', or the phrase '用火燎' are more commonly used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前整燒鵝，會用火燂走鵝皮上面啲幼毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 zing2 siu1 ngo2, wui5 jung6 fo2 taam4 zau2 ngo2 pei4 soeng6 min6 di1 jau3 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前做烧鹅，会用火燎去鹅皮上的细毛。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, when making roast goose, they would use fire to singe off the fine feathers on the goose skin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 燂豬腳嘅過程可以去除剩餘嘅毛同埋消毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam4 zyu1 goek2 ge3 gwo3 cing4 ho2 ji5 ceoi3 jyu4 soeng4 jyu4 ge3 mou4 tung4 maai4 siu1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 燎猪脚的过程可以去除残余的毛并且消毒。
examples.english_sentence: The process of singeing pig's feet can remove remaining hairs and also sterilize them.

mandarin_meaning: 燃、点燃；（网络语）形容激动、热血、振奋
english_meaning: to burn; to ignite; (slang) rousing, exciting
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞；（網絡用語亦可作形容詞）
explanation_mandarin: 表示物質燃燒或點著。口語和網絡語境中常用來形容某事物令人熱血、激動或振奮。
explanation_english: Denotes burning or igniting. In colloquial and internet usage it can describe something that is rousing, exciting, or inspirational.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用打火機點燃支蠟燭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 daa2 fo2 gei1 dim2 jin4 zi1 laap6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用打火机点燃了一支蜡烛。
examples.english_sentence: I used a lighter to light a candle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅鬥志重新燃起喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 dau3 zi3 cung4 san1 jin4 hei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的斗志重新燃起了。
examples.english_sentence: His fighting spirit has been rekindled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲真係好燃！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jin4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部片真的很燃！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really rousing!

mandarin_meaning: 燃料（指可燃燒以產生能量或動力的物質）
english_meaning: fuel (substance burned to produce energy or power)
explanation_mandarin: 指可燃燒以產生能量或動力的物質，例如煤、石油、天然氣等；也可引申為促使某種情況或情緒加劇的因素或來源。
explanation_english: Refers to substances that can be burned to generate energy or power, such as coal, oil, or natural gas; can also be used figuratively to mean something that fuels or intensifies a situation or emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發電廠需要大量燃料先至可以運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 din6 cong2 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 loeng6 jin4 liu6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发电厂需要大量燃料才能运作。
examples.english_sentence: The power plant needs a large amount of fuel to operate.

mandarin_meaning: 燃油 (rányóu) — 用作燃燒的液體燃料，如汽油、柴油等；也常用於指燃油附加費。
english_meaning: Fuel; combustible liquid fuels such as gasoline or diesel; can also refer to a fuel surcharge.
explanation_mandarin: 指用作燃燒的液體燃料，例如汽油、柴油或其他燃料油；在商業和交通領域常見用法還包括「燃油附加費」等衍生語義。
explanation_english: Refers to liquid fuels used for combustion, such as gasoline or diesel. In commercial and transport contexts it is also commonly used in terms like "fuel surcharge."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家燃油價升咗，航空公司可能會加燃油附加費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jin4 jau4 gaa3 sing1 zo2, hong4 hung1 gung1 si1 ho2 nang4 wui5 gaa1 jin4 jau4 fu6 gaa1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在燃油价格上涨，航空公司可能会加收燃油附加费。
examples.english_sentence: Fuel prices have risen now; airlines may add a fuel surcharge.

mandarin_meaning: 燃烧 (ránshāo)
english_meaning: to burn; to combust; to be on fire; figuratively, to be filled with passion or to expend energy (e.g., burn calories)
explanation_mandarin: 指物体通过化学反应产生火焰和热量（燃烧、着火）；也可引申表示情感或热情强烈地存在，或消耗能量（如燃烧卡路里）。
explanation_english: Refers to undergoing combustion, producing flame and heat; can also be used figuratively to describe intense passion or the burning/consumption of energy (e.g., burning calories).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 房間入面啲垃圾開始燃燒，嗰陣有好大煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong4 gaan1 jap6 min6 di1 laap6 saap3 hoi1 ci2 jin4 siu1, go2 zan6 jau5 hou2 daai6 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里的垃圾开始燃烧，冒出很多浓烟。
examples.english_sentence: The trash in the room started burning, producing a lot of thick smoke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對理想嘅熱情一直燃燒住，從未消退。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 lei5 soeng2 ge3 jit6 cing4 jat1 zik6 jin4 siu1 zyu6, cung4 mei6 siu1 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对理想的热情一直在燃烧，从未消退。
examples.english_sentence: His passion for his ideals has been burning constantly and has never waned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做高強度訓練可以幫你燃燒更多卡路里。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 gou1 koeng4 dou6 fan3 lin6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 jin4 siu1 gang1 do1 kaa1 lou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 进行高强度训练可以帮你燃烧更多卡路里。
examples.english_sentence: Doing high-intensity training can help you burn more calories.

mandarin_meaning: 燃烧三角形（比喻）
english_meaning: burning triangle (metaphorical)
explanation_mandarin: 用來比喻三方互相牽扯、情緒激烈且具破壞性的三角關係（類似「三角戀」），常用於形容感情糾葛、緋聞或三方衝突造成的劇烈矛盾與混亂。有時也泛指三方牽扯引起的火上加油式對立局面。
explanation_english: A metaphor describing an intense, destructive triangle involving three parties—similar to a love triangle. It often refers to romantic entanglements, scandals, or conflicts where three people are mutually implicated, producing heightened emotions and damaging outcomes. Can also be used for any three‑way conflict that escalates tensions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三個之間變成咗一個燃燒三角形，大家都好受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 go3 zi1 gaan1 bin3 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 jin4 siu1 saam1 gok3 jing4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们三个之间变成了一个燃烧三角形，大家都很受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The three of them turned into a burning triangle, and everyone got hurt.

mandarin_meaning: 燃烧弹（焚烧性武器或装置，能引发火灾）
english_meaning: incendiary bomb (a weapon or device designed to start fires)
explanation_mandarin: 指一类能够引燃易燃物并造成大范围燃烧的武器或装置，常见形式包括燃烧弹、凝固汽油弹（火焰弹）等，在军事和暴力事件中可能被使用并造成严重火灾与人员伤亡。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of weapon or device intended to ignite flammable materials and cause widespread burning. Examples include incendiary bombs and napalm-like devices. They are used in warfare or violent incidents and can cause serious fires and casualties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺現場發現多個燃燒彈殘骸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 faat3 jin6 do1 go3 jin4 siu1 daan6 caan4 hoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在现场发现多个燃烧弹残骸。
examples.english_sentence: The police discovered several incendiary bomb fragments at the scene.

mandarin_meaning: 非常紧急、亟需解决的问题
english_meaning: an urgent, pressing matter; an emergency that requires immediate attention
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常紧急，必须立即处理，不能拖延。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is extremely urgent and must be dealt with immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府而家要先處理燃眉之急，好似救災同安置災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 sin1 cyu2 lei5 jin4 mei4 zi1 gap1 hou2 ci5 gau3 zoi1 tung4 on1 zi6 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府现在要先处理燃眉之急，比如救灾和安置灾民。
examples.english_sentence: The government must deal with the most urgent matters first, such as disaster relief and resettling victims.

mandarin_meaning: 燃點；引燃點（物質的閃點/著火溫度）；比喻為激發熱情或興趣的觸發點
english_meaning: ignition point / flash point; figuratively, the trigger or spark that ignites enthusiasm or interest
explanation_mandarin: 「燃點」可指物質達到可燃狀態的臨界溫度或閃點（技術術語），也常用作比喻，指某件事或某個瞬間能引發情緒、興奮或關注的觸發點。
explanation_english: “燃點” can mean the ignition/flash point of a substance (a technical term), and is also used figuratively to describe the moment or trigger that sparks emotions, excitement, or attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 汽油嘅燃點好低，唔可以喺附近吸煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei3 jau4 ge3 jin4 dim2 hou2 dai1, m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 fu6 gan6 kap1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汽油的燃點很低，不能在附近吸煙。
examples.english_sentence: The flash point of gasoline is very low; you can't smoke nearby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事冇乜燃點，大家都唔太有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 mou5 mat1 jin4 dim2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 taai3 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事沒有什麼燃點，大家都不太有興趣。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has no spark; nobody's very interested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個歌手好識搵到觀眾嘅燃點，成場都好投入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 go1 sau2 hou2 sik1 wan2 dou3 gun1 zung3 ge3 jin4 dim2, seng4 coeng4 dou1 hou2 tau4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位歌手很會抓住觀眾的燃點，整場都很投入。
examples.english_sentence: The singer knows how to find the audience's trigger points; the whole concert was very engaging.

mandarin_meaning: 火焰
english_meaning: flame; blaze
explanation_mandarin: 燄（同焰）指火的火舌或火焰，常用於書面語或與其他字組合成複合詞（如火燄、火焰），表示火焰的部分或光亮。
explanation_english: 燄 refers to a flame or blaze — the visible, burning part of a fire. It is often used in written language or in compounds (e.g. 火燄) to denote flames.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火燄越嚟越大，大家快啲撤離！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 jim6 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 daai6, daai6 gaa1 faai3 di1 cit3 lei4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火焰越來越大，大家快點撤離！
examples.english_sentence: The flames are getting bigger — everyone evacuate quickly!

mandarin_meaning: 灯 (dēng)：灯具、光源
english_meaning: lamp; light; lantern; (also) traffic light
explanation_mandarin: 指发光的装置或光源，例如电灯、灯笼或灯泡；也可泛指照明或交通信号灯等。
explanation_english: Refers to a device or source that emits light, such as a lamp, lantern, or bulb; can also refer to lighting in general or traffic lights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企個燈壞咗，要換個燈膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 dang1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 go3 dang1 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家里的灯坏了，要换一个灯泡。
examples.english_sentence: The lamp at my house is broken; I need to replace the light bulb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上嘅燈好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 ge3 dang1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上的灯很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The street lights are beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等紅綠燈轉綠先可以過馬路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 hung4 luk6 dang1 zyun2 luk6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 maa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等红绿灯变绿才能过马路。
examples.english_sentence: Wait for the traffic light to turn green before crossing the road.

mandarin_meaning: 聚光燈位置；（比喻）獲得曝光或受矚目的位置／機會
english_meaning: spotlight; the position that receives attention or screen time (often figurative for getting exposure)
explanation_mandarin: 原指舞台或攝影中燈光照射的位置，口語中常用作比喻，指某人獲得關注、曝光或出風頭的機會或位置。
explanation_english: Literally the position of stage or camera lighting. Colloquially used figuratively to mean the spot of attention, exposure, or opportunity to be in the limelight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗爭燈位，成日喺綜藝節目度出鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zeng1 dang1 wai6, sing4 jat6 hai2 zung3 ngai6 zit3 muk6 dou6 ceot1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了爭取曝光機會，經常在綜藝節目出鏡。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly appears on variety shows to compete for the spotlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舞台嘅燈位已經安排好，主角要企喺中間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 toi4 ge3 dang1 wai6 ji5 ging1 on1 paai4 hou2, zyu2 gok3 jiu3 kei5 hai2 zung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舞台的燈光位置已經安排好，主角要站在中間。
examples.english_sentence: The stage lighting positions have been set; the lead should stand in the center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果搶唔到燈位，就唔好怪其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 coeng2 m4 dou2 dang1 wai6, zau6 m4 hou2 gwaai3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果搶不到曝光機會，就別責怪別人。
examples.english_sentence: If you can't get the spotlight, don't blame others.

mandarin_meaning: 灯光
english_meaning: lighting; lights; illumination
explanation_mandarin: 指由燈具發出的光線或整體照明效果，可用於室內、室外或舞台等場合的照明。
explanation_english: Refers to light emitted by lamps or the overall illumination/lighting; can describe indoor, outdoor, or stage lighting and its effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 燈光太暗，我睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 gwong1 taai3 am3, ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯光太暗，我看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The lighting is too dim; I can't see clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 灯火通明、热闹、繁华
english_meaning: brightly lit and bustling; lively and prosperous
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容夜晚或某個地方燈火亮堂、熱鬧繁華，常見於描述街道、市場或節慶場面。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom describing a place that is brightly lit and bustling with activity—used for streets, markets, festivals, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚嘅旺角，街道燈光火着，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ge3 wong6 gok3, gaai1 dou6 dang1 gwong1 fo2 zoek6, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜晚的旺角，街道灯光火着，很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: At night in Mong Kok, the streets are brightly lit and bustling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晩街市都亮晒，燈光火着，行人好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaai1 si5 dou1 loeng6 saai3, dang1 gwong1 fo2 zoek6, haang4 jan4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚市场都亮了，灯光火着，行人很多。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight the market is all lit up and bustling with many pedestrians.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年花市開鑼，沿途檔攤燈光火着，氣氛好旺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faa1 si5 hoi1 lo4, jin4 tou4 dong3 taan1 dang1 gwong1 fo2 zoek6, hei3 fan1 hou2 wong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年花市开市，沿路摊档灯光火着，气氛很旺。
examples.english_sentence: When the Lunar New Year flower market opens, stalls along the road are brightly lit and the atmosphere is lively.

mandarin_meaning: 灯塔 (dēngtǎ)
english_meaning: lighthouse
explanation_mandarin: 灯塔是设在海岸或岛屿上的高塔，顶部装有强光或信号，用来指引船只航行或警示危险；也常用作比喻，指引人或组织的榜样或依靠。
explanation_english: A lighthouse is a tall tower on a coast or island with a powerful light or signal to guide ships and warn of danger; it is also used metaphorically as a guide or beacon for people or groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去睇嗰座燈塔嘅夜景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 go2 zo6 dang1 taap3 ge3 je6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去看那座灯塔的夜景。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to see the night view of that lighthouse tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我哋團隊入面好似一座燈塔，畀到好清楚嘅指引。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 dei6 tyun4 deoi6 jap6 min6 hou2 ci5 jat1 zo6 dang1 taap3, bei2 dou3 hou2 cing1 co2 ge3 zi2 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我们团队里像一座灯塔，提供很清晰的指引。
examples.english_sentence: He is like a lighthouse in our team, providing clear guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 燈塔嘅燈光每隔幾秒會閃一下，幫助船隻判斷位置。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 taap3 ge3 dang1 gwong1 mui5 gok3 gei2 miu5 wui5 sim2 jat1 haa5, bong1 zo6 syun4 zek3 pun3 dyun6 wai6 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯塔的灯光每隔几秒会闪一下，帮助船只判断位置。
examples.english_sentence: The lighthouse's light flashes every few seconds to help ships determine their position.

mandarin_meaning: 路灯柱子；路灯杆
english_meaning: lamppost; streetlight pole
explanation_mandarin: 指道路或街道上支撐路燈的柱子，常見於城市和道路兩旁。
explanation_english: Refers to the pole that supports a street lamp, commonly found along roads and in urban areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條燈柱壞咗，要修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 dang1 zyu6 waai6 zo2, jiu3 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路边的路灯坏了，需要修理。
examples.english_sentence: The lamppost is broken and needs repair.

mandarin_meaning: 坐以待斃；無可奈何地等待會發生不好的結果（常用作口語、諷刺或自嘲）
english_meaning: to be doomed / to be resigned to a bad outcome; nothing can be done (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「燈死」是粵語口語用法，常作「等死」的變體寫法，表示事情無法挽回或無可避免地要吃虧、遭遇不良後果，帶有無奈、諷刺或自嘲的語氣。
explanation_english: “燈死” is a Cantonese colloquial expression (often written as a variant of 等死). It expresses resignation to an unavoidable bad outcome — being doomed, helpless, or left to suffer consequences. It carries a tone of helplessness, sarcasm, or self-mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落大雨你仲唔帶傘，濕到就燈死喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 nei5 zung6 m4 daai3 saan3, sap1 dou3 zau6 dang2 sei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下大雨你還不帶傘，淋得一身濕就只能自認倒楣了。
examples.english_sentence: It's pouring today and you still didn't bring an umbrella — you'll get soaked, you're doomed.

mandarin_meaning: 燈油和蠟燭（照明用的燃料），舊時常見的家用照明用品
english_meaning: lamp oil and candle wax; lighting fuels; household lighting supplies
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指用來照明的燃料（燈油、蠟燭）。多用以描述舊時家庭的照明用品或泛指照明所需的東西。
explanation_english: Literally refers to lamp oil and candle wax — fuels used for lighting. Often denotes household lighting supplies used in earlier times or, more generally, items needed for illumination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前冇電嘅時候，屋企要準備燈油火蠟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 mou5 din6 ge3 si4 hau6, uk1 kei2 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 dang1 jau4 fo2 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前沒有電的時候，家裡要準備燈油和蠟燭。
examples.english_sentence: Before there was electricity, households had to prepare lamp oil and candles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，買燈油火蠟都係一件大事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sei3 go3 go2 zan6, maai5 dang1 jau4 fo2 laat6 dou1 hai6 jat1 gin6 daai6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候，買燈油和蠟燭也是一件大事。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, buying lamp oil and candles was a big deal.

mandarin_meaning: 电灯泡；（口語）當「第三者／湊熱鬧的跟隨者」即英文的“third wheel”
english_meaning: light bulb; (slang) a 'third wheel' — someone who tags along with a couple
explanation_mandarin: 本詞字面意思是照明用的燈泡（電燈泡）。在口語中常用作俚語，指跟隨在情侶或一群人旁邊，顯得多餘或尷尬的人，相當於“第三者/電燈泡”。
explanation_english: Literally a light bulb. Colloquially used as slang to describe a person who tags along with a couple (or group) and feels redundant or awkward — a 'third wheel'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個燈泡壞咗，要換一個燈泡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 dang1 paau4 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3 dang1 paau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯泡坏了，要换一个灯泡。
examples.english_sentence: The light bulb is broken; we need to replace a light bulb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日跟住我哋，好似個燈泡咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gan1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6, hou2 ci5 go3 dang1 paau4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是跟着我们，像个电灯泡一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always tags along with us, like a third wheel.

mandarin_meaning: 灯光；灯火（灯的光亮，常指夜间的灯或城里的灯）
english_meaning: lights; lamplight; illumination (often referring to lights at night or city lights)
explanation_mandarin: 指燈的光亮或光源，常用來形容夜晚的燈光、城市的燈火或家中的燈光氛圍。
explanation_english: Refers to lights or lamp light; commonly used to describe lights at night, city lights, or the general illumination from lamps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚個城市燈火好靚，好啱出去散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 go3 sing4 si5 dang1 fo2 hou2 leng3, hou2 aam1 ceot1 heoi3 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上的城市燈火很漂亮，很適合出去散步。
examples.english_sentence: The city's lights are beautiful at night, perfect for going out for a walk.

mandarin_meaning: 灯火通明
english_meaning: brightly lit; ablaze with lights; well-lit; (figuratively) bustling or lively
explanation_mandarin: 形容光線非常明亮，特別是夜晚燈光很多，也可比喻熱鬧或繁忙。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is very brightly lit, especially at night with many lights; can also figuratively mean bustling, lively, or busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚街上燈火通明，人山人海，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaai1 soeng6 dang1 fo2 tung1 ming4, jan4 saan1 jan4 hoi2, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚街上灯火通明，人山人海，很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The streets are brightly lit tonight and packed with people; it's very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 燈神（神燈裡的精靈；也指運氣極好或能帶來幸運的人）
english_meaning: lamp-genie; (slang) a very lucky person or someone who brings luck
explanation_mandarin: 1) 神話故事中住在神燈裡、能實現願望的精靈。2) 口語/俚語，用來形容運氣非常好或替人帶來好運的人。
explanation_english: 1) The mythical spirit that lives in a lamp and grants wishes. 2) Colloquially, used to describe someone extremely lucky or a person who brings good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 故事入面個燈神一出現就幫人實現三個願望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu3 si6 jap6 min6 go3 dang1 san4 jat1 ceot1 jin6 zau6 bong1 jan4 sat6 jin6 saam1 go3 jyun6 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 故事裡面的燈神一出現就幫人實現三個願望。
examples.english_sentence: In the story, the lamp genie appears and grants people three wishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買六合彩中咗大獎，成班朋友話佢係燈神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 luk6 ho6 coi3 zung6 zo2 daai6 zoeng2, sing4 baan1 pang4 jau5 waa6 keoi5 hai6 dang1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買六合彩中了大獎，整班朋友都說他是燈神。
examples.english_sentence: He won the big lottery prize; the whole group of friends said he's a 'lamp god' (really lucky).

mandarin_meaning: 灯箱
english_meaning: lightbox; illuminated sign box
explanation_mandarin: 指內置光源的箱狀結構，通常用於商業廣告招牌的背光展示或攝影用的透光台，用來展示海報、宣傳圖等。
explanation_english: A box-like structure with internal lighting used for backlit displays or illuminated advertising signs; also refers to a lightbox used in photography to view transparencies or display posters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場門口嗰個燈箱今晚會換新海報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 mun4 hau2 go2 go3 dang1 soeng1 gam1 maan5 wui5 wun6 san1 hoi2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场门口的那个灯箱今晚会换新海报。
examples.english_sentence: They're going to change the poster on the lightbox at the mall entrance tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 灯笼
english_meaning: lantern
explanation_mandarin: 用來照明或作裝飾的器具，常以紙、布、竹等材料製成，常見於節慶（如中秋、農曆新年）或作為街頭裝飾。
explanation_english: A container for light used for illumination or decoration, often made of paper, cloth, or bamboo; commonly seen at festivals (e.g., Mid-Autumn, Lunar New Year) or as street decorations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農曆新年街上掛滿紅燈籠，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 gaai1 soeng6 gwaa3 mun5 hung4 dang1 lung4, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农历新年街上挂满红灯笼，很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The streets are hung with red lanterns during Lunar New Year; it's very festive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢手上拎住一個紙燈籠，準備去參加花燈會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau2 soeng6 ling1 zyu6 jat1 go3 zi2 dang1 lung4, zeon2 bei6 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 faa1 dang1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手上拿着一个纸灯笼，准备去参加花灯会。
examples.english_sentence: He was holding a paper lantern in his hand, getting ready to join the lantern festival.

mandarin_meaning: 灯笼椒／甜椒（又称柿子椒），一种甜味的灯笼状椒类蔬菜
english_meaning: bell pepper; sweet pepper (capsicum) — a mild, bell-shaped pepper that can be red, yellow, or green
explanation_mandarin: 指一种外形像小灯笼、味道不辣的椒类蔬菜，颜色常见有红、黄、绿，常用于炒、烤或生食。
explanation_english: Refers to a mild pepper with a lantern-like shape (bell pepper). It is not spicy, comes in red/yellow/green, and is used in stir-fries, roasting, or eaten raw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個燈籠椒好甜，啱晒炒牛肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dang1 lung4 ziu1 hou2 tim4, aam1 saai3 caau2 ngau4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个灯笼椒很甜，适合炒牛肉。
examples.english_sentence: This bell pepper is very sweet, perfect for stir-frying with beef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 菜市場有紅、黃、綠三色嘅燈籠椒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi3 si5 coeng4 jau5 hung4, wong4, luk6 saam1 sik1 ge3 dang1 lung4 ziu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜市场有红、黄、绿三色的灯笼椒。
examples.english_sentence: The market has red, yellow, and green bell peppers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 燈籠椒唔辣，可以生食或者煮熟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang1 lung4 ziu1 m4 laat6, ho2 ji5 saang1 sik6 waak6 ze2 zyu2 suk6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯笼椒不辣，可以生吃或者熟吃。
examples.english_sentence: Bell peppers aren't spicy; they can be eaten raw or cooked.

mandarin_meaning: 灯红酒绿（形容奢靡放纵的夜生活或沉迷声色场所）
english_meaning: A flashy, hedonistic nightlife; living in indulgence and debauchery centered on parties, drinking, and entertainment.
explanation_mandarin: 燈紅酒綠原指燈光鮮豔、酒色繁華，用來形容夜生活奢靡、沉迷聲色、放縱揮霍的生活狀態。
explanation_english: Literally 'red lights and green wine.' Describes a flashy, indulgent lifestyle focused on nightlife, drinking, and carousing—often implying moral looseness or excess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排嗰區成日燈紅酒綠，夜晚好嘈，我唔想去嗰啲地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 go2 keoi1 sing4 jat6 dang1 hung4 zau2 luk6, je6 maan5 hou2 cou4, ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 go2 di1 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近那一带常常灯红酒绿，晚上很吵，我不想去那些地方。
examples.english_sentence: Lately that area is often full of nightlife and debauchery; it's very noisy at night and I don't want to go to those places.

mandarin_meaning: 燈泡／燈膽（燈具中發光的部分）
english_meaning: light bulb (the bulb/filament part of a lamp)
explanation_mandarin: 指燈具中發光的燈泡或燈膽，即電燈裡產生光的那一部分。在香港粵語中日常用語，常用於說明燈泡壞了或要更換。
explanation_english: Refers to the light bulb (the part of a lamp that produces light). Common everyday term in Cantonese for saying a bulb has burned out or needs replacing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房嘅燈膽燒咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong4 ge3 dang1 daam2 siu1 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間的燈泡燒壞了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: The light bulb in the room burned out; it needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 灯光的颜色；灯光营造的氛围
english_meaning: the color or hue of lighting; mood/atmosphere created by lighting
explanation_mandarin: 指燈光的顏色或色調，也可用來描述燈光所帶出的氛圍（例如偏暖或偏冷的光色）。
explanation_english: Refers to the color or tone of light (e.g., warm or cool) and can describe the atmosphere produced by that lighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房嘅燈色偏暖，感覺好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong4 ge3 dang1 sik1 pin1 nyun5, gam2 gok3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间的灯光偏暖，感觉很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The room's lighting is on the warm side; it feels very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攝影師調整燈色同亮度，影出想要嘅氛圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sip3 jing2 si1 tiu4 zing2 dang1 sik1 tung4 loeng6 dou6, jing2 ceot1 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 fan1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摄影师调整灯色和亮度，拍出想要的氛围。
examples.english_sentence: The photographer adjusted the color and brightness of the lights to capture the desired mood.

mandarin_meaning: 燈芯 / 燈的芯子；可指用於點燈或蠟燭的棉線或植物髓心
english_meaning: lamp wick; the cord or material that burns in an oil lamp or candle (also the pith/core of certain plants used as a wick)
explanation_mandarin: 指用作點燃的燈芯或蠟燭的棉線，或某些植物的髓心，作為燃燒材料以維持火焰。
explanation_english: The braided or twisted cord (or similar material) placed in a lamp or candle that soaks up fuel and burns; can also refer to the pith/core of certain plants used as a wick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢盞油燈嘅燈芯已經燒到剩低，換咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zaan2 jau4 dang1 ge3 dang1 sam1 ji5 ging1 siu1 dou3 sing6 dai1, wun6 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盞油燈的燈芯已經燒到快沒了，換掉吧。
examples.english_sentence: The wick of this oil lamp is almost burned down; replace it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整手作蠟燭要用棉線做燈芯，先可以慢慢燃燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 sau2 zok3 laap6 zuk1 jiu3 jung6 min4 sin3 zou6 dang1 sam1, sin1 ho2 ji5 maan6 maan6 jin4 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做手工蠟燭要用棉線做燈芯，才能慢慢燃燒。
examples.english_sentence: When making handmade candles, use cotton thread as the wick so it can burn slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 灯芯绒（布料）
english_meaning: Corduroy (a textile with raised parallel ribs)
explanation_mandarin: 一種有條狀絨面的棉質或混紡面料，常用來製作外套、褲子等保暖服飾。
explanation_english: A textile with raised parallel ribs (wales), typically made from cotton or blended fibers, commonly used for warm garments like jackets and trousers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件大褸係燈芯絨做嘅，好暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 daai6 lau1 hai6 dang1 sam1 jung4 zou6 ge3, hou2 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件大衣是燈芯絨做的，很暖和。
examples.english_sentence: This coat is made of corduroy; it's very warm.

mandarin_meaning: 信號；提示（可指交通號誌或事態的徵兆）
english_meaning: signal; sign; indicator (can refer to traffic signals or figurative signs)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來示意或傳遞資訊的信號，既可指交通號誌（如紅綠燈），亦可指事情發展的徵兆或提示。
explanation_english: Refers to a signal or indicator used to convey information; can mean traffic signals (e.g., traffic lights) or, figuratively, a sign/indicator of developments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府冇畀清晰嘅燈號，市民唔知應唔應該出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 mou5 bei2 cing1 sik1 ge3 dang1 hou6, si5 man4 m4 zi1 jing1 m4 jing1 goi1 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府沒有給出清晰的信號，市民不知道是否應該出門。
examples.english_sentence: The government didn't give a clear signal, so citizens don't know if they should go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 路口嘅燈號壞咗，警察要指揮交通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou6 hau2 ge3 dang1 hou6 waai6 zo2, ging2 caat3 jiu3 zi2 fai1 gaau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路口的信號燈壞了，警察要指揮交通。
examples.english_sentence: The intersection's signal lights are broken, so the police have to direct traffic.

mandarin_meaning: 灯谜 (dēngmí)
english_meaning: lantern riddle; riddle posted on lanterns (traditional festival activity)
explanation_mandarin: 寫在燈籠或燈會上供人猜的謎語，常見於元宵節或傳統燈會等民俗活動。
explanation_english: A riddle written on a lantern or displayed at a lantern fair; a traditional riddle activity commonly associated with the Lantern Festival and other folk celebrations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年初十五我哋去燈會猜燈謎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 co1 sap6 ng5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 dang1 wui6 caai1 dang1 mai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 元宵節那天我們去燈會猜燈謎。
examples.english_sentence: On the Lantern Festival we went to the lantern fair to solve lantern riddles.

mandarin_meaning: 灯头（燈具的頭部，指燈泡、燈座或燈具頂部）
english_meaning: lamp head; the head/top part of a lamp — often refers to the bulb, socket, or lamp top
explanation_mandarin: 粵語中常用來指燈具的頭部或光源部位，可指燈泡、燈座或燈具頂部。口語中有時與「燈膽」「燈泡」互換使用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, this commonly refers to the head/top of a lamp or the light source — the bulb, socket, or lamp top. Colloquially it is sometimes used interchangeably with terms for bulb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅幫我換咗個新燈頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 bong1 ngo5 wun6 zo2 go3 san1 dang1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅帮我换了一个新的灯头。
examples.english_sentence: The technician replaced the lamp head for me.

mandarin_meaning: 灯饰；用于装饰或照明的灯具或灯光布置
english_meaning: decorative lighting; light fixtures or lighting decorations used for illumination or ornamentation
explanation_mandarin: 指用來裝飾或照明的燈具、燈串或燈光設計，常見於節慶、商場或室內裝潢的裝飾性照明。
explanation_english: Refers to lighting fixtures, strings of lights, or lighting designs used for decoration or illumination; commonly seen in festive displays, malls, or interior decoration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場嘅聖誕燈飾今晚會開幕，好多人嚟影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 ge3 sing3 daan3 dang1 sik1 gam1 maan5 wui5 hoi1 muk6, hou2 do1 jan4 lei4 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商場的聖誕燈飾今晚會開幕，很多人來拍照。
examples.english_sentence: The mall's Christmas lighting will be unveiled tonight; many people will come to take photos.

mandarin_meaning: 炖；用小火慢煮（食物）
english_meaning: to stew; to simmer slowly (food)
explanation_mandarin: 指用文火長時間燉煮食材，使味道滲入、肉質變軟爛，常用於湯或燉品的烹調方式。
explanation_english: A cooking method meaning to simmer or stew ingredients slowly over low heat so flavors meld and meats become tender; commonly used for soups and braises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽今晚燉咗隻雞湯，好滋補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 gam1 maan5 deon6 zo2 zek3 gai1 tong1, hou2 zi1 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈今晚炖了一锅鸡汤，很滋补。
examples.english_sentence: Mom stewed a pot of chicken soup tonight; it's very nourishing.

mandarin_meaning: 炖冬菇（炖香菇）
english_meaning: to stew shiitake mushrooms; stewed shiitake (dish/soup)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词短语 / 名词（菜名）
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把冬菇（即香菇）用慢火炖煮，常見於煲湯或滋補菜式，也可指成品的湯或菜。
explanation_english: Literally 'to stew shiitake mushrooms.' It refers to the cooking method (often for nourishing soups) and to the resulting dish or soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚阿媽燉咗啲冬菇湯，真係好補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 aa3 maa1 dun6 zo2 di1 dung1 gu1 tong1, zan1 hai6 hou2 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚妈妈炖了些冬菇汤，真的很补。
examples.english_sentence: My mom stewed some shiitake mushroom soup tonight—it's really nourishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗身體，佢成日燉冬菇湯俾屋企人飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 san1 tai2, keoi5 seng4 jat6 dun6 dung1 gu1 tong1 bei2 uk1 kei2 jan4 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了身体，他经常炖冬菇汤给家人喝。
examples.english_sentence: For health, he often stews shiitake soup for the family to drink.

mandarin_meaning: 炖冬菇（炖香菇）
english_meaning: to stew/slow-cook shiitake mushrooms
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，燉冬菰是烹調用語，指將冬菇（香菇）與其他材料一起慢燉入湯或燉品，常見於廣東菜或家庭湯水，並被認為有滋補作用。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 燉冬菰 is a culinary term meaning to stew shiitake mushrooms (often with other ingredients) in soups or braises. It is common in Guangdong cuisine and home soups, sometimes considered nourishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽今晚燉冬菰湯，佢話對身體好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gam1 maan5 dun6 dung1 gu1 tong1, keoi5 waa6 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈今晚炖冬菇汤，她说对身体很好。
examples.english_sentence: Mom is stewing shiitake soup tonight; she says it's good for the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯用豬骨同冬菰一齊燉，個湯好鮮甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 jung6 zyu1 gwat1 tung4 dung1 gu1 jat1 cai4 dun6, go3 tong1 hou2 sin1 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯伯把猪骨和冬菇一起炖，汤很鲜甜。
examples.english_sentence: The uncle stewed pork bones with shiitake; the soup is very savory and sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 燉品（燉製的菜餚或湯品）
english_meaning: stewed dishes / double‑boiled soups
explanation_mandarin: 指以燉或炖的方式長時間煮製的中式菜餚或補湯，常見於酒樓或中藥燉補菜單上，例如燉雞湯、燉排骨等。
explanation_english: Refers to dishes or tonic soups prepared by stewing or double‑boiling for a long time, commonly found on Chinese restaurant menus — e.g. stewed chicken soup or stewed ribs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒樓啲燉品好出名，尤其係燉雞湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 lou4 di1 dun6 ban2 hou2 ceot1 ming4, jau4 kei4 hai6 dun6 gai1 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間酒樓的燉品很出名，尤其是燉雞湯。
examples.english_sentence: The stewed dishes at this restaurant are famous, especially the stewed chicken soup.

mandarin_meaning: 燉盅（用小瓷盅隔水燉煮的湯或盛湯的小盅）
english_meaning: a small covered ceramic pot used for double-boiling soups; also the double-boiled soup made in such a pot
explanation_mandarin: 指用小瓷盅隔水慢燉煲出的湯品，或指盛湯的小盅器皿，常見於廣東菜、粵式燉湯文化中。
explanation_english: Refers to a small covered ceramic vessel used to double-boil soups (or the soup prepared in it). Common in Cantonese cuisine and traditional nourishing soups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶樓嘅燉盅好出名，你要唔要試下？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 lau4 ge3 dun6 zung1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 si3 haa5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間茶樓的燉盅很出名，你要不要試試？
examples.english_sentence: The double-boiled soups at this teahouse are famous — do you want to try one?

mandarin_meaning: （不常見詞，可能為暱稱或方言用語）字面為「燉（燉煮、煲湯）」＋「翁（老人）」，可用來戲稱愛煲湯的中老年男子
english_meaning: (uncommon/possibly colloquial) literally "dun (stew/simmer) + weng (old man)"; a joking nickname for an older man who frequently makes stews or soups
explanation_mandarin: 「燉翁」並非標準或廣泛使用的廣東話詞彙，可能是地方性或個人圈子裏的暱稱。字面上由「燉」和「翁」組成，常用作戲稱那些愛煲補湯或燉湯的中老年男子。若遇到不同語境，亦可能是筆誤或其他專有名稱，需根據上下文判斷。
explanation_english: “燉翁” is not a widely established Cantonese word; it likely functions as a local or private nickname. Literally composed of "燉" (to stew/simmer) and "翁" (old man), it can be used jokingly for an older man who often makes stews or soups. In other contexts it may be a typo or a proper name—interpretation depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿叔鍾意煲湯，朋友笑住叫佢「燉翁」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 suk1 zung1 ji3 bou1 tong1, pang4 jau5 siu3 zyu6 giu3 keoi5 'deon6 jung1'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叔叔喜歡煲湯，朋友們笑著叫他「燉翁」。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle likes making soup; his friends jokingly call him "dun-weng".

mandarin_meaning: 炖蛋 / dùn dàn
english_meaning: double‑steamed egg / steamed egg custard
explanation_mandarin: 一种把鸡蛋与水或牛奶混合后隔水蒸或文火炖成的细滑蛋羹，既有甜味亦有咸味的做法，常见于粤式茶楼与家常菜。
explanation_english: A dish made by mixing eggs with water or milk and double‑steaming or simmering gently to produce a smooth egg custard; can be sweet or savory and is common in Cantonese cuisine and home cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我媽成日整燉蛋畀我食，話對身體好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maa4 sing4 jat6 zing2 deon6 daan6 bei2 ngo5 sik6, waa6 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈经常做炖蛋给我吃，说对身体好。
examples.english_sentence: My mom often makes double‑steamed egg for me; she says it's good for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 茶樓午市有時會有燉蛋做甜品，滑得嚟唔會太甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 lau4 ng5 si5 jau5 si4 wui5 jau5 deon6 daan6 zou6 tim4 ban2, waat6 dak1 lai4 m4 wui5 taai3 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 茶楼午市有时会有炖蛋作为甜点，滑嫩而且不太甜。
examples.english_sentence: The tea house sometimes serves double‑steamed egg as a dessert at lunch; it's silky and not overly sweet.

mandarin_meaning: （古字）火光旺盛、興旺；亦作姓氏
english_meaning: a rare character meaning blazing, flourishing, prosperous; also used as a surname
explanation_mandarin: 燊為一個較少見的漢字，字形由多個「火」組成，表示火光旺盛、興盛、昌盛，亦可見作人名或姓氏用字。
explanation_english: 燊 is a rare character composed of multiple 'fire' radicals, conveying the idea of bright flames, prosperity, or flourishing; it is also used in personal names and as a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「燊」喺人名度成日見到，意思係興旺、火光旺盛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'san1' hai6 jan4 ming4 dou6 seng4 jat6 gin3 dou2, ji3 si1 hai6 hing1 wong6, fo2 gwong1 wong6 sing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“燊”在名字中经常出现，意思是兴旺、火光旺盛。
examples.english_sentence: The character '燊' often appears in names; it means flourishing or blazing.

mandarin_meaning: 焚烧；点燃；引起蔓延（常见于“燎原”）
english_meaning: to burn; to set on fire; to spread (of fire); often used in compounds like '燎原' (fire spreading across the plains)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用火烧、点燃或火势蔓延，常用于书面或成语，如“燎原”表示火势迅速蔓延。
explanation_english: Indicates setting on fire, burning, or the spreading of fire; frequently used in literary contexts or idioms such as '燎原' (a rapidly spreading fire).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰場火好快就燎原咗，燒咗成片草地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 coeng4 fo2 hou2 faai3 zau6 liu6 jyun4 zo2, siu1 zo2 seng4 pin3 cou2 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那场火很快就燎原了，烧掉了大片草地。
examples.english_sentence: That fire quickly spread across the plain, burning a large area of grassland.

mandarin_meaning: 磷（化學元素）
english_meaning: phosphorus (chemical element)
explanation_mandarin: 燐為磷的異體字，常見於日語或舊字形，用來指化學元素磷（元素符號 P）。在中文中一般多寫作「磷」。
explanation_english: 燐 is a variant form of the character for phosphorus (磷). It appears in Japanese and historical orthography and refers to the chemical element phosphorus (symbol P). In modern Chinese the standard form is 磷.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種肥料含有燐，對植物生長好緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 fei4 liu6 ham4 jau5 lam4, deoi3 zik6 mat6 saang1 zoeng2 hou2 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種肥料含有磷，對植物生長很重要。
examples.english_sentence: This fertilizer contains phosphorus, which is important for plant growth.

mandarin_meaning: 燒 / 烧 (shāo) — 烧、烤、燃烧；也可指发烧（发热）
english_meaning: to burn/roast; to heat with fire; (also) to have a fever
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「燒」常用來表示用火或高溫烹調（如燒鴨、燒烤）、使物體燃燒，或描述人體發熱（發燒）。
explanation_english: Commonly used to mean cooking with fire or high heat (e.g. roast), causing something to burn, or describing a person having a fever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我肚餓想食燒鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tou5 ngo6 soeng2 sik6 siu1 ngaap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我肚子餓想吃燒鴨。
examples.english_sentence: I'm hungry and want to eat roast duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發燒，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 siu1, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他發燒，要去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: He has a fever and needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂燒垃圾，會引致火警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 siu1 laap6 saap3, wui5 jan5 zi3 fo2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要亂燒垃圾，會引發火災。
examples.english_sentence: Don't burn trash indiscriminately; it can cause a fire.

mandarin_meaning: 烤乳猪 / 烧乳猪
english_meaning: roast suckling pig; roast pig
explanation_mandarin: 燒乳豬是以整隻乳豬烤製而成的菜餚，外皮酥脆、肉質嫩滑，常見於婚宴、節慶、喜慶或作為祭祀供品。
explanation_english: A whole young pig roasted until the skin is crispy and the meat tender. Commonly served at weddings, festivals, celebratory banquets, and sometimes used as an offering in ceremonies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚有燒乳豬，大家一齊食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jau5 siu1 jyu5 zyu1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚有烤乳猪，大家一起吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: We have roast suckling pig tonight — let's all eat together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港結婚擺酒嗰日，通常會有燒乳豬上席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 git3 fan1 baai2 zau2 go2 jat6, tung1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 siu1 jyu5 zyu1 soeng6 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港结婚摆酒那天，通常会有烤乳猪上席。
examples.english_sentence: At weddings in Hong Kong, a roast suckling pig is often served at the banquet.

mandarin_meaning: 燒掉你的帳簿／毀掉你的帳目（比喻性地毀掉某人的財務紀錄或使其破產）
english_meaning: to burn your ledger/accounts (figuratively: to destroy someone's financial records or to ruin/bankrupt someone)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，字面意為把對方的帳簿燒掉。通常為威脅或誇張說法，用來形容毀掉別人的帳目／證據，或者把對方搞至破產、債務無法清還。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang literally meaning 'to burn your ledger.' Often used as a threat or figuratively to describe destroying someone's financial records/evidence or ruining them financially (e.g., bankrupting them or wiping out their accounts).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好呃我，唔然我會燒你數簿！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 aak1 ngo5, m4 jin4 ngo5 wui5 siu1 nei5 sou3 bou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要騙我，否則我會燒掉你的帳簿！
examples.english_sentence: Don't cheat me, or I'll burn your ledger!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢借晒錢俾人，最後俾人燒晒佢嘅數簿，家陣已經破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ze3 saai3 cin2 bei2 jan4, zeoi3 hau6 bei2 jan4 siu1 saai3 keoi5 ge3 sou3 bou2, gaa1 zan6 ji5 ging1 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有錢借給別人，最後被人把他的帳簿燒掉，現在已經破產了。
examples.english_sentence: He lent all his money to others and ended up having his ledgers burned by them; now he's bankrupt.

mandarin_meaning: 做兼職／副業（通常暗中進行）
english_meaning: to moonlight / do a side job (often secretly)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，字面為「點燃冷灶」，比喻在正式工作之外暗中做兼職或副業以賺取額外收入，有時含隱瞞僱主之意。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression literally meaning "light a cold stove." Metaphorically it refers to doing moonlighting or running a side business in addition to one's main job, often done secretly or without the employer's knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺公司做嘢，但係夜晚會去燒冷灶，賺多啲外快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 je5, daan6 hai6 je6 maan5 wui5 heoi3 siu1 laang5 zou6, zaan6 do1 di1 ngoi6 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在公司上班，但晚上會去做兼職，賺外快。
examples.english_sentence: He works at the company now, but at night he does a side job to earn extra money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心唔好畀上司發現你燒緊冷灶，咁可能會有麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 bei2 soeng5 si1 faat3 jin6 nei5 siu1 gan2 laang5 zou6, gam2 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心不要讓上司發現你在兼職，否則可能會有麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful not to let your boss find out you're moonlighting, otherwise it could cause trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 把那一疊（錢）花光／輸光
english_meaning: to burn through that stack (of money); to spend or lose a large pile of cash
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，常用來表示把一大疊錢花光或在賭博/消費中輸掉那一疊錢。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to indicate spending or losing an entire stack of money (e.g., through shopping or gambling).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上個禮拜我喺網購買嘢買到停唔到手，結果燒到嗰疊現金都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 ngo5 hai2 mong5 gau3 maai5 je5 maai5 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2 sau2, git3 gwo2 siu1 dou3 go2 daap6 jin6 gam1 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上個禮拜我在網購不停地買東西，結果把那疊現金都花光了。
examples.english_sentence: Last week I kept buying things online and couldn't stop; I ended up burning through that stack of cash.

mandarin_meaning: 被牽連／被連累／捲入麻煩
english_meaning: to get implicated or dragged into trouble; to suffer bad consequences personally
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指不好的事情或爭議蔓延到某人身上，讓該人受到牽連或承擔後果。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang/idiomatic expression meaning that a problem, controversy, or negative consequence has spread to someone personally, causing them to be implicated or suffer the fallout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我幫佢出聲，驚會被燒到埋身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 ceot1 seng1, geng1 wui5 bei6 siu1 dou3 maai4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我替他出面，怕會被牽連。
examples.english_sentence: If I speak up for him, I'm afraid I'll be dragged into it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次公司出事，經理被燒到埋身，要承擔後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gung1 si1 ceot1 si6, ging1 lei5 bei6 siu1 dou3 maai4 san1, jiu3 sing4 daam1 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次公司出事，經理被牽連，要承擔後果。
examples.english_sentence: The company had a problem this time; the manager got implicated and has to bear the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺社交平台講錯嘢，啲網民鬧爆佢，驚會燒到埋身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 se5 gaau1 ping4 toi4 gong2 co3 je5, di1 mong5 man4 nau6 baau3 keoi5, geng1 wui5 siu1 dou3 maai4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在社交平台說錯話，網民罵翻他，怕會牽連到我們。
examples.english_sentence: He said the wrong thing on social media and got flamed; I'm afraid it will drag us into it.

mandarin_meaning: 在舞台或公開場合故意做出誇張、吸引注意的行為；出風頭、炒作
english_meaning: to grandstand or show off (literally 'set off cannon/firecrackers on the stage'); to do something flashy to attract attention
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語口語說法，形容在舞台或公開場合為了吸引注意而刻意做出誇張或出位的表演或言行，帶有批評或嘲諷意味。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term describing deliberately performative, attention-seeking or showy behavior onstage or in public. Often used critically to say someone is grandstanding or making a scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個歌手成日喺演唱會燒台炮，求關注。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 go1 sau2 seng4 jat6 hai6 jin2 coeng3 wui2 siu1 toi4 paau3, kau4 gwaan1 zyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個歌手總是在演唱會上出風頭，博取關注。
examples.english_sentence: That singer is always grandstanding at concerts to get attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺綜藝節目度不停燒台炮，連主持都覺得尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zung1 ngai6 zit3 muk6 dou6 bat1 ting4 siu1 toi4 paau3, lin4 zyu2 ci4 dou1 gok3 dak1 gam1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在綜藝節目裡不停出位，連主持人都覺得尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps showing off on the variety show; even the host feels awkward.

mandarin_meaning: 燒味 / 燒臘（指中式燒烤/掛燒類熟肉，如叉燒、燒鴨、燒肉等）
english_meaning: roasted/barbecued Cantonese-style meats (e.g., char siu, roast duck, roast pork)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東飲食文化中的一類熟肉總稱，通常指以明火或掛燒方式製作的肉類，如叉燒、燒鴨、燒肉等，常見於燒臘店或茶樓。
explanation_english: A collective term in Cantonese cuisine for roasted or barbecued meats, typically prepared over open flame or hung-roasted, such as char siu, roast duck and roast pork; commonly sold at siu mei shops and served in tea houses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食燒味，尤其係叉燒同燒鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 siu1 mei6, jau4 kei4 hai6 caa1 siu1 tung4 siu1 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃燒味，尤其是叉燒和燒鴨。
examples.english_sentence: I like siu mei, especially char siu and roast duck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶樓嘅燒味好出名，成日有人排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 lau4 ge3 siu1 mei6 hou2 ceot1 ming4, seng4 jat6 jau5 jan4 paai4 deoi6 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家茶樓的燒味很有名，經常有人排隊買。
examples.english_sentence: The roasted meats at this teahouse are famous; people often queue to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝喺街市買咗啲燒味返屋企食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 di1 siu1 mei6 faan1 uk1 kei5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上在街市買了些燒味回家吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some siu mei at the market this morning to eat at home.

mandarin_meaning: 按喇叭 / 鳴笛（不停按或鳴喇叭以製造噪音、示威或吸引注意）
english_meaning: to honk the horn / to sound the horn (often repeatedly; to make noise, protest, or attract attention)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指按車輛的喇叭或不停鳴笛，通常用來表示不滿、示威、招搖或單純製造噪音。有時可延伸為吸引注意的行為。
explanation_english: Colloquial term meaning to press or sound a vehicle's horn (often repeatedly). Used to indicate annoyance, protest, to attract attention, or to create noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個司機一邊開車一邊燒喇叭，好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 si1 gei1 jat1 bin1 hoi1 ce1 jat1 bin1 siu1 laap3 baa1, hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 司机一边开车一边按喇叭，很烦。
examples.english_sentence: The driver kept honking his horn while driving; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚有人落街燒喇叭示威，好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 jau5 jan4 lok6 gaai1 siu1 laap3 baa1 si6 wai1, hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上有人上街按喇叭示威，很吵。
examples.english_sentence: At night people went out honking horns in protest; it's very noisy.

mandarin_meaning: 燒烤／烤肉（用炭或火烤食物）
english_meaning: to barbecue / to grill food (have a barbecue)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指在戶外或用炭／火烤食物，即燒烤、烤肉的活動，也可泛指聚會時一起吃烤製食物。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase meaning to barbecue or grill food (to have a barbecue). It often refers to the activity of grilling food outdoors, typically as a social gathering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嚟我屋企，我哋去燒嘢食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 siu1 je5 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚來我家，我們去燒烤吧。
examples.english_sentence: Come to my place tonight — let's have a barbecue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 週末去海邊燒嘢食，好好玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau1 mut6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 siu1 je5 sik6, hou2 hou2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 周末去海邊燒烤，很好玩。
examples.english_sentence: We went to the beach to barbecue over the weekend — it was a lot of fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要買炭同埋肉，準備去燒嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 taan3 tung4 maai4 juk6, zeon2 bei6 heoi3 siu1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要買炭和肉，準備去燒烤。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy charcoal and meat; we're getting ready to have a barbecue.

mandarin_meaning: 把那一疊（錢／東西）全部花光或輸光
english_meaning: to burn through that stack (of money/things) — to spend or lose all of it
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，通常用於指把某一疊錢或某批東西全部用完、花光或輸掉。常見於賭博或揮霍情境，帶有警告或抱怨語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression used to say someone will use up, spend, or lose an entire stack (usually money). Commonly used in gambling or wasteful-spending contexts, often as a warning or complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再賭落去，會燒埋嗰疊錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2 lok6 heoi3, wui5 siu1 maai4 go2 daap6 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再賭下去了，會把那疊錢全都輸光的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep gambling — you'll burn through that stack of money.

mandarin_meaning: 把我那一叠（例如钱或文件）也烧掉；连带毁掉我的那一份
english_meaning: Burn my pile/stack as well — literally to burn someone's stack (money/documents); figuratively to destroy or ruin someone's share
