examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃為期三個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wai4 kei4 saam1 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划为期三个月。
examples.english_sentence: This project is scheduled to last three months.

mandarin_meaning: 以…为本（以某事物作为基础或重心）
english_meaning: to take (something) as the basis; be based on; put (something) first
explanation_mandarin: 「爲本」常見於結構「以…為本」，表示把某事物作為基礎或重點，強調優先考慮或核心價值。
explanation_english: Used commonly in the structure "以...為本" (take ... as the basis). It indicates treating something as the foundation or main priority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司以客為本，提供優質服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 haak3 wai4 bun2, tai4 gung1 jau1 zat1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司以客户为本，提供优质服务。
examples.english_sentence: The company puts customers first and provides high-quality service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以安全為本，所有程序都有檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 on1 cyun4 wai4 bun2, so2 jau5 cing4 zoek3 dou1 jau5 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以安全为本，所有程序都有检查。
examples.english_sentence: We take safety as our priority; every procedure is checked.

mandarin_meaning: 为止（表示达到某个限度或时间点而停止）
english_meaning: until; up to (a point); to stop at
explanation_mandarin: 表示达到某个限度或时间点而停止，常用于“到……为止”的结构，表示截至某时刻或某范围为止（不再继续）。
explanation_english: Indicates reaching a limit or time point and stopping. Commonly used in the structure 'until/up to ...' (e.g., 'up to now', 'until then').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到目前爲止，我哋仲未收到回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 muk6 cin4 wai4 zi2, ngo5 dei6 zung6 mei6 sau1 dou3 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到目前为止，我们还未收到回复。
examples.english_sentence: So far, we haven't received a reply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到此爲止，我唔想再講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 ci2 wai4 zi2, ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到此为止，我不想再说了。
examples.english_sentence: That's it; I don't want to talk about it anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 为止（截至；直到……为止）
english_meaning: until; up to (a certain point); up to the point of
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介词/结构成分（表示时限或终点）
partOfSpeech_english: preposition/phrase (indicating a temporal limit or end point)
explanation_mandarin: “为止”用于表示某一动作、状态或时间的终点，常见于书面或正式用语，表示“截止到……为止”。
explanation_english: “爲止” is used to indicate the end point of an action, state, or time. It is common in written or formal contexts and corresponds to “until” or “up to” in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 到今日為止，我已經做咗十次試驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou3 gam1 jat6 wai4 zi2, ngo5 ji5 ging1 zou6 zo2 sap6 ci3 si3 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 到今天为止，我已经做了十次试验。
examples.english_sentence: As of today, I have already conducted ten experiments.

mandarin_meaning: 为民请命／为人民请愿，为民众向当权者或上级替他们争取权益或救济
english_meaning: to plead on behalf of the people; to petition or speak up for the populace's rights and welfare
explanation_mandarin: 「爲民請命」是指替百姓向當權者、官員或上級請求、陳情或爭取權益、救濟等，常用於形容官員或代表為民眾發聲、代為請求的行為。
explanation_english: This phrase means to petition or plead on behalf of the people—asking authorities for rights, relief, or welfare. It often describes officials or representatives who speak up for the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位議員成日爲民請命，爭取低收入家庭嘅福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai6 ji5 jyun4 sing4 jat6 wai4 man4 cing2 ming6, zang1 ceoi2 dai1 sau1 jap6 gaa1 ting4 ge3 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位议员经常为民请命，争取低收入家庭的福利。
examples.english_sentence: This legislator often speaks up for the people, fighting for welfare for low-income households.

mandarin_meaning: 为民除害 (wèi mín chú hài)：为人民除去祸害，保护百姓
english_meaning: to rid the people of harm; to eliminate threats or evils for the populace
explanation_mandarin: 成語性短語，帶有正式或文言色彩，常用於政治或治安語境，指官員或力量為了保護百姓而消除禍害或不法勢力。
explanation_english: An idiomatic verb phrase with a formal/literary tone, often used in political or public safety contexts; it means authorities or forces remove harms or criminal threats to protect the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位官員話佢會為民除害，打擊黑幫同貪污。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai6 gun1 jyun4 waa6 keoi5 wui5 wai4 man4 ceoi4 hoi6, daa2 gik1 hak1 bong1 tung4 taam1 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位官员说他会为民除害，打击黑帮和贪污。
examples.english_sentence: The official said he would rid the people of harms, cracking down on gangs and corruption.

mandarin_meaning: 以……为准（以某事或某物作最终标准或决定依据）
english_meaning: to be taken as the standard; to be final/decisive
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某個人、事物或結果作爲最終標準或判斷依據，常用於規定哪一種說法或資料最具權威性或可作為準據。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person, item, or result is to be regarded as the final standard or basis for judgment; commonly used to state which statement or document is authoritative or definitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最終以公司決定為準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 zung1 ji5 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 wai4 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最终以公司决定为准。
examples.english_sentence: The company's decision will be final.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 價格以報價單為準，其他資料只作參考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 gaak3 ji5 bou3 gaa3 daan1 wai4 zeon2, kei4 taa1 zi1 liu2 zi2 zok3 caam1 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 价格以报价单为准，其他资料仅供参考。
examples.english_sentence: Prices are determined by the quotation; other information is for reference only.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有爭議，以合約內容爲準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 zaang1 ji6, ji5 hap6 joek3 noi6 jung4 wai4 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有争议，以合约内容为准。
examples.english_sentence: If there is a dispute, the contract terms shall prevail.

mandarin_meaning: 為什麼
english_meaning: why; for what reason
explanation_mandarin: 用來詢問原因或理由，相當於普通話的「為什麼」。在廣東話口語中常以「點解」代替。
explanation_english: Used to ask for a reason or cause; equivalent to Mandarin "為什麼" and English "why". In spoken Cantonese, "點解" is more commonly used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你爲甚麼遲到？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai6 sam6 mo1 ci4 dou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你為什麼遲到？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you late?

mandarin_meaning: 調皮、頑皮、搗蛋（口語）
english_meaning: to be naughty/cheeky; to play around or tease (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用語，用來形容人頑皮、愛惡作劇或愛逗弄別人，常見於香港日常對話。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone who is mischievous, playful, or teasing—often used in casual Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又為皮做咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 wai6 pei4 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又調皮，做什麼啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being cheeky again?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔咁為皮，成日唔肯聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 gam2 wai6 pei4, sing4 jat6 m4 hang2 teng1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子這麼頑皮，總是不肯聽話。
examples.english_sentence: The kid is so naughty; he never listens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係為皮玩吓人，唔係惡意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 wai6 pei4 waan2 haa5 jan4, m4 hai6 ok3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是調皮捉弄人，並無惡意。
examples.english_sentence: He's just being playful and teasing people, not malicious.

mandarin_meaning: 为了
english_meaning: for the sake of; in order to
explanation_mandarin: 表示目的或動機，書面或古典寫法可為「為着／為着」，口語常用「為咗」(wai6 zo2)。
explanation_english: Marks purpose or motive ("for the sake of", "in order to"). The colloquial Cantonese form is "為咗" (wai6 zo2); written classical forms include 為着/為著.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咗搵多啲錢，每日做十二個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 zo2 wan2 do1 di1 cin2, mui5 jat6 zou6 sap6 ji6 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我为了赚更多钱，每天工作十二个小时。
examples.english_sentence: I work twelve hours a day to earn more money.

mandarin_meaning: 为虎作伥
english_meaning: to act as an accomplice of a villain; to help a bad person prey on others
explanation_mandarin: 指替惡人充當幫兇，幫助壞人做壞事。來源於古代典故，用來形容為惡勢力出力、協助作惡的人。
explanation_english: Refers to acting as an accomplice of an evil person or helping a villain carry out harmful deeds. It describes someone who aids wrongdoing by supporting or serving the wrongdoer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫住貪官做嘢，簡直係爲虎作倀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 zyu6 taam1 gun1 zou6 je5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 wai4 fu2 zok3 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮助贪官做事，简直是在为虎作伥。
examples.english_sentence: He's helping the corrupt official — he's essentially acting as an accomplice to the villain.

mandarin_meaning: （表示）开始；变得；显得（某种状态）
english_meaning: to start to; to become; to begin to show a certain state
explanation_mandarin: 「爲起嚟」用來表示在某個情況或刺激下，某人或某事開始出現某種狀態，常接形容詞或表感情的詞。此用法較口語或地區性，部分情境下顯得偏舊式或方言色彩。
explanation_english: "爲起嚟" indicates that, in response to some circumstance or stimulus, someone or something begins to enter a certain state; it commonly precedes an adjective or an emotional descriptor. The expression is colloquial/regional and can sound somewhat old-fashioned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到呢個消息，佢為起嚟好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1, keoi5 wai6 hei2 lai4 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到这个消息，他变得很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: Upon hearing the news, he became very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到個結果，大家為起嚟有啲失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 go3 git3 gwo2, daai6 gaa1 wai6 hei2 lai4 jau5 di1 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到结果，大家有点儿失望起来。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the result, everyone felt a bit disappointed.

mandarin_meaning: 重視；以……為重要
english_meaning: to attach importance to; to regard as important
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某事物或某方面看作重要，著重於該項目或因素。
explanation_english: Indicates treating something as important or giving priority to a particular matter or factor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以安全爲重，所以要求員工遵守規定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 on1 cyun4 wai6 zung6, so2 ji5 jiu1 kau4 jyun4 gung1 zeon1 sau2 gwai1 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們以安全為重，所以要求員工遵守規定。
examples.english_sentence: We prioritize safety, so we require employees to follow the rules.

mandarin_meaning: 重視；把……視為重要（常用結構：以……為重）
english_meaning: to attach importance to; to regard as important; to prioritize
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某事物或某方面看作重要、特別重視。常見用法為「以……為重」，用於說明某一方面被優先考慮或被視為最重要。
explanation_english: Indicates regarding something as important or giving it priority. Commonly used in the pattern '以...為重' (to regard ... as important), used to state what is prioritized or valued most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司以質量為重，所以生產過程好嚴格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 zat1 loeng6 wai4 zung6, so2 ji5 saang1 caan2 gwo3 cing4 hou2 jim4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司重視質量，所以生產過程很嚴格。
examples.english_sentence: The company prioritizes quality, so the production process is very strict.

mandarin_meaning: 以……为限（限定在某范围内）
english_meaning: to limit to; to be restricted to
explanation_mandarin: 用於表示把某事或某物限定在特定範圍內，常見結構為「以……為限」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate restricting something to a specific scope; commonly appears in the structure "limited to..." or "to be restricted to...".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次活動以會員為限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 ji5 wui6 jyun4 wai6 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次活动以会员为限。
examples.english_sentence: This event is limited to members.

mandarin_meaning: 为难 (使难堪、使处于困境；感到为难、难以应付)
english_meaning: to make things difficult for someone; to put someone in an awkward or difficult position; to feel embarrassed or at a loss
explanation_mandarin: 「為難」可以指讓別人處於難堪或難以應付的情況（使為難），也可表示自己感到不便、尷尬或難以處理（覺得為難）。日常用語中既可用於他動，也可用於自動用法。
explanation_english: “為難” can mean to put someone in an awkward or difficult situation (to make things difficult for someone) or to feel embarrassed, inconvenienced, or unable to deal with something (to be at a loss). It is commonly used as a verb in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想爲難你，你講真心話啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 wai4 naan4 nei5, nei5 gong2 zan1 sam1 waa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想为难你，你就说实话吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to put you on the spot; just tell me the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣問，我都有啲爲難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 man6, ngo5 dou1 jau5 di1 wai4 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那樣問，我也有點为难。
examples.english_sentence: With the way he asked, I'm a bit put on the spot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果真係要你揀，你會唔會覺得爲難？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zan1 hai6 jiu3 nei5 gaan2, nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 wai4 naan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果真的要你选择，你会不会觉得为难？
examples.english_sentence: If you really had to choose, would you find it difficult?

mandarin_meaning: 为非作歹：干坏事、作恶、从事违法乱纪的行为。
english_meaning: To commit wrongdoing or do evil; to engage in criminal or malicious acts.
explanation_mandarin: 指做坏事、作恶或违法犯罪，用来谴责或描述有害、恶劣的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to doing evil deeds or committing illegal and immoral acts. Used to condemn or describe harmful, malicious behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班人經常爲非作歹，街坊冇安全感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 jan4 ging1 soeng4 wai4 fei1 zok3 daap6, gaai1 fong1 mou5 on1 cyun4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群人经常为非作歹，街坊没有安全感。
examples.english_sentence: Those people often commit wrongdoing, so the neighborhood feels unsafe.

mandarin_meaning: 愛吃、貪吃；（口語）對食物有強烈興趣的人，或形容為了食物/利益而實際、務實的人。
english_meaning: food-loving; gluttonous; a foodie (Cantonese slang). Can also imply being opportunistic or practical about food or gain.
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，通常用來形容喜歡吃、貪吃的人，也可用來形容為了食物或利益而較為務實、精明的人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term describing someone who loves to eat or is gluttonous. It can also be used more broadly to describe someone who is opportunistic or practical when it comes to food or gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好為食，成日四圍搵嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 wai6 sik6, sing4 jat6 sei3 wai4 wan2 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很愛吃，整天到處找東西吃。
examples.english_sentence: He/She really loves to eat and is always looking for something to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 吃貨／貪吃的人
english_meaning: a foodie/glutton; someone who loves to eat or is greedy for food
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，用來形容非常愛吃或貪吃、見到食物就特別積極的人。語氣可輕鬆或略帶貶意，視語境而定。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing someone who loves to eat or is greedy for food — often used playfully but can be mildly derogatory depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個為食貓，見到免費嘅嘢就即刻衝埋嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 wai6 sik6 maau1, gin3 dou2 min5 fai3 ge3 je5 zau6 zik1 hak1 cung1 maai4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個吃貨，一看到免費的東西就立刻衝過來。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a foodie — whenever he sees free food he rushes over immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 貪吃鬼 / 吃貨
english_meaning: glutton; foodie (someone who loves or is greedy for food)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指特別喜愛吃或貪吃的人，語氣多為戲謔或親切的稱呼，視語境可偏中性或稍帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who loves to eat or is greedy about food. Often used playfully or teasingly; context determines if it's neutral or mildly pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係個為食鬼，一見到好嘢就忍唔住要食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 go3 wai6 sik6 gwai2, jat1 gin3 dou3 hou2 je5 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 jiu3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是個貪吃鬼，一看到好吃的就忍不住要吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's always such a glutton; as soon as he sees good food he can't resist eating it.

mandarin_meaning: 以……為首；領導、帶頭
english_meaning: to be headed by; to lead; to take the lead
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某群體在一個行動或事件中擔任領導或帶頭角色，常用於『以X為首』的結構中。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person or group is taking the lead or heading an action or event; often used in the structure 'headed by X' or 'led by X'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次示威以學生為首，吸引咗好多市民參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 si6 wai1 ji5 hok6 saang1 wai4 sau2, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 si5 man4 caam1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次示威以學生為首，吸引了很多市民参与。
examples.english_sentence: This protest was led by students and attracted many citizens to participate.

mandarin_meaning: 爵（jué）：贵族的爵位；古代盛酒的器具。
english_meaning: jue (ancient wine vessel); noble rank or title (peerage); appears in compounds like 'jazz' (爵士).
explanation_mandarin: 「爵」原指古代用来盛酒的器具（爵），也指封爵、爵位等贵族头衔。现代汉语中常见于「爵位」「爵士」「爵士乐」等词，其中「爵士乐」指爵士音乐。
explanation_english: The character '爵' originally referred to an ancient wine vessel (a jue) and also denotes a noble rank or title. In modern usage it appears in compounds such as '爵位' (noble title), '爵士' (knight or 'Sir', and also used in transliteration of 'jazz'), and '爵士樂' (jazz music).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得到爵位，成為貴族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 dou3 zoek6 wai6, sing4 wai4 gwai3 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她得到了爵位，成为贵族。
examples.english_sentence: She received a noble title and became a member of the nobility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意聽爵士樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 zoek6 si6 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢听爵士乐。
examples.english_sentence: I really like listening to jazz.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代用爵嚟盛酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jung6 zoek6 lai4 sing4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代用爵来盛酒。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, a jue (a type of goblet) was used to hold wine.

mandarin_meaning: 爵位（juéwèi）— 贵族或封建体制中的头衔或等级
english_meaning: noble title; rank of nobility; peerage
explanation_mandarin: 指封建或貴族體系中授予或世襲的稱號與等級，如公爵、侯爵等，表示社會地位和權力。
explanation_english: A title or rank within a feudal or aristocratic system (e.g., duke, marquis), often hereditary or conferred, indicating social status and authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢繼承咗佢祖父嘅爵位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gai3 sing4 zo2 keoi5 zou2 fu6 ge3 zoek6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他继承了他祖父的爵位。
examples.english_sentence: He inherited his grandfather's noble title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代，爵位通常代表權力同地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6, zoek6 wai6 tung1 soeng4 doi6 biu2 kyun4 lik6 tung4 dei6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代，爵位通常代表權力和地位。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, a noble title typically represented power and status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多國家已經廢除咗爵位制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 ji5 ging1 fai3 ceoi4 zo2 zoek6 wai6 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多國家已經廢除了爵位制度。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many countries have abolished the system of noble titles.

mandarin_meaning: 爵士（通常指爵士樂，也可指被授予的爵位或爵士稱號）
english_meaning: jazz (music); a knight/'Sir' (honorary title)
explanation_mandarin: 「爵士」主要用來指一種音樂類型——爵士樂（jazz），也可指西方授予的爵位或榮譽稱號（相當於「騎士/Sir」）。在口語中常見於「爵士樂」、「爵士樂手」等詞組。
explanation_english: Primarily refers to the musical genre jazz (often seen in compounds like '爵士樂' = jazz music). It can also mean a noble title or knight ('Sir') when referring to an honorific.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意聽爵士樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 teng1 zoek6 si6 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢听爵士乐。
examples.english_sentence: I like listening to jazz.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個出名嘅爵士樂手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 ceot1 ming4 ge3 zoek6 si6 ngok6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位著名的爵士乐手。
examples.english_sentence: He is a famous jazz musician.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被封為爵士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 fung1 wai4 zoek6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被封为爵士。
examples.english_sentence: He was knighted (given the title 'Sir').

mandarin_meaning: 爵士乐（音乐风格）
english_meaning: jazz (music genre)
explanation_mandarin: 一种起源于美国的音乐流派，强调即兴演奏、蓝调元素和复杂节奏感，常见乐器包括萨克斯风、钢琴和鼓组。
explanation_english: A music genre originating in the United States that emphasizes improvisation, blues elements, and complex rhythms; common instruments include saxophone, piano, and drum kit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意聽爵士樂，特別係薩克斯風嘅獨奏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 teng1 zoek6 si6 ngok6, dak6 bit6 hai6 saat3 hak1 si1 fung1 ge3 duk6 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢听爵士乐，特别是萨克斯风的独奏。
examples.english_sentence: I like listening to jazz, especially saxophone solos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間酒吧今晚有爵士樂現場表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 zau2 baa1 gam1 maan5 jau5 zoek6 si6 ngok6 jin6 coeng4 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家酒吧今晚有爵士乐现场表演。
examples.english_sentence: That bar has a live jazz performance tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 爵位和俸祿（官員或貴族的職位與俸給）
english_meaning: noble rank and emolument; rank and salary associated with a title
explanation_mandarin: 「爵祿」為文言用語，指爵位與俸祿，常用以描述官員或貴族所享有的地位與薪祿，亦可泛指為名利或官職的報酬。
explanation_english: A classical/literary term referring to rank (title) and emolument (salary); denotes the position and the stipend enjoyed by officials or nobility, and can be used more generally for rewards of status and pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代嘅官員為爵祿爭奪勢力同地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 ge3 gun1 jyun4 wai4 joek6 luk6 zeng1 dyut3 sai3 lik6 tung4 dei6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代的官员为爵禄争夺势力和地位。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, officials vied for noble rank and emoluments to gain power and status.

mandarin_meaning: 父，父亲（多用于书面语或构词）
english_meaning: father (formal/literary; used in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示父亲，常用於書面語或構詞，如「父親」「父母」「父愛」。在口語中常用「爸爸」「阿爸」等稱呼。
explanation_english: Denotes 'father'. Often used in written or formal contexts and in compounds (e.g., 父親, 父母, 父愛). In everyday speech Cantonese speakers more commonly use terms like 爸爸 or 阿爸.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅父親好嚴格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fu6 can1 hou2 jim4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的父亲很严格。
examples.english_sentence: His father is very strict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母應該支持子女嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 jing1 goi1 zi1 ci4 zi2 neoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母应该支持子女的决定。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should support their children's decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父愛無言，佢一直默默付出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 oi3 mou4 jin4, keoi5 jat1 zik6 mak6 mak6 fu6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父爱无言，他一直默默付出。
examples.english_sentence: A father's love is unspoken; he has been giving quietly.

mandarin_meaning: 父债子还（字面：父亲的债由子女偿还；引申为父母的过失或债务由子女承担）
english_meaning: Literally 'the father's debt is repaid by the son' — the idea that children inherit or bear the debts or consequences of their parents' actions.
explanation_mandarin: 表示父親所欠的債務或犯下的錯誤由子女承擔或償還；常用來批評把子女牽累為父母行為後果的做法或觀念。
explanation_english: States that a father's debts or wrongdoings are borne or repaid by his children; often used to criticize the notion or practice of making children suffer the consequences of their parents' actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會唔應該容許「父債子還」，子女唔應該為父母嘅錯承擔責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 m4 jing1 goi1 jung4 heoi2 «fu6 zaai3 zi2 waan4», zi2 neoi5 m4 jing1 goi1 wai6 fu6 mou5 ge3 co3 sing4 daam1 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會不應該容許「父債子還」，子女不應該為父母的錯誤承擔責任。
examples.english_sentence: Society should not allow 'children to repay the father's debts'; children should not be made to bear responsibility for their parents' mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 指父親那一輩的人；泛指年紀較大且思想較保守或難以接納新事物的長輩，口語常帶貶義。
english_meaning: Refers to people of one's parents' generation; generally older, conservative elders—often used colloquially with a derogatory tone (similar to 'old fogeys').
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，常用來描述比自己年長（尤其是父母那一代）且較保守、不易接受新觀念的人，有時帶有輕蔑或戲謔意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial term used to describe people older than oneself (particularly one's parents' generation) who are perceived as conservative and resistant to new ideas; often carries a mildly derogatory or joking tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲父執輩成日話我哋唔識事，對新嘢又唔接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fu6 zaap1 bui3 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 dei6 m4 sik1 si6, deoi3 san1 je5 jau6 m4 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些父執輩老是說我們不懂事，對新事物也不接受。
examples.english_sentence: Those 'fu6 zaap1 bui3' always say we don't know how to behave and won't accept new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，'父執輩'有時帶貶意，尤其用嚟形容思想保守嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, 'fu6 zaap1 bui3' jau5 si4 daai3 bin2 ji3, jau6 kei4 jung6 lai4 jing4 jung4 si1 soeng2 bou2 sau2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，「父執輩」有時帶有貶義，尤其用來形容思想保守的人。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, '父執輩' sometimes carries a negative connotation, especially when used to describe people with conservative views.

mandarin_meaning: 父子（fùzǐ）：父亲和儿子的关系或一对父亲与儿子
english_meaning: father and son; a father-and-son relationship or pair
explanation_mandarin: 表示父親與兒子之間的親屬關係，或用來指一對父親與兒子。古漢語中“子”有時泛指子女，但現代用法多指兒子。
explanation_english: Refers to the familial relationship between a father and his son, or to a father-and-son pair. In historical usage '子' could mean children generally, but in modern usage it usually means son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰對父子喺公園散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 deoi3 fu6 zi2 hai2 gung1 jyun4 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那對父子在公園散步。
examples.english_sentence: That father and son are taking a walk in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係父子關係，感情好親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 fu6 zi2 gwaan1 hai6, gam2 cing4 hou2 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是父子关系，感情很亲密。
examples.english_sentence: They are father and son, and their relationship is very close.

mandarin_meaning: 粗口髒話，類似英文「fuck」的髒話，常見於網路文字用法以避開審查或作為諧音替代。
english_meaning: A vulgar expletive used as a written slang, roughly equivalent to the English word "fuck"; often used online as a euphemistic or censored form.
explanation_mandarin: 「父幹」是網路或口語中用來表達憤怒或詛咒的粗俗用語，屬於諧音或文字替代，用以避免直接使用更明顯的髒話或審查。
explanation_english: "父幹" is a vulgar slang term used to express anger or insult. It functions as a written/spoken expletive and is often used as a euphemistic or censored substitute for stronger profanity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再講父幹啦，咁粗口唔好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 fu6 gon3 laa1, gam2 cou1 hau2 m4 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再说「父幹」了，这么粗口不好听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say "父幹" anymore; such coarse language sounds bad.

mandarin_meaning: 父爱；父亲对孩子的爱
english_meaning: paternal love; fatherly love
explanation_mandarin: 指父親對子女的關愛與情感，常表現為保護、照顧和責任感。
explanation_english: Refers to a father's love for his children, often expressed through protection, care, and a sense of responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔擅長講甜言蜜語，但佢嘅父愛好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 sin6 coeng4 gong2 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5, daan6 keoi5 ge3 fu6 oi3 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不擅长说甜言蜜语，但他的父爱很深。
examples.english_sentence: He isn't good at saying sweet things, but his fatherly love is deep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爸爸總係默默照顧我，呢啲就係父愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa4 baa1 zung2 hai6 mak6 mak6 ziu3 gu3 ngo5, ni1 di1 zau6 hai6 fu6 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸总是默默照顾我，这就是父爱。
examples.english_sentence: Dad always looks after me quietly; this is fatherly love.

mandarin_meaning: 父权；父权制/父权主义（社会中以父亲或男性为中心的权力结构）
english_meaning: patriarchy; paternal authority; patriarchal system
explanation_mandarin: 指以父親或男性為核心的權力結構或社會制度，男性在家庭、政治、經濟等領域佔主導地位，擁有較多權力與資源。
explanation_english: A social system or ideology in which fathers or men hold primary power and dominate in roles of political leadership, moral authority, social privilege, and control of property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父權喺好多文化同制度入面都好根深蒂固。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 kyun4 hai2 hou2 do1 man4 faa3 tung4 zai3 dou6 jap6 min6 dou1 hou2 gan1 sam1 dai6 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父权在很多文化和制度中都非常根深蒂固。
examples.english_sentence: Patriarchy is deeply entrenched in many cultures and institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲公司決策通常由男性主導，顯示出父權嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gung1 si1 kyut3 caak3 tung1 soeng4 jau4 naam4 sing3 zyu2 dou6, hin2 si6 ceot1 fu6 kyun4 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司决策通常由男性主导，显示出父权的影响。
examples.english_sentence: Company decisions are typically led by men, showing the influence of patriarchy.

mandarin_meaning: 父母 / 雙親
english_meaning: parents
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的父親和母親，泛指雙親或監護人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's father and mother; generally denotes one's parents or guardians.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同父母住喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 fu6 mou5 zyu6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跟父母住在香港。
examples.english_sentence: I live with my parents in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 官員（古代指地方官，亦有父母般關懷百姓之意）
english_meaning: official; magistrate (literally 'parent-official' — an official who treats the people like his children; can be honorific or ironic)
explanation_mandarin: 「父母官」為傳統用語，原指地方官員，強調官員應像父母一樣關懷庶民；現代用法可為尊稱或帶諷刺意味，用以指稱政府或官員的職責與操守。
explanation_english: Originally a classical term for local officials who were expected to look after the people like parents. In modern usage it can be an honorific or used ironically to refer to government officials and their duty to care for citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該做番父母官，多啲關心市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 zou6 faan1 fu6 mou5 gwaan1, do1 di1 gwaan1 sam1 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該扮演父母官，多關心市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government should act like a parent to the people and pay more attention to citizens.

mandarin_meaning: 父母雙雙去世；雙親已故
english_meaning: Both parents have died; orphaned (lost both parents)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人的父親和母親都已去世，指該人失去雙親。
explanation_english: Indicates that a person's father and mother have both died; the person has lost both parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個時父母雙亡，由阿婆帶大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 si4 fu6 mou5 soeng1 mong4, jau4 aa3 po4 daai3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候父母雙亡，由阿婆帶大。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young his parents both died, and he was raised by his grandmother.

mandarin_meaning: 父系（fùxì）：以父親一方為主的血緣或繼承關係
english_meaning: patrilineal; paternal lineage (relating to the father's line of descent or inheritance)
explanation_mandarin: 指以父親一方的血緣、家族或繼承為主的系統或關係，例如父系血統或父系繼承。
explanation_english: Refers to a system or relationship based on the father's side—family descent, lineage, or inheritance traced through the male line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺我哋嘅家族入面，財產係由父系繼承。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gaa1 zuk6 jap6 min6, coi4 caan2 hai6 jau4 fu6 hai6 gai3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在我們家族裡，財產是由父系繼承的。
examples.english_sentence: In our family, property is inherited through the paternal line.

mandarin_meaning: 依靠父親的影響力或蔭庇而得到的好處；靠父輩的關係得益（常含貶義，指不是憑自己能力）
english_meaning: protection, patronage, or advantage obtained through one's father's influence or position; benefiting from a father's connections (often with a negative connotation: nepotism)
explanation_mandarin: 指依靠父親的權勢、名望或關係而獲得的利益、照顧或優待，常用來批評倚靠家世而非自身能力的人。
explanation_english: Refers to advantages, protection, or preferential treatment received because of one's father's influence, reputation, or connections; often used critically to describe benefiting from family ties rather than personal merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰份工，大家都話係靠父蔭上嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 fan6 gung1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 hai6 kao3 fu6 jam3 soeng5 loi4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都說他的那份工作是靠父蔭得來的。
examples.english_sentence: People say his job was obtained through his father's influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊時，做官好多人係靠父蔭上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 si4, zou6 gun1 hou2 do1 jan4 hai6 kao3 fu6 jam3 soeng5 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在舊時，很多人升官是靠父蔭的。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, many people attained official positions through their father's patronage.

mandarin_meaning: 父亲 (fùqīn)
english_meaning: father; dad; male parent
explanation_mandarin: 指男性的父母親之一，通常指生父或養父，是家庭中的稱謂之一，語體較正式。
explanation_english: Refers to a male parent—usually a biological or adoptive father. The term is more formal in usage than colloquial alternatives like "dad."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同父親一齊去釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 fu6 can1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 diu3 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和父亲一起去钓鱼。
examples.english_sentence: I went fishing with my father.

mandarin_meaning: 父亲节
english_meaning: Father's Day
explanation_mandarin: 父親節是紀念父親並向父親表達感謝和敬意的節日，通常在每年六月的第三個星期日慶祝。
explanation_english: Father's Day is a holiday to honor fathers and express gratitude and respect, usually celebrated on the third Sunday of June each year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個星期日係父親節，我打算同爸爸出去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 hai6 fu6 can1 zit3, ngo5 daa2 syun3 tung4 baa4 baa1 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个星期日是父亲节，我打算和爸爸出去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Next Sunday is Father's Day; I plan to go out to eat with my dad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你準備咗父親節禮物未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeon2 bei6 zo2 fu6 can1 zit3 lai5 mat6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你准备好父亲节礼物了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you prepared a Father's Day gift?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父親節通常係六月嘅第三個星期日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 can1 zit3 tung1 soeng4 hai6 luk6 jyut6 ge3 dai6 saam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父亲节通常是在六月份的第三个星期日。
examples.english_sentence: Father's Day usually falls on the third Sunday of June.

mandarin_meaning: 爸 / 父親
english_meaning: dad; father
explanation_mandarin: 「爸」表示父親，為口語常用的稱呼。常與「阿」或重疊成「阿爸」「爸爸」等稱呼，也可單獨使用「我爸」、「你爸」。
explanation_english: Means father or dad. A common spoken form used in everyday Cantonese; appears alone (e.g. '我爸') or in forms like '阿爸' and '爸爸'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爸今日唔舒服，冇出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 baa4 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, mou5 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸今天不舒服，沒有出門。
examples.english_sentence: My dad isn't feeling well today and didn't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以問下你爸借部車？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 man6 haa5 nei5 baa4 ze3 bou6 ce1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以問你爸爸借一輛車嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you ask your dad to lend you a car?

mandarin_meaning: 爸爸（非正式、潮語）
english_meaning: dad; daddy (informal, slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「爸B」是香港粵語的非正式用法，把中文「爸」與英文字母「B」結合，常見於口語或社交媒體上，作為對父親的親暱或潮語稱呼。
explanation_english: '爸B' is Hong Kong Cantonese slang that combines the Chinese character '爸' with the English letter 'B'. It is an informal, trendy way to refer to one's dad, often used in speech and on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺社交媒體成日叫老豆做「爸B」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 seng4 jat6 giu3 lou5 dau6 zou6 baa1 bi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在社交媒體上常常叫他爸爸「爸B」。
examples.english_sentence: He often calls his dad '爸B' on social media.

mandarin_meaning: 爸爸（俚語、口語）
english_meaning: dad; daddy (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「爸打」是香港粵語的俚語，用作稱呼父親，源自對英語“papa/pa”的音譯或戲稱，語氣較口語、隨意或帶幽默。
explanation_english: “爸打” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to address or refer to one's father. It is a colloquial/transliterated form (from English 'papa/pa'), often used casually or playfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚返唔到屋企，爸打會擔心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1maan5 faan1 m4 dou3 uk1 kei2, baa4 daa2 wui5 daam1sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚回不了家，爸爸會擔心的。
examples.english_sentence: I can't get home tonight; Dad will be worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路見到爸打就跑過去喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 gin3 dou3 baa4 daa2 zau6 paau2 gwo3 heoi3 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩看到爸爸就跑過去哭。
examples.english_sentence: The kids saw Dad and ran over to cry.

mandarin_meaning: 爸爸 (父親；爸)
english_meaning: dad; father
explanation_mandarin: 用來稱呼或指稱自己的男性父親，屬口語常用詞。與較書面的「父親」同義，口語或俚語還有「阿爸」、「老豆」等。
explanation_english: Refers to one's father; a common spoken term for the male parent. It is informal compared with the more formal 'father' and has colloquial variants like 'aa ba' or 'lou5 dau6' (老豆).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爸爸今日冇返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa4 baa1 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸今天沒有回家。
examples.english_sentence: Dad didn't come home today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同爸爸去行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 baa4 baa1 heoi3 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和爸爸去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going shopping with my dad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爸爸教我點樣寫字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa4 baa1 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 se2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸教我怎麼寫字。
examples.english_sentence: Dad taught me how to write characters.

mandarin_meaning: 父親；爸爸
english_meaning: dad; father
explanation_mandarin: 「爹」在粵語中用來稱呼或指代父親，常見口語或俗稱（如「阿爹」）。
explanation_english: Used in Cantonese to refer to one's father; a familiar or colloquial form of address (often seen as "阿爹").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爹今日冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 de1 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸今天沒有上班。
examples.english_sentence: My dad didn't go to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意同佢阿爹傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 aa3 de1 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡和他爸爸聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He likes chatting with his dad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爹，你食咗飯未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 de1, nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸，你吃飯了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Dad, have you eaten yet?

mandarin_meaning: （俚語/音譯）deli、熟食店（小型西式熟食販賣店）
english_meaning: (slang/loanword) deli; small delicatessen or prepared-food shop
explanation_mandarin: 「爹利」為廣東話口語中對英文「deli」的音譯用法，常用來指小型的西式熟食店或販售三明治、沙拉等即食食品的店舖。屬非正式用語，主要見於香港口語場合，使用上帶有俚語或隨意語感。
explanation_english: “爹利” is a Cantonese colloquial phonetic rendering of the English word “deli.” It typically refers to a small Western-style delicatessen that sells sandwiches, salads and ready-to-eat foods. This is informal/slang usage, mainly found in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋午餐去爹利買三明治啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ng5 caan1 heoi3 de1 lei6 maai5 saam1 ming4 zi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们午餐去deli买三明治吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the deli to buy sandwiches for lunch.

mandarin_meaning: 爸爸；父親
english_meaning: dad; father
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用詞，指爸爸或父親，帶有親暱或生活化的色彩，常見於香港或廣東地區的口語中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for 'father' or 'dad', used informally and often heard in Hong Kong or other Cantonese-speaking areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爹哋今日唔喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 de1 dei6 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爸爸今天不在家。
examples.english_sentence: My dad isn't at home today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，爹哋教我點樣釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, de1 dei6 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 diu3 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候，爸爸教我怎樣釣魚。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my dad taught me how to fish.

mandarin_meaning: 爸爸；爹地（爱称）
english_meaning: daddy; dad (affectionate, childish)
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中对父亲的爱称或昵称，常用于小孩或親密、玩笑的称呼。此詞有时也寫作「爹地」「爹哋」。
explanation_english: An affectionate, colloquial Cantonese term for father (daddy). Often used by young children or as a playful/intimate form of address. Sometimes written as 爹地 or 爹哋.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喊住話：「爹啲，我要抱抱！」
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 haam3 zyu6 waa6: "de1 di1, ngo5 jiu3 bou2 bou2!"
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子哭着说：“爸爸，我要抱抱！”
examples.english_sentence: The child cried, "Daddy, I want a hug!"

mandarin_meaning: 爸爸；父親（口語、愛稱）
english_meaning: daddy; dad (informal, affectionate)
explanation_mandarin: 「爹地」源自英語 'daddy' 的借用，常用作對父親的親暱稱呼，通常出現在兒童語或親密場合，也可作為愛稱或嬉笑調侃的用法。
explanation_english: “爹地” is a Cantonese borrowing of the English 'daddy'. It's an informal, affectionate term for father often used by children or in intimate contexts. It can also be used playfully or as a pet name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爹地，我要飲牛奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: de1 di6, ngo5 jiu3 jam2 ngau4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸，我要喝牛奶。
examples.english_sentence: Daddy, I want to drink milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你，爹地，今日接我返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5, de1 di6, gam1 jat6 zip3 ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 謝謝你，爸爸，今天接我回家。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks, Dad, for picking me up today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個成日叫佢爹地，好親熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 giu3 keoi5 de1 di6, hou2 can1 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小時候經常叫他「爹地」，很親暱。
examples.english_sentence: When he was little he always called him 'daddy'—very affectionate.

mandarin_meaning: （父系）祖父；對年長男子的稱呼；俚語中可作自稱或稱呼對方為“大佬/老大”
english_meaning: grandfather (paternal); a form of address for an older man; in slang, used to boast or call someone a 'big shot'/boss
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（也可做稱呼/俚語用）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (also a form of address / slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，「爺」常指父系的祖父（如「阿爺」）；同時可用作對年長男子的稱呼。作俚語時可用來自稱或貶稱他人為“大佬/老大”，帶有驕傲或戲謔語氣。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '爺' (je4) commonly refers to a (paternal) grandfather (e.g. 'ah je'). It can also be an address for an older man. In slang use it may be used to boast or to call someone a 'big shot' or boss, often with an arrogant or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺今日去市場買菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 gam1 jat6 heoi3 si5 coeng4 maai5 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的阿爺今天去市場買菜。
examples.english_sentence: My grandpa went to the market to buy vegetables today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為你係爺咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai6 nei5 hai6 je4 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以為你是大佬/老大嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think you're some big shot?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史劇入面，僕人會叫主人做「老爺」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 kek6 jap6 min6, bok3 jan4 wui5 giu3 zyu2 jan4 zou6 「lou5 je4」。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在歷史劇中，僕人會稱主人為「老爺」。
examples.english_sentence: In period dramas, servants address their masters as 'laoye' (sir).

mandarin_meaning: 爷爷（父方的祖父）
english_meaning: grandfather (paternal)
explanation_mandarin: 用于稱呼父親的父親，即父系的祖父。在廣東話日常會話中常用作家庭稱謂。
explanation_english: Used to address or refer to one's father's father (paternal grandfather). A common kinship term in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅爺爺住喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 je4 je5 zyu6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的爷爷住在香港。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather lives in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 爻（yáo）：易經卦爻，表示陰陽兩種爻線及其爻辭；古義亦可指交錯的線條，現代較少單獨使用。
english_meaning: Yao: a line of a hexagram in the I Ching (either yin or yang), including its associated yao text and symbolism; historically can mean crossing lines. Rarely used alone in modern speech.
explanation_mandarin: 爻主要指《易經》中構成卦的基本要素（陰爻或陽爻）及其對應的爻辭、爻象。此字在古文中也可表示交錯的線條，一般屬於書面或專業術語。
explanation_english: The character denotes a line in the I Ching's hexagrams (yin or yang), along with its related yao text and symbolism. It can also historically mean crossing lines; usage today is mostly literary or specialized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 《易經》入面每一爻都有爻辭，用嚟解釋個卦嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ging1 jap6 min6 mui5 jat1 ngaau4 dou1 jau5 ngaau4 ci4, jung6 lai4 gaai2 sik1 go3 gwaa3 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 《易经》里面每一爻都有爻辞，用来解释该卦的意思。
examples.english_sentence: In the I Ching, each yao has a yao text used to explain the meaning of the hexagram.

mandarin_meaning: 爽 (shuǎng)：舒服、痛快、爽快；（口語）使人滿足
english_meaning: pleasant; refreshing; comfortable;爽快 (straightforward); (colloquial) to feel satisfied
explanation_mandarin: 表示感覺舒服、痛快或爽快，也可指言行直爽。口語中有時作動詞，表示讓人滿足或舒服。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of comfort, refreshment, or being pleased; can describe someone who is frank/straightforward. Colloquially used as a verb to indicate being satisfied or made to feel good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞓咗個好覺，好爽呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan3 zo2 go3 hou2 gaau3, hou2 song2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡了一個好覺，真舒服啊！
examples.english_sentence: Slept really well — it feels great!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得好爽，唔會拖泥帶水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 hou2 song2, m4 wui5 to1 nei4 daai3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说得很爽快，不会拖泥带水。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very directly; he doesn't beat around the bush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲咗杯冰涼嘅綠茶，好爽！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 zo2 bui1 bing1 loeng4 ge3 luk6 caa4, hou2 song2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝了一杯冰涼的綠茶，真爽！
examples.english_sentence: Had a cold green tea — so refreshing!

mandarin_meaning: 爽快、利落
english_meaning: brisk, decisive, straightforward; neat and efficient
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話用詞，形容人或言行爽快、乾脆、利落，不拖泥帶水。
explanation_english: A Cantonese adjective describing a person or action that is brisk, decisive, and neat — straightforward and without unnecessary hesitation or fuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好爽利，唔會拐彎抹角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 soeng2 lei6, m4 wui5 gwaai2 waan1 mut6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很爽快，不會拐彎抹角。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very directly and doesn't beat around the bush.

mandarin_meaning: （形容食物）清爽、不油膩，吃起來令人舒服；也可指口感爽快
english_meaning: describes food that is refreshing/light on the palate; pleasant to eat (not greasy)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容食物口感清爽、不油膩、容易入口，讓人覺得舒服，有時也用於飲料或水果等口味清新的食物。
explanation_english: Used to describe food (or drinks) that feels light and refreshing in the mouth, not greasy, and generally pleasant to eat or drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個沙律好爽口，夏天食最啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saa1 leot6 hou2 song2 hau2, haa6 tin1 sik6 zeoi3 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个沙拉很爽口，夏天吃最合适。
examples.english_sentence: This salad is very refreshing; it's perfect to eat in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支青檸梳打飲落爽口，唔會太甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 ceng1 ning4 so1 daa2 jam2 lok6 song2 hau2, m4 wui5 taai3 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯青柠苏打喝起来很爽口，不会太甜。
examples.english_sentence: This lime soda tastes refreshing and isn't too sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 爽快（shuǎngkuài）：性格直爽、爽朗，或事情令人感到舒畅、痛快
english_meaning: refreshing; straightforward; frank; pleasantly relieved or hearty
explanation_mandarin: 形容人性格直爽、爽朗或做事利落；也可形容某件事或感受讓人覺得舒暢、痛快。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is frank and straightforward or an action/feeling that is refreshing, pleasant, and satisfying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢人好爽快，講嘢直來直往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan4 hou2 song2 faai3, gong2 je5 zik6 loi4 zik6 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很爽快，说话直来直往。
examples.english_sentence: He is very straightforward and speaks bluntly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲完一杯冰水，成個人爽快晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jam2 jyun4 jat1 bui1 bing1 seoi2, seng4 go3 jan4 song2 faai3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝完一杯冰水，整个人很爽快。
examples.english_sentence: After drinking a glass of ice water, I felt totally refreshed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好客氣，直話直說，爽快啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 haak3 hei3, zik6 waa6 zik6 syut3, song2 faai3 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要客气，直说吧，要爽快一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be polite, say it straight — be more direct.

mandarin_meaning: 手感好；用起來順手（口語）
english_meaning: feels good to the hand; comfortable or easy to use (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容物件握持或操作時手感很好、好用、順手；亦可口語化用來形容人做事手快、熟練。
explanation_english: Used to describe an object that feels good to hold or is comfortable/easy to use; colloquially can also describe a person who is quick or skilful with their hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把刀好爽手，切嘢好順手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 dou1 hou2 soeng2 sau2, cit3 je5 hou2 seon6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把刀手感很好，切东西很顺手。
examples.english_sentence: This knife feels great in the hand; it's very handy for cutting.

mandarin_meaning: 爽朗（性格開朗、率直；聲音或氣氛明朗）
english_meaning: cheerful; open and frank; bright and brisk (voice or atmosphere)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人性格開朗、爽快、率直，也可形容聲音或氣氛明亮、爽朗。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is open, cheerful, and frank; can also describe a bright, brisk voice or atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好爽朗，成日笑口常開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 soeng2 long5, sing4 jat6 siu3 hau2 soeng4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他個性爽朗，總是笑口常開。
examples.english_sentence: He is cheerful and open, always smiling.

mandarin_meaning: 爽甜（指味道清爽而帶甜味，或形容感覺令人舒服、爽快）
english_meaning: refreshingly sweet; pleasantly sweet (sweet but not cloying)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容食物或飲品的味道既有甜味又清爽、不膩；有時亦可比喻感覺舒暢、令人滿足。
explanation_english: Used to describe food or drink that is sweet yet refreshing and not cloying; can also be used metaphorically for a pleasantly satisfying feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯芒果奶昔飲落爽甜，又唔會太膩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 mong1 gwo2 naai5 sik1 jam2 lok6 soeng2 tim4, jau6 m4 wui5 taai3 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯芒果奶昔喝起来爽甜，又不会太腻。
examples.english_sentence: This mango milkshake tastes refreshingly sweet and isn't too cloying.

mandarin_meaning: 想要爽一下；渴望短暫的刺激或快感
english_meaning: an urge/craving to feel good or get a quick thrill; a short-lived desire for pleasure or excitement
explanation_mandarin: 「爽癮」是廣東話俗語，指想要獲得短暫的快感或刺激、滿足一時的欲望（例如想玩、想買、想吃、想喝等）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, '爽癮' refers to the urge to get a quick hit of pleasure or excitement — a short-lived craving to do something that makes one feel good or relieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好悶，真係有爽癮，想去唱K放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 mun6, zan1 hai6 jau5 soeng2 jan5, soeng2 heoi3 coeng3 K fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很無聊，真的想爽一下，想去唱K放鬆。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really bored today and have the urge to feel good; I want to go sing karaoke to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買嘢成日都係為咗一時爽癮，買完又唔用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 jat1 si4 soeng2 jan5, maai5 jyun4 jau6 m4 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買東西常常是為了一時的爽癮，買完又不用。
examples.english_sentence: He often buys things just to satisfy a temporary craving; after buying he doesn't use them.

mandarin_meaning: 厚臉皮／放肆／調皮（口語）
english_meaning: cheeky; impudent; mischievous; brazen (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「爽皮」為廣東話口語，通常用來形容人言行放肆、厚臉皮或調皮，有時帶玩笑意味，有時帶輕微貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang adjective describing someone who is cheeky, impudent, brazen, or mischievous. It can be used teasingly or with mild disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁爽皮，唔聽人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gam2 soeng2 pei4, m4 teng1 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是這麼厚臉皮，不聽人說話。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so cheeky; he doesn't listen to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁爽皮啦，講嘢客氣啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 soeng2 pei4 laa1, gong2 je5 haak3 hei3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要這麼厚臉皮，說話客氣一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cheeky; speak more politely.

mandarin_meaning: 直爽；率直；坦率
english_meaning: straightforward; frank; candid
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容性格或說話方式直率、不拐彎抹角，在粵語中常用來稱讚人說話直接又爽快。
explanation_english: Describes a person or manner of speaking that is direct and frank; often used in Cantonese to praise someone for being candid and straightforward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格好爽直，唔會拐彎抹角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gok3 hou2 soeng2 zik6, m4 wui5 gwaai2 waan1 mut6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格很直爽，不會拐彎抹角。
examples.english_sentence: He has a straightforward personality; he doesn't beat around the bush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意同爽直嘅人做朋友，溝通起上嚟舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tung4 soeng2 zik6 ge3 jan4 zou6 pang4 jau5, gau1 tung1 hei2 soeng5 lai4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡和直爽的人做朋友，溝通起來很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I like being friends with straightforward people; communicating with them feels easy.

mandarin_meaning: 享乐主义者；只求爽快、随性、追求即时快感的人（粤语俚语）
english_meaning: A pleasure-seeker or hedonist — someone who pursues immediate enjoyment or does things just to feel good (Cantonese slang).
explanation_mandarin: 「爽神」是粤语俚语，用来形容以追求爽快、即时享乐為主的人，行事随性、喜欢享受，语气可褒可贬，常用于评价某人只顾自己开心、不顾后果或团队感受。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who prioritizes immediate pleasure and feeling good. It describes a carefree or hedonistic person; usage can be approving or critical depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁衝動，唔理後果，真係爽神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gam2 cung1 dung6, m4 lei5 hau6 gwo2, zan1 hai6 song2 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是衝動，不顧後果，真是個爽神。
examples.english_sentence: He's always impulsive and doesn't care about the consequences — such a '爽神'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日放假，做個爽神，去按摩同打卡食好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 fong3 gaa3, zou6 go3 song2 san4, heoi3 on3 mo1 tung4 daa2 kaa1 sik6 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天放假，做個爽神，去按摩、打卡吃好東西。
examples.english_sentence: It's a day off — be a '爽神' today: get a massage, take some check-in photos and eat something delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係諗自己爽，要諗下團隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 lam2 zi6 gei2 song2, jiu3 lam2 haa5 tyun4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只想着自己爽，要想想團隊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just think about your own fun — think about the team.

mandarin_meaning: 爽约 / 失约；临时取消约定或没有按约定出现（也可说“放鸽子”）
english_meaning: to stand someone up; to break/cancel an appointment or fail to show up as agreed
explanation_mandarin: 指臨時取消約定或沒有按約定出現，使對方失望或不便。
explanation_english: To cancel an appointment or not show up as agreed, causing the other person disappointment or inconvenience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日爽約，真係唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 song2 joek3, zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常爽约，真的不可信。
examples.english_sentence: He often stands people up; really untrustworthy.

mandarin_meaning: 爽脆（形容食物口感清脆、酥脆）
english_meaning: crisp; crunchy; having a pleasantly crisp texture
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容食物口感清脆、爽口，咬落去有脆的聲音和口感，令人覺得鮮脆可口。
explanation_english: Describes a food texture that is pleasantly crisp or crunchy, often producing a snapping or crunching sound when bitten and giving a refreshing mouthfeel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蘋果好爽脆，好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ping4 gwo2 hou2 soeng2 ceoi3, hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个苹果很爽脆，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This apple is very crisp and delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包薯片炸得好爽脆，一開就停唔到口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 syu4 pin3 zaa3 dak1 hou2 soeng2 ceoi3, jat1 hoi1 zau6 ting4 m4 dou3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这包薯片炸得很爽脆，一打开就停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: These chips are fried very crisply — once you open them you can't stop eating.

mandarin_meaning: 使身體感到清爽或干爽；（口語）為身體擦拭或撲爽身粉以保持乾爽
english_meaning: to freshen up; to make the body feel cool/dry; (colloquial) to apply talcum powder or wipe the body to stay dry
explanation_mandarin: 粤語口語，常指洗澡或擦拭、撲爽身粉等令身體感覺清爽乾爽。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to freshen up (e.g., shower, wipe down, or apply talcum powder) so the body feels cool or dry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱落咗雨，返到屋企要沖涼爽身先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lok6 zo2 jyu5, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 jiu3 cung1 loeng4 song2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才被雨淋了，回到家要洗個澡清爽一下。
examples.english_sentence: I just got rained on; when I get home I'll shower and freshen up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB沖完涼記得要爽身，媽媽會幫佢抺爽身粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 BB cung1 jyun4 loeng4 gei3 dak1 jiu3 song2 san1, maa4 maa1 wui5 bong1 keoi5 mat6 song2 san1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嬰兒洗完澡記得要擦爽身（抹爽身粉），媽媽會幫他抹爽身粉。
examples.english_sentence: After the baby has a bath, remember to freshen/powder them; mom will help apply talcum powder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 踢完波我要去更衣室爽身先，會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tek3 jyun4 bo1 ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 gang1 ji1 sat1 song2 san1 sin1, wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 踢完球我要去更衣室清爽一下，會舒服一點。
examples.english_sentence: After playing football I'll go to the locker room to freshen up a bit — it'll feel nicer.

mandarin_meaning: 爽身粉（用於吸汗、保持皮膚乾爽的粉末，常指含滑石粉的嬰兒或身體用粉）
english_meaning: talcum powder / body powder / baby powder (a powder used to absorb moisture and keep the skin dry)
explanation_mandarin: 爽身粉是一種粉末，用來吸收汗水、保持皮膚乾爽並減少摩擦，常見成分包括滑石粉或玉米澱粉，常用於嬰兒及日常護理。
explanation_english: Body powder (talcum or baby powder) is a powder used to absorb sweat, keep skin dry, and reduce friction. It often contains talc or corn starch and is commonly used for babies and personal care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天咁熱，我會喺頸同腋下搽爽身粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 gam2 jit6, ngo5 wui5 hai2 geng2 tung4 ngok6 haa6 caat3 song2 san1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天這麼熱，我會在脖子和腋下擦爽身粉。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot in summer; I apply body powder on my neck and underarms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路出汗，媽媽會幫佢搽嬰兒爽身粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 ceot1 hon3, maa4 maa1 wui5 bong1 keoi5 caat3 jing1 ji4 song2 san1 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子出汗，媽媽會幫他擦嬰兒爽身粉。
examples.english_sentence: When the child sweats, the mother will put baby powder on him.

mandarin_meaning: 爾 (ěr) — 你；你們；如此、那樣（文言用法）
english_meaning: You (classical); thus/so/that way (literary)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 代詞（文言用法）；副詞/連詞（表示如此、那樣）
explanation_mandarin: 「爾」為文言字，常作第二人稱代詞（相當於現代漢語的「你／你們」），也可表示「如此、那樣」或出現在合成詞中（如「爾等」、「爾後」）。在現代口語粵語中多見於書面或文言語境。
explanation_english: The character 爾 is a classical/literary character. It is used as a second-person pronoun (you/you plural) and can also mean 'thus' or 'that way'. It appears in compounds such as 爾等 and 爾後. In modern spoken Cantonese it is mainly literary or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爾等要準時返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 dang2 jiu3 zeon2 si4 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們要準時回來。
examples.english_sentence: You (plural) must return on time.

mandarin_meaning: 尔虞我诈（互相欺骗、算计）
english_meaning: Mutual deception; a situation of mutual scheming and treachery
explanation_mandarin: 形容彼此互相欺骗、算计，常用来描述人际关系、政治或商场等充满猜忌和诡诈的局面。
explanation_english: Describes parties mutually deceiving or scheming against each other; often used for interpersonal, political, or business situations rife with suspicion and treachery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 職場入面好多人爾虞我詐，要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 coeng4 jap6 min6 hou2 do1 jan4 ji5 jyu4 ngo5 zaa3, jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 职场里有很多人尔虞我诈，要小心。
examples.english_sentence: There are many people engaged in mutual deceit in the workplace; be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 床 (床、臥具)
english_meaning: bed
explanation_mandarin: 表示供人睡覺或休息的家具，與「床」同義，為廣東話常用字形之一。
explanation_english: Refers to the piece of furniture used for sleeping or resting; a variant form of the character '床' commonly used in Cantonese contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買張新牀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zoeng1 san1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買張新床。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a new bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺牀上睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 cong4 soeng6 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常在床上看書。
examples.english_sentence: He often reads books on the bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺牀度食嘢，會整污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 cong4 dou6 sik6 je5, wui5 zing2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在床上吃東西，會弄髒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat on the bed; you'll make it dirty.

mandarin_meaning: 床底下
english_meaning: under the bed
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置，在床的下面；口語中也可用來比喻東西被藏起來或不公開。
explanation_english: Indicates the location beneath a bed; colloquially can also imply something hidden or tucked away out of sight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲玩具擺喺牀下底啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 waan2 geoi6 baai2 hai2 coeng4 haa6 dai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把你的玩具放在床底下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Put your toys under the bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把私房錢擺喺牀下底，冇人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 si1 fong4 cin2 baai2 hai2 coeng4 haa6 dai2, mou5 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把私房钱放在床底下，沒有人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He put his secret money under the bed; no one knows.

jyutping: coeng4 haa6 dai2 ceoi1 laa3 baa1
mandarin_meaning: （口語、粗俗）在床下做口交；比喻暗中進行不正當或不可告人的事情
english_meaning: Vulgar Cantonese slang literally 'blow a trumpet under the bed' — normally refers to performing oral sex (fellatio) under a bed; figuratively, to engage in secret/illicit or shameful activities
explanation_mandarin: 粵語粗俗俚語，字面為「在床下吹喇叭」。通常指在床下進行口交或其他隱秘的性行為；在更廣義上可用來形容暗中做不可告人的事情或偷情。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang phrase literally meaning 'to blow a trumpet under the bed.' It commonly denotes performing oral sex (fellatio) under a bed, and more broadly can describe clandestine, illicit, or shameful secret activities (e.g., affairs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺酒店房間偷情，仲喺牀下底吹喇叭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 zau2 dim3 fong4 gaan1 tau1 cing4, zung6 hai6 coeng4 haa6 dai2 ceoi1 laa3 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在酒店房间偷情，還在床底下做口交。
examples.english_sentence: They were having an affair in the hotel room, and even performed oral sex under the bed.

mandarin_meaning: 床底下的破柴（比喻破爛、沒價值或被忽視的東西/人）
english_meaning: literally 'broken firewood under the bed' — a Cantonese colloquialism for something or someone shabby, worthless, or neglected
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容破爛、沒價值或被忽視的人或物，帶有貶義或嘲諷意味，常用於口語。
explanation_english: Used to describe shabby, worthless, or neglected people or things; derogatory/derisive in tone and used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲舊衫擺喺抽屜入面，好似牀下底破柴咁，冇人要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gau6 saam1 baai2 hai2 cau1 dai3 jap6 min6, hou2 ci5 cong4 haa6 dai2 po3 caai4 gam2, mou5 jan4 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那些旧衣服放在抽屉里，就像床底下的破柴一样，没人要。
examples.english_sentence: His old clothes are kept in the drawer like broken firewood under the bed; nobody wants them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做牀下底破柴，出嚟爭一爭你應得嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 cong4 haa6 dai2 po3 caai4, ceot1 lai4 zang1 jat1 zang1 nei5 jing1 dak1 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做床底下的破柴，站出来争取你应得的机会。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be like broken wood under the bed; stand up and fight for the opportunities you deserve.

mandarin_meaning: 字面意思是「在床底下踢毽子」。口語用法上，為俚語或俗語，常用來形容在暗處偷懶、做無關緊要或浪費時間的事情（即悄悄地消磨時間、偷閒）。
english_meaning: Literally 'kick the shuttlecock under the bed'. Colloquially (slang) used to describe secretly idling, slacking off, or doing trivial/unimportant things to kill time.
explanation_mandarin: 這是一個粵語俗語／俚語，字面描繪在床底下玩毽子的情景。引申義多用於形容某人暗中偷懶、消磨光陰或做一些無關緊要的小動作，不做正經事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression literally describing kicking a shuttlecock under the bed. Figuratively it refers to secretly loafing around, killing time, or doing trivial/unimportant activities instead of doing proper work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日喺屋企度牀下底踢毽，唔好再偷懶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 dou6 cong4 haa6 dai2 tek3 zin3, m4 hou2 zoi3 tau1 laan5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是在家裡床底下踢毽子，別再偷懶了。
examples.english_sentence: You keep kicking the shuttlecock under the bed at home; stop slacking off.

mandarin_meaning: 床位（床铺、病床或宿位）
english_meaning: bed; bed space (e.g., hospital bed, bunk/hostel bed)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個可供人躺臥或入住的床位，常用於醫院病床數量、宿舍/旅館的床位或舖位等情況，也可指床位的可用性。
explanation_english: Refers to a bed or bed-space for sleeping or admission. Commonly used for hospital beds, dormitory/hostel beds or berths, and to talk about availability of beds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院而家好緊張，冇足夠牀位收佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 ji4 gaa1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, mou5 zuk1 gau3 cong4 wai6 sau1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫院現在很緊張，沒有足夠的床位收治他。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital is very busy right now; there aren't enough beds to admit him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 青年旅館仲有幾個牀位，想住就快啲預訂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 nin4 leoi5 gun2 zung6 jau5 gei2 go3 cong4 wai6, soeng2 zyu6 zau6 faai3 di1 jyu6 deng6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 青年旅館還有幾個床位，想住就快點預訂吧。
examples.english_sentence: The hostel still has a few beds available; if you want to stay, book soon.

mandarin_meaning: 床位寓所；按床位出租的住宿空間，指在一個單位內將床位分租給多人居住的住所
english_meaning: bedspace accommodation — lodging where individual beds or bed-spaces are rented within a subdivided unit
explanation_mandarin: 指把一個住宅單位分隔成多個床位或床位間，按床位向不同租客出租的住處。此類住宿在香港等地比較常見，通常空間狹小且須與他人共用設施。
explanation_english: Refers to accommodations where a residential unit is divided and individual beds or bed-spaces are rented to different tenants. Common in places like Hong Kong, these are often cramped and involve shared facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家住喺一間牀位寓所，要同其他人分用廚房同廁所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zyu6 hai6 jat1 gaan1 cong4 wai6 jyu6 so2, jiu3 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 fan1 jung6 cyu4 fong2 tung4 ci3 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在住在一間床位寓所，要和其他人共用廚房和廁所。
examples.english_sentence: He's living in a bedspace accommodation and has to share the kitchen and toilet with others.

mandarin_meaning: 上床睡覺
english_meaning: go to bed; get into bed; go to sleep
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語俗語，字面為「床」與「冚（蓋）」合成，指上床蓋被睡覺，常用於口語中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese slang term literally meaning 'bed' + 'cover'; it means to get into bed or go to sleep. Commonly used in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁夜仲唔瞓？快啲去牀冚啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 je6 zung6 m4 fan3? faai3 di1 heoi3 cong4 ham2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這麼晚還不睡？快點去上床睡覺吧！
examples.english_sentence: It's so late and you're still not sleeping? Go to bed quickly!

mandarin_meaning: 床单 (chuángdān)
english_meaning: bedsheet; bed sheet
explanation_mandarin: 指鋪在床墊上用來覆蓋或保護床墊、供人睡覺的布單。通常以棉、麻或混紡材質製成，需要定期清洗或更換。
explanation_english: A sheet placed over a mattress used to cover or protect the mattress and provide a surface for sleeping. Typically made of cotton, linen, or blends and should be washed or changed regularly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要換牀單，因為上面有污漬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wun6 cong4 daan1, jan1 wai6 seong6 min6 jau5 wu1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要換床單，因為上面有污漬。
examples.english_sentence: We need to change the bedsheets because there are stains on them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套牀單係純棉，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 cong4 daan1 hai6 seon4 min4, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這套床單是純棉，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This bedsheet set is pure cotton and very comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 床護欄；床欄杆（用來防止跌床的護欄）
english_meaning: bed rail; bed guard (a railing placed at the side of a bed to prevent falling)
explanation_mandarin: 指安裝在床邊用以防止嬰兒或老人從床上跌落的護欄，也可指床邊的保護或支撐裝置。
explanation_english: A railing or guard placed at the side of a bed to prevent a person (often a baby or patient) from falling out; a bedside protective/supportive device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友未識轉身，屋企人幫佢裝咗牀圍，唔使驚佢跌牀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 mei6 sik1 zyun2 san1, uk1 kei5 jan4 bong1 keoi5 zong1 zo2 cong4 wai4, m4 sai2 ging1 keoi5 dit3 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友還不會轉身，家人幫他裝了床護欄，不用怕他會從床上跌下來。
examples.english_sentence: The child can't roll over yet; the family installed a bed rail so he won't fall out of bed.

mandarin_meaning: 床墊 (chuángdiàn)
english_meaning: mattress
explanation_mandarin: 放在床上供人睡覺的軟墊，用來增加舒適度和支撐。
explanation_english: A padded cushion placed on a bed for sleeping, providing comfort and support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗張新牀墊，瞓得好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 san1 cong4 dim3, fan3 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們買了張新的床墊，睡得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a new mattress; it's very comfortable to sleep on.

mandarin_meaning: 床尾（床的末端，靠近腳的一端）
english_meaning: the foot (end) of the bed
explanation_mandarin: 指床的末端、靠近腳的一端。日常用語，多用於描述物品或人在床的哪一端位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of a bed opposite the headboard—the foot of the bed. Commonly used to describe where objects or people are located relative to the bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲衫成日擺喺牀尾，好亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 saam1 sing4 jat6 baai2 hai2 coeng4 mei5, hou2 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服經常放在床尾，很亂。
examples.english_sentence: My clothes are always left at the foot of the bed; it's very messy.

mandarin_meaning: 賴床；賴在床上不想起來
english_meaning: to stay in bed; to laze in bed; to oversleep
explanation_mandarin: 俗語用法，指賴在床上不想起來或想多休息一段時間（相當於「賴床」）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to stay in bed or laze in bed instead of getting up (equivalent to 'to laze in bed' / 'oversleep').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我唔想起身，想繼續牀憑多陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 m4 soeng2 hei2 san1, soeng2 gai3 zuk6 cong4 ping4 do1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上我不想起床，想再賴床一會兒。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I don't want to get up; I want to stay in bed a bit longer.

mandarin_meaning: 床戲
english_meaning: bed scene; sex scene
explanation_mandarin: 指電影、電視或舞台表演中描述性行為或親密接觸的鏡頭或場面。口語中亦可泛指性愛相關的場景或情節。
explanation_english: Refers to scenes in films, TV, or stage performances depicting sexual activity or intimate physical contact. Colloquially it can refer more generally to sex-related scenes or sequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影有好多牀戲，唔適合小朋友睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 jing2 jau5 hou2 do1 cong4 hei3, m4 sik1 hap6 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影有很多床戲，不適合小孩子看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie contains many sex scenes and is not suitable for children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺電影入面嘅牀戲拍得幾大膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 din6 jing2 jap6 min6 ge3 cong4 hei3 paak3 dak1 gei2 daai6 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在電影裡的床戲拍得挺大膽。
examples.english_sentence: Their bed scenes in the movie were filmed rather boldly.

mandarin_meaning: 同床、同床共枕；（口語）與他人共用一張床，成年人時常含有發生性關係或親密接觸的暗示
english_meaning: to share a bed; (colloquial) to sleep in the same bed with someone — often implies sexual or intimate contact for adults
explanation_mandarin: 「牀拼」為廣東話口語，字面是把床「拼」在一起或共用一張床。可指因空間或經濟原因而同床，也可指成年人之間有親密或發生性行為而同床，語境決定含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term literally meaning to 'join/share a bed'. It can refer to sharing a bed due to space/economic reasons, or to adults sleeping together with an implication of intimacy or sex depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日都話唔係情侶，但有時會牀拼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 m4 hai6 cing4 leoi5, daan6 jau5 si4 wui5 coeng4 ping3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个常说不是情侣，但有时会同床。
examples.english_sentence: They always say they're not a couple, but sometimes they sleep in the same bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 旅行時房間細，可能要牀拼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 hang4 si4 fong2 gaan1 sai3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 coeng4 ping3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旅行时房间小，可能需要拼床（同床）。
examples.english_sentence: When traveling and the room is small, we might have to share a bed.

mandarin_meaning: 床板（床的木板或支撐床墊的板）
english_meaning: bed board; the wooden/plank base of a bed that supports the mattress
explanation_mandarin: 指床上用以支撐床墊或承托睡覺者的板子，通常是木板或板條，屬於家具的構件之一。
explanation_english: Refers to the board or planks that form the base of a bed and support the mattress or sleeper; typically wooden components of the bed frame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要換新牀板，因為舊嘅裂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wun6 san1 cong4 baan2, jan1 wai6 gau6 ge3 lit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要換新的床板，因為舊的裂了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to replace the bed board because the old one cracked.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）床板夾到陰囊；（引申）處於很不舒服或被擠壓、尷尬的情況
english_meaning: (literal) the bedboard pinches the scrotum; (figurative) to be in an extremely uncomfortable, cramped, or awkward situation (vulgar/slang)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語俚語 / 動詞短語
explanation_mandarin: 這句廣東話俗語字面意思是床板夾住春袋（陰囊），常用作形容睡覺時身體不適、被擠壓或處於尷尬、不舒服的情況。屬於粗俗俚語，口語中有幽默或抱怨色彩。
explanation_english: This Cantonese slang phrase literally means the bedboard pinches the scrotum. It is often used to describe physical discomfort when sleeping (e.g., a hard or narrow bed) or, figuratively, an awkward, cramped, or unpleasant situation. It is vulgar and used informally, often humorously or as a complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰張床板硬到會夾春袋，瞓得好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zoeng1 cong4 baan2 ngaang6 dou3 wui5 gaap3 ceon1 doi6, fan3 dak1 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那張床板硬到會夾到陰囊，睡得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: That bedboard is so hard it might pinch your scrotum — it's really uncomfortable to sleep on.

mandarin_meaning: 剛脫離一個困境或不利處境，結果卻進入另一個同樣或更糟的困境（類似「剛出鍋又入灶」）
english_meaning: Leaving one bad situation only to land in another equally bad or worse situation (similar to 'out of the frying pan into the fire').
explanation_mandarin: 此廣東話俗語字面意為「從床板跳到席子上」，用來形容脫離一個困難或不利的處境後，結果又落入另一個同樣或更糟的境地。
explanation_english: This Cantonese colloquialism literally means 'jumping from the bedboard onto the mat.' It describes leaving one disadvantageous or difficult situation only to end up in another equally bad or worse situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗份工，以為會更好，點知係牀板跳上蓆，宜家比以前更慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, ji5wai6 wui5 gang3 hou2, dim2zi1 hai6 cong4-baan2-tiu3-soeng5-zik6, ji4gaa1 bei2 ji5cin4 gang3 caam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辭掉了那份工作，以為會更好，結果是牀板跳上蓆，現在比以前更慘。
examples.english_sentence: He quit that job thinking things would improve, but it was out of the frying pan into the fire — now he's worse off than before.

synonyms: 出鍋入火 (出鍋又入火坑)
out of the frying pan into the fire

mandarin_meaning: 床照（床上的照片，常指私密或帶有性暗示的照片）
english_meaning: Bed photo — a photo taken on a bed, often referring to intimate/private or sexually suggestive pictures (e.g., nude selfies).
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱，指在床上拍攝的照片，通常用來指私密、裸露或帶有性暗示的照片，有時會被用作敲詐或洩露個人隱私。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for photos taken on a bed; typically refers to intimate, revealing, or sexually suggestive images. Such photos are often private and can be exploited for blackmail or privacy breaches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂傳你啲牀照畀人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 cyun4 nei5 di1 cong4 ziu3 bei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要亂傳你的床照給別人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly share your bed photos with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢啲牀照被人外洩，依家好驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 di1 cong4 ziu3 bei6 jan4 ngoi6 sit3, ji1 gaa1 hou2 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說他的床照被人外洩，現在很害怕。
examples.english_sentence: They said their bed photos were leaked and now they're very scared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺網上見到好多牀照被人用嚟敲詐，大家要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 mong5 soeng6 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 cong4 ziu3 bei6 jan4 jung6 lai4 haau1 zaak6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在網上看到很多床照被人用來敲詐，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: I've seen many bed photos online being used for blackmail; everyone should be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 床笠；包覆床褥的有彈性床單或床褥套
english_meaning: fitted sheet; an elasticized bedsheet or mattress cover that wraps the mattress
explanation_mandarin: 粵語詞，指用來包覆床褥、有彈性的床單或保護套，通常有鬆緊邊以緊貼床墊，防止髒污或滲漏。
explanation_english: A Cantonese term for a fitted bedsheet or mattress cover—an elasticized sheet that wraps snugly around the mattress to protect it from dirt or spills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲牀笠破咗，要買新的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 cong4 lap1 po3 zo2, jiu3 maai5 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的床笠破了，要买新的。
examples.english_sentence: My fitted sheet is torn; I need to buy a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最好買個防水牀笠，細路仔訓尿床都唔駛擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 hou2 maai5 go3 fong4 seoi2 cong4 lap1, sai3 lou6 zai2 fan3 nou6 cong4 dou1 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最好买个防水床笠，孩子尿床也不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to get a waterproof fitted sheet so you don't have to worry if a child wets the bed.

mandarin_meaning: 床铺 (chuángpù)
english_meaning: bed; bedding; mattress
explanation_mandarin: 指用來睡覺或躺臥的家具，即床或床鋪，為廣東話常用詞彙。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of furniture used for sleeping or lying down — a bed or bedding; commonly used in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚會喺牀舖上睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 hai2 coeng4 pou3 soeng6 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我會在床上看書。
examples.english_sentence: I'll read a book on the bed tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 床虱（床上吸血的小昆蟲）
english_meaning: bedbug(s)
explanation_mandarin: 指寄居在床褥、床單等處、以人或動物血液為食的小型吸血昆蟲。常導致皮膚瘙癢和過敏反應，需清潔或滅殺處理。
explanation_english: Refers to small blood-sucking insects that live in mattresses, beddings, and similar places. They feed on human or animal blood, often causing itching and allergic reactions; cleaning or pest control is usually needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發現床褥有牀蝨，今晚要換床單同埋噴藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 jin6 cong4 juk6 jau5 cong4 sat1, gam1 maan5 jiu3 wun6 cong4 daan1 tung4 maai4 pan3 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我發現床褥有床虱，今晚要換床單並噴藥。
examples.english_sentence: I found bedbugs in the mattress; tonight I need to change the sheets and spray insecticide.

mandarin_meaning: 床褥 (chuáng rù) — 床上使用的被褥、床墊等
english_meaning: mattress; bedding; bedclothes
explanation_mandarin: 指放在床上供睡覺或休息使用的床墊、被褥等床上用品。
explanation_english: Refers to bedding items used on a bed for sleeping or resting, such as a mattress or bedclothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗新牀褥，瞓得舒服好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 san1 cong4 juk6, fan3 dak1 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他換了新的床褥，睡得舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: He changed to a new mattress/bedding and sleeps much more comfortably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋時記得清洗牀褥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 si4 gei3 dak1 cing1 sai2 cong4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家的時候記得清洗床褥。
examples.english_sentence: When moving house, remember to clean the bedding.

mandarin_meaning: 床鋪
english_meaning: bed; bedding
explanation_mandarin: 指睡覺用的床或床上的鋪蓋、床墊等。
explanation_english: Refers to a bed or the bedding (mattress, bedcovers) used for sleeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換咗新嘅牀鋪，我瞓得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 zo2 san1 ge3 coeng4 pou3, ngo5 fan3 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 換了新的床鋪，我睡得舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: I got a new bed/bedding, so I sleep much more comfortably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇整理牀鋪，房間好凌亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zing2 lei5 coeng4 pou3, fong4 gaan1 hou2 ling4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒整理床鋪，房間很凌亂。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't make the bed; the room is very messy.

mandarin_meaning: 床頭（床的一端；床旁）
english_meaning: head of the bed; bedside
explanation_mandarin: 指床的靠近頭部那一端位置，也可以泛指床旁的地方或床頭櫃。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of the bed near a person's head; can also refer to the area beside the bed or the bedside table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把張相擺咗係牀頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 zoeng1 soeng2 baai2 zo2 hai6 cong4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把照片放在床頭。
examples.english_sentence: He put the photo at the head of the bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚我成日起身望下牀頭個燈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ngo5 sing4 jat6 hei2 san1 mong6 haa5 cong4 tau4 go3 dang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上我經常起來看看床頭的燈。
examples.english_sentence: At night I often get up to check the lamp on the bedside.

jyutping: cong4 tau4 daa2 gaau1 cong4 mei5 wo4
mandarin_meaning: 床頭吵架床尾和（吵完很快和好）
english_meaning: Fight at the head of the bed, make up at the foot — quarrel but reconcile quickly (often used about couples)
explanation_mandarin: 形容夫妻或情侶雖然常為小事爭吵，但往往吵完很快就和好。
explanation_english: Describes couples (or people) who frequently quarrel over small things but soon reconcile; emphasizes quick make-ups after fights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日為小事鬧交，但最後通常都係牀頭打交牀尾和。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 wai6 siu2 si6 naau6 gaau1, daan6 zeoi3 hau6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 cong4 tau4 daa2 gaau1 cong4 mei5 wo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是为小事吵架，但最后通常都是床头吵架床尾和。
examples.english_sentence: They often argue about small things, but in the end they usually make up quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 床頭櫃（chuángtóuguì）
