mandarin_meaning: 牙垢、牙結石或卡在牙縫裡的東西
english_meaning: dental plaque/tartar or something stuck in the teeth
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指附着在牙齒上的污垢、結石或卡在牙縫裡的東西，有時也泛指需要清理的牙齒髒物。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for dirt on the teeth—plaque, tartar, or something stuck between the teeth—used when referring to material that needs cleaning out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你口入面有牙灰，要唔要我幫你剔走？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hau2 jap6 min6 jau5 ngaa4 fui1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 tik1 zau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你嘴裡有東西卡在牙縫，要不要我幫你剔掉？
examples.english_sentence: You have something stuck in your teeth—do you want me to pick it out for you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲牙灰好重，應該去洗牙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ngaa4 fui1 hou2 zung6, jing1 goi1 heoi3 sai2 ngaa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的牙垢很多，應該去洗牙了。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of tartar; he should go for a dental cleaning.

mandarin_meaning: 口臭
english_meaning: bad breath; halitosis
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，指口腔散發出難聞氣味（即口臭）。常用於口語中提醒或形容別人有不好的口氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to unpleasant mouth odor (bad breath/halitosis). Used informally to describe or warn someone about their breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有牙煙，講嘢嗰陣請記得漱口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 ngaa4 jin1, gong2 je5 go2 zan6 ceng2 gei3 dak1 seot6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有口臭，說話的時候請記得漱口。
examples.english_sentence: You have bad breath; please rinse your mouth before speaking.

mandarin_meaning: 牙龈（牙齦），包圍牙齒的軟組織
english_meaning: gums (the soft tissue surrounding the teeth)
explanation_mandarin: 指包裹並支撐牙齒的軟組織，一般稱為牙齦或牙床，若發炎會引起牙痛或牙周病。
explanation_english: Refers to the soft tissue that surrounds and supports the teeth (gums). Inflammation of the gums can cause pain or periodontal disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我牙牀腫咗，好痛，去咗牙醫睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 ngaa4 cong4 zung2 zo2, hou2 tung3, heoi3 zo2 ngaa4 ji1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我的牙龈肿了，很痛，去看了牙醫。
examples.english_sentence: My gums have been swollen recently and are very painful; I went to see the dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 刷牙要刷到牙牀位，先可以預防牙周病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caat3 ngaa4 jiu3 caat3 dou3 ngaa4 cong4 wai6, sin1 ho2 ji5 jyu6 fong4 ngaa4 zau1 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刷牙要刷到牙龈部位，才能預防牙周病。
examples.english_sentence: When brushing your teeth you should clean the gum area to prevent periodontal disease.

mandarin_meaning: 牙牙学语（开始学说话或比喻刚开始学习）
english_meaning: to babble; to begin to speak (of an infant); figuratively, to be a beginner or just starting to learn something
explanation_mandarin: 形容嬰兒開始發出含糊的語音（牙牙學語），也可比喻某人在學習的初階段、剛入門。
explanation_english: Describes an infant beginning to babble; can also be used figuratively for someone at the very beginning stage of learning or just getting started.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB而家開始牙牙學語，好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 BB ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 ngaa4 ngaa4 hok6 jyu5, hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宝宝现在开始牙牙学语，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is starting to babble—so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新入職嘅同事仲係牙牙學語，仲要多啲指導。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jap6 zik1 ge3 tung4 si6 zung6 hai6 ngaa4 ngaa4 hok6 jyu5, zung6 jiu3 do1 di1 zi2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新入职的同事还在牙牙学语，还需要多加指导。
examples.english_sentence: The new hire is still a beginner and needs more guidance.

mandarin_meaning: 牙牙学语 / 咿呀学语（指嬰兒開始發出咿呀聲，或比喻說話含糊難懂）
english_meaning: baby talk; babbling (the sounds infants make when beginning to speak; also used figuratively for unclear, unintelligible speech)
explanation_mandarin: 指嬰兒剛開始學說話時發出的咿呀聲，也可用來比喻說話含糊、難以理解或語無倫次的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the babbling sounds infants make when they begin to speak. It can also be used figuratively to describe speech that is unclear, unintelligible, or rambling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路開始牙牙語，聽落好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 hoi1 ci2 ngaa4 ngaa4 jyu5, teng1 lok6 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩開始牙牙學語，聽起來很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: The child started babbling; it sounds so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得好似牙牙語，根本聽唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 hou2 ci5 ngaa4 ngaa4 jyu5, gan1 bun2 teng1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說得像牙牙學語，根本聽不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks like he's babbling; I can't understand a thing.

mandarin_meaning: 牙疼 / 牙痛
english_meaning: toothache; pain in a tooth or teeth
explanation_mandarin: 指牙齒或牙周組織感到疼痛的不適或症狀，可能由蛀牙、牙髓炎、牙周炎或其他原因引起。
explanation_english: Refers to pain in a tooth or the surrounding tissues — a toothache. Causes can include cavities, pulpitis, gum disease, or other issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我昨晚牙痛，差啲冇訓到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zok6 maan5 ngaa4 tung3, caa1 di1 mou5 fan3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨晚牙疼，差点没睡着。
examples.english_sentence: My tooth ached last night; I almost couldn't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你牙痛，應該去睇牙醫檢查一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ngaa4 tung3, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1 gim2 caa4 jat1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你牙疼，应该去看牙医检查一下。
examples.english_sentence: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist for a check-up.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）愛抱怨、嘮叨或用哀怨的語氣說話
english_meaning: colloquial expression meaning to whine or complain in a pitiful/whiny tone
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 口語片語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容說話像牙痛般哀怨或嗚咽，表示對方很會抱怨、矯情或令人覺得煩。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone speaking in a whining, plaintive manner — literally 'sound like a toothache' — implying they are complaining, being overly dramatic, or irritating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好牙痛咁聲啦，大家都好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ngaa4 tung3 gam2 seng1 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別那麼愛抱怨／矯情，大家都很忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so whiny; everyone's busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日牙痛咁聲，真係聽到好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ngaa4 tung3 gam2 seng1, zan1 hai6 teng1 dou3 hou2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是愛抱怨，真的讓人很煩。
examples.english_sentence: He always complains; it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 裝作牙痛似的／裝可憐、裝腫作痛以博取同情
english_meaning: to pretend to have a toothache; to act pitiful or play up for sympathy
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的口語表達，字面是「牙痛那樣」，用來形容有人裝作疼痛或可憐、誇張撒嬌以博取關注或迴避責任。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning "like having a toothache." It describes pretending to be in pain or acting pitiful (often exaggerated) to get attention, sympathy, or to avoid something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話牙痛噉聲，叫媽咪幫佢請假，其實係想瞓多陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ngaa4 tung3 gam2 sing1, giu3 maa4 mi4 bong1 keoi5 ceng2 gaa3, kei4 sat6 hai6 soeng2 fan3 do1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己像牙痛似的，叫媽媽幫他請假，其實是想多睡一會兒。
examples.english_sentence: He said he had a toothache to get his mom to ask for leave for him; actually he just wanted to sleep longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好老係牙痛噉聲，自己都唔照顧身體點得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lou5 hai6 ngaa4 tung3 gam2 sing1, zi6 gei2 dou1 m4 ziu3 gu3 san1 tai2 dim2 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是裝作牙痛樣子，你自己都不照顧身體怎麼行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't always act like you have a toothache; if you don't even take care of yourself, how's that okay?

jyutping: ngaa4 tung3 caam2 gwo3 daai6 beng6
mandarin_meaning: 牙痛比重病還要難受／牙疼比大病還厲害
english_meaning: A toothache is worse than a serious illness (used to emphasize that a toothache is extremely painful or intolerable).
explanation_mandarin: 形容牙痛非常難受、痛苦得好像比得上或超過重病，常用於誇張地表達牙痛的嚴重程度。
explanation_english: An idiomatic, colloquial expression used to exaggerate how unbearable a toothache is — implying it feels worse than a serious illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙痛慘過大病，成晚訓唔着，今晚要睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 tung3 caam2 gwo3 daai6 beng6, sing4 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6, gam1 maan5 jiu3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙疼比重病還難受，整晚都睡不着，今晚要去看牙醫。
examples.english_sentence: My toothache is worse than a serious illness — I couldn't sleep all night; I need to see a dentist tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 牙石（牙结石）
english_meaning: dental calculus; tartar
explanation_mandarin: 指牙齒表面由牙菌斑經鈣化後形成的硬質沉積物，常附著在牙齦邊緣或牙齒表面，需由牙醫以專業工具清除，也稱牙結石，與牙垢、牙菌斑相關。
explanation_english: A hardened mineral deposit on teeth formed when dental plaque calcifies. It commonly adheres along the gum line or tooth surfaces and usually requires professional dental cleaning to remove. Also called dental calculus or tartar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你牙度有牙石，應該去睇牙醫清洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ngaa4 dou6 jau5 ngaa4 sek6, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1 cing1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的牙齒有牙石，應該去看牙醫清除。
examples.english_sentence: You have tartar on your teeth; you should see a dentist for cleaning.

mandarin_meaning: 牙科
english_meaning: dentistry; dental clinic
explanation_mandarin: 指与牙齿和口腔健康相关的医学科目或诊疗场所，例如牙科诊所或牙医所，负责检查、预防和治疗牙齿及口腔疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to the branch of medicine concerned with teeth and oral health, or to a dental clinic/department that provides checkups, preventive care, and treatments for dental and oral conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜要去牙科做檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 heoi3 ngaa4 fo1 zou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜要去牙科做检查。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the dental clinic for a checkup next week.

mandarin_meaning: 牙套 / 牙齒矯正器
english_meaning: braces (orthodontic braces)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來矯正牙齒排列的器具，通常由托槽、鋼絲等組成，俗稱戴牙箍或裝牙套。
explanation_english: Refers to the orthodontic appliance used to correct tooth alignment, typically consisting of brackets, wires, etc.; commonly called braces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會裝牙箍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 zong1 ngaa4 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下個月會裝牙套（戴牙箍）。
examples.english_sentence: I'm getting braces next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戴牙箍初頭會有啲痛，食嘢要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai3 ngaa4 gu1 co1 tau4 wui5 jau5 di1 tung3, sik6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 戴牙套剛開始會有點痛，吃東西要小心。
examples.english_sentence: Braces hurt at first; be careful when eating.

mandarin_meaning: 牙签 (yáqiān)
english_meaning: toothpick
explanation_mandarin: 用来剔除牙缝食物残渣的小工具，常见材质有竹、木、塑料等；也用于烹饪或固定小食材时使用。
explanation_english: A small tool used to remove food debris from between the teeth; commonly made of bamboo, wood, or plastic. Also used in cooking or to hold small food items together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯後我拎咗條牙簽剔牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 hau6 ngo5 ling1 zo2 tiu4 ngaa4 cim1 tik1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭后我拿了一根牙签剔牙。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, I took a toothpick to pick my teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有賣唔同材質嘅牙簽，好似竹同塑膠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 maai6 m4 tung4 coi4 zat1 ge3 ngaa4 cim1, hou2 ci5 zuk1 tung4 sou3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市场有卖不同材质的牙签，比如竹子和塑料。
examples.english_sentence: The market sells toothpicks of different materials, like bamboo and plastic.

mandarin_meaning: 牙签（小）；（俚语）瘦得像牙签的人
english_meaning: toothpick (diminutive); (slang) a very skinny person (like a toothpick)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指用來剔牙的小木簽，即牙签；2) 俚語用法，形容人非常瘦，像牙签一樣纖細（有時帶輕微貶義）。
explanation_english: 1) A small stick used to pick teeth (toothpick). 2) Slang usage: describes a person who is very thin, like a toothpick (sometimes slightly derogatory).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完嘢記得用牙簽仔清理下牙縫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 je5 gei3 dak1 jung6 ngaa4 cim1 zai2 cing1 lei5 haa5 ngaa4 fung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完飯記得用牙签清理牙缝。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, remember to use a toothpick to clean your teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁瘦，好似牙簽仔咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 sou3, hou2 ci5 ngaa4 cim1 zai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這麼瘦，好像牙签似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so skinny, like a toothpick.

mandarin_meaning: 牙签党
english_meaning: ‘toothpick gang’ (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俚語，字面意思是「牙簽黨」，通常戲稱那些愛挑剔小毛病、吹毛求疵或只會做表面評論、不提供建設性意見的人。屬於非正式且帶有貶義的用法。
explanation_english: Hong Kong colloquial/slang term literally meaning 'toothpick gang.' It's a jocular or derogatory label for people who habitually nitpick minor faults or offer unconstructive criticism. Informal usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做牙簽黨，成日喺人背後挑剔無益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 ngaa4 cim1 dong2, sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 tiu1 tik1 mou4 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當牙簽黨，總是在別人背後挑剔沒好處。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a 'toothpick gang'—constantly nitpicking behind others' backs does no good.

mandarin_meaning: 牙签 (yáqiān)
english_meaning: toothpick
explanation_mandarin: 一種用來剔除牙縫中食物殘渣的小棒，常由木頭或塑料製成。在日常生活與餐桌上常見。
explanation_english: A small stick, usually made of wood or plastic, used to remove food debris from between the teeth. Commonly found at the table or used after eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食完飯，要攞牙籤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 faan6, jiu3 lo2 ngaa4 cim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃完饭，要拿牙签。
examples.english_sentence: I need a toothpick after eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用牙籤掏得太深，會傷到牙齦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 ngaa4 cim1 tou4 dak1 taai3 sam1, wui5 soeng1 dou3 ngaa4 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把牙签掏得太深，会伤到牙龈。
examples.english_sentence: Don't probe too deep with a toothpick; it can hurt your gums.

mandarin_meaning: 牙签
english_meaning: toothpick
explanation_mandarin: 指用來剔除牙縫間食物殘渣的小木棒。口語中有時也用來形容人很瘦，像牙籤一樣。
explanation_english: A small stick used to remove food stuck between the teeth. Informally, it can also be used metaphorically to describe someone very thin, like a toothpick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完嘢記住用牙籤仔剔吓牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 je5 gei3 zyu6 jung6 ngaa4 cim1 zai2 tik1 haa5 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完东西记得用牙签剔一下牙。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to use a toothpick to pick your teeth after eating.

mandarin_meaning: （香港網絡/口語）指那些在網上只發短句、愛刺、愛嘲諷、只做表面評論的人，類似鍵盤俠或酸民。
english_meaning: Hong Kong slang for people who post short, provocative jabs online — superficial, poke-like comments; similar to 'keyboard warriors' or trolls.
explanation_mandarin: 牙籤黨是香港口語/網絡用語，形容一班喜歡用短句、尖銳或嘲諷語氣去『刺』別人、製造事端或只作表面參與的網民。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial/internet slang term for users who habitually post short, sharp, provocative comments to 'poke' others — often superficial participants or online provocateurs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近討論區成日有牙籤黨出現，淨係留短句嚟刺人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tou2 leon6 keoi1 sing4 jat6 jau5 ngaa4 cim1 dong2 ceot1 jin6, zing6 hai6 lau4 dyun2 geoi3 lai4 cik1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近討論區常常有牙签党出現，只會留簡短句子來刺人。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the forum has been full of 'toothpick gang' members who only leave short jabs to poke people.

mandarin_meaning: 牙线
english_meaning: dental floss
explanation_mandarin: 用来清洁牙齿间隙的细线或相关工具，以去除食物残渣和牙菌斑。
explanation_english: A thin thread or related tool used to clean between teeth to remove food particles and plaque.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙醫話我每日要用牙線清潔牙縫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ngo5 mui5 jat6 jiu3 jung6 ngaa4 sin3 cing1 git3 ngaa4 fung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙医说我每天要用牙线清洁牙缝。
examples.english_sentence: The dentist said I should use dental floss every day to clean between my teeth.

mandarin_meaning: 牙缝；牙齿之间的缝隙（也可引申为微小的空隙或极少的数量）
english_meaning: tooth gap; the gap between teeth (also used figuratively for a very small gap or tiny amount)
explanation_mandarin: 1) 口腔中牙齒之間的縫隙。2) 引申用法：比喻極小的空間或很少的數量（如‘從牙縫擠出來’表示數量很少）。
explanation_english: 1) The gap or space between teeth. 2) Figuratively used to refer to a very small gap or a tiny amount (e.g., 'squeezed out from between the teeth' to mean very little).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅牙縫卡咗菜渣，好唔舒服，要去洗牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 ngaa4 fung6 kaa1 zo2 coi3 zaa1, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6, jiu3 heoi3 sai2 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的牙缝塞了菜渣，很不舒服，要去洗牙。
examples.english_sentence: Food debris is stuck in the gap between my teeth; it's very uncomfortable — I need to get my teeth cleaned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲錢少得好似係由牙縫擠出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 cin2 siu2 dak1 hou2 ci5 hai6 jau4 ngaa4 fung6 zai1 ceot1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的钱少得好像是从牙缝里挤出来的。
examples.english_sentence: He has so little money it's as if it were squeezed out from between his teeth.

mandarin_meaning: 牙縫；牙間隙（指牙齒之間的縫隙；也用作比喻，表示填補空檔或微小的東西）
english_meaning: tooth gap; space between the teeth (also used figuratively for a small gap or something that only 'fills the gap')
explanation_mandarin: 指牙齒之間的縫隙（即牙縫）。在口語中也常與動詞「塞」搭配，用於比喻只起填補空檔、量少、不足以充飽的東西，例如「塞牙罅」。
explanation_english: Refers to the gap between teeth (the space between teeth). In colloquial use it is often combined with the verb 'to fill' (e.g. 'fill the tooth gap') as a metaphor for something small that just fills a gap or is insufficient as a full meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲嘢卡咗喺我牙罅，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 je5 kaat3 zo2 hai2 ngo5 ngaa4 hat6, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有東西卡在我的牙縫，很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Something is stuck in my tooth gap; it's very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個三文治只係塞牙罅，唔夠飽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 saam1 man4 zi6 zi2 hai6 sak1 ngaa4 hat6, m4 gau3 baau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個三明治只是填牙縫，不夠飽。
examples.english_sentence: That sandwich only fills the tooth gap; it's not enough to be full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為牙罅成日俾人笑，但佢唔介意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ngaa4 hat6 sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 siu3, daan6 keoi5 m4 gaai3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為牙縫常常被人取笑，但他不介意。
examples.english_sentence: He is often teased because of his tooth gap, but he doesn't mind.

mandarin_meaning: 牙龈（牙周組織的一部分，包裹牙齒的軟組織）
english_meaning: gums (gingiva)
explanation_mandarin: 指包裹和支持牙齒的軟組織，通常稱為牙龈。牙肉若出現紅腫、出血或疼痛，可能為牙周問題，需要注意口腔衛生或就醫處理。
explanation_english: The soft tissue surrounding and supporting the teeth, commonly called the gums or gingiva. Redness, swelling, bleeding, or pain in the gums can indicate periodontal problems; maintain oral hygiene and consult a dentist if necessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我牙肉腫咗，食嘢好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaa4 juk6 zung2 zo2, sik6 je5 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的牙龈肿了，吃东西很痛。
examples.english_sentence: My gums are swollen; it hurts to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 刷牙要小心，唔好傷到牙肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saat3 ngaa4 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 soeng1 dou3 ngaa4 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刷牙要小心，別傷到牙龈。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when brushing your teeth; don't hurt your gums.

mandarin_meaning: 牙膏 (yágāo)
english_meaning: toothpaste
explanation_mandarin: 指用來清潔牙齒的膏狀或凝膠狀產品，通常裝在軟管內並含有香味成分（如薄荷）。
explanation_english: A paste or gel used for cleaning teeth, usually packaged in a tube and often flavored (e.g., mint).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得買牙膏喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 maai5 ngaa4 gou1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘記買牙膏了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to buy toothpaste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙膏用晒，要買多支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 gou1 jung6 saai3, jiu3 maai5 do1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙膏用完了，需要再買一支。
examples.english_sentence: The toothpaste is finished; I need to buy another tube.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔應該食牙膏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 jing1 goi1 sik6 ngaa4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友不應該吃牙膏。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't eat toothpaste.

mandarin_meaning: 牙胶
english_meaning: dental impression material; dental wax/rubber used for impressions or denture work
explanation_mandarin: 牙科用語，指用來取牙齒印模或製作假牙的膠狀或橡膠狀材料，常用於牙齒取模和義齒製作。
explanation_english: A dental material (paste-like or rubbery) used to take dental impressions or in denture fabrication; commonly used for making molds of teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙醫用牙膠整印模，等陣幫你做假牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ji1 jung6 ngaa4 gaau1 zing2 jan3 mou4, dang2 zan6 bong1 nei5 zou6 gaa2 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙医用牙胶做印模，等一下幫你做假牙。
examples.english_sentence: The dentist used dental impression material to take an impression; they'll make your denture shortly.

mandarin_meaning: 牙菌斑；附着於牙齒表面的細菌生物膜
english_meaning: dental plaque; oral biofilm — a sticky film of bacteria that forms on the surface of teeth
explanation_mandarin: 指附着在牙齒表面、由細菌及其分泌物構成的黏性生物膜，容易導致蛀牙、牙齦炎及牙周病。
explanation_english: A sticky biofilm composed of bacteria and their products that adheres to tooth surfaces; it can lead to cavities, gingivitis, and periodontal disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 刷牙唔徹底會令牙菌膜積聚，容易引致蛀牙同牙齦炎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saat3 ngaa4 m4 cit3 dai2 wui5 ling6 ngaa4 gwan2 mok6 zik1 zeoi6, jung4 ji6 jan5 zi3 zyu3 ngaa4 tung4 ngaa4 ngai4 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刷牙不徹底會使牙菌膜堆積，容易引起蛀牙和牙齦炎。
examples.english_sentence: Not brushing thoroughly lets dental plaque build up, which can easily cause cavities and gingivitis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙醫話要用牙線去除牙菌膜，尤其係牙縫位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 jiu3 jung6 ngaa4 sin3 heoi3 ceoi4 ngaa4 gwan2 mok6, jau1 kei4 hai6 ngaa4 fung4 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙醫說要用牙線去除牙菌膜，尤其是在牙縫處。
examples.english_sentence: The dentist said to use dental floss to remove plaque, especially between the teeth.

mandarin_meaning: 牙齦出血；牙齒出血
english_meaning: bleeding from the gums or teeth (bleeding gums)
explanation_mandarin: 指牙齒或牙齦出血的情況，可由刷牙用力、牙齦發炎、牙周病或外傷等原因引起。在口語中也可直接用作描述口腔出血的現象。
explanation_english: Refers to bleeding from the teeth or gums, commonly caused by vigorous brushing, gum inflammation, periodontal disease, or trauma. Colloquially used to describe bleeding in the mouth area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日刷牙都會牙血，可能牙齦發炎，要去睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 caat3 ngaa4 dou1 wui5 ngaa4 hyut3, ho2 nang4 ngaa4 ngai4 faat3 jam4, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常刷牙都会牙龈出血，可能是牙龈发炎，要去看牙医。
examples.english_sentence: I often have bleeding gums when I brush my teeth; maybe my gums are inflamed and I should see a dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打籃球跌到成口牙血，傷得幾嚴重，要即刻送院檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 laam4 kau4 dit3 dou3 sing4 hau2 ngaa4 hyut3, soeng1 dak1 gei2 jim4 zung6, jiu3 zik1 hak1 sung3 jyun6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打篮球摔倒导致嘴里牙齿出血，伤得很严重，要马上送医院检查。
examples.english_sentence: He fell playing basketball and had bleeding from his teeth/mouth; the injury seems serious and he should be taken to the hospital immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 牙买加（國家名稱）
english_meaning: Jamaica (country)
explanation_mandarin: 牙买加（Jamaica）是位於加勒比海的島國，以雷鬼音樂、藍山咖啡和豐富的加勒比文化聞名，首都是金斯敦。
explanation_english: Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean, known for reggae music, Blue Mountain coffee and its rich Caribbean culture. The capital is Kingston.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去牙買加旅行，想聽下當地嘅雷鬼音樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 ngaa4 maai5 gaa1 leoi5 haang4, soeng2 teng1 haa5 dong1 dei6 ge3 leoi4 gwai1 jam1 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去牙买加旅行，想听听当地的雷鬼音乐。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Jamaica next month; I want to hear the local reggae music.

mandarin_meaning: 退縮、軟弱、喪失勇氣（口語）
english_meaning: to lose nerve; to become weak-willed; to give in (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，形容人在面對壓力或困難時變得軟弱、退縮或容易讓步。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who becomes weak, loses resolve, or gives in when faced with pressure or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老闆就牙軟，唔敢爭人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 lou5 baan2 zau6 ngaa4 jyun5, m4 gam2 zang1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到老板就退縮，不敢爭取加薪。
examples.english_sentence: He loses his nerve around the boss and doesn't dare ask for a raise.

mandarin_meaning: 牙醫 (yáyī)
english_meaning: dentist
explanation_mandarin: 專門診治牙齒和口腔問題的醫生，負責檢查、補牙、拔牙、洗牙及其他牙科治療。
explanation_english: A medical professional who diagnoses and treats teeth and oral health issues; performs exams, fillings, extractions, cleanings, and other dental procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期要去睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下星期要去看牙醫。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the dentist next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙醫話我要補一個蛀牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ji1 wa6 ngo5 jiu3 bou2 jat1 go3 zyu3 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙醫說我要補一顆蛀牙。
examples.english_sentence: The dentist said I need to get a cavity filled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙醫診所今日好多人，等咗我半個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ji1 zan2 so2 gam1 jat6 hou2 do1 jan4, dang2 zo2 ngo5 bun3 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙醫診所今天很多人，我等了半個小時。
examples.english_sentence: The dental clinic is very busy today; I waited for half an hour.

mandarin_meaning: （不常用／可能為錯寫）沒有明確的常見詞義；有可能是錯寫或罕見方言詞，需以語境判斷
english_meaning: (rare/obscure) no well‑established meaning; possibly a misspelling or a very rare regional/slang term
explanation_mandarin: 「牙鉸」並非常見的廣東話詞彙／成語；在公開詞典和常見語料中罕見。很可能是把其他詞（例如「牙膠」、「牙夾」或其他同音/近形字）寫錯或混淆。若在句子中出現，應依上下文判斷其含義，或向說話者求證。
explanation_english: '牙鉸' is not a commonly attested Cantonese word or idiom. It appears to be rare or possibly a misspelling/variant of other words (for example, similar‑looking or similar‑sounding items). If encountered, interpret based on context or ask the speaker for clarification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「牙鉸」呢個寫法好少見，好可能係寫錯字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 'ngaa4 gaau2' ni1 go3 se2 faat3 hou2 siu2 gin3, hou2 ho2 nang4 hai6 se2 co3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「牙鉸」這個寫法很少見，很可能是寫錯字。
examples.english_sentence: '牙鉸' as a spelling is rare and is likely a misspelling.

synonyms: 牙膠（可能的錯寫或近形字）

mandarin_meaning: 口水戰／口舌之戰（雙方以言語互相攻擊或爭論）
english_meaning: a war of words; verbal spat (a back-and-forth argument or exchange of insults)
explanation_mandarin: 指雙方以言語爭論、互相嘲諷或謾罵的爭執，多為口頭上或在網絡留言／討論區發生的比拼，通常沒有肢體衝突。
explanation_english: Refers to a verbal confrontation where parties exchange arguments, insults or taunts—often online or in comment threads. It denotes a back-and-forth dispute without physical fighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺社交媒體上，兩邊又爆發咗一場牙鉸戰，留言淨係喺度鬧來鬧去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6, loeng5 bin1 jau6 baau3 faat3 zo2 jat1 coeng4 ngaa4 gaau2 zin3, lau4 jim4 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 nau6 loi4 nau6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在社交媒体上，双方又爆发了一场牙鉸戰，留言区一直在互相谩骂。
examples.english_sentence: On social media, both sides broke out into another '牙鉸戰', with the comments filled with insults.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔好再起牙鉸戰，直接商量解決方法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zoi3 hei2 ngaa4 gaau2 zin3, zik6 zip3 soeng1 loeng4 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不要再发生牙鉸戰了，直接商量解决方法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not start another '牙鉸戰'; talk directly and find a solution.

mandarin_meaning: 牙关 (下颌/咬合；也用作比喻，咬紧牙关表示咬紧牙不说话或忍受痛苦)
english_meaning: jaw; jaw joint; (idiom) to grit one's teeth / to clench one's jaw
explanation_mandarin: 指人的下颌或上下牙齿接触的部位；在口语或成语中常用于“咬紧牙关”，表示忍耐、坚持或强忍痛苦、不发声。
explanation_english: Refers to the jaw (the lower jaw/area where the teeth meet); in colloquial/idiomatic use (e.g., “grit one's teeth”) it means to endure, persevere, or suppress pain or emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忍住痛，咬緊牙關冇喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan2 zyu6 tung3, ngaau5 gan2 ngaa4-gwaan1 mou5 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忍住疼痛，咬紧牙关没有喊。
examples.english_sentence: He endured the pain, gritted his teeth and didn't cry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣，我要咬緊牙關先過到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 go2 zan6, ngo5 jiu3 ngaau5 gan2 ngaa4-gwaan1 sin1 gwo3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候，我要咬紧牙关才能通过。
examples.english_sentence: During exams I had to grit my teeth to get through it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我牙關關節有問題，開口嗰陣好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ngaa4-gwaan1 gwaan1-zit3 jau5 man6-tai4, hoi1 hau2 go2 zan6 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的牙关关节有问题，张口的时候很痛。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my jaw joint has a problem; it's painful when I open my mouth.

mandarin_meaning: 下顎；頜骨（口語稱呼）
english_meaning: jaw; mandible (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指口腔的下頜或頜骨部位，有時泛指牙齒或咬合的部位。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term referring to the jaw or mandible area; sometimes used broadly for the area of the teeth or bite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我牙骹痛，唔敢食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaa4 gwaa1 tung3, m4 gam2 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的下顎（牙骹）痛，不敢吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: My jaw hurts, I don't dare to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，牙骹撞親腫咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, ngaa4 gwaa1 zong6 can1 zung2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跌倒，牙骹被撞到腫了。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and his jaw got hit and swollen.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）大打出手；激烈的肢體衝突
english_meaning: a brawl; a fierce physical fight (tooth-and-nail fight)
explanation_mandarin: 「牙骹戰」是廣東話俚語，用來形容雙方爆發激烈的肢體衝突或大打出手。有時也可作誇張用法，形容爭執非常激烈。
explanation_english: “牙骹戰” is Cantonese slang describing a fierce physical fight or brawl. It can also be used hyperbolically to describe a very intense dispute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺街市度睇到兩個人打到牙骹戰，真係嚇親我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gaai1 si5 dou6 tai2 dou3 loeng5 go3 jan4 daa2 dou3 ngaa4 gaau1 zin3, zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在街市看到兩個人大打出手，真的把我嚇到了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw two people brawling at the market; it really scared me.

mandarin_meaning: 牙齿
english_meaning: tooth; teeth
explanation_mandarin: 指口腔內用於咀嚼、咬合的堅硬器官，可指單顆或整組牙齒，與口腔健康相關。
explanation_english: Refers to the hard structures in the mouth used for chewing and biting; can denote a single tooth or the set of teeth, related to oral health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近牙齒痛，要去睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 ngaa4 ci2 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近牙齿痛，要去看牙医。
examples.english_sentence: My tooth has been hurting recently; I need to see a dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路換牙嘅時候會有啲出血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 wun6 ngaa4 ge3 si4 hau6 wui5 jau5 di1 ceot1 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩换牙的时候会有些出血。
examples.english_sentence: Children sometimes have slight bleeding when they lose baby teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食太多糖會蛀牙，損害牙齒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 taai3 do1 tong4 wui5 zyu3 ngaa4, syun2 hoi6 ngaa4 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃太多糖会蛀牙，损害牙齿。
examples.english_sentence: Eating too much sugar can cause cavities and damage the teeth.

mandarin_meaning: 牙齿印；咬痕
english_meaning: tooth mark; bite mark (impression left by teeth)
explanation_mandarin: 指牙齒留下的痕跡或壓印，常見於皮膚、衣物、食物等表面，表示被咬或壓過的痕跡。
explanation_english: Refers to marks or impressions left by teeth, commonly found on skin, clothing, food, etc., indicating something has been bitten or pressed by teeth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枕頭上有啲牙齒印，好似畀隻小狗咬過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zam2 tau4 soeng6 jau5 di1 ngaa4 ci2 jan3, hou2 ci5 bei2 zek3 siu2 gau2 ngaau5 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 枕头上有一些牙齿印，好像被小狗咬过。
examples.english_sentence: There are some bite marks on the pillow, as if a puppy chewed it.

mandarin_meaning: 牙齒打顫；牙齒發抖（通常因寒冷或害怕）
english_meaning: to have one's teeth chattering (usually from cold or fear)
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語表達，形容因為寒冷、害怕或發抖而出現牙齒顫動的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing the trembling or chattering of teeth, typically caused by cold or fear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚好凍，我啲牙齒成晚都打卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hou2 dung3, ngo5 di1 ngaa4 ci2 sing4 maan5 dou1 daa2 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚很冷，我的牙齒整晚都在打顫。
examples.english_sentence: It's very cold tonight; my teeth were chattering all night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到蛇，佢驚到牙齒打卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 se4, keoi5 geng1 dou3 ngaa4 ci2 daa2 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到蛇，他嚇得牙齒打顫。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw the snake, he was so scared his teeth chattered.

mandarin_meaning: 極度吝嗇／非常小氣
english_meaning: extremely stingy; penny-pinching
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人非常小氣、吝嗇，連日常開支也不願意花錢。這是一句帶有貶義的俗語，多用於口語。當用來批評別人或抱怨某人吝嗇時使用。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely stingy or penny-pinching, unwilling to spend even on ordinary things. This is a colloquial, negative idiom used to criticize or complain about someone's miserliness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢連買牙膏都唔肯，真係牙齒當金使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lin4 maai5 ngaa4 gou1 dou1 m4 hang2, zan1 hai6 ngaa4 ci2 dong3 gam1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他連買牙膏都不肯，真是太吝嗇了。
examples.english_sentence: He won't even buy toothpaste; he's really stingy.

mandarin_meaning: 牙龈 (yáyín)
english_meaning: gums (the soft tissue surrounding the teeth)
explanation_mandarin: 指包圍牙齒的軟組織，屬於牙周組織的一部分，常與牙齦發炎、出血等牙科問題相關。
explanation_english: The soft tissue that surrounds and supports the teeth; part of the periodontium. Commonly involved in dental issues such as gingivitis and bleeding gums.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近個牙齦成日痛，要去睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 go3 ngaa4 ngan4 seng4 jat6 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近牙龈总是痛，要去看牙医。
examples.english_sentence: My gums have been aching lately; I need to see the dentist.

mandarin_meaning: 牛（niú）：①牛，指牛或牛類（名詞）；②（口語、俚語）厲害、了不起（形容詞）
english_meaning: cow; ox (noun); (slang) awesome, impressive (colloquial adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 「牛」本義指牛這種動物；在粵語（及漢語其他方言／口語）中也可作俚語，表示某人或某事很厲害、很了不起。
explanation_english: Literally 'cow/ox'. Colloquially used as slang to mean someone or something is awesome, impressive, or very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有幾頭牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 tau4 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農場裡有幾頭牛。
examples.english_sentence: There are several cows on the farm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好牛，話幾句就解決晒問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ngau4, waa6 gei2 geoi3 zau6 gaai2 kyut3 saai3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很厲害，說幾句就解決了問題。
examples.english_sentence: He's really awesome — he solved the problem in just a few words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅攝影功能好牛！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 sip3 jing2 gung1 nang4 hou2 ngau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機的攝影功能很厲害！
examples.english_sentence: The camera on this phone is awesome!

mandarin_meaning: （1）在扑克牌遊戲「牛牛」中，點數為 1 的牌型（Niu 1）。（2）引申為程度較差、表現不佳或運氣不好（口語、俚語用法）。
english_meaning: (1) In the card game 'Niu Niu' (牛牛), a hand that scores 1 (Niu 1). (2) Colloquially, used figuratively to describe something or someone as mediocre, weak, or unlucky.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（遊戲術語；口語用法可作名詞或形容）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (game term; colloquial figurative use as a noun/adjective)
explanation_mandarin: 原詞來自牌戲「牛牛」（俗稱 Niu Niu），牛一指該局計分結果為 1 的牌型。口語中有時把「牛一」用來形容成績、運氣或能力較差、不中用的情況，屬於非正式用法。
explanation_english: Originally from the card game 'Niu Niu', where 'Niu One' denotes a hand scoring 1. In colloquial speech it can be used figuratively to describe poor performance, bad luck, or something unimpressive. This usage is informal/slangy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚打牛牛，我攞到牛一，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 maan5 daa2 ngau4 ngau4, ngo5 lo2 dou3 ngau4 jat1, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚玩牛牛，我拿到牛一，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Last night playing Niu Niu I got Niu One and lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好勁，其實只係牛一啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 ging6, sat1 kei4 zi2 hai6 ngau4 jat1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說自己很厲害，其實只是牛一而已。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying he's great, but he's really just Niu One (not impressive).

mandarin_meaning: 牛肉丸（牛肉製成的丸子）
english_meaning: beef ball (meatball made from beef)
explanation_mandarin: 以牛肉為主要原料製成的丸狀食品，常見於廣東/香港飲食，如火鍋、雲吞麵或街頭小食，口感彈牙。
explanation_english: A ball-shaped food made mainly from beef, commonly found in Cantonese/Hong Kong cuisine — used in hotpot, noodle soups, and street snacks; typically has a springy, bouncy texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚打邊爐我想食牛丸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 daa2 bin1 lou4 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 ngau4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃火鍋，我想吃牛丸。
examples.english_sentence: I'm having hotpot tonight and want to eat beef balls.

mandarin_meaning: 牛奶（牛的乳汁）
english_meaning: cow's milk; milk (from a cow)
explanation_mandarin: 指牛分泌的乳汁，即牛奶。書面或標籤上較常見，口語中通常說「牛奶」或「鮮奶」。
explanation_english: Refers to the milk produced by cows — i.e., cow's milk. The term is more formal/written (often on labels); in everyday speech Cantonese speakers commonly say "牛奶" or "鮮奶".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早餐我飲咗一杯牛乳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 caan1 ngo5 jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 ngau4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早餐我喝了一杯牛奶。
examples.english_sentence: I drank a cup of milk for breakfast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對牛乳過敏，唔可以食含乳製品嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngau4 jyu5 gwo3 man5, m4 ho2 ji5 sik6 ham4 jyu5 zai3 ban2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對牛奶過敏，不能吃含乳製品的東西。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is allergic to cow's milk and can't eat foods containing dairy.

mandarin_meaning: 牛乳饼（奶香味的饼干或点心）
english_meaning: milk biscuit / milk cookie (a biscuit or pastry with a milky flavor)
explanation_mandarin: 指以牛奶或乳制品为主要原料制成的饼干或点心，口感常带奶香，常见于香港或广东的传统饼店与零食中。
explanation_english: A biscuit or pastry made primarily from milk or dairy ingredients, typically with a milky aroma and flavor; commonly sold as a snack or at traditional bakeries in Hong Kong and Cantonese-speaking areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街市買咗幾包牛乳餅，幾好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 gei2 baau1 ngau4 jyu5 beng2, gei2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街市买了几包牛乳饼，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a few packs of milk biscuits at the market; they're really tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餅店啲牛乳餅係手工製作，好香牛奶味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 beng2 dim3 di1 ngau4 jyu5 beng2 hai6 sau2 gung1 zai3 zok3, hou2 hoeng1 ngau4 naai5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家饼店的牛乳饼是手工制作的，很有牛奶香味。
examples.english_sentence: The milk biscuits at this bakery are handmade and have a strong milky aroma.

mandarin_meaning: 牛杂（牛的各種內臟混合）
english_meaning: beef offal; mixed beef innards (various internal organs of the cow used as food)
explanation_mandarin: 指牛的各種內臟，如牛肚、牛腸、牛心等，常見於街頭小吃或湯粉、燉煮類菜餚中。是廣東話中常用的食品名稱。
explanation_english: Refers to various bovine internal organs such as tripe, intestines, heart, etc., commonly prepared together in soups, noodle dishes, or street-food stalls. A common Cantonese food term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去嗰間熟食檔食牛什湯粉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 go2 gaan1 suk6 sik6 dong3 sik6 ngau4 sap6 tong1 fan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們去那家熟食檔吃牛雜湯粉吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to that cooked-food stall tonight to have beef-offal noodle soup.

mandarin_meaning: 牛仔（指美國西部的牧牛者）；也常作「牛仔褲」的簡稱，指牛仔布製成的褲子
english_meaning: cowboy; (short for) jeans (i.e., denim pants)
explanation_mandarin: 「牛仔」可指騎馬牧牛的西部牛仔，也常作為「牛仔褲」的簡稱，指用牛仔布製成的褲子。在口語中可根據上下文指人（cowboy）或服飾（jeans）。
explanation_english: “牛仔” can mean a cowboy (a cattle herder of the American West) or, by abbreviation, jeans (pants made of denim). The meaning depends on context — either a person (cowboy) or an item of clothing (jeans).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想打扮成牛仔去萬聖節派對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 daa2 baan6 sing4 ngau4 zai2 heoi3 maan6 sing3 zit3 paai3 deoi3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想打扮成牛仔去万圣节派对。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to dress up as a cowboy for the Halloween party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間店有好多牛仔褲打折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 dim3 jau5 hou2 do1 ngau4 zai2 fu3 daa2 zit3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店有很多牛仔裤打折。
examples.english_sentence: This shop has many jeans on sale.

mandarin_meaning: 牛仔布 / 丹宁布 (niúzǎibù / dānníngbù)
english_meaning: denim (jean fabric)
explanation_mandarin: 牛仔布（亦称丹宁布）是一种结实的斜纹棉织物，常用于制作牛仔裤、牛仔夹克等服饰面料。
explanation_english: Denim is a sturdy twill cotton fabric (also called denim or dungaree cloth) commonly used for making jeans, jackets, and other garments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件牛仔褸係用高質牛仔布做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 ngau4 zai2 lou2 hai6 jung6 gou1 zat1 ngau4 zai2 bou3 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件牛仔夹克是用高质量的牛仔布做的。
examples.english_sentence: This denim jacket is made from high-quality denim fabric.

mandarin_meaning: 牛仔衬衫；用牛仔布制成的衬衫或上衣
english_meaning: denim shirt / jean shirt (a shirt or top made from denim)
explanation_mandarin: 指用牛仔布（丹寧布）製成的衬衫或上衣，屬於休閒服裝，常見藍色或做舊風格。
explanation_english: A shirt or top made from denim (jean fabric). It's a casual garment, often blue and sometimes styled with a worn/distressed look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一件新嘅牛仔衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 gin6 san1 ge3 ngau4 zai2 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一件新的牛仔衬衫。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new denim shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件牛仔衫好襯你，簡單又舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 ngau4 zai2 saam1 hou2 can1 nei5, gaan2 daan1 jau6 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件牛仔衬衫很配你，简单又舒适。
examples.english_sentence: This denim shirt suits you — simple and comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天可以著牛仔衫配毛衣，好有層次感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 ho2 ji5 zoek3 ngau4 zai2 saam1 pui3 mou4 ji1, hou2 jau5 cang4 ci3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天可以穿牛仔衬衫配毛衣，很有层次感。
examples.english_sentence: In winter you can wear a denim shirt with a sweater for a layered look.

mandarin_meaning: 牛仔裙（牛仔布製的裙子）
english_meaning: denim skirt; jean skirt
explanation_mandarin: 指用牛仔布（丹宁布）製作的各種裙裝款式，常見於休閒或日常穿著，可為短裙或較長的裙子。
explanation_english: A skirt made from denim (jean) fabric. It refers to various skirt styles—often casual—made of denim, ranging from mini skirts to longer denim skirts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗條新嘅牛仔裙，好靚呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 zoek3 zo2 tiu4 san1 ge3 ngau4 zai2 kwan4, hou2 leng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了新的牛仔裙，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She put on a new denim skirt; it looks very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買條牛仔裙，邊度有賣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ngo5 soeng2 maai5 tiu4 ngau4 zai2 kwan4, bin1 dou6 jau5 maai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一条牛仔裙，哪里有卖？
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a denim skirt. Where can I buy one?

mandarin_meaning: 牛仔裤 (niú zǎi kù)
english_meaning: jeans; denim pants
explanation_mandarin: 由丹寧布（牛仔布）製成的長褲，為常見的休閒服飾。
explanation_english: Trousers made from denim (jeans), a common type of casual clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗條新牛仔褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 maai5 zo2 tiu4 san1 ngau4 zai2 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛買了一條新牛仔褲。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a new pair of jeans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條牛仔褲有個窿，要補一補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 ngau4 zai2 fu3 jau5 go3 lung4, jiu3 bou2 jat1 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的牛仔褲有一個洞，需要補一補。
examples.english_sentence: My jeans have a hole; they need mending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牛仔褲濕咗好難快乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngau4 zai2 fu3 sap1 zo2 hou2 naan4 faai3 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牛仔褲濕了很難快速晾乾。
examples.english_sentence: Jeans are hard to dry quickly when they get wet.

mandarin_meaning: 牛仔夾克／牛仔外套
english_meaning: denim jacket; jean jacket
explanation_mandarin: 指用牛仔布（丹寧布）製成的外套，常見於休閒穿搭，也可稱為牛仔外套或牛仔夾克。
explanation_english: A jacket made from denim (jean) fabric. Common casual outerwear, also called a denim or jean jacket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個星期天氣凍，記得著件牛仔褸出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 tin1 hei3 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 gin6 ngau4 zai2 lou2 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個星期天氣冷，記得穿牛仔外套出門。
examples.english_sentence: It's cold this week; remember to wear a denim jacket when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 牛小排 / 牛肋排（牛仔骨）
english_meaning: beef short ribs (a cut of beef from the rib area)
explanation_mandarin: 指牛的肋骨部位的肉，常见的食材名称。常用于烤、焖、炖或煎等烹調方法，是港式酒樓或茶餐廳常供應的菜式。
explanation_english: Refers to a cut of beef from the rib area (beef short ribs). It's a common ingredient, often grilled, braised, stewed, or pan-fried, and appears frequently on menus in Hong Kong-style restaurants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅牛仔骨好正，啲肉又香又嫩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 ngau4 zai2 gwat1 hou2 zeng6, di1 juk6 jau6 hoeng1 jau6 nan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的牛仔骨很好吃，肉又香又嫩。
examples.english_sentence: The beef short ribs at this cha chaan teng are delicious — the meat is fragrant and tender.

mandarin_meaning: 公牛 / 雄牛
english_meaning: bull (male cattle)
explanation_mandarin: 指成年的雄性牛，也可稱作公牛。常用於農場、畜牧或描述體型、力量較大的雄性牲畜。
explanation_english: Refers to an adult male cattle (bull). Used in farming and livestock contexts, also used descriptively for large or powerful male animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場有一頭大牛公，佢好壯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jau5 jat1 tau4 daai6 ngau4 gung1, keoi5 hou2 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農場有一頭大公牛，他很壯。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big bull on the farm; it is very strong.

mandarin_meaning: 小试牛刀／小露身手，稍微展示自己的才能或本领
english_meaning: to make a small-scale demonstration of one's skill; to show a little of one's ability
explanation_mandarin: 表示在較小範圍或首次試驗性地展示自己的本領，通常指尚未全面發揮實力的初步表現。
explanation_english: Indicates a preliminary or small-scale display of one's skill—showing a bit of ability without fully demonstrating one’s full capability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢喺呢場比賽只係牛刀小試，未完全發揮出佢嘅實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 hai2 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 zi2 hai6 ngau4 dou1 siu2 si3, mei6 jyun4 cyun4 faat3 fai1 ceot1 keoi5 ge3 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他在这场比赛只是小试牛刀，还没有完全发挥出他的实力。
examples.english_sentence: This time he only gave a small demonstration of his skills in this competition; he hasn't fully shown his ability yet.

mandarin_meaning: 很厲害／很有力／很強
english_meaning: very impressive; powerful; extremely capable
explanation_mandarin: 「牛力」是香港粵語的非正式俚語，用來稱讚某人或某事物很有力量、很厲害或很強，口語化且帶讚賞意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term used in Hong Kong to praise someone or something as powerful, impressive, or very capable. Informal and complimentary in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波好牛力，經常入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 hou2 ngau4 lik6 ging1 soeng4 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球很厲害，經常得分。
examples.english_sentence: He plays ball really well; he often scores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦真係好牛力，跑大型遊戲都冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ngau4 lik6, paau2 daai6 jing4 jau4 hei3 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電腦真的很厲害，玩大型遊戲都沒問題。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is really powerful; it runs big games with no problem.

mandarin_meaning: 爱炫耀的中年男子；装腔作势的大叔（俚语）
english_meaning: a show-off middle-aged man; an arrogant 'uncle' (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「牛叔」為香港粵語俚語，結合「牛」（有吹噓、誇耀之意）與「叔」（指中年男子）來形容喜歡吹噓、愛顯擺或自大的中年男性，帶貶義。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term combining 'ngau' (boast/show-off) and 'suk' (uncle), used to describe a middle-aged man who likes to brag or show off. It is derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話自己好叻，真係一個牛叔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 ngau4 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己很厉害，真是个爱炫耀的大叔。
examples.english_sentence: He always brags about how great he is — such a show-off uncle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理個牛叔，佢鍾意吹牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 go3 ngau4 suk1, keoi5 zung1 ji3 ceoi1 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理那个牛叔，他爱吹牛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with that 'ngau suk'; he likes to brag.

mandarin_meaning: 很跩 / 很自大
english_meaning: cocky; arrogant; full of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 「牛咁眼」是廣東話俗語，用來形容一個人態度傲慢、很跩或自以為是，常帶貶義，表示對方擺出高人一等的樣子。
explanation_english: “牛咁眼” is Cantonese slang used to describe someone who is arrogant, cocky, or full of themselves. It is typically pejorative and conveys that the person is acting superior or smug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家成日講自己多叻，真係牛咁眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 sing4 jat6 gong2 zi6 gei2 do1 lek6, zan1 hai6 ngau4 gam2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在常常說自己很厲害，真的是很跩。
examples.english_sentence: He's always bragging about how great he is now — he's really cocky.

cantonese: 牛唔飲水唔㩒得牛頭低
jyutping: ngau4 m4 jam2 seoi2 m4 ngaap3 dak1 ngau4 tau4 dai1
mandarin_meaning: 不能強迫別人做不願意做的事；就像「牽馬到水邊，不能強迫它喝水」
english_meaning: You can't force someone to do something they don't want to do; you can lead them to an opportunity but you can't make them accept it (similar to 'You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink').
explanation_mandarin: 用以形容某些事情無法強求，勉強別人做他們不願意做的事通常無效。
explanation_english: An idiom used to say that you cannot compel someone to do something they refuse to do; forcing won't change their will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我叫佢去做，但係佢死都唔肯，真係牛唔飲水唔㩒得牛頭低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 heoi3 zou6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 sei2 dou1 m4 hang2, zan1 hai6 ngau4 m4 jam2 seoi2 m4 ngaap3 dak1 ngau4 tau4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我叫他去做，但他怎麼勸都不肯，真是不能強迫別人做不願意做的事。
examples.english_sentence: I told him to do it, but he absolutely refused — you really can't force someone to do what they don't want to do.

synonyms: 牽馬到水邊，不能強迫它喝水

cantonese: 牛唔飲水唔撳得牛頭低
jyutping: ngau4 m4 jam2 seoi2 m4 kam2 dak1 ngau4 tau4 dai1
mandarin_meaning: 不能強迫別人／強求不得（類似「強扭的瓜不甜」）
english_meaning: You can't force someone to do something they don't want to do; you can't achieve something by coercion.
explanation_mandarin: 這句廣東話諺語以「牛不喝水」作比喻，表示對方不願意就無法強迫，勉強不得。
explanation_english: This Cantonese proverb uses a cow unwilling to drink as a metaphor: you cannot force someone to do something against their will; coerced efforts won't succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經好耐勸佢去睇醫生，但佢唔肯，真係牛唔飲水唔撳得牛頭低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hou2 noi6 hyun3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1, daan6 keoi5 m4 hang2, zan1 hai6 ngau4 m4 jam2 seoi2 m4 kam2 dak1 ngau4 tau4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經勸他很久去看醫生，但他不肯，真是強求不得。
examples.english_sentence: I've been urging him for a long time to see a doctor, but he refuses — you really can't force someone.

mandarin_meaning: 用牛一般的呆滞或不屑的眼神看人
english_meaning: to give a blank, dazed, or disdainful stare (literally 'cow-like eyes')
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，形容用一副像牛一樣呆滯或帶不屑的眼神看着別人，可表示驚訝、茫然或輕視。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone looking at another person with a cow‑like blank or disdainful gaze. It can convey surprise, bewilderment, or contempt depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對住我牛噉眼，一句都冇講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 ngau4 gam2 ngaan5, jat1 geoi3 dou1 mou5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用一副牛般的眼神看著我，一句話也沒說。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a blank/disdainful look and didn't say a word.

mandarin_meaning: 粗俗之人裝作文雅；不相稱、格格不入的裝扮或行為
english_meaning: A coarse or uncultured person pretending to be refined; an incongruous or mismatched display of refinement
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俗語 / 俚語（或成語性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 比喻外表或言行想表現得優雅、有品味，但實際上粗俗、不相稱，令人覺得格格不入。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who tries to appear cultured or elegant but is actually coarse or out of place — an incongruous affectation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢裝得好有品味，但講嘢又粗又直，真係牛噍牡丹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong1 dak1 hou2 jau5 ban2 mei6, daan6 gong2 je5 jau6 cou1 jau6 zik6, zan1 hai6 ngau4 zoek6 mou5 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他裝得很有品味，但說話又粗魯又直接，真是牛噍牡丹。
examples.english_sentence: He dresses and acts like he has good taste, but his speech is coarse and blunt — truly an 'ox chewing peony' (a coarse person pretending to be refined).

cantonese: 牛噍牡丹 - 唔知味道
jyutping: ngau4 zoek3 mou5 daan1 — m4 zi1 mei6 dou6
mandarin_meaning: 像牛嚼牡丹──不知道（欣赏/体会）滋味；形容人粗俗、不懂欣赏美好事物
english_meaning: literally "an ox chewing a peony — doesn't know the taste"; describes someone coarse or unable to appreciate subtlety or refined things
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人沒有鑑賞能力或品味，面對精緻、雅致的事物時感受不到或不懂欣賞。
explanation_english: A figurative Cantonese expression used to describe a person who lacks appreciation or taste — someone who cannot recognize or enjoy refined, subtle things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日食街市嘢，去高級餐廳都唔識欣賞，真係牛噍牡丹——唔知味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 sik6 gaai1 si5 je5, heoi3 gou1 kap1 caan1 teng1 dou1 m4 sik1 jan1 soeng2, zan1 hai6 ngau4 zoek3 mou5 daan1 — m4 zi1 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他天天吃市井的東西，去高級餐廳也不懂得欣賞，真是牛嚼牡丹──不知道味道。
examples.english_sentence: He eats street food every day and can't appreciate fine dining — like an ox chewing a peony, he doesn't know how to taste it.

mandarin_meaning: 牛奶 (niú nǎi)
english_meaning: milk (cow's milk)
explanation_mandarin: 指從乳牛取得的飲品，常作為早餐或烹調材料，也有低脂、脫脂或鮮奶等不同種類。
explanation_english: A beverage obtained from cows, commonly consumed at breakfast or used in cooking; comes in varieties like whole, low-fat, skim, and fresh milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早飲左一杯牛奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jam2 zo2 jat1 bui1 ngau4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上喝了一杯牛奶。
examples.english_sentence: I drank a glass of milk this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友要飲牛奶先可以長高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 jiu3 jam2 ngau4 naai5 sin1 ho2 ji5 coeng4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子要喝牛奶才可以長高。
examples.english_sentence: Children need to drink milk to grow taller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有無低脂牛奶賣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 mou5 dai1 zi1 ngau4 naai5 maai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有沒有低脂牛奶賣？
examples.english_sentence: Does the supermarket sell low-fat milk?

mandarin_meaning: 奶嘴
english_meaning: pacifier; bottle teat
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱，用來指嬰兒吸吮或安撫用的奶嘴（奶瓶或安撫奶嘴）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to a pacifier or bottle teat used to feed or soothe an infant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB成日啜住牛奶咀，唔肯放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 BB sing4 jat6 cyut3 zyu6 ngau4 naai5 zeoi2, m4 hang2 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寶寶總是含著奶嘴，不肯放手。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is always sucking on the pacifier and won't let go.

mandarin_meaning: （香港俚語）指愛說甜言蜜語、拍馬屁的人
english_meaning: Hong Kong slang for a sweet-talker or flatterer (someone who flatters others to gain advantage)
explanation_mandarin: 「牛奶嘴」在廣東話/香港俚語中用來形容對別人說話很會討好、說好聽話以博取好處的人，相當於「馬屁精」或「嘴甜」的意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese/Hong Kong slang, '牛奶嘴' describes someone who speaks sweetly or flatters others to gain favor or advantages — similar to 'a bootlicker' or 'a sweet-talker'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對老闆講嘢好好聽，係個牛奶嘴，淨係諗住攞好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 lou5 baan2 gong2 je5 hou2 hou2 teng1, hai6 go3 ngau4 naai5 zeoi2, zing6 hai6 lam2 zyu6 lok6 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是對老闆說好聽的話，是個牛奶嘴，只想着拿好處。
examples.english_sentence: He always says flattering things to the boss — he's a sweet-talker who only thinks about getting benefits.

mandarin_meaning: 牛奶蕉（小香蕉的一种）
english_meaning: milk banana; a small sweet variety of banana (baby banana)
explanation_mandarin: 一種體型較小、果肉細緻且甜香的香蕉品種，常見於香港超市或街市，亦常以「奶蕉」或「小香蕉」稱呼。
explanation_english: A small, sweet banana variety with creamy flesh, commonly sold in Hong Kong supermarkets and markets — also called 'milk banana' or 'baby banana'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市有賣新鮮嘅牛奶蕉，買幾條返屋企當早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jau5 maai6 san1 sin1 ge3 ngau4 naai5 ziu1, maai5 gei2 tiu4 faan1 uk1 kei2 dong3 zou2 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市有賣新鮮的牛奶蕉，我買了幾根回家當早餐。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket sells fresh milk bananas; I bought a few to take home for breakfast.

mandarin_meaning: 牛孖筋（牛的兩條並排的筋，屬於牛筋的一種）
english_meaning: paired beef tendon (a section of beef tendon with two parallel tendons, used in Cantonese cooking)
explanation_mandarin: 指牛身上成對並排的筋，常見於廣東菜、火鍋或煲湯中，可燉、滷或涼拌，質地有嚼勁且富膠質。
explanation_english: Refers to a paired section of beef tendon (two parallel tendons). Common ingredient in Cantonese cuisine, hotpot and soups; typically braised, stewed or simmered, with a chewy, gelatinous texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚煲湯我想買啲牛孖筋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 bou1 tong1 ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 ngau4 maa1 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚熬汤我想买点牛孖筋（牛筋）。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some beef tendon (paired tendon) for the soup tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅牛孖筋好入味，滷得軟腍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 ngau4 maa1 gan1 hou2 jap6 mei6, lou5 dak1 jyun5 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的牛孖筋很入味，卤得很软烂。
examples.english_sentence: The beef tendon at this cafe is very flavorful; it's braised until tender.

mandarin_meaning: 牛粪；（俚语）胡说、狗屁
english_meaning: cow dung; (slang) crap, bullshit
explanation_mandarin: 本義指牛排泄的糞便。口語中也可作粗俗的比喻，用來形容某事物或說法很糟或不可信（相當於“胡說/狗屁”）。
explanation_english: Literally cow dung. In colloquial usage it can also be a coarse metaphor meaning something is bad, worthless, or untrue (similar to 'crap' or 'bullshit').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地上有好多牛屎，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 ngau4 si2, hang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地上有很多牛粪，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of cow dung on the ground; be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲嘢完全係牛屎，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 wun4 cyun4 hai6 ngau4 si2, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的那些话完全是胡说，不要理他。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is complete crap; don't pay attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語，侮辱語）形容卑鄙、討厭或沒用的人，字面為「牛屎佬」。
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese slang insult literally 'cow dung man', used to call someone despicable, useless, or annoying (scumbag/jerk).
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗的罵人用語，多在口語中使用，用來形容某人討厭、沒用或品行差，帶有強烈貶義。
explanation_english: A coarse insult used in Cantonese speech to describe someone as obnoxious, useless, or morally low; strongly derogatory and informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，又唔做嘢，真係牛屎佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, jau6 m4 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 ngau4 si2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是迟到，又不做事，真是個討厭的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late and doesn't do any work — what a scumbag.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）用來罵人的貶義詞，大致相當於「混蛋／討厭的人／沒用的人」
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese insult meaning a despicable, worthless or nasty person (literally 'cow-dung turtle').
explanation_mandarin: 「牛屎龜」是香港粵語的粗俗俚語，用作辱罵他人，帶有強烈的貶義。字面上是「牛屎」加「龜」，實際用法是稱某人討厭、沒用、卑劣或懶惰等。屬口語及粗俗用語，應避免在正式場合使用。
explanation_english: “牛屎龜” is a vulgar Hong Kong Cantonese slang insult. Literally 'cow-dung turtle', it is used to disparage someone as nasty, worthless, lazy, or contemptible. It is informal and coarse, so avoid using it in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個牛屎龜，做嘢成日都唔做，真係惹人嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 ngau4 si2 gwai1, zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 zou6, zan1 hai6 je5 jan4 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個牛屎龜，做事總是不做，真讓人生氣。
examples.english_sentence: You cow‑shit‑turtle—always not doing your work, it really pisses people off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，老細都話佢係個牛屎龜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, lou5 sai3 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 go3 ngau4 si2 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常遲到，老闆都說他是個牛屎龜。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late; the boss even calls him a 'cow‑shit‑turtle'.

mandarin_meaning: 從事粗重體力勞動的工作或從事這類工作的工人
english_meaning: manual labour; doing hard physical work; a manual labourer
explanation_mandarin: 「牛工」為粵語口語，通常指需要做粗重或長時間體力勞動的工作，或稱呼做這類工作的工人，有時帶有貶義或自嘲意味。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, "牛工" refers to doing heavy manual labour or to a person who does such work. It is colloquial and can carry a derogatory or self-deprecating nuance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢來香港做牛工好幾年，覺得好辛苦但係要養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loi4 Hoeng1 gong2 zou6 ngau4 gung1 hou2 gei2 nin4, gok3 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2 daan6 hai6 jiu3 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他來香港做體力工作好幾年，覺得很辛苦但要養家。
examples.english_sentence: He has been doing manual labour in Hong Kong for several years; he finds it very tough but has to support his family.

mandarin_meaning: 牛市（股市或金融市場普遍上漲、投資者樂觀的狀態）
english_meaning: Bull market (a market condition in which prices are rising or expected to rise)
explanation_mandarin: 指股票、債券或其他金融市場中價格普遍上升、買方佔優、投資者情緒樂觀的市場狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to a financial market condition where prices of stocks, bonds, or other assets are generally rising, buyers dominate, and investor sentiment is optimistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家股市係牛市，人人都爭住買股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gu2 si5 hai6 ngau4 si5, jan4 jan4 dou1 zang1 zyu6 maai5 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在股市处于牛市，大家都在抢着买股票。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market is in a bull market now; everyone is rushing to buy stocks.

mandarin_meaning: 牛棚；養牛的房屋或建築（牛舍）
english_meaning: cowshed; cattle barn — a building or enclosure for keeping cows
explanation_mandarin: 指用來關養或飼養牛隻的房屋或建築，通常出現在農場或牧場，用來提供遮蔽、休息與飼養空間。
explanation_english: Refers to a building or enclosure used to keep and raise cows, typically found on farms or ranches; provides shelter, resting space, and an area for feeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有幾間牛房，用嚟飼養乳牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 gaan1 ngau4 fong4, jung6 lai4 si3 joeng5 jyu5 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场里面有几间牛棚，用来饲养奶牛。
examples.english_sentence: There are several cowsheds on the farm used to raise dairy cows.

mandarin_meaning: 牛排
english_meaning: steak
explanation_mandarin: 指一塊牛肉，通常為切成片或厚塊，常以煎、燒、扒等方式烹調（即牛排）。
explanation_english: Refers to a cut of beef (steak), typically a slice or thick piece of beef cooked by pan-frying, grilling, or broiling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食牛扒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 ngau4 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃牛排。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat steak tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你鍾意幾成熟嘅牛扒？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung1 ji3 gei2 sing4 suk6 ge3 ngau4 paa4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你喜欢几分熟的牛排？
examples.english_sentence: How do you like your steak cooked?

mandarin_meaning: 牛百叶（牛的第三胃，俗称牛柏叶，常用于火锅或炒菜的食材）
english_meaning: beef omasum (the omasum or 'leaf tripe', the third stomach of cattle), a common ingredient in hotpot and stir-fries
explanation_mandarin: 牛柏葉指牛的第三個胃（俗稱「百葉」或「葉子胃」），質地像層疊的薄葉，常切片下鍋做火鍋或快炒，口感有嚼勁。
explanation_english: Refers to the beef omasum (also called leaf tripe), the third stomach of cattle. It has layered, leaf-like folds, is typically sliced and used in hotpot or stir-fries, and has a chewy texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食火鍋，要唔要落牛柏葉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 fo2 gwo1, jiu3 m4 jiu3 lok6 ngau4 baak3 jip6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃火锅，要不要放牛百叶？
examples.english_sentence: We're having hotpot tonight — do you want to add beef omasum?

mandarin_meaning: 牛柳（牛里脊或切成細條的牛肉）
english_meaning: Beef tenderloin / strips of beef (used in stir-fries and other dishes)
explanation_mandarin: 指用牛里脊或牛肉切成的細長條，質地較嫩，常用於中式炒菜或西式牛柳料理，也可指以此為主材的菜餚。
explanation_english: Refers to beef tenderloin or strips of beef (cut into thin, tender strips); commonly used in stir-fries or Western-style beef dishes, and can also denote dishes made from such beef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食牛柳炒飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 ngau4 lau5 caau2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃牛柳炒饭。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat beef fried rice (with beef strips) tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 牛百叶（牛的胃的一部分，常作食材）
english_meaning: beef omasum (book tripe), a part of a cow's stomach used as food
explanation_mandarin: 指牛的其中一個胃（通常稱為牛百葉或牛柏葉），質地有層次感，常用作火鍋或炒食的材料。
explanation_english: Refers to one of the cow's stomach compartments (commonly called beef omasum or 'book tripe'). It has layered texture and is commonly used as an ingredient in hot pot and stir-fries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食牛栢葉，打邊爐一定要放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 ngau4 baak3 jip6, daa2 bin1 lou4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡吃牛百葉，火鍋一定要放。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat beef omasum; it's a must-have in hot pot.

mandarin_meaning: 牛栏（圈养牛的围栏、栏舍）
english_meaning: cattle pen; an enclosure for keeping cows
explanation_mandarin: 指用來圈養牛的欄舍或圍欄，也可泛指圈養大型牲畜的場所。
explanation_english: An enclosure or pen used to keep cattle; a structure or fenced area where cows are housed and tended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間農場有個大牛欄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 nung4 coeng4 jau5 go3 daai6 ngau4 laan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間農場有一個大的牛欄。
examples.english_sentence: That farm has a large cattle pen.

mandarin_meaning: 非常高興／開心
english_meaning: extremely happy; overjoyed
explanation_mandarin: 口語化的粵語俗語，用來形容一個人非常高興、興奮或喜出望外，字面上是「像牛那樣高興」，屬於俚語或方言用法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang expression meaning someone is extremely happy or overjoyed. Literally "cow happy," used informally to describe great delight or excitement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢中咗獎，佢牛歡喜晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou3 keoi5 zung1 zo2 zoeng2, keoi5 ngau4 fun1 hei2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他中了獎，他高興極了。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard he'd won the prize, he was overjoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日放假，大家都牛歡喜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 ngau4 fun1 hei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天放假，大家都很高興。
examples.english_sentence: There's a holiday tomorrow; everyone is very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 爱吹牛、夸耀（的行为或人）
english_meaning: to brag; to boast; a braggart
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，廣東話用法，指誇耀或吹噓自己（或別人），也可以指經常吹牛的人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term meaning to brag or boast; can also refer to a person who frequently brags.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日牛殼，話自己乜都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ngau4 hok3, waa6 zi6 gei2 mat1 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是吹牛，说自己什么都会。
examples.english_sentence: He always brags, saying he knows everything.

mandarin_meaning: 牛池湾（地名）
english_meaning: Ngau Chi Wan (place name) — a neighborhood in Kowloon, Hong Kong
explanation_mandarin: 牛池湾是香港九龍的一個地區名稱，位於九龍東部，靠近彩虹、鑽石山等地，為本地社區和交通網絡的一部分。名稱中「牛池」可能與昔日的地理或養牛活動有關，是地名的固有稱呼。
explanation_english: Ngau Chi Wan is a neighborhood name in Kowloon, Hong Kong, located in the eastern part of Kowloon near Choi Hung and Diamond Hill. It is a local residential and transport area. The name 'Ngau Chi' (literally 'ox pond') likely reflects historical local features or activities and is used as a proper place name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺牛池灣附近，返工好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 ngau4 ci4 waan1 fu6 gan6, faan1 gung1 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在牛池湾附近，上班很方便。
examples.english_sentence: I live near Ngau Chi Wan; commuting to work is very convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 牛肉炒河粉（干炒牛河）
english_meaning: beef chow fun; stir-fried flat rice noodles with beef
explanation_mandarin: 一种粤式炒粉，主要材料为宽平的河粉与腌制过的牛肉，常加入葱、豆芽和酱油，讲究“鑊氣”（锅气）和火候。
explanation_english: A Cantonese stir-fried noodle dish made with wide flat rice noodles and marinated beef, often cooked with scallions, bean sprouts and soy sauce; prized for wok hei (wok flavor) and proper high-heat stir-frying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食乜好？我想食牛河。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 mat1 hou2? ngo5 soeng2 sik6 ngau4 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃什么？我想吃牛肉炒河粉。
examples.english_sentence: What should we eat tonight? I want to eat beef chow fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅牛河好出名，鑊氣好足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 ngau4 ho4 hou2 ceot1 ming4, wong6 hei3 hou2 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的牛肉炒河粉很出名，锅气很足。
examples.english_sentence: This cha chaan teng's beef chow fun is famous; it has great wok hei.

mandarin_meaning: 黄油 / 牛油（奶製品，常指塗抹或烘焙用的奶油）
english_meaning: butter (dairy spread used for cooking, baking, or spreading)
explanation_mandarin: 指由牛奶製成的固體奶油，常用於塗抹麵包、煎炸或烘焙。廣東話中「牛油」通常就是黃油、奶油的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to the solid dairy fat made from milk, commonly used for spreading on bread, frying, or baking. In Cantonese, '牛油' typically means butter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋早餐食牛油多士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou2 caan1 sik6 ngau4 jau4 do1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们早餐吃抹了牛油的吐司。
examples.english_sentence: We have buttered toast for breakfast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊牛油未溶晒，等陣先攞出嚟抺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 ngau4 jau4 mei6 jung4 saai3, dang2 zan6 sin1 lo2 ceot1 lai4 maat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块黄油还没融化，等一下再拿出来抹。
examples.english_sentence: This stick of butter hasn't softened yet; wait a bit before taking it out to spread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整蛋糕要用室溫嘅牛油，打出嚟先好鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 daan6 gou1 jiu3 jung6 sat1 wan1 ge3 ngau4 jau4, daa2 ceot1 lai4 sin1 hou2 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做蛋糕要用室温的黄油，打发出来才会松软。
examples.english_sentence: Baking a cake requires room-temperature butter; whipping it at that temperature makes it light and fluffy.

mandarin_meaning: 手滑；笨手笨脚（拿东西不稳、经常掉东西）
english_meaning: butterfingers; clumsy — someone who often drops things or handles things awkwardly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词（口语）/ 名词（俗称）
explanation_mandarin: 「牛油手」是粤语俗语，字面意思是「手像抹了牛油」，用来形容拿东西不稳、经常把东西掉到地上或动作笨拙。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang literally meaning 'butter hands'. It describes someone whose hands are 'slippery' or clumsy — prone to dropping things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都係牛油手，成日拎嘢跌落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 ngau4 jau4 sau2, sing4 jat6 ling1 je5 dit3 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是手滑，经常把东西掉到地上。
examples.english_sentence: You're always butterfingers — you keep dropping things.

mandarin_meaning: 牛油果（鳄梨 / 酪梨）
english_meaning: Avocado
explanation_mandarin: 一種熱帶或亞熱帶的水果，果肉呈奶油狀，富含健康脂肪，常用於沙拉、抹醬或料理中。
explanation_english: A tropical/subtropical fruit with creamy flesh high in healthy fats, commonly used in salads, spreads (like guacamole), and cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗個牛油果，想整沙律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 ngau4 jau4 gwo2, soeng2 zing2 saa1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天買了一個牛油果，想做沙拉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an avocado today and want to make a salad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個牛油果好熟，可以食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngau4 jau4 gwo2 hou2 suk6, ho2 ji5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個牛油果很熟，可以吃。
examples.english_sentence: This avocado is ripe and ready to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 牛油纸（防油紙／烘焙或包食物用的紙）
english_meaning: wax paper / greaseproof paper (paper used to wrap or line for baking)
explanation_mandarin: 一种有防油功能的纸，常用于包裹食物、包三明治或垫在烤盘上以防粘连。香港口語中常用來指代wax paper或parchment-type的食品用紙。
explanation_english: A greaseproof/wax paper used for wrapping food, lining baking trays, or preventing sticking. In Hong Kong Cantonese it commonly refers to the type of food-grade paper used for sandwiches, baking, or packing greasy items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有冇牛油紙？我要用嚟包三文治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 jap6 min6 jau5 mou5 ngau4 jau4 zi2? ngo5 jiu3 jung6 lai4 baau1 saam1 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里面有没有牛油纸？我要用来包三明治。
examples.english_sentence: Is there any wax paper in the kitchen? I need it to wrap sandwiches.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見用法；多作人名，或可能為打字/口誤（非標準詞彙）
english_meaning: Rare/obscure usage; commonly seen as a personal name or possibly a typo/mistake (not a standard lexical item)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 專有名詞（罕見）/非標準詞
explanation_mandarin: 「牛治」並非常見的粵語詞彙。作為詞語沒有固定含義，較常見的是用作人名；在日常書寫或對話中出現亦可能是打字或口誤（例如原意為「牛仔」、「牛志」等）。因此沒有慣用解釋或固定用法。
explanation_english: 「牛治」 is not a common Cantonese lexical item. It has no established meaning and is most plausibly used as a personal name. In everyday contexts it may appear due to a typing or speaking error (for example intended words like "牛仔" or other names). There is no fixed idiomatic usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牛治係我朋友，佢今晚有比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngau4 zi6 hai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5, keoi5 gam1 maan5 jau5 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牛治是我的朋友，他今晚有比賽。
examples.english_sentence: Ngauzhi is my friend; he has a match tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 牛津（指英國的城市或牛津大學）
english_meaning: Oxford (the city or Oxford University)
explanation_mandarin: 「牛津」通常指英國的牛津市或其著名的大學（牛津大學），在中文裡也可用作地名或教育機構名稱。
explanation_english: Refers to Oxford, the city in England, or the University of Oxford; used as a place name or to denote the university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去牛津旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 ngau4 zeon1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去牛津旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to Oxford next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完本科就申請咗入牛津大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 bun2 fo1 zau6 san1 cing2 zo2 jap6 ngau4 zeon1 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读完本科就申请进入牛津大学。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing his undergraduate degree he applied to Oxford University.

mandarin_meaning: 牛津鞋（Oxford 鞋，一種系帶皮鞋）
english_meaning: Oxford shoes (a type of lace-up dress shoe)
explanation_mandarin: 牛津鞋是一種傳統的系帶皮鞋，特徵是鞋面閉合（鞋帶片縫合在鞋面下方），常用於正式或商務場合，源自英國。
explanation_english: Oxford shoes are a traditional lace-up dress shoe characterized by a closed lacing system (the quarters sewn under the vamp). They are commonly worn for formal or business occasions and originated in Britain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住一對黑色牛津鞋，好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 jat1 deoi3 hak1 sik1 ngau4 zeon1 haai4, hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着一双黑色牛津鞋，很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He's wearing a pair of black Oxford shoes; they look very stylish.

mandarin_meaning: 牛熊证
english_meaning: bull/bear certificates (structured warrants used to bet on market rises or falls)
explanation_mandarin: 牛熊證是香港市場常見的一種結構性金融產品，由發行機構（通常為銀行或證券公司）發行，分為牛證（押注標的上升）和熊證（押注標的下跌）。此類產品通常具有槓桿效應與到期或觸發條款，風險較高，適合具備相應風險承受能力的投資者。
explanation_english: Bull/bear certificates are a type of structured financial product common in Hong Kong, issued by banks or brokerages. Bull certificates bet on the underlying asset rising; bear certificates bet on it falling. They typically have leverage and expiry or knock-out features, carry higher risk, and are suitable only for investors with appropriate risk tolerance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近好多投資者都買牛熊證搏短線利潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 tau4 zi1 ze2 dou1 maai5 ngau4 hung4 zing3 bok3 dyun2 sin3 lei6 jeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近很多投资者都买牛熊证博取短线利润。
examples.english_sentence: Recently many investors have been buying bull/bear certificates to try to earn short-term profits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牛熊證有槓桿效應，風險較高，唔啱風險承受能力低嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngau4 hung4 zing3 jau5 gong3 gon1 haau6 jing3, fung1 him2 gaau3 gou1, m4 aap3 fung1 him2 sing4 sau6 nang4 lik6 dai1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牛熊证有杠杆效应，风险较高，不适合风险承受能力低的人。
examples.english_sentence: Bull/bear certificates have leverage effects and higher risks; they're not suitable for people with low risk tolerance.

mandarin_meaning: 公牛、牛犢（口語）；有時作比喻，形容人粗獷或倔強（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: a bull / calf (literal); colloquially used to describe a rough, stubborn, or boorish person (informal/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「牛牯」字面上指牛的雄性或小牛。在廣東話的口語或某些方言用法中，有時會把它用來比喻人，帶有粗獷、倔強或粗魯的含義，屬於口語或俚語用法，語氣可帶貶義。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a bull or calf. In Cantonese colloquial or regional usage it can be used figuratively to describe someone who is rough, stubborn, or boorish. This is informal/slang and can carry a derogatory tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢頭牛牯好肥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tau4 ngau4 gu2 hou2 fei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這頭牛很肥。
examples.english_sentence: This bull is very fat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個牛牯，唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 ngau4 gu2, m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個倔強的人，不肯認錯。
examples.english_sentence: He's a stubborn person and won't admit he's wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 牛王（字面為「牛的王」；亦常指民間信仰中的牛王爺或以此命名的廟宇）
english_meaning: Ox King (literally 'king of oxen'); commonly refers to the Ox King deity (牛王爺) in folk religion or to temples/places named after that deity
explanation_mandarin: 「牛王」可作字面解釋，指牛中之王；在華南及粵語文化圈常見用法是指民間信仰中的牛王爺（地方廟宇中供奉的神祇），有時也出現在地名或廟名中。
explanation_english: “牛王” can be read literally as the king of oxen. In southern Chinese and Cantonese cultural contexts it commonly refers to the Ox King deity (牛王爺) worshipped in local folk religion, and the term appears in temple names and place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廟入面供奉住牛王，村民成日去拜祭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: miu6 jap6 min6 gung1 fung6 zyu6 ngau4 wong4, cyun1 man4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 baai3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廟裡供奉着牛王，村民經常去祭拜。
examples.english_sentence: The temple enshrines the Ox King; villagers often go to worship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻牛好大隻，真係有牛王嘅氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 ngau4 hou2 daai6 zek3, zan1 hai6 jau5 ngau4 wong4 ge3 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那頭牛很大，真有牛王的氣勢。
examples.english_sentence: That ox is very large and really has the presence of an Ox King.

mandarin_meaning: 非標準或罕見詞彙，常見為誤寫或誤稱；可能指地名、廟名或綽號（例如誤寫為「牛頭角」或與「牛王廟」混淆）
english_meaning: A non-standard or rare term; often a misspelling/misnaming. May refer to a place name, a temple name, or a nickname (commonly confused with place names like Ngau Tau Kok or Ngau Wong Temple).
explanation_mandarin: 「牛王頭」並非常見的粵語詞彙。實務中多數情況下是拼寫或口誤，容易與「牛頭角」（Ngau Tau Kok，地名）或「牛王廟」（某些地方的廟宇）混淆。也可能是某地或某人的綽號，但並無廣泛標準用法。使用時應根據上下文確認原意。
explanation_english: Not a commonly used Cantonese word. In practice it is often a spelling or naming mistake and is frequently confused with place names such as Ngau Tau Kok (牛頭角) or with Ngau Wong Temple (牛王廟). It might also appear as a local place-name or personal nickname, but there is no widely accepted standard meaning. Verify context before using.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽過叫「牛王頭」嗰間舊廟未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 gwo3 giu3 ngau4 wong4 tau4 go2 gaan1 gau6 miu6 mei6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你听过叫「牛王头」的那座旧庙吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you heard of that old temple called "牛王頭"?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時人哋會將「牛頭角」寫錯做「牛王頭」，要小心分辨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 jan4 dei6 wui5 zoeng1 ngau4 tau4 gok3 se2 co3 zou6 ngau4 wong4 tau4, jiu3 siu2 sam1 fan1 bin6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时人们会把「牛头角」写错成「牛王头」，要小心分辨。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes people misspell "Ngau Tau Kok" as "牛王頭"—be careful to distinguish them.

mandarin_meaning: 牛痘（指牛痘病毒或用牛痘接种以预防天花）
english_meaning: cowpox (the cowpox virus; historically used as an inoculation to prevent smallpox)
explanation_mandarin: 牛痘是由牛痘病毒引起的一種皮膚病。歷史上利用牛痘或其痘疹物質進行接種，以產生對天花的免疫，這也是最早的疫苗接種方法之一。
explanation_english: Cowpox is a skin disease caused by the cowpox virus. Historically, material from cowpox lesions was used for inoculation to induce immunity against smallpox — an early form of vaccination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前人會用牛痘接種嚟預防天花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 jan4 wui5 jung6 ngau4 dau6 zip3 zung3 lai4 jyu6 fong4 tin1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们会用牛痘接种来预防天花。
examples.english_sentence: People used to use cowpox inoculation to prevent smallpox.

mandarin_meaning: 牛腩中脂肪較多、顏色偏白的部位，常用於燉、煲、紅燒等烹調方式
english_meaning: the whiter, fattier portion of beef brisket (used for braising/stewing); a cut with both meat and visible fat
explanation_mandarin: 「牛白腩」是粵語中描述牛腩內較白且含脂肪較多的部位。此部位口感軟糯帶油香，適合長時間燉煮或紅燒，常見於廣東、香港料理的牛腩菜式中。
