examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢物慾好強，成日想買最新嘅電子產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat6 juk6 hou2 koeng5, sing4 jat6 soeng2 maai5 zeoi3 san1 ge3 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他物欲很強，總是想買最新的電子產品。
examples.english_sentence: He has strong material desires and is always wanting to buy the latest electronic products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會嘅物慾文化令到好多人成日覺得好大壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 ge3 mat6 juk6 man4 faa3 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社會的物欲文化讓很多人總是感到很大的壓力。
examples.english_sentence: The society's materialistic culture makes many people constantly feel great pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家學緊點樣抑制自己嘅物慾，唔想成日亂花錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hok6 gan2 dim2 joeng6 jik1 zai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 mat6 juk6, m4 soeng2 sing4 jat6 lyun6 faa1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在學著如何抑制自己的物欲，不想總是亂花錢。
examples.english_sentence: He is now learning how to curb his material desires; he doesn't want to keep spending money recklessly.

mandarin_meaning: 物換星移（wù huàn xīng yí）：形容時代變遷或世事巨變，世道、景象大不相同。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning that times change and the world undergoes great transformations; things are no longer as they once were.
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述時間流逝所帶來的巨大變化，常用以感慨世事變遷、景象或人事已非。
explanation_english: Used to describe profound changes brought by the passage of time; often used to express nostalgia or surprise that circumstances, places, or people are no longer the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 十年過去，物換星移，家鄉已經改變咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sap6 nin4 gwo3 heoi3, mat6 wun6 sing1 ji4, gaa1 hoeng1 ji5 ging1 goi2 bin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 十年过去，物换星移，家乡已经改变了。
examples.english_sentence: Ten years have passed; times have changed and my hometown has already transformed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 轉眼之間，物換星移，呢條街已經變得面目全非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun3 ngaan5 zi1 gaan1, mat6 wun6 sing1 ji4, ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ji5 ging1 bin3 dak1 min6 muk6 cyun4 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 转眼之间，物换星移，这条街已经面目全非。
examples.english_sentence: In the blink of an eye, times changed and this street looks completely different.

mandarin_meaning: 材料；物资（也可指媒體或宣傳素材）
english_meaning: materials; supplies; (also) media assets or promotional materials
explanation_mandarin: 指用來製造、建造、加工或提供服務的材料或物資；在媒體與市場推廣領域也可指宣傳素材或影像素材等。
explanation_english: Refers to materials or supplies used in manufacturing, construction, or processing; in media and marketing contexts it can also mean promotional assets or footage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要訂購更多物料先可以開工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 deng6 gou3 gang1 do1 mat6 liu6 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要订购更多物料才能开工。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to order more materials before it can start work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宣傳物料已經準備好，可以發佈喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun1 cyun4 mat6 liu6 ji5 ging1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 ho2 ji5 faat3 bou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宣传物料已经准备好，可以发布了。
examples.english_sentence: The promotional materials are ready and can be released.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要搵新嘅物料供應商，因為舊嗰間停產咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 san1 ge3 mat6 liu6 gung1 jing3 soeng1, jan1 wai6 gau6 go2 gaan1 ting4 caan2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要找新的物料供应商，因为旧的那家停产了。
examples.english_sentence: They need to find a new supplier for materials because the old one has stopped production.

mandarin_meaning: 物有所值 (wù yǒu suǒ zhí)：表示某物的價值與價格相符，值得購買或投資。
english_meaning: Indicates that something is worth its cost; good value for money.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某件商品或服務的價值與價格相符，買了不覺得浪費，值得花這個錢。
explanation_english: Used to describe a product or service whose value matches its price — you don't feel it was a waste; it's worth the expense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機雖然貴，但物有所值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 seoi1 jin4 gwai3, daan6 mat6 jau5 so2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机虽然贵，但物有所值。
examples.english_sentence: Although this phone is expensive, it's worth the price.

mandarin_meaning: 物业（房产、不动产或负责管理住宅/商用建筑的小区/大厦的管理公司）
english_meaning: property; real estate; (property) management/company
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粤语中，“物業”常指不动产或房地产，也常用来指负责管理住宅大厦或小区的物业管理公司或其提供的管理服务。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, “物業” commonly refers to real estate/property or, frequently, the property management company and the management services for residential or commercial buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要同物業申請維修電梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tung4 mat6 jip6 san1 cing2 wai4 sau1 din6 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要向物业申请维修电梯。
examples.english_sentence: You need to apply to the property management to repair the elevator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個物業最近升咗價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mat6 jip6 zeoi3 gan6 sing1 zo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个物业最近涨价了。
examples.english_sentence: The price of this property has gone up recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 物業公司會收管理費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mat6 jip6 gung1 si1 wui5 sau1 gun2 lei5 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 物业公司会收管理费。
examples.english_sentence: The property management company will collect management fees.

mandarin_meaning: 物業稅 / 房產稅 (對房地產或物業徵收的稅)
english_meaning: property tax (a tax levied on property or real estate)
explanation_mandarin: 針對房地產或物業向擁有者徵收的稅款，通常由政府按物業價值或其他標準計算並徵收。
explanation_english: A tax imposed on property or real estate, usually calculated and collected by the government from property owners based on property value or other criteria.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會調高物業稅，業主好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 diu6 gou1 mat6 jip6 seoi3, jip6 zyu2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會提高物業稅，業主很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: The government says it will raise property taxes; property owners are worried.

mandarin_meaning: 物業稅；房產稅（對房地產或物業擁有者徵收的稅）
english_meaning: property tax; a tax levied on real property or property owners
explanation_mandarin: 對擁有房地產或物業的個人或機構徵收的稅款，通常按物業價值或租金計算。
explanation_english: A tax imposed on ownership of real property, typically calculated based on property value or rental income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓之後，每年都要俾物業税同差餉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau4 zi1 hau6, mui5 nin4 dou1 jiu3 bei2 mat6 jip6 seoi3 tung4 caa1 saang3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買房之後，每年都要付物業稅和差餉。
examples.english_sentence: After buying a property, you have to pay property tax and rates every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話會調整物業税，業主好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 wui5 tiu4 zing2 mat6 jip6 seoi3, jip6 zyu2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說會調整物業稅，業主很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: The government said it will adjust property tax; property owners are worried.

mandarin_meaning: 物极必反（wù jí bì fǎn）：事物发展到极端时，往往会向相反方向转化。
english_meaning: When things reach an extreme, they will tend to reverse; extremes often lead to the opposite result.
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物發展到極端時，常常會出現相反的結果或走向相反的方向。
explanation_english: States that when something reaches an extreme, it is likely to turn in the opposite direction or produce opposite results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做事太極端，物極必反，可能會適得其反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 si6 taai3 gik6 dyun1, mat6 gik6 bit1 faan2, ho2 nang4 wui5 sik1 dak1 kei4 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做事太極端，物極必反，可能會適得其反。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do things too extremely; extremes often lead to the opposite result—you might end up achieving the opposite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓市過熱太耐，終有回落，真係物極必反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau4 si5 gwo3 jit6 taai3 noi6, zung1 jau5 wui4 lok6, zan1 hai6 mat6 gik6 bit1 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港房市過熱太久，終會回落，真是物極必反。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's property market overheated for too long; it's bound to fall back—truly, extremes turn into their opposite.

mandarin_meaning: 物归原主（把物品或權利歸還給原來的主人）
english_meaning: to return something to its original/rightful owner; figuratively, to restore something to its original state or rightful party
explanation_mandarin: 表示把失落或被佔有的物品、權利等歸還給原來的主人；也可用作比喻，指把事物恢復到原狀或交還給應有的人。
explanation_english: Means returning lost or wrongly held property or rights to their original owner; can also be used figuratively to indicate restoring something to its original state or giving it back to the rightful party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過比對，遺失嘅相機終於物歸原主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 bei2 deoi3, wai4 sat1 ge3 soeng1 gei1 zung1 jyu1 mat6 gwai1 jyun4 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過比對，遺失的相機終於物歸原主。
examples.english_sentence: After comparing, the lost camera was finally returned to its original owner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊收藏經過查證之後會物歸原主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 sau1 cong4 ging1 gwo3 caa4 zing3 zi1 hau6 wui5 mat6 gwai1 jyun4 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些舊收藏經過查證之後會物歸原主。
examples.english_sentence: These old collectibles will be returned to their original owner after verification.

mandarin_meaning: 物流 (wùliú) — 物資的運輸、儲存與配送
english_meaning: logistics — the transportation, storage, and distribution of goods
explanation_mandarin: 指商品、原料等從生產到消費過程中，涉及運輸、倉儲、包裝與配送等一系列管理與作業活動的系統或服務。
explanation_english: Refers to the systems and activities involved in moving goods from production to consumption, including transportation, warehousing, packaging, and distribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅物流做得好快，貨品兩日就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 mat6 lau4 zou6 dak1 hou2 faai3, fo3 ban2 loeng5 jat6 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司的物流做得很快，貨品兩天就到。
examples.english_sentence: This company's logistics are very fast; the goods arrive in two days.

mandarin_meaning: 物理（wùlǐ），指研究物質、能量及其相互作用的科學
english_meaning: physics (the scientific study of matter, energy, and their interactions)
explanation_mandarin: 物理是一門自然科學，主要研究物質的性質、能量的轉換以及各種基本相互作用，例如力、電、磁、熱等現象。
explanation_english: Physics is a natural science that studies the properties of matter, the conversion of energy, and fundamental interactions such as forces, electricity, magnetism, and heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學修讀物理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 daai6 hok6 sau1 duk6 mat6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學修讀物理。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying physics at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做物理實驗好危險，注意安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 mat6 lei5 sat6 jim6 hou2 ngai4 him2, zyu3 ji3 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做物理實驗很危險，注意安全。
examples.english_sentence: Doing physics experiments can be dangerous; pay attention to safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 物理同化學係兩門唔同但有關聯嘅科目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mat6 lei5 tung4 faa3 hok6 hai6 loeng5 mun4 m4 tung4 daan6 jau5 gwaan1 lyun6 ge3 fo1 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 物理和化學是兩門不同但有關聯的科目。
examples.english_sentence: Physics and chemistry are two different but related subjects.

mandarin_meaning: 物理学 (wùlǐ xué)
english_meaning: physics
explanation_mandarin: 物理學是自然科學的一個分支，研究物質、能量、力以及它們之間的相互作用與規律。
explanation_english: Physics is the natural science that studies matter, energy, forces, and the interactions and laws governing them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺大學讀緊物理學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 daai6 hok6 duk6 gan2 mat6 lei5 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在大學讀物理學。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying physics at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 物理學解釋到重力點樣運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mat6 lei5 hok6 gaai2 sik1 dou3 zung6 lik6 dim2 joeng6 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 物理学解释了重力如何作用。
examples.english_sentence: Physics explains how gravity works.

mandarin_meaning: 物理治疗 / 物理療法（通过运动、手法、电疗等方法恢复或改善肌肉、关节及运动功能的医疗手段）
english_meaning: physical therapy (physiotherapy) — a healthcare treatment using exercises, manual techniques, electrotherapy, etc., to restore or improve movement, function, and relieve pain
explanation_mandarin: 利用運動、手法、電療等方法，幫助受傷或功能受限的肌肉、關節及神經恢復或改善的一種醫療康復治療方式。
explanation_english: A branch of healthcare and rehabilitation that uses exercise, manual therapy, electrotherapy and other techniques to help injured or impaired muscles, joints, and nerves recover or improve function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議佢做物理治療，等條膝頭復原。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji3 keoi5 zou6 mat6 lei5 zi6 liu4, dang2 tiu4 sat1 tau4 fuk6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议他做物理治疗，让膝盖恢复。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor recommended he have physical therapy so his knee can recover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做物理治療要有恆心，同時配合家居練習先有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 mat6 lei5 zi6 liu4 jiu3 jau5 hang4 sam1, tung4 si4 pui3 hap6 gaa1 geoi1 lin6 zaap6 sin1 jau6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做物理治疗需要有恒心，同时配合居家练习才有效。
examples.english_sentence: Doing physical therapy requires perseverance and following home exercises to be effective.

mandarin_meaning: 物产（wù chǎn）：指某地出产的产品或天然资源
english_meaning: produce; products or natural resources produced by a region
explanation_mandarin: 「物產」通常指一個地區出產的農產品、海產或其他天然資源，常用於描述地方特產或資源分布。
explanation_english: “物產” refers to goods or natural resources produced in a particular area — for example agricultural produce, seafood, or other local resources. It is often used to describe regional specialties or resource endowments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東嘅物產好豐富，有好多海鮮同水果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 ge3 mat6 caan2 hou2 fung1 fu3, jau5 hou2 do1 hoi2 sin1 tung4 seoi2 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 广东的物产很丰富，有很多海鲜和水果。
examples.english_sentence: Guangdong's local produce is very rich; there are lots of seafood and fruits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區嘅天然物產要好好保護，唔好亂開採。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 tin1 jin4 mat6 caan2 jiu3 hou2 hou2 bou2 wu6, m4 hou2 lyun6 hoi1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地区的天然物产需要好好保护，不要乱开采。
examples.english_sentence: The natural resources of this area need to be well protected; don’t exploit them recklessly.

mandarin_meaning: 物尽其用（wù jìn qí yòng）：充分利用事物或資源的功能，讓東西不被浪費。
english_meaning: Make full use of something; utilize resources to their fullest so nothing is wasted.
explanation_mandarin: 出自文言，指把事物或資源盡其所能地使用，避免浪費。
explanation_english: A classical Chinese idiom meaning to make the best possible use of things or resources, avoiding waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司應該物盡其用，將舊電腦翻新畀新同事用，唔好浪費資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jing1 goi1 mat6 zeon6 kei4 jung6, zoeng1 gau6 din6 nou5 faan1 san1 bei2 san1 tung4 si6 jung6, m4 hou2 long6 fai3 zi1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司應該物盡其用，把舊電腦翻新給新同事使用，不要浪費資源。
examples.english_sentence: The company should make full use of resources — refurbish old computers for new staff to use; don't waste resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽教我買嘢要物盡其用，舊衫可以改造成圍巾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 gaau3 ngo5 maai5 je5 jiu3 mat6 zeon6 kei4 jung6, gau6 saam1 ho2 ji5 goi2 zou6 sing4 wai4 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽教我買東西要物盡其用，舊衣服可以改造成圍巾。
examples.english_sentence: Mom taught me to make the best use of purchases; old clothes can be turned into scarves.

mandarin_meaning: 物种（指生物分类单位：种）
english_meaning: species (a biological classification unit)
explanation_mandarin: 指生物分類上的基本單元，通常代表具有相似形態並能互相繁殖且產生可育後代的一群個體。
explanation_english: Refers to the basic unit of biological classification, typically a group of organisms with similar characteristics that can interbreed and produce fertile offspring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個島上有好多稀有物種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dou2 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 hei1 jau5 mat6 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个岛上有很多稀有物种。
examples.english_sentence: There are many rare species on this island.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家發現咗一個新物種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 mat6 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家发现了一个新物种。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists discovered a new species.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保護物種係我哋嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 wu6 mat6 zung2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保护物种是我们的责任。
examples.english_sentence: Protecting species is our responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 物竞天择（古語／成語），意指事物競爭而由自然或環境選擇存活者，現多用作「適者生存」「優勝劣汰」之意。
english_meaning: An idiom meaning 'survival of the fittest' or 'natural selection'; competition among things with selection by nature—used to describe 'the strong survive, the weak perish' or 'survival of the fittest'.
explanation_mandarin: 源自文言，字面為「事物競爭、由天（自然）選擇」，現用來形容在競爭環境中強者生存、弱者被淘汰的現象，常用於描述社會或市場競爭。
explanation_english: Originally a classical phrase meaning 'things compete and heaven (nature) selects.' It is used to describe situations where competition leads to the survival of the strong and elimination of the weak—commonly applied to social or market competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商業競爭入面，物競天擇，好多細公司都被淘汰咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 jip6 ging3 zang1 jap6 min6, mat6 ging3 tin1 zaak6, hou2 do1 sai3 gung1 si1 dou1 bei6 tou4 taai3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商业竞争中，物竞天择，许多小公司被淘汰了。
examples.english_sentence: In business competition, it's survival of the fittest; many small companies have been eliminated.

mandarin_meaning: 物联网（指透過感測器與網路連接的各種實體裝置與系統）
english_meaning: Internet of Things (IoT) — network of physical devices, vehicles, home appliances, and other items embedded with electronics, sensors, and network connectivity
explanation_mandarin: 物聯網是指將各種實體裝置透過感測器、通訊和網路連結起來，使其能收集和交換數據，從而實現遠端監控、自動化和智能化應用。
explanation_english: The Internet of Things refers to connecting physical devices via sensors, communication, and networks so they can collect and exchange data, enabling remote monitoring, automation, and intelligent applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多家用電器都有物聯網功能，可以用手機遙控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gaa1 jung6 din6 hei3 dou1 jau5 mat6 lyun4 mong5 gung1 nang4, ho2 ji5 jung6 sau2 gei1 jiu4 hung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多家用電器都有物聯網功能，可以用手機遙控。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many household appliances have IoT features and can be controlled by smartphone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 物聯網喺智慧城市發展上好重要，能夠改善交通同能源管理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mat6 lyun4 mong5 hai2 zi3 wai6 sing4 si5 faat3 zin2 soeng6 hou2 zung3 jiu3, nang4 gau3 goi2 sin3 gaau1 tung4 nang4 jyun4 gun2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 物聯網在智慧城市發展上很重要，能夠改善交通和能源管理。
examples.english_sentence: The Internet of Things is very important for the development of smart cities; it can improve traffic and energy management.

mandarin_meaning: 物色；尋找、挑選（人或物）
english_meaning: to look for; to seek out; to select (especially people or items)
explanation_mandarin: 表示尋找或挑選某人或某物，常用於物色人選、物色貨品等場合。
explanation_english: To look for or select someone or something; often used for scouting candidates or sourcing items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家要物色一個新經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 mat6 sik1 jat1 go3 san1 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在要物色一個新的經理。
examples.english_sentence: The company is now looking for a new manager.

mandarin_meaning: 物证（指用于证明案件事实的有形证据）
english_meaning: physical evidence; material evidence (tangible items used to prove facts in a case)
explanation_mandarin: 指在刑事或民事案件中，用來證明或支持某一事實的有形物品或痕跡，例如指紋、血跡、凶器、衣物等。
explanation_english: Refers to tangible items or traces in criminal or civil cases used to prove or support a fact, such as fingerprints, bloodstains, weapons, clothing, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺現場搵到好多物証，對調查好有幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 wan2 dou3 hou2 do1 mat6 zing3, deoi3 diu6 caa4 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在现场找到很多物证，对调查很有帮助。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a lot of physical evidence at the scene, which was very helpful for the investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 物語（源自日語），指故事、敘事；相當於「故事」或「傳說」
english_meaning: A tale or narrative (derived from Japanese 'monogatari'); a story or series of tales, often used in titles or literary contexts.
explanation_mandarin: 源自日語「物語（ものがたり）」，在粵語或書面語中用來表示故事或敘事作品，常見於作品標題或文學用語。
explanation_english: Borrowed from Japanese 'monogatari', used to denote a story or narrative. Commonly appears in titles or as a literary term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書叫《海邊物語》，講述一段細膩嘅成長故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 giu3 《hoi2 bin1 mat6 jyu5》，gong2 seot6 jat1 dyun6 sai3 nei6 ge3 sing4 zoeng2 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書叫《海邊物語》，講述一段細膩的成長故事。
examples.english_sentence: This book is called 'Seaside Monogatari' and tells a delicate coming-of-age story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣劇名叫《物語》，每集都係一個獨立嘅人生片段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 kek6 ming4 giu3 《mat6 jyu5》，mui5 zaap6 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 duk6 lap6 ge3 jan4 saang1 pin3 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這齣劇名為《物語》，每一集都是一個獨立的人生片段。
examples.english_sentence: This drama is titled 'Monogatari'; each episode is a standalone slice of life.

mandarin_meaning: 物证 (wùzhèng)
english_meaning: physical evidence; material evidence
explanation_mandarin: 指在刑事或民事案件中，能證明事實或相關情況的實物或物品，如刀、血跡、指紋等。
explanation_english: Refers to tangible objects or materials used as proof in legal contexts (e.g., knives, bloodstains, fingerprints) to establish facts in criminal or civil cases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺案發現場搵到好多物證，對破案好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 on3 faat3 jin6 coeng4 wan2 dou3 hou2 do1 mat6 zing3, deoi3 po3 on3 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在案發現場找到很多物證，對破案很重要。
examples.english_sentence: The police found many pieces of physical evidence at the crime scene; they were important for solving the case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把刀可以做物證送去化驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 dou1 ho2 ji5 zou6 mat6 zing3 sung3 heoi3 faa3 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這把刀可以作為物證送去化驗。
examples.english_sentence: This knife can be used as physical evidence and sent for testing.

mandarin_meaning: 物象（事物的外在形象或表象）
english_meaning: object image; the appearance or representation of objects/phenomena
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的外在形象或表象，常用於藝術、哲學或社會文化語境，表示可感知或被描繪的物體或現象的樣貌。
explanation_english: Refers to the outward appearance or representation of objects or phenomena; commonly used in art, philosophy, or cultural contexts to denote the perceivable or depicted form of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫入面嘅物象好抽象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 jap6 min6 ge3 mat6 zoeng6 hou2 cau1 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画里面的物象很抽象。
examples.english_sentence: The objects (imagery) in this painting are very abstract.

mandarin_meaning: 物资 (wùzī)，指供應或分發的物品與資源
english_meaning: supplies; materials; resources (goods or materials provided for use, especially relief or operational supplies)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於生活、工作或救援等的物品與資源，如食物、藥品、設備等。
explanation_english: Refers to goods or resources used for daily life, work, or relief efforts—for example food, medical supplies, equipment, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風過後，政府派咗好多物資俾受災嘅居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai1 fung1 gwo3 hau6, zing3 fu2 paai3 zo2 hou2 do1 mat6 zi1 bei2 sau6 zoi1 ge3 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风过后，政府派了很多物资给受灾的居民。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, the government sent a lot of supplies to the affected residents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院短缺醫療物資，需要盡快補充。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 dyun2 kyut3 ji1 liu4 mat6 zi1, seoi1 jiu3 zeon2 faai3 bou2 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院短缺医疗物资，需要尽快补充。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital is short of medical supplies and needs urgent replenishment.

mandarin_meaning: 物质；物料；物品；有形的實體，也可指物質條件（相對於精神）
english_meaning: matter; substance; material; material conditions (as opposed to spiritual)
explanation_mandarin: 指有形的實體或材料，也用來表示生活的物質條件或物質主義的概念。
explanation_english: Refers to physical matter or materials; can also denote material conditions of life or the concept of materialism as opposed to spiritual aspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件嘢係純粹嘅物質，冇靈魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 je5 hai6 seon4 seoi3 ge3 mat6 zat1, mou5 ling4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這東西是純粹的物質，沒有靈魂。
examples.english_sentence: This thing is purely material and has no soul.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢重視物質生活，多過精神層面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 si6 mat6 zat1 sang1 wut6, do1 gwo3 zing1 san4 cang4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他重視物質生活，勝過精神層面。
examples.english_sentence: He values material life more than the spiritual side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家研究新型物質嘅性質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 jin4 gau3 san1 jing4 mat6 zat1 ge3 sing3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科學家研究新型物質的性質。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists study the properties of new substances.

mandarin_meaning: 物品的價值超過其價格；物有所值、很划算
english_meaning: worth more than its price; excellent value for money
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容商品或服務的品質、功能等超出其價格，覺得很划算。
explanation_english: Used to describe goods or services whose quality or usefulness exceeds their price, i.e., something that is very good value for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻手錶價錢唔貴，質量又好，真係物超所值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sau2 biu1 gaa3 cin2 m4 gwai3, zat1 loeng6 jau6 hou2, zan1 hai6 mat6 ciu1 so2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表价格不贵，质量又好，真是物超所值。
examples.english_sentence: This watch isn't expensive and has good quality—it's really great value for money.

jyutping: mat6 lei4 hoeng1 gwai3, jan4 lei4 hoeng1 zin6
mandarin_meaning: 物品離開故鄉反而更值錢；人離開故鄉反而更易受冷落或被看輕。
english_meaning: Things become more valued when taken away from their native place, while people are often looked down upon or treated worse when they leave their homeland.
explanation_mandarin: 一句俗語，用來描述物品離開產地可能變得更有價值，但人離鄉後有時會遭遇歧視或地位下降，反映社會對外來者的不同待遇。
explanation_english: A proverb describing how goods may fetch higher prices outside their place of origin, while people who leave their homeland can be treated with less respect or lose status — commenting on social attitudes toward outsiders or emigrants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲本地手工藝品帶去外國賣通常賣得好貴，真係物離鄉貴；人移居外國，有時就覺得人離鄉賤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 bun2 dei6 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2 daai3 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 maai6 tung1 soeng4 maai6 dak1 hou2 gwai3, zan1 hai6 mat6 lei4 hoeng1 gwai3; jan4 ji4 geoi1 ngoi6 gwok3, jau5 si4 zau6 gok3 dak1 jan4 lei4 hoeng1 zin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本地的手工艺品拿到外国去卖通常能卖很贵，真是“物离乡贵”；人移居国外，有时就会感到“人离乡贱”。
examples.english_sentence: Local handicrafts often sell for high prices when taken abroad — truly 'things are dear away from home'; when people emigrate, they sometimes feel treated as lesser — 'people are cheap away from home'.

mandarin_meaning: 物体（指具有质量和体积的实体）
english_meaning: object; physical body (an entity with mass and volume)
explanation_mandarin: 指具有質量和體積、可以被觀察或測量的實體，例如固體、液體或氣體中的具體個體或形體。
explanation_english: Refers to a physical entity that has mass and volume and can be observed or measured, such as an object in solid, liquid, or gas form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個物體係固體定係液體？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mat6 tai2 hai6 gu3 tai2 ding6 hai6 jik6 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个物体是固体还是液体？
examples.english_sentence: Is this object a solid or a liquid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 測量物體嘅質量需要用天秤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cak1 loeng4 mat6 tai2 ge3 zat1 loeng6 seoi1 jiu3 jung6 tin1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 测量物体的质量需要用天平。
examples.english_sentence: Measuring an object's mass requires a balance.

mandarin_meaning: 雄牛、耕牛（指用來耕作或作役的牛）
english_meaning: male cattle; ox; bullock (often an ox used for plowing or draft work)
explanation_mandarin: “牯”為較書面或方言用字，常指雄性家牛或用作耕作、拉車等役用的牛，亦見於地名或古文中。
explanation_english: “牯” is a more literary or dialectal term referring to a male bovine (ox/bullock), typically one used for plowing or draft work; it also appears in place names and older texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場養咗幾隻牯，用嚟耕田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 joeng5 zo2 gei2 zek3 gu2, jung6 lai4 gang1 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農場養了幾頭牛，用來耕田。
examples.english_sentence: The farm kept several oxen to plow the fields.

mandarin_meaning: 牲（指牲畜、祭祀用的動物；可引申為受害者或被犧牲者）
english_meaning: sacrificial animal; livestock; victim (in some compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示動物，常指供耕作或宰殺的家畜；在祭祀或傳統語境中指用作祭品的動物。該字常見於合成詞，如「牲畜」、「牲口」、「牲禮」。
explanation_english: A character denoting a sacrificial animal or livestock — domesticated animals used for farming or slaughter. It appears in compounds related to sacrifices or animals (e.g. '牲畜', '牲口').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有好多牲畜，主要係牛、羊同豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 sang1 cuk1, zyu2 jiu3 hai6 ngau4, joeng4 tung4 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场里面有很多牲畜，主要是牛、羊和猪。
examples.english_sentence: There are many livestock on the farm, mainly cows, sheep and pigs.

mandarin_meaning: 牲畜；（口語）貶稱，指把人當作畜生般對待或罵人的稱呼
english_meaning: livestock; (colloquially) a derogatory term calling someone an animal/beast
explanation_mandarin: 本詞原本指家畜、牲畜。在廣東話口語中也可作貶稱，用來形容對方像畜生般惡劣或用作罵人的粗話。
explanation_english: Originally denotes livestock/domestic animals. In Cantonese colloquial usage it can also be a derogatory insult used to describe someone as an animal or to say someone behaves like a beast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有好多牲口，好似牛、羊、豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 sang1 hau2, hou2 ci5 ngau4, joeng4, zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農場裡有很多牲畜，例如牛、羊、豬。
examples.english_sentence: There are many livestock on the farm, such as cows, sheep, and pigs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢老婆咁樣，真係禽獸，簡直係牲口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 lou5 po4 gam2 joeng6, zan1 hai6 kam4 sau3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sang1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對他老婆那樣，真是禽獸，簡直就是牲口。
examples.english_sentence: He treats his wife like that — he's a beast, practically an animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好當我係牲口，我都係人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dong3 ngo5 hai6 sang1 hau2, ngo5 dou1 hai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把我當牲口，我也是人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat me like an animal — I'm human too.

mandarin_meaning: 牲畜；家畜（供人飼養用於勞動、食用或生產其他產品的動物）
english_meaning: livestock; domesticated animals raised for labor, food, or products (e.g., cattle, sheep, pigs)
explanation_mandarin: 指人為飼養用作勞動、食用或產生其他產品（如奶、毛等）的家畜。口語中亦可用作貶義，指把人當作畜生。
explanation_english: Refers to domesticated animals kept by humans for labor, food, or production of other goods (e.g., milk, wool). In colloquial use it can also be used derogatorily to liken a person to an animal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有好多牲畜，例如牛、羊同豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 saang1 cuk1, lai6 jyu4 ngau4, joeng4 tung4 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场里面有很多牲畜，例如牛、羊和猪。
examples.english_sentence: There are many livestock on the farm, such as cattle, sheep, and pigs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲牲畜需要定時餵食同打針，農場主人好注重佢哋嘅健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saang1 cuk1 seoi1 jiu3 ding6 si4 wai3 sik6 tung4 daa2 zam1, nung4 coeng4 zyu2 jan4 hou2 zyu3 zung3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些牲畜需要定时喂食和打针，农场主人很重视它们的健康。
examples.english_sentence: The livestock need regular feeding and vaccinations; the farmer pays a lot of attention to their health.

mandarin_meaning: 抵触；冲突；相互对立（多用于「牴触」一词）
english_meaning: to conflict with; to be in contradiction; to oppose (commonly used in the compound '牴觸')
explanation_mandarin: 表示相抵觸、衝突或對立的意思，通常出現在合成詞如「牴觸／抵觸」中，用以描述意見、規定或利益之間的不一致或衝突。
explanation_english: Indicates being in conflict, opposition, or contradiction. Commonly appears in compounds such as '牴觸' (抵触) to describe inconsistencies or clashes between opinions, rules, or interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩條法例有牴觸，政府要處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 tiu4 faat3 lai6 jau5 dai2 cuk1, zing3 fu2 jiu3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這兩條法例有抵觸，政府要處理。
examples.english_sentence: These two laws conflict; the government needs to address it.

mandarin_meaning: 特（tè），表示特殊或與眾不同
english_meaning: special; particular; distinctive
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 副詞（常作前綴或構詞成分）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / adverb (often used as a prefix or morpheme in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示「特殊、不同於一般」，常見於合成詞如「特別」「特色」「特首」等，用作前綴或詞根來表達特殊性。
explanation_english: Indicates something special or distinct. Commonly appears as a prefix or morpheme in compounds (e.g., "special", "distinctive", "chief executive"), conveying exceptional or particular quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅特首今晚會出席記者會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 dak6 sau2 gam1 maan5 wui5 ceot1 zik6 gei3 ze2 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的特首今晚會出席記者會。
examples.english_sentence: The Chief Executive of Hong Kong will attend the press conference tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有好多特色菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 hou2 do1 dak6 sik1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳有很多特色菜。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has many specialty dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我特別鍾意呢首歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak6 bit6 zung1 ji3 ni1 sau2 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我特別喜歡這首歌。
examples.english_sentence: I especially like this song.

mandarin_meaning: 对特殊情况采取特殊处理（特事特办）
english_meaning: to handle special cases in a special way; make special arrangements or exceptions for exceptional circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 表示对于特殊情况采取与一般流程不同的特别处理或安排，常用于政府、机构或单位在例外情况下给予特殊对待。
explanation_english: Indicates taking measures outside the normal procedures to deal with exceptional situations; often used when authorities, organizations, or companies make an exception or special arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次疫情，政府決定對某啲情況特事特辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 jik6 cing4, zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 deoi3 mau5 di1 cing4 fong3 dak6 si6 dak6 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次疫情，政府决定对某些情况特事特办。
examples.english_sentence: During this outbreak, the government decided to handle certain cases with special measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗趕時間交貨，公司對呢個客戶嘅要求特事特辦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gon2 si4 gaan3 gaau1 fo3, gung1 si1 deoi3 ni1 go3 haak3 wu6 ge3 jiu1 kau4 dak6 si6 dak6 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赶时间交货，公司对这个客户的要求特事特办。
examples.english_sentence: To meet the delivery deadline, the company made special arrangements for this customer's requests.

mandarin_meaning: 特使 (tèshǐ)：由国家或政府派出的代表，负责处理特定外交或谈判任务。
english_meaning: special envoy; an emissary sent by a government to carry out a specific diplomatic mission.
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府或國家臨時指派，承擔特定外交、談判或斡旋任務的代表。
explanation_english: A government-appointed representative temporarily sent to perform a specific diplomatic, negotiation, or mediation task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派咗一個特使去協商條約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 zo2 jat1 go3 dak6 si2 heoi3 hip3 soeng1 tiu4 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府派出了一位特使去协商条约。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent a special envoy to negotiate the treaty.

mandarin_meaning: 特例 / 特殊情況；例外
english_meaning: special case; exception
explanation_mandarin: 指與一般規則或慣例不同的特殊情況或例外處理。
explanation_english: Refers to a special situation that differs from the normal rules or routines; an exception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司話今次嘅加薪係特例，唔代表會繼續有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 waa6 gam1 ci3 ge3 gaa1 san1 hai6 dak6 lai6, m4 doi6 biu2 wui5 gai3 zuk6 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司說這次的加薪是特例，不代表以後還會有。
examples.english_sentence: The company said this raise is a special case; it doesn't mean there will be more in the future.

mandarin_meaning: （尤指為特定目的）特別準備／提供
english_meaning: specially prepared; specially provided (for a particular purpose or occasion)
explanation_mandarin: 表示為某特定目的或情況而特別準備或提供某物，視語境可作形容詞或動詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has been specially prepared or provided for a particular purpose or situation; can function as an adjective or verb depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府為防疫特備咗大量口罩同消毒用品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wai6 fong4 jik6 dak6 bei6 zo2 daai6 loeng6 hau2 zoek3 tung4 siu1 duk6 jung6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府為防疫特別準備了大量口罩和消毒用品。
examples.english_sentence: The government specially prepared a large quantity of masks and disinfectant supplies for epidemic prevention.

mandarin_meaning: 特价（以优惠或折扣价格出售）
english_meaning: special price; sale price; discounted price
explanation_mandarin: 表示商品以较低或优惠的价格出售，通常为临时的促销或折扣价。
explanation_english: Indicates an item is being sold at a reduced or promotional price, usually temporarily as part of a sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超級市場而家有好多特價貨，記得買返啲日用品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 ji4 gaa1 jau5 hou2 do1 dak6 gaa3 fo3, gei3 dak1 maai5 faan1 di1 jat6 jung6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市现在有很多特价商品，记得买些日用品。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket has many items on special now; remember to buy some daily essentials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話而家特價，仲送多一年的保養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa6 ji4 gaa1 dak6 gaa3, zung6 sung3 do1 jat1 nin4 bou2 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机现在有特价，还额外赠送一年保修。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is on special now and comes with an extra year of warranty.

mandarin_meaning: 特典（特別贈品、特別版附贈內容）
english_meaning: special bonus / bonus item / special-edition perk
explanation_mandarin: 指隨商品、出版物或活動附送的特別贈品或特別版內的額外內容，常見於漫畫、CD、票務等的促銷或限定版中。
explanation_english: Refers to a special bonus item or extra content included with a product, publication, or event—commonly used for promotional or limited-edition bonuses in manga, CDs, tickets, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買呢套漫畫會有隨書特典，仲有張海報同幾張貼紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 ni1 tou3 maan6 waa2 wui5 jau5 ceoi4 syu1 dak6 din2, zung6 jau5 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 tung4 gei2 zoeng1 tip3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 買這套漫畫會有隨書特典，還有一張海報和幾張貼紙。
examples.english_sentence: Buying this manga volume comes with a bonus (booklet/special item); it also includes a poster and several stickers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 門票包括VIP特典，例如優先入場同簽名海報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mun4 piu3 baau1 kut3 wai4 ai1 pi1 dak6 din2, lai6 jyu4 jau1 sin1 jap6 coeng4 tung4 cim1 ming4 hoi2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 門票包括VIP特典，例如優先入場和簽名海報。
examples.english_sentence: The ticket includes VIP bonuses, such as priority entry and a signed poster.

mandarin_meaning: 特别批准；特地允许
english_meaning: to specially permit; to grant special approval
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事特别批准或允许，常用于正式或书面语境中，含有例外或特殊处理的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates granting special approval or permission for something; often used in formal or written contexts and implies an exception or special arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上司特准我今日早走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 si1 dak6 zeon2 ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上司特准我今天早退。
examples.english_sentence: My boss specially approved my leaving early today.

mandarin_meaning: 特刊（期刊、雜誌或報紙的特別版）
english_meaning: special issue (a special edition of a periodical or publication)
explanation_mandarin: 指期刊、雜誌或報紙為特定主題或重大事件而製作的特別版面，內容通常集中於某一主題的深入報導或專題介紹。
explanation_english: A special issue of a periodical or publication produced to focus on a particular topic or major event; typically contains in-depth reporting or themed articles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館有一本關於攝影嘅特刊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 jau5 jat1 bun2 gwaan1 jyu1 sip3 jing2 ge3 dak6 hon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆有一本关于摄影的特刊。
examples.english_sentence: The library has a special issue about photography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報紙今朝推出咗一期有關選舉嘅特刊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 zi2 gam1 ziu1 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 kei4 jau5 gwaan1 syun2 geoi2 ge3 dak6 hon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报纸今天推出了一期关于选举的特刊。
examples.english_sentence: The newspaper released a special issue today about the election.

mandarin_meaning: 特别 (tèbié)
english_meaning: special; particular; especially
explanation_mandarin: 表示與一般不同、顯得突出或引人注意；作副詞時表示程度或強調「特別地、尤其」。
explanation_english: Indicates something different from the usual or noteworthy; as an adverb it expresses degree or emphasis ('particularly', 'especially').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅天氣好特別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 tin1 hei3 hou2 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的天气很特别。
examples.english_sentence: Today's weather is quite unusual.

mandarin_meaning: 特别行政区 (tèbié xíngzhèngqū)
english_meaning: Special Administrative Region (SAR)
explanation_mandarin: 指在一个主权国家内，依据特定法律和制度享有高度自治权的行政区域，如中国的香港特别行政区和澳门特别行政区。
explanation_english: Refers to an administrative region within a sovereign state that enjoys a high degree of autonomy under specific laws and systems, e.g., Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR in China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個特別行政區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 dak6 bit6 hang4 zing3 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个特别行政区。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a Special Administrative Region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 澳門同樣係一個特別行政區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ou3 mun4 tung4 joeng6 hai6 jat1 go3 dak6 bit6 hang4 zing3 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 澳门同样是一个特别行政区。
examples.english_sentence: Macau is also a Special Administrative Region.

mandarin_meaning: 特务 (tèwù)
english_meaning: secret agent; special agent; operative
explanation_mandarin: 指從事情報、間諜或秘密任務的特殊人員，常用來指從事間諜活動或潛伏工作的特工。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who works on intelligence, espionage, or clandestine missions; a secret agent or operative involved in covert activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人揭發係政府入面嘅特務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 gaai1faat3 hai6 zing3fu2 jap6min6 ge3 dak6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被揭发是政府内部的特务。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed as a government agent.

mandarin_meaning: 特区 / 特别行政区 (tèqū)
english_meaning: special administrative region; special zone
explanation_mandarin: 指具有特殊政治、經濟或行政安排的區域，如香港、澳門等享有一定自治權的地區。
explanation_english: Refers to an area granted special political, economic, or administrative arrangements — for example regions like Hong Kong or Macau that have a degree of autonomy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個特區，有自己嘅法律同經濟制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 dak6 keoi1, jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 faat3 leot6 tung4 ging1 zai3 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个特别行政区，拥有自己的法律和经济制度。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a special administrative region with its own legal and economic systems.

mandarin_meaning: 特区政府 / 特别行政区政府（例如香港特别行政区或澳门特别行政区的政府）
english_meaning: Special Administrative Region (SAR) government
explanation_mandarin: 指香港、澳門等作為特別行政區的地方政府機構，負責該區的行政事務與公共政策。
explanation_english: Refers to the government of a Special Administrative Region (e.g., the Hong Kong SAR Government), responsible for the administration and public policies of that region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 特區政府今日發表一項新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak6 keoi1 zing3 fu2 gam1 jat6 faat3 biu2 jat1 hong6 san1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 特区政府今天发表了一项新政策。
examples.english_sentence: The SAR government announced a new policy today.

mandarin_meaning: 特区护照
english_meaning: Special Administrative Region (SAR) passport
explanation_mandarin: 指由中國的特別行政區（例如香港或澳門）發出的護照，供該區居民作為出入境及國際旅行的證件。
explanation_english: Refers to a passport issued by a Special Administrative Region (e.g., Hong Kong or Macau), used by its residents for international travel and identification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗特區護照，可以免簽去好多國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 dak6 keoi1 wu6 ziu3, ho2 ji5 min5 cim1 heoi3 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了特區護照，可以免簽去很多國家。
examples.english_sentence: He got an SAR passport, so he can travel visa-free to many countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請香港特區護照需要滿足一定嘅資格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 hoeng1 gong2 dak6 keoi1 wu6 ziu3 seoi1 jiu3 mun5 zuk1 jat1 ding6 ge3 zi1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申請香港特区护照需要满足一定的资格。
examples.english_sentence: Applying for a Hong Kong SAR passport requires meeting certain eligibility criteria.

mandarin_meaning: 特意、专门（为某目的而做）
english_meaning: specially; deliberately; with a special purpose
explanation_mandarin: 表示为某个目的或为了某人而专门做某事，强调刻意或特别安排。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something for a particular purpose or person; emphasizes intentionality or a special arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我特地嚟幫你搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak6 dei6 lei4 bong1 nei5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我特地來幫你搬家。
examples.english_sentence: I came specially to help you move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢特地買咗禮物畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak6 dei6 maai5 zo2 lai5 mat6 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他特地買了禮物給你。
examples.english_sentence: He specifically bought a gift for you.

mandarin_meaning: 特定；指定的
english_meaning: specific; designated
explanation_mandarin: 表示特別指明或限定的，具有明確或指定的對象、範圍或用途。
explanation_english: Indicates something specified or designated, with a clear, limited object, scope, or purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係特定嘅規定，唔可以更改。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 dak6 ding6 ge3 gwai1 ding6, m4 ho2 ji5 gang1 goi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是特定的规定，不能更改。
examples.english_sentence: These are specific regulations and cannot be changed.

mandarin_meaning: 特写（鏡頭拉近以突出表情或細節；亦指報刊或節目的專題特寫）
english_meaning: close-up (a photographic/film shot that zooms in to emphasize a subject's expression or detail); feature (article)
explanation_mandarin: 在攝影、電影或電視中，指將鏡頭拉近以突出人物表情或細節的拍攝方式（特寫鏡頭）；在新聞或雜誌中也可指專題式的深入報導（特寫文章）。
explanation_english: In photography, film, or television, a close-up shot that brings the camera near to emphasize a person's expression or a detail. It can also refer to a feature piece in news or magazines that focuses in depth on a subject.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 導演想喺嗰刻落個特寫，突出主角嘅表情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou6 jin2 soeng2 hai6 go2 hak1 lok6 go3 dak6 se2, dat6 ceot1 zyu2 gok3 ge3 biu2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 導演想在那一刻拍個特寫，突出主角的表情。
examples.english_sentence: The director wanted a close-up at that moment to emphasize the protagonist's expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞雜誌有一篇關於佢嘅特寫，講述佢成長嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 zaap6 zi3 jau5 jat1 pin1 gwaan1 jyu1 keoi5 ge3 dak6 se2, gong2 keoi5 sing4 zoeng2 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞雜誌有一篇關於他的特寫，講述他的成長故事。
examples.english_sentence: A news magazine ran a feature on him, telling the story of his upbringing.

mandarin_meaning: 特工（从事秘密或特殊任务的人员，常指秘密特务或间谍）
english_meaning: special agent; secret agent; operative
explanation_mandarin: 指受僱於政府或組織，執行秘密或特殊任務的專業人員，常見於情報、偵察或滲透等工作。
explanation_english: Refers to a person employed by a government or organization who carries out secret or special missions—commonly an intelligence operative, spy, or covert agent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係特務部門嘅特工，依家唔再做呢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 dak6 mou6 bou6 mun4 ge3 dak6 gung1, ji1 gaa1 m4 zoi6 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是特務部門的特工，現在不再做這份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be an operative in a special service unit; now he no longer does that job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部電影講一個特工嘅故事，情節好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 din6 jing2 gong2 jat1 go3 dak6 gung1 ge3 gu3 si6, cing4 zit3 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部電影講述一個特工的故事，情節很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: That movie tells the story of a secret agent; the plot is very suspenseful.

mandarin_meaning: 特征 (tèzhēng)
english_meaning: feature; characteristic; distinguishing trait
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某事物或某人的顯著或可辨別的屬性、標誌或特點。
explanation_english: Used to denote a noticeable or distinguishing attribute, mark, or trait of something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅最大特徵係佢鮮明嘅色彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 dak6 zang1 hai6 keoi5 sin1 ming4 ge3 sik1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫最大的特徵是它鮮明的色彩。
examples.english_sentence: The painting's most prominent characteristic is its vivid colors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新手機嘅一個特徵係可以一日唔充電都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 sau2 gei1 ge3 jat1 go3 dak6 zang1 hai6 ho2 ji5 jat1 jat6 m4 cung1 din6 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新手機的一個特徵是可以一天不用充電。
examples.english_sentence: One feature of the new phone is that it can last a day without charging.

mandarin_meaning: 特快（tèkuài）——特别快，常用于列车、邮递等的快速服务
english_meaning: express; extra-fast (used for services like trains or mail)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 名词（视上下文而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示速度特别快，常用于描述交通或邮递服务，例如“特快列车”“特快专递”。
explanation_english: Indicates especially fast speed; commonly used to describe express services such as express trains or express mail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭特快列車去廣州，會快好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dak6 faai3 lit6 ce1 heoi3 gwong2 zau1, wui5 faai3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐特快列车去广州，会快很多。
examples.english_sentence: We'll take the express train to Guangzhou; it will be much faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢封信我用特快專遞寄出，明日就到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fung1 seon3 ngo5 jung6 dak6 faai3 zyun1 dai6 gei3 ceot1, ming4 jat6 zau6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这封信我用特快专递寄出，明天就能到。
examples.english_sentence: I sent this letter by express delivery; it will arrive tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 特性 (tèxìng)：事物或系統本身的性質、特徵或屬性
english_meaning: characteristic; trait; property
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或人本身具有的性質或特徵，可以用來描述功能、行為或屬性，常用於技術、科學或日常描述中。
explanation_english: Refers to an inherent quality, feature, or attribute of something or someone; used to describe traits, functions, or properties in technical, scientific, or everyday contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機嘅特性係電池耐用同埋相機拍得靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 ge3 dak6 sing3 hai6 din6 ci4 noi6 jung6 tung4 maai4 soeng1 gei1 paak3 dak1 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機的特性是電池耐用和相機拍得好。
examples.english_sentence: This phone's characteristics are a long-lasting battery and a good camera.

mandarin_meaning: （商家）提供的特別優惠或折扣
english_meaning: a special discount; promotional offer
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示商家針對商品或服務推出的特別優惠、折扣或促銷活動。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a special promotional discount or preferential price offered by a seller for goods or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家商場有特惠，買兩件衫有折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 soeng1 coeng4 jau5 dak6 wai6, maai5 loeng5 gin6 saam1 jau5 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在商場有特惠，買兩件衣服有折扣。
examples.english_sentence: The mall currently has a special offer — buy two items of clothing and get a discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今期電子產品有特惠，唔好錯過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 kei4 din6 zi2 caan2 ban2 jau5 dak6 wai6, m4 hou2 cok3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本期電子產品有特惠，不要錯過。
examples.english_sentence: This period's electronics are on special — don't miss it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你係會員，可以用特惠價購買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 wui6 jyun4, ho2 ji5 jung6 dak6 wai6 gaa3 kau3 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你是會員，可以用特惠價購買。
examples.english_sentence: If you're a member, you can buy at a special price.

mandarin_meaning: 特惠金（促销或优惠发放的金额/抵扣券）
english_meaning: promotional credit / special discount cash
explanation_mandarin: 商家或平台为促销活动发放的优惠金额，可用于抵扣消费、作为现金奖励或兑换指定商品/服务。
explanation_english: An amount of promotional credit issued by a merchant or platform during promotions; it can be used to offset purchases, given as a cash reward, or redeemed for specific goods/services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家用呢張信用卡可以拎到二百蚊嘅特惠金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jung6 ni1 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 ho2 ji5 ling1 dou3 ji6 baak3 man1 ge3 dak6-wai6-gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在用这张信用卡可以拿到200元的特惠金。
examples.english_sentence: Right now, using this credit card you can get 200 of promotional credit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電商節期間會發放特惠金畀新用戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 soeng1 zit3 kei4 gaan1 wui5 faat3 fong3 dak6-wai6-gam1 bei2 san1 jung6 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电商节期间会发放特惠金给新用户。
examples.english_sentence: During the e‑commerce festival, promotional credits will be given to new users.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 特惠金只可以用嚟買指定商品，唔適用於其他優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak6-wai6-gam1 zi2 ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 maai5 zi2 ding6 soeng1 ban2, m4 sik1 jung6 jyu1 kei4 taa1 jau1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 特惠金只能用于购买指定商品，不适用于其他优惠。
examples.english_sentence: The promotional credit can only be used to purchase designated items and does not apply to other discounts.

mandarin_meaning: 特意（有意、故意）
english_meaning: specifically; deliberately; on purpose
explanation_mandarin: 表示为了某个目的而特别去做，强调有意为之或特别安排去做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something intentionally or specially for a particular purpose, emphasizing deliberate or planned action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我特意早啲嚟幫你搬嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak6 ji3 zou2 di1 lai4 bong1 nei5 bun1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我特意早点来帮你搬东西。
examples.english_sentence: I came early on purpose to help you move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢特意買咗呢份禮物畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak6 ji3 maai5 zo2 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他特意买了这份礼物给你。
examples.english_sentence: He specifically bought this gift for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使特意，唔使麻煩我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 dak6 ji3, m4 sai2 maa4 faan4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用特意，不用麻烦我。
examples.english_sentence: You don't have to go out of your way; don't bother on my account.

mandarin_meaning: 特技 (tèjì) — 特殊技能；表演或電影中的特技、特效（如危险或高难度的动作或视觉效果）
english_meaning: special skill; stunt; special effect
explanation_mandarin: 指特殊的技能或技藝，也常指表演或電影、電視中的高難度、危險動作或製作出特殊視覺效果的技術。
explanation_english: Refers to a special skill or technique; commonly used for stunts (dangerous/high-difficulty actions) or techniques used in film/TV to create special effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係特技演員，成日要做啲好危險嘅動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dak6 gei6 jin2 jyun4, sing4 jat6 jiu3 zou6 di1 hou2 ngai4 him2 ge3 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是特技演员，经常要做一些很危险的动作。
examples.english_sentence: He is a stunt performer and often has to do very dangerous moves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電影啲爆破場面係用特技整出嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 jing2 di1 baau3 po3 coeng4 min6 hai6 jung6 dak6 gei6 zing2 ceot1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影的爆破场面是用特技做出来的。
examples.english_sentence: The explosion scenes in that movie were produced using stunts/special effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺滑板上有好多特技，跳嗰啲動作好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 waat6 baan2 soeng5 jau5 hou2 do1 dak6 gei6, tiu3 go2 di1 dung6 zok3 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在滑板上会很多特技，那些动作很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He has many tricks on his skateboard; those moves are impressive.

mandarin_meaning: 特技演員／特技人員（負責電影、電視、舞台上危險或高難度動作的人）
english_meaning: stuntman / stunt performer (a professional who performs dangerous or difficult stunts for film, TV, or stage)
explanation_mandarin: 指在電影、電視或舞台製作中，負責執行危險或高難度動作的專業人員，亦常稱為特技演員或替身。
explanation_english: Refers to a professional who performs dangerous or high-skill physical actions for films, television, or stage productions; also called a stunt performer or stunt double.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個特技人，喺片場負責做危險動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 tek6 gei6 jan4, hai2 pin3 coeng4 fu6 zak1 zou6 ngai4 him2 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一名特技人，在片场负责做危险动作。
examples.english_sentence: He is a stuntman who handles dangerous stunts on set.

mandarin_meaning: 特攝（tè shè），指以實拍結合特殊效果的影視類型（如日本的tokusatsu）
english_meaning: Tokusatsu; live-action films/TV that use special effects (especially Japanese series like Kamen Rider, Super Sentai, Ultraman)
explanation_mandarin: 日語“特撮”（tokusatsu）的中文寫法，通常指以實拍配合實體或視覺特效的影視作品，常見題材有變身英雄、巨大化與怪獸戰鬥等，典型例子有《假面騎士》《超人力霸王》《超級戰隊》。
explanation_english: The Chinese term for Japanese 'tokusatsu'—live-action film or TV that uses practical and/or visual special effects. Common themes include transforming heroes, giant-size battles, and monsters (e.g., Kamen Rider, Ultraman, Super Sentai).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日睇特攝片，例如《超人力霸王》同《假面騎士》。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 tai2 dak6 sip3 pin3, lai6 jyu4 《ciu1 jan4 lik6 wong4》 tung4 《gaa2 min6 kei4 si6》.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候常看特攝片，例如《超人力霸王》和《假面騎士》。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid I often watched tokusatsu shows, like Ultraman and Kamen Rider.

mandarin_meaning: 特效（电影、电视、游戏等中的特殊视听效果；亦可见于“特效药”等复合词中，指疗效显著的药物）
english_meaning: special effects (visual or audio effects used in films, TV, games, etc.; also appears in compounds like 'miracle drug')
explanation_mandarin: 指為了增強視覺或聽覺效果而製作的特技、視覺或音效（如電影、電視、遊戲中的效果）；在某些語境下也用作修飾詞的一部分，例如“特效藥”指療效顯著的藥物。
explanation_english: Refers to specially produced visual or audio effects used to enhance scenes in films, television, videos, or games. In some contexts it appears in compounds (e.g., '特效药') to mean an especially effective medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅特效好逼真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 dak6 haau6 hou2 bik1 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的特效很逼真。
examples.english_sentence: The special effects in this movie are very realistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要幾個星期先整好啲特效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 zing2 hou2 di1 dak6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们需要好几个星期才能做完这些特效。
examples.english_sentence: They need several weeks to finish the special effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話冇特效藥可以完全治癒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 mou5 dak6 haau6 joek6 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 zi6 jyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说没有特效药可以完全治愈他。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said there's no miracle drug that can completely cure him.

mandarin_meaning: 特效药 (tè xiào yào) — 指具有显著疗效、能迅速治愈或缓解某種疾病的药物；也可比喻解决问题的灵验方法或手段。
english_meaning: a highly effective or 'special-effect' medicine (a miracle cure); figuratively, an especially effective remedy or solution.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指對某種病症特別有效、能迅速見效的藥；口語中也常用作比喻，表示能迅速解決問題或達到效果的方法或手段。
explanation_english: Refers to a medicine that is especially effective and brings quick results; colloquially it can be used metaphorically to mean a solution or method that quickly resolves a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥話係特效藥，但我食咗冇效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 waa6 hai6 dak6 haau6 joek6, daan6 ngo5 sik6 zo2 mou5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種藥說是特效藥，但我吃了沒有效果。
examples.english_sentence: They say this medicine is a special cure, but it didn't work when I took it.

mandarin_meaning: 特效药（对某种疾病特别有效的药；也比喻灵验的解决办法）
english_meaning: a medicine that is especially effective for a particular disease; a 'miracle drug' or panacea (also used metaphorically for a decisive remedy)
explanation_mandarin: 指對特定疾病有明顯療效的藥物；在口語或比喻用法上，亦可指能迅速或徹底解決問題的靈驗方法或手段。
explanation_english: Refers to a drug that has marked effectiveness against a specific illness; colloquially or metaphorically, it can mean a remedy or measure that quickly or decisively solves a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話而家仲未有對呢種病毒嘅特效藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ji4 gaa1 zung6 mei6 jau5 deoi3 ni1 zung2 beng6 duk6 ge3 dak6 haau6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说现在还没有针对这种病毒的特效药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said there is still no specific/effective medicine for this virus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為換個方法就係特效藥，結果問題仲惡化咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 wun6 go3 fong1 faat3 zau6 hai6 dak6 haau6 joek6, git3 gwo2 man6 tai4 zung6 ngok6 faa3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为换个方法就是灵丹妙药，结果问题反而恶化了。
examples.english_sentence: He thought changing the method would be a cure-all, but the problem ended up getting worse.

mandarin_meaning: 夜間保安；夜間看守/巡邏的人
english_meaning: night watchman; night security guard; night-shift guard
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話中，「特更」指受僱於夜間負責巡邏或看守的人，通常由商鋪、物業或工地在夜間僱用以防盜或維持治安。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "特更" refers to a person hired to patrol or guard premises at night — a night watchman or security guard often employed by shops, properties, or construction sites to prevent theft or maintain security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司夜晚班多，請咗個特更守門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 je6 maan5 baan1 do1, ceng2 zo2 go3 dak6 gang1 sau2 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司夜班多，請了一個夜間保安守門。
examples.english_sentence: The company has many night shifts, so they hired a night guard to watch the door.

mandarin_meaning: 具有独特性或专属性的（特有）
english_meaning: characteristic of; unique to; peculiar to; endemic
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物具有某種獨特性，專屬於某地、某群體或某類別，其他地方或情況少見或沒有。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is distinctive or exclusive to a particular place, group, or category — rarely found or absent elsewhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲草係本地特有嘅品種，外地好少見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cou2 hai6 bun2 dei6 dak6 jau5 ge3 ban2 zung2, ngoi6 dei6 hou2 siu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些草是本地特有的品种，外地很少见。
examples.english_sentence: These grasses are native to this area and are rarely seen elsewhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有特有嘅招牌菜，只有呢度先有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 dak6 jau5 ge3 ziu1 paai4 coi3, zi2 jau5 ni1 dou6 sin1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间餐厅有特有的招牌菜，只有这里才有。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has a unique signature dish that's only available here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司有一套特有嘅管理制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 tou3 dak6 jau5 ge3 gun2 lei5 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司有一套特有的管理制度。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has a distinct management system.

mandarin_meaning: 特权 (tèquán)
english_meaning: privilege; special rights or advantages
explanation_mandarin: 指某些人或團體因職位、地位或關係而享有超出一般人的特殊權利或利益，常帶有不公平或濫用的含意。
explanation_english: Refers to special rights, advantages, or exemptions enjoyed by certain individuals or groups beyond those available to the general public, often stemming from position, status, or connections and sometimes implying unfairness or abuse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 官員唔應該有特權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gun1 jyun4 m4 jing1 goi1 jau5 dak6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 官员不应该有特权。
examples.english_sentence: Officials should not have special privileges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司高層有太多特權，員工會覺得唔公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 gou1 cang4 jau5 taai3 do1 dak6 kyun4, jyun4 gung1 wui5 gok3 dak1 m4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司高层有太多特权，员工会觉得不公平。
examples.english_sentence: If the company's top management has too many privileges, employees will feel it's unfair.

mandarin_meaning: 特此（用於正式書面語，表示藉此、特地以此）
english_meaning: hereby; hereby (for this purpose); for this reason (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 用於正式書信、公文或公告，表示藉此、特地用此來通知、聲明或強調某事（例如「特此通知」）。
explanation_english: A formal written expression meaning "hereby" or "for this purpose", used in notices, official documents, or letters to indicate that something is being stated or declared by means of this communication (e.g., "特此通知").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 特此通知，本公司下星期一放假一天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak6 ci2 tung1 zi1, bun2 gung1 si1 haa6 sing1 kei4 jat1 fong3 gaa3 jat1 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 特此通知，本公司下星期一放假一天。
examples.english_sentence: Hereby notify: Our company will be closed for one day next Monday.

mandarin_meaning: 特殊 (tèshū)：与一般不同，具有独特或例外的性质
english_meaning: special; particular; unusual; exceptional
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或情形与常态不同，有独特性、例外性或不寻常的特点。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is different from the norm, having distinct, unique, exceptional, or unusual characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樣嘢好特殊，普通人未必明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 joeng6 je5 hou2 dak6 syu1, pou2 tung1 jan4 mei6 bit1 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很特殊，普通人未必明白。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very special; ordinary people may not necessarily understand it.

mandarin_meaning: 特殊学校（為有特殊教育需要或殘障學生設立的學校）
english_meaning: special school (a school for pupils with special educational needs or disabilities)
explanation_mandarin: 指為有特殊教育需要或身心障礙的學生提供專門教育和支援的學校，課程、資源和支援安排會因應學生需要作出調整。
explanation_english: Refers to schools that provide specialised education and support for students with special educational needs or disabilities. Curricula, resources, and support arrangements are adapted to meet students' needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔喺特殊學校讀書，老師好有耐性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 hai2 dak6 syu1 hok6 haau6 duk6 syu1, lou5 si1 hou2 jau5 noi6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我兒子在特殊學校上學，老師很有耐心。
examples.english_sentence: My son attends a special school; the teachers are very patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 特殊學校係為有特殊教育需要嘅學生而設，提供專門嘅支援服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dak6 syu1 hok6 haau6 hai6 wai4 jau5 dak6 syu1 gaau3 juk6 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 hok6 saang1 ji4 cit3, tai4 gung1 zyun1 mun4 ge3 zi1 wun6 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 特殊學校是為有特殊教育需要的學生而設，提供專門的支援服務。
examples.english_sentence: Special schools are established for students with special educational needs and provide specialised support services.

mandarin_meaning: 特殊教育 / 特殊需要教育
english_meaning: special education (education for students with disabilities or special needs)
explanation_mandarin: 為具有身心障礙、學習困難或其他特殊需要的學生提供的專門教育和支援服務，包含個別化課程、輔助措施及資源支援。
explanation_english: Education and support services tailored for students with disabilities, learning difficulties, or other special needs. It includes individualized programs, accommodations, and resource support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校有特殊教育課程，專門幫助有學習障礙嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 jau5 dak6-syu1-gaau3-juk6 fo3 cing4, zyun1 mun4 bong1 zo6 jau5 hok6 zaap6 zoeng3 ngaai6 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這所學校有特殊教育課程，專門幫助有學習障礙的學生。
examples.english_sentence: This school has special education programs that specifically help students with learning disabilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該增加對特殊教育嘅資源，同提供更多專業訓練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 zang1 gaa1 deoi3 dak6-syu1-gaau3-juk6 ge3 zi1 jyun4, tung4 tai4 gung1 gang3 do1 zyun1 jip6 fan3 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該增加對特殊教育的資源，並提供更多專業訓練。
examples.english_sentence: The government should increase resources for special education and provide more professional training.

mandarin_meaning: 特殊教育 (tèshū jiàoyù)
english_meaning: special education
explanation_mandarin: 指為有特殊需要或障礙的兒童或學生提供的教學、支援與課程，目的是促進其學習與社會適應。
explanation_english: Refers to instruction, programs, and support services designed for children or students with special needs or disabilities to facilitate their learning and social adaptation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校有特殊教育課程，幫助有學習障礙嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jau5 dak6 syu1 gaau3 juk6 fo3 cing4, bong1 zo6 jau5 hok6 zaap6 zoeng3 ngai6 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校有特殊教育課程，幫助有學習障礙的學生。
examples.english_sentence: The school has special education programs to help students with learning disabilities.

mandarin_meaning: 特派（tèpài）：派遣特別人員或代表執行任務、出差或採訪等工作
english_meaning: to specially assign; to dispatch someone on a special mission or assignment
explanation_mandarin: 表示由某一機構或單位專門指派人員去執行某項任務或代表出差、採訪等。
explanation_english: Indicates that an organization or unit specially assigns a person to carry out a particular task, mission, or assignment (e.g., envoy, reporter, representative).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司特派佢去北京開發新市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 dak6 paai3 keoi5 heoi3 bak1 ging1 hoi1 faat3 san1 si5 coeng4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司特派他去北京開發新市場。
examples.english_sentence: The company specially assigned him to Beijing to develop new markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報社特派記者去前線採訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 se5 dak6 paai3 gei3 ze2 heoi3 cin4 sin3 coi2 fong2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 報社特派記者去前線採訪。
examples.english_sentence: The newspaper dispatched reporters to the front lines to cover the story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府特派代表同對方協商。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 dak6 paai3 doi6 biu2 tung4 deoi3 fong1 hip3 soeng1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府特派代表與對方協商。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent a special representative to negotiate with the other party.

mandarin_meaning: 特产（某地或某區域的特有或著名產品）
english_meaning: local specialty; regional specialty; specialty product
explanation_mandarin: 指某地或某區特有或著名的產品、土產，通常作旅遊紀念品或伴手禮。
explanation_english: Refers to products that are characteristic or famous in a particular place or region, often sold as souvenirs or regional specialties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋有冇啲本地特產可以買？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 jau5 mou5 di1 bun2 dei6 dak6 caan2 ho2 ji5 maai5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们有没有可以买到的本地特产？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any local specialties I can buy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣好多香港特產，例如老婆餅同杏仁餅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 dak6 caan2, lai6 jyu4 lou5 po4 beng2 tung4 hang6 jan4 beng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖很多香港特产，例如老婆饼和杏仁饼。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells a lot of Hong Kong specialties, like wife cakes and almond cakes.

mandarin_meaning: 特异（tèyì）：表示奇特、異常、出眾
english_meaning: peculiar; unusual; extraordinary; distinctive
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物或某人與眾不同、奇特或異常，語氣偏正式或書面。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or someone is unusual, peculiar, or extraordinary; often used in more formal or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅能力好特異，做嘢總有自己一套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6 hou2 dak6 ji6, zou6 je5 zung2 jau5 zi6 gei2 jat1 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的能力很特异，做事總有自己一套。
examples.english_sentence: His ability is quite unusual; he always has his own way of doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幅畫嘅風格好特異，引起咗唔少人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fuk1 waa6 ge3 fung1 gaak3 hou2 dak6 ji6, jan5 hei2 zo2 m4 siu2 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幅畫的風格很特異，引起了不少人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: The painting's style is very unusual, attracting a lot of attention.

mandarin_meaning: 特异功能（超自然的能力，如念力、透視等）
english_meaning: psychic powers; supernatural abilities (e.g., telekinesis, clairvoyance)
explanation_mandarin: 指超出常理解釋的能力或現象，例如念力、透視、預知等，常出現在小說、電影或迷信語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to abilities or phenomena beyond ordinary explanation, such as telekinesis, clairvoyance, or precognition; commonly used in fiction, media, or discussions of the paranormal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己有特異功能，可以用念力拎起杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 jau5 dak6 ji6 gung1 nang4 ho2 ji5 jung6 nim6 lik6 ling1 hei2 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己有特異功能，可以用念力拿起杯子。
examples.english_sentence: He says he has psychic powers and can lift a cup with telekinesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲電視劇成日講特異功能，好吸引觀眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 din6 si6 kek6 sing4 jat6 gong2 dak6 ji6 gung1 nang4 hou2 kap1 jan5 gun1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些電視劇經常談到特異功能，很吸引觀眾。
examples.english_sentence: These TV dramas often feature psychic powers and attract viewers.

mandarin_meaning: 特意 / 故意 / 專門
english_meaning: specially; deliberately; on purpose
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，表示刻意、專門或有意為之，常用於粵語會話中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adverb meaning deliberately, purposely, or especially; used to indicate an action done on purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你特登遲到嚟做咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dak6 dang1 ci4 dou3 lai4 zou6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你特意迟到来做什么？
examples.english_sentence: Why did you purposely come late?

mandarin_meaning: 特种兵 (tè zhǒng bīng) — 特殊作战部队的士兵
english_meaning: special forces soldier; member of special operations forces
explanation_mandarin: 指接受特殊训练、执行高难度或非常规任务的军事人员，通常属于特种部队或特战单位。
explanation_english: Refers to military personnel trained for special operations and unconventional or high-difficulty missions; usually members of special forces units.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係特種兵，退役之後做教練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5cin4 hai6 dak6 zung2 bing1, teoi3 jik6 zi1 hau6 zou6 gaau3 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是特种兵，退役之后做教练。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be in the special forces; after retiring he worked as an instructor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支特種兵部隊完成咗一個高難度嘅任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 dak6 zung2 bing1 bou6 deoi3 jyun4 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 gou1 naan4 dou6 ge3 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支特种兵部队完成了一个高难度的任务。
examples.english_sentence: This special forces unit completed a highly difficult mission.

mandarin_meaning: 特种部队（指受过特殊训练、执行高危险或专门任务的军队或警方单位）
english_meaning: special forces; special operations unit (military or police units trained for high-risk or specialized missions)
explanation_mandarin: 指接受特殊訓練、負責反恐、人質救援、滲透、偵察等專門或高風險任務的軍事或警方單位。
explanation_english: Refers to military or police units that receive specialized training and carry out high-risk or specialized missions such as counter-terrorism, hostage rescue, infiltration, and reconnaissance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隊特種部隊今朝去執行一個秘密任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 deoi6 dak6 zung2 bou6 deoi6 gam1 ziu1 heoi3 zap1 hang4 jat1 go3 bei3 mat6 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那支特种部队今天去执行一个秘密任务。
examples.english_sentence: That special forces unit went on a covert mission this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方嘅特種部隊主要負責反恐同人質救援行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ge3 dak6 zung2 bou6 deoi6 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zak1 faan2 hung2 tung4 jan4 zat1 gau3 wun4 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方的特种部队主要负责反恐和人质救援行动。
examples.english_sentence: The police special forces are mainly responsible for counter-terrorism and hostage rescue operations.

mandarin_meaning: 特稿（特別報導、專題文章）
english_meaning: feature article; special report; special article
explanation_mandarin: 新聞和媒體用語，指為特別報導或深入分析而撰寫的文章，通常為專題性或深度報導。
explanation_english: A journalistic term referring to a special article or feature report written for in-depth coverage or special reporting, often as a feature piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今期雜誌有一篇關於環保嘅特稿，寫得好深入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 kei4 zaap6 zi2 jau5 jat1 pin1 gwaan1 jyu1 waan4 bou2 ge3 dak6 gou1, se2 dak1 hou2 sam1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今期雜誌有一篇關於環保的特稿，寫得很深入。
examples.english_sentence: This issue of the magazine includes a feature on environmental protection; it's written very in-depth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位記者為今次災情寫咗一篇特稿，喺電視上播出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 gei3 ze2 wai6 gam1 ci3 zoi1 cing4 se2 zo2 jat1 pin1 dak6 gou1, hai2 din6 si6 soeng5 bo3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位記者為這次災情寫了一篇特稿，在電視上播出。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter wrote a special report about this disaster, which was broadcast on television.

mandarin_meaning: 特立独行（形容人行事獨立、不隨波逐流）
english_meaning: Acting independently and unconventionally; independent-minded; eccentric
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人性格或行為與眾不同、很有獨立性，不太受他人或社會潮流影響。
explanation_english: Describes a person who behaves independently and unconventionally, not following the crowd and showing strong individualism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向特立獨行，唔太理會其他人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dak6 lap6 duk6 hang4, m4 taai3 lei5 wui6 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向特立獨行，不太理會別人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been independent-minded and doesn't pay much attention to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本小說嘅主角特立獨行，好有個人風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 siu2 seot3 ge3 zyu2 gok3 dak6 lap6 duk6 hang4, hou2 jau5 go3 jan4 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本小說的主角特立獨行，很有個人風格。
examples.english_sentence: The protagonist of this novel is unconventional and has a distinct personal style.

mandarin_meaning: 特约；特别聘任或签订的合同/协议；受特别邀请或聘用的（例如特约评论员、特约记者）
english_meaning: to specially appoint; contracted; specially commissioned — can refer to a special appointment, a contracted agreement, or someone commissioned under such terms (e.g., a contracted columnist or reporter)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 形容词 / 名词
explanation_mandarin: 表示以特别方式约定、聘任或签订合同，或指以这种方式受聘的人或合同本身，常见于媒体、顾问或合同关系中。
explanation_english: Indicates a special appointment, commission, or contracted arrangement; can describe a specially commissioned person (e.g., 'special/contracted commentator') or the contract/arrangement itself, commonly used in media and professional contracts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係本報嘅特約評論員，間唔中會有稿登出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 bun2 bou3 ge3 dak6 joek3 ping4 leon6 jyun4, gaan3 m4 zung1 wui5 jau5 gou2 deng1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是本报的特约评论员，间或会有稿件登出。
examples.english_sentence: He is a contracted commentator for this newspaper; occasionally his pieces are published.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司同佢簽咗特約合約，佢就負責做顧問同項目監督。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tung4 keoi5 cim1 zo2 dak6 joek3 hap6 joek3, keoi5 zau6 fu6 zak1 zou6 gu3 man6 tung4 hong6 muk6 gaam1 duk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司和他签了特约合同，他负责做顾问和项目监督。
examples.english_sentence: The company signed a special/contracted agreement with him; he is responsible for consulting and supervising the project.

mandarin_meaning: 特约演员：受邀或按短期合约出演的演员，多指客串或短期出演者。
english_meaning: guest actor / special-contracted actor — an actor hired on a short-term or special contract to appear in a brief, guest, or cameo role.
explanation_mandarin: 指受邀或以短期／特別合約參與演出，通常只演短暫或客串角色的演員，常見於電影、電視劇或舞台劇中。
explanation_english: Refers to an actor engaged under a special or short-term contract, usually appearing in brief, guest, or cameo roles in films, TV dramas, or stage productions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次部電影有幾位特約演員，佢哋淨係演短角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bou6 din6 jing2 jau5 gei2 wai2 dak6 joek3 jin2 jyun4, keoi5 dei6 zing6 hai6 jin2 dyun2 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次电影有几位特约演员，他们只是演短角色。
examples.english_sentence: This film has several guest actors; they only play brief roles.

mandarin_meaning: 特色 (tèsè)
english_meaning: distinctive feature; characteristic; specialty
explanation_mandarin: 指事物與其他事物不同、突出的特點或獨特之處，也可指具有吸引力的賣點或專長。
explanation_english: Refers to the distinguishing or prominent features that set something apart from others; a unique trait, specialty, or selling point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有自己嘅特色，必試佢哋嘅招牌菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 dak6 sik1, bit1 si3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ziu1 paai4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间餐厅有自己的特色，必尝他们的招牌菜。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has its own distinctive character; you must try their signature dishes.

mandarin_meaning: 特制 (tèzhì)，特别制作或定制的
english_meaning: specially made; custom-made; special edition
explanation_mandarin: 表示为特定目的或某人而特别制作或定制，通常具有特殊规格、配方或限量属性。
explanation_english: Indicates something made specially for a particular purpose or person; custom-produced or a special edition, often with unique specifications or limited availability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯係特製奶茶，味道同普通唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 hai6 dak6 zai3 naai5 caa4, mei6 dou6 tung4 pou2 tung1 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯是特制奶茶，味道和普通的不一样。
examples.english_sentence: This cup is a specially made milk tea; the taste is different from the regular one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廠商推出咗一款特製版手錶，只有一百隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong2 soeng1 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 fun2 dak6 zai3 baan2 sau2 biu1, zi2 jau5 jat1 baak3 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厂商推出了一款特制版手表，只有一百只。
examples.english_sentence: The manufacturer launched a special edition watch; there are only a hundred pieces.

mandarin_meaning: 特训（对某人或某团体进行特别、密集的训练）
english_meaning: special training; intensive training; boot-camp style coaching
explanation_mandarin: 指為了提升技能、表現或備戰而安排的特別且通常較為密集的訓練，可用作名詞（一次特訓）或動詞（對某人進行特訓）。
explanation_english: Refers to special, often intensive training arranged to improve skills, performance, or prepare for an event. Can be used as a noun (a session of special training) or a verb (to give someone special training).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練話下星期要對球隊做特訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 waa6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 deoi3 kau4 deoi2 zou6 dak6 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练说下星期要对球队进行特训。
examples.english_sentence: The coach said there will be special training for the team next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排咗一個特訓班俾新同事。
