examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 soeng6 go3 jyut6 bei6 zan2 dyun6 ceot1 jau5 sing1 hung4 jit6, ji1 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei5 gaak3 lei4 tung4 sik6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友上個月被診斷出得了猩紅熱，現在在家隔離並吃藥。
examples.english_sentence: The child was diagnosed with scarlet fever last month; now they are isolating at home and taking medicine.

mandarin_meaning: 猴（猴子）
english_meaning: monkey
explanation_mandarin: 指猴科或常稱為「猴子」的靈長類動物；在語言中也常用於成語或比喻（如「猴年馬月」）。
explanation_english: Refers to monkeys (primates); also used in idioms and figurative expressions (e.g. "猴年馬月" meaning an unlikely time).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有一隻猴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun2 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 zek3 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一只猴。
examples.english_sentence: There is a monkey in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講要等佢改，等到猴年馬月先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 jiu3 dang2 keoi5 goi2, dang2 dou3 hau4 nin4 maa5 jyut6 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说要等他改，等到猴年马月才会吧。
examples.english_sentence: You say you'll wait for him to change, but that'll only happen in the unlikely 'monkey years and horse months' (i.e. never).

mandarin_meaning: 猴子；一種靈長類動物，也可比喻調皮、愛耍寶或愛惡作劇的人
english_meaning: monkey; a primate animal; figuratively, a mischievous or playful person; to clown around
explanation_mandarin: 指靈長類動物猴子；在口語中常用來形容人調皮、耍寶或愛鬧，也可用作戲謔或輕鬆的稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to the primate 'monkey'. In colloquial use it often describes someone who is mischievous, playful, or clowning around; can be used jokingly or teasingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物園入面啲猴子喺籠入面跳嚟跳去，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 di1 hau4 zi2 hai2 lung4 jap6 min6 tiu3 loi4 tiu3 heoi3, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 动物园里的猴子在笼子里跳来跳去，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: The monkeys at the zoo are jumping around in their enclosure; they're so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺班度扮猴子，成日搞笑，唔專心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 baan1 dou6 baan6 hau4 zi2, sing4 jat6 gaau2 siu3, m4 zyun1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在班上耍寶、裝瘋賣傻，注意力不集中。
examples.english_sentence: He is always clowning around in class, goofing off and not paying attention.

mandarin_meaning: 字面为“猴子偷桃”；引申为偷摸、调戏或暗中取得好處（俚語常指猥褻性觸碰或調戲）
english_meaning: Literally 'monkey stealing peaches'; figuratively a slang/idiom meaning to grope, make lewd advances, flirt slyly, or secretly take advantage
explanation_mandarin: “猴子偷桃”字面上指猴子偷桃子的動作。作為俚語時常用來形容暗中摸索、偷摸或調戲女性等不恰當的肢體接觸，也可廣義指用狡猾手段暗中取得利益。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a monkey stealing a peach. As a Cantonese idiom/slang it often describes secretly groping or making lewd advances (especially toward women); more broadly it can mean using sly means to obtain benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺派對度猴子偷桃，搞到啲女仔好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 paai3 deoi3 dou6 hau4 zi2 tau1 tou4, gaau2 dou3 di1 neoi5 zai2 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在派對上偷摸女生，讓她們很不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He often gropes girls at parties, making them very upset.

mandarin_meaning: 心急、著急
english_meaning: impatient; overly eager; hasty
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，形容人很急躁、迫不及待或容易著急，相當於「心急」或「急躁」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang/idiom describing someone who is impatient, overly eager, or hasty — similar to 'impatient' or 'anxious to get on with something.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁猴急啦，慢慢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hau4 gap1 laa1, maan6 maan6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別那麼猴急，慢慢來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impatient; take your time.

mandarin_meaning: （俗語）被抓住、被逮到或落入圈套（字面為「猴子被擒」）；引申為被人設計、被揭穿或被當場逮住
english_meaning: Colloquial: to be caught/captured or fall into a trap (literally 'monkey caught'); to be busted, tricked, or exposed
explanation_mandarin: 方言或口語用法，字面意思為「猴子被擒」，常用來形容人被捉到、被人設局或當場露餡。語氣多為輕蔑或無奈，屬地方性用詞，並不十分常見於正式語境。
explanation_english: A colloquial/dialectal expression literally meaning 'monkey caught'. It figuratively describes being caught, trapped, or outwitted — e.g. getting busted, falling into someone's trap, or being exposed. Informal and regionally used; not common in formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一出錯，就俾人猴擒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 co3, zau6 bei2 jan4 hau4 kam4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一出错，就被人抓住了／被逮到了。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake and got caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好畀人設局猴擒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 cit3 guk6 hau4 kam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，别让人设局把你抓住／陷害。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful; don't let someone set a trap and catch you.

mandarin_meaning: 仍然；还；好像；尤（文言或书面语）
english_meaning: still; yet; as if; even (literary/classical use)
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「猶」多見於古漢語或書面語，作副詞使用，表示仍然、好像、尤其等意。常見於複合詞如「猶如」「猶未」「猶猶豫豫」。
explanation_english: The character '猶' is used in classical or literary Chinese as an adverb meaning still/yet, as if, or even. It appears in compounds like '猶如' (as if), '猶未' (still not), and '猶猶豫豫' (hesitant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅聲音猶如風吹過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 seng1 jam1 jau4 jyu4 fung1 ceoi1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音仿佛被风吹过。
examples.english_sentence: His voice was like the wind blowing past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 問題猶未解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man6 tai4 jau4 mei6 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 问题仍未解决。
examples.english_sentence: The problem still hasn't been solved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢猶猶豫豫唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 jau4 jyu6 jyu6 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犹犹豫豫不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: He hesitated and didn't dare to speak.

mandarin_meaning: 犹太（指猶太人或與猶太有關的事物）
english_meaning: Jewish (relating to the Jews or Judaism)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（常作定語，如「犹太人」、「犹太教」）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / noun (used attributively or in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示與猶太人或猶太文化、猶太教有關的事物，常見於「猶太人」「猶太教」「猶太文化」等詞組中。
explanation_english: Denotes something related to Jewish people or Judaism; commonly appears in compounds such as 'Jew/Jewish person', 'Judaism', or 'Jewish culture'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個猶太人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 jau4 taai3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她是一個犹太人。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a Jewish person.

mandarin_meaning: 犹太人
english_meaning: Jew; Jewish person
explanation_mandarin: 指屬於猶太民族或信仰猶太教的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who belongs to the Jewish people or practices Judaism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個猶太人，會慶祝光明節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 jau4 taai3 jan4 , wui5 hing3 zuk1 gwong1 ming4 zit3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位犹太人，会庆祝光明节。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Jewish person and celebrates Hanukkah.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近同一個猶太人合作做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 tung4 jat1 go3 jau4 taai3 jan4 hap6 zok3 zou6 saang1 ji3 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近和一位犹太人合作做生意。
examples.english_sentence: The company recently partnered with a Jewish person on a business venture.

mandarin_meaning: 犹太教
english_meaning: Judaism
explanation_mandarin: 犹太教是一种起源于古代以色列的单一神信仰及宗教传统，包含律法、节日和文化习俗，是犹太民族的重要宗教与文化根基。
explanation_english: Judaism is a monotheistic religion originating among the ancient Israelites, encompassing laws, festivals and cultural practices; it is the religious and cultural foundation of the Jewish people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢研究猶太教嘅歷史同文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jin4 gau3 jau4 taai3 gaau3 ge3 lik6 si2 tung4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他研究犹太教的历史和文化。
examples.english_sentence: He studies the history and culture of Judaism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有少數猶太教會堂，社區活動頗為活躍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 siu2 sou3 jau4 taai3 gaau3 wui6 tong4, se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6 po2 wai4 wut6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有少数犹太教会堂，社区活动相当活跃。
examples.english_sentence: There are a few Jewish synagogues in Hong Kong, and community activities are fairly active.

mandarin_meaning: 猶如 / 像 / 好像（表示比喻）
english_meaning: like; as if; similar to (used to make a simile)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介詞 / 連詞（書面語，比喻用法）
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示比喻，說明一種事物像另一種事物，常見於書面或正式語體。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a simile, indicating that one thing resembles another; commonly used in written or formal language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜空上嘅星星猶如鑽石咁閃爍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 hung1 soeng6 ge3 sing1 sing1 jau4 jyu4 zyun3 sek6 gam2 sim2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜空中的星星猶如鑽石般閃爍。
examples.english_sentence: The stars in the night sky sparkle like diamonds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面帶微笑，猶如春日嘅陽光，令人感到溫暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 daai3 mei4 siu3, jau4 jyu4 ceon1 jat6 ge3 joeng4 gwong1, ling6 jan4 gam2 dou3 wan1 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他面帶微笑，猶如春日的陽光，讓人感到溫暖。
examples.english_sentence: He wears a gentle smile, like the spring sunlight, making people feel warm.

mandarin_meaning: 仍然心有餘悸／仍存餘悸
english_meaning: to still feel lingering fear or apprehension after a frightening or dangerous experience
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容經歷過可怕或危險的事件之後，內心仍然保留恐懼、驚怕的感覺。
explanation_english: Describes the lingering fear or apprehension someone feels after having experienced a terrifying or dangerous event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次班機遇到亂流，落機之後我仲猶有餘悸，唔敢坐第二次長途機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 baan1 gei1 jyu6 dou3 lyun6 lau4, lok6 gei1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zung6 jau4 jau5 jyu4 gei3, m4 gam2 co5 dai6 ji6 ci3 coeng4 tou4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次航班遇到氣流，落地後我仍然心有餘悸，不敢再坐第二次長途航班。
examples.english_sentence: The last flight hit turbulence; after landing I still felt lingering fear and didn't dare take another long-haul flight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然地震已經過咗，但大家仲猶有餘悸，聽到細小嘅震動都會緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 dei6 zan3 ji5 ging1 gwo3 zo2, daan6 daai6 gaa1 zung6 jau4 jau5 jyu4 gei3, teng1 dou3 sai3 siu2 ge3 zan3 dung6 dou1 wui5 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然地震已經過去了，但大家仍然心有餘悸，聽到細微的震動都會緊張。
examples.english_sentence: Although the earthquake had passed, everyone was still uneasy; even small tremors made them tense.

mandarin_meaning: 猶豫；心存疑慮
english_meaning: hesitant; doubtful; wavering
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事拿不定主意或心中有疑慮，猶豫不決或遲疑不定。
explanation_english: Indicates being unsure, having doubts, or hesitating; to waver or be indecisive about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個提議仲猶疑，未肯答應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 tai4 ji5 zung6 jau4 ji4, mei6 hang2 daap3 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對這個提議還在猶疑，還不肯答應。
examples.english_sentence: He's still hesitating about this proposal and hasn't agreed yet.

mandarin_meaning: 猶豫不決，拿不定主意
english_meaning: hesitant; indecisive; unable to make up one's mind
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容對某事遲疑、猶豫，無法迅速或果斷地做出決定。
explanation_english: Describes being hesitant or irresolute, unable to make a firm decision quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對去唔去嗰次旅行猶疑不決，最後都冇買機票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 heoi3 m4 heoi3 go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4 jau4 ji4 bat1 kyut3, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 maai5 gei1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對去不去那趟旅行猶豫不決，最後也沒買機票。
examples.english_sentence: He was indecisive about whether to go on that trip and ended up not buying a plane ticket.

mandarin_meaning: 尚且可以；仍可接受
english_meaning: still acceptable; tolerable; could be worse
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事雖不理想或不完美，但仍在可以接受或容忍的範圍內。語氣偏書面或文言化。
explanation_english: Indicates that something, although not ideal or perfect, remains within an acceptable or tolerable range. The tone is somewhat literary or formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅食物唔係最好，但份量足，猶自可。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 m4 hai6 zeoi3 hou2, daan6 fan6 loeng6 zuk1, jau4 zi6 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间茶餐厅的食物不是最好，但分量足，尚且可接受。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this cha chaan teng isn't the best, but the portions are sufficient; it's still acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程延期咗，但重做嘅幅度唔大，猶自可挽回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 jin4 kei4 zo2, daan6 zung6 zou6 ge3 fuk1 dou6 m4 daai6, jau4 zi6 ho2 waan5 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程延期了，但重做的幅度不大，尚且可以挽回。
examples.english_sentence: The project was delayed, but the amount of rework isn't large; it can still be salvaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然球隊連輸咗幾場，但總有機會翻身，猶自可。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 kau4 deoi6 lin4 syu1 zo2 gei2 coeng4, daan6 zung2 jau5 gei1 wui6 faan1 san1, jau4 zi6 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然球队连输几场，但总还有翻身的机会，尚且可。
examples.english_sentence: Although the team lost several matches in a row, there's still a chance to turn things around; it's still acceptable.

mandarin_meaning: 犹豫
english_meaning: to hesitate; hesitant; indecisive
explanation_mandarin: 表示拿不定主意、迟疑不决的状态或动作，既可以表示正在犹豫（动词），也可以表示具有犹豫性质（形容词）。
explanation_english: Indicates being unable to make up one's mind or wavering in decision; can be used as a verb (to hesitate) or an adjective (hesitant/indecisive).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲喺度猶豫緊咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 hai2 dou6 jau4 jyu6 gan2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还在犹豫什么？
examples.english_sentence: What are you still hesitating about?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對去唔去旅行一直都好猶豫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 heoi3 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 jau4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对去不去旅行一直很犹豫。
examples.english_sentence: He has been very hesitant about whether to travel or not.

mandarin_meaning: 犹豫不决
english_meaning: hesitant; unable to make a decision
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事拿不定主意、遲疑不肯做決定。
explanation_english: Indicates hesitancy or inability to decide about something; to be undecided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對嗰個工作邀請猶豫不決，仲未決定要唔要去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 go2 go3 gung1 zok3 jiu1 cing2 jau4 jyu6 bat1 kyut3, zung6 mei6 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 m4 jiu3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對那個工作邀請猶豫不決，還沒決定要不要去。
examples.english_sentence: He is hesitant about the job offer and hasn't decided whether to go.

mandarin_meaning: 計劃、謀略、方略（多用於書面或文言）
english_meaning: plan; scheme; strategy (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: 「猷」為書面或文言用字，指計劃、謀略或方略，用於描述籌劃、策略性的方案或意圖。
explanation_english: A literary/formal term meaning a plan, scheme, or strategy. Used to describe a devised plan or course of action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提出咗一套經營之猷，大家覺得可行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 tou3 ging1 jing4 zi1 jau4, daai6 gaa1 gok3 dak1 ho2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出了一套經營之猷，大家覺得可行。
examples.english_sentence: He proposed a set of management plans, and everyone thinks they're feasible.

mandarin_meaning: 狲；猴子（如猕猴）
english_meaning: macaque; monkey (rhesus monkey)
explanation_mandarin: 猻（又作狲）指一種猴子，常用來指猕猴或類似的猴類。此字在古書或文言中亦可見。
explanation_english: Refers to a kind of monkey (often a macaque/rhesus monkey). The character is sometimes seen in classical or literary texts and functions as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上見到一隻猻，佢好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng6 gin3 dou3 jat1 zek3 seon1, keoi5 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上看到一只猻，它很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a macaque on the mountain; it was very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 狡猾；奸詐（也可指滑溜）
english_meaning: sly; crafty; cunning; crafty; (also: slippery, literal)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人狡詐、奸猾、機靈，常帶負面含義，表示不可信或易耍手段；也可指物體表面滑溜。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is sly, crafty, or cunning (usually negative), indicating untrustworthiness or evasiveness; can also literally mean slippery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好猾，成日搵方法甩身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 waat6, sing4 jat6 wan2 fong1 faat3 lat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很狡猾，總是想辦法脫身。
examples.english_sentence: He's very sly; he always finds ways to get out of trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小偷好猾，好快就溜走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 tau1 hou2 waat6, hou2 faai3 lau4 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個小偷很狡猾，很快就溜走了。
examples.english_sentence: That thief was very sly and slipped away quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 猿（指靈長類的一類動物，常指長臂猿或類人猿）
english_meaning: ape (especially gibbons or other apes)
explanation_mandarin: 名詞，指靈長類動物中的猿類，常用於生物學或書面語，例如果長臂猿、類人猿等。
explanation_english: A noun referring to apes — a group of primates including gibbons and great apes; used in biological and literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長臂猿喺樹上盪嚟盪去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 bei3 jyun4 hai2 syu6 soeng6 dong6 lai4 dong6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长臂猿在树上荡来荡去。
examples.english_sentence: The gibbon swings back and forth in the tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 博物館展出一塊古代猿類化石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 ceot1 jat1 faai3 gu2 doi6 jyun4 leoi6 faa3 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 博物馆展出一块古代猿类化石。
examples.english_sentence: The museum exhibited an ancient ape fossil.

mandarin_meaning: 猿人 / 原人（早期人科動物或類人猿與人之間的過渡種）
english_meaning: ape-man; hominid (early human or transitional species between apes and modern humans)
explanation_mandarin: 指早期的人科動物，介於類人猿與現代人之間的過渡種；在考古與人類學語境中常用來指古代的原始人類或類人猿化石。
explanation_english: Refers to early hominids—transitional species between apes and modern humans. Used in archaeology and anthropology to denote ancient hominids or ape-man fossils.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考古學家發現咗一個古代猿人化石。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gu2 hok6 gaa1 faat3 jin6 zo2 jat1 go3 gu2 doi6 jyun4 jan4 faa3 sek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考古学家发现了一个古代猿人化石。
examples.english_sentence: Archaeologists discovered a fossil of an ancient ape-man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺自然歷史博物館嘅展覽，你可以睇到關於猿人嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zi6 jin4 lik6 si2 bok3 mat6 gun2 ge3 zin2 laam5, nei5 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 gwaan1 jyu1 jyun4 jan4 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在自然历史博物馆的展览中，你可以看到关于猿人的资料。
examples.english_sentence: In the natural history museum's exhibition, you can see information about ape-men.

mandarin_meaning: 呆（發呆、愣住、遲鈍）
english_meaning: dull; stunned; to be in a daze; foolish
explanation_mandarin: 表示愚鈍、發呆或因驚訝、驚愕而暫時不知所措。例如「獃住」表示呆住、愣住。
explanation_english: Indicates being dull or stunned, or staring blankly (being in a daze). Can describe someone foolish or temporarily frozen by surprise or shock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息，一時獃咗喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1, jat1 si4 daai1 zo2 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那個消息，一時呆在那裡。
examples.english_sentence: He heard the news and stood there stunned.

mandarin_meaning: 監獄；牢獄（也用於法律相關詞彙，如冤獄）
english_meaning: prison; jail; incarceration (also used in legal compounds like 'wrongful imprisonment')
explanation_mandarin: 「獄」指監禁罪犯的地方或牢房，也常見於法律相關的合成詞中，例如「冤獄」（被誤判入獄）。
explanation_english: The character refers to a prison or place of confinement; it commonly appears in legal compounds (e.g., '冤獄' meaning wrongful imprisonment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為貪污被判入獄十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 taam1 wu1 bei6 pun3 jap6 juk6 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為貪污被判入獄十年。
examples.english_sentence: He was sentenced to ten years in prison for corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰宗案最後被證明係一宗冤獄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zung1 on3 zeoi3 hau6 bei6 zing3 ming4 hai6 jat1 zung1 jyun1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那宗案件最後被證明是一宗冤獄。
examples.english_sentence: That case was ultimately proven to be a miscarriage of justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺監獄入面學識咗一啲手藝，出獄後可以搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaam1 juk6 jap6 min6 hok6 sik1 zo2 jat1 di1 sau2 ngai6, ceot1 juk6 hau6 ho2 ji5 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在監獄裡學到了一些手藝，出獄後可以找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He learned some skills in prison, and after release he can find work.

mandarin_meaning: 獄卒（看守、獄吏）
english_meaning: jailer; prison guard; warder
explanation_mandarin: 指在監獄或囚室負責看守、押解犯人的人，亦可泛指監獄內的獄吏或看守人員。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who guards prisoners in a jail or prison (a jailer, prison guard, or warder); broadly denotes custodial staff within a prison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個獄卒成日虐待犯人，唔少人投訴佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 juk6 zuk1 sing4 jat6 joek6 doi6 faan6 jan4, m4 siu2 jan4 tau4 sou3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個獄卒經常虐待犯人，很多人投訴他。
examples.english_sentence: That jailer often abused the prisoners; many people complained about him.

mandarin_meaning: 狱警；监狱看守，负责监管囚犯的人
english_meaning: prison guard; jailer — a person who supervises prisoners and maintains order in a prison
explanation_mandarin: 指在監獄或看守所中負責看守、管理囚犯、維持秩序與執行押送或檢查等工作的工作人員。
explanation_english: Refers to staff who work in prisons or detention facilities responsible for guarding and managing inmates, maintaining order, and performing tasks like escorting and inspections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係獄警，負責監管囚犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 juk6 ging2, fu6 zaak3 gaam1 gun2 cau4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是狱警，负责监管囚犯。
examples.english_sentence: He is a prison guard, responsible for supervising the inmates.

mandarin_meaning: 獅（獅子）；可指動物獅子或作為文化象徵（如舞獅）
english_meaning: lion (the animal); can also refer to cultural symbol such as the lion dance
explanation_mandarin: 「獅」指大型貓科動物獅子，常用於詞語如「獅子」「舞獅」，在華人文化中也是吉慶和驅邪的象徵。
explanation_english: The character refers to the lion, a large felid. It appears in compounds like "獅子" and "舞獅"; in Chinese culture it is also a festive symbol used for auspiciousness and warding off evil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年有舞獅表演，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 jau5 mou5 si1 biu2 jin2, hou2 jit6 nou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年有舞狮表演，很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: There is a lion dance performance for the New Year; it's very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 獅城（指新加坡）
english_meaning: Lion City (a poetic nickname for Singapore)
explanation_mandarin: 對新加坡的別稱，意為「獅子之城」，為該地的雅稱或詩意稱呼。
explanation_english: A poetic or literary nickname for Singapore meaning "Lion City," used as an alternate name for the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月會去獅城旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 si1 sing4 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下個月會去獅城旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We'll travel to the Lion City next month.

mandarin_meaning: 狮子
english_meaning: lion
explanation_mandarin: 大型猫科动物（学名为 Panthera leo），主要分布于非洲和亚洲部分地区。也常用作比喻，形容勇猛或威严的人或事物。
explanation_english: A large feline mammal (Panthera leo) native to Africa and parts of Asia. Also used figuratively to describe someone or something brave, powerful, or majestic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物園入面有隻獅子喺打盹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 si1 zi2 hai2 daa2 dan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 动物园里有一只狮子在打盹。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lion dozing at the zoo.

mandarin_meaning: 獅子山（香港九龍的山名）；亦可指代表香港人堅毅奮鬥精神的「獅子山精神」
english_meaning: Lion Rock (a mountain in Kowloon, Hong Kong); also used symbolically for the 'Lion Rock Spirit' — the hardworking, resilient spirit of Hong Kong people
explanation_mandarin: 獅子山位於香港九龍，是一個著名地標與行山地點。由於多部電視劇與社會語境的影響，獅子山常被用來象徵香港人的團結與刻苦精神，稱為「獅子山精神」。
explanation_english: Lion Rock is a prominent hill in Kowloon, Hong Kong, and a popular hiking spot and landmark. Culturally, it has become a symbol of Hong Kong people's solidarity and perseverance — often referred to as the 'Lion Rock Spirit'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個禮拜六去行獅子山，順便睇下夜景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 luk6 heoi3 haang4 si1 zi2 saan1, seon6 bin6 tai2 haa5 je6 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們這個星期六去爬獅子山，順便看看夜景。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to hike Lion Rock this Saturday and, while we're at it, check out the night view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 獅子山精神鼓勵香港人努力奮鬥，共度難關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 zi2 saan1 zing1 san4 gu2 lai3 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 nou5 lik6 fan5 dau3, gung6 dou6 naan4 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 獅子山精神鼓勵香港人努力奮鬥、共同度過難關。
examples.english_sentence: The Lion Rock Spirit encourages Hong Kong people to work hard and persevere together through difficulties.

mandarin_meaning: 獅子山下（字面意為獅子山腳下）；引申為代表香港人堅毅、互助與自強不息的「獅子山精神」，也是一首著名的粵語歌曲名稱。
english_meaning: Literally 'under Lion Rock' (a hill in Hong Kong); figuratively refers to the 'Lion Rock Spirit'—the solidarity, hardworking attitude and resilience of Hongkongers. Also the title of a famous Cantonese song.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞短語（象徵性慣用語）
explanation_mandarin: 「獅子山下」原指香港獅子山脚下的地理位置。自1970年代起，透過電視節目與同名歌曲，逐漸成為描述香港人團結、勤勞和互助精神的文化符號，常用來指代香港社會的互相扶持與奮鬥精神。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the area beneath Lion Rock in Hong Kong. Through media and the famous song of the same name, it became a cultural symbol for Hongkongers' unity, hard work and mutual support—often called the 'Lion Rock Spirit'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 獅子山下嘅精神鼓舞住好多香港人，喺困難嘅時候大家都會互相扶持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 zi2 saan1 haa6 ge3 zing1 san4 gu2 mou5 zyu6 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4, hai2 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 wui5 wu6 soeng1 fu4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 獅子山下的精神鼓舞了許多香港人，在困難的時候大家都會互相扶持。
examples.english_sentence: The 'Under Lion Rock' spirit has inspired many Hongkongers; in difficult times people support one another.

mandarin_meaning: 狮子座（黃道十二宮之一）
english_meaning: Leo (astrological zodiac sign)
explanation_mandarin: 獅子座是十二星座之一，對應西曆大約7月23日至8月22日，象徵為獅子，在占星學中常和自信、慷慨、領導力等性格特質聯繫在一起。
explanation_english: Leo is one of the twelve zodiac signs, roughly covering July 23–August 22. Symbolized by the lion, it is often associated with traits like confidence, generosity, and leadership in astrology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係獅子座，通常都幾有自信同大方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 si1 zi2 zo6, tung1 soeng4 dou1 gei2 jau5 zi6 seon3 tung4 daai6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是狮子座，通常都很有自信且大方。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a Leo; I'm usually confident and generous.

mandarin_meaning: 獅子撲兔
english_meaning: A powerful party attacking a much weaker one; overkill or bullying the weak
explanation_mandarin: 比喻以強欺弱或用過大的力量去對付微不足道的對象，也可指小題大作或過度反應。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a strong party pouncing on a much weaker one; describes bullying the weak or using disproportionate force — an act of overkill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咁多兵力去搞個細小嘅問題，真係獅子撲兔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gam2 do1 beng1 lik6 heoi3 gaau2 go3 sai3 siu2 ge3 man6 tai4, zan1 hai6 si1 zi2 pok3 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用那麼多兵力去處理一個很小的問題，真是獅子撲兔。
examples.english_sentence: He used so many resources to handle a tiny issue — that's really a lion pouncing on a rabbit (overkill).

mandarin_meaning: 獅子狗／西施犬（Shih Tzu），一種小型伴侶犬，常作寵物
english_meaning: Shih Tzu (a small toy/companion dog breed), commonly kept as a pet
explanation_mandarin: 獅子狗是一種小型伴侶犬，原產於西藏／中國，毛長、面短，性格溫順，常作為寵物飼養並需定期美容護理。
explanation_english: A small companion dog breed (Shih Tzu) originating from Tibet/China; long-haired and short-faced, generally friendly and kept as a pet. Requires regular grooming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買隻獅子狗做寵物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zek3 si1 zi2 gau2 zou6 cung5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想買一隻獅子狗當寵物。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy a Shih Tzu as a pet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條獅子狗成日喺客廳周圍走，好錫主人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 si1 zi2 gau2 sing4 jat6 hai2 haak3 teng1 zau1 wai4 zau2, hou2 sek3 zyu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻獅子狗總是在客廳附近走來走去，很黏主人。
examples.english_sentence: The Shih Tzu is always walking around the living room and is very clingy to its owner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 獅子狗要定期去做美容同梳毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 zi2 gau2 jiu3 ding6 kei4 heoi3 zou6 mei5 jung4 tung4 so1 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 獅子狗需要定期去做美容和梳毛。
examples.english_sentence: Shih Tzus need regular grooming and brushing.

mandarin_meaning: 獅子大開口（比喻要價過高或要求過分）
english_meaning: to ask for too much; to make an exorbitant demand (often used for asking an unreasonably high price)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容要求過高或開出過高價格，含有貶義，表示不合理或過分的要求。
explanation_english: Used to describe asking for an excessive or unreasonable demand, often referring to an overly high price; carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳今次加價太過分，真係獅子開大口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam1 ci3 gaa1 gaa3 taai3 gwo3 fan6, zan1 hai6 si1 zi2 hoi1 daai6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳這次漲價太離譜，真是獅子大開口。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's price increase this time is excessive — they're really asking for too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔好獅子開大口，價錢要講得合理啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2 si1 zi2 hoi1 daai6 hau2, gaa3 cin2 jiu3 gong2 dak1 hap6 lei5 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不要獅子大開口，價格要講得合理一些。
examples.english_sentence: When doing business, don't ask for exorbitant prices; prices should be more reasonable.

mandarin_meaning: （獅子山）隧道的俗稱，指獅子山隧道（Lion Rock Tunnel）
english_meaning: Colloquial abbreviation for the Lion Rock Tunnel (獅子山隧道), a major road tunnel in Hong Kong connecting Kowloon and the New Territories
explanation_mandarin: 「獅隧」是香港口語中對獅子山隧道（獅子山隧道）的縮稱或俗稱，常用於日常談論交通路線或塞車情況時。
explanation_english: “獅隧” is a colloquial abbreviation for the Lion Rock Tunnel (獅子山隧道) in Hong Kong. It is commonly used in everyday speech when talking about traffic, routes, or commuting between Kowloon and the New Territories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日塞車，經過獅隧都要一個鐘頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sak1 ce1, ging1 gwo3 si1 seoi6 dou1 jiu3 jat1 go3 zung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天堵車，經過獅子山隧道要一個小時。
examples.english_sentence: Traffic was bad today; it took an hour to pass through the Lion Rock Tunnel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趕住返屋企，行獅隧最快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gon2 zyu6 faan1 uk1 kei5, haang4 si1 seoi6 zeoi3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趕著回家，走獅子山隧道最快。
examples.english_sentence: In a rush to go home, taking the Lion Rock Tunnel is the fastest option.

mandarin_meaning: 獅頭鵝（字面：獅子的頭+鵝）；罕見或俚語用法，通常用來戲謔地形容外表、髮型或造型奇特、誇張或滑稽
english_meaning: lion-headed goose (literal); an uncommon/slang term jokingly used to describe an odd, exaggerated, or comical appearance or hairstyle
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指「獅子的頭的鵝」。在廣東話中屬於比較罕見或口語化的說法，通常用來戲謔或誇張地形容某人的外表、髮型或造型看起來怪誕、滑稽或誇張（非正式用法）。
explanation_english: Literally 'lion-headed goose.' In Cantonese this is a rare/colloquial expression, typically used jokingly or hyperbolically to describe someone's appearance, hairstyle, or look as odd, comical, or exaggerated (informal usage).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個髮型真係似獅頭鵝，大家都笑咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 faat3 jing4 zan1 hai6 si6 si1 tau4 ngo4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 siu3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的髮型真的像獅頭鵝，大家都笑了。
examples.english_sentence: His hairstyle really looks like a lion-headed goose — everyone laughed.

mandarin_meaning: 奖；奖赏、奖品、表彰
english_meaning: award; prize; reward
explanation_mandarin: 表示給予表彰或獎賞的事物或行為，也可用作動詞，意為授予獎勵。
explanation_english: Refers to an award, prize, or recognition; can also be used as a verb meaning to award or reward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為做得好，攞咗個獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 zou6 dak1 hou2, lo2 zo2 go3 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為做得好，拿到了一個獎。
examples.english_sentence: He got a prize because he did well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校每年會頒發獎學金畀優秀嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 mui5 nin4 wui5 baan1 fat3 zoeng2 hok6 gam1 bei2 jau1 sau3 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校每年會頒發獎學金給優秀的學生。
examples.english_sentence: The school awards scholarships to outstanding students every year.

mandarin_meaning: 奖券（用于抽奖或作为奖品凭证的票券）
english_meaning: raffle ticket; prize ticket; lottery ticket
explanation_mandarin: 指用于抽奖、彩票活动或作为奖励凭证的票券，常见于慈善筹款或抽奖活动中。
explanation_english: A ticket or voucher used for raffles, lotteries, or as a prize coupon; commonly used in charity fundraisers or prize draws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一張獎券，希望可以中頭獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zoeng1 zoeng2 hyun3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zung1 tau4 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一張獎券，希望可以中頭獎。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a raffle ticket hoping to win the top prize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 慈善會賣獎券籌款，大家都買嚟支持下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 sin6 wui6 maai6 zoeng2 hyun3 cau4 fun2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 maai5 lei4 zi1 ci4 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 慈善會賣獎券籌款，大家都買來支持一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: The charity is selling raffle tickets to raise funds; everyone is buying them to show support.

mandarin_meaning: 奖励 (jiǎnglì) — 给予奖励或鼓励
english_meaning: reward; to reward; encouragement; incentive
explanation_mandarin: 指給予獎賞或鼓勵以表揚成果或促進某種行為，可作動詞或名詞使用。
explanation_english: To give a reward or encouragement to recognize achievements or promote certain behavior. Can function as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會獎勵表現出色的員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 wui5 zoeng2lai6 biu2jin6 ceot1sik1 dik1 jyun4gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會獎勵表現出色的員工。
examples.english_sentence: The company will reward employees who perform outstandingly.

mandarin_meaning: 奖品
english_meaning: prize; award; reward
explanation_mandarin: 指比賽、抽獎或作為獎勵而贈送的物品或回饋，通常用來鼓勵或表彰表現。
explanation_english: An item or reward given in competitions, raffles, or as recognition for achievement; typically used to encourage or acknowledge performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日參加抽獎，有機會攞到獎品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 caam1 gaa1 cau1 zoeng2, jau5 gei1 wui6 lo2 dou3 zoeng2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天参加抽奖，有机会拿到奖品。
examples.english_sentence: If you join the raffle today, you might win a prize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽嘅獎品係一張禮券。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 sai3 ge3 zoeng2 ban2 hai6 jat1 zoeng1 lai5 hyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛的奖品是一张礼券。
examples.english_sentence: The prize for the competition is a gift voucher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師話成績好會有獎品作獎勵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 waa6 sing4 zik1 hou2 wui5 jau5 zoeng2 ban2 zok3 zoeng2 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师说成绩好会有奖品作为奖励。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher said good grades would be rewarded with prizes.

mandarin_meaning: 獎學金 (jiǎngxuéjīn)，頒發給學生的獎勵或資助款項
english_meaning: scholarship; monetary award given to a student as a reward or financial assistance
explanation_mandarin: 由學校、機構或團體根據成績、才能或經濟需要頒發給學生的金錢資助或獎勵，用以支付學費或減輕經濟負擔。
explanation_english: Money awarded by a school, institution, or organization to a student based on merit, talent, or financial need; typically used to cover tuition or reduce study-related costs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攞咗獎學金，唔使擔心學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo2 zo2 zoeng2 hok6 gam1, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我得到了獎學金，不用擔心學費。
examples.english_sentence: I received a scholarship, so I don't have to worry about tuition fees.

mandarin_meaning: 獎杯
english_meaning: trophy; cup (award)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表彰優勝者或傑出者的杯狀獎品。
explanation_english: A cup-shaped award given to winners, champions, or outstanding performers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個獎杯返嚟，成個屋企都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 zoeng2 bui1 faan1 lai4, seng4 go3 uk1 kei5 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了個獎杯回來，全家都很高興。
examples.english_sentence: He/She brought home a trophy, and the whole family was very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個獎杯係頒畀最佳表演者嘅獎勵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng2 bui1 hai6 baan1 bei2 zeoi3 gaai1 biu2 jin2 ze2 ge3 zoeng2 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個獎杯頒給最佳表演者作為獎勵。
examples.english_sentence: This trophy is awarded to the best performer as a reward.

mandarin_meaning: 獎牌
english_meaning: medal (award)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指在比賽、競賽或表彰儀式中授予的金屬或類似材質的牌章，用以表示名次、榮譽或成就。
explanation_english: A metal or similar object awarded in competitions, contests, or recognition ceremonies to denote ranking, honor, or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺奧運會攞到一枚獎牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ou3 wan6 wui2 lo2 dou3 jat1 mui4 zoeng2 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在奧運會獲得了一枚獎牌。
examples.english_sentence: He won a medal at the Olympics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校每年都會頒發獎牌畀成績優異嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 baan1 faat3 zoeng2 paai4 bei2 sing4 zik1 jau1 ji6 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校每年都會頒發獎牌給成績優異的學生。
examples.english_sentence: The school awards medals each year to students with outstanding results.

mandarin_meaning: 獎狀／獎狀（表彰用的證書）
english_meaning: award certificate; a formal certificate recognizing achievement
explanation_mandarin: 用來表彰個人或團體成就的正式文件或證書，常由學校、機構或單位頒發。
explanation_english: A formal document or certificate awarded to recognize an individual's or group's achievement, usually issued by a school, organization, or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到學校頒發嘅獎狀，覺得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 hok6 haau6 baan1 faat3 ge3 zoeng2 zong6, gok3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了學校頒發的獎狀，覺得很開心。
examples.english_sentence: I received an award certificate from the school and felt very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師將獎狀貼喺班房嘅牆上，大家都去睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 zoeng1 zoeng2 zong6 tip3 hai2 baan1 fong4 ge3 coeng4 soeng6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 heoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師把獎狀貼在教室的牆上，大家都去看。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher put the award certificate on the classroom wall, and everyone went to look.

mandarin_meaning: 奖杯
english_meaning: trophy (cup-shaped award)
explanation_mandarin: 指在比賽或活動中頒發給獲勝者或表現優異者的杯狀獎品，常作為榮譽的象徵，材質可為金屬、玻璃或塑料等。
explanation_english: A cup-shaped award presented to winners or outstanding performers in competitions or events; serves as a symbol of achievement and honor. Materials may include metal, glass, or plastic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校舉行運動會，班隊得到獎盃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 geoi2 hang4 wan6 dung6 wui2, baan1 deoi6 dak1 dou3 zoeng2 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校举行运动会，班级获得了奖杯。
examples.english_sentence: The school held a sports meet, and the class/team won the trophy.

mandarin_meaning: 獎章 (獎牌、勳章，用於表彰成就或貢獻的徽章或金屬牌)
english_meaning: medal; badge; decoration (an award worn or kept to recognize achievement or service)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來表彰個人或團體成就、功績或服務的徽章、獎牌或勳章，常以金屬製成並可佩戴或收藏。
explanation_english: Refers to a badge, medal, or decoration awarded to an individual or group to recognize achievement, merit, or service; often made of metal and can be worn or kept as an honor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為喺比賽入面表現出色，攞咗一塊金色嘅獎章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 biu2 jin2 ceot1 sik1, lo2 zo2 jat1 faai3 gam1 sik1 ge3 zoeng2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為在比賽中表現出色，拿了一枚金色的獎章。
examples.english_sentence: He received a gold medal for his outstanding performance in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為多年服務而獲頒榮譽獎章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 do1 nin4 fuk6 mou6 ji4 wok6 baan1 wing4 jyu6 zoeng2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因多年服務而獲頒榮譽獎章。
examples.english_sentence: He was awarded an honorary medal for his many years of service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校會喺畢業禮分發獎章俾成績優異嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 wui5 hai2 bat1 jip6 lai5 fan1 fat3 zoeng2 zoeng1 bei2 sing4 zik1 jau1 ji6 ge3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校會在畢業典禮上頒發獎章給成績優異的學生。
examples.english_sentence: The school will award medals to students with outstanding results at the graduation ceremony.

mandarin_meaning: 奖赏；给予奖励或报酬
english_meaning: reward; to reward; prize
explanation_mandarin: 表示给予某人以奖励或报酬，以表扬其表现或鼓励其行为。可作名词（奖励）或动词（给予奖励）。
explanation_english: Refers to giving someone a reward or remuneration to acknowledge performance or encourage behavior. Can be used as a noun (a reward) or a verb (to reward).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆承諾會俾獎賞畀做得好嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 sing4 nok6 wui5 bei2 zoeng2 soeng2 bei2 zou6 dak1 hou2 ge3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板承诺会给表现好的员工奖励。
examples.english_sentence: The boss promised to give rewards to employees who perform well.

mandarin_meaning: 獎金 (jiǎngjīn)
english_meaning: bonus; prize money; monetary reward
explanation_mandarin: 指公司、機構或單位因為員工表現、達標或其他獎勵措施而發放的金錢作為獎勵或鼓勵。
explanation_english: Money awarded as a reward or incentive—commonly a bonus paid by a company or organization for performance, achievement, or as a prize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今年發咗好多獎金畀表現好嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 faat3 zo2 hou2 do1 zoeng2 gam1 bei2 biu2 jin2 hou2 ge3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今年發了很多獎金給表現好的員工。
examples.english_sentence: The company paid a lot of bonuses to high-performing employees this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月我攞咗一筆年終獎金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 ngo5 lo2 zo2 jat1 bat1 nin4 zung1 soeng2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個月我拿到了一筆年終獎金。
examples.english_sentence: I received a year-end bonus this month.

mandarin_meaning: 獎項
english_meaning: award; prize; award category
explanation_mandarin: 指頒發給個人或團體以表彰其成就或貢獻的獎項或獎賞，也可指比賽或典禮中的獎項類別。
explanation_english: Refers to an award or prize given to an individual or group to recognize achievements or contributions; can also mean a category of awards in competitions or ceremonies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影贏咗三個獎項。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 jeng4 zo2 saam1 go3 zoeng2 hong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影獲得了三個獎項。
examples.english_sentence: This film won three awards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校每年都有唔同嘅獎項頒發畀優秀學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 mui5 nin4 dou1 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 zoeng2 hong6 baan1 faat3 bei2 jau1 sau3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校每年都有不同的獎項頒發給優秀學生。
examples.english_sentence: The school awards different prizes to outstanding students every year.

mandarin_meaning: 獒犬（如藏獒），大型、毛長且體格健壯的犬種
english_meaning: mastiff (a large, long-haired, powerful dog; often refers to the Tibetan mastiff)
explanation_mandarin: 指大型犬，體格健壯、毛厚長，常作護衛或看家用，現多指藏獒等品種。
explanation_english: Refers to a large, powerful dog with long thick hair, often used as a guard dog; commonly refers to the Tibetan mastiff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻獒好威猛，唔好走近佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 ngou4 hou2 wai1 mung5, m4 hou2 zau2 gan6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只獒犬很威猛，别靠近它。
examples.english_sentence: That mastiff is very fierce; don't go near it.

mandarin_meaning: （常见于“猖獗”）猖狂、肆虐
english_meaning: rampant; unrestrained; violent and widespread (often used in the compound “猖獗”)
explanation_mandarin: 表示猖狂、肆虐，多用于“猖獗”一词，形容坏事或不良现象肆虐、泛滥。
explanation_english: Denotes being rampant or unrestrained. Often appears in the compound “猖獗” to describe things like crimes or diseases spreading violently or unchecked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近有啲罪案好猖獗，市民要提高警覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 jau5 di1 zeoi6 on3 hou2 coeng1 kyut3, si5 man4 jiu3 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近有些罪案非常猖獗，市民要提高警惕。
examples.english_sentence: Recently some crimes have been very rampant; citizens should be more vigilant.

mandarin_meaning: 凶猛的狗；野獸（罕用字）
english_meaning: a fierce dog; a predatory or savage canine (rare character)
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語或方言中用來指稱凶猛的狗或野獸，現代漢語中很少使用，屬罕見字。
explanation_english: An old or dialectal character used to refer to a fierce dog or wild beast. Rarely used in modern Chinese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到條獞我都驚，唔敢行近佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 tiu4 tung4 ngo5 dou1 geng1, m4 gam2 hang4 gan6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到那只獞我很害怕，不敢靠近它。
examples.english_sentence: I was scared when I saw that fierce dog and didn't dare to approach it.

mandarin_meaning: 獠牙；古代對某些山地或邊遠部族的稱呼（如「獠人」）
english_meaning: fang; tusk; (archaic) a term for certain mountain or frontier tribes (e.g. '獠人')
explanation_mandarin: 「獠」常用於合成詞如「獠牙」，指尖牙或長牙；古文中也用作對某些山地、邊遠部族的稱呼，如「獠人」。現代多見於書面或複合詞中。
explanation_english: The character is commonly seen in compounds like "獠牙" meaning a fang or long tooth. Historically it was also used to refer to certain mountain or frontier tribes (e.g. "獠人"). Today it mainly appears in written language or composite words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老虎露出獠牙，嚇得啲小動物走晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 fu2 lou6 ceot1 liu4 ngaa4, haak3 dak1 di1 siu2 dung6 mat6 zau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老虎露出獠牙，把小動物嚇跑了。
examples.english_sentence: The tiger showed its fangs, scaring the small animals away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時嘅文獻提到「獠人」係指山區嘅原住民族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 ge3 man4 hin2 tai4 dou3 "liu4 jan4" hai6 zi2 saan1 keoi1 ge3 jyun4 zyu6 man4 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古時的文獻提到「獠人」是指山區的原住民族。
examples.english_sentence: Historical records mentioned "獠人" referring to indigenous mountain peoples.

mandarin_meaning: 獠牙（liáoyá）：長而尖的牙，尤指動物的犬齒；也可作比喻指兇猛或攻擊性的表現。
english_meaning: fang; tusk — a long, pointed tooth (especially an animal's canine); figuratively, to show aggression ('to bare one's fangs').
explanation_mandarin: 指動物口中又長又尖的牙齒，通常指犬齒或像犬齒的尖牙；也可用作比喻，表示露出兇狠或攻擊性的姿態（如「露出獠牙」）。
explanation_english: Refers to long, pointed teeth of animals (fangs or tusks), typically canines; can also be used figuratively to describe showing aggression or hostility (e.g., 'to bare one's fangs').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅獠牙好鋒利，好似可以咬爛嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 liu4 ngaa4 hou2 fung1 lei6, hou2 ci5 ho2 ji5 ngaau5 laan6 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的獠牙很鋒利，似乎可以咬碎東西。
examples.english_sentence: His fangs are very sharp, as if they could bite through things.

mandarin_meaning: 独（表示单独、独自、单一或独立）
english_meaning: alone; single; solitary; independent (used as a prefix or adjective in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 前綴（在詞語中常作構詞成分）
explanation_mandarin: “獨”表示單獨、不與他人一起或單一的狀態，常見於構詞如“獨自”“獨立”“獨生”。
explanation_english: “獨” denotes being alone, single, or solitary; it often appears as a prefix or adjective in compounds such as “獨自” (alone), “獨立” (independent), or “獨生” (only).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意獨處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 duk6 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢独处。
examples.english_sentence: He likes being alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係獨生子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 duk6 saang1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是独生子。
examples.english_sentence: He is an only child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份計劃要你獨自負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gai3 waak6 jiu3 nei5 duk6 zi6 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份计划要你独自负责。
examples.english_sentence: You need to take sole responsibility for this project.

mandarin_meaning: 独一无二
english_meaning: unique; one of a kind
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常独特，没有任何可以相比的第二个。常用来形容人或物的唯一性。
explanation_english: Indicates something is extremely unique — there is no other like it. Commonly used to describe the singular nature of a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫真係獨一無二，冇得複製。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 zan1 hai6 duk6 jat1 mou4 ji6, mou5 dak1 fuk1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画真是独一无二，无法复制。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is truly one of a kind; it can't be replicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我心目中係獨一無二嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 hai6 duk6 jat1 mou4 ji6 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我心目中是独一无二的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is a unique friend in my eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部限量版手錶係獨一無二，收藏價值高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 haan6 loeng6 baan2 sau2 biu1 hai6 duk6 jat1 mou4 ji6, sou1 cong4 gaa3 zik6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款限量版手表是独一无二的，收藏价值很高。
examples.english_sentence: This limited-edition watch is unique and has high collectible value.

mandarin_meaning: 獨生子 / 獨生男孩
english_meaning: only son; an only male child
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭中唯一的男孩，沒有兄弟姊妹。常用於口語或廣東話語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to a male who is the only child in the family (no siblings). A colloquial Cantonese term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係獨仔，冇兄弟姊妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 duk6 zai2, mou5 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是獨生子，沒有兄弟姊妹。
examples.english_sentence: He is an only child; he has no siblings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺屋企，阿媽成日溺愛佢，因為佢係獨仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 uk1 kei5, aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 nik6 oi3 keoi5, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 duk6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在家裡，媽媽常常溺愛他，因為他是獨生子。
examples.english_sentence: At home, his mother often spoils him because he is the only child.

mandarin_meaning: 独占鳌头（在考试或竞争中名列第一、居首位）
english_meaning: to take first place; to top the rankings; to stand out as number one
explanation_mandarin: 源自古代典故，原指在科舉中名列前茅。現用來形容在考試、比賽或各類競爭中獨佔第一、居於首位。
explanation_english: Originally from classical stories referring to topping the imperial examinations. Now used to describe someone who ranks first or stands out as the top performer in exams, competitions, or other contests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試佢獨佔鰲頭，攞咗全校第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 keoi5 duk6 zim6 ngou4 tau4, lok6 zo2 cyun4 haau6 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他独占鳌头，拿了全校第一名。
examples.english_sentence: He took first place in this exam, securing the top rank in the school.

mandarin_meaning: 独来独往（单独行动、不与人来往）
english_meaning: keep to oneself; act alone; solitary; not sociable
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或動詞性短語）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (used adjectivally or as a verb phrase)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人習慣獨自行動或不與他人來往，性格較孤僻或不愛社交。
explanation_english: Describes someone who habitually acts alone or keeps to themselves, often implying a solitary or unsociable disposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日獨來獨往，唔鐘意同人傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 duk6 loi4 duk6 wong5, m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常独来独往，不喜欢和别人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He often keeps to himself and doesn't like chatting with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嚟嘅同事見到佢獨來獨往，好似唔太合群。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 lai4 ge3 tung4 si6 gin3 dou3 keoi5 duk6 loi4 duk6 wong5, hou2 ci5 m4 taai3 hap6 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新来的同事看到他独来独往，好像不太合群。
examples.english_sentence: The new colleague seems solitary and not very sociable.

mandarin_meaning: 只是；偏偏（表示僅有或強調與預期不同的情況）
english_meaning: only; just; simply (often used to emphasize exclusivity or an unexpected contrast)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的口語用法，表示「只有、僅僅」或帶有「偏偏」的語氣，用來強調某事僅發生在某人或某情況，或與預期相反。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adverb meaning 'only' or 'just'; it can emphasize exclusivity or indicate a contrarian/unexpected action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 獨係你遲到，其他人都準時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 hai6 nei5 ci4 dou3, kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 zeon2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只有你迟到，其他人都准时。
examples.english_sentence: You're the only one who's late; everyone else was on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢獨係鍾意睇足球，唔鍾意睇籃球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 hai6 zung1 ji3 tai2 zuk1 kau4, m4 zung1 ji3 tai2 lam4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是喜欢看足球，不喜欢看篮球。
examples.english_sentence: He only likes watching soccer; he doesn't like watching basketball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明知道會遲，佢獨係唔肯出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 zi1 dou3 wui5 ci4, keoi5 duk6 hai6 m4 hang2 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明知道會遲，他偏偏不肯出門。
examples.english_sentence: Even though he knew he'd be late, he still refused to leave.

mandarin_meaning: 獨自、自己一個人
english_meaning: alone; by oneself; on one's own
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示一個人、單獨，不與他人一起。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to be alone or by oneself; indicates someone is on their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要獨個兒去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 duk6 go3 ji4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要独自去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to travel alone today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意獨個兒喺屋企睇書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung1 ji3 duk6 go3 ji4 hai2 uk1 kei5 tai2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常喜欢一个人在家看书。
examples.english_sentence: He often likes to read at home by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔走失咗，佢獨個兒喺街度喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zau2 sat1 zo2, keoi5 duk6 go3 ji4 hai2 gaai1 dou6 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孩子走失了，他一个人在街上哭。
examples.english_sentence: The child got lost; he was crying alone on the street.

mandarin_meaning: 獨具慧眼（dú jù huì yǎn）：具有敏銳的觀察力或判斷力，能發現別人難以察覺的優點或價值。
english_meaning: To have a keen eye; to possess sharp insight or judgment, able to recognize merits or value that others may miss.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人眼光敏銳、判斷力強，能看到別人忽略的優點或潛力。
explanation_english: Describes someone with keen perception and strong judgment, able to spot strengths or potential that others overlook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺設計方面獨具慧眼，啲作品好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cit3 gai3 fong1 min6 duk6 geoi6 wai6 ngaan5, di1 zok3 ban2 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在设计方面独具慧眼，那些作品很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: He has a keen eye in design; those works are very distinctive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆獨具慧眼，提拔咗嗰位年輕人做主管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 duk6 geoi6 wai6 ngaan5, tai4 baat3 zo2 go2 wai2 nin4 hing1 jan4 zou6 zyu2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板独具慧眼，提拔了那位年轻人做主管。
examples.english_sentence: The boss had a keen eye and promoted that young person to manager.

mandarin_meaning: 独到（有独特、独到的见解或风格）
english_meaning: unique; original; distinctive; insightful (as in an original/insightful viewpoint)
explanation_mandarin: 形容見解、觀點或風格新穎、有獨特之處，常用於表示見解深刻或具有創見。
explanation_english: Describes an opinion, viewpoint, or style that is original or distinctive; often used for insightful or novel observations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲評論好獨到，令人對問題有新嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ping4 leon6 hou2 duk6 dou3, ling6 jan4 deoi3 man6 tai4 jau5 san1 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的評論很独到，让人对问题有新的看法。
examples.english_sentence: His comments are very original and give people a new perspective on the issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師提出好多獨到見解，幫我哋睇清楚問題所在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 tai4 ceot1 hou2 do1 duk6 dou3 gin3 gaai2, bong1 ngo5 dei6 tai2 cing1 co2 man6 tai4 so2 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師提出了很多独到见解，幫助我們看清楚問題的所在。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher offered many original insights that helped us clarify the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 独创（dúchuàng）
english_meaning: original; independently created; to originate
explanation_mandarin: 指由個人或單位獨自創作或創立，具有原創性或創新性的作品、方法或想法。
explanation_english: Refers to something created independently by an individual or entity; denotes originality or innovation in a work, method, or idea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件作品係佢獨創嘅，其他人做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 zok3 ban2 hai6 keoi5 duk6 cong3 ge3, kei4 taa1 jan4 zou6 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件作品是他独创的，别人做不出来。
examples.english_sentence: This piece is his original creation; others can't reproduce it.

mandarin_meaning: 独力；靠自己的力量、单独完成
english_meaning: to do something by one's own efforts; alone; single-handedly
explanation_mandarin: 表示依靠自己的力量、單獨完成某事，不依賴他人幫助。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something by one's own effort, without help from others; single-handedly or alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想獨力完成呢個項目，唔想搵人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 duk6 lik6 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, m4 soeng2 wan2 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想独力完成这个项目，不想找人帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to complete this project on his own; he doesn't want to ask for help.

mandarin_meaning: 难以凭借个人力量支撑或完成（某事）
english_meaning: unable to manage or support something alone; difficult to cope by oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示靠一個人的力量很難支撐、完成或承擔某件事，通常用來形容人手或能力不足。
explanation_english: Expresses that it is difficult to sustain, complete, or bear something with only one person's effort; often used to describe insufficient manpower or capability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目咁大，一個人做唔掂，獨力難支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 gam2 daai6, jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 m4 dim2, duk6 lik6 naan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么大，一个人做不过来，难以独自承担。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so big that one person can't handle it; it's hard to manage alone.

mandarin_meaning: 独吞；独自占有或吞并全部（利益、东西等）
english_meaning: to monopolize; to take or keep everything for oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人把所有的利益、資源或東西全部占為己有，不與他人分享或分配。
explanation_english: Describes someone taking all the benefits, resources, or goods for themselves without sharing or distributing to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅獎金唔應該畀老闆一個人獨吞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 zoeng2 gam1 m4 jing1 goi1 bei2 lou5 baan2 jat1 go3 jan4 duk6 tan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的奖金不应该被老板一个人独吞。
examples.english_sentence: The company's bonuses shouldn't be monopolized by the boss alone.

mandarin_meaning: 独唱（獨自演唱）
english_meaning: solo singing; to sing solo
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人單獨演唱。既可作動詞（獨自唱歌），亦可作名詞（指一段或一次獨唱表演）。
explanation_english: Refers to a single person singing alone. Can be used as a verb (to sing solo) or a noun (a solo performance or solo piece).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場音樂會有位歌手會獨唱佢嘅成名曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 jam1 ngok6 wui2 jau5 wai6 go1 sau2 wui5 duk6 coeng3 keoi5 ge3 sing4 ming4 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場音樂會有位歌手會獨唱他的成名曲。
examples.english_sentence: At this concert, a singer will perform a solo of his hit song.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想加入合唱隊，首先要過獨唱試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 gaa1 jap6 hap6 coeng3 deoi2, sau2 sin1 jiu3 gwo3 duk6 coeng3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想加入合唱隊，首先要通過獨唱試。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to join the choir, you must first pass a solo audition.

mandarin_meaning: 只顾自己保持清白或安全，不关心他人或社会事务
english_meaning: to look after one's own welfare/moral integrity only; to mind one's own affairs and not concern oneself with others or public matters
explanation_mandarin: 指只顾保护自己或保持个人道德操守，不参与或不关心社会、他人的事务。有时含有批评自私、不承担社会责任的意味。
explanation_english: Means to care only for one's own safety or moral standing and not take part in or care about social or others' matters. It can carry a critical tone implying selfishness or shirking social responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對社會問題，佢淨係想獨善其身，唔會出嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 se5 wui6 man6 tai4, keoi5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 duk6 sin6 kei4 san1, m4 wui5 ceot1 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對社會問題，他只顧獨善其身，不會出來幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: Facing social problems, he only looks after himself and won't come out to help.

mandarin_meaning: 独奏 (dúzòu)
english_meaning: solo (musical); a musical performance by a single instrumentalist
explanation_mandarin: 指由一位演奏者獨自演奏樂曲，或指單人演奏的曲目。
explanation_english: A musical performance by a single instrumentalist, or a piece performed solo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚交響樂團有一段小提琴獨奏，好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaau1 hoeng2 ngok6 tyun4 jau5 jat1 dyun6 siu2 tai4 kam4 duk6 zau3, hou2 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚交响乐团有一段小提琴独奏，很精彩。
examples.english_sentence: The symphony orchestra has a violin solo tonight — it was brilliant.

mandarin_meaning: 獨女 / 獨生女（家中唯一的女兒）
english_meaning: only daughter (the only female child in a family)
explanation_mandarin: 指家中唯一的女兒，與「獨生女」同義，常用於描述家庭中的性別與子女狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to the only daughter in a family (same as 'only daughter'); used to describe a family's child-gender situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅獨女，父母特別錫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 duk6 neoi5, fu6 mou5 dak6 bit6 sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是家裡的獨生女，父母特別寵愛她。
examples.english_sentence: She is the family's only daughter; her parents especially dote on her.

mandarin_meaning: 独子（家中唯一的儿子）
english_meaning: only son
explanation_mandarin: 指家中唯一的兒子，沒有兄弟姊妹的男性子女，常用來描述家庭中子女結構。
explanation_english: Refers to the only son in a family — a male child with no siblings. Commonly used to describe family composition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係家中嘅獨子，父母對佢好重視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gaa1 zung1 ge3 duk6 zi2, fu6 mou5 deoi3 keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家中的独子，父母对他很重视。
examples.english_sentence: He is the only son in the family; his parents pay a lot of attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 獨守空幃（獨守空幃/獨守空帷）：形容獨自守寡或孤單孤寂地獨居在家，常用來指寡婦或孤獨的人獨自守著空蕩的閨房。
english_meaning: To remain alone in an empty chamber; to live in lonely solitude (often implies a widow or a person left alone and lonely).
explanation_mandarin: 「獨守空幃」出自文言，字面意思是獨自守著空蕩的帷帳。比喻孤獨守寡、獨自生活或孤寂無依。
explanation_english: A classical idiom meaning literally 'to keep watch alone behind an empty curtain.' It figuratively describes being solitary and lonely—often used for a widow or someone who lives alone and isolated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從老伴去咗之後，佢一直獨守空幃，好少出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 lou5 bun6 heoi3 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jat1 zik6 duk6 sau2 hung1 wai4, hou2 siu2 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從老伴去世之後，她一直獨守空幃，很少出門。
examples.english_sentence: Since her husband passed away, she has remained alone and lonely, rarely going out.

mandarin_meaning: 獨自一人在空房（常指配偶外出、離世或不在家），含孤獨、寂寞或性需求無法滿足之意
english_meaning: to stay alone in an empty house/room (often implying a spouse is away or deceased), conveying loneliness or unmet emotional/sexual needs
explanation_mandarin: 指某人獨自留在空蕩的房間裡，常用來形容配偶不在或喪偶後的孤寂狀態，有時帶有委婉的性意味。
explanation_english: Refers to someone staying alone in an empty room; commonly describes the loneliness of a spouse being away or of a widowed person. It can carry a euphemistic sexual connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從老公長期出差，阿珍獨守空房，日日都好孤單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 lou5 gung1 coeng4 kei4 ceot1 caai1, aa3 zan1 duk6 sau2 hung1 fong4, jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 gu1 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從老公長期出差，阿珍獨守空房，每天都很孤單。
examples.english_sentence: Since her husband started long business trips, Ah Zhen has been living alone in an empty house and feels lonely every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家喪偶之後，很多時候會獨守空房，朋友要多關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 song3 jyu5 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 si4 hau6 wui5 duk6 sau2 hung1 fong4, pang4 jau5 jiu3 do1 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人家喪偶之後，很多時候會獨守空房，朋友要多關心。
examples.english_sentence: After becoming widowed, elderly people often live alone in an empty house; friends should offer more care.

mandarin_meaning: 独家 (僅由一家擁有或發佈)
english_meaning: exclusive; sole; proprietary (only one owner/provider or an exclusive scoop/offer)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（視語境亦可作名詞）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can be used as a noun in some contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 表示只有一家擁有、發佈或銷售，常用於媒體報導、產品發售或合約等，強調排他性或唯一性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is held, released, or sold by a single party only; commonly used for media reports, product releases, or contracts to emphasize exclusivity or uniqueness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有獨家報導，唔可以俾人抄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 duk6 gaa1 bou3 dou6, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 jan4 caau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們有獨家報導，不能讓別人抄襲。
examples.english_sentence: We have an exclusive report; we can't let others copy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款限量鞋係我哋嘅獨家發售。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 haan6 loeng6 haai4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 duk6 gaa1 faat3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款限量鞋是我們的獨家發售。
examples.english_sentence: This limited-edition shoe is sold exclusively by us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同電視台簽咗獨家合約，淨係喺嗰間台出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 din6 si6 toi4 cim1 zo2 duk6 gaa1 hap6 joek3, zing6 hai6 hai2 go2 gaan1 toi4 ceot1 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跟電視台簽了獨家合約，只會在那一台出現。
examples.english_sentence: He signed an exclusive contract with the TV station and will only appear on that channel.

mandarin_meaning: 單姓村 / 同姓村（指一家或一個宗族佔多數的村落），引申為人際關係單一或同溫層的社區
english_meaning: single-surname village (a village dominated by one family/clan); by extension, an insular or homogeneous community / echo chamber
explanation_mandarin: 「獨家村」字面上指一個村子主要由同一個姓氏或同一家族組成，也可用作比喻，形容一個社群內部關係緊密、外人難以加入或意見單一的環境。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a village mainly inhabited by a single surname or clan. It is also used metaphorically to describe an insular, homogeneous community or social circle where people are tightly connected and outside perspectives are rare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條村好似獨家村，成村都係李氏，外人好難入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 cyun1 hou2 ci5 duk6 gaa1 cyun1, seng4 cyun1 dou1 hai6 Lei5 si6, ngoi6 jan4 hou2 naan4 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條村好像是個單姓村，整個村子都是李姓，外人很難進去。
examples.english_sentence: That village seems like a single-surname village — the whole village is surnamed Lee, and outsiders find it hard to get in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司成日都係老面孔，搞到好似獨家村咁，創新意見好難被接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 lou5 min6 hung2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 ci5 duk6 gaa1 cyun1 gam2, cong3 san1 ji3 gin3 hou2 naan4 bei6 zip3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司總是老面孔，搞得像個獨家村一樣，創新的意見很難被接受。
examples.english_sentence: This company is always full of the same old faces, making it feel like an insular community — new ideas are hard to get accepted.

mandarin_meaning: 獨居（dújū）
english_meaning: to live alone; living by oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人獨自居住，不與他人同住，強調生活安排由個人自行負責。
explanation_english: Refers to living alone—residing by oneself without roommates or family, emphasizing that daily living is managed individually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家獨居，屋企好靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 geoi1, uk1 kei5 hou2 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在獨居，家裡很安靜。
examples.english_sentence: I currently live alone; the home is very quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為工作關係搬去外地獨居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gung1 zok3 gwaan1 hai6 bun1 heoi3 ngoi6 dei6 duk6 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為工作關係搬到外地獨居。
examples.english_sentence: He moved to another place to live alone because of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人鍾意獨居，享受私人空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zung1 ji3 duk6 geoi1, hoeng2 sau6 si1 jan4 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人喜歡獨居，享受私人空間。
examples.english_sentence: Some people like living alone and enjoy private space.

mandarin_meaning: （指）被獨占或由單一供應者控制的市場（壟斷市場）
english_meaning: a market that is monopolized or dominated by a single supplier; monopoly market
explanation_mandarin: 「獨市」常用來形容某一行業或市場由少數或單一公司控制，消費者缺乏選擇，接近或形成壟斷的情況。
explanation_english: Used to describe an industry or market controlled by one or very few companies, leaving consumers with little choice — effectively a monopolized market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該打破獨市，促進競爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 daa2 paa3 duk6 si5, cuk1 zeon3 ging6 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該打破壟斷市場，促進競爭。
examples.english_sentence: The government should break up the monopolized market to promote competition.

mandarin_meaning: 獨家生意 / 壟斷性生意
english_meaning: exclusive/monopoly business; sole-source contract
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一市場或某一項服務上只有單一供應者或承包者，其他競爭者無法進入或參與，屬於獨佔或獨家經營的生意形式。
explanation_english: Refers to business or contracts where a single supplier or operator has exclusive rights in a market or for a service, preventing competitors from entering — essentially a monopolistic or sole-source arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司攞咗個獨市生意，其他競爭對手冇得做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 lo2 zo2 go3 duk6 si5 saang1 ji3, kei4 taa1 ging3 zang1 deoi3 sau2 mou5 dak1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間公司拿到了獨市生意，其他競爭對手沒有機會做生意。
examples.english_sentence: That company secured an exclusive/monopoly contract; other competitors have no chance to operate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話政府畀太多獨市生意會令價錢上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 zing3 fu2 bei2 taai3 do1 duk6 si5 saang1 ji3 wui5 ling6 gaa3 cin2 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說政府給予太多獨市生意會導致價格上漲。
examples.english_sentence: Some say that giving too many exclusive contracts will lead to higher prices.

mandarin_meaning: 在某一領域獨自佔優勢、表現出色（獨領風騷／獨佔鰲頭）
english_meaning: to dominate a field; to excel in one's specialty; to be outstanding or unrivaled in a particular area
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某個領域或場面上單獨擅長、佔有優勢或表現特別突出。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone excels alone in a particular domain or setting, holding a clear advantage or outstanding performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺創意設計方面，阿明一向獨擅勝場，唔少企業都搵佢做顧問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 cong3 ji3 cit3 gai3 fong1 min6, aa3 ming4 jat1 hoeng2 duk6 sin6 sing3 coeng4, m4 siu2 kei5 jip6 dou1 wan2 keoi5 zou6 gu3 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在創意設計方面，阿明一直獨具優勢，很多公司都請他當顧問。
examples.english_sentence: In creative design, Ah Ming has always dominated the field; many companies hire him as a consultant.

mandarin_meaning: 獨攬大權 / 獨掌大權（由某人單獨掌握所有權力）
english_meaning: to monopolize power; to hold sole authority
explanation_mandarin: 指由某人單獨掌握或集中全部權力，排除他人參與或制衡。
explanation_english: Refers to one person concentrating or monopolizing all authority, excluding others from participation or checks and balances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從做咗CEO之後，就開始獨攬大權，唔聽其他人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 zou6 zo2 CEO zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 ci2 duk6 laam5 daai6 kyun4, m4 teng1 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自從做了CEO之後，就開始獨攬大權，不聽其他人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: Since he became CEO, he began to monopolize power and ignore others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果政治權力全部集中喺一個人手上，就可能出現獨攬大權嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 zi6 kyun4 lik6 cyun4 bou6 zaap6 zung1 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 sau2 soeng6, zau6 ho2 nang4 ceot1 jin2 duk6 laam5 daai6 kyun4 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政治權力全部集中在一個人手中，就可能出現獨攬大權的情況。
examples.english_sentence: If political power is entirely concentrated in one person's hands, it may lead to situations of monopolizing authority.

mandarin_meaning: 独断独行（不听从他人意见，独自做决定并实施）
english_meaning: to act arbitrarily or unilaterally; to make and carry out decisions without consulting others
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人不與他人商量、獨自決定並執行，常帶有負面評價，指擅自行事、專斷。
explanation_english: Describes someone who makes decisions and acts on them without consulting others; often negative, implying arbitrary or authoritarian behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日獨斷獨行，唔聽大家意見，搞到團隊好混亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 duk6 dyun6 duk6 hang4, m4 teng1 daai6 gaa1 ji3 gin3, gaau2 dou3 tyun4 deoi2 hou2 wan6 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是独断独行，不听大家意见，弄得团队很混乱。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts unilaterally and doesn't listen to others' opinions, which has caused chaos in the team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果政府獨斷獨行，最終會惹起市民不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 duk6 dyun6 duk6 hang4, zeoi3 zung1 wui5 je5 hei2 si5 man4 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府独断独行，最终会引起市民不满。
examples.english_sentence: If the government acts arbitrarily, it will eventually provoke public dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁獨斷獨行，做重要決定之前記得搵我哋傾下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 duk6 dyun6 duk6 hang4, zou6 zung6 jiu3 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 wan2 ngo5 dei6 king1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么独断独行，做重要决定之前记得找我们商量一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so single-minded; remember to consult us before making important decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 獨有（某事物或特徵專屬於某人或某處，其他人或地方沒有）
english_meaning: unique; exclusive; possessed or occurring only by someone or somewhere
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某特徵是專屬於某人、某處或某事，其他人或地方沒有或不具備，相當於「只有」、「專屬」。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is exclusive to a person, place, or thing — not shared by others; equivalent to 'only' or 'exclusive'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款產品獨有嘅設計好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 caan2 ban2 duk6 jau5 ge3 cit3 gai3 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款產品獨有的設計很受歡迎。
examples.english_sentence: This product's unique design is very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個村有一種獨有嘅風俗，外地人好感興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cyun1 jau5 jat1 zung2 duk6 jau5 ge3 fung1 zuk6, ngoi6 dei6 jan4 hou2 gam2 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個村有一種獨有的風俗，外地人很感興趣。
examples.english_sentence: The village has a unique custom that outsiders find very interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擁有一項獨有嘅技能，其他人難以取代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung2 jau5 jat1 hong6 duk6 jau5 ge3 gei6 nang4, kei4 taa1 jan4 naan4 ji5 ceoi2 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擁有一項獨有的技能，其他人難以取代。
examples.english_sentence: He possesses an exclusive skill that others cannot easily replace.

mandarin_meaning: 独木舟
english_meaning: canoe
explanation_mandarin: 由整塊木頭或其他材料製成的狹長小船，通常以槳划行，用於運輸、捕魚或休閒娛樂（如泛舟）。
explanation_english: A narrow, lightweight boat traditionally carved from a single log or made from other materials, propelled with paddles; used for transport, fishing, or recreational paddling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個禮拜去海邊玩，租咗兩條獨木舟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 waan2, zou1 zo2 loeng5 tiu4 duk6 muk6 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这周去海边玩，租了两只独木舟。
examples.english_sentence: We went to the beach this week and rented two canoes.

jyutping: duk6 lok6 lok6 bat1 jyu4 zung3 lok6 lok6
mandarin_meaning: 與其獨自享樂，不如與眾人共享快樂。
english_meaning: It's better to share happiness with others than to enjoy it alone.
explanation_mandarin: 這句話表達與其獨自高興，不如把快樂與他人分享，大家一起享受更有意義。
explanation_english: This proverb expresses that enjoying something together with others is preferable to enjoying it alone; sharing joy makes it more meaningful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲開心嘅時候，獨樂樂不如眾樂樂，叫埋啲朋友一齊嚟慶祝啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hoi1 sam1 ge3 si4 hau6, duk6 lok6 lok6 bat1 jyu4 zung3 lok6 lok6, giu3 maai4 di1 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 lai4 hing3 zuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些快樂的時刻，與其自己高興，不如叫上朋友一起來慶祝。
examples.english_sentence: At times like these, rather than enjoying happiness alone, let's invite friends to celebrate together.

jyutping: duk6 lok6 lok6 bat1 jyu4 zung3 lok6 lok6
mandarin_meaning: 獨自享樂不如與眾人共享快樂
english_meaning: It's better to share joy with others than to enjoy it alone
explanation_mandarin: 這句話用來表達與他人共同分享快樂比獨自享受更令人愉快，更有意義的觀點，常用於勸人結伴或鼓勵共享。
explanation_english: This proverb expresses the idea that sharing happiness with others is more enjoyable and meaningful than enjoying it alone; often used to encourage companionship or communal enjoyment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我本來諗住一個人去旅行，但獨樂樂不如眾樂樂，不如約埋幾個朋友一齊去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun2 loi4 lam2 zyu6 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, daan6 duk6 lok6 lok6 bat1 jyu4 zung3 lok6 lok6, bat1 jyu4 joek3 maai4 gei2 go3 pang4 jau5 jat1 cai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我本來打算一個人去旅行，但獨樂樂不如眾樂樂，不如約幾個朋友一起去。
examples.english_sentence: I was originally planning to travel alone, but it's better to share the fun with others — let's invite some friends to go together.

mandarin_meaning: 独树一帜
english_meaning: to establish a distinctive style; to stand out as unique
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（可作形容詞或動詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: 比喻独自创立一套风格或派别，与众不同，独具特色。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone or something that has established a unique style or approach and stands apart from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間小館嘅菜式獨樹一幟，吸引咗唔少食客特地嚟試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 siu2 gun2 ge3 coi3 sik1 duk6 syu6 jat1 zi6, kap1 jan5 zo2 m4 siu2 sik6 haak3 dak6 dei6 lai4 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家小馆的菜式独树一帜，吸引了不少食客特地来尝试。
examples.english_sentence: The dishes at this small restaurant are distinctive, attracting many diners who come specifically to try them.

mandarin_meaning: 獨樹一格（形容風格獨特、別具一格）
english_meaning: to have a distinctive or unique style; to stand out with one's own original manner
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人的風格、作品或作風非常獨特、別具一格，與眾不同且容易辨認。
explanation_english: Describes a person’s style, work, or manner as distinctive and original—standout and easily recognizable for its uniqueness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫風獨樹一格，觀眾一睇就認得出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa6 fung1 duk6 syu6 jat1 gaak3, gun1 zung3 jat1 tai2 zau6 jing6 dak1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的畫風獨樹一格，觀眾一看就能認出來。
examples.english_sentence: His painting style is distinctive; viewers can recognize it at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這間餐廳嘅菜式獨樹一格，好多人慕名而來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 duk6 syu6 jat1 gaak3, hou2 do1 jan4 mou6 ming4 ji4 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餐廳的菜式獨樹一格，很多人慕名而來。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dishes are uniquely styled; many people come because of its reputation.

mandarin_meaning: 独沽一味
english_meaning: to stick to a single approach/style; to offer only one kind of thing; unwilling to change
explanation_mandarin: 形容只坚持一种做法、风格或口味，不肯变通或尝试新事物，常含贬义。
explanation_english: Describes sticking to one method, style, or taste without adapting or trying new things; often used negatively to criticize lack of variety or creativity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳成日獨沽一味，冇新意思，生意都開始下滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sing4 jat6 duk6 gu1 jat1 mei6, mou5 san1 ji3 si3, sang1 ji3 dou1 hoi1 ci2 haa6 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅总是独沽一味，没有新意，生意都开始下滑。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant always sticks to the same thing, has no novelty, and business has begun to decline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作家如果獨沽一味，作品會失去吸引力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 gaa1 jyu4 gwo2 duk6 gu1 jat1 mei6, zok3 ban2 wui5 sat1 heoi3 kap1 jan5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作家如果一味坚持一种风格，作品会失去吸引力。
examples.english_sentence: If a writer sticks to only one style, their work will lose its appeal.

mandarin_meaning: 独特
english_meaning: unique; distinctive
explanation_mandarin: 表示與眾不同，具有明顯的特點或特色，通常用作形容詞來描述人、事物或風格。
explanation_english: Indicates being different from others; having distinctive characteristics. Typically used as an adjective to describe a person, thing, or style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫風格好獨特，睇落好有藝術感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 fung1 gaak3 hou2 duk6 dak6, tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 ngai6 seot6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅畫風格很獨特，看起來很有藝術感。
examples.english_sentence: This painting has a unique style and looks very artistic.

mandarin_meaning: 独生（表示家中没有兄弟姐妹）
english_meaning: only-born; only child (as modifier)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在一家人中只有一個孩子，沒有其他兄弟姊妹。常用作形容詞或出現在「獨生子女／獨生仔／獨生女」等詞語中。
explanation_english: Indicates being the only child in a family (having no siblings). Commonly used as an adjective or in compounds such as 獨生子女, 獨生仔, 獨生女.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係獨生子女，冇兄弟姊妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 duk6 saang1 zi2 neoi5, mou5 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是独生子女，没有兄弟姐妹。
examples.english_sentence: I'm an only child; I have no siblings.

mandarin_meaning: 独生女
english_meaning: only daughter
explanation_mandarin: 指在家庭中沒有兄弟姐妹的女性，是家中唯一的女兒。
explanation_english: Refers to a female who is the only child in her family (no siblings), i.e. the family's sole daughter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係獨生女，冇兄弟姊妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 duk6 saang1 neoi5, mou5 hing1 dai6 ze2 mui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是独生女，没有兄弟姐妹。
examples.english_sentence: I'm an only daughter; I have no siblings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係獨生女，父母好錫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 duk6 saang1 neoi5, fu6 mou5 hou2 sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是独生女，父母很疼爱她。
examples.english_sentence: She is an only daughter; her parents dote on her.

mandarin_meaning: 獨生子（指家中唯一的兒子）
english_meaning: only son (the only male child in a family)
explanation_mandarin: 指家中唯一的兒子。若指家中唯一的女孩，則稱為「獨生女」。在受計劃生育政策或家庭結構討論中常被提及。
explanation_english: Refers to the only male child in a family. (The female equivalent is "only daughter".) Often mentioned in discussions about family structure or birth-control policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅獨生子，父母好錫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 duk6 saang1 zi2, fu6 mou5 hou2 sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家裡的獨生子，父母很疼愛他。
examples.english_sentence: He is the only son at home; his parents dote on him.

mandarin_meaning: 能獨自擔當某一方面的工作或責任；能獨立勝任
