examples.english_sentence: I'm on class duty today; I have to collect homework and clean the classroom.

mandarin_meaning: （口語/俚語）一群人；一堆東西；帶貶義的稱呼（如罵人）
english_meaning: slang for a bunch/group (people or things); often derogatory or coarse when referring to people
explanation_mandarin: 「班嘢」在香港粵語口語中常用，既可以指一群人，也可以指一堆東西。用來形容人的時候常帶貶義或不禮貌的語氣，有時也當作泛指的俗語用法。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, 「班嘢」 can refer to a bunch/group of people or a pile of things. When applied to people it often carries a derogatory or rude tone; it can also be used casually as a generic colloquial term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班嘢真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人真的很煩人。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你班嘢走開啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baan1 je5 zau2 hoi1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們走開啦！
examples.english_sentence: You lot, get lost!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收埋啲班嘢，我哋要開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 maai4 di1 baan1 je5, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把那些東西收起來，我們要開會。
examples.english_sentence: Put those things away, we need to start the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語、貶義）一群低賤或無用的人
english_meaning: (slang, derogatory) a bunch of lowly/insignificant or worthless people; riffraff
explanation_mandarin: 「班地厘」是香港粵語的俗語，帶有貶義，用來形容一群被視為低賤、討厭或無用的人。多為口語、非正式語境下的罵人用語。
explanation_english: “班地厘” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang term, derogatory in tone, used to describe a group of people regarded as low-class, annoying, or worthless. It is informal and used conversationally to insult or dismiss others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理班地厘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 baan1 dei6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理那群人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay attention to those people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班地厘淨係識講大話，同埋成日串我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 dei6 lei4 zing6 hai6 sik1 gong2 daai6 waa6, tung4 maai4 sing4 jat6 cyun3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群人只會說大話，而且老是嘲弄我們。
examples.english_sentence: Those people only tell lies and are always mocking us.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見俚語，意義不詳，可能作為對一群人或某類人的戲稱或貶稱
english_meaning: Rare Cantonese slang; meaning uncertain — possibly a colloquial label for a group of people used jokingly or pejoratively
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語／名詞或感嘆詞（不確定）
explanation_mandarin: 「班地喱」非標準廣東話詞彙，屬地區性或個人創造的俚語。根據語境，可能用作稱呼一群人（類似「一班人」）或帶有戲謔、貶低意味。具體含義與語氣因地區和語境而異，使用時需謹慎。
explanation_english: Not a standard Cantonese term; it appears to be regional or idiosyncratic slang. Depending on context it may refer to a group of people (similar to 'those guys') or be used jokingly or pejoratively. Exact meaning and tone vary by region and context, so use with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識佢哋班地喱？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 keoi5 dei6 baan1 dei6 lei1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你認識他們那幫「班地喱」嗎？（為俚語，意義不詳）
examples.english_sentence: Do you know those 'baan dei lei'? (slang, meaning unclear)

mandarin_meaning: 班子（指領導或負責一個單位／項目的一群人）
english_meaning: a team or group, especially a leadership or core group responsible for running an organization or project
explanation_mandarin: 「班子」常用來指一個組織或單位中的領導層或核心成員，亦可泛指一班人或團隊的集合。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of people (often the leadership or core members) who run or are responsible for an organization, unit, or project; can also mean a team or a bunch of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要換班子，大家都好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 jiu3 wun6 baan1 zi2, daai6gaa1 dou1 hou2 gan2zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要换班子，大家都很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: The company is changing its leadership; everyone is very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班子做事好有效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 zi2 zou6 si6 hou2 jau5 haau6 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这班子做事很有效率。
examples.english_sentence: This team works very efficiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅班子要有遠見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 ge3 baan1 zi2 jiu3 jau5 jyun5 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的班子要有远见。
examples.english_sentence: The government's leadership needs to have foresight.

mandarin_meaning: 班底（指組織或劇組等的骨幹人員、核心團隊）
english_meaning: core team; backbone/stable of personnel (e.g., of a company, production, or group)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個組織、公司、劇組或團隊的骨幹成員或主要人員配置，常用來表示固定合作或有默契的一群人。
explanation_english: Refers to the core members or principal personnel of an organization, company, production crew, or team; often implies a stable group who regularly work together and form the backbone of the operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間電視劇嘅班底好強，導演同主演以前合作過好多次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 din6 si6 kek6 ge3 baan1 dai2 hou2 koeng4, dou6 jin2 tung4 zyu2 jin2 ji5 cin4 hap6 zok3 gwo3 hou2 do1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電視劇的班底很強，導演和主演以前合作過很多次。
examples.english_sentence: The core team of this TV series is very strong; the director and the lead actors have worked together many times before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要改革，但班底冇變，仍然係嗰班人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 goi2 gaak3, daan6 baan1 dai2 mou5 bin3, jing4 jin4 hai6 go2 baan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要改革，但班底沒變，仍然是那幾個人。
examples.english_sentence: The company is going to reform, but the core staff hasn't changed; it's still the same group of people.

mandarin_meaning: 薄煎饼（西式煎饼 / 美式煎饼）
english_meaning: pancake (Western-style)
explanation_mandarin: 班戟是香港粤语对西式薄煎饼的称呼，通常由面糊煎成圆形扁平的饼，常配以蜂蜜、枫糖浆、黄油、水果或鲜奶油等作为配料或佐食。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, '班戟' refers to Western-style pancakes — flat, round cakes made from batter, typically served stacked with toppings such as syrup, butter, fruit, or whipped cream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朝早喺茶餐廳食咗班戟，仲加咗蜜糖同藍莓，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hai2 caa4 caan1 teng1 sik6 zo2 baan1 gik1, zung6 gaa1 zo2 mat6 tong4 tung4 laam4 mui4, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早上在茶餐廳吃了班戟，還加了蜂蜜和藍莓，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I had pancakes at the cha chaan teng this morning, with honey and blueberries — very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間咖啡店嘅班戟好鬆軟，份量又多，成日有人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3 ge3 baan1 gik1 hou2 sung1 jyun5, fan6 loeng6 jau6 do1, sing4 jat6 jau5 jan4 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家咖啡店的班戟很鬆軟，份量也多，常有人排隊。
examples.english_sentence: The pancakes at this cafe are fluffy and large in portion — people often line up.

mandarin_meaning: 教室；（口語）牢房、監房（在某些語境下）
english_meaning: classroom; (colloquial) jail cell / prison cell (in some contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 「班房」在廣東話中通常指學校的教室，也可在口語或特定語境下指牢房或監房。主要用於描述上課的房間，偶爾用作俗稱「入班房」表示入獄。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 班房 typically refers to a school's classroom. In some colloquial or specific contexts it can also mean a jail/prison cell. Primarily used to denote the room where classes are held; occasionally used slangily as 'go to the cell/prison'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日喺班房做考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 hai2 baan1 fong4 zou6 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今天在班房（教室）考試。
examples.english_sentence: We have an exam in the classroom today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺班房講解今日嘅功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 baan1 fong4 gong2 gaai2 gam1 jat6 ge3 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師在教室裡講解今天的功課。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is explaining today's homework in the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗罪，最後要入班房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 zeoi6, zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 jap6 baan1 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了罪，最後要進入牢房（入獄）。
examples.english_sentence: He committed a crime and eventually had to go to jail (into a cell).

mandarin_meaning: 班会（班級內的集會）
english_meaning: class meeting; homeroom meeting
explanation_mandarin: 班會是指在學校班級內舉行的集會，通常由班主任主持，用來討論班級事務、發佈通告或進行活動。
explanation_english: A meeting held within a school class, usually led by the homeroom teacher, used to discuss class affairs, make announcements, or carry out class activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日放學前有班會，老師話有重要通告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 fong3 hok6 cin4 jau5 baan1 wui6, lou5 si1 waa6 jau5 zung6 jiu3 tung1 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天放学前有班会，老师说有重要通告。
examples.english_sentence: There is a class meeting before dismissal today; the teacher said there is an important announcement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班會通常由班主任主持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 wui6 tung1 soeng4 jau4 baan1 zyu2 jam6 zyu2 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 班会通常由班主任主持。
examples.english_sentence: Class meetings are usually presided over by the homeroom teacher.

mandarin_meaning: 航班；班次飛機
english_meaning: scheduled flight; a particular airplane flight
explanation_mandarin: 指按照時間表運行的飛機班次，常用於機場、旅遊和交通語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to a scheduled airplane flight (a particular flight on the timetable), commonly used in airport, travel, and transportation contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我班機遲咗兩個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baan1 gei1 ci4 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的航班晚了兩個小時。
examples.english_sentence: My flight was delayed by two hours.

mandarin_meaning: 班次 (bāncì)：指交通工具（如公車、火車、飛機）按時刻表運行的每一班次或每日/某時段的出發次數；也可指每班的編號。
english_meaning: The number or frequency of scheduled services (e.g. buses, trains, flights) — an individual scheduled run or the count of runs; can also mean the identifier of a particular run.
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述交通運輸工具按時間表運行的次數或具體的每一班，例如每天有幾多班次、某班次幾點出發等。
explanation_english: Used to describe the scheduled runs of transport services — how many runs there are in a period or a specific scheduled departure (e.g., how many runs per day, what time a specific run departs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵班次平日比較密，唔使等太耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 baan1 ci3 ping4 jat6 bei2 gaau3 mat6, m4 sai2 dang2 taai3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁在平日班次比较密，不用等太久。
examples.english_sentence: On weekdays the subway runs more frequently, so you don't have to wait long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條線每日有幾多班次？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sin3 mui5 jat6 jau5 gei2 do1 baan1 ci3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条线路每天有多少班次？
examples.english_sentence: How many services does this line have each day?

mandarin_meaning: 不是廣泛認可的廣東話詞語；可能是地區俚語、打錯字或罕見用法，需具體語境才能確定意思。
english_meaning: Not a widely recognized Cantonese term; possibly a regional slang, a typo, or a rare usage — meaning depends on context.
explanation_mandarin: 單字「班」常指班次、群體，「水」可指水或俗用作金錢等。但「班水」這個組合在標準粵語詞典中沒有明確詞條。它可能是：1) 地方性俚語；2) 打錯字（例如想寫「搬水」等）；3) 某些圈子內的慣用語。若提供具體語境，可再分析確切含義。
explanation_english: The character '班' often means shift/group and '水' means water (or colloquially money). However, the compound '班水' has no clear entry in standard Cantonese references. It may be: 1) a regional slang; 2) a typo (e.g., intended '搬水'); or 3) a jargon within a particular group. A specific context is needed to determine the exact meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街度聽人講「班水」，但唔知佢係咩意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 teng1 jan4 gong2 "baan1 seoi2", daan6 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 me1 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上聽人說「班水」，但不知道它是什麼意思。
examples.english_sentence: I heard people say '班水' on the street, but I don't know what it means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可能係打錯字，本來想講「搬水」或者其他詞，唔確定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 nang4 hai6 daa2 co3 zi6, bun2 loi4 soeng2 gong2 "bun1 seoi2" waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 ci4, m4 kok3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可能是打錯字，本來想說「搬水」或者其他詞，不確定。
examples.english_sentence: It might be a typo — they may have meant '搬水' or another word; not certain.

mandarin_meaning: 班级合照
english_meaning: class photo
explanation_mandarin: 指班级的合照，通常在学校活动（如开学、毕业）时拍摄。
explanation_english: Refers to a photograph of a class — a group photo of classmates, typically taken at school events such as the start of term or graduation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要影班相，記得著校服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 jing2 baan1 soeng2, gei3 dak1 zoek3 haau6 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天要拍班级照，记得穿校服。
examples.english_sentence: We're taking the class photo tomorrow; remember to wear your school uniform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噚日喺畢業禮度影咗張班相，大家都影得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 hai2 bat1 jip6 lai5 dou6 jing2 zo2 zoeng1 baan1 soeng2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jing2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天在毕业典礼上拍了一张班级照，大家都很开心。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday at the graduation ceremony we took a class photo; everyone was very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 班级 (bānjí)
english_meaning: class (a group of students in a school)
explanation_mandarin: 指在学校中由同一位教师管理的一群学生，或学校按年级/课程划分的一个分班单位。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of students in a school who are taught/managed together by a teacher; a class or class unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班級今次考試成績唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 kap1 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们班级这次考试成绩不错。
examples.english_sentence: Our class did well on the exam this time.

mandarin_meaning: 班兰（香兰），一種常用於東南亞料理的香草（班蘭葉／香兰叶）
english_meaning: pandan (pandanus leaf) — an aromatic leaf used in Southeast Asian cooking for flavoring and coloring
explanation_mandarin: 班蘭（香蘭）為熱帶植物，其葉子有濃郁香氣，常用於東南亞甜點、米飯和飲品中增香或作天然染色。
explanation_english: Pandan (Pandanus amaryllifolius) is a tropical plant whose aromatic leaves are widely used in Southeast Asian cuisine to flavor and naturally color desserts, rice, and drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款椰汁糕加咗班蘭，香味更加濃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 je4 zap1 gou1 gaa1 zo2 baan1 laan4, hoeng1 mei6 gang1 gaa1 nung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款椰汁糕加了班蘭，香味更濃。
examples.english_sentence: This coconut jelly has pandan added, making the aroma richer.

mandarin_meaning: 班服；班级或团队统一的上衣（通常指为活动或纪念而购买的T恤或运动衫）
english_meaning: class/group shirt; matching T‑shirt or uniform worn by members of a class or team
explanation_mandarin: 「班衫」為香港粵語口語，指同一班級、團體或隊伍為了識別或紀念而訂購的統一上衣或T恤，常在畢業、旅行或比賽時出現。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "班衫" refers to matching shirts (often T‑shirts) ordered by a class, group, or team for identification or commemoration, commonly used for graduations, trips, or events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋班下星期要買班衫，大家一齊設計款式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 baan1 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 maai5 baan1 saam1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 sik1 gai3 fun2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们班下星期要买班服，大家一起设计款式。
examples.english_sentence: Our class will buy class shirts next week; everyone will design the style together.

mandarin_meaning: 班长
english_meaning: class monitor; squad/team leader
explanation_mandarin: 指在学校班级或某个小组中担任管理或带领职责的学生或人员，负责纪律、值日或组织事务。有时也用于非正式场合指带头或负责人。
explanation_english: Refers to the student or member who serves as the monitor or leader of a class/group, responsible for discipline, duties, or organizing tasks. Can also be used informally to mean the person in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班長今日冇返學，大家要自行輪流收拾教室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 zoeng2 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 hok6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zi6 hang4 leon6 lau4 sau1 zap1 gaau3 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 班长今天没来上学，大家要自行轮流打扫教室。
examples.english_sentence: The class monitor didn't come to school today; everyone should take turns cleaning the classroom.

mandarin_meaning: 在行家面前賣弄本領；自不量力（班門弄斧）
english_meaning: To show off one's skill in front of an expert; to display slight skill before a master; to be presumptuous or out of one's depth.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在專家或權威面前賣弄本領，不自量力。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone showing off skills before a true expert, implying they are overestimating their own ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你冇必要喺佢面前班門弄斧，佢係嗰方面嘅權威。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mou5 bit1 jiu3 hai6 keoi5 min6 cin4 baan1 mun4 nung6 fu2, keoi5 hai6 go2 fong1 min6 ge3 kyun4 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你沒必要在他面前班門弄斧，他是那方面的權威。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to show off in front of him; he's an authority in that field.

mandarin_meaning: 班际（指不同班级之间的）
english_meaning: inter-class; between classes (e.g., activities or competitions held between school classes)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞（用作定語，如「班際比賽」）
explanation_mandarin: 「班際」指發生在不同班級之間的事務或活動，例如班際比賽、班際聯誼等，常用來描述班級之間的競賽或交流。
explanation_english: "班際" denotes something occurring between different classes (within a school), such as competitions or exchange activities. Often used to describe class-vs-class events (e.g., "inter-class competition").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下個禮拜有個班際運動會，成個禮堂都會好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 jau5 go3 baan1 zai3 wan6 dung6 wui2, seng4 go3 lai5 tong4 dou1 wui5 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校下周有班际运动会，整个礼堂都会很热闹。
examples.english_sentence: The school has an inter-class sports day next week; the whole hall will be lively.

mandarin_meaning: 顶班；代替别人上班
english_meaning: to cover a shift; to fill in for someone's work shift
explanation_mandarin: 「班頂」是廣東話口語用法，表示代替別人上班、頂替班次，相當於「頂班」或「代班」。通常用作動詞，例如「幫我班頂」。
explanation_english: '班頂' (baan1 ding2) is a colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to cover someone else's work shift — equivalent to '頂班' or '代班'. It is used as a verb, e.g. '幫我班頂' = 'cover my shift'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔舒服，今日要搵人幫我班頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6, gam1 jat6 jiu3 wan2 jan4 bong1 ngo5 baan1 ding2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不舒服，今天要找人幫我頂班。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not feeling well; I need to find someone to cover my shift today.

mandarin_meaning: 斑马
english_meaning: zebra
explanation_mandarin: 指一種身體有黑白條紋、屬於馬科的非洲草原動物。日常語境中也常見於構成詞「斑馬線」，表示人行橫道（zebra crossing）。
explanation_english: Refers to the black-and-white striped African equid (a zebra). The term also appears in the compound "zebra crossing" (斑馬線) meaning a pedestrian crossing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺動物園見到一隻班馬，佢條紋好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dung6 mat6 jyun4 gin3 dou3 jat1 zek3 baan1 maa5, keoi5 tiu4 man4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在動物園看到一匹斑馬，它的條紋很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a zebra at the zoo; its stripes are very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 玉佩；佩飾（掛在身上的飾物），亦可指佩戴
english_meaning: jade pendant; pendant or ornament worn on the body; (historically) to wear as an ornament
explanation_mandarin: 「珮」原指用玉或其他材料製成，佩掛於身上的飾物，常見於古代服飾與禮儀中，也可泛指佩戴的飾物。
explanation_english: Refers to a pendant or ornament (often made of jade) worn on the body. Common in historical dress and ceremonies; can generally mean any ornament worn as a pendant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢枚玉珮係家傳之寶，佢一直好珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 mui4 juk6 pui3 hai6 gaa1 cyun4 zi1 bou2, keoi5 jat1 zik6 hou2 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这枚玉佩是家传之宝，他一直很珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: This jade pendant is a family heirloom; he has always treasured it.

mandarin_meaning: （罕見字）珀，指琥珀（化石樹脂）的異體字
english_meaning: Rare variant of the character 珀 (amber, fossilized resin)
explanation_mandarin: 珼為罕見字，常作「珀」的異體字，意指琥珀。在現代書寫與粵語口語中極少使用，通常以「珀」代之。
explanation_english: 珼 is a rare/obsolete variant of 珀, meaning amber (fossilized tree resin). It is seldom used in modern writing or spoken Cantonese, and the form 珀 is normally used instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「珼」好少見，通常寫做「珀」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'pok3' hou2 siu2 gin3, tung1 soeng4 se2 zou6 'pok3'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字“珼”很少见，通常写作“珀”。
examples.english_sentence: The character '珼' is rare; it is usually written as '珀' (amber).

mandarin_meaning: 现 / 出现；现在、目前
english_meaning: to appear; to show; current, present (now)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞；形容詞（常見於複合詞）
explanation_mandarin: 表示出現、顯現或表示當前、現在的狀態。粵語中常見於複合詞如「出現」「現身」「現時」。
explanation_english: Indicates appearing or becoming visible, or denotes the current/present time. Commonly used in Cantonese compounds such as '出現' (to appear), '現身' (to show up), '現時' (current time).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於現身喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jin6 san1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於現身了。
examples.english_sentence: He finally showed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現時天氣好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 si4 tin1 hei3 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 目前天氣很熱。
examples.english_sentence: The current weather is very hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 問題又再次出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man6 tai4 jau6 zoi3 ci3 ceot1 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 問題又再次出現了。
examples.english_sentence: The problem has appeared again.

mandarin_meaning: 现世／今生（指当下的世间或今生）
english_meaning: the present world; this life; the current life (as opposed to an afterlife)
explanation_mandarin: 指当前的世間或今生，常用於佛教語境或討論人生、因果、報應等話題。
explanation_english: Refers to the present world or this life; often used in Buddhist contexts or when talking about life, karma, or worldly matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋都想喺現世過得開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dou1 soeng2 hai2 jin6 sai3 gwo3 dak1 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都想在现世过得开心。
examples.english_sentence: We all want to live happily in this life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢相信現世報應，所以唔做壞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 seon3 jin6 sai3 bou3 jing3, so2 ji5 m4 zou6 waai6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他相信现世报应，所以不做坏事。
examples.english_sentence: He believes in karma in this life, so he doesn't do bad things.

mandarin_meaning: 如今；當今
english_meaning: nowadays; at present; the current times
explanation_mandarin: 表示現在或當前的情況，常用於書面或較正式的語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the present time or current situation; commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現今嘅科技發展得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 gam1 ge3 fo1 gei6 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現今的科技發展得很快。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays technology is developing very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現今嘅社會對環保越來越重視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 gam1 ge3 se5 wui6 deoi3 waan4 bou2 jyut6 loi4 jyut6 zung6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現今的社會對環保越來越重視。
examples.english_sentence: Today's society increasingly values environmental protection.

mandarin_meaning: 现代
english_meaning: modern; contemporary
explanation_mandarin: 表示属于现代时期或具有现代特征，可作名词（指现代时代）或形容词（指现代的、当代的）使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the modern era or having contemporary features; can be used as a noun ('the modern age') or as an adjective ('modern').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市好現代，街上都有好多高樓同智能設備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 hou2 jin6 doi6, gaai1 soeng5 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 gou1 lau4 tung4 zi3 nang4 cit3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市很現代，街上有很多高樓和智能設備。
examples.english_sentence: This city is very modern; the streets have many skyscrapers and smart devices.

mandarin_meaning: 现代主义
english_meaning: Modernism; the artistic and cultural movement emphasizing innovation and a break from traditional forms
explanation_mandarin: 一種在文學、藝術、建築等領域強調創新、打破傳統形式與觀念的思潮或流派。
explanation_english: An artistic and cultural movement in literature, art, architecture, etc., that emphasizes innovation and a departure from traditional forms and conventions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館有個現代主義展覽，展出好多抽象作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 jau5 go3 jin6 doi6 zyu2 ji6 zin2 laam5, zin2 ceot1 hou2 do1 cau1 zoeng6 zok3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间博物馆有一个现代主义展览，展出很多抽象作品。
examples.english_sentence: This museum is hosting a modernist exhibition featuring many abstract works.

mandarin_meaning: 现代化 (xiàn dài huà)
english_meaning: modernization; to modernize
explanation_mandarin: 把事物轉變得更符合現代標準或採用現代技術、制度與觀念的過程或結果。
explanation_english: The process or result of making something modern—bringing it up to contemporary standards, often by adopting modern technology, systems, or ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市而家正喺現代化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ji4 gaa1 zing3 hai6 jin6 doi6 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個城市現在正在現代化。
examples.english_sentence: This city is currently undergoing modernization.

mandarin_meaning: 现代舞
english_meaning: modern dance
explanation_mandarin: 一種20世紀以後發展的舞蹈形式，強調個人表現、創新動作與肢體語言，與古典芭蕾等傳統舞種不同。
explanation_english: A dance form developed since the 20th century that emphasizes individual expression, innovative movement, and physical storytelling, distinct from classical ballet and traditional dance styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期六去上現代舞課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 luk6 heoi3 soeng5 jin6 doi6 mou5 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期六去上现代舞课。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to attend a modern dance class on Saturday.

mandarin_meaning: 现任（xiànrèn）：指当前担任某一职务的人；也可作形容词表示正在担任某职务的。
english_meaning: current; incumbent — a person currently holding a particular office or an adjective meaning holding a current position.
explanation_mandarin: 用來指某人目前正在擔任某職務（如現任市長、現任董事長），既可當名詞指“現任者”，也常作形容詞修飾職務。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who currently holds a particular office (e.g., the incumbent mayor). It can be used as a noun ('the incumbent') or as an adjective ('the current').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係現任公司總經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 jin6 jam6 gung1 si1 zung2 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她現在是現任公司總經理。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the company's current general manager.

mandarin_meaning: 现价 / 当前价格
english_meaning: current price; spot price
explanation_mandarin: 指商品、股票或其他物品在當前時刻的價格，常用於購物、金融與交易場合。
explanation_english: Refers to the price of an item, stock, or commodity at the present moment. Commonly used in shopping, finance, and trading contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫而家嘅現價係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ji4 gaa1 ge3 jin6 gaa3 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服现在的现价是多少？
examples.english_sentence: What's the current price of this shirt?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻股票嘅現價已經升咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gu2 piu3 ge3 jin6 gaa3 ji5 ging1 sing1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只股票的现价已经上涨了。
examples.english_sentence: The current price of the stock has already gone up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以上網查下而家嘅現價嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 soeng5 mong5 caa4 haa5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 jin6 gaa3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在网上查一下现在的现价吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you check the current price online?

mandarin_meaning: 指在现实生活中感到充实、社交或感情生活丰富的人（网络俚语）
english_meaning: a person who is fulfilled in real life — has an active social life, relationship, job, etc. (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「現充」源自日語，常用來形容那些現實生活（社交、感情、工作等）很充實、看起來很幸福的人，通常帶有對比「宅/宅男宅女/二次元」的語境。
explanation_english: Derived from Japanese, this slang labels people whose real-life circumstances (social life, relationships, work) appear fulfilling. It's often used in contrast with otaku/introverted lifestyles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家有女朋友，成日去旅行，真係好現充。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 neoi5 pang4 jau5, sing4 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 hou2 jin6 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在有女朋友，經常去旅行，真的是個很「現充」的人。
examples.english_sentence: He has a girlfriend now and often travels — he's really a 'real-life fulfilled' person.

mandarin_meaning: 炫耀、出風頭／露面吸引注意（港式俗語）
english_meaning: to show off; to make a flashy appearance to attract attention (Hong Kong slang)
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俗語，用來形容故意露面或誇張地炫耀自己以引人注意，多含賣弄、出風頭的意思。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong colloquial/slang term meaning to deliberately appear or behave flamboyantly to attract attention; often implies showing off or seeking the spotlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去酒吧現兜兜，成日想引人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 zau2 baa1 jin6 dau1 dau1, seng4 jat6 soeng2 jan5 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常去酒吧出風頭，總想引起別人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to bars to show off, always trying to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗件名牌衫，出街一定要現兜兜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gin6 ming4 paai4 saam1, ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jin6 dau1 dau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他買了件名牌衣服，上街一定要炫耀一番。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a designer shirt and had to flaunt it when going out.

mandarin_meaning: 被揭穿、當場拆穿（尤指在網路或朋友面前被發現是假、作假）
english_meaning: to be exposed / to be caught out (especially for faking something online or in front of others)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語網絡/口語俗語，指某人當場或被人揭發其假象、偽裝或作假（例如修圖、誇大本領等），被當眾拆穿。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression used when someone is publicly exposed as fake or fraudulent (for example, photoshopped images or exaggerated skills) — to be caught out or revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺IG放嗰啲靚相係用濾鏡整出嚟，俾人現叉廚晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 IG fong3 go2 di1 leng3 soeng2 hai6 jung6 leoi6 geng2 zeng2 ceot1 lai4, bei2 jan4 jin6 caa1 cyu4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在IG放的那些漂亮照片是用濾鏡加工的，被人當場拆穿了。
examples.english_sentence: The nice photos he posted on IG were edited with filters; he got exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係大廚，但試咗佢煮嘅，大家即刻現叉廚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 daai6 cyu4, daan6 si3 zo2 keoi5 zyu2 ge3, daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 jin6 caa1 cyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是大廚，但大家嘗了他做的菜後立刻揭穿了他。
examples.english_sentence: He claimed to be a great chef, but after everyone tasted his food they immediately exposed him.

mandarin_meaning: 现在
english_meaning: now; at present
explanation_mandarin: 表示當前的時間或此刻，用來指示現在的狀態或時間點。
explanation_english: Indicates the current time or moment; used to refer to the present state or point in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我現在好忙，無時間去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jin6 zoi6 hou2 mong4, mou5 si4 gaan3 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在很忙，沒時間去吃點心。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very busy right now and don't have time to go for dim sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你現在仲做緊乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jin6 zoi6 zung6 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你現在還在做什麼？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing right now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現在天氣開始凍咗，記得著衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 zoi6 tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 dung3 zo2, gei3 dak1 zoek3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在天氣開始冷了，記得穿衣服。
examples.english_sentence: It's getting cold now; remember to put on some clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 現場 / 當場 (xiànchǎng)
english_meaning: scene; on-site; on the spot; live (broadcast)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事件或活動發生的地點（現場、當場）；也可表示在場或當場進行（可作名詞或副詞）。
explanation_english: Refers to the place where an event or incident occurs (the scene) or doing something on the spot; can function as a noun or an adverb. Also used for live/on-site broadcasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方話現場已經封鎖，唔好入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waa6 jin6 coeng4 ji5 ging1 fung1 so2, m4 hou2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方說現場已經封鎖，不要進去。
examples.english_sentence: The police said the scene has already been cordoned off; don't go in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺現場示範俾我哋睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jin6 coeng4 si6 faan3 bei2 ngo5 dei6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在現場示範給我們看。
examples.english_sentence: He demonstrated it on-site for us to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚會有現場直播，記得準時收睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 wui5 jau5 jin6 coeng4 zik6 bo3, gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4 sau1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚會有現場直播，記得準時收看。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a live on-site broadcast tonight; remember to watch on time.

mandarin_meaning: 现场感 (xiànchǎnggǎn)：对现场氛围或临场体验的感知
english_meaning: sense of presence; sense of being at the scene; the feeling of immediacy or live atmosphere
explanation_mandarin: 指在观看、聆听或参与活动时，能够感受到现场氛围或身临其境的感受。常用于描述演出、直播、影像或音频等所带来的临场体验。
explanation_english: Refers to the perceived feeling of being physically present at an event or scene — the live atmosphere or immediacy experienced when watching performances, livestreams, video/audio that convey a 'being there' sensation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場演唱會嘅現場感好強，好似親身到場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 jin6 coeng4 gam2 hou2 koeng4, hou2 ci5 can1 san1 dou3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场演唱会的现场感很强，感觉像是亲临现场。
examples.english_sentence: The concert had a strong sense of presence; it felt like being there in person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個直播鏡頭帶出好強嘅現場感，觀眾反應好熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik6 bo3 geng3 tau4 daai3 ceot1 hou2 koeng4 ge3 jin6 coeng4 gam2, gun1 zung3 faan2 jing4 hou2 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个直播镜头传达出很强的现场感，观众反响很热烈。
examples.english_sentence: This livestream shot conveyed a strong sense of presence; the audience responded enthusiastically.

mandarin_meaning: 现场观众（在现场观看活动或演出的观众）
english_meaning: live audience; on-site audience (people physically present at an event or performance)
explanation_mandarin: 指親自到活動或演出現場觀看的人群，與線上觀眾或電視觀眾相對。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are physically present at an event or performance, as opposed to online or broadcast viewers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚演唱會嘅現場觀眾多到爆，氣氛超級熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 jin6 coeng4 gun1 zung3 do1 dou3 baau3, hei3 fan1 ciu1 kap1 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚演唱會的現場觀眾非常多，氣氛很熱烈。
examples.english_sentence: The live audience at tonight's concert was packed and the atmosphere was extremely lively.

mandarin_meaning: 现场观众
english_meaning: live audience; audience present at the venue
explanation_mandarin: 指親自到活動或表演現場觀看節目或表演的觀眾。
explanation_english: Refers to people who are physically present at an event or performance to watch it live.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次演唱會入面有幾千個現場觀眾，好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 jin2 coeng3 wui6 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 cin1 go3 jin6 coeng4 gun1 zung3, hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次演唱会现场有几千名观众，非常热闹。
examples.english_sentence: There were several thousand live audience members at this concert; it was very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 現存 / 存在於現在
english_meaning: existing; extant; currently in existence
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 動詞（表示目前仍然存在）
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物目前仍然存在或保留，多用來描述文物、建築、文獻等仍然存留於世。
explanation_english: Indicates that something still exists or remains at present; often used to describe surviving artifacts, buildings, records, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座古屋係現存最古老嘅建築之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 gu2 uk1 hai6 jin6 cyun4 zeoi3 gu2 lou5 ge3 gin3 zuk1 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這座古屋是現存最古老的建築之一。
examples.english_sentence: This old house is one of the oldest extant buildings.

mandarin_meaning: 现实 (xiànshí)
english_meaning: reality; realistic; practical
explanation_mandarin: 表示客观存在的情况或指一种务实、不抱幻想的态度。
explanation_english: Refers to objective reality or a pragmatic, unsentimental attitude; can mean 'reality' (noun) or 'realistic/practical' (adjective).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好現實，唔係咁多幻想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jin6 sat6, m4 hai6 gam2 do1 waan6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很现实，不是那麼多幻想。
examples.english_sentence: He's very realistic; not so full of fantasies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現實好殘酷，唔係所有計劃都會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 sat6 hou2 caan4 huk6, m4 hai6 soeng5 jau5 gai3 waak6 dou1 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现实很残酷，不是所有计划都会成功。
examples.english_sentence: Reality is harsh; not every plan will succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要面對現實，唔可以一直逃避。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 min6 deoi3 jin6 sat6, m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 zik6 tou4 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要面对现实，不能一直逃避。
examples.english_sentence: You have to face reality; you can't keep avoiding it.

mandarin_meaning: 现届；本届、目前任期的
english_meaning: the current term/session (of an office, legislature, cohort, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示目前任期的屆次，常用於政府、議會、學生會或各類組織，意指「本屆」或「現任屆期」。
explanation_english: Refers to the current term or session of an office, body, or cohort (e.g., government, legislature, student union); equivalent to "this term" or "the current session."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現屆政府承諾改善房屋問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 gaai3 zing3 fu2 sing4 nok6 goi2 sin6 fong4 uk1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本届政府承诺改善住房问题。
examples.english_sentence: The current government has pledged to improve housing problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現屆委員會下個月屆滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 gaai3 wai2 jyun4 wui6 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaai3 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本届委员会下个月届满。
examples.english_sentence: The current committee's term ends next month.

mandarin_meaning: 現年（指某人目前的年齡）
english_meaning: currently aged; the current age (of someone)
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某人目前的年齡，常用於報告或介紹年齡，例如「現年三十歲」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a person's current age; commonly used when reporting or stating someone's age, e.g. 'is currently 30 years old.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢現年三十五歲，仲好健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jin6 nin4 saam1 sap6 ng5 seoi3, zung6 hou2 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現年三十五歲，還很健康。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently 35 years old and still very healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢現年淨係二十歲，已經係公司經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jin6 nin4 zing6 hai6 ji6 sap6 seoi3, ji5 ging1 hai6 gung1 si1 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現年只有二十歲，已經是公司經理。
examples.english_sentence: He is only 20 years old but already a company manager.

mandarin_meaning: 现形（显露真面目、露出马脚）
english_meaning: to reveal one's true identity or nature; to be exposed
explanation_mandarin: 表示隱藏的真實身份、意圖或真面目被揭露出來，常用於被抓包或露出破綻時。
explanation_english: Used when someone's true identity, intentions, or nature are revealed or exposed, often when they are caught or their flaws show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於現形，原來係個騙子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jin6 jing4, jyun4 loi4 hai6 go3 pin3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於現形，原來是個騙子。
examples.english_sentence: He finally revealed his true colors — it turns out he's a fraud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺社交媒體上，佢啲真面目現形晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6, keoi5 di1 zan1 min6 muk6 jin6 jing4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在社交媒體上，他們的真面目顯露無遺。
examples.english_sentence: On social media, their true faces were exposed.

mandarin_meaning: 现役（目前仍在服役或在職）
english_meaning: on active service; active (currently serving or in service)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞（軍事用語）
explanation_mandarin: 指目前仍在服役或仍在從事某項職務，常用於軍人或仍在職的職業運動員等。
explanation_english: Refers to someone currently serving or active in a role; commonly used for military personnel or professional athletes who are still in service/competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲係現役軍人，未打算退役。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 hai6 jin6 jik6 gwan1 jan4, mei6 daa2 syun3 teoi3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还是现役军人，没打算退役。
examples.english_sentence: He's still an active-duty soldier and doesn't plan to leave the service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家仲係現役球員，未有退役計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 jin6 jik6 kau4 jyun4, mei6 jau5 teoi3 jik6 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在还是现役球员，还没有退役计划。
examples.english_sentence: He is still an active player and has no plans to retire.

mandarin_meaning: 现成
english_meaning: ready-made; already prepared; readily available
explanation_mandarin: 表示東西已經做好或已存在，可以直接使用或採用，不需要再加工或製作。
explanation_english: Indicates something that is already made or available for immediate use; ready-made or preexisting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲材料係現成嘅，可以即刻用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 coi4 liu2 hai6 jin6 sing4 ge3, ho2 ji5 zik1 haak1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些材料是现成的，可以立刻用。
examples.english_sentence: These materials are ready-made and can be used immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想整，買現成嘅比較快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zeng2, maai5 jin6 sing4 ge3 bei2 gaau3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想做，买现成的比较快。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to make it; buying ready-made ones is faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有現成方案可以採用，唔需要重新設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 jin6 sing4 fong1 on3 ho2 ji5 coi2 jung6, m4 seoi1 jiu3 cung4 san1 cit3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有现成方案可以采用，不需要重新设计。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a ready-made plan that can be adopted; there's no need to redesign.

mandarin_meaning: 目前 / 现在
english_meaning: at present; currently
explanation_mandarin: 表示當前的時間或情況，語氣較正式，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates the present time or current situation; relatively formal and often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現時我哋未有確定嘅日期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 si4 ngo5 dei6 mei6 jau5 kok3 ding6 ge3 jat6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 目前我们还没有确定的日期。
examples.english_sentence: At present we don't have a confirmed date.

mandarin_meaning: 暫時 / 目前
english_meaning: for now; temporarily; at present
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語用法，表示目前或暫時的狀態，類似「暫時／目前」。常見於口語或在線聊天中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning 'for now' or 'temporarily'. Used to indicate a current, temporary state, similar to 'for the time being'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我現暫唔想去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jin6 zaam6 m4 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我暫時不想去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to travel for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃現暫未決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jin6 zaam6 mei6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個計畫暫時還沒決定。
examples.english_sentence: This plan hasn't been decided yet for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現暫咁做比較好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 zaam6 gam2 zou6 bei2 gaau3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暫時這樣做比較好。
examples.english_sentence: It's better to do it like this for now.

synonyms: 而家暫時 (ji4 gaa1 zaam6 si4)

mandarin_meaning: 现有（目前存在的、可利用的）
english_meaning: existing; current; presently available
explanation_mandarin: 表示目前已經存在或可供使用的事物或狀態，常用於正式或書面語中，例如描述現有資源、現有政策等。
explanation_english: Indicates something that currently exists or is available for use. Commonly used in formal or written contexts to describe existing resources, policies, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現有名額只剩十個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 jau5 ming4 ngok6 zi2 seng2 sap6 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现有名额只剩十个。
examples.english_sentence: There are only ten places left from the existing quota.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會利用現有資源改善系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 lei6 jung6 jin6 jau5 zi1 jyun4 goi2 sin6 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會利用現有資源改善系統。
examples.english_sentence: The company will use existing resources to improve the system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現有政策未能解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 jau5 zing3 caak3 mei6 nang4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現有政策未能解決問題。
examples.english_sentence: The current policy cannot solve the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 現樓／現房（已建成並可即時交付使用的樓宇或單位）
english_meaning: completed building / ready-to-move-in property (a housing unit or building already completed and available for immediate occupancy)
explanation_mandarin: 指已經建成並可即時交付使用的屋宇或單位，通常與「樓花」（未建成的預售單位、期房）相對。
explanation_english: Refers to a building or housing unit that has already been completed and is available for immediate occupancy; contrasted with presale or off‑plan units.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新盤係現樓，可以即刻攞鎖匙入伙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 pun4 hai6 jin6 lau4, ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 lo2 so2 si4 jap6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個新盤是現樓，可以立刻拿到鑰匙入住。
examples.english_sentence: This new development is a completed building (ready to move in); you can get the keys and move in immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開發商話會賣樓花，但我寧願買現樓，唔想等幾年先收樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 faat3 soeng1 waa6 wui5 maai6 lau4 faa1, daan6 ngo5 ning4 jyun6 maai5 jin6 lau4, m4 soeng2 dang2 gei2 nin4 sin1 sau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開發商說會賣樓花，但我寧願買現樓，不想等幾年才收樓。
examples.english_sentence: The developer says they'll sell presale units, but I'd rather buy a completed unit; I don't want to wait several years to take possession.

mandarin_meaning: 现款 / 现金 (xiànkuǎn)
english_meaning: cash (physical banknotes/coins); cash payment
explanation_mandarin: 指以現金（紙幣或硬幣）支付，不使用信用卡、轉帳或支票等非現金方式。常用於標示只接受現金付款。
explanation_english: Refers to payment in cash (banknotes or coins), not by card, transfer, or cheque. Commonly used to indicate 'cash only' transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件嘢賣五十蚊，只收現款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 je5 maai6 ng5 sap6 man1, zi2 sau1 jin6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件东西卖五十块，只收现金。
examples.english_sentence: This item is fifty dollars — cash only.

mandarin_meaning: 现况 / 当前状况
english_meaning: current situation; present condition; status
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或某情況在當下的情形或狀態，常用於描述社會、公司、疫情等的現時狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to the present condition or state of something; commonly used to describe the current status of society, a company, an epidemic, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家嘅現況唔太好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ge3 jin6 fong3 m4 taai3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在的現況不太好。
examples.english_sentence: The current situation isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會定期公布疫情現況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 ding6 kei4 gung1 bou3 jing4 cing4 jin6 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會定期公布疫情的現況。
examples.english_sentence: The government will regularly announce the current situation of the epidemic.

mandarin_meaning: 现状 (xiànzhuàng)
english_meaning: current situation; status quo
explanation_mandarin: 表示當前的情況或狀態，通常指某個系統、組織或事情的現有情形。
explanation_english: Refers to the present condition or state of affairs, often describing the existing situation of a system, organization, or issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要接受現狀，先可以諗下一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zip3 sau6 jin6 zong6, sin1 ho2 ji5 lam2 haa6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要接受现状，才能想下一步。
examples.english_sentence: We need to accept the current situation before we can think about the next step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府需要正視現狀，並推出解決方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 zing3 si6 jin6 zong6, bing6 teoi1 ceot1 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府需要正视现状，并推出解决方案。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to face the current situation and introduce solutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想改善現狀，就要改變管理方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 goi2 sin3 jin6 zong6, zau6 jiu3 goi2 bin3 gun2 lei5 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想改善现状，就要改变管理方式。
examples.english_sentence: If a company wants to improve the current situation, it must change its management style.

mandarin_meaning: 當眾出醜 / 遭到公開的羞辱或報應
english_meaning: to be publicly humiliated / to get a public comeuppance
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指因為先前的行為（例如嘲笑或得意）而在眾人面前丟臉或受到報應、被揭穿失態。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning to be publicly embarrassed or to receive a comeuppance in front of others, often as a result of one's earlier arrogance or mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日笑人，遲啲可能會畀人現眼報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 siu3 jan4, ci4 di1 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei2 jan4 hin6 ngaan5 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要總是嘲笑別人，遲早可能會被人當眾出醜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep mocking others — you might get publicly humiliated later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話件事好簡單，點知做唔到，真係畀自己現眼報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gin6 si6 hou2 gaan2 daan1, dim2 zi1 zou6 m4 dou2, zan1 hai6 bei2 zi6 gei2 hin6 ngaan5 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說那件事很簡單，結果做不到，真是自找當眾出醜。
examples.english_sentence: He said the task was easy but couldn't do it — he really embarrassed himself in public.

mandarin_meaning: 现职 (目前担任的职务)
english_meaning: current position; current post; incumbent job
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人目前擔任的職位或職務，強調現在正在任職的工作崗位。
explanation_english: Refers to the job or position a person is currently holding, emphasizing the post they presently occupy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家嘅現職係市場部經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 jin6 zik1 hai6 si5 coeng4 bou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在的現職是市場部經理。
examples.english_sentence: His current position is marketing manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗現職，去創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 jin6 zik1, heoi3 cong3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她辭去了現職，去創業。
examples.english_sentence: She resigned from her current post to start a business.

mandarin_meaning: 當莊；擔任莊家
english_meaning: to act as the banker/dealer (in a gambling game); to be the current dealer
explanation_mandarin: 口語/俚語，指在賭局或遊戲中擔任莊家（負責發牌或承擔賭局中的莊家角色）。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang term meaning to take the role of the banker/dealer in a gambling game or round (the player who acts as the house).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今局由阿強現莊，大家小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 guk6 jau4 aa3 koeng4 jin6 zong1, daai6 gaa1 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這一局由阿強當莊，大家要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This round Ah Keung is the dealer, everyone be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 现行；当前正在实施的、现有的
english_meaning: current; in force; existing (now in effect)
explanation_mandarin: 指目前正在实施或已经存在并有效的制度、法律、規定等。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is currently in effect or in force (e.g., a law, policy, or system).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現行法律禁止喺公共場所吸煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 hong4 faat3 leot6 gam2 zi2 hai2 gung1 gung6 coeng4 so2 kap1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现行法律禁止在公共场所吸烟。
examples.english_sentence: The current law prohibits smoking in public places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 根據現行制度，員工享有年假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 geoi3 jin6 hong4 zai3 dou6, jyun4 gung1 hoeng2 jau5 nin4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 根据现行制度，员工享有年假。
examples.english_sentence: Under the current system, employees are entitled to annual leave.

mandarin_meaning: 现象 (xiànxiàng)
english_meaning: phenomenon; observable event or occurrence
explanation_mandarin: 指在自然、社會或科學範疇中出現、可被觀察或描述的事件或表現。
explanation_english: An observable event or occurrence in nature, society, or science; something that can be seen and described.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個現象最近好多人都討論緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jin6 zoeng6 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 tou2 leon6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个现象最近有很多人在讨论。
examples.english_sentence: This phenomenon has been widely discussed recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市熱島效應係一種常見嘅現象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 jit6 dou2 haau6 jing3 hai6 jat1 zung2 soeng4 gin3 ge3 jin6 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市热岛效应是一种常见的现象。
examples.english_sentence: The urban heat island effect is a common phenomenon.

mandarin_meaning: 现货
english_meaning: in-stock goods; spot goods; ready stock
explanation_mandarin: 指現成有貨、可以即時出貨或販售的商品，與預購或訂貨相對。
explanation_english: Refers to items that are currently in stock and ready to be sold or shipped immediately, as opposed to pre-order or backorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 門市有現貨，唔使等，今日買今日拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mun4 si5 jau5 jin6 fo3, m4 sai2 dang2, gam1 jat6 maai5 gam1 jat6 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 门市有现货，不用等，今天买今天带走。
examples.english_sentence: The store has items in stock, no need to wait — buy today, take it home today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批貨係現貨，可以即日出貨俾客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pat1 fo3 hai6 jin6 fo3, ho2 ji5 zik1 jat6 ceot1 fo3 bei2 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这批货是现货，可以当天发货给顾客。
examples.english_sentence: This batch is in stock and can be shipped to customers the same day.

mandarin_meaning: 現身 / 出現、露面
english_meaning: to appear; to show up; to make an appearance
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某地或公開場合出現、露面，常用於新聞或正式語境，也可指私人或網上身份的出現。
explanation_english: Means to appear or show up (somewhere), to make a public appearance. Used in news/formal contexts and also for someone coming forward or revealing themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於喺晚會現身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 hai2 maan5 wui2 jin6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於在晚會上現身。
examples.english_sentence: He finally showed up at the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有目擊者已經現身作證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 muk6 gik1 ze2 ji5 ging1 jin6 san1 zok3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有目擊者已經現身作證。
examples.english_sentence: A witness has already come forward to testify.

mandarin_meaning: 現身說法／以親身經驗作說明
english_meaning: to give a first-hand account; to illustrate by one's own personal experience
explanation_mandarin: 表示以親身到場或以自己的經歷來說明或示範，通常用作舉例、勸誡或證明某事的真實性。
explanation_english: Indicates explaining or demonstrating something by appearing in person or citing one's own experience; often used to give an example, warn others, or prove the truth of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師請咗一位前輩上台現身說法，分享求職經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 ceng2 zo2 jat1 wai2 cin4 bui3 soeng5 toi4 jin6 san1 syut3 faat3, fan1 hoeng2 gau2 zik1 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師請了一位前輩上台現身說法，分享求職經驗。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher invited a senior to come on stage and give a first-hand account, sharing job-hunting experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到騙案之後，警方都希望受害人現身說法，提醒市民提高警覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 pin3 on3 zi1 hau6, ging2 fong1 dou1 hei1 mong6 sau6 hoi6 jan4 jin6 san1 syut3 faat3, tai4 sing2 si5 man4 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到詐騙案之後，警方都希望受害人現身說法，提醒市民提高警覺。
examples.english_sentence: After fraud cases, the police hope victims will come forward and give first-hand accounts to warn the public to be more vigilant.

mandarin_meaning: 以親身經歷或親自示範來說明或勸導
english_meaning: to explain or persuade by personal example; to demonstrate or testify from one's own experience
explanation_mandarin: 指以自己的親身經歷或親自示範來說明問題、提供證據或勸導他人，常用於演講、宣導或教育場合。
explanation_english: Refers to explaining, persuading, or demonstrating by appearing in person or by using one's own experience as an example; commonly used in talks, advocacy, or teaching contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺講座入面現身說法，分享佢戒煙成功嘅經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 gong2 zo6 jap6 min6 jin6 san1 syut3 faat3, fan1 hoeng2 keoi5 gaai3 jin1 sing4 gung1 ge3 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師在講座中現身說法，分享他戒菸成功的經驗。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher spoke from personal experience at the seminar, sharing his success in quitting smoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司經理親自現身說法，示範點解要重視客戶投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ging1 lei5 can1 zi6 jin6 san1 syut3 faat3, si6 faan3 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 cung4 si6 haak3 wu6 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司經理親自現身說法，示範為何要重視客戶投訴。
examples.english_sentence: The company manager personally demonstrated and explained why customer complaints should be taken seriously.

mandarin_meaning: 現身說法 (xiàn shēn shuō fǎ)：親自出面講述或示範，用自身經歷來說明或勸戒他人。
english_meaning: To appear in person to explain or demonstrate, often using one's own experience to instruct or admonish others.
explanation_mandarin: 指親自出面說明或示範，利用自己的經歷或行為來說服或提醒別人。
explanation_english: Refers to personally coming forward to explain or demonstrate, using one's own experience or actions to persuade or warn others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗提醒大家，佢現身説法，講出自己曾經犯過嘅錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 tai4 sing2 daai6 gaa1, keoi5 jin6 san1 syut3 faat3, gong2 ceot1 zi6 gei2 cang4 ging1 faan6 gwo3 ge3 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了提醒大家，他現身說法，講出自己曾經犯過的錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: To warn everyone, he appeared in person to speak, recounting mistakes he had once made.

mandarin_meaning: 现金 (xiànjīn)
english_meaning: cash (physical money); cash payment
explanation_mandarin: 指實物貨幣，如紙幣或硬幣；用於即時支付的現款。
explanation_english: Refers to physical money (banknotes and coins); money used for immediate/cash payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要帶多啲現金，因為有啲小店只收現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daai3 do1 di1 jin6 gam1, jan1 wai6 jau5 di1 siu2 dim3 zi2 sau1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要帶多一點現金，因為有些小店只收現金。
examples.english_sentence: We should bring more cash because some small shops only accept cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用信用卡，但有啲情況要用現金先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 seon3 jung6 kaa1, daan6 jau5 di1 cing4 fong3 jiu3 jung6 jin6 gam1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用信用卡，但有些情況需要用現金才行。
examples.english_sentence: You can use a credit card, but in some situations cash is required.

mandarin_meaning: 现金流
english_meaning: cash flow
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或個人在一定時期內現金的流入與流出情況，用來衡量短期支付能力與資金周轉狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to the movement of cash into and out of a business or individual over a period of time; used to assess short-term liquidity and the ability to meet obligations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個月公司嘅現金流有啲緊張，可能要申請短期貸款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyut6 gung1si1 ge3 jin6 gam1 lau4 jau5 di1 gan2 zoeng1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 san1 cing2 dyun2 kei4 daai3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月公司的现金流有点紧张，可能要申请短期贷款。
examples.english_sentence: The company's cash flow is a bit tight this month; it may have to apply for a short-term loan.

mandarin_meaning: 现钞；现金（纸币）
english_meaning: cash; physical banknotes
explanation_mandarin: 指實體的紙幣，不包括支票或電子支付。
explanation_english: Refers to physical banknotes (paper money), excluding checks or electronic payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇帶信用卡，淨係有啲現鈔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 daai3 seon3 jung6 kaat1, zing6 hai6 jau5 di1 jin6 caau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒帶信用卡，只有一些現鈔。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't bring my credit card; I only have some cash.

mandarin_meaning: 现金（口语）
english_meaning: cash (physical money)
explanation_mandarin: 「現銀」是廣東話的口語用法，指實物現金，如紙幣或硬幣，常用於日常交易或強調需用現金付款的情況。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "現銀" is a colloquial term referring to physical cash (banknotes or coins), often used in everyday transactions or to emphasize payment in cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳唔收信用卡，最好帶足夠現銀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 m4 sau1 seon3 jung6 kaat1, zeoi3 hou2 daai3 zuk1 gau3 jin6 ngan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅不收信用卡，最好带足够现金。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant doesn't accept credit cards; it's best to bring enough cash.

mandarin_meaning: 现金
english_meaning: cash (physical money)
explanation_mandarin: 指實際的紙幣或硬幣，可立即使用的現金，不包括支票或電子轉賬。
explanation_english: Refers to physical money (banknotes or coins) available for immediate use; excludes checks or electronic transfers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖只收現錢，唔收信用卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 zi2 sau1 jin6 cin2, m4 sau1 seon3 jung6 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间店只收现金，不收信用卡。
examples.english_sentence: This shop only accepts cash; it doesn't accept credit cards.

mandarin_meaning: 现阶段 (xiàn jiēduàn)
english_meaning: at this stage; the current stage
explanation_mandarin: 表示目前的階段或當前的時期，常用來說明在某個特定時期內的情況或安排。
explanation_english: Refers to the current stage or phase; used to indicate the present period when describing conditions or arrangements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現階段我哋暫時唔會更改計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 gaai1 dyun6 ngo5 dei6 zaam6 si4 m4 wui5 gang1 goi2 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现阶段我们暂时不会更改计划。
examples.english_sentence: At this stage, we will not change the plan for the time being.

mandarin_meaning: 球 (qiú)：球体、球状物；也指球类运动用球或泛指球类运动。
english_meaning: ball; sphere; globe; (by extension) ball used in sports or ball sports in general.
explanation_mandarin: 表示圆形的物体或球状体；在体育中常指用来比赛或练习的球，也可用作某些运动名称的后缀（如足球、羽毛球）。
explanation_english: Refers to a round object or sphere; in sports it commonly denotes the ball used in play, and it appears as a suffix in names of ball sports (e.g., football, badminton).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一個新球，想唔想去打球？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 kau4, soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 daa2 kau4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新球，你想不想去打球？
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new ball. Do you want to go play ball?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地球係我哋嘅屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 kau4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地球是我们的家。
examples.english_sentence: The Earth is our home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係羽毛球選手，成日練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jyu5 mou4 kau4 syun2 sau2, sing4 jat6 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是羽毛球选手，经常练习。
examples.english_sentence: He is a badminton player and practices frequently.

mandarin_meaning: 体育道德；比赛中的风度与公平竞赛精神
english_meaning: sportsmanship; fair play (attitude and conduct during a game)
explanation_mandarin: 指运动或比赛中的品行与风度，尤其指是否有公平竞争、尊重对手与遵守规则的态度；常用于评价球员或球队的行为，也可用于讽刺不良行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a player's or team's sportsmanship—how they behave during a match, including fairness, respect for opponents, and adherence to rules. Can be used to praise good conduct or criticize unsportsmanlike behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個球品真係好差，犯咗規就唔承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 kau4 ban2 zan1 hai6 hou2 caa1, faan6 zo2 gwai1 zau6 m4 sing4 jan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的运动道德真差，犯规了就不承认。
examples.english_sentence: His sportsmanship is really poor; he commits fouls and refuses to admit it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽最後嗰下佢好有球品，冇再鬧對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 zeoi3 hau6 go2 haa6 keoi5 hou2 jau5 kau4 ban2, mou5 zoi3 naau6 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛最后那一下他很有运动家风范，没有再骂对手。
examples.english_sentence: In the final moment of the match he showed great sportsmanship and didn't insult the opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇佢咁做，根本冇球品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 keoi5 gam2 zou6, gan1 bun2 mou5 kau4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看他那样做，根本没有运动精神。
examples.english_sentence: Look at what he did; he has no sportsmanship at all.

mandarin_meaning: 球員；參與球類比賽或運動的運動員
english_meaning: player (of ball games); athlete who plays ball sports (e.g., footballer, basketball player)
explanation_mandarin: 指參與球類運動或比賽的運動員，例如足球員、籃球員、排球員等，通常在隊伍中擔任特定位置或職責。
explanation_english: Refers to an athlete who participates in ball sports or matches, such as a footballer, basketball player, or volleyball player; usually a member of a team with a specific position or role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個足球員，訓練好刻苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 zuk1 kau4 jyun4, fan3 lin6 hou2 hak1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一名足球員，訓練非常刻苦。
examples.english_sentence: He is a football player who trains very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球員需要團隊合作先可以贏波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 jyun4 seoi1 jiu3 tyun4 deoi6 hap6 zok3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jing4 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球員需要團隊合作才能贏球。
examples.english_sentence: Players need teamwork to win matches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗十年球員，已經退役。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4 kau4 jyun4, ji5 ging1 teoi3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當了十年球員，已經退役。
examples.english_sentence: He was a player for ten years and has already retired.

mandarin_meaning: 球场 (qiúchǎng)
english_meaning: ball field; sports field; stadium; court
explanation_mandarin: 指用于进行球类运动或比赛的场地，如足球场、篮球场、网球场等。
explanation_english: A venue or area used for ball sports or related activities, such as a soccer field, basketball court, or tennis court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個禮拜去球場踢波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 kau4 coeng4 tek3 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个礼拜去球场踢球吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the soccer field to play next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個球場有冇更衣室？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kau4 coeng4 jau5 mou5 geng1 ji1 sat1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球场有更衣室吗？
examples.english_sentence: Does this venue have changing rooms?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賽事期間球場入面好多人，要早啲去搵位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi3 si6 kei4 gaan1 kau4 coeng4 jap6 min6 hou2 do1 jan4, jiu3 zou2 di1 heoi3 wan2 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛期间球场里人很多，要早点去找位置。
examples.english_sentence: During the match the stadium is very crowded; go early to find a seat.

mandarin_meaning: 球坛（指球类运动的界别或圈子）
english_meaning: the world/scene of ball sports; the ball-sports community (e.g., football, basketball)
explanation_mandarin: 指與球類運動有關的界別或圈子，包括比賽、球隊、選手和相關的新聞與活動，常用來描述足球、籃球等項目的整體生態或動態。
explanation_english: Refers to the sphere or community of ball sports, including competitions, teams, players, and related news or activities; commonly used to describe the overall scene for sports like football and basketball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年球壇競爭好激烈，球隊成日買外援增強陣容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 kau4 taan4 ging3 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6, kau4 deoi6 sing4 jat6 maai5 ngoi6 jyun4 zang1 koeng4 zan6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年球坛竞争很激烈，球队经常买外援增强阵容。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years the ball-sports scene has been very competitive; teams often buy foreign players to strengthen their squads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一入球壇就好快成名，做咗好出名嘅球評員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jap6 kau4 taan4 zau6 hou2 faai3 sing4 ming4, zou6 zo2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 kau4 ping4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一进入球坛就很快成名，成為知名的球評員。
examples.english_sentence: He became famous very quickly after entering the ball-sports world and became a well-known pundit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球壇消息話佢可能轉會到歐洲球隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 taan4 siu1 sik1 waa6 keoi5 ho2 nang4 zyun2 wui6 dou3 au1 zau1 kau4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球坛有消息說他可能转会到欧洲球队。
examples.english_sentence: According to reports in the ball-sports world, he may transfer to a European club.

mandarin_meaning: 球季 / 赛季（指某種球類運動的一個比賽季節，如棒球賽季、籃球賽季）
english_meaning: ball season; season of a ball sport (e.g., baseball season, basketball season)
explanation_mandarin: 指以球類運動為單位的一段比賽時間，例如棒球季、籃球季，常用來表示一整個比賽賽季的時期。
explanation_english: Refers to the competitive season for a ball sport (e.g., baseball season, basketball season). Used to indicate the period during which a sport's official matches are held.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個球季佢表現好好，可能會入選國家隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 kau4 gwai3 keoi5 biu2 jin6 hou2 hou2, ho2 nang4 wui5 jap6 syun2 gwok3 gaa1 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球季他的表现很好，可能会入选国家队。
examples.english_sentence: He performed very well this season; he might be selected for the national team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球季快開始，我哋要盡快買飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 gwai3 faai3 hoi1 ci2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 maai5 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球季快开始，我们要尽快买票。
examples.english_sentence: The season is starting soon; we should buy tickets quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 球员
english_meaning: ball player; player of a ball sport (e.g., footballer, basketball player, golfer)
explanation_mandarin: 指參與球類運動的選手或運動員，口語中可泛指任何球類比賽的隊員，有時特指高爾夫球手或職業球員。
explanation_english: Refers to a player who participates in ball sports. Commonly used for players in games like football, basketball, or golf; can be used generally for ball-game athletes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋隊嘅主力球手，今場比賽踢得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 deoi6 ge3 zyu2 lik6 kau4 sau2, gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 tek3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们队的主力球员，这场比赛踢得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He is the main player on our team; he played very well in this game.

mandarin_meaning: 球技 (qiújì) — 指球類運動的技術或技巧
english_meaning: ball skills; proficiency or technique in ball sports
explanation_mandarin: 指在足球、籃球、排球等球類運動中，對控球、傳球、射門、防守等技術的掌握與表現。
explanation_english: Refers to the techniques and abilities in ball sports (e.g., control, passing, shooting, defending) and how well someone performs them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅球技好好，成日喺學校代表隊踢波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kau4 gei6 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 doi6 biu2 deoi6 tek3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的球技很好，經常在學校代表隊踢球。
examples.english_sentence: His ball skills are very good; he often plays on the school's representative team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 練多啲基本動作，可以提升你嘅球技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin6 do1 di1 gei1 bun2 dung6 zok3, ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 nei5 ge3 kau4 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多練習基本動作，可以提高你的球技。
examples.english_sentence: Practicing the basic moves more can improve your ball skills.

mandarin_meaning: 球拍（用于击打球的器具，如网球拍、羽毛球拍、乒乓球拍等）
english_meaning: racket; paddle (a tool used to hit a ball in sports such as tennis, badminton, table tennis)
explanation_mandarin: 指用于球类运动中击打球的器具，常见有网球拍、羽毛球拍、乒乓球拍等，材质和形状根据项目不同而不同。
explanation_english: Refers to the implement used to hit a ball in racket sports; common types include tennis rackets, badminton rackets, and table tennis paddles. Materials and shapes vary by sport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇帶球拍嚟？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 kau4 paak3 lai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有带球拍来？
examples.english_sentence: Did you bring your racket?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱買咗一支羽毛球拍，想星期日去打下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 maai5 zo2 jat1 zi1 jyu5 mou4 kau4 paak3, soeng2 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 daa2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚买了一只羽毛球拍，想星期天去打一下。
examples.english_sentence: I just bought a badminton racket and want to play on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把網球拍好重，要唔要我幫你拎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 mong5 kau4 paak3 hou2 zung6, jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 ling1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把网球拍很重，要不要我帮你拿？
examples.english_sentence: This tennis racket is heavy; do you want me to carry it for you?

mandarin_meaning: 球类运动中出色且有名的选手（运动明星）
english_meaning: a star player in ball sports; a sports star
explanation_mandarin: 指在足球、籃球、羽毛球等球類運動中技術出眾、具有高知名度與影響力的選手。
explanation_english: Refers to an athlete in ball sports (e.g., football, basketball) who is exceptionally skilled and widely famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好出名嘅球星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 kau4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位非常出名的球星。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous sports star.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球星比賽前要做好多訓練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 sing1 bei2 coi3 cin4 jiu3 zou6 hou2 do1 fan3 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球星在比賽前要做很多訓練。
examples.english_sentence: A sports star needs to do a lot of training before a match.

mandarin_meaning: 球会 (qiúhuì)；体育俱乐部
english_meaning: sports club; ball/football club
explanation_mandarin: 指以球類運動為主的組織或俱樂部，例如足球會、籃球會等。常用於廣東話語境，泛指以球類運動為核心的團體或社團。
explanation_english: An organization or club centered on ball sports (e.g., football club, basketball club). Commonly used in Cantonese to refer to a sports club or team focused on ball games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好支持自己嘅球會，個個週末都去睇比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zi1 ci4 zi6 gei2 ge3 kau4 wui6, go3 go3 zau1 mut6 dou1 heoi3 tai2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很支持自己的球会，每個週末都去看比賽。
examples.english_sentence: I strongly support my club; every weekend I go to watch the matches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球會下星期會舉行新球員招募日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 geoi2 hang4 san1 kau4 jyun4 ziu1 mou6 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球会下星期會舉行新球員招募日。
examples.english_sentence: The club will hold a recruitment/tryout day for new players next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉咗去另一間球會踢波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun3 zo2 heoi3 ling6 jat1 gaan1 kau4 wui6 tek3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他轉到另一家球會踢球了。
examples.english_sentence: He transferred to another club to play football.

mandarin_meaning: （某一球類運動的）最傑出、最具影響力或地位最高的球員，常用以稱呼傳奇或頂尖球星（如足球、籃球的「球王」）
english_meaning: The top or most celebrated player in a ball sport; "king" of a sport (e.g., the king of football), a legendary or top-tier player
explanation_mandarin: 「球王」用來稱呼在某一球類運動中技術、地位或影響力被廣泛認為是最頂尖的球員，通常帶有尊稱或崇敬的意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe a player widely regarded as the best, most influential, or most prominent in a particular ball sport; often an honorific for legendary or elite players.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都話佢係我哋學校嘅球王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 ge3 kau4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都说他是我们学校的球王。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone says he's the school's top player.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 梅西喺球場上嘅表現令佢成為咗唔少人心目中嘅球王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui4 sai1 hai2 kau4 coeng4 soeng6 ge3 biu2 jin6 ling6 keoi5 sing4 wai4 zo2 m4 siu2 jan4 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 kau4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 梅西在球场上的表现使他成为很多人心目中的球王。
examples.english_sentence: Messi's performances on the pitch made him the 'king' in many people's eyes.

mandarin_meaning: 球衣 (運動隊服)
english_meaning: jersey; sports shirt (team jersey)
explanation_mandarin: 指運動比賽或球隊成員所穿的專用上衣，通常會印有隊名、號碼或贊助商標誌。
explanation_english: A sports jersey or team shirt worn by players, typically displaying the team name, number, or sponsor logos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺旺角買咗一件新球衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 wong6 gok3 maai5 zo2 jat1 gin6 san1 kau4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在旺角買了一件新球衣。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new jersey in Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件球衣好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 kau4 ji1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的球衣很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Your jersey is very nice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出場前記得著返你嘅球衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 coeng4 cin4 gei3 dak1 zoek3 faan1 nei5 ge3 kau4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上場前記得穿好你的球衣。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to put on your jersey before going on the field.

mandarin_meaning: 球证；裁判（指体育比赛中的裁判员）
english_meaning: referee; match official (in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，常見於香港，指在球類比賽中執法的裁判員。常用於評價裁判的判罰，語氣可中性也可帶有不滿。
explanation_english: Colloquial term, common in Hong Kong, referring to the referee or match official in ball games. Used when commenting on officiating — neutral or sometimes disparaging in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場波啲球証判罰好唔公道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bo1 di1 kau4 zing3 pun3 faat3 hou2 m4 gung1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛裁判的判罚很不公正。
examples.english_sentence: The referee's decisions in this match are very unfair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好鬧球証，佢只係做緊工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 naau6 kau4 zing3, keoi5 zi2 hai6 zou6 gan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要责骂裁判，他只是在工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shout at the referee — he's just doing his job.

mandarin_meaning: （球類）裁判／裁判員
english_meaning: referee / umpire (official in ball games)
explanation_mandarin: 指在球類比賽中負責判定犯規、進球、界外等裁決的比賽裁判人員，等同於普通話的「裁判」或「裁判員」。
explanation_english: An official in ball games responsible for making decisions on fouls, goals, out-of-bounds, and other rule-related matters — equivalent to 'referee' or 'umpire'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽嗰個球證判罰好唔公平，球迷好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2sai3 go2 go3 gau2 zing3 pun3 fat6 hou2 m4 gung1 ping4, kau4 mai4 hou2 nau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今场比赛那个裁判判罚很不公平，球迷很生气。
examples.english_sentence: The referee in today's match made very unfair decisions; the fans are very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你對球證有異議，教練可以向場上主裁反映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 deoi3 gau2 zing3 jau5 ji6 ji3, gaau3 lin6 ho2 ji5 hoeng3 coeng4 soeng6 zyu2 coi4 faan2 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你对裁判有异议，教练可以向场上的主裁反映。
examples.english_sentence: If you have objections to the referee, the coach can report them to the head referee on the field.

mandarin_meaning: 球赛 (qiúsài) — 指各種球類運動的比賽，如足球、籃球等
english_meaning: ball game; a (sports) match — a competition in ball sports (e.g., football, basketball)
explanation_mandarin: 「球賽」是對各類球類比賽的總稱，用來指像足球、籃球、排球等的比賽場次或賽事。
explanation_english: “球賽” is a general term for matches of ball sports, referring to contests or games such as football, basketball, volleyball, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要去睇球賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 kau4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要去看球赛。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to watch the game tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場球賽好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 kau4 coi3 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场球赛很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: This match is very intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球賽幾點開始？
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 coi3 gei2 dim2 hoi1 ci2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球赛几点开始？
examples.english_sentence: What time does the match start?

mandarin_meaning: （体育）球类运动的爱好者或支持者，常指足球、篮球等运动的粉丝
english_meaning: a fan of ball sports (e.g., football/soccer, basketball); sports fan
explanation_mandarin: 指喜歡觀看、關注或支持球類運動（如足球、籃球等）的人。可用於口語和書面語，亦可加上具體項目如「足球迷」、「籃球迷」。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who enjoys watching, follows, or supports ball sports (such as football/soccer or basketball). Used in both spoken and written contexts; can be specified as e.g. "football fan" or "basketball fan."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係一個球迷，最鍾意睇足球比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 kau4 mai4, zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是一个球迷，最喜欢看足球比赛。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a fan (of ball sports); I like watching football/soccer matches the most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個城市有好多球迷支持我哋嘅主場球隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 go3 sing4 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 kau4 mai4 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zyu2 coeng4 kau4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个城市有很多球迷支持我们的主场球队。
examples.english_sentence: The whole city has many fans supporting our home team.

mandarin_meaning: 球門 (qiúmén)
english_meaning: goal (the goalmouth/goalposts/net in ball sports)
explanation_mandarin: 指各類球類運動中用來得分的門口或其構造（如球門框、球網），如足球、曲棍球、冰球等比賽中的得分目標位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the goal in ball sports—the goalmouth or the goal structure (posts, crossbar, net) used as the scoring target in games like soccer, hockey, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽最後一分鐘，佢踢入咗一球，直入球門，球隊贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1, keoi5 tek3 jap6 zo2 jat1 kau4, zik6 jap6 kau4 mun4, kau4 deoi6 jing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比賽最後一分鐘，他踢進了一球，直接進了球門，球隊贏了。
examples.english_sentence: In the last minute of the match, he kicked a ball straight into the goal and the team won.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 守門員企喺球門前，阻止對方入球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 mun4 jyun4 kei5 hai2 kau4 mun4 cin4, zo2 zi2 deoi3 fong1 jap6 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 守門員站在球門前，阻止對方得分。
examples.english_sentence: The goalkeeper stands in front of the goal to stop the opponent from scoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球門個網破咗，要換一個新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 mun4 go3 mong5 po3 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球門的網破了，需要換一個新的。
examples.english_sentence: The net of the goal is torn and needs to be replaced.

mandarin_meaning: 球队；参加球类比赛的队伍
english_meaning: team (specifically a ball-sports team, e.g., soccer team, basketball team)
explanation_mandarin: 指參加球類運動或比賽的隊伍，例如足球隊、籃球隊、排球隊等。
explanation_english: Refers to a team that participates in ball sports or competitions, such as a soccer team, basketball team, or volleyball team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚有足球比賽，記得去幫球隊打氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jau5 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3, gei3 dak1 heoi3 bong1 kau4 deoi2 daa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚有足球比赛，记得去帮球队加油。
examples.english_sentence: We have a soccer match tonight; remember to go cheer for the team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊需要新教練嚟訓練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 seoi1 jiu3 san1 gaau3 lin6 lai4 fan3 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队需要新教练来训练。
examples.english_sentence: The team needs a new coach to train.

mandarin_meaning: 球体（球形物体、球状体）
english_meaning: sphere; spherical body; ball-shaped object
explanation_mandarin: 表示形状像球的物体或几何上的球体，常用于描述球形的物件或天体等。
explanation_english: Refers to an object that is ball-shaped or a geometric sphere; used to describe spherical objects or bodies (e.g., planets, models).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個模型係用塑膠做成嘅球體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mou4 jing4 hai6 jung6 suk1 gaau1 zou6 sing4 ge3 kau4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个模型是用塑胶做成的球体。
examples.english_sentence: This model is a sphere made of plastic.

mandarin_meaning: 表示聲音清脆、響亮；多見於詞語如「琅琅上口」，也用作人名、地名等
english_meaning: Denotes a clear, resonant or tinkling sound; appears in expressions like '琅琅上口' meaning catchy or easy to pronounce; also used in names
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 擬聲詞（常見於複詞或成語中）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / onomatopoeia (commonly in compounds or idioms)
